teaching_sense.en_definition: The end of life, when a person or another living thing is no longer alive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或其他生物生命的终结，即不再存活的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tmiem tal-ħajja, meta persuna jew ħlejqa oħra ma tibqax ħajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 死亡；生命的终结。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega l-kawża tal-mewt u jindika d-data meta seħħet.
formal.en: The report explains the cause of death and gives the date on which it occurred.
formal.zh: 报告说明了死亡原因，并注明了死亡发生的日期。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Smajt bil-mewt tas-Sur Borg? Pawlu: Iva, kienet aħbar ta' niket. Nina: Dejjem kien jieqaf jitkellem magħna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you hear about Mr Borg's death? Pawlu: Yes, it was sad news. Nina: He always used to stop and talk to us.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你听说博尔格先生去世的消息了吗？保罗：听说了，真是令人难过。妮娜：他以前总会停下来和我们聊聊天。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.zh: 你听说博尔格先生去世的消息了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear about Mr Borg's death?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 听说了，真是令人难过。
messages.en: Yes, it was sad news.

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.zh: 他以前总会停下来和我们聊聊天。
messages.en: He always used to stop and talk to us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mewt 放进“生命终点”的概念卡片，配合 il-kawża tal-mewt 记住“死因”；再与强调一次死亡或死法的 mewta 对照。

gloss_zh: 一次死亡；某人的死亡；死法

teaching_sense.en_definition: An individual occurrence of death, or the particular way in which someone dies.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次具体的死亡事件，也可指某人死亡的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Każ wieħed ta' mewt, jew il-mod partikolari kif xi ħadd imut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 死亡；可指一次具体的死亡。
mewt 的单次形式：一次死亡。
某人死亡的一次事件；一例死亡。
死亡的方式；死法。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-mewta f'daqqa tal-protagonist tbiddel il-ħajja tal-familja kollha.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist's sudden death changes the life of the whole family.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，主人公的突然死亡改变了全家人的生活。

colloquial.mt: Sara: In-nannu tal-karattru kif miet? Mark: Miet mewta naturali, skont l-aħħar kapitlu. Sara: Issa fhimt għaliex il-familja nġabret kollha.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did the character's grandfather die? Mark: He died a natural death, according to the last chapter. Sara: Now I understand why the whole family gathered.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那个角色的祖父是怎么去世的？马克：按最后一章的说法，他是自然死亡。萨拉：现在我明白为什么全家人都聚在一起了。

messages.speaker: Sara (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 那个角色的祖父是怎么去世的？
messages.en: How did the character's grandfather die?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Miet mewta naturali, skont l-aħħar kapitlu.
messages.mt_standard: Miet mewta naturali, skont l-aħħar kapitlu.
messages.zh: 按最后一章的说法，他是自然死亡。
messages.en: He died a natural death, according to the last chapter.

messages.speaker: Sara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa fhimt għaliex il-familja nġabret kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Issa fhimt għaliex il-familja nġabret kollha.
messages.zh: 现在我明白为什么全家人都聚在一起了。
messages.en: Now I understand why the whole family gathered.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 mewta 时想一张具体人物的事件卡：谁去世、怎样去世；用 mewta naturali 把“一次死亡”和“死亡方式”一起记牢。

gloss_zh: 使平息；使消沉或冷漠；使停止；使死亡；使麻木

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause death, or to weaken or stop a feeling, activity, or response, including by discouraging or numbing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使死亡；也可指削弱或停止某种情感、活动或反应，使人灰心、冷漠或麻木。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd imut, jew idgħajjef jew iwaqqaf sentiment, attività jew reazzjoni, fosthom billi jaqta' l-qalb jew itellef is-sensazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使逐渐减弱；使平息。
使消沉；使沮丧。
使变得冷漠；使不再关心。
使某事停止；使终止。
造成死亡；使死亡。
杀死；使丧命。
使气馁；使灰心丧气。
使麻木；使感觉减弱或消失。

formal.mt: Il-kliem iebes tal-kowċ mewwet il-ħeġġa tat-tim u naqqas il-fiduċja tal-plejers.
formal.en: The coach's harsh words dampened the team's enthusiasm and reduced the players' confidence.
formal.zh: 教练严厉的话语挫伤了全队的热情，也削弱了球员们的信心。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Dak il-kumment mewwet il-ħeġġa tiegħi. Emma: Taqtax qalbek; ix-xogħol tiegħek qed jitjieb. Luca: Grazzi, se nerġa' nipprova.
colloquial.en: Luca: That comment dampened my enthusiasm. Emma: Don't lose heart; your work is improving. Luca: Thanks, I'll try again.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：那句评论打击了我的热情。艾玛：别灰心，你的作品正在进步。卢卡：谢谢，我会再试一次。

messages.speaker: Luca (学生)
messages.zh: 那句评论打击了我的热情。
messages.en: That comment dampened my enthusiasm.

messages.speaker: Emma (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Taqtax qalbek; ix-xogħol tiegħek qed jitjieb.
messages.mt_standard: Taqtax qalbek; ix-xogħol tiegħek qed jitjieb.
messages.zh: 别灰心，你的作品正在进步。
messages.en: Don't lose heart; your work is improving.

messages.speaker: Luca (学生)
messages.zh: 谢谢，我会再试一次。
messages.en: Thanks, I'll try again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mewwet 的义项分成三张学习卡：“生命停止”“热情减弱”“感觉麻木”；读例句时先看宾语，再判断具体含义。

gloss_zh: 使产生波浪；使起伏；使呈波浪状

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce waves or cause something to have a wavy shape or movement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产生波浪，或使某物呈波浪状、作波状起伏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħloq il-mewġ jew jagħmel xi ħaġa b'għamla jew moviment bħal tal-mewġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产生波浪；使出现波纹。
作波状起伏；呈波浪般运动。
使某物呈波浪状。
波状起伏；作波浪般的运动。

collocations.en: made the surface of the water ripple

formal.mt: Matul l-esperiment, il-mutur mewweġ wiċċ l-ilma fit-tank.
formal.en: During the experiment, the motor made the surface of the water in the tank ripple.
formal.zh: 实验过程中，电机使水箱里的水面泛起波纹。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Il-parrukkier mewweġ ix-xagħar tiegħek? Rita: Iva, għat-tieġ ta' oħti. Anna: Il-mewġ jidher sabiħ ħafna.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did the hairdresser make your hair wavy? Rita: Yes, for my sister's wedding. Anna: The waves look lovely.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：理发师给你做了波浪发型吗？丽塔：是的，为了参加我姐姐的婚礼。安娜：这些波浪卷真好看。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 理发师给你做了波浪发型吗？
messages.en: Did the hairdresser make your hair wavy?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，为了参加我姐姐的婚礼。
messages.en: Yes, for my sister's wedding.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些波浪卷真好看。
messages.en: The waves look lovely.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“让原本平直的东西变成波浪”记 mewweġ：一幅画是水面泛波，另一幅画是头发变卷，突出它表达的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a place believed to contain ghosts, or a place that is inhabited.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容被认为有鬼魂出没的地方；也可形容有人或其他居住者居住的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi post fejn jingħad li hemm il-fantażmi, jew post li fih jgħix xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闹鬼的；被认为有鬼魂出没的。
有居住者的；有人居住的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-kastell huwa mewwi: il-karattri jisimgħu passi fi kmamar vojta.
formal.en: In the story, the castle is haunted: the characters hear footsteps in empty rooms.
formal.zh: 故事中的城堡闹鬼：人物们听见空房间里传来脚步声。

colloquial.mt: Mila: Dan il-kastell mewwi, skont l-istorja? Noel: Iva, jgħidu li jidher fantażma fit-torri. Mila: Mela din l-istorja naqraha binhar!
colloquial.en: Mila: Is this castle haunted, according to the story? Noel: Yes, they say a ghost appears in the tower. Mila: Then I'll read this story during the day!
colloquial.zh: 米拉：按故事里的说法，这座城堡闹鬼吗？诺埃尔：是啊，据说塔里会出现一个鬼魂。米拉：那我还是白天读这个故事吧！

messages.speaker: Mila (读者)
messages.zh: 按故事里的说法，这座城堡闹鬼吗？
messages.en: Is this castle haunted, according to the story?

messages.speaker: Noel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jgħidu li jidher fantażma fit-torri.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jgħidu li jidher fantażma fit-torri.
messages.zh: 是啊，据说塔里会出现一个鬼魂。
messages.en: Yes, they say a ghost appears in the tower.

messages.speaker: Mila (读者)
messages.zh: 那我还是白天读这个故事吧！
messages.en: Then I'll read this story during the day!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 mewwi 画两幅独立场景：一幅是故事里有鬼魂的城堡，一幅是有住户的地方；靠上下文选择词义，不把“有人住”都理解成“闹鬼”。

gloss_zh: 小折刀制作或销售者；刀具匠；刀具商

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes or sells knives, especially small folding knives or penknives.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作或销售刀具的人，尤指制作或销售小折刀的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel jew tbigħ skieken, speċjalment skieken żgħar li jingħalqu.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who makes or sells pen-knives
sense_translations.zh_definition: 制作或销售小折刀的人。
刀具匠；刀具制造者或销售者。

formal.mt: Fil-wirja tal-artiġjanat, il-mewwies spjega kif jagħmel skieken żgħar li jingħalqu.
formal.en: At the craft exhibition, the cutler explained how he makes small folding knives.
formal.zh: 在手工艺展上，刀具匠讲解了他制作小折刀的方法。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min għamel din is-sikkina żgħira? Sara: Il-mewwies li għandu ħanut ħdejn il-pjazza. Mark: Il-manku sabiħ ħafna; jidher xogħol tas-sengħa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who made this small knife? Sara: The cutler who has a shop near the square. Mark: The handle is lovely; it looks like skilled work.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这把小刀是谁做的？萨拉：广场附近开店的那位刀具匠。马克：刀柄真漂亮，看得出手艺很好。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这把小刀是谁做的？
messages.en: Who made this small knife?

messages.speaker: Sara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-mewwies li għandu ħanut ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.mt_standard: Il-mewwies li għandu ħanut ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.zh: 广场附近开店的那位刀具匠。
messages.en: The cutler who has a shop near the square.

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-manku sabiħ ħafna; jidher xogħol tas-sengħa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-manku sabiħ ħafna; jidher xogħol tas-sengħa.
messages.zh: 刀柄真漂亮，看得出手艺很好。
messages.en: The handle is lovely; it looks like skilled work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mewwies 写在刀具店老板或工匠的名牌上，旁边画一把小折刀；记住这个词指制作或卖刀的“人”，而不是刀具本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to cause death; also used of something that causes deep despondency.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够导致死亡的；也可形容使人深感沮丧、意志消沉的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jikkawża l-mewt; jintuża wkoll għal xi ħaġa li ġġib qtigħ il-qalb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 导致死亡的。
使人沮丧、灰心或意志消沉的。
致命的；具有致死危险的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li l-gass mewwiet kien ta' periklu għall-ħaddiema.
formal.en: The report indicates that the deadly gas posed a danger to the workers.
formal.zh: 报告指出，这种致命气体对工人构成了危险。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm sinjal ta' periklu fuq dan il-flixkun? Pawlu: Għax fih velenu mewwiet. Tmissux.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is there a danger sign on this bottle? Pawlu: Because it contains deadly poison. Don't touch it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么这个瓶子上有危险标志？保罗：因为里面装着致命毒药。别碰它。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm sinjal ta' periklu fuq dan il-flixkun?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm sinjal ta' periklu fuq dan il-flixkun?
messages.zh: 为什么这个瓶子上有危险标志？
messages.en: Why is there a danger sign on this bottle?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 因为里面装着致命毒药。别碰它。
messages.en: Because it contains deadly poison. Don't touch it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mewwiet 和画有骷髅的毒药瓶一起记：先记“致命的”，再联想到让心情沉下去的“使人沮丧的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Waves on the surface of the sea or another body of water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 海洋或其他水体表面起伏的波浪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment tal-ilma li jitla' u jinżel fuq wiċċ il-baħar jew ta' medda oħra ta' ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 波浪；海浪。
海浪；海面起伏的运动。

formal.mt: Minħabba r-riħ qawwi u l-mewġ għoli, il-vjaġġ bid-dgħajsa ġie pospost.
formal.en: Because of the strong wind and high waves, the boat trip was postponed.
formal.zh: 由于风大浪高，乘船出游的行程被推迟了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid ninżlu ħdejn il-baħar? Ben: Iva, imma llum hemm ħafna mewġ. Lara: Mela noqogħdu fuq il-bank u nisimgħu l-baħar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall we go down to the seaside? Ben: Yes, but there are lots of waves today. Lara: Then let's sit on the bench and listen to the sea.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们去海边好吗？本：好，不过今天海浪很多。拉拉：那我们就坐在长椅上听海吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们去海边好吗？
messages.en: Shall we go down to the seaside?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma llum hemm ħafna mewġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma llum hemm ħafna mewġ.
messages.zh: 好，不过今天海浪很多。
messages.en: Yes, but there are lots of waves today.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela noqogħdu fuq il-bank u nisimgħu l-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Mela noqogħdu fuq il-bank u nisimgħu l-baħar.
messages.zh: 那我们就坐在长椅上听海吧。
messages.en: Then let's sit on the bench and listen to the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mewġ 和海边连续起伏的浪头一起记，再用 mewġ għoli 联想“浪高”，用 il-ħoss tal-mewġ 联想“浪声”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a wave-like shape or a surface that rises and falls in curves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有波浪般的形状，或表面呈弯曲起伏状态的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu għamla bħal mewġ jew wiċċ li jitla' u jinżel f'kurvi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 波浪状的；呈波纹的。
波状起伏的；呈连续高低曲线的。

formal.mt: Il-pannell għandu wiċċ mewġi li joħloq effetti differenti ta' dawl u dell.
formal.en: The panel has an undulating surface that creates different effects of light and shade.
formal.zh: 这块面板具有波状起伏的表面，能产生不同的光影效果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema disinn jogħġbok għall-purtieri? Toni: Dak mewġi, ħdejn it-tieqa. Maja: Iva, il-kurvi tiegħu sbieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which design do you like for the curtains? Toni: The wavy one, next to the window. Maja: Yes, its curves are lovely.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢哪一种窗帘图案？托尼：窗边那个波浪状的。玛雅：嗯，它的曲线很好看。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 你喜欢哪一种窗帘图案？
messages.en: Which design do you like for the curtains?

messages.speaker: Toni (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 窗边那个波浪状的。
messages.en: The wavy one, next to the window.

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 嗯，它的曲线很好看。
messages.en: Yes, its curves are lovely.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mewġi 贴在波浪图案旁，记成“看起来像波浪的”；与表示波浪本身的 mewġ 对照，练习区分事物和性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To walk or move forward; also to progress or advance in an activity or in life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 步行或向前移动；也指事情取得进展，或人在生活中有所发展。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imur minn post għal ieħor bil-mixi, jew jagħmel progress f'xi xogħol jew fil-ħajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 走路；步行。
进展；向前发展。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make one's way in the world
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在社会上立足并逐渐有所成就。
移动；行进。
取得进步；取得进展。
行事得体；按恰当的方式办事。
追随某人的足迹；走某人走过的道路。
与某人相处；与某人合得来。
跟随；遵循。
有销路；有需求；受到市场欢迎。
估算损失或损害的数额。
可行；能够实行。

formal.mt: Il-proġett mexa 'l quddiem wara li t-tim solva l-problema ewlenija.
formal.en: The project progressed after the team resolved the main problem.
formal.zh: 团队解决主要问题后，项目取得了进展。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif wasal id-dar Leo? Ninu: Mexa mill-istazzjon sad-dar. Ma ħax il-karozza tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Marta: How did Leo get home? Ninu: He walked from the station to his house. He didn't take the bus.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：利奥怎么回家的？尼努：他从车站走回了家，没有坐公交车。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 利奥怎么回家的？
messages.en: How did Leo get home?

messages.speaker: Ninu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mexa mill-istazzjon sad-dar. Ma ħax il-karozza tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Mexa mill-istazzjon sad-dar. Ma ħax il-karozza tal-linja.
messages.zh: 他从车站走回了家，没有坐公交车。
messages.en: He walked from the station to his house. He didn't take the bus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“人往前走，事情也往前走”串起 mexa：脚下是步行，项目里是进展，人生里是逐渐发展。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone or something to move forward, or to lead or manage a group or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或事物向前移动；也指带领群体、管理事务或推进活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa timxi 'l quddiem, jew imexxi grupp, xogħol jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人行走；让人走动。
带领；领导。
管理；经营；主持。
销售某种产品；把产品卖出去。
继续进行；往下推进。
指生意经营顺利、业绩良好。
帮助消化；促进食物消化。
移调或转置；将内容移到另一位置或调性。
赶快；加快动作或进度。

formal.mt: Id-direttur mexxa l-laqgħa u ta lil kull membru l-opportunità li jitkellem.
formal.en: The director chaired the meeting and gave every member an opportunity to speak.
formal.zh: 主任主持了会议，并给每位成员发言的机会。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min mexxa t-tim waqt li kont nieqsa? Mark: Mexxieh Toni, u kollox mar tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who led the team while I was away? Mark: Toni led it, and everything went well.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我不在的时候是谁带领团队的？马克：托尼带的，一切都很顺利。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min mexxa t-tim waqt li kont nieqsa?
messages.mt_standard: Min mexxa t-tim waqt li kont nieqsa?
messages.zh: 我不在的时候是谁带领团队的？
messages.en: Who led the team while I was away?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mexxieh Toni, u kollox mar tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Mexxieh Toni, u kollox mar tajjeb.
messages.zh: 托尼带的，一切都很顺利。
messages.en: Toni led it, and everything went well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mexa“向前走”和 mexxa“带着向前走”成对记；双写的 xx 可当作多一份推动力的学习提示。

gloss_zh: 领导者；首领；畅销的；高效的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who leads a group, directs its activities, or holds a position of authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 领导群体、指导其活动或处于领导地位的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tmexxi grupp, tidderieġi l-attivitajiet tiegħu jew għandha pożizzjoni ta' tmexxija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 领导者；带领群体的人。
首领；主管；居于主要领导地位的人。
需求旺盛的；有销路的；畅销的。
办事迅速的；高效的；利落的。

formal.mt: Il-mexxej tat-tim ippreżenta l-pjan u qassam ix-xogħol fost il-membri.
formal.en: The team leader presented the plan and distributed the work among the members.
formal.zh: 团队负责人介绍了计划，并在成员之间分配了工作。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min hu l-mexxej tal-grupp tagħna? Ġanni: David. Jekk għandek mistoqsija, tista' tkellmu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who is the leader of our group? Ġanni: David. If you have a question, you can speak to him.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我们的小组负责人是谁？詹尼：戴维。如果你有问题，可以找他谈。

messages.speaker: Rita (小组新成员)
messages.zh: 我们的小组负责人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the leader of our group?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: David. Jekk għandek mistoqsija, tista' tkellmu.
messages.mt_standard: David. Jekk għandek mistoqsija, tista' tkellmu.
messages.zh: 戴维。如果你有问题，可以找他谈。
messages.en: David. If you have a question, you can speak to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mexxej 放在团队最前面想象：他负责带领大家。另做形容词卡片记“畅销、高效”，避免把所有用法都当人名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A method, device, or other means used to achieve a purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了达到某个目的而使用的方法、工具或其他手段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Metodu, għodda jew xi ħaġa oħra li tintuża biex jintlaħaq għan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手段；用来达到目的的途径或工具。
方法；办事的方式。
一种手段，具体可指器具、装置或方法。

formal.mt: Il-posta elettronika hija mezz ta' komunikazzjoni bejn l-iskola u l-ġenituri.
formal.en: Email is a means of communication between the school and parents.
formal.zh: 电子邮件是学校与家长之间的一种沟通手段。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandna mezz ta' trasport għal għada? Luqa: Iva, nistgħu mmorru bil-karozza ta' oħti.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do we have a means of transport for tomorrow? Luqa: Yes, we can go in my sister's car.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我们明天有交通工具吗？卢卡：有，可以坐我姐姐的车去。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna mezz ta' trasport għal għada?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna mezz ta' trasport għal għada?
messages.zh: 我们明天有交通工具吗？
messages.en: Do we have a means of transport for tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nistgħu mmorru bil-karozza ta' oħti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nistgħu mmorru bil-karozza ta' oħti.
messages.zh: 有，可以坐我姐姐的车去。
messages.en: Yes, we can go in my sister's car.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“达到目的要有办法”：车是出行的 mezz，邮件是沟通的 mezz；把方法与工具都装进这个词。

gloss_zh: 老板；工头；主管；有学问的人；导师

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who directs other people's work, or someone respected for knowledge and teaching.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指挥、管理他人工作的人，也可指因学识或教导而受尊敬的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tmexxi x-xogħol ta' oħrajn, jew persuna rispettata għall-għarfien u t-tagħlim tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有学问的人；学识渊博者
老板；上司
首领；负责人
工头；领班
经理；主管
老板；工头

sense_translations.en_definition: leader or teacher of a group (e.g. biblically of Jesus, in the sense of rabbi)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 团体的领袖或导师，如《圣经》中以拉比、老师之意称呼耶稣

formal.mt: L-imgħallem spjega lill-ħaddiema kif kellu jsir ix-xogħol.
formal.en: The foreman explained to the workers how the work was to be done.
formal.zh: 工头向工人们说明了这项工作应当怎样完成。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hu l-imgħallem? Maja: Qiegħed fl-uffiċċju. Trid tkellmu?
colloquial.en: Mark: Where's the boss? Maja: He's in the office. Do you want to speak to him?
colloquial.zh: 马克：老板在哪儿？玛雅：他在办公室。你要找他说话吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (员工)
messages.zh: 老板在哪儿？
messages.en: Where's the boss?

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 他在办公室。你要找他说话吗？
messages.en: He's in the office. Do you want to speak to him?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个既安排工作又传授经验的人：在工地是工头，在学习场景中是导师，按语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hand tool used to loosen, dig or turn soil in a garden or field.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在花园或田地中用来松土、挖土或翻土的手工农具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda tal-idejn li tintuża biex tinħadem, titħaffer jew tinqaleb il-ħamrija fi ġnien jew għalqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锄头；用来松土、除草的农具
园艺铲；园艺用的挖土工具
铁锹；挖土用的铲

collocations.en: to work the soil with a hoe

formal.mt: Il-bidwi uża mgħażqa biex ineħħi l-ħaxix ħażin minn madwar il-pjanti.
formal.en: The farmer used a hoe to remove weeds from around the plants.
formal.zh: 农夫用锄头清除了植株周围的杂草。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' ġġibli l-imgħażqa? Mark: Iva, qiegħda ħdejn il-bieb tal-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you bring me the hoe? Mark: Yes, it's beside the garden gate.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能把锄头拿给我吗？马克：可以，它就在花园门旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺伙伴)
messages.zh: 你能把锄头拿给我吗？
messages.en: Can you bring me the hoe?

messages.speaker: Mark (园艺伙伴)
messages.zh: 可以，它就在花园门旁边。
messages.en: Yes, it's beside the garden gate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与花园里松土、除草的动作一起记：看见长柄农具，就联想锄头或挖土铲。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A negative word meaning 'not', used to deny an identity, quality or circumstance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示否定的词，意为“不”或“不是”，用于否定身份、性质或情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tesprimi ċaħda ta' identità, kwalità jew ċirkostanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不；不是；表示否定

sense_translations.en_definition: not; negates nominal sentences, adjectives, adverbs
sense_translations.zh_definition: 不；不是；用于否定名词性句子、形容词或副词

formal.mt: Dan id-dokument mhux kuntratt, iżda sommarju tal-proposta.
formal.en: This document is not a contract, but a summary of the proposal.
formal.zh: 这份文件不是合同，而是提案摘要。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-ktieb tiegħek? Maja: Le, mhux tiegħi. Naħseb li hu ta' Pawlu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this book yours? Maja: No, it isn't mine. I think it's Paul's.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这本书是你的吗？玛雅：不，不是我的。我想是保罗的。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这本书是你的吗？
messages.en: Is this book yours?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, mhux tiegħi. Naħseb li hu ta' Pawlu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, mhux tiegħi. Naħseb li hu ta' Pawlu.
messages.zh: 不，不是我的。我想是保罗的。
messages.en: No, it isn't mine. I think it's Paul's.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记整块表达：mhux tiegħi 是“不是我的”，mhux dejjem 是“并非总是”，用否定句带住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong feeling of hate or hostility towards a person, group, or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某个人、群体或事物怀有的强烈憎恶或敌意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sentiment qawwi ta' stmerrija jew ostilità lejn persuna, grupp jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仇恨；对某人或某事的强烈憎恶。
憎恨；仇恨，指强烈的敌意或厌恶情绪。

formal.mt: L-iskola tħeġġeġ lill-istudenti jsolvu n-nuqqas ta' qbil bid-djalogu u mingħajr mibegħda.
formal.en: The school encourages students to resolve disagreements through dialogue and without hatred.
formal.zh: 学校鼓励学生通过对话化解分歧，不怀仇恨。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek irrabjat ma' Pawlu? Toni: Iva, imma ma nħossx mibegħda lejh. Irrid nitkellem miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you still angry with Pawlu? Toni: Yes, but I don't feel hatred towards him. I want to talk to him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还在生保罗的气吗？托尼：是的，但我并不恨他。我想和他谈谈。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还在生保罗的气吗？
messages.en: Are you still angry with Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ma nħossx mibegħda lejh. Irrid nitkellem miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ma nħossx mibegħda lejh. Irrid nitkellem miegħu.
messages.zh: 是的，但我并不恨他。我想和他谈谈。
messages.en: Yes, but I don't feel hatred towards him. I want to talk to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mibegħda 放进“对他人怀有仇恨”的场景记忆：它表示强烈而持续的憎恨，比一时生气更重。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where one or more people are buried, such as a grave, burial ground, or cemetery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 埋葬一个或多个人的地点，可指某人的坟墓，也可指整片墓地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn tkun midfuna persuna waħda jew aktar, bħal qabar jew ċimiterju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 埋葬死者的场地；墓地。
公墓；供安葬死者的墓园。

sense_translations.en_definition: burial site; someone's grave; a place where one or more persons are buried
sense_translations.zh_definition: 埋葬地点；某人的坟墓；安葬一个或多个人的地方。
墓园；坟场。

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi l-post tal-midfen antik u t-triq li twassal għalih.
formal.en: The map shows the location of the old burial ground and the road leading to it.
formal.zh: 地图标出了古老墓地的位置及通往那里的道路。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu l-midfen tal-familja tagħkom? Mark: Ħdejn il-knisja l-qadima. Immorru hemm il-Ħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is your family's burial place? Mark: Beside the old church. We're going there on Sunday.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你们家的墓地在哪里？马克：在老教堂旁边。我们星期日去那里。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们家的墓地在哪里？
messages.en: Where is your family's burial place?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-knisja l-qadima. Immorru hemm il-Ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-knisja l-qadima. Immorru hemm il-Ħadd.
messages.zh: 在老教堂旁边。我们星期日去那里。
messages.en: Beside the old church. We're going there on Sunday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用地图上的墓地标记来记 midfen：核心是“安葬的地方”，范围可以小到一座坟墓，也可以大到一片墓园。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who habitually curses or blasphemes, or language that expresses such cursing or blasphemy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人经常咒骂或说亵渎神圣的话，也可形容具有这类性质的言辞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil min jidgħi ta' spiss, jew kliem li jesprimi dagħa.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who curses or blasphemes habitually
sense_translations.zh_definition: 惯于咒骂或亵渎神圣的，形容经常有这类言语行为的人。
亵渎神圣的；咒骂的。

collocations.en: a man who habitually curses or blasphemes
collocations.zh: 惯于咒骂或说亵渎话的男子

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru ewlieni huwa raġel midgħi li juża kliem offensiv meta jirrabja.
formal.en: In the story, the main character is a man who habitually curses and uses offensive language when he gets angry.
formal.zh: 故事中的主角是个惯于咒骂的男子，生气时会使用冒犯性的言辞。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma tridx toqgħod ħdejh? Ben: Għax hu midgħi u ma nieħux gost nisma' dak il-kliem.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why don't you want to sit next to him? Ben: Because he keeps cursing, and I don't like hearing that language.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么不想坐在他旁边？本：因为他老是咒骂，我不喜欢听那些话。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不想坐在他旁边？
messages.en: Why don't you want to sit next to him?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu midgħi u ma nieħux gost nisma' dak il-kliem.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu midgħi u ma nieħux gost nisma' dak il-kliem.
messages.zh: 因为他老是咒骂，我不喜欢听那些话。
messages.en: Because he keeps cursing, and I don't like hearing that language.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 midgħi 贴在“动不动就咒骂的人”的人物卡上：记住它是描述言语习惯或亵渎性质的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Grease or greasy material; also a person who is slovenly in appearance or habits.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 油脂或油腻物质；也指外表或生活习惯邋遢、不整洁的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xaħam jew materjal żejtni; ukoll persuna traskurata fid-dehra jew fl-indafa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 油脂；油腻的物质。
邋遢的人；不注意外表或整洁的人，带贬义。

formal.mt: Qabel ma tuża l-għodda, neħħi s-saff ta' midilka minn fuq il-manku.
formal.en: Before using the tool, remove the layer of grease from the handle.
formal.zh: 使用工具前，请清除手柄上的那层油脂。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex ma tridx tmiss il-manku? Karl: Għax hemm il-midilka fuqu. Ġib ċarruta biex innaddfu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why don't you want to touch the handle? Karl: Because there's grease on it. Bring a cloth so we can clean it.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么不想碰那个手柄？卡尔：因为上面有油脂。拿块布来，我们把它擦干净。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么不想碰那个手柄？
messages.en: Why don't you want to touch the handle?

messages.speaker: Karl (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hemm il-midilka fuqu. Ġib ċarruta biex innaddfu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hemm il-midilka fuqu. Ġib ċarruta biex innaddfu.
messages.zh: 因为上面有油脂。拿块布来，我们把它擦干净。
messages.en: Because there's grease on it. Bring a cloth so we can clean it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“油腻的手柄”和“邋遢的人”两幅画记 midilka 的两个义项；这是学习联想，见到具体句子时再判断它指物还是指人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who commits sin, especially in a religious context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 犯有罪过的人，尤其用于宗教语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel id-dnub, speċjalment f'kuntest reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 罪人；在宗教或道德意义上犯有罪过的人。

formal.mt: It-test reliġjuż jiddeskrivi midneb li jindem u jitlob maħfra.
formal.en: The religious text describes a sinner who repents and asks for forgiveness.
formal.zh: 这篇宗教文本描述了一个悔罪并请求宽恕的罪人。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi jfisser midneb f'din is-silta? David: Persuna li tagħmel id-dnub. Hawnhekk qed titlob maħfra.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does midneb mean in this passage? David: A person who commits sin. Here, the person is asking for forgiveness.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这段话里的 midneb 是什么意思？戴维：指犯有罪过的人。这里说的是这个人在请求宽恕。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 这段话里的 midneb 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does midneb mean in this passage?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Persuna li tagħmel id-dnub. Hawnhekk qed titlob maħfra.
messages.mt_standard: Persuna li tagħmel id-dnub. Hawnhekk qed titlob maħfra.
messages.zh: 指犯有罪过的人。这里说的是这个人在请求宽恕。
messages.en: A person who commits sin. Here, the person is asking for forgiveness.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象宗教故事中一个请求宽恕的人，把 midneb 记作“罪人”；重点抓住宗教语境中的罪过，避免直接等同于法律上的罪犯。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fork or shovel used in threshing or winnowing grain, including tossing it to separate the grain from the chaff.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于谷物脱粒或扬谷的叉或铲，可用来扬起谷物，使谷粒与糠壳分离。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda bħal furketta jew pala li tintuża fid-dris jew biex jitwaddab il-qamħ fl-arja u jinfired mill-karfa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脱粒叉；用于谷物脱粒作业的农用叉。
扬谷叉或扬谷铲；用来扬起谷物、借风分离谷粒与糠壳的工具。

collocations.en: to winnow wheat with a winnowing fork

formal.mt: Il-bidwi juża l-midra biex iwaddab il-qamħ fl-arja, u r-riħ iġorr il-karfa.
formal.en: The farmer uses the winnowing fork to toss the wheat into the air, and the wind carries away the chaff.
formal.zh: 农民用扬谷叉把小麦扬到空中，让风吹走糠壳。

colloquial.mt: Mila: X'inhi dik l-għodda tal-injam? Ġanni: Dik midra. Nużaha biex inderri l-qamħ u nifirdu mill-karfa.
colloquial.en: Mila: What's that wooden tool? Ġanni: That's a winnowing fork. I use it to winnow the wheat and separate it from the chaff.
colloquial.zh: 米拉：那个木制工具是什么？詹尼：那是扬谷叉。我用它扬麦，把麦粒和糠壳分开。

messages.speaker: Mila (访客)
messages.zh: 那个木制工具是什么？
messages.en: What's that wooden tool?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik midra. Nużaha biex inderri l-qamħ u nifirdu mill-karfa.
messages.mt_standard: Dik midra. Nużaha biex inderri l-qamħ u nifirdu mill-karfa.
messages.zh: 那是扬谷叉。我用它扬麦，把麦粒和糠壳分开。
messages.en: That's a winnowing fork. I use it to winnow the wheat and separate it from the chaff.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 midra 时想象“叉起谷物、向空中扬、风吹走糠壳”三个连续动作；用工具的用途记词，比只背“叉子”更准确。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A machine or implement used to separate grain from harvested stalks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将收割后的谷物籽粒从茎秆或穗上分离出来的机器或工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magna jew għodda li tintuża biex tifred il-qamħ mis-sbul.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脱粒机，用于将谷粒从穗上分离的农业机械。
脱粒工具，用于使谷粒脱离谷穗的农具。

collocations.en: to use the threshing machine or implement
collocations.zh: 使用脱粒机或脱粒工具

formal.mt: Il-bidwi uża l-midras biex jifred il-qamħ mis-sbul wara l-ħsad.
formal.en: The farmer used the threshing machine to separate the wheat from the ears after the harvest.
formal.zh: 收割后，农民使用脱粒机将麦粒从麦穗上分离出来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għal xiex jintuża dan il-midras? Toni: Biex jifred il-qamħ mis-sbul.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this threshing machine used for? Toni: To separate the wheat from the ears.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这台脱粒机是做什么用的？托尼：用来把麦粒从麦穗上分离出来。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 这台脱粒机是做什么用的？
messages.en: What is this threshing machine used for?

messages.speaker: Toni (农民)
messages.zh: 用来把麦粒从麦穗上分离出来。
messages.en: To separate the wheat from the ears.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 midras 配上“麦穗进去、谷粒出来”的画面，记住它是脱粒机或脱粒工具。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small window that allows light to enter a room or other enclosed space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让光线进入房间或其他封闭空间的小窗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tieqa żgħira li minnha jidħol id-dawl f'kamra jew fi spazju magħluq.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small window that lets light in
sense_translations.zh_definition: 让光线照进室内的小窗；采光小窗。

sense_translations.en_definition: small window to let light in
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于引入光线的小窗。

collocations.en: a small light-admitting window in the wall
the light coming through the small window
collocations.zh: 从采光小窗透进来的光

formal.mt: Midwal fil-parti ta' fuq tal-ħajt iħalli d-dawl jidħol fil-kamra.
formal.en: A small window in the upper part of the wall lets light into the room.
formal.zh: 墙壁上部的一扇采光小窗让光线进入房间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Minn fejn ġej dan id-dawl? Mark: Mill-midwal hemm fuq, ħdejn is-saqaf.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is this light coming from? Mark: Through the small window up there, near the ceiling.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这光是从哪里来的？马克：从上面靠近天花板的那扇小窗透进来的。

messages.speaker: Sara (访客)
messages.zh: 这光是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where is this light coming from?

messages.speaker: Mark (屋主)
messages.zh: 从上面靠近天花板的那扇小窗透进来的。
messages.en: Through the small window up there, near the ceiling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象暗房墙上开了一扇小窗，一束光照进来；用这个画面把 midwal 记成“采光小窗”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A decorative light fitting that hangs from a ceiling and has several branches or lights.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 悬挂在天花板上、带有多个灯臂或光源的装饰性吊灯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lampa dekorattiva mdendla mis-saqaf, b'diversi friegħi jew dwal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一盏枝形吊灯，即带有多个灯臂或光源的装饰性吊灯。
枝形吊灯；多灯臂装饰吊灯。

collocations.en: a chandelier hanging from the ceiling
collocations.zh: 悬挂在天花板上的枝形吊灯

formal.mt: Midwala tal-kristall kienet imdendla f'nofs is-sala u kienet iddawwal l-imwejjed.
formal.en: A crystal chandelier hung in the middle of the hall and illuminated the tables.
formal.zh: 大厅中央悬挂着一盏水晶枝形吊灯，照亮了各张桌子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Togħġbok din il-midwala? Pawlu: Iva, imma hija kbira wisq għall-kamra tagħna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you like this chandelier? Pawlu: Yes, but it is too big for our room.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你喜欢这盏枝形吊灯吗？保罗：喜欢，不过放在我们房间里太大了。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这盏枝形吊灯吗？
messages.en: Do you like this chandelier?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (伴侣)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma hija kbira wisq għall-kamra tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma hija kbira wisq għall-kamra tagħna.
messages.zh: 喜欢，不过放在我们房间里太大了。
messages.en: Yes, but it is too big for our room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 midwala 放进“抬头看见多臂水晶吊灯”的场景，并与表示采光小窗的 midwal 分开记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container used for melting material, or a foundry where metal is melted and cast.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于熔化材料的容器；也指熔化并浇铸金属的铸造厂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent li jintuża biex idewweb materjal, jew fabbrika fejn il-metall jiddewweb u jitferra' fil-forom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于熔化材料的容器；熔化容器。
一家铸造厂，即熔化金属并将其浇入铸模的工厂。
铸造厂；进行金属熔化和浇铸的生产场所。

formal.mt: Fil-midweb, il-ħaddiema dewbu l-metall u ferrgħuh fil-forom.
formal.en: At the foundry, the workers melted the metal and poured it into moulds.
formal.zh: 在铸造厂里，工人们将金属熔化，再倒入铸模。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għal xiex jintuża dan il-midweb? Ġużeppi: Biex indewbu l-metall fih.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is this melting container used for? Ġużeppi: To melt metal in it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个熔化容器是做什么用的？朱塞佩：用来在里面熔化金属。

messages.speaker: Nina (学徒)
messages.zh: 这个熔化容器是做什么用的？
messages.en: What is this melting container used for?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (工匠)
messages.zh: 用来在里面熔化金属。
messages.en: To melt metal in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个大小不同的画面记 midweb：近看是熔化材料的容器，远看是进行金属浇铸的工厂。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entrance or means of access; also a coastal inlet, bay, or port.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进入某处的入口或通道；也可指海岸的水湾、海湾或港口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daħla jew passaġġ li jagħti aċċess għal post; ukoll daħla fil-kosta, bajja jew port.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 入口；进入的通道；水湾；海湾；港口。
入口；进入某处的地方。
海湾；港口。

formal.mt: Il-pjanta tindika l-midħal ewlieni tal-bini u l-passaġġ għall-viżitaturi.
formal.en: The plan indicates the building's main entrance and the passage for visitors.
formal.zh: 平面图标明了建筑物的主入口和访客通道。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Minn fejn nidħlu? Sam: Il-midħal qiegħed fuq ix-xellug, ħdejn it-tieqa l-kbira.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where do we go in? Sam: The entrance is on the left, beside the large window.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们从哪里进去？萨姆：入口在左边，就在大窗户旁边。

messages.speaker: Nina (访客)
messages.zh: 我们从哪里进去？
messages.en: Where do we go in?

messages.speaker: Sam (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-midħal qiegħed fuq ix-xellug, ħdejn it-tieqa l-kbira.
messages.mt_standard: Il-midħal qiegħed fuq ix-xellug, ħdejn it-tieqa l-kbira.
messages.zh: 入口在左边，就在大窗户旁边。
messages.en: The entrance is on the left, beside the large window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张图记 midħal：一张是建筑入口，一张是船只进入的海湾。把它们并排联想，帮助记住陆地入口和海岸地点两组词义。

gloss_zh: 熟悉；内情知识；专门知识

teaching_sense.en_definition: Familiarity with a subject or situation, including inside knowledge or expertise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某个领域或情况的熟悉程度，可包括对内情的了解或专门知识。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għarfien ta' suġġett jew sitwazzjoni, li jista' jinkludi tagħrif minn ġewwa jew għarfien speċjalizzat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 熟悉；对某人、某事或某个领域的了解。
对内情的了解；掌握内部情况的知识。
专门知识；在某个领域的熟练认识与能力。

collocations.en: he is familiar with the subject
he has inside knowledge of the situation

formal.mt: L-awtur għandu midħla tajba tal-istorja lokali u jispjega s-suġġett b'mod ċar.
formal.en: The author has a good knowledge of local history and explains the subject clearly.
formal.zh: 作者熟悉当地历史，对这一主题的讲解清楚明白。

colloquial.mt: Eva: Lil min nistaqsu dwar l-istorja tar-raħal? Leo: Staqsi lil Ġużeppi. Għandu midħla tajba tagħha.
colloquial.en: Eva: Who should we ask about the village's history? Leo: Ask Ġużeppi. He knows it well.
colloquial.zh: 埃娃：关于村子的历史，我们该问谁？莱奥：问朱塞佩吧。他很熟悉这方面的情况。

messages.speaker: Eva (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min nistaqsu dwar l-istorja tar-raħal?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min nistaqsu dwar l-istorja tar-raħal?
messages.zh: 关于村子的历史，我们该问谁？
messages.en: Who should we ask about the village's history?

messages.speaker: Leo (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsi lil Ġużeppi. Għandu midħla tajba tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsi lil Ġużeppi. Għandu midħla tajba tagħha.
messages.zh: 问朱塞佩吧。他很熟悉这方面的情况。
messages.en: Ask Ġużeppi. He knows it well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għandu midħla 整块记成“他对此很熟悉”：从了解一个主题，到知道内情，再到拥有专门知识，按熟悉程度串联三个义项。

gloss_zh: 充分咀嚼；吐字清楚或含糊咕哝（依语境）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To chew food thoroughly before swallowing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把食物充分嚼碎后再吞咽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tomgħod l-ikel sewwa qabel tibla'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 充分咀嚼；仔细把食物嚼碎。

sense_translations.en_definition: to speak intelligibly, to mumble one's words
sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话清楚易懂；也可指含糊地咕哝、吐字不清，须根据上下文区分。

formal.mt: It-tifel miegħed kull gidma sewwa qabel bela'.
formal.en: The boy chewed every mouthful thoroughly before swallowing.
formal.zh: 男孩每一口都充分咀嚼后才吞下去。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex dam daqshekk jiekol Leo? Mark: Miegħed kull gidma sewwa; ma kielx bl-għaġla.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did Leo take so long to eat? Mark: He chewed every mouthful thoroughly; he did not rush his food.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：利奥怎么吃了这么久？马克：他每一口都仔细嚼了，没有急着吃。

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 利奥怎么吃了这么久？
messages.en: Why did Leo take so long to eat?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Miegħed kull gidma sewwa; ma kielx bl-għaġla.
messages.mt_standard: Miegħed kull gidma sewwa; ma kielx bl-għaġla.
messages.zh: 他每一口都仔细嚼了，没有急着吃。
messages.en: He chewed every mouthful thoroughly; he did not rush his food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“每一口都慢慢嚼碎”的动作记住 miegħed；遇到说话语境，再结合上下文判断吐字含义。

gloss_zh: 把人摔倒；使人在地上翻滚；粗暴对待

teaching_sense.en_definition: To throw someone down, make them roll on the ground, or handle them roughly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人摔倒、弄得在地上翻滚，或粗暴地摆弄、对待某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Twaqqa' lil xi ħadd mal-art, iġġiegħlu jitgerbeb, jew tittrattah b'mod goff u vjolenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某人摔倒在地。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make sb. roll on the floor
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人在地板上翻滚。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make someone roll on the ground
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人在地面上翻滚。
粗暴地摆弄或对待某人，如用力拉扯、推搡。

collocations.en: threw down or roughly handled the opponent

formal.mt: Waqt il-ġlieda, ir-raġel miegħek lill-avversarju mal-art.
formal.en: During the fight, the man threw his opponent to the ground.
formal.zh: 打斗中，那名男子把对手摔倒在地。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lil Toni? Sara: Raġel miegħek lil Toni mal-art, imma issa jinsab tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to Toni? Sara: A man threw Toni to the ground, but he is all right now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：托尼怎么了？萨拉：一个男人把托尼摔到了地上，不过他现在没事了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 托尼怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to Toni?

messages.speaker: Sara (目击者)
messages.mt_spoken: Raġel miegħek lil Toni mal-art, imma issa jinsab tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Raġel miegħek lil Toni mal-art, imma issa jinsab tajjeb.
messages.zh: 一个男人把托尼摔到了地上，不过他现在没事了。
messages.en: A man threw Toni to the ground, but he is all right now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词放进“某人被摔倒、在地上翻滚”的连续画面里，连同“粗暴对待”的含义一起记。

gloss_zh: 苛刻贬损；不公正地批评

teaching_sense.en_definition: To treat someone harshly by contradicting, belittling, or unfairly criticizing them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过刻意反驳、贬低或不公正地批评，苛刻地对待某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tittratta lil xi ħadd bl-aħrax billi tmeri, iċċekken jew tikkritika lil dik il-persuna b'mod inġust.

sense_translations.en_definition: to treat sb. very harshly by contradicting or otherwise putting them down
sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过反驳、贬低等方式非常苛刻地对待某人。

sense_translations.en_definition: to run down, to criticize someone unfairly
sense_translations.zh_definition: 贬损某人；对某人作不公正的批评。

collocations.mt: miegħer lil xi ħadd quddiem kulħadd
collocations.en: put someone down in front of everyone
collocations.zh: 当着众人的面贬损某人

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, il-maniġer miegħer lill-impjegat quddiem il-kollegi kollha mingħajr ma sema' l-ispjegazzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: During the meeting, the manager belittled the employee in front of all his colleagues without hearing his explanation.
formal.zh: 会议中，经理没有听取那名员工的解释，就当着所有同事的面贬损他。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark ħareġ imdejjaq? Pawlu: Il-kap miegħer lil Mark quddiem kulħadd. Ma kienx ġust miegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark leave looking upset? Pawlu: The boss put Mark down in front of everyone. He was unfair to him.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：马克怎么一脸难过地出去了？保罗：老板当着大家的面贬损了马克，对他很不公平。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 马克怎么一脸难过地出去了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave looking upset?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kap miegħer lil Mark quddiem kulħadd. Ma kienx ġust miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kap miegħer lil Mark quddiem kulħadd. Ma kienx ġust miegħu.
messages.zh: 老板当着大家的面贬损了马克，对他很不公平。
messages.en: The boss put Mark down in front of everyone. He was unfair to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人在会上不断反驳、当众贬低别人；把 miegħer 与这种苛刻且不公平的批评场景绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be profitable or produce a financial gain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产生利润或带来经济收益。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħalli qligħ jew jagħti dħul akbar mill-ispejjeż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有利润；能够产生经济收益。

formal.mt: Il-proġett miegħex fl-ewwel sena, għax id-dħul kien akbar mill-ispejjeż.
formal.en: The project was profitable in its first year because its income exceeded its costs.
formal.zh: 这个项目第一年就实现了盈利，因为收入超过了成本。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-ħanut miegħex din is-sena? Toni: Iva, id-dħul kien akbar mill-ispejjeż u baqa' qligħ sabiħ.
colloquial.en: Nina: Was the shop profitable this year? Toni: Yes, income exceeded expenses and there was a good profit left over.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这家店今年盈利了吗？托尼：是的，收入超过了支出，还留下了一笔不错的利润。

messages.speaker: Nina (合伙人)
messages.zh: 这家店今年盈利了吗？
messages.en: Was the shop profitable this year?

messages.speaker: Toni (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, id-dħul kien akbar mill-ispejjeż u baqa' qligħ sabiħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, id-dħul kien akbar mill-ispejjeż u baqa' qligħ sabiħ.
messages.zh: 是的，收入超过了支出，还留下了一笔不错的利润。
messages.en: Yes, income exceeded expenses and there was a good profit left over.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“收入减去成本，最后还有钱剩下”的账本画面记住 miegħex，核心就是经营或项目有利润。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To work gradually, or to slow something down and cause a delay.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 逐步进行工作；也可表示使进程放慢或造成延误。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħdem ftit ftit, jew inaqqas il-ħeffa ta' xi ħaġa u jikkawża dewmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐步工作，一点一点地做。
使进展减慢；使延迟，拖延。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem miehel fix-xogħol u temm parti żgħira kuljum.
formal.en: The worker worked gradually at the task and completed a small part each day.
formal.zh: 这名工人逐步开展工作，每天完成一小部分。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex ix-xogħol għadu ma spiċċax? Pawlu: In-nuqqas ta' materjal miehel il-progress.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why isn't the work finished yet? Pawlu: The shortage of materials slowed down progress.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：工作怎么还没完成？保罗：材料短缺拖慢了进度。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 工作怎么还没完成？
messages.en: Why isn't the work finished yet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 材料短缺拖慢了进度。
messages.en: The shortage of materials slowed down progress.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面想成缓慢移动的进度条：自己一点点做是“逐步工作”，事情被拖慢则是“延缓”；结合句中的对象区分。

gloss_zh: 倾斜；弯身；跪下；倾向；俯首；财富（名词）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lean or bend in a direction, kneel or bow down, or show a preference for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体或物体向某方向倾斜、弯下，也可表示跪下、俯首，或在选择上有所倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinżel jew jitgħawweġ lejn naħa, jinżel għarkupptejh jew ibaxxi rasu, jew juri preferenza għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向某一方向倾斜。
弯曲；弯下身体。
跪下，屈膝着地。
倾向于某事；有某种意愿或偏好。
俯首，躬身低头。
财富，财产。

formal.mt: Wara li qara ż-żewġ proposti, id-direttur miel lejn it-tieni waħda.
formal.en: After reading both proposals, the director was inclined towards the second one.
formal.zh: 读完两项提议后，主任倾向于第二项。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark miel 'il quddiem? Toni: Biex jisma' aħjar; il-mużika kienet qawwija.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark lean forward? Toni: To hear better; the music was loud.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克为什么向前倾身？托尼：为了听得更清楚，音乐太响了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么向前倾身？
messages.en: Why did Mark lean forward?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex jisma' aħjar; il-mużika kienet qawwija.
messages.mt_standard: Biex jisma' aħjar; il-mużika kienet qawwija.
messages.zh: 为了听得更清楚，音乐太响了。
messages.en: To hear better; the music was loud.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“身体倾向一边、心里倾向一个选择”串联动词义；跪下和俯首另配动作画面。名词“财富”单独做卡片记忆。

gloss_zh: 光滑的；柔软的；丝般的；柔滑贴身的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Smooth or soft to the touch, sometimes silky or flowing closely around the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容触感光滑、柔软或如丝一般；用于衣料时也可形容柔滑贴身的质感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lixx jew artab mal-mess, bħal ħarir, jew li jaqa' b'mod artab u qrib il-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 光滑的，表面平顺的。
柔软的，触感不硬的。
丝般柔滑的，有丝绸质感的。
柔滑贴身的，随身体线条垂落的。

formal.mt: Għall-kisja ta' ġewwa ntgħażel drapp mieles biex ikun komdu mal-ġilda.
formal.en: A soft, smooth fabric was selected for the lining so that it would feel comfortable against the skin.
formal.zh: 内衬选用了柔软光滑的布料，以确保贴肤舒适。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ħoss dan id-drapp. Kemm hu mieles! Rita: Iva, artab ħafna, bħal ħarir.
colloquial.en: Nina: Feel this fabric. It's so smooth! Rita: Yes, very soft, like silk.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：摸摸这块布，真光滑！丽塔：是啊，很柔软，像丝绸一样。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħoss dan id-drapp. Kemm hu mieles!
messages.mt_standard: Ħoss dan id-drapp. Kemm hu mieles!
messages.zh: 摸摸这块布，真光滑！
messages.en: Feel this fabric. It's so smooth!

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，很柔软，像丝绸一样。
messages.en: Yes, very soft, like silk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用手抚过一块柔滑丝布：表面光滑、触感柔软、质感如丝；再想它顺着身体垂落，记住贴身柔滑义。

gloss_zh: 反驳；质疑判断，事后挑剔

teaching_sense.en_definition: To contradict someone, or question a person's judgment or decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反驳别人的说法，或对某人的判断、决定提出质疑，也可指事后挑剔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid il-kontra ta' dak li jgħid ħaddieħor, jew iqiegħed f'dubju l-ġudizzju jew id-deċiżjoni ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反驳，说出与对方相反的意见。
质疑别人的判断或决定，尤指事后加以挑剔。

formal.mt: Matul id-dibattitu, ir-rappreżentant miera lill-kelliem u ppreżenta ċifri differenti.
formal.en: During the debate, the representative contradicted the speaker and presented different figures.
formal.zh: 辩论期间，这名代表反驳了发言者，并提出了不同的数据。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Luqa miera d-deċiżjoni tiegħi wara li spiċċa kollox? Ben: Forsi ma kienx jaf għaliex għażilt hekk.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Luqa second-guess my decision after everything was over? Ben: Maybe he didn't know why you made that choice.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：事情都结束了，卢卡为什么还来质疑我的决定？本：也许他不知道你为什么那样选。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Luqa miera d-deċiżjoni tiegħi wara li spiċċa kollox?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Luqa miera d-deċiżjoni tiegħi wara li spiċċa kollox?
messages.zh: 事情都结束了，卢卡为什么还来质疑我的决定？
messages.en: Why did Luqa second-guess my decision after everything was over?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi ma kienx jaf għaliex għażilt hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi ma kienx jaf għaliex għażilt hekk.
messages.zh: 也许他不知道你为什么那样选。
messages.en: Maybe he didn't know why you made that choice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两个对话画面：别人刚说完就提出相反意见是“反驳”；决定做完后再追问为何这样选，可帮助记忆“事后质疑”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A goal or intended end; in a separate sense, a tariff or established rate of charges.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 希望达到的目标、目的或终点；另一个义项指规定的费率或收费标准。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għan jew tmiem li wieħed irid jilħaq; f'tifsira oħra, tariffa jew rata ta' ħlas stabbilita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 费率，规定的收费标准。
目标，目的；所要达到的终点。

formal.mt: Il-mieta tal-programm hija li kull student ikun jista' jaqra test qasir bil-Malti.
formal.en: The aim of the programme is for every student to be able to read a short text in Maltese.
formal.zh: 该课程的目标是让每位学生都能阅读一篇马耳他语短文。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhi l-mieta tiegħek għal dan ix-xahar? Eva: Irrid naqra ktieb qasir bil-Malti.
colloquial.en: Mark: What's your goal for this month? Eva: I want to read a short book in Maltese.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你这个月的目标是什么？埃娃：我想读完一本马耳他语小书。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi l-mieta tiegħek għal dan ix-xahar?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi l-mieta tiegħek għal dan ix-xahar?
messages.zh: 你这个月的目标是什么？
messages.en: What's your goal for this month?

messages.speaker: Eva (同学)
messages.zh: 我想读完一本马耳他语小书。
messages.en: I want to read a short book in Maltese.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成两张图记忆：计划纸上的靶心代表“目标”，服务柜台上的价目表代表“费率”；两个义项分别练句，不强行串成词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bed used for lying down, resting or sleeping.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人躺卧、休息或睡觉的床或床铺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sodda fejn wieħed jimtedd, jistrieħ jew jorqod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一张床；一处床铺。
床，供躺卧或睡眠的床铺。

formal.mt: Fil-kamra kien hemm mifrex komdu fejn il-mistieden seta' jistrieħ wara l-vjaġġ.
formal.en: In the room there was a comfortable bed where the guest could rest after the journey.
formal.zh: 房间里有一张舒适的床，客人可以在旅途结束后休息。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn ħallejt il-ktieb tiegħi? Ġanni: Fuq il-mifrex, ħdejn l-imħadda.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where did you leave my book? Ġanni: On the bed, next to the pillow.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你把我的书放哪儿了？詹尼：在床上，枕头旁边。

messages.speaker: Anna (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你把我的书放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you leave my book?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (弟弟)
messages.zh: 在床上，枕头旁边。
messages.en: On the bed, next to the pillow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mifrex 放进卧室画面：枕头旁有书，人躺在床铺上休息；整块记住 fuq il-mifrex 表示“在床上”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Enraged: in a state of extreme anger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于极度愤怒、暴怒的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fi stat ta' rabja kbira ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暴怒的，极为愤怒的。
姓氏 Mifsud。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-missier kien mifsud meta sar jaf bil-ħsara.
formal.en: In the story, the father was enraged when he learned about the damage.
formal.zh: 故事中，父亲得知损坏的情况后勃然大怒。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Ma' min għandna nitkellmu dwar il-kors? David: Mas-Sur Mifsud; hu l-għalliem tagħna.
colloquial.en: Lina: Who should we speak to about the course? David: Mr Mifsud; he's our teacher.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：课程的事我们该找谁谈？戴维：找 Mifsud 先生，他是我们的老师。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' min għandna nitkellmu dwar il-kors?
messages.mt_standard: Ma' min għandna nitkellmu dwar il-kors?
messages.zh: 课程的事我们该找谁谈？
messages.en: Who should we speak to about the course?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: 找 Mifsud 先生，他是我们的老师。
messages.en: Mr Mifsud; he's our teacher.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张独立卡片：小写 mifsud 配暴怒表情，大写 Mifsud 配人物姓名牌；姓名本身不能用来推断这个人的情绪。

gloss_zh: 词典；词汇集；同义词词典

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reference collection of words used to look up meanings, vocabulary, or synonyms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供查阅词义、词汇或同义词的词语汇编或工具书。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġabra ta' kliem li tintuża biex wieħed ifittex tifsiriet, vokabularju jew sinonimi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词典；供查阅词语及其释义的工具书
词汇集；汇集某种语言或某一领域词汇的资料
同义词词典；供查找同义词或近义表达的工具书

collocations.en: look it up in the dictionary

formal.mt: L-istudent uża miklem biex isib it-tifsira tal-kelma qabel ma kiteb is-sentenza.
formal.en: The student used a dictionary to find the meaning of the word before writing the sentence.
formal.zh: 学生在写句子之前，用词典查明了这个词的意思。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser din il-kelma? Mark: Ejja nfittxuha fil-miklem.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does this word mean? Mark: Let's look it up in the dictionary.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个词是什么意思？马克：我们查查词典吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does this word mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 我们查查词典吧。
messages.en: Let's look it up in the dictionary.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 miklem 想成学习桌上的词语工具箱：查意思想到词典，找近义表达想到同义词词典，用具体查词动作帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool used to sweep dust and dirt from the floor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来扫除地面灰尘和污物的工具；扫帚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex tiknes it-trab u l-ħmieġ mill-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用来清扫的工具。
大量的教堂。
扫帚。

collocations.en: a broom with a long handle

formal.mt: Wara x-xogħol, il-ħaddiem uża l-miknes biex ineħħi t-trab mill-art.
formal.en: After work, the worker used the broom to remove dust from the floor.
formal.zh: 工作结束后，工人用扫帚清扫地面的灰尘。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn hu l-miknes? Irrid niknes il-kċina. Pawlu: Qiegħed wara l-bieb. Ħudu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where's the broom? I want to sweep the kitchen. Pawlu: It's behind the door. Take it.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：扫帚在哪里？我想扫一下厨房。保罗：在门后面，拿去吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-miknes? Irrid niknes il-kċina.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-miknes? Irrid niknes il-kċina.
messages.zh: 扫帚在哪里？我想扫一下厨房。
messages.en: Where's the broom? I want to sweep the kitchen.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 在门后面，拿去吧。
messages.en: It's behind the door. Take it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 miknes 和门后那把扫帚联系起来，边想象扫厨房边记“清扫工具”；“大量教堂”这一义项另做一张卡片，分开记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A unit of distance equal to 1,609.344 metres.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 距离单位“英里”，一英里等于1609.344米。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità ta' distanza li hija daqs 1609.344 metru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 英里，距离单位，等于1609.344米。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Unità ta' distanza li hija daqs 1609.344 metru.

formal.mt: L-iskola tinsab mil 'il bogħod miċ-ċentru tar-raħal.
formal.en: The school is a mile away from the village centre.
formal.zh: 学校距离村庄中心一英里。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-bajja kemm hi 'l bogħod minn hawn? Mark: Mil biss. Nistgħu nimxu sa hemm.
colloquial.en: Sara: How far is the beach from here? Mark: Only a mile. We can walk there.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：海滩离这里有多远？马克：只有一英里，我们可以走过去。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bajja kemm hi 'l bogħod minn hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Il-bajja kemm hi 'l bogħod minn hawn?
messages.zh: 海滩离这里有多远？
messages.en: How far is the beach from here?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mil biss. Nistgħu nimxu sa hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Mil biss. Nistgħu nimxu sa hemm.
messages.zh: 只有一英里，我们可以走过去。
messages.en: Only a mile. We can walk there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mil 与英语 mile 的拼写并排记忆，再想象地图上一段约一点六公里的路线，看到 mil 就想到“英里”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where people gamble, such as a casino or gambling house.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人进行赌博活动的场所，如赌场或赌馆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn in-nies jilagħbu għal flus, bħal każinò.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赌场。
供人进行赌博活动的场所。
赌馆；经营赌博活动的场所。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi milagħba li tinsab qrib il-port.
formal.en: The report describes a gambling venue located near the harbour.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一家位于港口附近的赌博场所。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'hemm f'dak il-bini? Mark: Hemm milagħba, fejn in-nies jilagħbu għal flus. Lara: Mela ejja mmorru fil-kafetterija ħdejha.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's in that building? Mark: There's a gambling venue, where people play for money. Lara: Then let's go to the café next door.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那栋楼里是什么？Mark：里面是赌场，人们在那里赌钱。Lara：那我们去旁边的咖啡馆吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那栋楼里是什么？
messages.en: What's in that building?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm milagħba, fejn in-nies jilagħbu għal flus.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm milagħba, fejn in-nies jilagħbu għal flus.
messages.zh: 里面是赌场，人们在那里赌钱。
messages.en: There's a gambling venue, where people play for money.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们去旁边的咖啡馆吧。
messages.en: Then let's go to the café next door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上赌场门口的画面，再用“玩的是钱”提醒自己：它指赌博场所。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area where children can play, often with equipment such as swings and slides.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供儿童玩耍的区域，常设有秋千、滑梯等设施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn it-tfal jistgħu jilagħbu, spiss b'bandli u żrieżaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供儿童玩耍的区域。
儿童游乐场。

formal.mt: Il-milgħab il-ġdid għandu bandli u żrieżaq adattati għal tfal żgħar.
formal.en: The new playground has swings and slides suitable for young children.
formal.zh: 新游乐场设有适合幼儿的秋千和滑梯。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nistgħu mmorru fil-milgħab wara l-iskola? Sara: Iva, tista' tilgħab fuq il-bandli. Nina: Tajjeb, nieħu l-flixkun tal-ilma miegħi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can we go to the playground after school? Sara: Yes, you can play on the swings. Nina: Great, I'll take my water bottle with me.
colloquial.zh: Nina：放学后我们能去游乐场吗？Sara：可以，你可以去荡秋千。Nina：太好了，我会带上水瓶。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 放学后我们能去游乐场吗？
messages.en: Can we go to the playground after school?

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.zh: 可以，你可以去荡秋千。
messages.en: Yes, you can play on the swings.

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 太好了，我会带上水瓶。
messages.en: Great, I'll take my water bottle with me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住秋千、滑梯和孩子这三个画面，把 milgħab 固定联想到儿童游乐场。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small spoon used with coffee or tea, for example to stir in sugar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 饮用咖啡或茶时使用的小匙，例如用来搅拌糖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mgħarfa żgħira li tintuża mal-kafè jew mat-te, pereżempju biex tħawwad iz-zokkor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咖啡匙；饮用咖啡时使用的小匙。
茶匙；咖啡匙。

collocations.en: to stir with a small spoon

formal.mt: Poġġi milgħaqa fuq il-plattina ħdejn it-tazza tal-kafè.
formal.en: Place a coffee spoon on the saucer beside the coffee cup.
formal.zh: 把咖啡匙放在咖啡杯旁的杯碟上。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tista' ġġibli milgħaqa, jekk jogħġbok? Rita: Żgur. Trid tħawwad iz-zokkor fil-kafè? Mark: Iva, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Mark: Could you bring me a coffee spoon, please? Rita: Of course. Do you want to stir the sugar into your coffee? Mark: Yes, thank you.
colloquial.zh: Mark：请给我拿一把咖啡匙，好吗？Rita：当然。你要搅拌咖啡里的糖吗？Mark：是的，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我拿一把咖啡匙，好吗？
messages.en: Could you bring me a coffee spoon, please?

messages.speaker: Rita (服务员)
messages.zh: 当然。你要搅拌咖啡里的糖吗？
messages.en: Of course. Do you want to stir the sugar into your coffee?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 是的，谢谢。
messages.en: Yes, thank you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象咖啡杯边一把小匙正在搅糖，用这个完整画面记住 milgħaqa 的用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A whirlpool: a place in water where the current turns around a centre.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 漩涡，即水流围绕一个中心旋转的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fl-ilma fejn il-kurrent idur madwar ċentru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 漩涡；水流围绕中心旋转的现象。
湖泊、海湾等水体中的水面驻波振荡。
漩涡；旋转的水流。

formal.mt: L-osservaturi nnutaw milgħuba fejn żewġ kurrenti tal-ilma ltaqgħu.
formal.en: The observers noticed a whirlpool where two water currents met.
formal.zh: 观察人员在两股水流交汇处发现了一个漩涡。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tara dik il-milgħuba fl-ilma? Pawlu: Iva, l-ilma qed idur f'ċirku. Lara: Ejja nħarsu lejha minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you see that whirlpool in the water? Pawlu: Yes, the water is moving in a circle. Lara: Let's watch it from here.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你看到水里那个漩涡了吗？Pawlu：看到了，水正在打转。Lara：我们就在这里看吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到水里那个漩涡了吗？
messages.en: Can you see that whirlpool in the water?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，水正在打转。
messages.en: Yes, the water is moving in a circle.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们就在这里看吧。
messages.en: Let's watch it from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用水流绕圈的画面记住漩涡义；另把水面来回起伏的振荡义单独配图记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of filling something, or the stuffing placed inside food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物装满或填入材料的行为，也指填入食物内部的馅料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li timla xi ħaġa, jew it-taħlita li titqiegħed ġewwa ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 馅料；填入食物内部的材料。
动词 mela 的动名词，表示填充、装满这一行为。
填充、装满或塞入材料的行为。

sense_translations.en_definition: flow, the rising of the sea
sense_translations.zh_definition: 涨潮；海水上涨。

formal.mt: Ipprepara l-mili tal-laħam u ħallih jiksaħ qabel tużah fit-torta.
formal.en: Prepare the meat stuffing and let it cool before using it in the pie.
formal.zh: 准备好肉馅，待其冷却后再用来做馅饼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'hemm fil-mili ta' din it-torta? Toni: Hemm irkotta u tursin. Maja: Tajjeb, inħobb ħafna l-irkotta.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's in the filling of this pie? Toni: There's ricotta and parsley. Maja: Great, I really like ricotta.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个馅饼的馅料里有什么？Toni：有里科塔乳清奶酪和欧芹。Maja：太好了，我很喜欢里科塔乳清奶酪。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个馅饼的馅料里有什么？
messages.en: What's in the filling of this pie?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 有里科塔乳清奶酪和欧芹。
messages.en: There's ricotta and parsley.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 太好了，我很喜欢里科塔乳清奶酪。
messages.en: Great, I really like ricotta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张图分别记忆：塞进饼里的馅料、灌满瓶子的动作、逐渐上涨的海水。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Christmas, the Christian festival celebrating the birth of Jesus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 圣诞节，基督教纪念耶稣诞生的节日；实际教学用法以这一节日义为主。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-festa Nisranija li tiċċelebra t-twelid ta' Ġesù.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣诞节。

sense_translations.en_definition: birthday (literal meaning -- this word isn't used in this sense)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 生日（字面意义；这个词实际上不用于表达这一义项）。
圣诞节。
生日（字面义；实际使用时不以此词表达一般的生日）。

formal.mt: Matul il-festi tal-Milied, il-librerija se torganizza attività għall-familji.
formal.en: During the Christmas festivities, the library will organise an activity for families.
formal.zh: 圣诞庆祝期间，图书馆将举办一项面向家庭的活动。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn se tqatta' l-Milied din is-sena? David: Għand in-nanna, mal-familja kollha. Anna: Il-Milied it-tajjeb lilkom ilkoll!
colloquial.en: Anna: Where will you spend Christmas this year? David: At Grandma's, with the whole family. Anna: Merry Christmas to you all!
colloquial.zh: Anna：今年你准备在哪里过圣诞节？David：在奶奶家，和全家人一起。Anna：祝你们大家圣诞快乐！

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se tqatta' l-Milied din is-sena?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se tqatta' l-Milied din is-sena?
messages.zh: 今年你准备在哪里过圣诞节？
messages.en: Where will you spend Christmas this year?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 在奶奶家，和全家人一起。
messages.en: At Grandma's, with the whole family.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 祝你们大家圣诞快乐！
messages.en: Merry Christmas to you all!

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到大写 Milied，就想圣诞树和全家团聚；生日字面义只作理解提示，不当日常用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the armed forces or their activities, equipment, or organisation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与军队及其活动、装备或组织有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-forzi armati, mal-attivitajiet tagħhom jew mat-tagħmir tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 军事的；军队的；与武装部队有关的。

formal.mt: Il-wirja tinkludi vettura militari u dokumenti dwar it-taħriġ tas-suldati.
formal.en: The exhibition includes a military vehicle and documents about soldiers' training.
formal.zh: 展览包括一辆军用车辆，以及有关士兵训练的文件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik vettura militari? Mark: Iva, hija parti mill-wirja tal-mużew. Maja: Ejja naqraw it-tagħrif dwarha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that a military vehicle? Mark: Yes, it's part of the museum exhibition. Maja: Let's read the information about it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那是军用车辆吗？Mark：是的，它是博物馆展览的一部分。Maja：我们看看它的介绍吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 那是军用车辆吗？
messages.en: Is that a military vehicle?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，它是博物馆展览的一部分。
messages.en: Yes, it's part of the museum exhibition.

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 我们看看它的介绍吧。
messages.en: Let's read the information about it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 militari 放在车辆、训练、制服后面一起记，理解为给这些名词加上“军事的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organised armed group of citizens, distinct from a regular professional army.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由普通公民组成的有组织武装群体，区别于正规的职业军队。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp organizzat u armat ta' ċittadini, distint minn armata regolari professjonali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 民兵；由普通公民组成的武装组织。

formal.mt: Fit-test tal-eżerċizzju, il-milizzja lokali hija magħmula minn ċittadini tar-raħal.
formal.en: In the exercise text, the local militia consists of citizens from the village.
formal.zh: 练习课文中的地方民兵组织由该村的居民组成。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser milizzja f'dan it-test? Pawlu: Grupp armat ta' ċittadini. Hawnhekk qed jitkellem dwar il-milizzja tar-raħal. Nina: Issa fhimt għaliex isemmi lir-residenti.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does militia mean in this text? Pawlu: An armed group of citizens. Here it's talking about the village militia. Nina: Now I understand why it mentions the residents.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这篇课文里的 milizzja 是什么意思？Pawlu：由公民组成的武装群体。这里说的是村里的民兵组织。Nina：现在我明白为什么文中会提到居民了。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇课文里的 milizzja 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does militia mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Grupp armat ta' ċittadini. Hawnhekk qed jitkellem dwar il-milizzja tar-raħal.
messages.mt_standard: Grupp armat ta' ċittadini. Hawnhekk qed jitkellem dwar il-milizzja tar-raħal.
messages.zh: 由公民组成的武装群体。这里说的是村里的民兵组织。
messages.en: An armed group of citizens. Here it's talking about the village militia.

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 现在我明白为什么文中会提到居民了。
messages.en: Now I understand why it mentions the residents.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用村民集合组成武装队伍的画面记住 milizzja；它是组织名称，可搭配“成员”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 1,000,000, or a quantity containing that many units.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一百万这个数，或由一百万个单位组成的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 1,000,000, jew kwantità ta' daqshekk unitajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 百万；一百万这个数或数量。
一百万，表示数量的数词。

formal.mt: Il-proġett għandu baġit ta' miljun ewro.
formal.en: The project has a budget of one million euros.
formal.zh: 该项目的预算为一百万欧元。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm-il darba rawh dan il-filmat? Mark: Aktar minn miljun darba!
colloquial.en: Maja: How many times has this video been watched? Mark: More than a million times!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个视频被看了多少次？马克：超过一百万次！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个视频被看了多少次？
messages.en: How many times has this video been watched?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 超过一百万次！
messages.en: More than a million times!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 miljun 和数字 1,000,000 一起记：看到 miljun ewro，就在脑中数出一百万欧元。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organ in the upper left part of the abdomen that filters blood and helps the immune system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于腹部左上方的器官，具有过滤血液和参与免疫防御等作用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Organu fin-naħa ta' fuq tax-xellug taż-żaqq li jiffiltra d-demm u jgħin lis-sistema immunitarja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脾；脾脏，位于腹部左上方的器官。

formal.mt: Il-milsa tinsab fin-naħa ta' fuq tax-xellug taż-żaqq.
formal.en: The spleen is located in the upper left part of the abdomen.
formal.zh: 脾脏位于腹部左上方。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi l-milsa f'din l-istampa? Mark: Hawn, fuq ix-xellug taż-żaqq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the spleen in this picture? Mark: Here, in the upper left part of the abdomen.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张图里的脾脏在哪里？马克：在这里，腹部左上方。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这张图里的脾脏在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the spleen in this picture?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 在这里，腹部左上方。
messages.en: Here, in the upper left part of the abdomen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在人体图的腹部左上方贴上 milsa 标签，把词形、位置和中文“脾脏”连成一个记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dictionary or collection of words that records their meanings or use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 收录词语并说明其意义或用法的词典或词汇集。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dizzjunarju jew ġabra ta' kliem bit-tifsir jew bl-użu tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词典；供查阅词语及其释义等信息的工具书。
词汇；词汇集，指某种语言或某一领域的词语集合。

collocations.en: look up a word in the dictionary

formal.mt: L-istudenti jistgħu jużaw milsen bilingwi biex jifhmu l-kliem fit-test.
formal.en: Students may use a bilingual dictionary to understand the words in the text.
formal.zh: 学生可以使用双语词典来理解课文中的词语。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser din il-kelma? Mark: Ma nafx. Ejja nfittxuha fil-milsen.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does this word mean? Mark: I don't know. Let's look it up in the dictionary.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个词是什么意思？马克：我不知道。我们查一下词典吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does this word mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 我不知道。我们查一下词典吧。
messages.en: I don't know. Let's look it up in the dictionary.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本封面写着 milsen 的词典：遇到生词就翻开它，把“查词”的动作和这个名词一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A length or measured stretch of something, such as cloth or cord.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物的一段长度或按长度量取的一段，例如一段布料或绳子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tul jew biċċa mkejla ta' xi ħaġa, bħal drapp jew ħabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一段；一段长度。
长度；按长度计算的一段。

formal.mt: Għall-eżerċizzju, kull student għandu jkejjel milwa ta' ħabel.
formal.en: For the exercise, each student should measure a length of rope.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，每名学生都应测量一段绳子的长度。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tgħaddili dik il-milwa ta' drapp? Mark: Iva. Trid l-imqass ukoll?
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you pass me that length of cloth? Mark: Yes. Do you want the scissors too?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：能把那段布料递给我吗？马克：可以。你还要剪刀吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (手工课学生)
messages.zh: 能把那段布料递给我吗？
messages.en: Can you pass me that length of cloth?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 可以。你还要剪刀吗？
messages.en: Yes. Do you want the scissors too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用尺子量好一段布，再给这段布贴上 milwa 标签；用“一段有长度的材料”记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Containing as much as it can hold, or containing a large amount of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 装到了容量上限的，或含有大量某物的；满的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih kemm jesa', jew li fih ħafna minn xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 满的；装满的。
丰满的；圆润的。
塞满的；填有馅料或其他填充物的。
动词 mela 的过去分词，表示已被填满或装满。
已满；已被填满、装满。

sense_translations.en_definition: at high tide, in a state of flow, flood
sense_translations.zh_definition: 处于高潮位或涨潮状态；处于水流上涨或泛滥状态。

formal.mt: Il-kontenitur għandu jkun mimli ilma qabel jibda l-esperiment.
formal.en: The container must be full of water before the experiment begins.
formal.zh: 实验开始前，容器必须装满水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm post fuq ix-xarabank? Mark: Le, mimli nies. Nistennew ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there room on the bus? Mark: No, it's full of people. Let's wait for another one.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：公交车上还有地方吗？马克：没有，挤满了人。我们等下一辆吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.zh: 公交车上还有地方吗？
messages.en: Is there room on the bus?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，挤满了人。我们等下一辆吧。
messages.en: No, it's full of people. Let's wait for another one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个“满”的画面记 mimli：杯子装满水、公交车挤满人、甜椒塞满馅；搭配阴性 tazza 时记作 mimlija。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pronoun used to ask which person is meant, or to refer to a person described by a following clause.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于询问某人的身份，表示“谁”；也可引出“……的人”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pronom li jintuża biex tistaqsi dwar persuna jew biex tindika persuna deskritta fil-kliem li jiġi wara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谁；用于询问人的身份，或指符合某种描述的人。
谁；指人的代词，也可表示“……的人”。

formal.mt: Min jixtieq jipparteċipa għandu jimla l-formola.
formal.en: Anyone who wishes to participate should complete the form.
formal.zh: 希望参加的人应填写表格。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ġej magħna għada? Mark: Anna u Pawlu. Trid tiġi wkoll?
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is coming with us tomorrow? Mark: Anna and Pawlu. Do you want to come too?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：明天谁和我们一起去？马克：安娜和保罗。你也想来吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 明天谁和我们一起去？
messages.en: Who is coming with us tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Anna u Pawlu. Trid tiġi wkoll?
messages.mt_standard: Anna u Pawlu. Trid tiġi wkoll?
messages.zh: 安娜和保罗。你也想来吗？
messages.en: Anna and Pawlu. Do you want to come too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 min 想成指向人物的问号：问身份用“谁”，后面接行为描述时可理解为“做这件事的人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A passage through or under the ground; also an explosive device placed where contact or another trigger can set it off.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿过地下或山体的通道，即隧道；也指接触或其他触发条件可使其爆炸的地雷等爆炸装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Passaġġ minn taħt l-art jew minn ġo muntanja; ukoll apparat splussiv li jisplodi meta jiġi attivat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 隧道；穿过地下或山体的通道。
地雷、水雷等爆炸装置。

formal.mt: Il-mina l-ġdida se tgħaqqad iż-żewġ naħat tal-muntanja.
formal.en: The new tunnel will connect the two sides of the mountain.
formal.zh: 新隧道将连接山体两侧。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqafna? Mark: Il-mina magħluqa. Irridu ngħaddu minn triq oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why have we stopped? Mark: The tunnel is closed. We have to take another road.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们为什么停下来了？马克：隧道关闭了。我们得走另一条路。

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.zh: 我们为什么停下来了？
messages.en: Why have we stopped?

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-mina magħluqa. Irridu ngħaddu minn triq oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Il-mina magħluqa. Irridu ngħaddu minn triq oħra.
messages.zh: 隧道关闭了。我们得走另一条路。
messages.en: The tunnel is closed. We have to take another road.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 mina 做两张分开的图卡：一张画车辆穿过隧道，一张画带警示标志的地雷；靠语境区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: From a particular past time onward, marking when a continuing situation began.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从过去某个时间起一直到后来，指出某种持续情况的起点；自从。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Minn żmien partikolari fil-passat 'il quddiem, biex juri meta bdiet sitwazzjoni li kompliet wara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自从；从某个过去的时间起。
自……以来；从……起，用于引出时间起点。
自从……以来，用于连接表示起始时间或事件的从句。

formal.mt: Mindu nfetħet il-librerija l-ġdida, żdied in-numru ta' qarrejja.
formal.en: Since the new library opened, the number of readers has increased.
formal.zh: 自从新图书馆开放以来，读者人数增加了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ilek taf lil Anna? Mark: Iva, mindu kont żgħir. Konna fl-istess klassi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you known Anna for a long time? Mark: Yes, since I was little. We were in the same class.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你认识安娜很久了吗？马克：是啊，从我小时候就认识了。我们以前是同班同学。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你认识安娜很久了吗？
messages.en: Have you known Anna for a long time?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, mindu kont żgħir. Konna fl-istess klassi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, mindu kont żgħir. Konna fl-istess klassi.
messages.zh: 是啊，从我小时候就认识了。我们以前是同班同学。
messages.en: Yes, since I was little. We were in the same class.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在时间线上圈出一个过去的起点，再画箭头延伸到后来；把 mindu 放在起点旁，记作“自从那时起”。

gloss_zh: 风箱；复数 mniefaħ 也可作表示恼怒的感叹语

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device that blows air into a fire, used by workers such as blacksmiths and glass blowers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向炉火中鼓送空气的装置，常用于锻铁或玻璃吹制等工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex tonfoħ l-arja fin-nar, pereżempju minn ħaddied jew minn min jonfoħ il-ħġieġ.

sense_translations.en_definition: bellows (as used by blacksmiths, glass blowers etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 风箱，指铁匠、玻璃吹制工等用来鼓送空气的工具。

sense_translations.en_definition: an interjection used to express annoyance (typically in the plural form 'mniefaħ')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 表示恼怒或不耐烦的感叹用语，通常使用复数形式 mniefaħ。
风箱，用来鼓送空气的装置。

collocations.en: to blow air into the fire with bellows

formal.mt: Il-ħaddied uża l-minfaħ biex iżid l-arja fin-nar qabel beda jaħdem il-ħadid.
formal.en: The blacksmith used the bellows to supply more air to the fire before he began working the iron.
formal.zh: 铁匠开始锻铁前，用风箱向炉火鼓入更多空气。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għal xiex jintuża dan il-minfaħ? Pawlu: Biex tonfoħ l-arja fin-nar u żżommu jaqbad.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are these bellows used for? Pawlu: To blow air into the fire and keep it burning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个风箱是用来做什么的？Pawlu：向炉火鼓风，让火持续燃烧。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.zh: 这个风箱是用来做什么的？
messages.en: What are these bellows used for?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (铁匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex tonfoħ l-arja fin-nar u żżommu jaqbad.
messages.mt_standard: Biex tonfoħ l-arja fin-nar u żżommu jaqbad.
messages.zh: 向炉火鼓风，让火持续燃烧。
messages.en: To blow air into the fire and keep it burning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 minfaħ 配上铁匠拉风箱的画面，记住它把空气送进火里；另将 mniefaħ 单独记为恼怒感叹语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An opening through which air can enter, such as a vent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供空气进入的开口，例如通气口；也可指鼻孔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fetħa minn fejn tista' tidħol l-arja; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll fetħa fl-imnieħer.

sense_translations.en_definition: an opening to let in air
sense_translations.zh_definition: 让空气进入的开口；进气口或通气口。
鼻孔，鼻子上供空气进出的开口。

collocations.en: an air vent in the wall
a blocked nostril or air opening

formal.mt: Il-minfes fil-ħajt għandu jinżamm nadif biex l-arja tkun tista' tidħol fil-kamra.
formal.en: The air vent in the wall should be kept clean so that air can enter the room.
formal.zh: 墙上的通气口应保持清洁，以便空气进入房间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex poġġejt il-kaxxa hemm? Qiegħda tgħatti l-minfes. Mark: Għandek raġun. Inċaqlaqha issa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you put the box there? It's covering the air vent. Mark: You're right. I'll move it now.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么把箱子放在那里？它挡住通气口了。Mark：你说得对。我现在就把它移开。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex poġġejt il-kaxxa hemm? Qiegħda tgħatti l-minfes.
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex poġġejt il-kaxxa hemm? Qiegħda tgħatti l-minfes.
messages.zh: 你为什么把箱子放在那里？它挡住通气口了。
messages.en: Why did you put the box there? It's covering the air vent.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 你说得对。我现在就把它移开。
messages.en: You're right. I'll move it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把墙上的通气口和脸上的鼻孔并排画出，两者都有空气通过，用这两个画面记住 minfes 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to show that one person, thing, or action takes the place of another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某人、某物或某个行为取代另一人、物或行为，相当于“代替”或“而不是”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex turi li persuna, ħaġa jew azzjoni tieħu post oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 代替；而不是，表示选择或使用另一人、物或做法。
代替；而不是，用于引出被替换的人、物或行为。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat iddeċieda li jibgħat ir-rapport bl-email minflok bil-posta.
formal.en: The committee decided to send the report by email instead of by post.
formal.zh: 委员会决定通过电子邮件发送报告，代替邮寄。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid kafè? Toni: Illum nieħu te minflok kafè, jekk jogħġbok.
