colloquial.en: Mark: What will you use to cut this stone? Pawlu: I'll use a small stone-cutting hatchet.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你要用什么劈这块石头？保罗：我要用一把小劈石斧。

messages.speaker: Mark (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se tuża biex taqta' din il-ġebla?
messages.mt_standard: X'se tuża biex taqta' din il-ġebla?
messages.zh: 你要用什么劈这块石头？
messages.en: What will you use to cut this stone?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (石匠)
messages.zh: 我要用一把小劈石斧。
messages.en: I'll use a small stone-cutting hatchet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mterqa 和石匠修整石块的画面绑定，想象手中那把小斧，每次看到石头就复习这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having little or no light, so that it is difficult to see clearly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 光线很少或没有光线的，因此难以看清；黑暗的或昏暗的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih ftit dawl jew xejn, b'mod li jkun diffiċli tara ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黑暗的；缺乏光线的。
昏暗的；光线微弱的。
阴暗的；因光线不足而显得沉闷的。

sense_translations.en_definition: dark (not bright, especially through absence of light)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 不明亮的，尤指因没有光线而黑暗的。

formal.mt: Il-kuritur baqa' mudlam sakemm inxtegħel id-dawl.
formal.en: The corridor remained dark until the light was switched on.
formal.zh: 走廊一直黑着，直到灯被打开。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan il-kuritur daqshekk mudlam? Lara: Id-dawl mitfi. Se nixegħlu issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is this corridor so dark? Lara: The light is off. I'll switch it on now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这条走廊怎么这么暗？拉拉：灯关着。我现在把它打开。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这条走廊怎么这么暗？
messages.en: Why is this corridor so dark?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 灯关着。我现在把它打开。
messages.en: The light is off. I'll switch it on now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象走进没有开灯的走廊，眼前一片昏暗，立即说出 kuritur mudlam，把形容词和场景一起记。

gloss_zh: 钥匙，尤指大型铁钥匙；鹿角

teaching_sense.en_definition: A key used to open or lock a door or another lock, especially a large iron key.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来开启或锁住门及其他锁具的钥匙，尤指大型铁钥匙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jintuża biex jinfetaħ jew jingħalaq serratura, speċjalment wieħed kbir tal-ħadid.

sense_translations.en_definition: key (now mostly used for large, iron keys)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 钥匙；现今主要用于指大型铁钥匙。
用于开锁或上锁的钥匙。
鹿角；鹿类动物头上生长的分枝状角。

formal.mt: Il-kustodju fetaħ il-bieb il-qadim b'muftieħ kbir tal-ħadid.
formal.en: The caretaker opened the old door with a large iron key.
formal.zh: 管理员用一把大型铁钥匙打开了那扇旧门。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hu l-muftieħ tal-bieb il-qadim? Mark: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-lampa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is the key to the old door? Mark: On the table, next to the lamp.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那扇旧门的钥匙在哪儿？马克：在桌上，台灯旁边。

messages.speaker: Nina (住户)
messages.zh: 那扇旧门的钥匙在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is the key to the old door?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 在桌上，台灯旁边。
messages.en: On the table, next to the lamp.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用旧门上的大铁钥匙记住 muftieħ 的常用教学义，再另画一张鹿角卡片，分开复习两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who owns a house or other property and rents it to someone else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拥有房屋或其他房产并将其出租给他人的人；房东。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha dar jew proprjetà oħra u tikriha lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 房东；将自己拥有的房产出租给他人的人。
姓氏 Mula。

formal.mt: Il-kerrej bagħat ittra lill-mula biex jitolbu jsewwi t-tieqa.
formal.en: The tenant sent a letter to the landlord asking him to repair the window.
formal.zh: 租客给房东寄了一封信，请他修理窗户。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Lil min ngħid bit-tieqa miksura? Pawlu: Kellem lill-mula tad-dar. Hu jista' jirranġaha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who should I tell about the broken window? Pawlu: Speak to the landlord of the house. He can fix it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：窗户坏了，我该告诉谁？保罗：跟这所房子的房东说。他可以把它修好。

messages.speaker: Lara (租客)
messages.zh: 窗户坏了，我该告诉谁？
messages.en: Who should I tell about the broken window?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Kellem lill-mula tad-dar. Hu jista' jirranġaha.
messages.mt_standard: Kellem lill-mula tad-dar. Hu jista' jirranġaha.
messages.zh: 跟这所房子的房东说。他可以把它修好。
messages.en: Speak to the landlord of the house. He can fix it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mula 放进租房报修的场景：窗户坏了就联系房东；遇到大写 Mula 时，再按姓氏义理解。

gloss_zh: 主；上主；道成肉身的耶稣基督

teaching_sense.en_definition: The religious title Lord, used to refer to God or to Jesus Christ.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宗教称号“主”或“上主”，用于称呼上帝或耶稣基督。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titlu reliġjuż li jintuża għal Alla jew għal Ġesù Kristu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 主；作为尊称或宗教称号使用。
上帝；神。
上主；指上帝。

sense_translations.en_definition: Jesus Christ as God in the flesh.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 指作为道成肉身之上帝的耶稣基督。

formal.mt: Fit-talb, il-komunità rringrazzjat lill-Mulej għall-paċi.
formal.en: In prayer, the community thanked the Lord for peace.
formal.zh: 会众在祈祷中感谢上主赐予平安。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għal min qed nużaw il-kelma Mulej f'dan it-talb? Marija: Qed nużawha għal Alla.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who are we referring to with the word Lord in this prayer? Marija: We are using it to refer to God.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这篇祷文里的“主”指的是谁？玛丽亚：这里用来指上帝。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal min qed nużaw il-kelma Mulej f'dan it-talb?
messages.mt_standard: Għal min qed nużaw il-kelma Mulej f'dan it-talb?
messages.zh: 这篇祷文里的“主”指的是谁？
messages.en: Who are we referring to with the word Lord in this prayer?

messages.speaker: Marija (宗教课教师)
messages.zh: 这里用来指上帝。
messages.en: We are using it to refer to God.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Mulej 写在祷文卡片上，旁边标注“主、上主”，再用 il-Mulej Ġesù 联结“主耶稣”的称呼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An amount of money that someone must pay as punishment for breaking a law or rule.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因违反法律或规定而必须缴纳的一笔钱；罚款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Somma flus li persuna jkollha tħallas bħala kastig għax tkun kisret liġi jew regola.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 罚款；作为处罚而要求缴纳的钱。

sense_translations.en_definition: fine (a fee levied as punishment for breaking the law)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因违法而被处以的罚款。

formal.mt: Ix-xufier ingħata multa għax ipparkja f'post fejn il-parkeġġ kien ipprojbit.
formal.en: The driver was fined for parking in a place where parking was prohibited.
formal.zh: 司机因在禁止停车的地方停车而被处以罚款。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex irċevejt multa? Lara: Ħallejt il-karozza f'post fejn ma stajtx nipparkja.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did you get a fine? Lara: I left the car somewhere I wasn't allowed to park.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你为什么被罚款了？拉拉：我把车停在了不准停车的地方。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么被罚款了？
messages.en: Why did you get a fine?

messages.speaker: Lara (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallejt il-karozza f'post fejn ma stajtx nipparkja.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallejt il-karozza f'post fejn ma stajtx nipparkja.
messages.zh: 我把车停在了不准停车的地方。
messages.en: I left the car somewhere I wasn't allowed to park.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象挡风玻璃上夹着停车罚单，看到 multa 就联想到“违规后要交的钱”，再连读 tħallas multa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of metal money with a particular value, usually round.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有特定面值、通常为圆形的金属货币；硬币。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa flus tal-metall b'valur partikolari, ġeneralment tonda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 硬币；具有一定面值的金属货币。

formal.mt: Il-mużew esebixxa munita antika b'sinjal ċar fuq kull naħa.
formal.en: The museum displayed an old coin with a clear mark on each side.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出了一枚古旧硬币，两面各有清晰的标记。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandek munita ta' ewro għall-magna? Mark: Iva, hawn waħda fil-but tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you have a one-euro coin for the machine? Mark: Yes, here's one in my pocket.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你有一枚一欧元硬币可以投进机器吗？马克：有，我口袋里这儿有一枚。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有一枚一欧元硬币可以投进机器吗？
messages.en: Do you have a one-euro coin for the machine?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，我口袋里这儿有一枚。
messages.en: Yes, here's one in my pocket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 拿起一枚圆形硬币，在掌心翻看正反两面，同时说 munita；用实物触感把词义记牢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The hard, projecting mouthpart of a bird, used for picking up food and other activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟类嘴部向前突出的坚硬部分，用于啄取食物等活动；鸟喙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti iebsa li toħroġ 'il barra minn ħalq l-għasfur u li juża biex jiġbor l-ikel u għal ħidmiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸟喙；鸟类坚硬而突出的嘴部。

formal.mt: L-għasfur uża l-munqar tiegħu biex jiġbor iż-żerriegħa mill-art.
formal.en: The bird used its beak to pick up seeds from the ground.
formal.zh: 那只鸟用喙啄起地上的种子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara kemm għandu munqar twil dak l-għasfur! Pawlu: Iva, issa qed jiġbor l-ikel bih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look how long that bird's beak is! Pawlu: Yes, it's picking up food with it now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，那只鸟的喙真长！保罗：是啊，它现在正用喙啄取食物。

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm għandu munqar twil dak l-għasfur!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm għandu munqar twil dak l-għasfur!
messages.zh: 看，那只鸟的喙真长！
messages.en: Look how long that bird's beak is!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa qed jiġbor l-ikel bih.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa qed jiġbor l-ikel bih.
messages.zh: 是啊，它现在正用喙啄取食物。
messages.en: Yes, it's picking up food with it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两根手指合拢成鸟喙形状，模仿啄取种子的动作，同时说 munqar，再用 munqar twil 练习描述长喙。

gloss_zh: 山；大量，堆积如山的东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large natural rise of earth and rock; figuratively, a very large amount of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由土石构成、明显高出周围地面的山；也可比喻数量极多的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għolja kbira ta' art u blat; b'mod figurattiv, kwantità kbira ħafna ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 山；山岳。

sense_translations.en_definition: mountain (large mass of earth and rock)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 山，由大量土石构成的高大地形。
大量；堆积如山的数量，比喻用法。

formal.mt: Il-mogħdija twassal sal-quċċata tal-muntanja, minn fejn tidher il-wied kollu.
formal.en: The path leads to the summit of the mountain, from where the entire valley is visible.
formal.zh: 这条小径通往山顶，从那里可以看见整个山谷。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi timxi magħna għada? Pawlu: Nixtieq, imma għandi muntanja xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like to come walking with us tomorrow? Pawlu: I'd like to, but I have a mountain of work.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：明天想和我们一起去散步吗？保罗：我想去，可是我的工作堆积如山。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 明天想和我们一起去散步吗？
messages.en: Would you like to come walking with us tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我想去，可是我的工作堆积如山。
messages.en: I'd like to, but I have a mountain of work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象一座高山，再把待办工作想成堆到山顶：同一个词连接“山”和“数量极多”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adult male sheep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成年雄性绵羊，即公羊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-nagħġa maskili adulta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公羊。
雄性绵羊；公羊。
白羊座，天文学中的星座名称。
白羊座，黄道十二宫中的星座名称。

formal.mt: Fir-razzett hemm muntun u diversi nagħaġ f'għalqa kbira.
formal.en: On the farm, there is a ram and several sheep in a large field.
formal.zh: 农场的一大片田地里有一只公羊和几只绵羊。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak muntun jew mogħża? Toni: Dak muntun. Il-mogħża qiegħda ħdejn iċ-ċint.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is that a ram or a goat? Toni: That's a ram. The goat is beside the fence.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那是公羊还是山羊？托尼：那是公羊。山羊在围栏旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.zh: 那是公羊还是山羊？
messages.en: Is that a ram or a goat?

messages.speaker: Toni (农场主)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak muntun. Il-mogħża qiegħda ħdejn iċ-ċint.
messages.mt_standard: Dak muntun. Il-mogħża qiegħda ħdejn iċ-ċint.
messages.zh: 那是公羊。山羊在围栏旁边。
messages.en: That's a ram. The goat is beside the fence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张图记忆：田里的公羊对应普通名词，星空中的公羊图案对应白羊座专名。

gloss_zh: 有角的；被伴侣背叛的，戴绿帽的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having horns; also used insultingly of a man whose partner is unfaithful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长有角的；也可侮辱性地形容伴侣不忠的男子，即“戴绿帽的”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-qrun; jintuża wkoll bħala insult għal raġel li s-sieħba tiegħu mhix fidila lejh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有角的；长着角的。
被伴侣背叛的；被戴绿帽的，通常用于男子，带贬损意味。
戴绿帽的；伴侣与他人有私情的，形容男子时带侮辱意味。

formal.mt: L-istampa turi barri muqran wieqaf f'nofs għalqa.
formal.en: The picture shows a horned bull standing in the middle of a field.
formal.zh: 图片展示了一头长着角的公牛，站在田地中央。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif niddeskrivi dan l-annimal li għandu l-qrun? Mark: Tista' tgħid li hu annimal muqran.
colloquial.en: Nina: How do I describe this animal that has horns? Mark: You can say that it is a horned animal.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这只有角的动物该怎么形容？马克：你可以说它是“有角的动物”。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif niddeskrivi dan l-annimal li għandu l-qrun?
messages.mt_standard: Kif niddeskrivi dan l-annimal li għandu l-qrun?
messages.zh: 这只有角的动物该怎么形容？
messages.en: How do I describe this animal that has horns?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħid li hu annimal muqran.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħid li hu annimal muqran.
messages.zh: 你可以说它是“有角的动物”。
messages.en: You can say that it is a horned animal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用公牛头上的角记住“有角的”；用于男子时另记为带侮辱性的“戴绿帽的”，注意语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small knife, usually with a blade that folds into its handle, including pocket knives and switchblades.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常可将刀刃折入刀柄的小刀，可指袖珍折刀，也可指弹簧刀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sikkina żgħira li normalment ix-xafra tagħha tingħalaq fil-manku, inklużi tipi li jinfetħu b'molla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 袖珍小刀；可随身携带的折刀。
折刀，刀刃可折入刀柄。
小折刀；袖珍折叠小刀。
折叠刀；刀刃可以折收的小刀。
弹簧刀，借助弹簧机构弹出或展开刀刃的小刀。

sense_translations.en_definition: pocket knife, folding knife, jack-knife, switchblade
sense_translations.zh_definition: 袖珍刀、折叠刀或弹簧刀，具体类型由语境确定。

collocations.en: the blade of the folding knife

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi mus żgħir b'xafra li tingħalaq fil-manku.
formal.en: The catalogue describes a small folding knife with a blade that folds into the handle.
formal.zh: 目录介绍了一把小折刀，其刀刃可以折入刀柄。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek mus biex naqtgħu din l-ispaga? Pawlu: Iva, għandi wieħed fil-kaxxa tal-għodda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have a pocket knife so we can cut this string? Pawlu: Yes, I have one in the toolbox.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你有小折刀吗？我们可以用它剪断这根绳子。保罗：有，我的工具箱里有一把。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek mus biex naqtgħu din l-ispaga?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek mus biex naqtgħu din l-ispaga?
messages.zh: 你有小折刀吗？我们可以用它剪断这根绳子。
messages.en: Do you have a pocket knife so we can cut this string?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，我的工具箱里有一把。
messages.en: Yes, I have one in the toolbox.

cognitive_memory_aid: 这个词短短三个字母，可配上一把能收进刀柄的小刀来记；遇到具体刀具，再靠上下文分辨折刀或弹簧刀。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lamp used to provide light, especially one that burns oil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于照明的灯，尤其指燃油照明的油灯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jagħti d-dawl, speċjalment wieħed li jaħraq iż-żejt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 油灯，以油为燃料的照明器具。
灯；照明用的器具。

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesebixxi musbieħ taż-żejt li kien jintuża għad-dawl fid-dar.
formal.en: The museum exhibits an oil lamp that was used to light the home.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出了一盏过去用于家庭照明的油灯。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak fuq l-ixkaffa? Nannu: Dak musbieħ taż-żejt. Konna nixegħluh meta jinqata' d-dawl.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's that on the shelf? Grandfather: That's an oil lamp. We used to light it when the power went out.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：架子上那个是什么？爷爷：那是油灯。以前停电时，我们会把它点起来。

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 架子上那个是什么？
messages.en: What's that on the shelf?

messages.speaker: Nannu (祖父)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak musbieħ taż-żejt. Konna nixegħluh meta jinqata' d-dawl.
messages.mt_standard: Dak musbieħ taż-żejt. Konna nixegħluh meta jinqata' d-dawl.
messages.zh: 那是油灯。以前停电时，我们会把它点起来。
messages.en: That's an oil lamp. We used to light it when the power went out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象停电后点亮的一盏油灯，把整个词与火苗和灯光一起记住；加上 taż-żejt 就明确是油灯。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pointed metal fastener driven into wood or another material to hold things together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 钉入木材等材料、用来固定物件的尖头金属钉子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa metall bil-ponta li tiddaħħal fl-injam jew f'materjal ieħor biex iżżomm affarijiet flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一枚钉子。
丘疹；皮肤上隆起的小疙瘩或痘。
钉子，尖杆状的固定件。
麻烦；令人困扰的事。
横砌砖；横向铺砌的砖，建筑用语。

collocations.en: to drive a nail into the wall

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa daħħal musmar fl-injam biex iwaħħal iż-żewġ biċċiet flimkien.
formal.en: The carpenter drove a nail into the wood to fasten the two pieces together.
formal.zh: 木匠把一枚钉子钉入木材，将两块木头固定在一起。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek musmar biex indendel din l-istampa? Rita: Iva, hawn wieħed żgħir fil-kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have a nail so I can hang this picture? Rita: Yes, there's a small one here in the box.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你有钉子吗？我想挂这幅画。丽塔：有，盒子里这里有一枚小的。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek musmar biex indendel din l-istampa?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek musmar biex indendel din l-istampa?
messages.zh: 你有钉子吗？我想挂这幅画。
messages.en: Do you have a nail so I can hang this picture?

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 有，盒子里这里有一枚小的。
messages.en: Yes, there's a small one here in the box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“钉子挂画”固定核心义；另外把皮肤小疙瘩、麻烦和横砌砖分别放进各自场景，不混成同一种东西。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tubular part of the digestive system through which food passes after leaving the stomach.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 消化系统中的管状器官，食物离开胃后会经过这里，即肠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti tas-sistema diġestiva f'għamla ta' tubu li minnha jgħaddi l-ikel wara li joħroġ mill-istonku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肠；肠道。
肠；肠道，较通俗的说法。
肠，消化系统中的管状器官。
肠；肠道。
腹泻；拉肚子。

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi l-istonku, il-musrana ż-żgħira u l-musrana l-kbira bħala partijiet tas-sistema diġestiva.
formal.en: The diagram shows the stomach, the small intestine and the large intestine as parts of the digestive system.
formal.zh: 图中展示了胃、小肠和大肠，它们都是消化系统的组成部分。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din il-parti twila fid-dijagramma hija l-musrana? Maja: Iva, dik il-musrana ż-żgħira. Il-musrana l-kbira tidher madwarha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this long part in the diagram the intestine? Maja: Yes, that's the small intestine. The large intestine is shown around it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：图里这条长长的部分是肠吗？玛雅：对，那是小肠。图中的大肠围在它周围。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-parti twila fid-dijagramma hija l-musrana?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-parti twila fid-dijagramma hija l-musrana?
messages.zh: 图里这条长长的部分是肠吗？
messages.en: Is this long part in the diagram the intestine?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dik il-musrana ż-żgħira. Il-musrana l-kbira tidher madwarha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dik il-musrana ż-żgħira. Il-musrana l-kbira tidher madwarha.
messages.zh: 对，那是小肠。图中的大肠围在它周围。
messages.en: Yes, that's the small intestine. The large intestine is shown around it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在消化系统图上沿着胃后的长管描一遍，记住 musrana 是肠；再成对记“小肠”和“大肠”，腹泻义另按语境辨认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fish or other animals caught, especially the catch brought back from a fishing trip.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 捕捉到的鱼或其他动物，尤指出海捕鱼后带回的渔获。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħut jew annimali oħra li jinqabdu, speċjalment il-ħut li jinġieb lura minn ħarġa għas-sajd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次捕捉所得的捕获物；一批渔获。

sense_translations.en_definition: catch (that which is captured or caught)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被捕获的东西，尤指捕到的鱼或动物。

formal.mt: Is-sajjieda ġabu l-mustada tal-lum fis-suq kmieni filgħodu.
formal.en: The fishers brought today's catch to the market early in the morning.
formal.zh: 渔民们一大早就把今天的渔获送到了市场。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Kif mar is-sajd illum? Rita: Tajjeb ħafna! Ġibna mustada tajba.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: How was the fishing today? Rita: Very good! We brought back a good catch.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：今天捕鱼怎么样？Rita：很好！我们带回了不少渔获。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天捕鱼怎么样？
messages.en: How was the fishing today?

messages.speaker: Rita (渔民)
messages.zh: 很好！我们带回了不少渔获。
messages.en: Very good! We brought back a good catch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象渔船返港后卸下一筐鱼，把 mustada 与眼前这批“渔获”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Hair growing between the nose and the upper lip.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长在鼻子与上唇之间的胡须，即上唇胡子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xagħar li jikber bejn l-imnieħer u x-xoffa ta' fuq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 上唇胡须；小胡子。
胡须；须毛。

sense_translations.en_definition: moustache (growth of facial hair between the nose and the upper lip)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 上唇胡须，生长在鼻子与上唇之间的面部毛发。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidher raġel b'mustaċċ oħxon u xagħar qasir.
formal.en: The photograph shows a man with a thick moustache and short hair.
formal.zh: 照片中是一名留着浓密上唇胡须、头发很短的男子。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Tridni nqassarlek il-mustaċċ ukoll? Mark: Iva, ftit biss, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Toni: Would you like me to trim your moustache too? Mark: Yes, just a little, please.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：也要我帮你修一下上唇胡须吗？马克：要，请稍微修一点就好。

messages.speaker: Toni (理发师)
messages.zh: 也要我帮你修一下上唇胡须吗？
messages.en: Would you like me to trim your moustache too?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 要，请稍微修一点就好。
messages.en: Yes, just a little, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在鼻子下面、上唇上面画一小撇胡子来记这个词；重点锁定胡子的位置，再配对记浓密和纤细两种样子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a person who follows Islam, or something connected with Islam and its followers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容信奉伊斯兰教的人，或与伊斯兰教及其信众有关的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħaddan l-Iżlam, jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Iżlam u ma' dawk li jħaddnuh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穆斯林的；信奉伊斯兰教的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Muslim (of persons, peoples, cultures: pertaining to Islam)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于人、民族或文化，表示信奉伊斯兰教的或与伊斯兰教有关的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-ħajja ta' kuljum ta' raġel musulman li jgħix f'Malta.
formal.en: The report describes the daily life of a Muslim man living in Malta.
formal.zh: 这份报告描述了一名居住在马耳他的穆斯林男子的日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Int musulman? Amir: Iva, jien musulman. Jekk trid, nista' ngħidlek dwar il-festi li niċċelebra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you Muslim? Amir: Yes, I'm Muslim. If you'd like, I can tell you about the festivals I celebrate.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你信奉伊斯兰教吗？Amir：是的，我是穆斯林。如果你愿意，我可以给你讲讲我庆祝的节日。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你信奉伊斯兰教吗？
messages.en: Are you Muslim?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien musulman. Jekk trid, nista' ngħidlek dwar il-festi li niċċelebra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien musulman. Jekk trid, nista' ngħidlek dwar il-festi li niċċelebra.
messages.zh: 是的，我是穆斯林。如果你愿意，我可以给你讲讲我庆祝的节日。
messages.en: Yes, I'm Muslim. If you'd like, I can tell you about the festivals I celebrate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 musulman 放进 raġel musulman“穆斯林男子”中整组记忆，注意这里用作形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Covered with abundant hair or fur, often long and untidy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长着浓密毛发的，常指毛发较长、蓬松或凌乱的样子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miksi b'ħafna xagħar jew suf, spiss twil u mħabbel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毛发长而蓬乱的；披着蓬松长毛的。
多毛的；覆盖着浓密毛发的。

formal.mt: Fl-istampa jidher kelb muswaf ħdejn il-bieb ta' dar żgħira.
formal.en: The picture shows a shaggy dog beside the door of a small house.
formal.zh: 图片中，一只毛发蓬乱的狗出现在一间小屋的门旁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt dak il-kelb muswaf? Toni: Iva! Għandu ħafna xagħar, speċjalment madwar wiċċu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see that shaggy dog? Toni: Yes! It has lots of hair, especially around its face.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看见那只毛发蓬乱的狗了吗？Toni：看见了！它的毛真多，尤其是脸周围。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看见那只毛发蓬乱的狗了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that shaggy dog?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Għandu ħafna xagħar, speċjalment madwar wiċċu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Għandu ħafna xagħar, speċjalment madwar wiċċu.
messages.zh: 看见了！它的毛真多，尤其是脸周围。
messages.en: Yes! It has lots of hair, especially around its face.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只长毛遮住眼睛的小狗，用 kelb muswaf 把“多毛、蓬乱”的画面固定下来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sloping surface or ramp connecting a lower level with a higher one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 连接较低处与较高处的倾斜路面或坡道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wiċċ jew passaġġ imżerżaq li jgħaqqad livell aktar baxx ma' wieħed ogħla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坡道或斜坡；从低处通往高处的倾斜地面。
连接不同高度的坡道。

formal.mt: Il-pjan tal-bini jinkludi mutalgħa għas-siġġijiet tar-roti ħdejn id-daħla prinċipali.
formal.en: The building plan includes a wheelchair ramp beside the main entrance.
formal.zh: 建筑方案在主入口旁设置了一条轮椅坡道。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Minn fejn nista' nitla' bil-bagalja? Mark: Uża l-mutalgħa fuq ix-xellug; minn hemm ma jkollokx bżonn it-taraġ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which way can I go up with the suitcase? Mark: Use the ramp on the left; that way you won't need the stairs.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我带着行李箱可以从哪边上去？Mark：走左边的坡道，从那里走就不用爬楼梯了。

messages.speaker: Lara (旅客)
messages.zh: 我带着行李箱可以从哪边上去？
messages.en: Which way can I go up with the suitcase?

messages.speaker: Mark (工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża l-mutalgħa fuq ix-xellug; minn hemm ma jkollokx bżonn it-taraġ.
messages.mt_standard: Uża l-mutalgħa fuq ix-xellug; minn hemm ma jkollokx bżonn it-taraġ.
messages.zh: 走左边的坡道，从那里走就不用爬楼梯了。
messages.en: Use the ramp on the left; that way you won't need the stairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拖着行李沿斜坡上行，把 mutalgħa 与“连接高低两处的坡道”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Covered or dirtied with mud, or having a muddy surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被泥弄脏、表面沾着泥的，或地面泥泞的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maħmuġ jew miksi bit-tajn, jew li għandu t-tajn fuq il-wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被泥弄脏的；已经沾上泥的。
有泥的；泥泞的；沾满泥的。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita, il-passaġġ kien mutjan u diffiċli biex timxi fih.
formal.en: After the rain, the path was muddy and difficult to walk along.
formal.zh: 雨后，小路泥泞难行。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Iż-żarbun tiegħek mutjan! Ben: Naf, dħalt f'għadira. Innaddfu qabel nidħol id-dar.
colloquial.en: Marija: Your shoe is muddy! Ben: I know, I stepped in a puddle. I'll clean it before I go into the house.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你的鞋沾上泥了！Ben：我知道，我踩进了一个水坑。我进屋前会把它清理干净。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 你的鞋沾上泥了！
messages.en: Your shoe is muddy!

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Naf, dħalt f'għadira. Innaddfu qabel nidħol id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Naf, dħalt f'għadira. Innaddfu qabel nidħol id-dar.
messages.zh: 我知道，我踩进了一个水坑。我进屋前会把它清理干净。
messages.en: I know, I stepped in a puddle. I'll clean it before I go into the house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mutjan 配上雨后鞋底沾泥的画面：鞋可以“沾泥”，路也可以“泥泞”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unable to speak or remaining without speech; also describing a film without spoken dialogue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不能说话或不出声的；也用于形容没有口头对白的电影。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jitkellem jew jibqa' bla kliem; għal film, li ma fihx djalogu mitkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不能说话的；不出声的；用于电影时指没有口头对白的。
不能说话的；此处对应英语 dumb 表示无言或不能说话的义项，不表示愚笨。

formal.mt: L-istudenti analizzaw film mutu u ddiskutew kif il-ġesti jwasslu l-emozzjonijiet.
formal.en: The students analysed a silent film and discussed how gestures convey emotions.
formal.zh: 学生们分析了一部无声电影，并讨论了手势如何传达情绪。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ħadd ma jitkellem f'dan il-film? Leo: Għax huwa film mutu; segwi l-ġesti u aqra t-titli.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does nobody speak in this film? Leo: Because it's a silent film; follow the gestures and read the title cards.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这部电影里怎么没人说话？Leo：因为这是无声电影；留意人物的动作，再看字幕卡。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħadd ma jitkellem f'dan il-film?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħadd ma jitkellem f'dan il-film?
messages.zh: 这部电影里怎么没人说话？
messages.en: Why does nobody speak in this film?

messages.speaker: Leo (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax huwa film mutu; segwi l-ġesti u aqra t-titli.
messages.mt_standard: Għax huwa film mutu; segwi l-ġesti u aqra t-titli.
messages.zh: 因为这是无声电影；留意人物的动作，再看字幕卡。
messages.en: Because it's a silent film; follow the gestures and read the title cards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 film mutu“无声电影”建立记忆：画面在动，却没有口头对白，核心是“不说话”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The creative inspiration that prompts someone to write, compose, or make art.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 促使人写作、作曲或进行艺术创作的灵感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħsieb jew il-ħeġġa li tqanqal lil xi ħadd biex jikteb, jikkomponi jew joħloq xogħol artistiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灵感；激发创作的思绪或动力。

formal.mt: Il-muża għall-poeżija ġiet mill-ħoss tal-mewġ u mill-kuluri tal-baħar.
formal.en: The inspiration for the poem came from the sound of the waves and the colours of the sea.
formal.zh: 这首诗的灵感来自海浪的声音和大海的色彩。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex qed timxi waħdek fil-ġnien? David: Qed infittex il-muża għal kanzunetta ġdida.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why are you walking alone in the garden? David: I'm looking for inspiration for a new song.
colloquial.zh: Elena：你怎么一个人在花园里散步？David：我正在为一首新歌寻找灵感。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么一个人在花园里散步？
messages.en: Why are you walking alone in the garden?

messages.speaker: David (词曲作者)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed infittex il-muża għal kanzunetta ġdida.
messages.mt_standard: Qed infittex il-muża għal kanzunetta ġdida.
messages.zh: 我正在为一首新歌寻找灵感。
messages.en: I'm looking for inspiration for a new song.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听到海浪后突然想到一句诗，把脑中闪现的创作念头叫作 muża“灵感”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where objects of historical, artistic, scientific, or cultural interest are collected, preserved, and displayed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 收藏、保存并展示具有历史、艺术、科学或文化价值物品的场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn jinġabru, jinżammu u jintwerew oġġetti ta' interess storiku, artistiku, xjentifiku jew kulturali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 博物馆；收藏、保存和展示历史、艺术、科学或文化相关物品的场所。

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara fil-mużew, l-istudenti osservaw għodod antiki u qraw it-tagħrif dwarhom.
formal.en: During the museum visit, the students examined old tools and read the information about them.
formal.zh: 参观博物馆时，学生们仔细观察了古老的工具，并阅读了相关介绍。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Trid immorru l-mużew is-Sibt? Sam: Iva! Nixtieq nara l-wirja l-ġdida.
colloquial.en: Anna: Shall we go to the museum on Saturday? Sam: Yes! I'd like to see the new exhibition.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我们星期六去博物馆好吗？Sam：好啊！我想看看新展览。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们星期六去博物馆好吗？
messages.en: Shall we go to the museum on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Sam (朋友)
messages.zh: 好啊！我想看看新展览。
messages.en: Yes! I'd like to see the new exhibition.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mużew 与展柜、文物和说明牌组成一幅画面，再用 żjara fil-mużew 记住“参观博物馆”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Related to music, or showing an ability to understand or perform music.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与音乐有关的，或表现出理解、演奏音乐的才能的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-mużika, jew li juri ħila fil-mużika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 音乐的；有音乐才能的。

formal.mt: L-iskola se torganizza kunċert biex l-istudenti juru t-talent mużikali tagħhom.
formal.en: The school will organize a concert so that students can show their musical talent.
formal.zh: 学校将举办一场音乐会，让学生展示自己的音乐才能。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek xi strument mużikali d-dar? Pawlu: Iva, għandi kitarra u ndoqqha filgħaxija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a musical instrument at home? Pawlu: Yes, I have a guitar and I play it in the evening.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你家里有乐器吗？保罗：有，我有一把吉他，晚上会弹。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你家里有乐器吗？
messages.en: Do you have a musical instrument at home?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi kitarra u ndoqqha filgħaxija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi kitarra u ndoqqha filgħaxija.
messages.zh: 有，我有一把吉他，晚上会弹。
messages.en: Yes, I have a guitar and I play it in the evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把乐器和音乐才能放在同一幅画面里：strument mużikali 是乐器，talent mużikali 是音乐才能，用两个搭配记住形容词的用途。

gloss_zh: 大腹便便的；肚子凸出的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a noticeably protruding belly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人的腹部明显向前凸出，即大腹便便的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu żaqqu mqabbża 'l barra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容某人肚子明显凸出。
大腹便便的；挺着大肚子的。

collocations.zh: 一个肚子凸出的人物角色

formal.mt: Fl-illustrazzjoni jidher raġel mużqaq bilqiegħda fuq bank ħdejn is-siġra.
formal.en: The illustration shows a potbellied man sitting on a bench beside the tree.
formal.zh: 插图中，一个大腹便便的男人坐在树旁的长椅上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema karattru għażilt għall-istorja? Mark: Għażilt dak ir-raġel mużqaq bil-kappell aħmar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which character did you choose for the story? Mark: I chose that potbellied man with the red hat.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你给故事选了哪个人物？马克：我选了那个戴红帽子、大腹便便的男人。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你给故事选了哪个人物？
messages.en: Which character did you choose for the story?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għażilt dak ir-raġel mużqaq bil-kappell aħmar.
messages.mt_standard: Għażilt dak ir-raġel mużqaq bil-kappell aħmar.
messages.zh: 我选了那个戴红帽子、大腹便便的男人。
messages.en: I chose that potbellied man with the red hat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象画中人物的肚子向前鼓起，把 mużqaq 与这个具体轮廓配对；它描述的是腹部凸出的外形。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The spread of an infectious disease among people, or an outbreak affecting many people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 传染性疾病在人群中的传播，或影响许多人的疫病流行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tixrid ta' marda minn persuna għal oħra, jew tifqigħa ta' marda fost ħafna nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疫病流行；流行性疫病。
传染；疾病在人与人之间的传播。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-mxija tal-marda fir-raħal matul ix-xitwa.
formal.en: The report describes the spread of the disease in the village during the winter.
formal.zh: 报告描述了冬季这种疾病在村庄中的传播情况。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fuq xiex kien l-artiklu li qrajt? Samwel: Fuq il-mxija ta' marda f'raħal żgħir.
colloquial.en: Nina: What was the article you read about? Samwel: About the spread of a disease in a small village.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你读的那篇文章讲什么？萨穆埃尔：讲一种疾病在一个小村庄里的传播。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq xiex kien l-artiklu li qrajt?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq xiex kien l-artiklu li qrajt?
messages.zh: 你读的那篇文章讲什么？
messages.en: What was the article you read about?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-mxija ta' marda f'raħal żgħir.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-mxija ta' marda f'raħal żgħir.
messages.zh: 讲一种疾病在一个小村庄里的传播。
messages.en: About the spread of a disease in a small village.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画出村庄地图，用连线表示疾病在人群间传播；mxija 可以指这种传染，也可以指形成的疫病流行。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A depot or port where merchandise is unloaded.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供商品卸载的货场或港口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post jew port fejn tinħatt il-merkanzija.

sense_translations.en_definition: a depot or port for the unloading of merchandise
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于卸载商品的货场或港口。

sense_translations.en_definition: Mġarr (a village and local council of the Northern Region, Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: Mġarr：马耳他北部地区的一个村庄及其地方议会。

sense_translations.en_definition: Mġarr (a town in the Gozo Region, Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: Mġarr：马耳他戈佐地区的一个城镇。

collocations.en: a depot or port for merchandise
collocations.zh: 供商品使用的卸货场或卸货港

formal.mt: Il-merkanzija nħattet fil-mġarr qabel ma ttieħdet lejn il-maħżen.
formal.en: The merchandise was unloaded at the depot before being taken to the warehouse.
formal.zh: 商品先在卸货场卸下，随后运往仓库。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Meta tgħid l-Imġarr, qed titkellem dwar il-villaġġ f'Malta? Pietru: Le, qed ngħid l-Imġarr f'Għawdex, ħdejn il-port.
colloquial.en: Marija: When you say Mġarr, do you mean the village in Malta? Pietru: No, I mean Mġarr in Gozo, near the harbour.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你说 Mġarr，是指马耳他岛上的那个村庄吗？彼得：不是，我说的是戈佐岛上靠近港口的 Mġarr。

messages.speaker: Marija (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid l-Imġarr, qed titkellem dwar il-villaġġ f'Malta?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid l-Imġarr, qed titkellem dwar il-villaġġ f'Malta?
messages.zh: 你说 Mġarr，是指马耳他岛上的那个村庄吗？
messages.en: When you say Mġarr, do you mean the village in Malta?

messages.speaker: Pietru (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, qed ngħid l-Imġarr f'Għawdex, ħdejn il-port.
messages.mt_standard: Le, qed ngħid l-Imġarr f'Għawdex, ħdejn il-port.
messages.zh: 不是，我说的是戈佐岛上靠近港口的 Mġarr。
messages.en: No, I mean Mġarr in Gozo, near the harbour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先画货物卸到岸边的场景记普通名词 mġarr，再在地图上分别标出两个 Mġarr；地名要连同岛屿一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The way a person behaves, treats others, or carries themselves in a situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人在某种情境中的行为方式、待人举止或表现出的仪态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mod kif persuna taġixxi, tittratta lil ħaddieħor jew iġġib ruħha f'sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行为；一个人采取行动和作出反应的方式。
举止；通过外在表现呈现的态度和神情。
仪态；姿态；举手投足表现出的风度。

formal.mt: L-iskola tħeġġeġ imġiba tajba u rispett lejn l-istudenti u l-għalliema kollha.
formal.en: The school encourages good behaviour and respect towards all students and teachers.
formal.zh: 学校鼓励良好行为，并倡导尊重所有学生和教师。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Kif kienet l-imġiba ta' Ben fil-klassi llum? David: Tajba ħafna. Stenna sakemm imissu jitkellem u għen lil sħabu.
colloquial.en: Elena: How was Ben's behaviour in class today? David: Very good. He waited for his turn to speak and helped his classmates.
colloquial.zh: 埃琳娜：本今天在课堂上的表现怎么样？戴维：很好。他等轮到自己才发言，还帮助了同学。

messages.speaker: Elena (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kienet l-imġiba ta' Ben fil-klassi llum?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kienet l-imġiba ta' Ben fil-klassi llum?
messages.zh: 本今天在课堂上的表现怎么样？
messages.en: How was Ben's behaviour in class today?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajba ħafna. Stenna sakemm imissu jitkellem u għen lil sħabu.
messages.mt_standard: Tajba ħafna. Stenna sakemm imissu jitkellem u għen lil sħabu.
messages.zh: 很好。他等轮到自己才发言，还帮助了同学。
messages.en: Very good. He waited for his turn to speak and helped his classmates.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mġiba 想成一段观察人的短视频：做了什么是行为，怎样待人是举止，站坐神态是仪态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Was made to do something by another person or by circumstances, without a free choice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到他人要求或客观情势限制，没有自由选择而被迫做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kellu jagħmel xi ħaġa minħabba persuna oħra jew iċ-ċirkostanzi, mingħajr għażla ħielsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被迫做某事；当时受到强制或情势逼迫。
被迫的；受到强制的；并非出于自由意愿的。

formal.mt: Minħabba l-għargħar, is-sewwieq kien mġiegħel ibiddel ir-rotta.
formal.en: Because of the flooding, the driver was compelled to change the route.
formal.zh: 由于洪水，司机被迫改变了路线。

colloquial.mt: Nora: Għaliex telaq kmieni Adam? Samwel: Kien mġiegħel jitlaq għax ċemplulu mill-iskola ta' ibnu.
colloquial.en: Nora: Why did Adam leave early? Samwel: He had to leave because his son's school called him.
colloquial.zh: 诺拉：亚当为什么提前走了？萨姆韦尔：他儿子的学校打电话给他，他不得不离开。

messages.speaker: Nora (同事)
messages.zh: 亚当为什么提前走了？
messages.en: Why did Adam leave early?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien mġiegħel jitlaq għax ċemplulu mill-iskola ta' ibnu.
messages.mt_standard: Kien mġiegħel jitlaq għax ċemplulu mill-iskola ta' ibnu.
messages.zh: 他儿子的学校打电话给他，他不得不离开。
messages.en: He had to leave because his son's school called him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象原本打算留下，却因突发情况必须离开：mġiegħel 记“被迫”，整块记 kien mġiegħel jitlaq“当时被迫离开”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong feeling of love, affection or care for someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某事物怀有的强烈爱意、亲情或关爱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sentiment qawwi ta' għożża u ħsieb għal xi ħadd jew għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱；爱情；爱意
喜爱；亲切的感情；关爱
深厚的爱；强烈的喜爱之情
因为；由于；表示原因

formal.mt: L-imħabba u r-rispett huma importanti fir-relazzjonijiet bejn il-membri tal-familja.
formal.en: Love and respect are important in relationships between family members.
formal.zh: 爱与尊重在家庭成员之间的关系中十分重要。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan ir-rigal għalik, b'imħabba. Luca: Grazzi, Ma! Inħobbok ukoll.
colloquial.en: Marija: This gift is for you, with love. Luca: Thanks, Mum! I love you too.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这份礼物送给你，带着我的爱。卢卡：谢谢妈妈！我也爱你。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 这份礼物送给你，带着我的爱。
messages.en: This gift is for you, with love.

messages.speaker: Luca (儿子)
messages.zh: 谢谢妈妈！我也爱你。
messages.en: Thanks, Mum! I love you too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 b'imħabba 想成礼物卡片上的“带着爱”：名词记爱意；遇到介词义时另按“由于”理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A soft object used to support the head in bed or the body while sitting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 睡觉时承托头部，或坐着时支撑身体的柔软垫子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett artab li jintuża biex isostni r-ras fis-sodda jew il-ġisem meta wieħed ikun bilqiegħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 枕头；睡觉时垫在头下的软垫
靠垫；用于倚靠或承托身体的软垫

formal.mt: Kull sodda fil-kamra għandha mħadda nadifa u kutra.
formal.en: Each bed in the room has a clean pillow and a blanket.
formal.zh: 房间里的每张床都配有一个干净的枕头和一条毯子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid mħadda oħra? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Din baxxa wisq għalija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like another pillow? Mark: Yes, please. This one is too low for me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要再来一个枕头吗？马克：好的，谢谢。这个对我来说太低了。

messages.speaker: Maja (主人)
messages.zh: 你要再来一个枕头吗？
messages.en: Would you like another pillow?

messages.speaker: Mark (客人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Din baxxa wisq għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Din baxxa wisq għalija.
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢。这个对我来说太低了。
messages.en: Yes, please. This one is too low for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住同一个柔软垫子放在不同位置：床上托头是枕头，沙发上倚靠是靠垫。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reel around which thread is wound for storage or use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供线缠绕其上、便于收纳或使用的线轴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jitkebbeb il-ħajt madwaru biex jinżamm jew jintuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 线轴；供缝纫线等缠绕的轴
星座；被视为一个整体的恒星组合
卷轴；绕线轴

formal.mt: Il-ħajjata żammet il-ħajt fuq mħalla biex ma jitħabbilx.
formal.en: The seamstress kept the thread on a reel so that it would not become tangled.
formal.zh: 女裁缝把线绕在线轴上，以免线缠结。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek mħalla vojta? Mark: Iva, ħu din. Tista' tkebbeb il-ħajt fuqha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have an empty reel? Mark: Yes, take this one. You can wind the thread onto it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有空线轴吗？马克：有，拿这个吧。你可以把线绕在上面。

messages.speaker: Maja (缝纫学员)
messages.zh: 你有空线轴吗？
messages.en: Do you have an empty reel?

messages.speaker: Mark (缝纫老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu din. Tista' tkebbeb il-ħajt fuqha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu din. Tista' tkebbeb il-ħajt fuqha.
messages.zh: 有，拿这个吧。你可以把线绕在上面。
messages.en: Yes, take this one. You can wind the thread onto it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分别制作两张记忆图卡：缝纫桌上的线轴、夜空中的星座；分开记忆这两个义项，不推测词源联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose official role is to hear cases and make decisions in a court of law.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在法院依法审理案件并作出裁决的人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha l-kariga li tisma' kawżi u tagħti deċiżjonijiet fil-qorti skont il-liġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法官；在法院审理案件并作出裁决的人

collocations.zh: 在法官面前；出庭面对法官

formal.mt: L-imħallef sema' lix-xhieda qabel ta d-deċiżjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The judge heard the witnesses before giving his decision.
formal.zh: 法官听取证人的证言后作出了裁决。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jisma' l-kawża llum? Mark: L-imħallef li rajna hawn il-ġimgħa l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will hear the case today? Mark: The judge we saw here last week.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天谁来审理这个案子？马克：就是我们上周在这里见过的那位法官。

messages.speaker: Maja (旁听者)
messages.zh: 今天谁来审理这个案子？
messages.en: Who will hear the case today?

messages.speaker: Mark (旁听同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: L-imħallef li rajna hawn il-ġimgħa l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: L-imħallef li rajna hawn il-ġimgħa l-oħra.
messages.zh: 就是我们上周在这里见过的那位法官。
messages.en: The judge we saw here last week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进法庭画面：听证言、审案件、作裁决；连续三个动作帮助记住“法官”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An agreement to risk money or something else on the outcome of an uncertain event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 针对结果尚不确定的事情，以钱或其他东西为赌注订立的约定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ftehim li fih wieħed jirriskja flus jew xi ħaġa oħra fuq ir-riżultat ta' ġrajja li għadu mhux magħruf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打赌；赌约；针对某个结果所下的赌注

formal.mt: Skont il-ftehim tagħhom, min jitlef l-imħatra jixtri kafè lill-ieħor.
formal.en: Under their agreement, whoever loses the bet buys the other person a coffee.
formal.zh: 按照他们的约定，打赌输的一方要请另一方喝杯咖啡。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nagħmlu mħatra fuq min jirbaħ il-logħba? Min jitlef jixtri kafè. Maja: Sewwa! Jien ngħid li jirbaħ it-tim bl-aħmar.
colloquial.en: Mark: Shall we make a bet on who wins the match? The loser buys a coffee. Maja: All right! I say the team in red will win.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们赌一赌谁会赢这场比赛吧？输的人请喝咖啡。玛雅：好啊！我猜穿红衣服的队会赢。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħmlu mħatra fuq min jirbaħ il-logħba? Min jitlef jixtri kafè.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħmlu mħatra fuq min jirbaħ il-logħba? Min jitlef jixtri kafè.
messages.zh: 我们赌一赌谁会赢这场比赛吧？输的人请喝咖啡。
messages.en: Shall we make a bet on who wins the match? The loser buys a coffee.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa! Jien ngħid li jirbaħ it-tim bl-aħmar.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa! Jien ngħid li jirbaħ it-tim bl-aħmar.
messages.zh: 好啊！我猜穿红衣服的队会赢。
messages.en: All right! I say the team in red will win.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友猜比赛结果，约好输的人请咖啡：有预测、有输赢、有约定，就是一次打赌。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put something where people can see it, especially for display.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品放在别人能够看见的位置，供人观看或展示。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qiegħed xi ħaġa fejn in-nies jistgħu jarawha, biex juriha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 展示；把物品陈列出来供人观看。

collocations.en: displayed the objects in the window

formal.mt: Il-bejjiegħ nabar il-prodotti fuq mejda ħdejn id-daħla tal-ħanut.
formal.en: The seller displayed the products on a table near the shop entrance.
formal.zh: 卖家把产品陈列在商店入口附近的一张桌子上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn poġġa l-platti l-ġodda? Toni: Nabar il-platti fit-tieqa biex jarahom kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did he put the new plates? Toni: He displayed the plates in the window so everyone could see them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他把新盘子放在哪里了？托尼：他把盘子陈列在橱窗里，让大家都能看见。

messages.speaker: Maja (店员)
messages.zh: 他把新盘子放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did he put the new plates?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Nabar il-platti fit-tieqa biex jarahom kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Nabar il-platti fit-tieqa biex jarahom kulħadd.
messages.zh: 他把盘子陈列在橱窗里，让大家都能看见。
messages.en: He displayed the plates in the window so everyone could see them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用商店橱窗记住 nabar：把盘子从箱子里拿出，摆到人人看得见的位置，整个动作就是展示或陈列。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who puts objects or goods on display for others to see.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品或商品摆放出来供别人观看的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqiegħed oġġetti jew prodotti fejn in-nies jistgħu jarawhom.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who puts things on display
sense_translations.zh_definition: 陈列物品的人；负责把东西展示出来的人。
展示；陈列物品供人观看。

collocations.en: the person who arranges the shop's displays
collocations.zh: 商店里负责陈列物品的人

collocations.en: displayed the products in the window

formal.mt: In-nabbar poġġa l-oġġetti fuq l-ixkafef sabiex il-viżitaturi jkunu jistgħu jarawhom sew.
formal.en: The person arranging the display placed the objects on the shelves so that visitors could see them clearly.
formal.zh: 负责陈列的人把物品摆在架子上，以便参观者看清楚。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jqiegħed l-oġġetti fit-tieqa? Mark: In-nabbar tal-ħanut; diġà għażel fejn se jpoġġi kollox.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who will put the objects in the window? Mark: The person who arranges the shop's displays; he has already chosen where to put everything.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁来把物品摆进橱窗？马克：店里负责陈列的人；他已经选好每件东西放在哪里了。

messages.speaker: Sara (店员)
messages.zh: 谁来把物品摆进橱窗？
messages.en: Who will put the objects in the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nabbar tal-ħanut; diġà għażel fejn se jpoġġi kollox.
messages.mt_standard: In-nabbar tal-ħanut; diġà għażel fejn se jpoġġi kollox.
messages.zh: 店里负责陈列的人；他已经选好每件东西放在哪里了。
messages.en: The person who arranges the shop's displays; he has already chosen where to put everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一张人物卡和一张动作卡：nabbar 作名词时对应负责陈列的人，作动词时对应展示动作；连同词性一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who claims to foretell future events, or a prophet in a religious context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 声称能够预知未来的人，也可指宗教语境中的先知。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħid li tista' tbassar il-ġejjieni, jew li twassal messaġġ mingħand Alla f'kuntest reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 算命者；声称能够预测个人命运或未来事件的人。
先知；宗教语境中被认为传达神意的人。

collocations.en: a fortune teller who predicts the future

formal.mt: Fit-test reliġjuż, in-nabi jwassal messaġġ lill-poplu u jsejjaħlu biex jagħmel it-tajjeb.
formal.en: In the religious text, the prophet delivers a message to the people and calls on them to do what is right.
formal.zh: 在这篇宗教文本中，先知向民众传达信息，并呼吁他们行善。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak ir-raġel fl-istorja? Pawlu: Hu nabi li jgħid lin-nies x'se jiġri fil-ġejjieni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is that man in the story? Pawlu: He is a fortune teller who tells people what will happen in the future.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：故事里的那个男人是谁？保罗：他是个算命者，会告诉人们未来将发生什么。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 故事里的那个男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that man in the story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu nabi li jgħid lin-nies x'se jiġri fil-ġejjieni.
messages.mt_standard: Hu nabi li jgħid lin-nies x'se jiġri fil-ġejjieni.
messages.zh: 他是个算命者，会告诉人们未来将发生什么。
messages.en: He is a fortune teller who tells people what will happen in the future.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 nabi 配两张场景卡：预测个人未来时记作算命者，宗教文本中传达神意时记作先知；靠上下文区分两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To watch or observe someone or something, including keeping watch over a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 注视或观察某人、某物，也可指持续留意某个地方以进行守望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħares lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa b'attenzjoni, jew żamm għajnejh fuq post biex jgħassu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 观看；注视。
守望；持续留意周围情况以进行看守。
观察；仔细察看。
视觉；视力。

formal.mt: Il-gwardjan nadar id-daħla tal-bini matul il-lejl.
formal.en: The guard kept watch over the building's entrance during the night.
formal.zh: 守卫在夜间守望着大楼的入口。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għamel Pawlu waqt li stennejnieh? Toni: Nadar il-baħar minn fuq il-blat.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did Pawlu do while we waited for him? Toni: He watched the sea from the rocks.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们等保罗的时候，他在做什么？托尼：他在岩石上望着海面。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们等保罗的时候，他在做什么？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do while we waited for him?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 他在岩石上望着海面。
messages.en: He watched the sea from the rocks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 以眼睛为共同画面：看海是观看，细看是观察，盯住入口是守望；另把名词义视觉单列一栏，避免混淆词性。

gloss_zh: 清洁；把盘里的食物吃得一干二净

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove dirt from something; also, to eat every last bit of food on one's plate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 除去物品上的污垢，使其干净；也可指把自己盘里的食物全部吃光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa l-ħmieġ minn xi ħaġa; jista' jfisser ukoll li kiel l-ikel kollu li kellu fil-platt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清洁；清除污垢，使之干净。

sense_translations.en_definition: to eat every last scrap on one's plate
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把自己盘里的食物吃得一干二净，一点不剩。

collocations.en: ate every last bit on the plate
collocations.zh: 把盘里的食物吃得一干二净

formal.mt: Wara l-attività, l-għalliem naddaf il-mejda u poġġa l-materjal lura fl-armarju.
formal.en: After the activity, the teacher cleaned the table and put the materials back in the cupboard.
formal.zh: 活动结束后，老师清洁了桌子，并把材料放回柜子里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għoġbu l-ikel lil Pawlu? Sara: Iva, naddaf il-platt u ma ħalla xejn!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu like the food? Sara: Yes, he ate every last bit on his plate and left nothing!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗喜欢这些饭菜吗？萨拉：喜欢，他把盘里的食物吃得一干二净，一点也没剩！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗喜欢这些饭菜吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu like the food?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, naddaf il-platt u ma ħalla xejn!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, naddaf il-platt u ma ħalla xejn!
messages.zh: 喜欢，他把盘里的食物吃得一干二净，一点也没剩！
messages.en: Yes, he ate every last bit on his plate and left nothing!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅干净的画面记忆：抹布擦净桌子对应清洁，吃到空盘对应全部吃光；遇到 platt 时结合吃饭或洗涤的上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clean or neat, without dirt or untidiness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有污垢的，或收拾得整齐的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mingħajr ħmieġ jew imbarazz; miżmum fi stat tajjeb u pulit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 干净的；没有污垢的
整洁的；整齐利落的

formal.mt: Il-post tax-xogħol għandu jinżamm nadif u fl-ordni.
formal.en: The workplace should be kept clean and orderly.
formal.zh: 工作场所应保持干净、有序。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dan it-tazza nadifa? Pawlu: Iva, għadni kemm ħsiltha. U l-mejda nadifa wkoll.
colloquial.en: Marta: Is this glass clean? Pawlu: Yes, I've just washed it. And the table is clean too.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这个杯子干净吗？Pawlu：干净，我刚洗过。桌子也干净。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.zh: 这个杯子干净吗？
messages.en: Is this glass clean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadni kemm ħsiltha. U l-mejda nadifa wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadni kemm ħsiltha. U l-mejda nadifa wkoll.
messages.zh: 干净，我刚洗过。桌子也干净。
messages.en: Yes, I've just washed it. And the table is clean too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nadif 连到两幅画面：擦净的桌面和排齐的物品，分别记住“干净”和“整洁”。

gloss_zh: 戈佐岛纳杜尔的；纳杜尔人

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a person from Nadur in Gozo, or something connected with Nadur.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容来自戈佐岛纳杜尔的人，或与纳杜尔有关的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej min-Nadur, f'Għawdex, jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' dan ir-raħal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容某人来自戈佐岛的纳杜尔
纳杜尔的；与纳杜尔有关的
纳杜尔居民；纳杜尔人

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi l-wirt Naduri u r-rabta tiegħu mal-ħajja tar-raħal.
formal.en: The study describes the heritage of Nadur and its connection with village life.
formal.zh: 这项研究描述了纳杜尔的文化遗产及其与村庄生活的联系。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Int Naduri? Mark: Iva, jien min-Nadur, f'Għawdex.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you from Nadur? Mark: Yes, I'm from Nadur in Gozo.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你是纳杜尔人吗？Mark：是的，我来自戈佐岛的纳杜尔。

messages.speaker: Lara (新同学)
messages.zh: 你是纳杜尔人吗？
messages.en: Are you from Nadur?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 是的，我来自戈佐岛的纳杜尔。
messages.en: Yes, I'm from Nadur in Gozo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Naduri 放在人物和地方文化旁一起记：修饰人时表示来自纳杜尔，修饰事物时表示与纳杜尔有关。

gloss_zh: 受惊；易受惊；感到冒犯；惊退

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become frightened or shy away, especially when an animal reacts to something alarming.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因受到惊吓而害怕或退缩，尤其用于动物的受惊反应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Beża' jew tbiegħed minħabba l-biża', speċjalment meta annimal jara jew jisma' xi ħaġa li tbeżżgħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 害怕；受到惊吓
容易受惊；表现得惊惶不安
突然受惊；惊慌起来
感到被冒犯；因不悦而产生反感
因受惊而躲闪或退缩，尤指马等动物

formal.mt: Iż-żiemel nafar meta sema' ħoss qawwi u waqaf ħesrem.
formal.en: The horse took fright when it heard a loud noise and stopped abruptly.
formal.zh: 马听到巨响后受了惊，突然停了下来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex waqaf iż-żiemel? Toni: Nafar mill-ħoss tal-mutur. Agħtih ftit ħin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did the horse stop? Toni: It took fright at the motorbike's noise. Give it a little time.
colloquial.zh: Sara：马为什么停下来了？Toni：它被摩托车的声音吓到了。给它一点时间。

messages.speaker: Sara (骑马学员)
messages.zh: 马为什么停下来了？
messages.en: Why did the horse stop?

messages.speaker: Toni (骑马教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Nafar mill-ħoss tal-mutur. Agħtih ftit ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Nafar mill-ħoss tal-mutur. Agħtih ftit ħin.
messages.zh: 它被摩托车的声音吓到了。给它一点时间。
messages.en: It took fright at the motorbike's noise. Give it a little time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 nafar 时想象马听见响声后自己惊退；再把人的心理退缩联系到“感到冒犯”，帮助区分不同义项。

gloss_zh: 吓唬；使烦躁；惊走；稻草人；驱赶动物者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To frighten or startle someone or an animal, sometimes causing them to move away.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或动物害怕、受惊，有时使其因此离开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Beżża' lil persuna jew annimal, xi drabi b'mod li jitbiegħdu jew jaħarbu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吓唬；使害怕
使烦躁；惹恼
稻草人；用于吓走鸟兽的假人
吓唬或驱赶动物的人
使突然受惊；吓走

formal.mt: Il-ħoss tal-magna naffar l-għasafar mill-għalqa.
formal.en: The noise of the machine scared the birds away from the field.
formal.zh: 机器的声音把鸟儿从田里吓走了。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn marru l-għasafar? Ġużeppi: Il-kelb naffarhom meta beda jinbaħ.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where did the birds go? Ġużeppi: The dog scared them away when it started barking.
colloquial.zh: Anna：鸟儿都去哪儿了？Ġużeppi：狗一叫，就把它们吓跑了。

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.zh: 鸟儿都去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did the birds go?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (园主)
messages.zh: 狗一叫，就把它们吓跑了。
messages.en: The dog scared them away when it started barking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用场景对照记忆：nafar 是马自己受惊，naffar 是声音把马吓到；再把田里的稻草人当作“吓走动物”的提示图。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a low, plaintive sound, as when whimpering or whining.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出低低的、带有哀求或不适意味的呜咽声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħareġ leħen baxx u ta' tnehid jew ilment, bħal annimal li jkun imdejjaq jew irid xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呜咽；发出低低的哀鸣
哼哼唧唧地叫；呜咽

formal.mt: Il-kelb nagħa bil-mod waqt li kien qed jistenna lil sidu ħdejn il-bieb.
formal.en: The dog whimpered softly while waiting for its owner by the door.
formal.zh: 狗在门边等待主人时，轻轻地呜咽。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Smajt lill-kelb? David: Iva, nagħa ħdejn il-bieb. Naħseb li jrid joħroġ.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you hear the dog? David: Yes, it whimpered by the door. I think it wants to go out.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你听到狗的声音了吗？David：听到了，它在门边呜咽。我想它要出去。

messages.speaker: Nina (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你听到狗的声音了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear the dog?

messages.speaker: David (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nagħa ħdejn il-bieb. Naħseb li jrid joħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nagħa ħdejn il-bieb. Naħseb li jrid joħroġ.
messages.zh: 听到了，它在门边呜咽。我想它要出去。
messages.en: Yes, it whimpered by the door. I think it wants to go out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小狗守在门边轻声哼叫，把 nagħa 和这种低低的呜咽声绑定，记住它表达声音和情绪。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fit horseshoes to a horse, donkey, or similar animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给马、驴等动物的蹄部装上蹄铁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħħal in-nagħal ma' saqajn żiemel, ħmar jew annimal simili.

sense_translations.en_definition: to shoe a horse, donkey etc
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给马、驴等动物钉蹄铁
蹄铁；马蹄铁，可指单个或多个

formal.mt: Il-ħaddied nagħal iż-żiemel qabel il-vjaġġ.
formal.en: The farrier fitted horseshoes to the horse before the journey.
formal.zh: 钉蹄铁匠在出发前给马钉了蹄铁。

colloquial.mt: Luqa: Iż-żiemel lest għall-vjaġġ? Marija: Iva, il-ħaddied nagħlu dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Luqa: Is the horse ready for the journey? Marija: Yes, the farrier shod it this morning.
colloquial.zh: Luqa：马准备好出发了吗？Marija：准备好了，钉蹄铁匠今天早上给它钉好了蹄铁。

messages.speaker: Luqa (骑手)
messages.zh: 马准备好出发了吗？
messages.en: Is the horse ready for the journey?

messages.speaker: Marija (马主)
messages.zh: 准备好了，钉蹄铁匠今天早上给它钉好了蹄铁。
messages.en: Yes, the farrier shod it this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nagħal 记成“给马穿铁鞋”的画面：动作是钉蹄铁，装上去的物件就是蹄铁，借同一场景区分两种词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fall asleep, especially to doze off without intending to.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 睡着，尤其指因困倦而不知不觉地打盹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jorqod, speċjalment għal ftit ħin mingħajr ma jkun beħsiebu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 入睡；睡着。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be sleepy; to doze off; to fall asleep inadvertently
sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到困倦；打盹；不经意地睡着。

formal.mt: Wara jum twil ta' xogħol, Pawlu nagħas waqt li kien jaqra.
formal.en: After a long day at work, Pawlu dozed off while reading.
formal.zh: 工作了漫长的一天后，保罗读着读着便打起了盹。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu Mark? Lara: Nagħas fuq is-sufan. Ħallih jistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Mark? Lara: He dozed off on the sofa. Let him rest for a bit.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克在哪儿？拉拉：他在沙发上睡着了。让他休息一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is Mark?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħas fuq is-sufan. Ħallih jistrieħ ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħas fuq is-sufan. Ħallih jistrieħ ftit.
messages.zh: 他在沙发上睡着了。让他休息一会儿吧。
messages.en: He dozed off on the sofa. Let him rest for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nagħas 配上“读着读着眼皮合上”的画面，记住它表示睡着或不知不觉打盹这一动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mint, an aromatic plant whose leaves are used to flavor food and drinks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 薄荷，一种叶片带有香气、可用于给食物和饮品调味的植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta b'weraq ifuħ li jintuża biex jagħti togħma lill-ikel u lix-xorb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 薄荷；可用于食物和饮品调味的芳香植物。

formal.mt: Żid ftit weraq tan-nagħniegħ frisk mal-insalata qabel isserviha.
formal.en: Add a few fresh mint leaves to the salad before serving it.
formal.zh: 端上沙拉前，加入几片新鲜薄荷叶。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid ftit nagħniegħ fit-te? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Żid żewġ werqiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like some mint in your tea? Mark: Yes, please. Add two leaves.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你的茶里要放点薄荷吗？马克：好的，谢谢。放两片叶子吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (主人)
messages.zh: 你的茶里要放点薄荷吗？
messages.en: Would you like some mint in your tea?

messages.speaker: Mark (客人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Żid żewġ werqiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Żid żewġ werqiet.
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢。放两片叶子吧。
messages.en: Yes, please. Add two leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nagħniegħ 写在薄荷茶的想象标签上，再联想两片清香的绿叶，用气味和画面一起记住“薄荷”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period of sleep, especially a short nap or doze.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一段睡眠，尤其指时间较短的小睡或打盹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu ta' rqad, speċjalment wieħed qasir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次小睡；短时间的睡眠。
一次打盹；短暂而较浅的睡眠。
睡一觉；小睡一会儿，英语对应词带有口语色彩。
一觉；一段睡眠。

formal.mt: Wara l-ikel, Marija ħadet nagħsa qasira qabel kompliet taħdem.
formal.en: After lunch, Marija took a short nap before continuing her work.
formal.zh: 午饭后，玛丽亚先小睡了一会儿，然后继续工作。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Se toħroġ magħna issa? Maja: Aktar tard. L-ewwel nieħu nagħsa ta' għoxrin minuta.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Are you coming out with us now? Maja: Later. First I'll take a twenty-minute nap.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：你现在跟我们一起出去吗？玛雅：晚一点吧。我先小睡二十分钟。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 你现在跟我们一起出去吗？
messages.en: Are you coming out with us now?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aktar tard. L-ewwel nieħu nagħsa ta' għoxrin minuta.
messages.mt_standard: Aktar tard. L-ewwel nieħu nagħsa ta' għoxrin minuta.
messages.zh: 晚一点吧。我先小睡二十分钟。
messages.en: Later. First I'll take a twenty-minute nap.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一次小睡”记 nagħsa 这个名词，再与表示“睡着”动作的 nagħas 对照，区分“一觉”和“入睡”。

gloss_zh: 爱好；喜爱；吸引；偏好；蜂王

teaching_sense.en_definition: A liking, attraction, or affection for someone or something, including an interest pursued as a hobby.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某事的喜爱、吸引或感情，也可指作为爱好投入的兴趣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġibda, għożża jew interess lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, inkluż interess li wieħed jieħu bħala passatemp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱好；业余消遣。
一时的喜爱；心头的兴趣或念头。
吸引；对某人或某物产生的好感。
倾向；喜好；受到吸引的感觉。
爱；爱慕；亲爱之情。
偏好；刻意表现出的做派或姿态。
女王；蜂王。

formal.mt: In-namra tagħha għall-mużika wasslitha biex tistudja l-vjolin.
formal.en: Her love of music led her to study the violin.
formal.zh: 她对音乐的喜爱促使她学习小提琴。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn ġietek din in-namra għall-ġardinaġġ? Toni: Bdejt b'qasrija waħda, u issa għandi ġnien sħiħ!
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you develop this passion for gardening? Toni: I started with one flowerpot, and now I have a whole garden!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么迷上园艺的？Toni：我从一个花盆开始，现在已经有一整个花园了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġietek din in-namra għall-ġardinaġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġietek din in-namra għall-ġardinaġġ?
messages.zh: 你怎么迷上园艺的？
messages.en: How did you develop this passion for gardening?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bdejt b'qasrija waħda, u issa għandi ġnien sħiħ!
messages.mt_standard: Bdejt b'qasrija waħda, u issa għandi ġnien sħiħ!
messages.zh: 我从一个花盆开始，现在已经有一整个花园了！
messages.en: I started with one flowerpot, and now I have a whole garden!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“喜欢到愿意投入时间”串起 namra 的爱好、好感和爱慕义；另给女王、蜂王义单独配图，避免混在同一场景里。

gloss_zh: 恋人；男朋友或女朋友；情人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person with whom someone has a romantic relationship, such as a boyfriend, girlfriend, or lover.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某人处于恋爱关系的人，如男朋友、女朋友或情人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun f'relazzjoni ta' mħabba ma' persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恋人；恋爱关系中的伴侣。
男朋友或女朋友。
恋人；情人。

collocations.en: to go out with one's boyfriend

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tagħha, Marija semmiet li n-namrat tagħha kien se jakkumpanjaha għaċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: In her letter, Marija mentioned that her boyfriend would accompany her to the ceremony.
formal.zh: 玛丽亚在信中提到，她的男朋友将陪她参加典礼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ġej miegħek għall-ikla? Lara: In-namrat tiegħi, Pawlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is coming with you to dinner? Lara: My boyfriend, Pawlu.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁会和你一起来吃饭？Lara：我的男朋友 Pawlu。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁会和你一起来吃饭？
messages.en: Who is coming with you to dinner?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的男朋友 Pawlu。
messages.en: My boyfriend, Pawlu.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 namrat 放进“介绍恋爱伴侣”的画面：身旁站着一个人，你说“这是我的恋人”，用人物关系记住名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The mother of one's father or mother.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 父亲或母亲的母亲，即祖母或外祖母。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Omm il-missier jew omm l-omm ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 祖母；外祖母；奶奶；外婆。

formal.mt: Fit-tifkiriet tagħha, l-awtriċi tiddeskrivi kif in-nanna tagħha għallmitha taqra.
formal.en: In her memoirs, the author describes how her grandmother taught her to read.
formal.zh: 作者在回忆录中描述了祖母如何教她阅读。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tmur għand in-nanna llum? Toni: Iva, se niekol magħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to your grandmother's today? Toni: Yes, I'm going to eat with her.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你今天要去奶奶家吗？Toni：是的，我要和她一起吃饭。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天要去奶奶家吗？
messages.en: Are you going to your grandmother's today?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，我要和她一起吃饭。
messages.en: Yes, I'm going to eat with her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nanna 与 nannu 并排做成家庭卡片：nanna 配祖母或外祖母照片，留意末尾 a，帮助区分两位长辈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small beetle, often with a red or orange back marked with dark spots.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种小型甲虫，背部常呈红色或橙色，并带深色斑点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insett żgħir tat-tip tal-ħanfus, li spiss ikollu dahru aħmar jew oranġjo b'tikek skuri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瓢虫，一类体形小而圆、背部常带斑点的甲虫。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, it-tfal raw nannakola ħamra b'tikek suwed fuq werqa.
formal.en: During their observation in the garden, the children saw a red ladybird with black spots on a leaf.
formal.zh: 在花园观察时，孩子们看到叶片上有一只带黑色斑点的红瓢虫。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara, hemm nannakola fuq idek! Toni: Ħa nħalliha titla' fuq din il-werqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look, there's a ladybird on your hand! Toni: I'll let it climb onto this leaf.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看，你手上有一只瓢虫！Toni：我让它爬到这片叶子上吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，你手上有一只瓢虫！
messages.en: Look, there's a ladybird on your hand!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħa nħalliha titla' fuq din il-werqa.
messages.mt_standard: Ħa nħalliha titla' fuq din il-werqa.
messages.zh: 我让它爬到这片叶子上吧。
messages.en: I'll let it climb onto this leaf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把完整词形 nannakola 写进一只斑点瓢虫的轮廓中，想象它从手背爬到叶片，用完整画面记词，不拆猜词源。

gloss_zh: 祖父；外祖父；对年长男性的尊称

teaching_sense.en_definition: The father of one's father or mother; also a respectful form of address for an elderly man.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 父亲或母亲的父亲，即祖父或外祖父；也可用于尊称年长男性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Missier il-missier jew missier l-omm ta' persuna; tintuża wkoll biex wieħed jindirizza raġel anzjan b'rispett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 祖父；外祖父；爷爷；外公。

sense_translations.en_definition: Used to show respect when addressing old men.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 称呼年长男性时表示尊敬，可按语境译为“老爷爷”等。

collocations.en: Good morning, grandfather! / Good morning, sir!
collocations.zh: 早上好，爷爷！／早上好，老爷爷！

formal.mt: Fl-istorja tal-familja, l-istudenta kitbet dwar in-nannu tagħha u x-xogħol tiegħu bħala sajjied.
formal.en: In the family history, the student wrote about her grandfather and his work as a fisherman.
formal.zh: 在家族史作业中，这名学生写了她的祖父以及他当渔民的工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nannu, tixtieq tazza te? Ġużeppi: Iva, grazzi, mingħajr zokkor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Grandpa, would you like a cup of tea? Ġużeppi: Yes, thank you, without sugar.
colloquial.zh: Maja：爷爷，要喝杯茶吗？Ġużeppi：好，谢谢，不放糖。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷，要喝杯茶吗？
messages.en: Grandpa, would you like a cup of tea?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (祖父)
messages.zh: 好，谢谢，不放糖。
messages.en: Yes, thank you, without sugar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 nannu 配爷爷或外公的照片，与 nanna 对照记忆；再想象向年长男性问好，补记它也能作尊称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To leave something in liquid so that it softens, becomes saturated, or its fibres loosen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物留在液体中浸泡，使其变软、浸透，或使纤维松解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħalla xi ħaġa f'likwidu biex tirtab, tixxarrab sew jew jinħallu l-fibri tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: to soften by steeping in liquid
sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过浸在液体中使某物变软；浸软。

sense_translations.en_definition: to macerate, to ret, to soak
sense_translations.zh_definition: 浸渍使软化；沤浸使纤维松解；浸泡。

collocations.en: he soaked the bread in milk
collocations.zh: 他把面包浸在牛奶里泡软

collocations.en: he soaked the fibres in water

formal.mt: Qabel ma ħallat l-ingredjenti, il-kok naqa' l-ħobż fil-ħalib sakemm irtab.
formal.en: Before mixing the ingredients, the cook soaked the bread in milk until it softened.
formal.zh: 混合食材之前，厨师把面包浸在牛奶里，直到泡软。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel il-kok bil-ħobż niexef? Toni: Naqa' l-ħobż fil-ħalib biex jirtab.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the cook do with the dry bread? Toni: He soaked the bread in milk to soften it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：厨师怎么处理那些干面包的？Toni：他把面包浸在牛奶里泡软。

messages.speaker: Maja (学员)
messages.zh: 厨师怎么处理那些干面包的？
messages.en: What did the cook do with the dry bread?

messages.speaker: Toni (学员)
messages.zh: 他把面包浸在牛奶里泡软。
messages.en: He soaked the bread in milk to soften it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象干面包泡进牛奶后慢慢变软，用“放入液体—等待—软化”三个画面记 naqa'，并保留词尾的撇号。

gloss_zh: 啄；小口啃食；零星偷取；涉及

teaching_sense.en_definition: To peck at something or eat it in small bites; also, to steal small amounts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用喙啄某物，或一点一点地啃食；也可指少量、多次地偷取。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jolqot xi ħaġa bil-munqar jew jiekol gidmiet żgħar; jista' jfisser ukoll li jisraq ammonti żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用喙啄某物。
小口啃食；一点一点地吃。
每次偷取少量东西。
用喙啄食或啄击某物。
小偷小摸；偷取少量财物。
涉及；与某人或某事有关。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, l-għasfur naqar iż-żerriegħa li kienet fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: During the observation, the bird pecked at the seeds on the table.
formal.zh: 观察期间，那只鸟啄食了桌上的种子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-għasfur naqar il-ħobż? Mark: Iva, imma kiel biss ftit frak.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the bird peck at the bread? Mark: Yes, but it only ate a few crumbs.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那只鸟啄面包了吗？Mark：啄了，不过只吃了一点面包屑。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那只鸟啄面包了吗？
messages.en: Did the bird peck at the bread?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma kiel biss ftit frak.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma kiel biss ftit frak.
messages.zh: 啄了，不过只吃了一点面包屑。
messages.en: Yes, but it only ate a few crumbs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 naqar 配上小鸟啄面包的画面：每次只啄一点，再用“一点点”联系小口吃和零星偷取；“涉及”义单独记。

gloss_zh: 减少；下降；体重减轻；缺少

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become smaller in amount or degree, to lose weight, or to be lacking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量或程度变少、下降，也可指体重减轻或有所欠缺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir inqas fil-kwantità jew fil-grad, jitlef il-piż, jew ma jkunx hemm biżżejjed minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 数量或程度减少。
下降；降低；衰退。
体重减轻；变瘦。
缺少；不足；欠缺。

formal.mt: In-numru ta' viżitaturi naqas matul ix-xahar ta' Ottubru.
formal.en: The number of visitors decreased during October.
formal.zh: 十月份的访客人数减少了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-prezz naqas? Pawlu: Iva, issa jiswa għaxar ewro.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has the price gone down? Pawlu: Yes, it now costs ten euros.
colloquial.zh: Sara：价格降了吗？Pawlu：降了，现在十欧元。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 价格降了吗？
messages.en: Has the price gone down?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.zh: 降了，现在十欧元。
messages.en: Yes, it now costs ten euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“价格自己降了”这个场景：naqas 描写变少的结果；再联想人数减少、体重下降和数量不足。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To shape or mark material by chiseling, carving, whittling, scraping, or engraving.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过凿、雕、削或刮，在材料上加工形状、图案或文字。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti forma lil materjal jew jagħmel marki fih billi jaħdem b'għodda li tneħħi biċċiet minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用凿子凿刻。
雕塑；将材料加工成立体造型。
雕刻；刻出形状或图案。
用小刀一点一点地削刻，尤指木料。
刮削；刮去材料表面的一部分。
雕塑、凿刻、雕刻或镌刻。

collocations.zh: 在木头上刻了一个名字

formal.mt: L-artist naqax id-data fil-ġebel taħt l-istatwa.
formal.en: The artist carved the date into the stone beneath the statue.
formal.zh: 艺术家在雕像下方的石头上刻下了日期。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min naqax dan l-isem fl-injam? Toni: Ħija; għamlu b'sikkina żgħira.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who carved this name into the wood? Toni: My brother; he did it with a small knife.
colloquial.zh: Lara：谁在木头上刻了这个名字？Toni：我哥哥，他用一把小刀刻的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁在木头上刻了这个名字？
messages.en: Who carved this name into the wood?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我哥哥，他用一把小刀刻的。
messages.en: My brother; he did it with a small knife.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 naqax 写在“木板刻名字”的学习卡上，想象工具逐点去掉材料，串联凿、雕、削、刮几种动作。

gloss_zh: 呱呱叫；用低沉、沙哑或喉音重的声音说话

teaching_sense.en_definition: To croak, or to speak with a deep, gravelly, or throaty voice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出呱呱的叫声，或用低沉、沙哑、喉音明显的声音说话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss bħal ta' żrinġ, jew jitkellem b'leħen baxx u mħarbat jew b'ħoss qawwi mill-gerżuma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出呱呱的叫声。

sense_translations.en_definition: to speak in a deep or gravelly voice
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用低沉或粗哑的声音说话。

sense_translations.en_definition: to speak in a throaty voice
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用喉音明显的声音说话。

collocations.en: spoke in a low, croaky voice
collocations.zh: 用低沉沙哑的声音说话

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl, iż-żrinġ naqnaq ħdejn l-għadira.
formal.en: During the night, the frog croaked beside the pond.
formal.zh: 夜里，青蛙在池塘边呱呱叫。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Smajtu dak il-ħoss? Ġanni: Iva, żrinġ naqnaq ħdejn l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you hear that sound? Ġanni: Yes, a frog croaked by the water.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你听见那个声音了吗？Ġanni：听见了，一只青蛙在水边呱呱叫。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见那个声音了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that sound?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.zh: 听见了，一只青蛙在水边呱呱叫。
messages.en: Yes, a frog croaked by the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 利用 naqnaq 字形里重复的 naq 作课堂节奏提示，联想接连的呱呱声，再联系人的低沉沙哑嗓音；这只是助记。

gloss_zh: 拔取；挑选；除草；校订文字

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pluck or pick items out of a larger collection, remove weeds, or check and revise a text.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从一堆东西中拔取或挑选，清除杂草；也可指检查、校订文字。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqlagħ jew jagħżel affarijiet minn fost oħrajn, ineħħi l-ħaxix ħażin, jew jiċċekkja u jirrevedi test.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拔取；摘取。

sense_translations.en_definition: to select items from a mass
sense_translations.zh_definition: 从一堆或一批东西中挑选出所需的项目。
除草；清除杂草。

sense_translations.en_definition: to weed, to remove the bad weeds from
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给某处除草，清除其中有害或不需要的杂草。

sense_translations.en_definition: to redact, revise, recheck (e.g. a text for errors)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 编订、修订或重新检查，例如检查文本中的错误。

collocations.en: revised the text to remove errors

formal.mt: Qabel il-pubblikazzjoni, l-editur naqqa t-test mill-iżbalji.
formal.en: Before publication, the editor revised the text to remove errors.
formal.zh: 出版前，编辑校订了文本，清除了其中的错误。

sense_translations.en_definition: to turn people against each other
sense_translations.zh_definition: 挑拨离间，使人彼此对立。
阴谋算计他人的人。
设置陷阱；布下圈套。
密谋；策划阴谋。
煽动人与人之间的敌意。

collocations.zh: 用陷阱捉住了一只老鼠

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, ir-raġel nassas kontra sħabu biex jikseb il-kariga.
formal.en: According to the report, the man schemed against his colleagues to obtain the post.
formal.zh: 据报告，这名男子为了得到该职位而阴谋算计同事。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak ir-raġel? Toni: Għax nassas kontra sħabu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why don't you trust that man? Toni: Because he schemed against his companions.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么不信任那个男人？托尼：因为他曾阴谋算计自己的同伴。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak ir-raġel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak ir-raġel?
messages.zh: 你为什么不信任那个男人？
messages.en: Why don't you trust that man?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为他曾阴谋算计自己的同伴。
messages.en: Because he schemed against his companions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上“布圈套”的画面：对动物是设陷阱，对人可以是算计或挑拨；作名词时则指设局算计别人的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Existing in nature or occurring in an ordinary, expected way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 存在于自然界的，或以正常、合乎情理的方式出现的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jeżisti fin-natura jew li jiġri b'mod normali u mistenni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自然的；天然的；正常而合乎情理的。

formal.mt: Il-bini għandu twieqi kbar biex jidħol aktar dawl naturali.
formal.en: The building has large windows to let in more natural light.
formal.zh: 这栋建筑设有大窗户，以便让更多自然光照进来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex trid tieħu r-ritratt ħdejn it-tieqa? Mark: Għax hawn id-dawl naturali huwa aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you want to take the photo by the window? Mark: Because the natural light is better here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么想在窗边拍照？马克：因为这里的自然光更好。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex trid tieħu r-ritratt ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex trid tieħu r-ritratt ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.zh: 你为什么想在窗边拍照？
messages.en: Why do you want to take the photo by the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hawn id-dawl naturali huwa aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hawn id-dawl naturali huwa aħjar.
messages.zh: 因为这里的自然光更好。
messages.en: Because the natural light is better here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想窗外照进来的自然光：dawl naturali。把 naturali 放在事物名称旁边，记住它用于描述“自然的、天然的”。

gloss_zh: 自然地；自然而然地；当然

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a natural or expected way; also used to mean of course.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以自然或意料之中的方式；也可表示“当然”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod naturali jew mistenni; jintuża wkoll biex ifisser li xi ħaġa hija ovvja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自然地；自然而然地。
自然地；自然而然地；当然。

formal.mt: L-għalliem ħeġġeġ lill-istudenti jitkellmu naturalment waqt id-diskussjoni.
formal.en: The teacher encouraged the students to speak naturally during the discussion.
formal.zh: 老师鼓励学生在讨论时自然地表达。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' noqgħod ħdejk? Pawlu: Naturalment! Hemm siġġu vojt hawn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I sit next to you? Pawlu: Of course! There's an empty chair here.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我可以坐在你旁边吗？保罗：当然！这里有一把空椅子。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 我可以坐在你旁边吗？
messages.en: Can I sit next to you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 当然！这里有一把空椅子。
messages.en: Of course! There's an empty chair here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景记忆：说话不拘谨是“自然地”，爽快答应朋友是“当然”。naturali 描述事物，naturalment 可描述动作或回应整句话。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce or open flowers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长出或绽放花朵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ il-fjuri jew jiftaħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开花；绽放。
腐烂；腐败。
发霉；变得有霉斑。
引起霉菌滋生或霉味的作用。
逐渐发霉；长出霉菌。
腐烂；腐朽。
开花；花朵盛开。

formal.mt: Il-lewż fil-ġnien nawwar kmieni din is-sena.
formal.en: The almond tree in the garden blossomed early this year.
formal.zh: 花园里的杏树今年开花较早。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan il-ħobż għadu tajjeb? Ben: Le, nawwar. Ħu ftit ħobż frisk.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is this bread still good? Ben: No, it's gone mouldy. Have some fresh bread.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这个面包还能吃吗？本：不能，已经发霉了。吃点新鲜面包吧。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 这个面包还能吃吗？
messages.en: Is this bread still good?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nawwar. Ħu ftit ħobż frisk.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nawwar. Ħu ftit ħobż frisk.
messages.zh: 不能，已经发霉了。吃点新鲜面包吧。
messages.en: No, it's gone mouldy. Have some fresh bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两张语境卡片：杏树旁写“开花”，面包旁写“发霉”。同一词形要靠主语辨义，不要把两种意思混成一种生长过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hang clothes or other laundry up so that they can dry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把衣服等洗涤物挂起来晾干。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idendel il-ħwejjeġ maħsula biex jinxfu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to hang (especially clothes in order to dry them)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 悬挂，尤指把衣服挂起来晾干。
割某人的喉咙。
