sense_translations.en_definition: to hang out to dry (i.e. expose)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 挂到外面晾干；使暴露在外。
把洗好的衣物挂出去晾干。

collocations.en: hung out the clothes to dry
hung up the towels to dry

formal.mt: Wara l-ħasil, il-ħaddiem naxar il-lożor fil-bitħa biex jinxfu.
formal.en: After washing them, the worker hung the sheets in the courtyard to dry.
formal.zh: 洗完后，工作人员把床单挂在院子里晾干。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn huma x-xugamani? Ġorġ: Missieri naxarhom fuq il-bejt.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where are the towels? Ġorġ: My father hung them out on the roof to dry.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：毛巾在哪里？乔治：我爸爸把它们晾在屋顶上了。

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.zh: 毛巾在哪里？
messages.en: Where are the towels?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (家人)
messages.zh: 我爸爸把它们晾在屋顶上了。
messages.en: My father hung them out on the roof to dry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“把湿衣服挂上晾衣绳”的动作记住常用义；另把“割喉”单独做语境卡，避免看到同一词形就一律理解为晾晒。

gloss_zh: 晾着的衣物；一批晾晒的衣物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Laundry that has been hung up to dry, considered together as a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 挂起来晾干的衣物，通常作为一批整体来看。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħwejjeġ maħsula mdendlin biex jinxfu, meqjusa flimkien.

sense_translations.en_definition: the laundry hung out to dry
sense_translations.zh_definition: 挂在外面晾干的那批衣物。
挂出去晾干的衣物。

collocations.zh: 把晾着的衣物收进来了

collocations.en: a large batch of laundry hung out to dry

formal.mt: Minħabba x-xita, il-familja daħħlet in-naxra qabel ma nixfet.
formal.en: Because of the rain, the family brought in the laundry before it had dried.
formal.zh: 因为下雨，这家人在衣物晾干之前就把它们收进来了。

colloquial.mt: Marija: In-naxra għadha barra? David: Iva, se ndaħħalha issa għax ġejja x-xita.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is the laundry still outside? David: Yes, I'll bring it in now because it's going to rain.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：晾着的衣物还在外面吗？戴维：是的，快下雨了，我现在就收进来。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 晾着的衣物还在外面吗？
messages.en: Is the laundry still outside?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se ndaħħalha issa għax ġejja x-xita.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se ndaħħalha issa għax ġejja x-xita.
messages.zh: 是的，快下雨了，我现在就收进来。
messages.en: Yes, I'll bring it in now because it's going to rain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用画面区分相近词形：naxar 配“挂衣服”的动作，naxra 配“绳上整批衣物”的照片；后者是可以收进屋里的东西。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large community of people sharing a national identity, or a country considered as such a community.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有共同国家或民族认同的人民共同体，也可指作为这一共同体的国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Poplu b'identità komuni, jew pajjiż meqjus bħala komunità ta' nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 国家；民族，即具有共同国家或民族认同的人民共同体。

formal.mt: L-edukazzjoni għandha rwol importanti fil-ġejjieni tan-nazzjon.
formal.en: Education has an important role in the future of the nation.
formal.zh: 教育对国家的未来具有重要作用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed tikteb għall-iskola? Pawlu: Qed nikteb dwar il-ġejjieni tan-nazzjon u r-rwol taż-żgħażagħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you writing for school? Pawlu: I'm writing about the nation's future and the role of young people.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在写什么学校作业？保罗：我在写国家的未来和年轻人的作用。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你在写什么学校作业？
messages.en: What are you writing for school?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nikteb dwar il-ġejjieni tan-nazzjon u r-rwol taż-żgħażagħ.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nikteb dwar il-ġejjieni tan-nazzjon u r-rwol taż-żgħażagħ.
messages.zh: 我在写国家的未来和年轻人的作用。
messages.en: I'm writing about the nation's future and the role of young people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一个共同体”记 nazzjon：先想共同生活并拥有共同认同的人们，再联系“国家、民族”，不要只想到地图上的边界。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a nation or country, or involving the country as a whole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与国家或民族有关的，或涉及全国范围的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' nazzjon jew pajjiż, jew li jolqot lill-pajjiż kollu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 国家的；全国的；民族的。

formal.mt: Il-librerija nazzjonali torganizza wirja ta' kotba u dokumenti għall-pubbliku.
formal.en: The national library is organizing an exhibition of books and documents for the public.
formal.zh: 国家图书馆正在为公众举办图书与文献展览。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se tara l-logħba tat-tim nazzjonali llejla? Mark: Iva, se naraha ma' ħuti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you going to watch the national team's match tonight? Mark: Yes, I'm going to watch it with my siblings.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你今晚会看国家队的比赛吗？马克：会，我会和兄弟姐妹一起看。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tara l-logħba tat-tim nazzjonali llejla?
messages.mt_standard: Se tara l-logħba tat-tim nazzjonali llejla?
messages.zh: 你今晚会看国家队的比赛吗？
messages.en: Are you going to watch the national team's match tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 会，我会和兄弟姐妹一起看。
messages.en: Yes, I'm going to watch it with my siblings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nazzjonali 放在“队、图书馆”等名词后一起记：tim nazzjonali 是国家队，帮助记住它表示“国家的、全国的”。

gloss_zh: 民族主义者；民族主义的；民族党支持者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who supports nationalism; in a party context, a supporter of the Nationalist Party.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支持民族主义的人；在政党语境中，也指民族党的支持者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tappoġġja n-nazzjonaliżmu; f'kuntest ta' partit, persuna li tappoġġja l-Partit Nazzjonalista.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 民族主义者；支持民族主义的人。
民族党支持者；支持民族党的人。
民族主义的；具有民族主义立场的。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi lill-karattru prinċipali bħala nazzjonalist konvint li jagħti importanza kbira lill-identità tan-nazzjon.
formal.en: The author describes the main character as a convinced nationalist who places great importance on the nation's identity.
formal.zh: 作者把主人公描写成一名坚定的民族主义者，非常重视民族认同。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta tgħid li hu nazzjonalist, qed tirreferi għall-partit? Pawlu: Iva, hawn qed infisser li jappoġġja l-Partit Nazzjonalista.
colloquial.en: Maja: When you say he is a nazzjonalist, are you referring to the party? Pawlu: Yes, here I mean that he supports the Nationalist Party.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你说他是 nazzjonalist，是在说他的政党立场吗？保罗：对，我这里是指他支持民族党。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid li hu nazzjonalist, qed tirreferi għall-partit?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid li hu nazzjonalist, qed tirreferi għall-partit?
messages.zh: 你说他是 nazzjonalist，是在说他的政党立场吗？
messages.en: When you say he is a nazzjonalist, are you referring to the party?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn qed infisser li jappoġġja l-Partit Nazzjonalista.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn qed infisser li jappoġġja l-Partit Nazzjonalista.
messages.zh: 对，我这里是指他支持民族党。
messages.en: Yes, here I mean that he supports the Nationalist Party.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 nazzjonalist 配两张人物卡：“民族主义者”和“民族党支持者”；再配一张“民族主义思想”卡，分别记住名词与形容词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person's membership of a particular nation or country, especially as recorded in official documents.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人所属国家的身份，尤其指官方证件或表格中登记的国籍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-appartenenza ta' persuna għal nazzjon jew pajjiż, speċjalment kif tidher fid-dokumenti uffiċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 国籍；个人所属国家的身份。

formal.mt: L-applikant għandu jindika n-nazzjonalità tiegħu fit-taqsima dwar id-dettalji personali.
formal.en: The applicant must indicate his nationality in the section on personal details.
formal.zh: 申请人须在个人资料栏中注明自己的国籍。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għandi nikteb fil-kaxxa tan-nazzjonalità? Rita: Ikteb 'Maltija' jekk għandek nazzjonalità Maltija.
colloquial.en: Lara: What should I write in the nationality box? Rita: Write 'Maltese' if you have Maltese nationality.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：国籍这一栏我该填什么？丽塔：如果你是马耳他国籍，就填“马耳他”。

messages.speaker: Lara (申请人)
messages.zh: 国籍这一栏我该填什么？
messages.en: What should I write in the nationality box?

messages.speaker: Rita (办事员)
messages.zh: 如果你是马耳他国籍，就填“马耳他”。
messages.en: Write 'Maltese' if you have Maltese nationality.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象填写表格时的“国籍”一栏，把 nazzjonalità 和自己的国籍答案一起记，再用 nazzjonalità doppja 记“双重国籍”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The belief that a nation's identity, interests, and right to govern itself should be strongly promoted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强调民族认同、民族利益及民族自主治理权利的思想或立场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Twemmin li jenfasizza l-identità u l-interessi ta' nazzjon u d-dritt tiegħu li jmexxi lilu nnifsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 民族主义；强调民族认同、民族利益或民族自主的思想与立场。

collocations.zh: 民族主义的兴起或增强

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina kif in-nazzjonaliżmu jinfluwenza d-dibattitu dwar l-identità u l-indipendenza.
formal.en: The study examines how nationalism influences the debate about identity and independence.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察民族主义如何影响有关认同与独立的讨论。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dwar xiex kienet il-lezzjoni tal-lum? Sara: Dwar in-nazzjonaliżmu u kif jista' jinfluwenza l-politika.
colloquial.en: Mark: What was today's lesson about? Sara: About nationalism and how it can influence politics.
colloquial.zh: 马克：今天这节课讲什么？萨拉：讲民族主义，以及它可能怎样影响政治。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 今天这节课讲什么？
messages.en: What was today's lesson about?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar in-nazzjonaliżmu u kif jista' jinfluwenza l-politika.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar in-nazzjonaliżmu u kif jista' jinfluwenza l-politika.
messages.zh: 讲民族主义，以及它可能怎样影响政治。
messages.en: About nationalism and how it can influence politics.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nazzjonaliżmu 放进“课堂讨论一种思想”的场景，记作“民族主义”；再与表示人的 nazzjonalist 配对，区分思想与持这种思想的人。

gloss_zh: 修整；磨光；修平石料；精加工

teaching_sense.en_definition: To trim, smooth, or polish material, especially stone, to give it a finished form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过修削、修平或磨光加工材料，尤其是石料，使其达到完成状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħadem materjal, speċjalment ġebel, billi neħħa partijiet żejda jew għamel il-wiċċ lixx biex jagħtih forma lesta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修削；修整掉多余部分
磨光；抛光
修整石料；使石面平整光滑
修整；精修；完善；完成最后加工

collocations.en: smoothed the surface of the stone

formal.mt: L-artiġjan naġar il-wiċċ tal-ġebla sakemm sar lixx.
formal.en: The artisan worked the surface of the stone until it became smooth.
formal.zh: 工匠修磨石块表面，直到它变得光滑。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Din il-ġebla kienet daqshekk lixxa? Pietru: Le, missieri naġar il-wiċċ tagħha lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Marija: Was this stone always this smooth? Pietru: No, my father smoothed its surface yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这块石头原来就这么光滑吗？Pietru：不是，我父亲昨天修磨了它的表面。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 这块石头原来就这么光滑吗？
messages.en: Was this stone always this smooth?

messages.speaker: Pietru (工匠的儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, missieri naġar il-wiċċ tagħha lbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Le, missieri naġar il-wiċċ tagħha lbieraħ.
messages.zh: 不是，我父亲昨天修磨了它的表面。
messages.en: No, my father smoothed its surface yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 naġar 配上一块由粗糙变光滑的石头，沿着“修掉多余、磨平表面、完成精修”的顺序记住各义项。

gloss_zh: 修整石料；石料修整工；石匠

teaching_sense.en_definition: To trim or dress stone into the required shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 修削或整治石料，使其达到所需形状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħadem il-ġebel billi qata' jew neħħa l-partijiet żejda biex jagħtih il-forma meħtieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修削石料；修整石块
修整石料的人；石料修整工

sense_translations.en_definition: stonemason (artisan who prepares and dresses stone)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 石匠；负责备制和修整石料的工匠

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem naġġar il-ġebel skont il-qisien mogħtija fil-pjanta.
formal.en: The worker dressed the stone according to the dimensions given in the plan.
formal.zh: 工人按照图纸所列尺寸修整了石料。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min jista' jaħdem dan il-ġebel? Karl: Nafu naġġar tas-sengħa; nista' nagħtik in-numru tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who can work this stone? Karl: I know a skilled stonemason; I can give you his number.
colloquial.zh: Rita：谁能加工这些石料？Karl：我认识一位手艺很好的石匠，可以把他的电话号码给你。

messages.speaker: Rita (房主)
messages.zh: 谁能加工这些石料？
messages.en: Who can work this stone?

messages.speaker: Karl (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Nafu naġġar tas-sengħa; nista' nagħtik in-numru tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Nafu naġġar tas-sengħa; nista' nagħtik in-numru tiegħu.
messages.zh: 我认识一位手艺很好的石匠，可以把他的电话号码给你。
messages.en: I know a skilled stonemason; I can give you his number.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 naġġar 准备两张记忆卡：一张画修整石料的动作，一张画做这项工作的石匠，用句中位置区分动词和名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cry with a whimpering or wailing sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以低声呜咽或放声哀号的方式哭泣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibki b'leħen baxx jew b'għajjat ta' niket.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呜咽；哀号；发出低低的哭声或悲切的号哭声。

formal.mt: It-tifel naħ bl-uġigħ waqt li l-infermiera kienet tnaddaf il-ferita.
formal.en: The boy wailed in pain while the nurse cleaned the wound.
formal.zh: 护士清理伤口时，男孩痛得哀号起来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara lil Ben? Smajtu jibki. Mark: Waqa' u naħ ftit, imma issa jinsab tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to Ben? I heard him crying. Mark: He fell and whimpered for a bit, but he's fine now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：本怎么了？我听见他在哭。马克：他摔了一跤，呜咽了一会儿，不过现在没事了。

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.zh: 本怎么了？我听见他在哭。
messages.en: What happened to Ben? I heard him crying.

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Waqa' u naħ ftit, imma issa jinsab tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Waqa' u naħ ftit, imma issa jinsab tajjeb.
messages.zh: 他摔了一跤，呜咽了一会儿，不过现在没事了。
messages.en: He fell and whimpered for a bit, but he's fine now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 naħ 放进“孩子摔倒后呜咽”的情景，记住它强调哭声，可从低低呜咽到悲切哀号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A side or direction relative to a reference point; also a neighborhood or surrounding area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 相对于某个参照点的一侧或方向，也可指附近一带或街区。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġenb jew direzzjoni b'rabta ma' punt ta' riferiment; ukoll żona fil-qrib jew lokal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 侧；边；某物或某处的一面。

sense_translations.en_definition: side; direction (space in relation to some reference point, e.g. to the left or right of it)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一侧；方向，指相对于某个参照点的空间位置，例如其左侧或右侧。
附近一带；周边地区；街区。

collocations.en: the other side of the street

formal.mt: Id-daħla ewlenija tinsab fuq in-naħa tal-lemin tal-bini.
formal.en: The main entrance is on the right-hand side of the building.
formal.zh: 主入口位于建筑物的右侧。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħanut qiegħed fuq din in-naħa tat-triq? Pawlu: Le, qiegħed fuq in-naħa l-oħra, ħdejn il-forn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the shop on this side of the street? Pawlu: No, it's on the other side, next to the bakery.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：商店在街道这一侧吗？保罗：不，在另一侧，面包店旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (问路者)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħanut qiegħed fuq din in-naħa tat-triq?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħanut qiegħed fuq din in-naħa tat-triq?
messages.zh: 商店在街道这一侧吗？
messages.en: Is the shop on this side of the street?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, qiegħed fuq in-naħa l-oħra, ħdejn il-forn.
messages.mt_standard: Le, qiegħed fuq in-naħa l-oħra, ħdejn il-forn.
messages.zh: 不，在另一侧，面包店旁边。
messages.en: No, it's on the other side, next to the bakery.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象站在街口指向左边、右边和对面，用 naħa 给这些方位贴标签，再把视野扩大到“附近这一带”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make the characteristic loud call of a donkey.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出驴特有的响亮叫声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel il-ħoss qawwi u karatteristiku ta' ħmar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出驴鸣声；像驴一样叫。

sense_translations.en_definition: to bray (make the sound of a donkey)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 驴叫，即发出驴的叫声。

formal.mt: Il-ħmar naħaq bil-qawwi meta l-bidwi fetaħ il-bieb tal-istalla.
formal.en: The donkey brayed loudly when the farmer opened the stable door.
formal.zh: 农夫打开畜舍门时，驴大声叫了起来。

colloquial.mt: Ben: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Maja: Il-ħmar naħaq. Qiegħed fl-għalqa wara d-dar.
colloquial.en: Ben: What was that noise? Maja: The donkey brayed. It's in the field behind the house.
colloquial.zh: 本：刚才是什么声音？玛雅：是驴叫了。它在房子后面的田里。

messages.speaker: Ben (孩子)
messages.zh: 刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that noise?

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħmar naħaq. Qiegħed fl-għalqa wara d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħmar naħaq. Qiegħed fl-għalqa wara d-dar.
messages.zh: 是驴叫了。它在房子后面的田里。
messages.en: The donkey brayed. It's in the field behind the house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 naħaq 与田里一头驴张嘴大叫的画面绑定，整句记住 il-ħmar naħaq，就能抓住“驴叫”的专门含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To snore while asleep; in a separate sense, to cut an animal's throat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 睡觉时打鼾；另一个独立义项是割断动物的喉咙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss waqt l-irqad; f'tifsira oħra, jaqta' gerżuma ta' annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打鼾；睡觉时发出鼾声。
割断动物的喉咙。

collocations.zh: 割断了那只动物的喉咙

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl, il-pazjent naħar għal diversi minuti.
formal.en: During the night, the patient snored for several minutes.
formal.zh: 夜间，病人打了几分钟鼾。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Irqadt tajjeb ilbieraħ? Mark: Mhux wisq. Ħija naħar bil-qawwi u qajjimni darbtejn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you sleep well last night? Mark: Not very well. My brother snored loudly and woke me up twice.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你昨晚睡得好吗？马克：不太好。我哥哥鼾声很大，把我吵醒了两次。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你昨晚睡得好吗？
messages.en: Did you sleep well last night?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux wisq. Ħija naħar bil-qawwi u qajjimni darbtejn.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux wisq. Ħija naħar bil-qawwi u qajjimni darbtejn.
messages.zh: 不太好。我哥哥鼾声很大，把我吵醒了两次。
messages.en: Not very well. My brother snored loudly and woke me up twice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 naħar 做两张情景卡：睡眠场景记“打鼾”，处理动物的场景记“割喉”；通过整句语境分别记忆两个义项。

gloss_zh: 蜜蜂的；与蜜蜂有关的；像蜜蜂的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to bees or resembling them in appearance or behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示与蜜蜂有关，或在外形、行为上像蜜蜂的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam man-naħal jew li jixbah lin-naħal fid-dehra jew fl-imġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜜蜂的；与蜜蜂有关的。
像蜜蜂的；与蜜蜂有关的。

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi l-komportament naħli waqt il-ġbir tan-nektar.
formal.en: The study describes bee behaviour during nectar collection.
formal.zh: 这项研究描述了蜜蜂采集花蜜时的行为。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'naħli' f'din is-sentenza? Toni: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam man-naħal.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'naħli' mean in this sentence? Toni: It means related to bees.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这句话里的 naħli 是什么意思？Toni：意思是与蜜蜂有关的。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 naħli 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'naħli' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.zh: 意思是与蜜蜂有关的。
messages.en: It means related to bees.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 naħli 写在蜜蜂图片旁，联想“蜜蜂的行为、像蜜蜂的样子”，用画面记住这个形容词。

gloss_zh: 用鼻音说话；说话带鼻腔共鸣

teaching_sense.en_definition: To speak with a nasal voice, making the voice sound as though it comes through the nose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话时带明显鼻音，使声音听起来像从鼻腔发出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitkellem b'leħen nażali, bħallikieku l-ħoss joħroġ minn imnieħru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用鼻音说话。

sense_translations.en_definition: to speak through one's nose, to twang
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用鼻音说话；发出带鼻腔共鸣的说话声。

collocations.en: he began speaking through his nose
to speak with a nasal twang

formal.mt: Waqt il-qari, l-attur beda jnaħnaħ biex jagħti leħen differenti lill-karattru.
formal.en: During the reading, the actor began speaking through his nose to give the character a different voice.
formal.zh: 朗读时，演员开始用鼻音说话，让这个角色拥有不同的声音。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tnaħnaħ hekk? Toni: Għandi mnieħri misdud illum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you speaking through your nose like that? Toni: My nose is blocked today.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么说话鼻音这么重？Toni：我今天鼻子堵了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么说话鼻音这么重？
messages.en: Why are you speaking through your nose like that?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我今天鼻子堵了。
messages.en: My nose is blocked today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读到 naħnaħ 时，想象一个鼻子堵住的人开口说话，把“说话带鼻音”的动作与词形一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To introduce bees into a place so that they inhabit or fill it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将蜜蜂引入某个地方，使其有蜜蜂栖居或充满蜜蜂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idaħħal in-naħal f'post biex jgħix fih jew jimlieh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向某处引入蜜蜂，使其有蜂群栖居。
使某处充满蜜蜂。

collocations.en: populated the new hive with bees

formal.mt: Il-bidwi naħħal id-doqqajs il-ġdid wara li għażel post adattat għalih.
formal.en: The farmer populated the new hive with bees after choosing a suitable location for it.
formal.zh: 农夫为新蜂箱选好合适的位置后，向其中引入了蜂群。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Diġà hemm in-naħal fid-doqqajs il-ġdid? Pawlu: Iva, missieri naħħal id-doqqajs ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are there bees in the new hive already? Pawlu: Yes, my father populated the hive with bees yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新蜂箱里已经有蜜蜂了吗？保罗：有了，我父亲昨天把蜂群引进去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 新蜂箱里已经有蜜蜂了吗？
messages.en: Are there bees in the new hive already?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农夫的儿子)
messages.zh: 有了，我父亲昨天把蜂群引进去了。
messages.en: Yes, my father populated the hive with bees yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个原本空着的蜂箱，随后被引入蜂群；用这幅前后变化图记 naħħal，重点是“使某处有蜜蜂”的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the nose, or describing a speech sound produced with air passing through the nose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与鼻子或鼻腔有关的；也形容发音时有气流通过鼻腔的语音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-imnieħer, jew ma' ħoss li jsir billi l-arja tgħaddi mill-imnieħer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼻的；鼻腔的；鼻音的，即发音时气流通过鼻腔的。

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni tal-fonetika, l-għalliema spjegat kif jiġi prodott ħoss nażali.
formal.en: During the phonetics lesson, the teacher explained how a nasal sound is produced.
formal.zh: 在语音学课上，老师讲解了鼻音是如何发出的。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-ħoss m huwa nażali? Leo: Iva, meta tgħidu, l-arja tgħaddi mill-imnieħer.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is the m sound nasal? Leo: Yes, when you say it, air passes through the nose.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：m 这个音是鼻音吗？利奥：是的，发这个音时，气流会通过鼻腔。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: m 这个音是鼻音吗？
messages.en: Is the m sound nasal?

messages.speaker: Leo (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, meta tgħidu, l-arja tgħaddi mill-imnieħer.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, meta tgħidu, l-arja tgħaddi mill-imnieħer.
messages.zh: 是的，发这个音时，气流会通过鼻腔。
messages.en: Yes, when you say it, air passes through the nose.

cognitive_memory_aid: 轻轻发一个持续的 m 音，感受鼻部振动，再把 nażali 和“鼻音的”连起来；看到鼻腔喷雾的语境时则理解为“鼻腔的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality or degree of nasal resonance in a voice or speech sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 声音或语音带有鼻腔共鸣的性质或程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew il-grad ta' reżonanza fl-imnieħer f'vuċi jew f'ħoss tad-diskors.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼻音性；声音中鼻腔共鸣的特征或程度。

formal.mt: L-istudenti qabblu l-grad ta' nażalità f'żewġ reġistrazzjonijiet tal-istess kelma.
formal.en: The students compared the degree of nasality in two recordings of the same word.
formal.zh: 学生们比较了同一个词的两段录音中鼻音程度的差别。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Tisma' differenza bejn dawn iż-żewġ vuċijiet? Adam: Iva, it-tieni vuċi għandha aktar nażalità.
colloquial.en: Emma: Can you hear a difference between these two voices? Adam: Yes, the second voice has more nasality.
colloquial.zh: 埃玛：你听得出这两种嗓音的区别吗？亚当：听得出，第二种嗓音的鼻音更重。

messages.speaker: Emma (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tisma' differenza bejn dawn iż-żewġ vuċijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Tisma' differenza bejn dawn iż-żewġ vuċijiet?
messages.zh: 你听得出这两种嗓音的区别吗？
messages.en: Can you hear a difference between these two voices?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, it-tieni vuċi għandha aktar nażalità.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, it-tieni vuċi għandha aktar nażalità.
messages.zh: 听得出，第二种嗓音的鼻音更重。
messages.en: Yes, the second voice has more nasality.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个调节“鼻音多少”的旋钮：nażali 用来形容声音，nażalità 则是旋钮所调节的鼻音性质或程度，可以比较多与少。

teaching_sense.en_definition: With a nasal sound or quality, especially when speaking or singing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带着鼻音地，尤其用于描述说话或唱歌的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'ħoss li jinħass ġej mill-imnieħer, speċjalment waqt it-taħdit jew il-kant.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带鼻音地；以鼻音发声的方式。

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju tal-qari, l-istudent tkellem nażalment minħabba li kellu mnieħru misdud.
formal.en: During the reading exercise, the student spoke nasally because his nose was blocked.
formal.zh: 在朗读练习中，这名学生因为鼻塞，说话带着鼻音。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed titkellem nażalment illum? Pawlu: Għax għandi mnieħri misdud.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you speaking nasally today? Pawlu: Because my nose is blocked.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天说话怎么带着鼻音？保罗：因为我鼻子堵了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天说话怎么带着鼻音？
messages.en: Why are you speaking nasally today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为我鼻子堵了。
messages.en: Because my nose is blocked.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象鼻塞时朗读的声音，把 nażalment 和“带鼻音地说话、唱歌”一起记；它描述发声方式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sniff repeatedly or to have a nose that is running.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复吸鼻子，或鼻子不断流出鼻涕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiġbed l-arja minn imnieħrek darba wara l-oħra, jew ikollok imnieħrek iqattar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复吸鼻子；接连发出吸鼻子的声音。
流鼻涕；鼻子处于不断流出鼻涕的状态。
流鼻涕；有鼻涕流出的症状。

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni, it-tifel nażnaż diversi drabi u l-għalliema tatu maktur tal-karti.
formal.en: During the lesson, the boy sniffed several times and the teacher gave him a tissue.
formal.zh: 上课时，男孩吸了好几次鼻子，老师给了他一张纸巾。

colloquial.mt: Sara: It-tifel nażnaż ħafna dalgħodu. Mark: Mela ħa nieħu pakkett imkatar tal-karti miegħi.
colloquial.en: Sara: The boy sniffled a lot this morning. Mark: Then I'll take a packet of tissues with me.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：孩子今天早上一直吸鼻子。马克：那我带一包纸巾。

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.zh: 孩子今天早上一直吸鼻子。
messages.en: The boy sniffled a lot this morning.

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ħa nieħu pakkett imkatar tal-karti miegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ħa nieħu pakkett imkatar tal-karti miegħi.
messages.zh: 那我带一包纸巾。
messages.en: Then I'll take a packet of tissues with me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nażnaż 想成孩子连续吸两下鼻子的画面，再联想到手里的纸巾；用这个场景串起“反复吸鼻子”和“流鼻涕”。

gloss_zh: 鼻子；旧时对幼儿说话时使用的称呼

teaching_sense.en_definition: The nose; a word formerly used when speaking to young children.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鼻子；这个词旧时用于对幼儿说话的语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-imnieħer; kelma li fl-imgħoddi kienet tintuża fit-taħdit mat-tfal iż-żgħar.

sense_translations.en_definition: nose (a word formerly used in child-directed speech)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼻子，旧时用于对幼儿说话的用词。
鼻子。

collocations.en: the boy's nose, using the older child-directed word
collocations.zh: 男孩的鼻子，使用旧时对幼儿说话的用词

collocations.en: wipe your nose, using the older child-directed word
collocations.zh: 擦擦鼻子，使用旧时对幼儿说话的用词

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'nażu' tfisser 'imnieħer' u fl-imgħoddi kienet tintuża fit-taħdit mat-tfal iż-żgħar.
formal.en: The word 'nażu' means 'nose' and was formerly used when speaking to young children.
formal.zh: nażu 的意思是“鼻子”，旧时用于对幼儿说话。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Meta kont żgħira, ommi kienet tgħidli 'imsaħ in-nażu'. Lara: Jiġifieri kienet tgħidlek timsaħ imnieħrek?
colloquial.en: Rita: When I was little, my mother used to tell me 'wipe your nażu'. Lara: So she was telling you to wipe your nose?
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我小时候，妈妈常用 nażu 这个词叫我擦鼻子。拉拉：也就是说，她是让你擦擦鼻子？

messages.speaker: Rita (祖母)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta kont żgħira, ommi kienet tgħidli 'imsaħ in-nażu'.
messages.mt_standard: Meta kont żgħira, ommi kienet tgħidli 'imsaħ in-nażu'.
messages.zh: 我小时候，妈妈常用 nażu 这个词叫我擦鼻子。
messages.en: When I was little, my mother used to tell me 'wipe your nażu'.

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 也就是说，她是让你擦擦鼻子？
messages.en: So she was telling you to wipe your nose?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象祖母回忆小时候妈妈叫她擦鼻子的场景，把 nażu 记作“鼻子”，并同时记住它旧时用于对幼儿说话。

gloss_zh: 被吞下；被狼吞虎咽地吃掉；惊呆

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be swallowed or eaten very quickly; figuratively, to be so surprised that one cannot respond.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被吞咽下去或很快被吃掉；比喻因十分惊讶而一时说不出话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinżel mill-ħalq għall-istonku jew jittiekel malajr ħafna; f'sens figurattiv, jibqa' mistagħġeb tant li ma jkunx jaf x'se jgħid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被吞下；被咽下。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be wolfed down (used of food)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 指食物被狼吞虎咽地吃掉。
惊得目瞪口呆；一时不知如何回应。
bela' 的中间被动态形式，表示被吞下等意义。
因惊讶或震动而呆住；惊得说不出话。

collocations.zh: 食物很快就被狼吞虎咽地吃掉了。

formal.mt: Il-biċċa żgħira tal-ħobż inbelgħet mingħajr diffikultà.
formal.en: The small piece of bread was swallowed without difficulty.
formal.zh: 那一小块面包被顺利咽下了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif irreaġixxa Pawlu meta sema' l-aħbar? Lara: Nbela' bl-għaġeb u għal mument ma qal xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Pawlu react when he heard the news? Lara: He was dumbfounded and did not say anything for a moment.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗听到消息后是什么反应？拉拉：他惊呆了，一时什么也没说。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irreaġixxa Pawlu meta sema' l-aħbar?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irreaġixxa Pawlu meta sema' l-aħbar?
messages.zh: 保罗听到消息后是什么反应？
messages.en: How did Pawlu react when he heard the news?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nbela' bl-għaġeb u għal mument ma qal xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Nbela' bl-għaġeb u għal mument ma qal xejn.
messages.zh: 他惊呆了，一时什么也没说。
messages.en: He was dumbfounded and did not say anything for a moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个画面连着记：食物被吞进肚子，惊讶时话也仿佛被吞回去。后一个画面帮助记住“惊呆”的比喻义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An alcoholic drink made by fermenting grape juice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用葡萄汁发酵制成的酒，即葡萄酒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xarba alkoħolika magħmula mill-meraq tal-għeneb permezz tal-fermentazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 葡萄酒。

formal.mt: Il-menu jinkludi għażla ta' nbid aħmar u nbid abjad.
formal.en: The menu includes a selection of red and white wines.
formal.zh: 菜单提供多款红葡萄酒和白葡萄酒。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Liema nbid tixtieq mal-ikla? Rita: Nixtieq tazza nbid abjad, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mark: Which wine would you like with the meal? Rita: I'd like a glass of white wine, please.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这顿饭你想配哪种葡萄酒？丽塔：请给我一杯白葡萄酒。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这顿饭你想配哪种葡萄酒？
messages.en: Which wine would you like with the meal?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq tazza nbid abjad, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq tazza nbid abjad, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请给我一杯白葡萄酒。
messages.en: I'd like a glass of white wine, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用餐桌上的两杯酒来记：nbid aħmar 是红葡萄酒，nbid abjad 是白葡萄酒；共同的 nbid 就是“葡萄酒”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be sold; figuratively, to be bribed or corrupted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被出售；比喻被利益收买或受到腐化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata lil xerrej bi ħlas; f'sens figurattiv, iċedi għall-flus jew għal xi vantaġġ u jaġixxi b'mod korrott.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被出售；被卖掉。
被贿赂、被收买，或受到腐化。
被腐化；因利益诱惑而失去操守。

collocations.en: was sold at a high price

formal.mt: Il-kwadru nbiegħ fl-irkant bi prezz ogħla milli kien mistenni.
formal.en: The painting was sold at auction for a higher price than expected.
formal.zh: 这幅画在拍卖会上以高于预期的价格售出。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-mejda għadha għall-bejgħ? Mark: Le, ilbieraħ inbiegħet lil ġar tagħna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the table still for sale? Mark: No, it was sold to a neighbour of ours yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那张桌子还在出售吗？马克：不了，昨天已经卖给我们的一位邻居了。

messages.speaker: Lara (买家)
messages.zh: 那张桌子还在出售吗？
messages.en: Is the table still for sale?

messages.speaker: Mark (卖家)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ilbieraħ inbiegħet lil ġar tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ilbieraħ inbiegħet lil ġar tagħna.
messages.zh: 不了，昨天已经卖给我们的一位邻居了。
messages.en: No, it was sold to a neighbour of ours yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想拍卖品贴上“已售出”，再想某人的原则被金钱买走：用这两个场景串起“被出售”和“被收买”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or sound of barking, especially by a dog.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吠叫这一行为或发出的声音，尤指狗叫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-ħoss ta' kelb li jinbaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吠叫；狗叫声。
动词 nebaħ 的动名词，表示吠叫这一行为或声音。

formal.mt: Ir-residenti rrappurtaw li n-nbiħ kontinwu tal-kelb kien qed ifixkel l-irqad tagħhom.
formal.en: The residents reported that the dog's continuous barking was disturbing their sleep.
formal.zh: 居民反映，狗持续不断的吠叫声影响了他们的睡眠。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Smajt dak in-nbiħ? Pawlu: Iva, ġej mill-ġnien tal-ġar.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did you hear that barking? Pawlu: Yes, it's coming from the neighbour's garden.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你听到那阵狗叫声了吗？保罗：听到了，是从邻居的花园传来的。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.zh: 你听到那阵狗叫声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that barking?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 听到了，是从邻居的花园传来的。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the neighbour's garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nbiħ 当作录音里的“那阵狗叫声”来记；与动作词 nebaħ 对照：一个命名吠叫，一个叙述狗叫了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of being clean and free from dirt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有污垢、保持干净的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' xi ħaġa li tkun nadifa u mingħajr ħmieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清洁；洁净的状态。

formal.mt: L-iskola tħeġġeġ lill-istudenti jieħdu ħsieb in-ndafa personali u jżommu l-klassijiet nodfa.
formal.en: The school encourages students to take care of their personal cleanliness and keep the classrooms clean.
formal.zh: 学校鼓励学生注意个人清洁卫生，并保持教室整洁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm pinzell ħdejn il-bieb? Rita: Biex inżommu n-ndafa; nistgħu nneħħu t-tajn miż-żraben qabel nidħlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is there a brush by the door? Rita: To keep things clean; we can remove the mud from our shoes before going in.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：门边为什么放着一把刷子？丽塔：为了保持清洁；进门前可以把鞋上的泥刷掉。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 门边为什么放着一把刷子？
messages.en: Why is there a brush by the door?

messages.speaker: Rita (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex inżommu n-ndafa; nistgħu nneħħu t-tajn miż-żraben qabel nidħlu.
messages.mt_standard: Biex inżommu n-ndafa; nistgħu nneħħu t-tajn miż-żraben qabel nidħlu.
messages.zh: 为了保持清洁；进门前可以把鞋上的泥刷掉。
messages.en: To keep things clean; we can remove the mud from our shoes before going in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象擦完桌面后留下的干净状态，把它标成 ndafa；重点记“清洁的状态”，而不是某一次擦洗动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To involve oneself in someone else's affairs, often without being invited or wanted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 介入或干涉别人的事情，常指未经邀请、令人不悦地插手。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidħol fl-affarijiet ta' ħaddieħor, spiss mingħajr ma jkun mistieden jew mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 干涉；插手他人的事情。
干涉；擅自插手；多管闲事。

formal.mt: Il-maniġer ndaħal fid-deċiżjoni tat-tim mingħajr ma kkonsulta lill-membri tiegħu.
formal.en: The manager interfered in the team's decision without consulting its members.
formal.zh: 经理没有征询团队成员的意见，就插手了团队的决定。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex irrabjat ma' Mark? Maja: Għax ndaħal fl-affarijiet tiegħi mingħajr ma staqsieni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you angry with Mark? Maja: Because he meddled in my affairs without asking me.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么生马克的气？玛雅：因为他没问过我就插手我的事。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么生马克的气？
messages.en: Why are you angry with Mark?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ndaħal fl-affarijiet tiegħi mingħajr ma staqsieni.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ndaħal fl-affarijiet tiegħi mingħajr ma staqsieni.
messages.zh: 因为他没问过我就插手我的事。
messages.en: Because he meddled in my affairs without asking me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象别人正在处理自己的事，第三个人突然把手伸进来；用“擅自插手”的画面记 ndaħal 的常见语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a barking sound, as a dog does; figuratively, to shout sharply at someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 像狗一样发出吠叫声；比喻冲某人厉声喊叫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel il-ħoss ta' kelb; f'sens figurattiv, jgħajjat ma' xi ħadd b'leħen aħrax.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吠叫；狗叫。
冲某人大喊；厉声斥喊某人。
对某人大声叫嚷或吼叫。

formal.mt: Il-kelb nebaħ meta sema' ħoss mhux tas-soltu ħdejn il-bieb.
formal.en: The dog barked when it heard an unusual noise near the door.
formal.zh: 狗听到门边有异常声响时叫了起来。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Għaliex nebaħ il-kelb? Rita: Sema' lil xi ħadd fil-kuritur.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Why did the dog bark? Rita: It heard someone in the corridor.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：狗为什么叫了？丽塔：它听到走廊里有人。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 狗为什么叫了？
messages.en: Why did the dog bark?

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 它听到走廊里有人。
messages.en: It heard someone in the corridor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记“狗叫了”这个动作，再联想到有人像狗叫般厉声冲人喊；同时把 nebaħ 与名词 nbiħ“吠叫声”配对学习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To use money to pay for goods, services, or other needs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 花钱购买物品、支付服务费用或满足其他需要。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tuża l-flus biex tixtri affarijiet, tħallas għal servizzi jew tkopri ħtiġijiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 花费；支出金钱。

formal.mt: Matul is-sena, il-kunsill nefaq għaxart elef ewro fuq it-tiswijiet tal-iskola.
formal.en: During the year, the council spent ten thousand euros on repairs to the school.
formal.zh: 这一年，议会花了一万欧元维修学校。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm nefaq Mark fuq iż-żraben? Lara: Nefaq sittin ewro, għax kienu għall-bejgħ bi skont.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much did Mark spend on the shoes? Lara: He spent sixty euros because they were on sale.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark买这双鞋花了多少钱？Lara：花了六十欧元，因为当时打折。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark买这双鞋花了多少钱？
messages.en: How much did Mark spend on the shoes?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nefaq sittin ewro, għax kienu għall-bejgħ bi skont.
messages.mt_standard: Nefaq sittin ewro, għax kienu għall-bejgħ bi skont.
messages.zh: 花了六十欧元，因为当时打折。
messages.en: He spent sixty euros because they were on sale.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nefaq 放进购物小账本里记：谁花了多少钱、花在哪件东西上。整句联想比孤立背词更清楚。

gloss_zh: 吹；呼气；喷鼻息；充气；吹捧

teaching_sense.en_definition: To blow air out or fill something with air; figuratively, to flatter someone or inflate their self-esteem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向外吹气、呼气或给物体充气；比喻奉承某人，使其自我评价膨胀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ l-arja minn ħalqu jew jimla xi ħaġa bl-arja; f'sens figurattiv, ifaħħar lil xi ħadd b'mod li jkabbarlu l-opinjoni tiegħu nnifsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吹；吹气。
呼气；把气呼出。
从鼻子猛地喷气；发出喷鼻息的声音。
给气球等物体充气，使其膨胀。
使某人的自我评价膨胀；使其因受捧而自满。

sense_translations.en_definition: to compliment insincerely; to flatter; to puff up
sense_translations.zh_definition: 不真诚地称赞；奉承；吹捧得某人飘飘然。
充气；使膨胀或鼓起。

collocations.en: puffed up his friend with praise
collocations.zh: 用赞美把朋友捧得飘飘然

formal.mt: Qabel il-festa, l-organizzatur nefaħ il-bżieżaq u waħħalhom mal-ħajt.
formal.en: Before the party, the organiser inflated the balloons and attached them to the wall.
formal.zh: 聚会开始前，组织者给气球充好气，并把它们固定在墙上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min nefaħ dawn il-bżieżaq kollha? Mark: Pawlu nefaħhom qabel ma wasalna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who blew up all these balloons? Mark: Pawlu blew them up before we arrived.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些气球都是谁吹起来的？马克：保罗在我们到之前就把它们吹好了。

messages.speaker: Maja (聚会宾客)
messages.zh: 这些气球都是谁吹起来的？
messages.en: Who blew up all these balloons?

messages.speaker: Mark (聚会主人)
messages.zh: 保罗在我们到之前就把它们吹好了。
messages.en: Pawlu blew them up before we arrived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 围绕“气向外出”记吹气、呼气和喷鼻息，再想气球被吹大；把人的自我感觉也想成气球，就能联想到“吹捧”的比喻义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who spends a lot of money, sometimes carelessly or excessively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 花钱很多的人；根据语境，也可指花钱不节制、喜欢挥霍的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tonfoq ħafna flus, kultant bla ħsieb jew aktar milli jkun meħtieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 花钱很多的人。
挥霍者；花钱缺乏节制的人。
出手阔绰的人；消费金额很大的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru prinċipali huwa neffieq li jonfoq il-wirt kollu tiegħu fuq il-lussu.
formal.en: In the novel, the main character is a spendthrift who spends his entire inheritance on luxury.
formal.zh: 小说的主人公是个挥霍者，把全部遗产都花在奢侈享受上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu reġa' xtara arloġġ għali? Maja: Iva, veru neffieq! Diġà għandu tlieta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Pawlu buy another expensive watch? Maja: Yes, he's such a big spender! He already has three.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Pawlu又买了一块昂贵的手表？Maja：是啊，他花钱真是大手大脚！他已经有三块了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu又买了一块昂贵的手表？
messages.en: Did Pawlu buy another expensive watch?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, veru neffieq! Diġà għandu tlieta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, veru neffieq! Diġà għandu tlieta.
messages.zh: 是啊，他花钱真是大手大脚！他已经有三块了。
messages.en: Yes, he's such a big spender! He already has three.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个提着许多购物袋的人，给他贴上 neffieq 标签。记住这个词指花钱的人，语气可从阔绰到挥霍。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An amount of money spent or needed to pay for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为某件事已经支付或需要支付的一笔钱，即费用或开支。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Somma flus li tintefaq jew li tkun meħtieġa biex tħallas għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 费用；开支；为某事花费的钱。

formal.mt: Il-baġit jinkludi nefqa ta' elfejn ewro għax-xiri ta' tagħmir ġdid.
formal.en: The budget includes an expense of two thousand euros for the purchase of new equipment.
formal.zh: 预算包含一笔两千欧元的开支，用于购买新设备。

colloquial.mt: Mark: It-tiswija tal-karozza kienet nefqa kbira? Lara: Iva, swietni erba' mitt ewro, u ma kontx qed nistennieha.
colloquial.en: Mark: Was repairing the car a big expense? Lara: Yes, it cost me four hundred euros, and I wasn't expecting it.
colloquial.zh: Mark：修车花了很大一笔钱吗？Lara：是啊，花了我四百欧元，而且这笔开支完全出乎意料。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 修车花了很大一笔钱吗？
messages.en: Was repairing the car a big expense?

messages.speaker: Lara (车主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, swietni erba' mitt ewro, u ma kontx qed nistennieha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, swietni erba' mitt ewro, u ma kontx qed nistennieha.
messages.zh: 是啊，花了我四百欧元，而且这笔开支完全出乎意料。
messages.en: Yes, it cost me four hundred euros, and I wasn't expecting it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张修车收据记 nefqa：收据上的那笔费用就是它。与 nefaq 的花钱动作、neffieq 的花钱者一起对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose business is buying and selling goods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以买卖商品为业的人，即商人或贸易商。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tixtri u tbigħ prodotti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 商人；从事商品买卖或贸易的人。
商人；经营商品买卖的生意人。

formal.mt: In-negozjant tal-inbid iffirma ftehim biex iforni tliet ristoranti lokali.
formal.en: The wine merchant signed an agreement to supply three local restaurants.
formal.zh: 这位葡萄酒商签署了一份协议，为三家本地餐厅供货。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mingħand min xtrajt dan id-drapp? Mark: Mingħand negozjant fis-suq. Għandu ħafna kuluri sbieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who did you buy this fabric from? Mark: From a merchant at the market. He has lots of beautiful colours.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这块布你是向谁买的？Mark：向市场里的一位商人买的。他那里有很多漂亮的颜色。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这块布你是向谁买的？
messages.en: Who did you buy this fabric from?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Mingħand negozjant fis-suq. Għandu ħafna kuluri sbieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Mingħand negozjant fis-suq. Għandu ħafna kuluri sbieħ.
messages.zh: 向市场里的一位商人买的。他那里有很多漂亮的颜色。
messages.en: From a merchant at the market. He has lots of beautiful colours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 negozjant 记在市场摊主的人物卡上：这个人负责进货、卖货、谈价格。再与表示生意的 negozju 配对练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Commercial activity involving buying and selling, or an enterprise that carries out this activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 买卖商品或服务的商业活动，也可指经营这些活动的企业或商号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attività ta' xiri u bejgħ ta' prodotti jew servizzi, jew impriża li tagħmel din l-attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生意；商业经营活动；企业。
生意；买卖；经商议达成的买卖或划算的交易。
交易；一项具体的买卖行为。
商店；经营商品买卖的店铺。

formal.mt: In-negozju tal-familja jbigħ għamara u jimpjega għaxar ħaddiema.
formal.en: The family business sells furniture and employs ten workers.
formal.zh: 这家家族企业销售家具，雇用了十名员工。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif sejjer in-negozju tiegħek? Mark: Tajjeb, grazzi! Din il-ġimgħa kellna ħafna klijenti ġodda.
colloquial.en: Lara: How is your business going? Mark: Well, thanks! We had lots of new customers this week.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你的生意最近怎么样？Mark：挺好的，谢谢！这周来了很多新顾客。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的生意最近怎么样？
messages.en: How is your business going?

messages.speaker: Mark (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, grazzi! Din il-ġimgħa kellna ħafna klijenti ġodda.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, grazzi! Din il-ġimgħa kellna ħafna klijenti ġodda.
messages.zh: 挺好的，谢谢！这周来了很多新顾客。
messages.en: Well, thanks! We had lots of new customers this week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一家正在营业的小店，用 negozju 串起店铺、生意和具体买卖三个画面；阅读时再由上下文选择合适的中文义项。

gloss_zh: 生的；未经加工的；未成熟的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not cooked; used of food that has not been prepared by heating.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有煮熟或未经加热烹调的，用来描述生的食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx imsajjar; jingħad għal ikel li ma jkunx tħejja bis-sħana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生的；处于未经烹调或处理的状态的。
未经精制或加工的；粗糙的。
生的，指食物没有经过烹调或尚未煮熟。
未成熟的；尚未熟透的，尤指果实。

formal.mt: Il-kok juża bord separat biex jaqta' l-laħam nej.
formal.en: The cook uses a separate board to cut raw meat.
formal.zh: 厨师用单独的一块砧板切生肉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-laħam għadu nej minn ġewwa? Mark: Iva, ħallih jissajjar ftit ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this meat still raw inside? Mark: Yes, let it cook a little longer.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这块肉里面还是生的吗？Mark：是啊，再让它煮一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-laħam għadu nej minn ġewwa?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-laħam għadu nej minn ġewwa?
messages.zh: 这块肉里面还是生的吗？
messages.en: Is this meat still raw inside?

messages.speaker: Mark (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，再让它煮一会儿。
messages.en: Yes, let it cook a little longer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 nej 配两张学习图片：一块还没煮的肉和一个还没成熟的果子。前者记未经烹调，后者记尚未成熟。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pointed canine tooth, or a long projecting tooth such as an animal's fang or tusk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尖形的犬齿，也可指动物较长、向外突出的尖牙、獠牙或长牙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sinna bil-ponta, jew sinna twila li toħroġ 'il barra minn ħalq annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长牙；动物向外突出的长牙，如象的长牙。
上颌犬齿；上排的尖牙。
犬齿；位于门齿旁、牙冠较尖的牙齿。
长牙；獠牙；动物尖长的牙齿。

formal.mt: Id-dentist eżamina n-nejba ta' fuq biex jara jekk kellhiex xi ħsara.
formal.en: The dentist examined the upper canine tooth to see whether it had any damage.
formal.zh: 牙医检查了那颗上颌犬齿，查看是否有损伤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema sinna qed tweġġgħek? Mark: In-nejba ta' fuq, fuq il-lemin. Għandi appuntament mad-dentist għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which tooth is hurting? Mark: The upper canine on the right. I have a dentist's appointment tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你哪颗牙疼？Mark：右边上排的犬齿。我约了明天看牙医。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哪颗牙疼？
messages.en: Which tooth is hurting?

messages.speaker: Mark (牙痛的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nejba ta' fuq, fuq il-lemin. Għandi appuntament mad-dentist għada.
messages.mt_standard: In-nejba ta' fuq, fuq il-lemin. Għandi appuntament mad-dentist għada.
messages.zh: 右边上排的犬齿。我约了明天看牙医。
messages.en: The upper canine on the right. I have a dentist's appointment tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用牙齿示意图记 nejba：先圈出门齿旁的尖犬齿，再联想动物突出的獠牙和长牙；按人物或动物语境区分中文译法。

gloss_zh: 一次性交（粗俗）；无聊的小事；玩笑

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vulgar noun for a single sexual encounter, also used for a joke or something considered trivial or unserious.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 粗俗名词，指一次性行为；也可指玩笑，或被认为无关紧要、不值得认真对待的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li b'mod vulgari jfisser att sesswali wieħed; jintuża wkoll għal ċajta jew għal ħaġa bla importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次性接触或性行为（粗俗用语）
轻浮、无聊或微不足道的事情
玩笑；笑话

sense_translations.en_definition: a fuck (single act of sexual intercourse)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次性交（粗俗说法）

collocations.en: just a joke or a trivial thing (vulgar)
collocations.zh: 只是个玩笑或小事（粗俗）

formal.mt: Huwa sejjaħ il-proposta 'nejka', u b'hekk uża kelma vulgari biex juri li ma ħadhiex bis-serjetà.
formal.en: He called the proposal a 'nejka', using a vulgar word to show that he did not take it seriously.
formal.zh: 他把这项提议称为“nejka”，用一个粗俗词表示自己没有认真看待它。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għedt hekk quddiem kulħadd? Mark: Kienet biss nejka. Lara: Imma jien ma sibthiex tad-daħk.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you say that in front of everyone? Mark: It was just a joke. Lara: But I didn't find it funny.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么当着大家的面那样说？马克：只是开个玩笑。拉拉：可我觉得一点也不好笑。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么当着大家的面那样说？
messages.en: Why did you say that in front of everyone?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 只是开个玩笑。
messages.en: It was just a joke.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 可我觉得一点也不好笑。
messages.en: But I didn't find it funny.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时给 nejka 贴上“粗俗名词”标签，再分成“性行为”和“玩笑、小事”两格；即使用来表示玩笑，也要记住它的粗俗语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To tease or deliberately bother someone, sometimes with the intention of annoying or spiting them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 逗弄或故意招惹某人，有时带有使对方恼火或故意与对方作对的意思。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittanta jew idejjaq lil xi ħadd, kultant apposta biex jirritah jew jagħmillu dispett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逗弄；戏弄

sense_translations.en_definition: to tease, to annoy, to spite
sense_translations.zh_definition: 戏弄；惹恼；故意刁难或与人作对

formal.mt: Matul il-logħba, it-tifel neka lil ħuh biex itelliflu l-attenzjoni.
formal.en: During the game, the boy teased his brother to distract him.
formal.zh: 游戏过程中，那个男孩逗弄他的兄弟，想让他分心。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hu rrabjat Pawlu? Lara: Mark neka lil Pawlu apposta waqt il-logħba. Maja: Mela aħjar ikellmu u jiskuża ruħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Pawlu angry? Lara: Mark deliberately annoyed Pawlu during the game. Maja: Then he'd better talk to him and apologize.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么生气了？拉拉：马克刚才玩游戏时故意招惹他。玛雅：那马克最好去跟他谈谈，道个歉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么生气了？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu angry?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark neka lil Pawlu apposta waqt il-logħba.
messages.mt_standard: Mark neka lil Pawlu apposta waqt il-logħba.
messages.zh: 马克刚才玩游戏时故意招惹他。
messages.en: Mark deliberately annoyed Pawlu during the game.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela aħjar ikellmu u jiskuża ruħu.
messages.mt_standard: Mela aħjar ikellmu u jiskuża ruħu.
messages.zh: 那马克最好去跟他谈谈，道个歉。
messages.en: Then he'd better talk to him and apologize.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 neka 放进“故意逗人，逗到生气”的小场景里记忆；从轻微逗弄到恶意刁难，具体语气要看上下文。

gloss_zh: 雪貂；爱窥探的人；好打听的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ferret; figuratively, a person who pries into other people's affairs or is very inquisitive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 雪貂；也可比喻爱窥探别人私事、喜欢追问打听的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal imsejjaħ ferret bl-Ingliż; b'mod figurattiv, persuna li tistħarreġ il-ħajja ta' ħaddieħor jew tistaqsi ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雪貂
爱窥探别人私事的人
好奇、爱追问打听的人

collocations.en: like a ferret; like a nosy person
collocations.zh: 像雪貂一样；像个爱打听的人

formal.mt: In-nemes domestiku għandu bżonn post nadif u sigur fejn jgħix.
formal.en: A domestic ferret needs a clean, safe place to live.
formal.zh: 家养雪貂需要一个干净、安全的生活空间。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm hu nemes dak il-ġar! Mark: Għaliex qed tgħid hekk? Lara: Dejjem jistaqsi min ġie għandna u x'konna qed nagħmlu.
colloquial.en: Lara: That neighbor is such a busybody! Mark: Why do you say that? Lara: He always asks who came to our house and what we were doing.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那个邻居真爱打听！马克：你为什么这么说？拉拉：他老问谁来过我们家，还有我们当时在干什么。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个邻居真爱打听！
messages.en: That neighbor is such a busybody!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么这么说？
messages.en: Why do you say that?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dejjem jistaqsi min ġie għandna u x'konna qed nagħmlu.
messages.mt_standard: Dejjem jistaqsi min ġie għandna u x'konna qed nagħmlu.
messages.zh: 他老问谁来过我们家，还有我们当时在干什么。
messages.en: He always asks who came to our house and what we were doing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习时画两张图：一张写“雪貂”，另一张画“总在打听的邻居”，都标上 nemes；这是帮助区分本义和人物比喻的联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small pigmented spots on the skin, especially on the face, known as freckles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 皮肤上的小色斑，尤其指脸部的雀斑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikek żgħar ta' kulur fuq il-ġilda, speċjalment fuq il-wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雀斑；皮肤上细小的色斑

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt, in-nemex fuq wiċċ it-tifla jidher ċar, speċjalment fuq imnieħerha.
formal.en: In the photograph, the freckles on the girl's face are clearly visible, especially on her nose.
formal.zh: 照片中，女孩脸上的雀斑清晰可见，鼻子上的尤其明显。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi n-nemex fuq imnieħri. Lara: Iva, jidher sew f'dan ir-ritratt. Maja: Jogħġobni kif jidher.
colloquial.en: Maja: I have freckles on my nose. Lara: Yes, they show clearly in this photo. Maja: I like how they look.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我鼻子上有雀斑。拉拉：是啊，这张照片里看得很清楚。玛雅：我喜欢它们的样子。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我鼻子上有雀斑。
messages.en: I have freckles on my nose.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，这张照片里看得很清楚。
messages.en: Yes, they show clearly in this photo.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我喜欢它们的样子。
messages.en: I like how they look.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在写着 nemex 的卡片旁画一张带小点的鼻子，把整个词和“脸上的小雀斑”一起记；再用“鼻子上、脸上”两个搭配复习。

gloss_zh: 滋生蚂蚁；使产生刺麻感；发麻

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become infested with or abound in ants; also to produce or experience a prickling, tingling sensation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 滋生蚂蚁或到处都是蚂蚁；也指引起或感到针刺般的麻痒、发麻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimtela bin-nemel jew ikollu ħafna nemel; ukoll joħloq jew iħoss tingiż bħal ta' labar żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滋生蚂蚁；受到蚂蚁侵扰
引起刺麻感；使产生麻痒感
有大量蚂蚁；到处都是蚂蚁
感到刺麻；发麻

collocations.en: the bread became infested with ants

formal.mt: Il-ħobż nemmel għax tħalla mikxuf ħdejn il-bejta tan-nemel.
formal.en: The bread became infested with ants because it was left uncovered beside the ants' nest.
formal.zh: 面包没有盖好，又放在蚁巢旁边，因此爬满了蚂蚁。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Sieqi nemmlet wara li qgħadt fuqha. Lara: Qisek qed tħoss labar żgħar? Mark: Iva, eżatt hekk.
colloquial.en: Mark: My foot tingled after I sat on it. Lara: Does it feel like little needles? Mark: Yes, exactly.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我坐着压到脚，脚都麻了。拉拉：是不是像小针在扎？马克：对，就是那种感觉。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sieqi nemmlet wara li qgħadt fuqha.
messages.mt_standard: Sieqi nemmlet wara li qgħadt fuqha.
messages.zh: 我坐着压到脚，脚都麻了。
messages.en: My foot tingled after I sat on it.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 是不是像小针在扎？
messages.en: Does it feel like little needles?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，就是那种感觉。
messages.en: Yes, exactly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nemmel 的两组意思分别画成“面包上有蚂蚁”和“脚上有刺麻感”；可以用蚂蚁爬动的画面帮助联想，但这只是记忆方法，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 用雪貂狩猎；窥探；监视别人；色迷迷地看姑娘

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hunt using a ferret; also to pry into or spy on other people's affairs, or to ogle girls.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用雪貂帮助狩猎；也指窥探、监视别人的事情，或色迷迷地盯着姑娘看。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juża nemes għall-kaċċa; ukoll jindaħal fil-ħajja ta' ħaddieħor, jispija fuq nies oħra jew iħares lejn il-bniet b'mod sesswali u mhux xieraq.

sense_translations.en_definition: to use a ferret to hunt
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用雪貂帮助狩猎
窥探；打探别人的私事
暗中监视或窥伺别人
用雪貂猎取或驱出猎物
色迷迷地盯着姑娘看

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-kaċċatur nemmes għall-fniek ħdejn l-għalqa.
formal.en: In the story, the hunter used a ferret to hunt rabbits beside the field.
formal.zh: 故事中，猎人在田地旁用雪貂猎兔。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-ġar reġa' nemmes fil-ħajja tagħna. Mark: X'ried ikun jaf din id-darba? Lara: Min kien magħna lbieraħ filgħaxija.
colloquial.en: Lara: The neighbor pried into our lives again. Mark: What did he want to know this time? Lara: Who was with us yesterday evening.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：邻居又来打探我们的私事了。马克：这次他想知道什么？拉拉：昨天晚上谁和我们在一起。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 邻居又来打探我们的私事了。
messages.en: The neighbor pried into our lives again.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这次他想知道什么？
messages.en: What did he want to know this time?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天晚上谁和我们在一起。
messages.en: Who was with us yesterday evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 nemmes 时建立三个动作画面：“用雪貂打猎”“探听别人私事”“不礼貌地盯着姑娘看”；用不同场景区分词义，不把所有意思都理解成普通好奇。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause freckles to appear on the skin or to make a face or area of skin freckled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使皮肤出现雀斑，或使脸部、某处皮肤变得带有雀斑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel il-ġilda jew il-wiċċ jimtela b'tikek tan-nemex.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使长出雀斑；使变得满是雀斑
使出现雀斑；形成雀斑

collocations.en: the sun made his skin freckled
collocations.zh: 阳光使他的皮肤长出了雀斑

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, ix-xemx tas-sajf nemmxet wiċċ it-tifel, speċjalment fuq imnieħru.
formal.en: In the story, the summer sun made the boy's face freckled, especially on his nose.
formal.zh: 故事中，夏日的阳光使男孩脸上长出了雀斑，鼻子上尤其明显。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ix-xemx nemmxetli wiċċi dan is-sajf. Lara: Iva, issa għandek aktar nemex fuq imnieħrek. Maja: Innutajtu meta rajt ir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Maja: The sun made my face freckled this summer. Lara: Yes, you have more freckles on your nose now. Maja: I noticed them when I saw the photo.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今年夏天，太阳把我的脸晒出了雀斑。拉拉：是啊，你现在鼻子上的雀斑更多了。玛雅：我看照片时才注意到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今年夏天，太阳把我的脸晒出了雀斑。
messages.en: The sun made my face freckled this summer.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa għandek aktar nemex fuq imnieħrek.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa għandek aktar nemex fuq imnieħrek.
messages.zh: 是啊，你现在鼻子上的雀斑更多了。
messages.en: Yes, you have more freckles on your nose now.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我看照片时才注意到。
messages.en: I noticed them when I saw the photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nemex 的“雀斑”图片和 nemmex 的“使雀斑出现”动作卡并排复习；双写 m 可作为这个词的视觉提醒，但不要据此推导其他词的构词规则。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mound or heap of earth made by ants around or above their nest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蚂蚁在巢穴周围或上方堆起的土丘、土堆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għolja żgħira jew munzell ta' ħamrija li jagħmlu n-nemel madwar il-bejta tagħhom jew fuqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蚁丘；蚂蚁筑成的小土丘
蚁丘；蚂蚁在巢穴处堆起的土堆

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw nemmiela ħdejn is-siġra u nnutaw in-nemel dieħel u ħiereġ minnha.
formal.en: The students observed an anthill beside the tree and noticed ants going in and out of it.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了树旁的一座蚁丘，并留意到蚂蚁不断进进出出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dik in-nemmiela ħdejn is-siġra! Mark: Ħsibtha biss munzell ħamrija. Maja: Ħares mill-qrib; hemm in-nemel dieħel u ħiereġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that anthill beside the tree! Mark: I thought it was just a heap of earth. Maja: Look closely; there are ants going in and out.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看树旁那座蚁丘！马克：我还以为只是一堆土。玛雅：仔细看看，有蚂蚁在进进出出。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看树旁那座蚁丘！
messages.en: Look at that anthill beside the tree!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我还以为只是一堆土。
messages.en: I thought it was just a heap of earth.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħares mill-qrib; hemm in-nemel dieħel u ħiereġ.
messages.mt_standard: Ħares mill-qrib; hemm in-nemel dieħel u ħiereġ.
messages.zh: 仔细看看，有蚂蚁在进进出出。
messages.en: Look closely; there are ants going in and out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nemmiela 写在一座有蚂蚁进出的小土丘下面，记住它指的是“蚂蚁堆起的丘”，再用“大的蚁丘”和“花园里的蚁丘”两个画面巩固。

gloss_zh: 爱打探隐私的人；盯着别人色眯眯看的人；好色之徒

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who pries into other people's private affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喜欢打听、窥探别人私事的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħobb tistaqsi u tfittex dwar il-ħajja privata ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱打听、窥探别人私事的人。
用带有色欲或令人不适的目光盯着别人看的人。
惯于追逐女性、拈花惹草的男人；好色之徒。

collocations.zh: 做一个爱窥探私事的人

collocations.en: a snoop who interferes in everything
collocations.zh: 什么事都要插手的窥私者

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, in-nemmies jipprova jsir jaf is-sigrieti tal-ġirien billi jistaqsihom mistoqsijiet personali.
formal.en: In the story, the snoop tries to discover the neighbours' secrets by asking them personal questions.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个爱窥探私事的人通过询问私人问题，试图探知邻居们的秘密。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex trid tkun taf ma' min ħriġt? Tkunx nemmies! Luqa: Sewwa, ma nistaqsikx aktar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you want to know who I went out with? Don't be a snoop! Luqa: All right, I won't ask you any more.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么想知道我跟谁出去了？别打探我的私事！卢卡：好吧，我不再问了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex trid tkun taf ma' min ħriġt? Tkunx nemmies!
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex trid tkun taf ma' min ħriġt? Tkunx nemmies!
messages.zh: 你为什么想知道我跟谁出去了？别打探我的私事！
messages.en: Why do you want to know who I went out with? Don't be a snoop!

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 好吧，我不再问了。
messages.en: All right, I won't ask you any more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nemmies 放进“别打探我的私事！”这个场景来记；另外两义则把越界行为从打听隐私联想到色眯眯地看人和追逐女性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mosquitoes, the small flying insects that can bite people; the word can also refer to fruit flies.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蚊子，即会叮咬人的小型飞虫；这个词也可以指果蝇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insetti żgħar li jtiru u jistgħu jigdmu lin-nies; il-kelma tista' tirreferi wkoll għad-dubbien żgħir tal-frott.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蚊子，指这类会叮咬人的飞虫。
蚊子；可用于指一只蚊子或多只蚊子，具体数量由语境确定。
果蝇；常见于水果附近的小型飞虫，可指一只或多只。

formal.mt: Il-familja waħħlet xibka mat-tieqa biex in-nemus ma jidħolx fil-kamra.
formal.en: The family fitted a screen to the window to keep mosquitoes out of the room.
formal.zh: 这家人在窗户上装了防蚊网，防止蚊子进入房间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hawn ħafna nemus illejla! Mark: Nagħlaq it-tieqa u nixgħel il-fann.
colloquial.en: Sara: There are lots of mosquitoes here tonight! Mark: I'll close the window and turn on the fan.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：今晚这里蚊子真多！马克：我把窗户关上，再打开风扇。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 今晚这里蚊子真多！
messages.en: There are lots of mosquitoes here tonight!

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我把窗户关上，再打开风扇。
messages.en: I'll close the window and turn on the fan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“夏夜关窗挡 nemus”的画面，先联结蚊子；再把水果旁的小飞虫作为果蝇义的独立场景，避免只认一个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having freckles, especially on the face or skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脸部或皮肤上长有雀斑的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu n-nemex fuq wiċċu jew fuq il-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长有雀斑的；皮肤上带有雀斑的。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidher tifel nemxi b'xagħru aħmar, bilqiegħda ħdejn it-tieqa.
formal.en: The photograph shows a freckled boy with red hair sitting beside the window.
formal.zh: 照片中，一个长着雀斑的红发男孩坐在窗边。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema wieħed hu ħuk? Sara: Dak it-tifel nemxi ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which one is your brother? Sara: That freckled boy by the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：哪一个是你兄弟？萨拉：门边那个长着雀斑的男孩。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 哪一个是你兄弟？
messages.en: Which one is your brother?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 门边那个长着雀斑的男孩。
messages.en: That freckled boy by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nemxi 写在一张画着点点雀斑的脸旁边，并整组记忆 wiċċ nemxi；看到脸上的小斑点就回想这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male relative who is either the son of one's brother or sister, or the son of one's own child.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 男性亲属，既可以指兄弟姐妹的儿子，即侄子或外甥，也可以指自己子女的儿子，即孙子或外孙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iben ħuk jew oħtok, jew iben wieħed minn uliedek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 侄子或外甥，即兄弟或姐妹的儿子。
孙子或外孙，即儿子或女儿的儿子。

collocations.zh: 我的外甥，也就是我姐妹的儿子
我的外孙，也就是我女儿的儿子

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Borg attendiet iċ-ċerimonja ma' bintha u man-neputi tagħha, iben bintha.
formal.en: Mrs Borg attended the ceremony with her daughter and her grandson, her daughter's son.
formal.zh: 博格女士与女儿及外孙，也就是女儿的儿子，一起出席了典礼。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan it-tifel hu ibnek? Pawlu: Le, in-neputi tiegħi, iben ħija.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this boy your son? Pawlu: No, he's my nephew, my brother's son.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个男孩是你儿子吗？保罗：不是，是我侄子，我兄弟的儿子。

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 这个男孩是你儿子吗？
messages.en: Is this boy your son?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 不是，是我侄子，我兄弟的儿子。
messages.en: No, he's my nephew, my brother's son.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两条亲属路线记 neputi：一条通向兄弟姐妹的儿子，另一条通向自己子女的儿子；翻译成中文前先确认是哪条路线。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fail to remember something, including forgetting to bring an item or do a task.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 未能记起某事，也包括忘记携带物品或忘记完成某项任务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma jiftakarx xi ħaġa, jew ma jġibx xi oġġett jew ma jagħmilx xi ħaġa għax ma jiftakarx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 忘记；未能记起某人、某事或某项信息。
因忘记而把物品留下；忘了带走。
疏忽；粗心大意，未加留意。

collocations.en: he left his keys at home

formal.mt: L-istudent nesa jikteb ismu fuq il-karta tal-eżami.
formal.en: The student forgot to write his name on the examination paper.
formal.zh: 这名学生忘了在试卷上写名字。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu Mark? Luqa: Għadu d-dar; nesa ċ-ċwievet u mar lura għalihom.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is Mark? Luqa: He's still at home; he forgot his keys and went back for them.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克在哪里？卢卡：他还在家里；他忘了带钥匙，回去拿了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Mark?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu d-dar; nesa ċ-ċwievet u mar lura għalihom.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu d-dar; nesa ċ-ċwievet u mar lura għalihom.
messages.zh: 他还在家里；他忘了带钥匙，回去拿了。
messages.en: He's still at home; he forgot his keys and went back for them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“出门后才发现钥匙还在家里”的画面记 nesa：事情没记住是忘记，东西没带走是遗落，做事没留心则联系疏忽义。

gloss_zh: 使忘记；使某人忘掉某事

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to forget something or stop thinking about it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人忘记某事，或使其暂时不再想着那件事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jinsa xi ħaġa jew ma jibqax jaħseb fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使忘记；造成遗忘。
使某人忘掉某事；让某人不再记着某事。

collocations.en: it made Mark forget his worries
it made Pawlu lose track of time

formal.mt: Il-vjaġġ nessa lil Pawlu l-problemi tax-xogħol għal ftit.
formal.en: The trip made Pawlu forget his work problems for a while.
formal.zh: 这次旅行使保罗暂时忘却了工作上的问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħadt gost bil-film? Mark: Iva, nessieni l-inkwiet għal ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you enjoy the film? Mark: Yes, it made me forget my worries for a while.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电影看得开心吗？马克：开心，它让我暂时忘了烦恼。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影看得开心吗？
messages.en: Did you enjoy the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 开心，它让我暂时忘了烦恼。
messages.en: Yes, it made me forget my worries for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nesa 和 nessa 配成两张教学卡：“他忘了烦恼”与“旅行使他忘了烦恼”。记 nessa 时特别圈出“使某人”这一层意思。

gloss_zh: 使人忘事的；令人遗忘的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing someone to forget things or lose track of what they were thinking about.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 会使人忘记事情，或忘掉原先所想内容的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd jinsa xi ħaġa jew dak li kien qed jaħseb fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 会导致遗忘的；使人忘事的。
具有使人遗忘作用的；用来描述引起遗忘的事物。

collocations.en: a sound that makes someone forget

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħoss għandu effett nessej fuq il-karattru, li jinsa dak li kien se jgħid.
formal.en: In the story, the sound has a forgetfulness-inducing effect on the character, who forgets what he was about to say.
formal.zh: 故事中，这个声音使人物忘事，他忘了自己刚要说什么。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Dan il-ħoss nessej; insejt x'kont se ngħid! Maja: Nagħlaq it-tieqa biex tkun tista' tkompli bil-kwiet.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: This noise makes you forget things; I've forgotten what I was going to say! Maja: I'll close the window so you can carry on in peace.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：这声音真让人忘事；我忘了刚要说什么！玛雅：我把窗户关上，你就能安静地继续说了。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħoss nessej; insejt x'kont se ngħid!
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħoss nessej; insejt x'kont se ngħid!
messages.zh: 这声音真让人忘事；我忘了刚要说什么！
messages.en: This noise makes you forget things; I've forgotten what I was going to say!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħlaq it-tieqa biex tkun tista' tkompli bil-kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħlaq it-tieqa biex tkun tista' tkompli bil-kwiet.
messages.zh: 我把窗户关上，你就能安静地继续说了。
messages.en: I'll close the window so you can carry on in peace.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 nessej 时画一支从声音指向空白思绪的箭头，并标注“使人忘事的”；注意它描述造成遗忘的事物，而非单纯记性差的人。

gloss_zh: 适当时机；轮换；作物轮作；雨前天气变化

teaching_sense.en_definition: A suitable time or opportunity for doing something, especially in relation to agricultural work and seasons.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 适合做某事的时间或机会，尤其可用于农业活动和季节相关的语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-waqt adattat jew l-opportunità biex issir xi ħaġa, speċjalment f'rabta max-xogħol tal-biedja u l-istaġuni.

sense_translations.en_definition: the right time for sth. (originates in an agricultural context, referring to seasons)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 做某事的适当时节；这一义项源于农业语境，指与季节相应的合适时间。
轮换；交替；按次序更替。
作物轮作；同一块土地按一定次序种植不同作物。

sense_translations.en_definition: the change of the air before rain
sense_translations.zh_definition: 下雨前空气或天气状况的变化。

sense_translations.en_definition: opportunity, the right time for something
sense_translations.zh_definition: 机会；做某事的合适时机。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi għażel in-newba t-tajba għaż-żrigħ skont l-istaġun u l-kundizzjoni tal-ħamrija.
formal.en: The farmer chose the right time for sowing according to the season and the condition of the soil.
formal.zh: 农民根据季节和土壤状况，选择了合适的播种时机。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Niżirgħu llum? Ġużeppi: Iva, issa n-newba t-tajba; il-ħamrija għadha niedja.
colloquial.en: Marija: Shall we sow today? Ġużeppi: Yes, now is the right time; the soil is still moist.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：我们今天播种吗？朱塞佩：是的，现在时机正好；土壤还湿润。

messages.speaker: Marija (农场帮手)
messages.zh: 我们今天播种吗？
messages.en: Shall we sow today?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa n-newba t-tajba; il-ħamrija għadha niedja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa n-newba t-tajba; il-ħamrija għadha niedja.
messages.zh: 是的，现在时机正好；土壤还湿润。
messages.en: Yes, now is the right time; the soil is still moist.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张农事日历记 newba：圈出的日期表示合适时机，轮流种植的作物表示轮作，再单独画一朵雨云提示雨前天气变化义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A frame or machine on which threads are arranged and woven into cloth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把纱线按一定方式排列并交织成布的框架或机器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qafas jew magna li fuqha jitqiegħdu l-ħjut biex jintesġu u jsiru drapp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 织工使用的织布机。
织机，即用来交织纱线的织布框架。

formal.mt: Fil-workshop, l-istudenti raw kif il-ħjut jitqiegħdu fuq in-newl biex jinħadem id-drapp.
formal.en: During the workshop, the students saw how threads are placed on the loom to make cloth.
formal.zh: 在实践课上，学生们观察了如何把纱线装到织布机上来织布。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'inhu dak il-qafas tal-injam? Pawlu: Dak newl. Iz-zija tużah biex tagħmel it-twapet.
colloquial.en: Marija: What is that wooden frame? Pawlu: That's a loom. My aunt uses it to make rugs.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：那个木架子是什么？保罗：那是织布机。我姑姑用它织地毯。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个木架子是什么？
messages.en: What is that wooden frame?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak newl. Iz-zija tużah biex tagħmel it-twapet.
messages.mt_standard: Dak newl. Iz-zija tużah biex tagħmel it-twapet.
messages.zh: 那是织布机。我姑姑用它织地毯。
messages.en: That's a loom. My aunt uses it to make rugs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 newl 写在织布机的图片旁，想象经线绷在框上、纬线来回穿过，用具体器具画面记住这个名词。

gloss_zh: 不停抽泣；哀号；不断哼哼抱怨

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sob or wail repeatedly, or to complain in a persistent whining voice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复抽泣或发出哀号，也指用哼哼唧唧的语气不断抱怨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibki jew jgħajjat b'niket għal ħin twil, jew jilmenta bla waqfien b'leħen ta' tnehid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长时间或反复抽泣，哭得很多。
不停地哼哼唧唧地抱怨。
哀号，或发出带有哭腔的哼唧声。

sense_translations.en_definition: to keen, to utter a keen
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出悲切的哀哭声，号哭悼念。

collocations.en: to sob or wail all night

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel newwaħ bin-niket meta sar jaf li kien tilef lil ħuh.
formal.en: In the story, the man wailed in sorrow when he learned that he had lost his brother.
formal.zh: 故事中，那名男子得知哥哥去世后，悲痛地号哭起来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ħuk newwaħ daqshekk ilbieraħ? Mark: Kien għajjien u ried imur id-dar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did your brother whine so much yesterday? Mark: He was tired and wanted to go home.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你弟弟昨天为什么一直哼哼唧唧？马克：他累了，想回家。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你弟弟昨天为什么一直哼哼唧唧？
messages.en: Why did your brother whine so much yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien għajjien u ried imur id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Kien għajjien u ried imur id-dar.
messages.zh: 他累了，想回家。
messages.en: He was tired and wanted to go home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 newwaħ 时想象一段持续不断的哭声：悲伤时是哀号，不满时是哼唧抱怨；共同点是声音反复持续。

gloss_zh: 轮换；交替；接连发生；择时

teaching_sense.en_definition: To rotate or alternate in turns, to occur successively, or to choose a suitable time for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按次序轮换或交替，接连发生，也可指为某事选择合适的时机。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibdel skont it-turn jew iseħħ wara xulxin; jista' jfisser ukoll jagħżel il-waqt xieraq għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轮换，使不同的人或事物依次替换。
接连发生，按先后次序出现。
轮流进行，交替更换。

sense_translations.en_definition: to choose the right time for something
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某件事选择恰当的时间或时机。

formal.mt: Matul it-taħriġ, il-koordinatur newweb il-ħaddiema bejn iż-żewġ stazzjonijiet biex kulħadd jitgħallem iż-żewġ kompiti.
formal.en: During training, the coordinator rotated the workers between the two stations so that everyone could learn both tasks.
formal.zh: 培训期间，协调员安排工人在两个工作岗位之间轮换，让每个人都能学会两项任务。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min newweb ir-rwoli fil-logħba? Toni: L-għalliem, biex kulħadd ikollu ċans ikun il-kaptan.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who rotated the roles in the game? Toni: The teacher, so everyone would get a chance to be captain.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：是谁安排游戏中的角色轮换的？托尼：老师，这样每个人都有机会当队长。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 是谁安排游戏中的角色轮换的？
messages.en: Who rotated the roles in the game?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għalliem, biex kulħadd ikollu ċans ikun il-kaptan.
messages.mt_standard: L-għalliem, biex kulħadd ikollu ċans ikun il-kaptan.
messages.zh: 老师，这样每个人都有机会当队长。
messages.en: The teacher, so everyone would get a chance to be captain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用轮班表记 newweb：甲做完轮到乙，乙做完轮到丙；另在日历上圈出合适时间，单独记住它的择时义。

gloss_zh: 织布；操作织机；递给；交出

teaching_sense.en_definition: To weave or work a loom; also, to pass or hand something to another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 织布或操作织布机；也指把某物递给别人或交出去。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħdem fuq in-newl jew jinseġ; ifisser ukoll jgħaddi jew jagħti xi ħaġa lil persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 操作织布机进行织布。
把纱线交织成布；织布。
把某物递给某人。
把某物交出或交到别人手中。
交给，递过去。

collocations.en: to pass the book to his friend

formal.mt: Fi tmiem il-laqgħa, is-segretarju newwel id-dokumenti lill-president biex jiffirmahom.
formal.en: At the end of the meeting, the secretary handed the documents to the president for signature.
formal.zh: 会议结束时，秘书把文件递给主席签字。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min newwel il-melħ lil ommi? Luqa: Jien. Tridu int ukoll?
colloquial.en: Nina: Who passed the salt to my mother? Luqa: I did. Do you want it too?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁把盐递给我妈妈了？卢卡：我递的。你也要吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (家人)
messages.zh: 谁把盐递给我妈妈了？
messages.en: Who passed the salt to my mother?

messages.speaker: Luqa (家人)
messages.zh: 我递的。你也要吗？
messages.en: I did. Do you want it too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 newwel 配两张学习卡：一张画人在织布，一张画手把书递给另一只手；分别记住织布与递交两组意思。

gloss_zh: 爱哀号或呜咽的人；受雇哭丧者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who tends to wail or whimper, or someone hired to mourn aloud.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常哀号或呜咽的人；也可指受雇以哀哭表达悼念的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha ħabta tibki jew tnewwaħ, jew persuna mqabbda biex tibki għall-mejjet.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who tends to wail or whimper
sense_translations.zh_definition: 动不动就哀号或呜咽的人。
受雇在丧事中哀哭悼念的人；哭丧者。

collocations.en: a mourner hired for the funeral
the voice of the person wailing

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, in-newwieħ imqabbad għall-funeral jidħol fil-kamra u jibda jibki b'leħen għoli.
formal.en: In the novel, the mourner hired for the funeral enters the room and begins to weep loudly.
formal.zh: 小说中，为葬礼雇请的哭丧者走进房间，开始放声哀哭。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex sejjaħtlu newwieħ? David: Għax kull darba li jitlef logħba jibda jibki u jilmenta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you call him a whiner? David: Because every time he loses a game, he starts crying and complaining.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么叫他爱哭鬼？戴维：因为他每次游戏输了，就开始哭着抱怨。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么叫他爱哭鬼？
messages.en: Why did you call him a whiner?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kull darba li jitlef logħba jibda jibki u jilmenta.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kull darba li jitlef logħba jibda jibki u jilmenta.
messages.zh: 因为他每次游戏输了，就开始哭着抱怨。
messages.en: Because every time he loses a game, he starts crying and complaining.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 newwieħ 放在人物卡上：它说的是哀哭的人。再画两个场景，分别记住爱哭的人与受雇哭丧者这两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take something away from a place or position, or cause it to no longer be present.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物从原来的位置拿走，或使它不再存在于某处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Twarrab xi ħaġa minn fejn tkun jew tagħmel li ma tibqax hemm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 移除；拿走；去掉。
遣走；打发走。
删除；删去文字、资料等。
脱下；摘下身上的衣物或配饰。
废除；取消制度、规定等。

collocations.en: deleted a word from the text
collocations.zh: 从文本中删去了一个词

formal.mt: L-editur neħħa sentenza mir-rapport għax kienet tirrepeti informazzjoni li diġà ngħatat.
formal.en: The editor removed a sentence from the report because it repeated information already provided.
formal.zh: 编辑从报告中删去了一句话，因为它重复了前面已经提供的信息。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min neħħa l-kotba minn fuq il-mejda? Mark: Pawlu neħħiehom. Poġġiehom fuq l-ixkaffa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who removed the books from the table? Mark: Pawlu did. He put them on the shelf.
colloquial.zh: Lara：谁把桌上的书拿走了？Mark：Pawlu拿走的。他把书放到书架上了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min neħħa l-kotba minn fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Min neħħa l-kotba minn fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 谁把桌上的书拿走了？
messages.en: Who removed the books from the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: Pawlu拿走的。他把书放到书架上了。
messages.en: Pawlu did. He put them on the shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一个拿走的手势记 neħħa：拿走桌上的东西、删掉纸上的句子、脱下身上的外套，都能帮助联想它的不同用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take off clothing or get undressed; also, to get rid of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脱去衣物或脱衣服；也可指去掉或摆脱某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa l-ħwejjeġ jew xi biċċa lbies minn fuqu; jista' jfisser ukoll ħeles minn xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脱去衣物，使身体或某部分露出。
脱衣服。
把衣服脱下来。

sense_translations.en_definition: to undress oneself, to get undressed
sense_translations.zh_definition: 自己脱衣服，进入脱去衣物的状态。
去掉，摆脱，不再保留某物。

formal.mt: Wara li daħal fil-kamra, il-pazjent neża' l-kowt u poġġa bilqiegħda għall-eżami.
formal.en: After entering the room, the patient took off his coat and sat down for the examination.
formal.zh: 病人进入房间后，脱下外套，坐下来接受检查。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn hu l-kowt ta' Ben? Rita: Neża' l-kowt malli daħal; qiegħed fuq is-siġġu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is Ben's coat? Rita: He took it off as soon as he came in; it's on the chair.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：本的外套在哪里？丽塔：他一进来就脱了，在椅子上。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 本的外套在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Ben's coat?

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Neża' l-kowt malli daħal; qiegħed fuq is-siġġu.
messages.mt_standard: Neża' l-kowt malli daħal; qiegħed fuq is-siġġu.
messages.zh: 他一进来就脱了，在椅子上。
messages.en: He took it off as soon as he came in; it's on the chair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 neża' 时做一个脱外套的动作，再把去掉负担作为另一张联想图；抄写时把词尾撇号也当作拼写的一部分。

gloss_zh: 打开；对公众开放；张开扩展；腹泻；被公开

teaching_sense.en_definition: To open or become open, including opening to the public; in other contexts, to expand, have diarrhoea, or become public.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 打开或变为开启状态，包括对公众开放；在其他语境中也可指实体扩展开来、腹泻或事情被公开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sar miftuħ jew beda jilqa' lill-pubbliku; skont il-kuntest jista' jfisser ukoll twessa', kellu dijarea, jew sar magħruf pubblikament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打开，变为开启状态。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be opened to the public
sense_translations.zh_definition: 向公众开放，开始允许公众进入或使用。
在实体形态上张开、展开或扩展。
腹泻，拉肚子。
被公开，变为公众知晓的事情。

formal.mt: Il-mużew nfetaħ għall-pubbliku wara li tlesta x-xogħol ta' restawr.
formal.en: The museum opened to the public after the restoration work was completed.
formal.zh: 修复工程完成后，博物馆向公众开放。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Il-bieb nfetaħ waħdu? Samwel: Iva, bir-riħ. Se nagħlqu.
colloquial.en: Elena: Did the door open by itself? Samwel: Yes, because of the wind. I'll close it.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：门自己打开了吗？萨姆韦尔：是的，是风吹的。我去关上。

messages.speaker: Elena (室友)
messages.zh: 门自己打开了吗？
messages.en: Did the door open by itself?

messages.speaker: Samwel (室友)
messages.zh: 是的，是风吹的。我去关上。
messages.en: Yes, because of the wind. I'll close it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用门从关闭变为打开的画面记 nfetaħ，再分别配上开放场馆、物体展开、腹泻和消息公开的语境卡，避免把不同义项混用。

gloss_zh: 突然发泄；情绪迸发；猛攻或痛斥
