teaching_sense.en_definition: To burst into an emotional expression, give vent to a feeling, or attack someone or something forcefully.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 突然表现出强烈情绪或发泄感受，也可指猛烈攻击、责骂某人或某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħareġ emozzjoni bil-qawwa, bħal meta beda jibki jew jgħajjat f'daqqa, jew attakka lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa bil-qawwa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to give vent to an emotion
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某种情绪强烈地表达或发泄出来。

sense_translations.en_definition: to lay into sth. or sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 猛烈攻击或严厉责骂某人或某物。

sense_translations.en_definition: to burst into, to vent (an emotion or its expression)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 突然爆发出某种情绪或表现，如放声哭泣、突然大笑；发泄情绪。

formal.mt: Meta sema' r-riżultat, l-istudent nfexx jibki bil-ferħ wara xhur ta' studju intensiv.
formal.en: When he heard the result, the student burst into tears of joy after months of intensive study.
formal.zh: 经过数月紧张学习，那名学生听到结果时，喜极而泣。

colloquial.mt: Julia: Għaliex Tom nfexx jidħak? Adam: Ra l-qattus rieqed fil-basket tal-ħwejjeġ.
colloquial.en: Julia: Why did Tom burst out laughing? Adam: He saw the cat asleep in the laundry basket.
colloquial.zh: 朱莉娅：汤姆为什么突然笑起来？亚当：他看到猫睡在洗衣篮里。

messages.speaker: Julia (朋友)
messages.zh: 汤姆为什么突然笑起来？
messages.en: Why did Tom burst out laughing?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.zh: 他看到猫睡在洗衣篮里。
messages.en: He saw the cat asleep in the laundry basket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nfexx 想成情绪突然冲出闸门：接哭泣就是突然哭起来，接笑就是突然大笑；重点记住情绪一下子爆发的感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become excessively pleased with oneself and act as though one is more important than others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因过分欣赏自己而变得自满，表现得仿佛自己比别人更重要。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu opinjoni għolja wisq tiegħu nnifsu u jġib ruħu bħallikieku hu aqwa minn ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自满；自视甚高；自以为了不起

collocations.en: became full of himself after his success
became full of himself because of the praise
collocations.zh: 受到赞扬后变得自以为了不起

formal.mt: Wara s-suċċess tal-proġett, il-mexxej ngħamar u ma baqax jagħti kas il-pariri tat-tim.
formal.en: After the project's success, the leader became full of himself and stopped paying attention to the team's advice.
formal.zh: 项目成功后，负责人变得自满，不再听取团队的建议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Paul ngħamar minn meta rebaħ il-premju. Lara: Iva, issa jaħseb li jaf kollox.
colloquial.en: Maja: Paul has become full of himself since he won the prize. Lara: Yes, now he thinks he knows everything.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Paul自从获奖后就变得自以为了不起。Lara：是啊，他现在觉得自己什么都懂。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Paul ngħamar minn meta rebaħ il-premju.
messages.mt_standard: Paul ngħamar minn meta rebaħ il-premju.
messages.zh: Paul自从获奖后就变得自以为了不起。
messages.en: Paul has become full of himself since he won the prize.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)

messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa jaħseb li jaf kollox.
messages.zh: 是啊，他现在觉得自己什么都懂。
messages.en: Yes, now he thinks he knows everything.

teaching_sense.en_definition: To join other people or a group, or to become connected or united with others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 加入某个群体，或与其他人、事物连接起来、团结起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidħol fi grupp jew isir parti minnu, jew jingħaqad ma' oħrajn biex ikunu flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被连接在一起；接合起来
作出很大努力；奋力去做

sense_translations.en_definition: to join a group, society, club, etc
sense_translations.zh_definition: 加入团体、社团、俱乐部等
联合起来；团结起来；结成一体

collocations.en: joined the rest of the team
collocations.zh: 与团队的其他成员会合

formal.mt: Il-voluntier il-ġdid ngħaqad mal-għaqda biex jgħin fl-organizzazzjoni ta' attivitajiet għall-komunità.
formal.en: The new volunteer joined the association to help organize activities for the community.
formal.zh: 这位新志愿者加入了协会，协助组织社区活动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark ngħaqad mal-klabb tagħna? Maja: Iva, u għada se jiġi għall-ewwel laqgħa tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Mark join our club? Maja: Yes, and tomorrow he is coming to his first meeting.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark加入我们俱乐部了吗？Maja：加入了，他明天会来参加他的第一次聚会。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sleepy feeling that makes someone want to sleep; also sleep itself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人想要睡觉的困倦感觉，也可指睡眠本身。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħtieġa jew ix-xewqa li wieħed jorqod; jista' jfisser ukoll l-irqad innifsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 睡眠；睡觉
困意；困倦；昏昏欲睡的感觉
太阳穴；头部两侧靠近眼睛外侧的部位

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa twila, qabadni n-ngħas u bdejt insibha diffiċli biex nikkonċentra.
formal.en: During the long meeting, I became sleepy and began to find it difficult to concentrate.
formal.zh: 在漫长的会议中，我开始犯困，逐渐难以集中注意力。

messages.en: All right, we will talk tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用打哈欠的画面记住ngħas的困意和睡眠义，再另画一个指向太阳穴的箭头，分别记忆同形的身体部位义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A day, especially the light part of the day between dawn and nightfall.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一日或一天，尤其指从黎明到天黑之间的白昼时段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jum, speċjalment il-ħin meta jkun hemm id-dawl tax-xemx, minn meta jisbaħ sa meta jidlam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 日；一天

sense_translations.en_definition: daytime, day (time between dawn and nightfall)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 白天；白昼，即从黎明到天黑之间的时段

formal.mt: Il-ħidma fuq il-bini se ssir bin-nhar sabiex jitnaqqas l-istorbju matul il-lejl.
formal.en: The building work will take place during the daytime to reduce noise at night.
formal.zh: 建筑施工将在白天进行，以减少夜间噪声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta se niltaqgħu? Mark: Nhar il-Ħadd filgħodu, jekk jaqbillek.
colloquial.en: Maja: When shall we meet? Mark: On Sunday morning, if that suits you.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们什么时候见面？Mark：星期天上午吧，如果你方便的话。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To begin growing by germinating, taking root, or producing shoots or buds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过种子萌发、生根或长出嫩芽而开始生长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda jikber billi joħroġ għeruq, rimjiet jew blanzuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 萌芽；长出芽苞。
生根；开始扎根。
发芽；种子开始萌发。

sense_translations.en_definition: to take root, to begin to grow, to form sprouts or buds
sense_translations.zh_definition: 生根，开始生长，长出嫩芽或芽苞。

collocations.en: the basil sprouted in the pot

formal.mt: Il-qamħ nibet ftit jiem wara ż-żrigħ, meta l-ħamrija kellha biżżejjed ilma.
formal.en: The wheat germinated a few days after sowing, when the soil had enough water.
formal.zh: 播种几天后，土壤水分充足，小麦便发芽了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-ħabaq li żrajt nibet? Toni: Iva, nibet dalgħodu. Ejja ara kemm hu żgħir!
colloquial.en: Lara: Has the basil you sowed sprouted? Toni: Yes, it sprouted this morning. Come and see how tiny it is!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你种的罗勒发芽了吗？托尼：发了，今天早上发芽了。快来看，它多小呀！

teaching_sense.en_definition: To tease, taunt, or provoke someone with words or actions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用言语或行为逗弄、嘲弄或挑衅某人，引起对方反应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid jew jagħmel xi ħaġa biex jiċċajta ma' xi ħadd jew jipprovokah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逗弄；拿某人开玩笑。
嘲弄；用带有挑衅意味的话讥讽某人。
骚扰；不断烦扰某人。
逗弄、嘲弄或挑衅某人。

formal.mt: L-għalliem intervjena meta student nibex lil sieħbu bi kliem li weġġgħu.
formal.en: The teacher intervened when a student taunted a classmate with hurtful words.
formal.zh: 一名学生用伤人的话嘲弄同学时，老师出面制止了。

colloquial.en: Nina: Why did your brother get angry? Ben: Pawlu teased my brother about his hair, and my brother didn't like it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你兄弟为什么生气了？本：保罗拿我兄弟的头发开玩笑，他听了不高兴。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small drops of water that form on cool surfaces, especially outdoors overnight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在较冷物体表面形成的小水滴，尤指夜间在户外凝结的露水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qtar żgħir tal-ilma li jifforma fuq uċuħ kesħin, speċjalment barra matul il-lejl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 露水；空气中的水汽在较冷表面凝结成的小水滴。

formal.mt: Filgħodu kmieni, qtar tan-nida kien jidher fuq il-weraq tal-pjanti.
formal.en: Early in the morning, drops of dew were visible on the plants' leaves.
formal.zh: 清晨，可以看见植物叶片上的露珠。

gloss_zh: 推出；宣传；发布；宣告；正式启动

teaching_sense.en_definition: To officially and publicly start a project, programme, or other activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式并公开地启动项目、计划或其他活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda proġett, programm jew attività oħra b'mod uffiċjali u pubbliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 推出；启动。
宣传；使公众知晓。
公布；发布；发表。
宣告；公开宣布。

sense_translations.en_definition: to initiate, launch (a program, project, etc.), to start something officially and publicly. Synonym: vara
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发起或启动计划、项目等；正式并公开地开始某项事务。同义词：vara。

collocations.zh: 发起了提高公众认识的宣传活动

formal.mt: Il-kunsill nieda programm ġdid biex jinkoraġġixxi r-riċiklaġġ fid-djar.

formal.zh: 地方议会启动了一项新计划，鼓励家庭开展回收利用。

colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你看到那个新的语言课程了吗？马克：看到了，中心昨天推出了这个课程。我要报名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slightly wet or containing a small amount of moisture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有少量水分、摸起来微湿或潮湿的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ftit imxarrab jew li fih ftit umdità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 潮湿的；略微湿润的。
湿润的；含有少量水分的；微湿的。

formal.mt: Il-ħajt għandu jkun niexef qabel iż-żebgħa; jekk ikun niedi, ix-xogħol għandu jiġi pospost.
formal.en: The wall must be dry before painting; if it is damp, the work should be postponed.
formal.zh: 刷漆前墙面必须干燥；如果墙面潮湿，应推迟施工。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fit a horse with horseshoes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给马装上或钉上蹄铁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħħal in-nagħal ma' saqajn żiemel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给马钉蹄铁。

collocations.en: shod the horse before the journey
collocations.zh: 在出发前给马钉了蹄铁

formal.mt: Il-ħaddied niegħel iż-żiemel qabel il-vjaġġ.

teaching_sense.en_definition: To speak in a pleasant, soothing, or melodious manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用悦耳、柔和或带有安慰意味的语气说话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tkellem b'leħen ħelu, pjaċevoli jew li jfarraġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以亲切悦耳的语气说话。
用安慰人的语气说话；柔声劝慰。
说话悦耳动听，或语调富有旋律感。

formal.mt: L-għalliem niegħem mat-tifel biex ifarrġu wara l-aħbar ħażina.
formal.en: The teacher spoke soothingly to the boy to comfort him after the bad news.
formal.zh: 听到坏消息后，老师柔声对那个男孩说话，安慰他。

messages.zh: 他爸爸柔声安慰他，他就不哭了。

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象大人压低声音安慰哭泣的孩子，把悦耳、柔和、安慰三个意思串起来记。

gloss_zh: 发生性关系（粗俗）；弄坏、毁掉

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have sexual intercourse with someone, expressed vulgarly; also to spoil or ruin something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以粗俗说法表示与某人发生性关系；也可表示把某物弄坏、搞砸或毁掉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kellu x'jaqsam sesswalment ma' xi ħadd, b'espressjoni vulgari; jista' jfisser ukoll ħassar jew rovina xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发生性交；行淫。
与某人发生性关系。
掺杂而使变质；糟蹋、弄坏或毁掉。
操；干，指发生性关系的粗俗说法。

cognitive_memory_aid: 记成带有粗俗标签的两张卡：对象是人时联系性行为，对象是事情时联系搞砸。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small bed or cradle for a baby.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供婴儿睡觉的小床或摇篮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sodda żgħira jew benniena fejn torqod tarbija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 婴儿小床。
摇篮。
婴儿摇篮；婴儿床。

formal.mt: It-tarbija kienet rieqda fin-nieqa tal-injam ħdejn is-sodda ta' ommha.
formal.en: The baby was asleep in the wooden cradle beside her mother's bed.
formal.zh: 婴儿睡在母亲床旁的木制摇篮里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi t-tarbija? Toni: Qiegħda torqod fin-nieqa. Tkellem bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the baby? Toni: She is sleeping in the cradle. Speak softly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：宝宝在哪里？Toni：她正在摇篮里睡觉。说话轻一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.zh: 宝宝在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the baby?

messages.speaker: Toni (父亲)
messages.zh: 她正在摇篮里睡觉。说话轻一点。
messages.en: She is sleeping in the cradle. Speak softly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张只容得下宝宝的小床，轻轻摇动就是摇篮，用同一幅画面记住两个译法。

gloss_zh: 缺少的；缺席的；失踪的；已故的；差几分到某时

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lacking something, absent, or missing; also used for someone deceased and for minutes before an hour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示有所欠缺、不在场或下落不明；也可表示已故，并用于钟点表达中的“差几分”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jonqsu xi ħaġa, li mhux preżenti jew li ma jafux fejn jinsab; jintuża wkoll għal min miet u fil-ħin biex juri minuti qabel siegħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缺少的；有所欠缺的。
缺席的；不在场的。
已故的；去世的。
用于钟点，表示差若干分钟到所说的时刻。
失踪的；下落不明的。
外出的；离开而不在此处的。

collocations.zh: 差十分五点；四点五十分

formal.mt: L-istudent kien nieqes mill-iskola minħabba l-mard.

colloquial.en: Maja: Is Toni still absent? Mark: Yes, he has not arrived yet. There are still ten minutes before the meeting starts.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Toni还没到吗？Mark：对，他还没来。离开会还有十分钟。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: Toni还没到吗？
messages.en: Is Toni still absent?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadu ma wasalx. Għad jonqos għaxar minuti biex tibda l-laqgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadu ma wasalx. Għad jonqos għaxar minuti biex tibda l-laqgħa.
messages.zh: 对，他还没来。离开会还有十分钟。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用座位空着记缺席，用拼图缺块记缺少，用钟面差十分记时间义；已故义另配人物追思场景。

gloss_zh: 人们；社会；有教养或富裕的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: People considered as a group or as society; in some contexts, educated or well-off people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为群体的人们或社会大众；在某些语境中指有教养或生活富裕的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuni meqjusa flimkien jew bħala soċjetà; f'ċerti kuntesti, persuni edukati jew sinjuri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人们；人群。
社会；社会大众。
有教养的人；经济宽裕或富裕的人。

collocations.zh: 受过教育或有教养的人

formal.mt: Ħafna nies tal-lokal ħadu sehem fil-laqgħa dwar it-trasport pubbliku.
formal.en: Many local people took part in the meeting about public transport.
formal.zh: 许多当地居民参加了有关公共交通的会议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm daqshekk nies fil-pjazza? Toni: Hemm kunċert illejla, u kulħadd qed jistenna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are there so many people in the square? Toni: There is a concert tonight, and everyone is waiting.
colloquial.zh: Maja：广场上怎么有这么多人？Toni：今晚有音乐会，大家都在等。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 广场上怎么有这么多人？
messages.en: Why are there so many people in the square?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm kunċert illejla, u kulħadd qed jistenna.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm kunċert illejla, u kulħadd qed jistenna.
messages.zh: 今晚有音乐会，大家都在等。
messages.en: There is a concert tonight, and everyone is waiting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见这个词就想象广场上的一群人；把人群放大成社会，再按语境理解有教养或富裕的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Prone to forgetting things, or unaware of something because it has escaped one's attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易忘事的；或因没有留意而对某事浑然不觉的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsa malajr jew li ma jagħtix kas ta' xi ħaġa u ma jintebaħx biha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 健忘的；容易忘事的。
浑然不觉的；没有意识到或留意到的。

formal.mt: Min ikun niesi jista' juża lista biex jiftakar l-appuntamenti tiegħu.
formal.en: Someone who is forgetful can use a list to remember their appointments.
formal.zh: 健忘的人可以用清单帮助自己记住预约安排。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Erġajt insejt iċ-ċwievet? Toni: Iva, illum jien niesi wisq. Ħallejthom fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you forget the keys again? Toni: Yes, I am very forgetful today. I left them on the table.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你又忘拿钥匙了？Toni：是啊，我今天特别健忘。我把钥匙落在桌上了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你又忘拿钥匙了？
messages.en: Did you forget the keys again?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum jien niesi wisq. Ħallejthom fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum jien niesi wisq. Ħallejthom fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 是啊，我今天特别健忘。我把钥匙落在桌上了。
messages.en: Yes, I am very forgetful today. I left them on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把钥匙忘在桌上的人想成健忘，把看书看得忘了时间想成浑然不觉，用两个场景区分词义。

gloss_zh: 干燥的；干硬不新鲜的；消瘦的；惊呆的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dry or without moisture; also stale, very thin, or dumbfounded, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 干燥或缺少水分的；也可按语境表示食物干硬不新鲜、人消瘦，或惊得说不出话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma fihx ilma jew umdità; jista' jiddeskrivi wkoll ikel li tilef il-freskezza, bniedem irqiq ħafna, jew persuna li baqgħet bla kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 干的；干燥的；没有水分的。
食物放久后不新鲜、变干硬的。
瘦的；消瘦的；瘦弱憔悴的。
惊呆的；惊得说不出话的。

collocations.zh: 干面包；放干了的不新鲜面包

formal.mt: Il-ħobż sar niexef wara li tħalla mikxuf għal ġurnata sħiħa.
formal.en: The bread became dry after being left uncovered for a whole day.
formal.zh: 面包没有盖着放了一整天，变干了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ma qal xejn meta sema' l-aħbar? Toni: Baqa' niexef. Ma kienx qed jistenna li jirbaħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark say nothing when he heard the news? Toni: He was dumbfounded. He was not expecting to win.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark听到消息后为什么一句话也没说？Toni：他惊呆了。他没想到自己会赢。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark ma qal xejn meta sema' l-aħbar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark ma qal xejn meta sema' l-aħbar?
messages.zh: Mark听到消息后为什么一句话也没说？
messages.en: Why did Mark say nothing when he heard the news?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Baqa' niexef. Ma kienx qed jistenna li jirbaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Baqa' niexef. Ma kienx qed jistenna li jirbaħ.
messages.zh: 他惊呆了。他没想到自己会赢。
messages.en: He was dumbfounded. He was not expecting to win.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四张画面记忆：干燥天气、放干面包、消瘦身形、惊呆表情；这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pierce or puncture something, making a hole or passing through it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刺入或穿过某物，使其出现孔洞或被穿透。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idaħħal ponta f'xi ħaġa u jagħmel toqba fiha jew jgħaddi minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺穿；穿破
扎破；刺出孔洞
猛刺；用力插入
穿透；刺入内部

sense_translations.en_definition: to pierce; to penetrate; to puncture; to pass through
sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺穿；穿透；扎破；穿过

formal.zh: 钉子扎破了轮胎，导致漏气。

colloquial.en: Mark: Why is the tyre flat? Pawlu: A nail punctured the tyre; we need to change it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：轮胎怎么没气了？保罗：一颗钉子扎破了轮胎，我们得换胎。

messages.speaker: Mark (车主)
messages.zh: 轮胎怎么没气了？
messages.en: Why is the tyre flat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (修车师傅)
messages.zh: 一颗钉子扎破了轮胎，我们得换胎。
messages.en: A nail punctured the tyre; we need to change it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nifed 配上钉子穿透轮胎的画面：重点是刺入后形成孔洞或穿过去。

gloss_zh: 呼吸；一口气；微风；休息；暂缓

teaching_sense.en_definition: A breath of air taken into or released from the lungs; also a brief rest or relief.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吸入或呼出的一口气；也可指短暂的休息或喘息机会。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arja li wieħed jieħu fil-pulmuni jew joħroġ minnhom; ukoll mistrieħ qasir jew serħan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呼吸；一口气
一阵微风
短暂休息；喘口气的时间
暂缓；暂时摆脱压力或困境的喘息机会
一小口气；短促呼出的一股气

formal.mt: Qabel ma beda d-diskors, il-kelliem ħa nifs u ħares lejn l-udjenza.
formal.en: Before beginning the speech, the speaker took a breath and looked at the audience.
formal.zh: 演讲开始前，发言者吸了一口气，望向听众。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Ejja nieqfu ftit; għandi bżonn nieħu nifs. Lara: Tajjeb, nistrieħu hawn għal minuta.
colloquial.en: Marta: Let's stop for a moment; I need to catch my breath. Lara: Okay, let's rest here for a minute.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我们停一下吧，我得喘口气。拉拉：好，我们在这里歇一分钟。

messages.speaker: Marta (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nieqfu ftit; għandi bżonn nieħu nifs.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nieqfu ftit; għandi bżonn nieħu nifs.
messages.zh: 我们停一下吧，我得喘口气。
messages.en: Let's stop for a moment; I need to catch my breath.

messages.speaker: Lara (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我们在这里歇一分钟。
messages.en: Okay, let's rest here for a minute.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“吸一口气、停下来喘口气”串起 nifs 的呼吸与休息义；微风义则想成轻轻吹来的一口气。

gloss_zh: 刺；蜇；戳；用言语刺激或挑衅

teaching_sense.en_definition: To prick, sting, or prod someone or something; also to provoke someone with hurtful words.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用尖物刺、蜇或戳某人或某物；也指用伤人的话刺激或挑衅某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iweġġa' b'ponta jew b'niggieża, jew jipprovoka lil xi ħadd bi kliem li jweġġa'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻刺；扎一下
蜇；刺痛
戳；捅；以戳动催促

sense_translations.en_definition: to provoke by using offensive or hurtful language
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用冒犯或伤人的言语刺激、挑衅
蜇；刺；戳

sense_translations.en_definition: to spur, to prod in order to agitate
sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺激；通过催逼或戳动使其激动、不安

collocations.zh: 用尖刻的话刺激了对方

formal.mt: Waqt id-dibattitu, il-kelliem niggeż lill-avversarju bi kliem iebes.

formal.zh: 辩论期间，发言者用尖刻的话刺激了对手。

colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你怎么一直揉胳膊？马克：那只虫子蜇了我，现在有点痒。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么一直揉胳膊？
messages.en: Why are you rubbing your arm?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak l-insett niggeż lili, u issa qed inħoss ħakk.
messages.mt_standard: Dak l-insett niggeż lili, u issa qed inħoss ħakk.
messages.zh: 那只虫子蜇了我，现在有点痒。
messages.en: That insect stung me, and now I feel itchy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 niggeż 想成“尖尖的一下”：针尖扎身体，尖刻话扎心里；这是记忆画面，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of sorrow, sadness, or grief, especially after loss or distress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 悲伤、难过或悲痛的情绪，尤其指失去某人、某物或遭遇不幸后的感受。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' dwejjaq jew sogħba, speċjalment wara telfa jew ġrajja ta' swied il-qalb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悲伤；哀愁
悲痛；哀伤，尤指失去亲友后的深切悲伤
忧郁；低落而伤感的情绪
悲伤；难过；悲痛

formal.mt: Wara t-telfa ta' ħabibu, ħass niket kbir.
formal.en: After the loss of his friend, he felt great sorrow.
formal.zh: 失去朋友后，他感到深切的悲痛。

colloquial.en: Marta: I still feel a lot of grief when I think of Grandma. Sara: I understand; if you want to talk about her, I'm here.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：想起奶奶，我还是很难过。萨拉：我理解，如果你想聊聊她，我就在这里。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni nħoss ħafna niket meta naħseb fin-nanna.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni nħoss ħafna niket meta naħseb fin-nanna.
messages.zh: 想起奶奶，我还是很难过。
messages.en: I still feel a lot of grief when I think of Grandma.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nifhem; jekk trid titkellem dwarha, jien hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Nifhem; jekk trid titkellem dwarha, jien hawn.
messages.zh: 我理解，如果你想聊聊她，我就在这里。
messages.en: I understand; if you want to talk about her, I'm here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 niket 放进“感到悲伤”和“满怀悲痛”两个短语里，记住它是情绪的名称，可以深也可以淡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To slow someone or something down, delaying movement, work, or progress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人或某物的速度变慢，耽搁行动、工作或进展。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inaqqas il-ħeffa ta' xi ħadd jew ta' xi ħaġa u jdewwem il-mixja, ix-xogħol jew il-progress.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人的速度变慢；拖慢某人
阻碍某人；拖住某人，使其难以前进或取得进展
使某物或某人减速；拖慢某事或某人

formal.mt: In-nuqqas ta' materjal nikker ix-xogħol fuq il-proġett.
formal.en: The lack of materials slowed down work on the project.
formal.zh: 材料短缺拖慢了项目的施工进度。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex wasalt tard? David: It-traffiku nikker il-vjaġġ tiegħi.

colloquial.zh: 安娜：你怎么迟到了？戴维：路上堵车，耽搁了行程。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 你怎么迟到了？

messages.speaker: David (同事)

gloss_zh: 用点作标记；使悲伤；使悲痛

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone sad or cause grief; in a separate sense, to mark something with a dot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人难过或悲痛；另一个独立义项是用点给某物作标记。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss niket; f'tifsira oħra, jimmarka xi ħaġa b'tikka.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用点作标记；加上点状记号
使难过；使悲伤
使悲痛；使陷入哀伤

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么不开心？
messages.en: Why are you sad?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-film nikket lili; it-tmiem kien tassew ta' swied il-qalb.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-film nikket lili; it-tmiem kien tassew ta' swied il-qalb.

messages.en: That film saddened me; the ending was truly heartbreaking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅图记 nikket：纸上加一个点，或消息使人伤心；再对照 niket 是“悲伤”，nikket 是“使人悲伤”。

gloss_zh: 睡觉；睡觉觉（对幼儿说的话）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sleep, especially in language used when speaking to a young child.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 睡觉，尤指对幼儿说话时使用的亲昵表达，相当于“睡觉觉”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jorqod, speċjalment fil-lingwaġġ li jintuża mat-tfal iż-żgħar.

sense_translations.en_definition: to sleep (a word used in child-directed speech)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 睡觉觉；对幼儿说话时表示“睡觉”。
睡觉。

collocations.zh: 对儿童说话时使用的 ninna

formal.mt: Il-verb 'ninna' jintuża meta nitkellmu mat-tfal iż-żgħar dwar l-irqad.
formal.en: The verb 'ninna' is used when speaking to young children about sleeping.
formal.zh: 动词 ninna 用于对幼儿谈论睡觉的情境。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'ninna'? Omm: Tfisser torqod; hija kelma li nużaw mat-tfal iż-żgħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'ninna' mean? Mum: It means to sleep; it is a word we use with little children.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：ninna 是什么意思？妈妈：就是睡觉，是我们对小孩子说的话。

messages.speaker: Maja (女儿)
messages.zh: ninna 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ninna' mean?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser torqod; hija kelma li nużaw mat-tfal iż-żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser torqod; hija kelma li nużaw mat-tfal iż-żgħar.
messages.zh: 就是睡觉，是我们对小孩子说的话。
messages.en: It means to sleep; it is a word we use with little children.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ninna 放进哄孩子入睡的画面，配上中文“睡觉觉”的温柔语气，记住它的幼儿用语色彩。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Indigo: a deep blue colour, or the plant associated with that colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 靛蓝，一种深蓝色；也指与这种颜色相关的靛蓝植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kulur blu skur, jew il-pjanta marbuta ma' dan il-kulur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 靛蓝；一种深蓝色。
靛蓝植物；该植物所对应的靛蓝色。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi d-drapp bħala blu skur, b'lewn in-nir.
formal.en: The catalogue describes the fabric as dark blue, with an indigo hue.
formal.zh: 目录将这种布料描述为带有靛蓝色调的深蓝色。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema lewn tippreferi għal din il-libsa? Mark: In-nir; jogħġobni dak il-blu skur.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which shade do you prefer for this dress? Mark: Indigo; I like that deep blue.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这条裙子你更喜欢什么色调？马克：靛蓝，我喜欢那种深蓝色。

messages.speaker: Lara (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema lewn tippreferi għal din il-libsa?
messages.mt_standard: Liema lewn tippreferi għal din il-libsa?
messages.zh: 这条裙子你更喜欢什么色调？
messages.en: Which shade do you prefer for this dress?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 靛蓝，我喜欢那种深蓝色。
messages.en: Indigo; I like that deep blue.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在记忆卡上画一片深蓝色块和一株植物，把 nir 同时连到“靛蓝色”与“靛蓝植物”两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person's or family's lineage or origin; also offspring or a group understood through shared descent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人或家族的世系、出身；也可指后代，或按共同血缘理解的族类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-antenati jew l-oriġini ta' persuna jew familja; ukoll id-dixxendenti jew grupp marbut b'antenati komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 世系；家族代代相承的血缘脉络。
后代；子孙。
种族；按共同血缘或祖先划分的族类。
出身；来源；起源。

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur studja n-nisel tal-familja permezz ta' dokumenti antiki.
formal.en: The researcher studied the family's lineage through old documents.
formal.zh: 研究者通过旧文献研究了这个家族的世系。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Int ta' nisel Malti? Mark: Iva, in-nanniet tiegħi kienu minn Għawdex.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you of Maltese descent? Mark: Yes, my grandparents were from Gozo.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你有马耳他血统吗？马克：有，我的祖父母来自戈佐岛。

messages.speaker: Sara (新朋友)
messages.zh: 你有马耳他血统吗？
messages.en: Are you of Maltese descent?

messages.speaker: Mark (新朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, in-nanniet tiegħi kienu minn Għawdex.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, in-nanniet tiegħi kienu minn Għawdex.
messages.zh: 有，我的祖父母来自戈佐岛。
messages.en: Yes, my grandparents were from Gozo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一棵家族树：向上看是世系和出身，向下看是子孙后代，再用共同祖先联想族类这一义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To weave threads together; also to design or plot something by arranging its parts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把线交织成织物；也指组织各个部分来设计或策划某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaqqad il-ħjut biex jagħmel drapp; ukoll ifassal jew jippjana xi ħaġa billi jgħaqqad il-partijiet tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 编织；把线交织成织物。
设计；构思并安排某物的结构或形式。
策划；谋划，尤指仔细或秘密地安排计划。

formal.mt: L-awtur niseġ storja kumplessa li torbot flimkien il-ħajja ta' tliet familji.
formal.en: The author wove a complex story that connects the lives of three families.
formal.zh: 作者编织了一个复杂的故事，将三个家庭的生活联系起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min niseġ dan id-drapp? Pawlu: Nannuwi; għamlu fuq newl antik.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who wove this fabric? Pawlu: My grandfather; he made it on an old loom.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这块布是谁织的？保罗：我爷爷，他用一台旧织布机织的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这块布是谁织的？
messages.en: Who wove this fabric?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我爷爷，他用一台旧织布机织的。
messages.en: My grandfather; he made it on an old loom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把线织成布，再把想法编成设计、把步骤编成计划；用这组画面串联义项，不把联想当作词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instance or act of forgetting, including use as a cognate object with the verb 'nesa'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次遗忘或忘事的行为；可与动词 nesa 搭配，充当其同源宾语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att jew każ ta' nsi; tintuża wkoll bħala oġġett tal-istess għerq mal-verb 'nesa'.

sense_translations.en_definition: an act of forgetting, used as a cognate object of the verb 'nesa'
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次遗忘行为，用作动词 nesa 的同源宾语。
一次忘事；一个遗忘的事例。

collocations.en: forgot, with 'nisja' expressing the act of forgetting
collocations.zh: 忘了一回；nisja 在此表达遗忘这一行为

formal.mt: Fil-frażi 'nesa nisja', il-kelma 'nisja' hija nom li jindika att ta' nsi.
formal.en: In the phrase 'nesa nisja', the word 'nisja' is a noun indicating an act of forgetting.
formal.zh: 在短语 nesa nisja 中，nisja 是表示一次遗忘行为的名词。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Insejt inġib il-ħobż! Ben: Kienet nisja żgħira; nixtrih jien.
colloquial.en: Lara: I forgot to bring the bread! Ben: It was a minor lapse; I'll buy it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我忘了带面包！本：只是忘了一件小事，我去买。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 我忘了带面包！
messages.en: I forgot to bring the bread!

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 只是忘了一件小事，我去买。
messages.en: It was a minor lapse; I'll buy it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 nisja 配一张“忘带面包”的便签，记住它把忘记这件事当作名词说，重点是“一次遗忘”。

gloss_zh: 基督教的；基督徒；特定用法中指天主教的或天主教徒

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Christianity or Christians; in some uses, specifically relating to Roman Catholicism.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基督教的、与基督徒有关的；在某些用法中专指罗马天主教的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Kristjaneżmu jew mal-Insara; f'ċerti użi, mal-Knisja Kattolika Rumana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 基督教的；基督徒的。
基督徒；信奉基督教的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: Roman Catholic (adherent to the Roman Catholic Church)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 罗马天主教徒；信奉罗马天主教会的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: Christian (of, like or relating to Christianity or Christians)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 基督教的；具有基督教特征的；与基督教或基督徒有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Roman Catholic (of or pertaining to the Roman Catholic Church)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 罗马天主教的；属于或涉及罗马天主教会的。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina t-tagħlim nisrani dwar l-imħabba lejn il-proxxmu.
formal.en: The study examines Christian teaching about love for one's neighbour.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察基督教关于爱邻人的教导。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark hu nisrani? Sara: Iva, u jħobb jitkellem dwar it-twemmin tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Mark a Christian? Sara: Yes, and he likes talking about his faith.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克是基督徒吗？萨拉：是的，他也喜欢谈自己的信仰。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克是基督徒吗？
messages.en: Is Mark a Christian?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u jħobb jitkellem dwar it-twemmin tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u jħobb jitkellem dwar it-twemmin tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是的，他也喜欢谈自己的信仰。
messages.en: Yes, and he likes talking about his faith.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张卡区分词性：修饰信仰时译“基督教的”，指人时译“基督徒”；天主教义项另作语境标记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce offspring or breed animals; also to bring forth, generate, or derive something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生育后代或繁育动物；也指使某物产生、生成或衍生出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu wlied jew ikattar l-annimali; ukoll joħloq, iqajjem jew joħroġ xi ħaġa minn oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生育；繁衍后代。
使衍生；从某个来源引出或生成。
繁育；使生殖或繁殖。
生育；使有后代。
产生；生出；使出现。

sense_translations.en_definition: to procreate, to have children, offspring
sense_translations.zh_definition: 生育；有孩子或后代。
繁育动物；使动物繁殖。
产生；生成；使衍生。

formal.mt: Is-suċċess tal-proġett nissel tama ġdida fil-komunità.
formal.en: The project's success generated new hope in the community.
formal.zh: 项目的成功在社区中带来了新的希望。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Id-diskors tiegħu nissel tama fik? Ben: Iva, issa naħseb li nistgħu nsibu soluzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did his speech give you hope? Ben: Yes, now I think we can find a solution.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他的讲话让你产生希望了吗？本：是的，现在我觉得我们能找到解决办法。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 他的讲话让你产生希望了吗？
messages.en: Did his speech give you hope?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa naħseb li nistgħu nsibu soluzzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa naħseb li nistgħu nsibu soluzzjoni.
messages.zh: 是的，现在我觉得我们能找到解决办法。
messages.en: Yes, now I think we can find a solution.

cognitive_memory_aid: 围绕“使产生”串联记忆：产生后代是生育，繁育动物是使其繁殖，产生希望或疑问则是抽象用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pluck or strip something off, especially feathers or facial hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物拔下或扯掉，尤指拔除羽毛或面部毛发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqla' jew ineħħi xi ħaġa billi jiġbidha, speċjalment ir-rix jew ix-xagħar tal-wiċċ.

sense_translations.en_definition: to pluck (e.g. feathers, facial hair etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拔除，例如拔羽毛、面部毛发等。
拔下；扯掉；剥除。

formal.mt: Il-kok nitef ir-rix tat-tiġieġa qabel sajjarha.
formal.en: The cook plucked the chicken's feathers before cooking it.
formal.zh: 厨师在烹饪前拔掉了鸡的羽毛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark nitef dik ix-xagħra? Sara: Kienet qed iddejqu fuq wiċċu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark pluck that hair? Sara: It was bothering him on his face.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么拔掉那根毛？萨拉：那根毛长在脸上，让他不舒服。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么拔掉那根毛？
messages.en: Why did Mark pluck that hair?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那根毛长在脸上，让他不舒服。
messages.en: It was bothering him on his face.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用镊子夹住一根毛再向外拔，把 nitef 与“拔下、扯掉”的动作相连，并搭配羽毛和面部毛发记忆。

gloss_zh: 开始发臭；发恶臭；显得可疑

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop or give off an unpleasant smell; figuratively, to seem dishonest or untrue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 开始产生或散发难闻的气味；比喻事情显得不诚实或不可信。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda jarmi jew jarmi riħa ħażina; b'mod figurattiv, jagħti l-impressjoni ta' qerq jew nuqqas ta' verità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开始产生难闻的气味；开始发臭。

sense_translations.en_definition: to stink (have a strong bad smell)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 散发强烈的难闻气味；臭气熏人。

sense_translations.en_definition: to stink (give an impression of dishonesty or untruth)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 显得不诚实或不真实；让人觉得其中有诈。
是正确的事情；是合适的做法。

collocations.en: The rubbish gave off a bad smell.
collocations.zh: 垃圾散发出难闻的气味。

formal.mt: Il-ħut niten wara li tħalla barra mill-friġġ għal żmien twil.
formal.en: The fish started to smell bad after being left out of the refrigerator for a long time.
formal.zh: 鱼在冰箱外放置很久后开始发臭。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi din ir-riħa? Mark: L-iskart niten. Se noħorġu issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that smell? Mark: The rubbish has started to stink. I'll take it out now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是什么味道？马克：垃圾开始发臭了。我现在就把它拿出去。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这是什么味道？
messages.en: What's that smell?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 垃圾开始发臭了。我现在就把它拿出去。
messages.en: The rubbish has started to stink. I'll take it out now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象打开垃圾桶闻到臭味，记住 niten 表示东西自身发臭；再把难闻的感觉联想到事情可疑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very small amount of something, such as a pinch of salt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物极少的分量，例如一撮盐或一点点糖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammont żgħir ħafna ta' xi ħaġa, bħal ftit melħ li taqbad bejn subgħajk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 极少量；很小的一点。
一点点；微量。
一撮；用手指捏起的少量。
拔除羽毛的动作；一次拔羽毛。
小东西；小不点，指很小的人或物。

formal.mt: Żid nitfa melħ mat-taħlita u ħawwad sew qabel isservi.
formal.en: Add a pinch of salt to the mixture and stir well before serving.
formal.zh: 在混合物中加入一撮盐，上桌前充分搅拌。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid zokkor fit-te? Pawlu: Iva, imma nitfa biss.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like sugar in your tea? Pawlu: Yes, but just a tiny bit.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的茶里要加糖吗？保罗：要，不过只加一点点。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的茶里要加糖吗？
messages.en: Would you like sugar in your tea?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 要，不过只加一点点。
messages.en: Yes, but just a tiny bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拇指和食指捏起一撮盐，把 nitfa 和这个微小分量绑定；看到 nitfa biss 就想到只有一点点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something dirty or cause it to smell bad.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变脏，或使某物散发难闻的气味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħammeġ xi ħaġa jew iġegħelha tarmi riħa ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弄脏；使沾上污物。
使产生难闻的气味；使发臭。
把某物弄脏；使某物受到污损。
使散发恶臭；把某处熏臭。

collocations.zh: 使房间产生了难闻的气味

formal.mt: L-iskart li tħalla fil-kċina nitten il-kamra kollha.
formal.en: The rubbish left in the kitchen made the entire room stink.
formal.zh: 留在厨房里的垃圾把整个房间都熏臭了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ftaħt it-tieqa? Toni: Il-ħut nitten il-kċina kollha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you open the window? Toni: The fish made the whole kitchen stink.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么把窗户打开了？托尼：鱼把整个厨房都熏臭了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把窗户打开了？
messages.en: Why did you open the window?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 鱼把整个厨房都熏臭了。
messages.en: The fish made the whole kitchen stink.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用场景对照记忆：niten 是垃圾自己臭了，nitten 是垃圾把厨房熏臭了；记住后者使别的东西变脏或变臭。

gloss_zh: 淫乱者；好色之徒；褐玄参

teaching_sense.en_definition: A derogatory term for a lecherous or sexually depraved person; also the name of the brown figwort plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对好色或性行为淫乱者的贬称；也可指褐玄参这种植物，须依语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma ta' disprezz għal persuna żienja jew mogħtija għall-imġiba sesswali ħażina; ukoll isem ta' pjanta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 性变态者；用于贬斥他人的称呼。
好色之徒；对他人怀有淫欲的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: the brown figwort (a type of plant)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 褐玄参，一种植物。
生活淫乱、放荡好色的人。

formal.mt: F'din il-lista ta' pjanti, l-isem 'nittien' jirreferi għal pjanta u ma jintużax bħala insult.
formal.en: In this list of plants, the name 'nittien' refers to a plant and is not used as an insult.
formal.zh: 在这份植物名录中，nittien 指一种植物，并非用作辱骂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex sejjaħlu nittien? Mark: Għax kien qed jgħaddi kummenti sesswali mhux mixtieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did he call him a lecher? Mark: Because he was making unwanted sexual comments.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他为什么称那个人为好色之徒？马克：因为那个人一直在说令人反感的性方面的话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么称那个人为好色之徒？
messages.en: Why did he call him a lecher?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kien qed jgħaddi kummenti sesswali mhux mixtieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kien qed jgħaddi kummenti sesswali mhux mixtieqa.
messages.zh: 因为那个人一直在说令人反感的性方面的话。
messages.en: Because he was making unwanted sexual comments.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 nittien 做两张情境卡：人物卡写好色之徒，植物卡写褐玄参；先看上下文，再选择意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become dry or lose moisture; in other contexts, to grow thin, wither, or become exhausted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变干或失去水分；在其他语境中，也可指消瘦、枯萎或耗尽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef l-ilma jew l-umdità; skont il-kuntest, jista' wkoll ifisser li jsir irqiq, jidbiel jew jispiċċa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 干透；因失去水分而变干。
体重下降；瘦下来。
枯萎；因失去水分或生机而萎缩。
耗尽；枯竭；不再有剩余。
变干；由湿变为干燥。
变得消瘦；逐渐瘦下来。

formal.mt: Il-bir nixef wara diversi xhur mingħajr xita.
formal.en: The well dried up after several months without rain.
formal.zh: 连续数月没有下雨后，这口井干涸了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' ngħaddi minn hawn? Pawlu: Iva, it-tajn nixef.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I walk through here? Pawlu: Yes, the mud has dried.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我能从这里走过去吗？保罗：能，泥已经干了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我能从这里走过去吗？
messages.en: Can I walk through here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 能，泥已经干了。
messages.en: Yes, the mud has dried.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nixef 的用法画成四格：泥变干、井干涸、植物枯萎、人变瘦；用画面串联含义，不当作词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period of very dry weather with little or no rain, or the condition of being dry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 少雨或无雨的干旱时期；也指缺乏水分的干燥状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu ta' temp niexef bi ftit xita jew mingħajr xita; ukoll il-kundizzjoni ta' nuqqas ta' umdità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 干旱；因长期少雨而缺水的状况。
一段持续干燥、少雨的天气。
干燥；缺乏水分或湿气的状态。
干旱期；天气非常干燥并持续少雨的一段时期。

formal.mt: In-nixfa qawwija naqqset l-ilma disponibbli għat-tisqija tal-għelieqi.
formal.en: The severe drought reduced the water available for irrigating the fields.
formal.zh: 严重干旱减少了可用于农田灌溉的水量。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-ġnien daqshekk niexef? Toni: Minħabba n-nixfa. Ilu ma jagħmel ix-xita.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is the garden so dry? Toni: Because of the drought. It hasn't rained for a long time.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：花园为什么这么干？托尼：因为干旱。已经很久没下雨了。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 花园为什么这么干？
messages.en: Why is the garden so dry?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba n-nixfa. Ilu ma jagħmel ix-xita.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba n-nixfa. Ilu ma jagħmel ix-xita.
messages.zh: 因为干旱。已经很久没下雨了。
messages.en: Because of the drought. It hasn't rained for a long time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nixfa 放在一张龟裂土地的照片下记作干旱，再放到干燥皮肤的照片下记作干燥；两种用法都是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To flow out slowly in small amounts, leak, or secrete a substance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体缓慢、少量地流出或渗漏；也可指分泌某种物质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ bil-mod fi kwantitajiet żgħar, iċarċar jew jipproduċi sustanza bħala tnixxija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缓慢渗出；一点点地流出。
分泌；由生物组织产生并释放某种物质。
渗漏；液体从裂缝或不密封处流出。

sense_translations.en_definition: to ooze, leak (flow out in small amounts)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 渗出或漏出；以少量、缓慢的方式流出。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, ġie osservat li l-ilma nixxa minn xaqq fil-ħajt.
formal.en: During the inspection, it was observed that water had seeped through a crack in the wall.
formal.zh: 检查时发现，水从墙上的一道裂缝中渗出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn ġej dan l-ilma? Mark: Nixxa minn taħt il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is this water coming from? Mark: It seeped in under the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些水是从哪里来的？马克：是从门底下渗进来的。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这些水是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where is this water coming from?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 是从门底下渗进来的。
messages.en: It seeped in under the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象水沿墙缝一点点渗出，把 nixxa 记成慢慢漏出来的动作；再分别搭配水、油和分泌物练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A natural spring or source of water, or a small stream.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 水自然涌出的泉或水源；也可指小溪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għajn naturali li minnha joħroġ l-ilma, sors ta' ilma, jew mogħdija żgħira ta' ilma ġieri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 泉；地下水自然涌出的地方。
源头；水流发源之处。
泉或溪流；自然涌出的水源或小股流水。

collocations.zh: 一眼涌出清凉泉水的泉

collocations.en: the water of the spring or stream

formal.mt: Il-mogħdija tgħaddi ħdejn nixxiegħa żgħira li tforni l-ilma lill-ġnien.
formal.en: The path passes beside a small stream that supplies water to the garden.
formal.zh: 这条小路经过一条为花园供水的小溪。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se nieqfu nistrieħu? Pawlu: Ħdejn in-nixxiegħa, taħt dik is-siġra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where shall we stop for a rest? Pawlu: Beside the stream, under that tree.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们在哪里停下来休息？保罗：在溪边，就在那棵树下。

messages.speaker: Lara (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里停下来休息？
messages.en: Where shall we stop for a rest?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 在溪边，就在那棵树下。
messages.en: Beside the stream, under that tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一眼泉，再画泉水流成小溪，把两幅图都标上 nixxiegħa；借连续画面记住泉、源头和溪流三个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A recessed space in a wall, often used to display a statue or another object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 墙面向内凹入的小空间，常用于摆放雕像或其他物件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spazju mdaħħal fil-ħajt, spiss biex titqiegħed fih statwa jew xi oġġett ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 壁龛；墙上用于摆放物品的凹入空间。
神龛；供奉圣像等宗教物件的空间或小型设施。
灯芯；蜡烛或油灯中吸取燃料并供燃烧的芯线。

collocations.en: a shrine containing a statue of Our Lady

formal.mt: Il-proġett ta' restawr jinkludi t-tindif tan-niċċa u l-konservazzjoni tal-istatwa li hemm fiha.
formal.en: The restoration project includes cleaning the niche and conserving the statue inside it.
formal.zh: 修复项目包括清洁壁龛，并保护其中的雕像。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn qiegħda l-istatwa ż-żgħira? Ġorġ: Fin-niċċa ħdejn il-bieb. Ara hemm, fuq il-lemin.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is the small statue? Ġorġ: In the niche beside the door. Look there, on the right.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：那尊小雕像在哪里？乔治：在门旁边的壁龛里。看那儿，右边。

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.zh: 那尊小雕像在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the small statue?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Fin-niċċa ħdejn il-bieb. Ara hemm, fuq il-lemin.
messages.mt_standard: Fin-niċċa ħdejn il-bieb. Ara hemm, fuq il-lemin.
messages.zh: 在门旁边的壁龛里。看那儿，右边。
messages.en: In the niche beside the door. Look there, on the right.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先画墙上放雕像的小凹格记“壁龛、神龛”，再单独画灯芯记另一义项；这是分类记忆，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bermuda grass, Cynodon dactylon; in a separate sense, a star.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指狗牙根，又称百慕大草；另一个独立义项指星星。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxix tal-ispeċi Cynodon dactylon; f'tifsira oħra, kewkba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狗牙根，又称百慕大草，学名为 Cynodon dactylon
星；星星

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar neħħa n-niġma minn madwar il-fjuri.
formal.en: The gardener removed the bermuda grass from around the flowers.
formal.zh: 园丁清除了花卉周围的狗牙根。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara dik in-niġma fis-sema! Adam: Qed naraha; tiddi ħafna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at that star in the sky! Adam: I can see it; it's very bright.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看天空中的那颗星！亚当：我看到了，它很亮。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 看天空中的那颗星！
messages.en: Look at that star in the sky!

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.zh: 我看到了，它很亮。
messages.en: I can see it; it's very bright.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 niġma 做两张独立图卡：花园里标狗牙根，夜空里标星星；靠场景区分，不把两个义项混成一种东西。

gloss_zh: 污染；弄脏；使不洁；违反饮食戒律

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something dirty, polluted, contaminated, or impure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变脏、受到污染或变得不洁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa maħmuġa, imniġġsa jew mhux safja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 污染
弄脏
使受到污染；使混入有害或不洁物质
污染，例如污染空气
使不纯净；使不洁

sense_translations.en_definition: to break a dietary rule (during Lent, or by eating meat on a Friday)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 违反饮食戒律，例如在大斋期违反规定，或在星期五食肉

formal.mt: It-tnixxija taż-żejt niġġset l-ilma tal-port.
formal.en: The oil leak contaminated the harbour water.
formal.zh: 漏油污染了港口的水。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex l-ilma f'dan il-barmil maħmuġ? Toni: Xi ħadd niġġes l-ilma biż-żebgħa; se nġib ilma nadif.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is the water in this bucket dirty? Toni: Someone contaminated the water with paint; I'll get clean water.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个桶里的水怎么脏了？托尼：有人把油漆弄进水里了，我去拿干净的水。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 这个桶里的水怎么脏了？
messages.en: Why is the water in this bucket dirty?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd niġġes l-ilma biż-żebgħa; se nġib ilma nadif.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd niġġes l-ilma biż-żebgħa; se nġib ilma nadif.
messages.zh: 有人把油漆弄进水里了，我去拿干净的水。
messages.en: Someone contaminated the water with paint; I'll get clean water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 niġġes 时想一桶清水被倒入油漆，抓住“使原本干净的东西变脏”；饮食戒律义另作语境卡片。

gloss_zh: 下去；下降；被记下或登记

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move down to a lower place or level; also used for a decrease in value or for something being recorded.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向较低的位置移动或下降；也可表示价值降低，或某事被记下、登记。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imur lejn post jew livell aktar baxx; jintuża wkoll għal valur li jonqos jew għal xi ħaġa li tidħol f'rekord.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 下去；向较低处移动。
被写下；被记录下来。
下降；向下移动。
下降；下去。
贬值；价值降低。
被登记；被录入名册或记录。
理解并跟上论证或推理的思路。

formal.mt: Il-livell tal-ilma niżel wara li waqfet ix-xita.
formal.en: The water level fell after the rain stopped.
formal.zh: 雨停之后，水位下降了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu Pawlu? Mark: Niżel fil-bitħa biex jistenna lil ħuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Pawlu? Mark: He went down to the courtyard to wait for his brother.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu在哪儿？Mark：他下到院子里等他兄弟去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Niżel fil-bitħa biex jistenna lil ħuh.
messages.mt_standard: Niżel fil-bitħa biex jistenna lil ħuh.
messages.zh: 他下到院子里等他兄弟去了。
messages.en: He went down to the courtyard to wait for his brother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象一个人沿楼梯往下走，再把同一个向下箭头放到水位和价值旁边，帮助记住主要用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A downward slope or a descent from a higher place to a lower one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从高处通向低处的坡道，或沿着坡道向下行进的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Triq jew art li twassal minn post għoli għal wieħed aktar baxx, jew il-mixja 'l isfel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 山坡；坡地。
下行；下坡；斜坡。

collocations.en: at the end of the downward slope

formal.mt: Is-sewwieqa għandhom inaqqsu l-veloċità f'din in-niżla.
formal.en: Drivers should reduce their speed on this downward slope.
formal.zh: 驾驶员应在这段下坡路上减速。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din in-niżla wieqfa ħafna. Toni: Ejja nimxu bil-mod biex ma niżolqux.
colloquial.en: Lara: This slope is very steep. Toni: Let's walk slowly so we don't slip.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这段下坡很陡。Toni：我们慢慢走，免得滑倒。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这段下坡很陡。
messages.en: This slope is very steep.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nimxu bil-mod biex ma niżolqux.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nimxu bil-mod biex ma niżolqux.
messages.zh: 我们慢慢走，免得滑倒。
messages.en: Let's walk slowly so we don't slip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词画成一段向下倾斜的路，旁边写上“下坡慢走”，用道路画面记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bring or move something down, to record someone's details, or to download a digital file.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物向下移动或降低；也可表示登记资料，或下载数字文件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib jew iqiegħed xi ħaġa aktar 'l isfel, jirreġistra d-dettalji ta' xi ħadd, jew jieħu fajl mill-internet fuq apparat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使下来；把某人或某物带到较低处。
放低；降低；使下降。
贬低；使地位或等级降低。
登记；记录姓名或其他资料。
签名；签署。
犹豫不决；尚未作出决定。
下载；将数字文件传输到本地设备。

formal.mt: L-istudent niżżel il-formola mis-sit tal-iskola u mela d-dettalji kollha.
formal.en: The student downloaded the form from the school's website and filled in all the details.
formal.zh: 学生从学校网站下载了表格，并填写了全部资料。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif nista' naqra r-rapport? Mark: Niżżel il-fajl; tista' taqrah fuq it-telefon.
colloquial.en: Sara: How can I read the report? Mark: Download the file; you can read it on your phone.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我怎样才能读到报告？Mark：把文件下载下来，就能在手机上读。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 我怎样才能读到报告？
messages.en: How can I read the report?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Niżżel il-fajl; tista' taqrah fuq it-telefon.
messages.mt_standard: Niżżel il-fajl; tista' taqrah fuq it-telefon.
messages.zh: 把文件下载下来，就能在手机上读。
messages.en: Download the file; you can read it on your phone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手把物品放低，再把电脑下载按钮画成向下箭头；用两幅画面串起“放下、降低、下载”。

gloss_zh: 爱逗弄人的；惹人烦的；带恶意的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to tease or annoy others, sometimes in a deliberately spiteful way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 爱逗弄或招惹别人、使人烦恼的，有时含有故意使坏的意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħobb jinki jew idejjaq lil ħaddieħor, kultant b'intenzjoni ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱逗弄人的；喜欢招惹别人的。
令人烦恼的；惹人厌烦的。

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to tease or annoy, spiteful
sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱逗弄或烦扰别人的；怀有恶意、故意使坏的。

collocations.zh: 带恶意或惹人烦的评论

collocations.en: a boy who likes teasing others

formal.mt: Il-kumment nkejjuż tiegħu ħoloq tensjoni waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: His spiteful comment created tension during the meeting.
formal.zh: 他那句带恶意的评论使会议气氛紧张起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu llum qed ikun nkejjuż. Lara: Għidlu jieqaf; iċ-ċajt għandu jkun pjaċevoli għal kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu is being annoying today. Lara: Tell him to stop; jokes should be enjoyable for everyone.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu今天总在招惹人。Lara：叫他停下来吧；开玩笑应该让大家都开心。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu今天总在招惹人。
messages.en: Pawlu is being annoying today.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għidlu jieqaf; iċ-ċajt għandu jkun pjaċevoli għal kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għidlu jieqaf; iċ-ċajt għandu jkun pjaċevoli għal kulħadd.
messages.zh: 叫他停下来吧；开玩笑应该让大家都开心。
messages.en: Tell him to stop; jokes should be enjoyable for everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人不断拿别人开玩笑，直到对方皱眉；把这个词贴在“逗弄过头惹人烦”的场景旁。

gloss_zh: 破裂；损坏；受到冷落；陷入窘境

teaching_sense.en_definition: To break or become damaged; also used of a person who is snubbed, embarrassed, or reduced to poverty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 破裂或损坏；用于人时，也可表示受到冷落、感到难堪或变得贫困。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqasam jew issirlu ħsara; dwar persuna, jista' jfisser ukoll li ġiet imwarrba, ħasset mistħija jew saret fqira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破裂；折断；损坏。
受到冷落；被怠慢或无礼地拒绝。
感到尴尬；陷入难堪的处境。
变得贫穷；陷入贫困。

formal.mt: Il-ħġieġ tat-tieqa nkiser waqt il-maltemp.
formal.en: The window glass broke during the storm.
formal.zh: 窗玻璃在暴风雨中破裂了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ma nistgħux nużaw dan is-siġġu? Toni: Għax nkiser. Se nġib siġġu ieħor.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why can't we use this chair? Toni: Because it broke. I'll get another chair.
colloquial.zh: Sara：为什么这把椅子不能用？Toni：因为它坏了。我去拿另一把。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistgħux nużaw dan is-siġġu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistgħux nużaw dan is-siġġu?
messages.zh: 为什么这把椅子不能用？
messages.en: Why can't we use this chair?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax nkiser. Se nġib siġġu ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Għax nkiser. Se nġib siġġu ieħor.
messages.zh: 因为它坏了。我去拿另一把。
messages.en: Because it broke. I'll get another chair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用碎玻璃记住“破裂”，再用受冷落的人记住人物义；遇到这个词先判断主语是物还是人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be written or recorded, or to enrol oneself or be enrolled in a course or group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被写下或记录；也可表示自行报名，或被登记加入课程、团体等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi miktub jew irreġistrat; jista' wkoll ifisser li xi ħadd daħal f'kors jew fi grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被写下；被撰写。
自行报名；登记参加。
被登记入学、入会或参加课程。
动词 kiteb（写）的中间被动态形式，表示被写下或登记等。
被登记；被录入名册或记录。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport nkiteb b'lingwa ċara biex il-qarrejja jifhmu r-riżultati.
formal.en: The report was written in clear language so that readers could understand the results.
formal.zh: 报告采用清晰的语言撰写，以便读者理解结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu nkiteb fil-kors tal-Malti? Mark: Iva, u l-ewwel lezzjoni tiegħu hi nhar it-Tnejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu enrol in the Maltese course? Mark: Yes, and his first lesson is on Monday.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu报名参加马耳他语课程了吗？Mark：报了，他的第一节课在星期一。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: Pawlu报名参加马耳他语课程了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu enrol in the Maltese course?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u l-ewwel lezzjoni tiegħu hi nhar it-Tnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u l-ewwel lezzjoni tiegħu hi nhar it-Tnejn.
messages.zh: 报了，他的第一节课在星期一。
messages.en: Yes, and his first lesson is on Monday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象纸上出现一段文字，再想象报名册上出现一个姓名；用“文字被写下、姓名被登记”连接两种用法。

gloss_zh: 一半；中间；一种容量单位

teaching_sense.en_definition: One of two equal parts of something, or the middle of something; also a volume measure whose size depends on the liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物两个相等部分中的一个，或某物的中间位置；也用作容量单位，具体容量随液体种类而定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda minn żewġ partijiet indaqs ta' xi ħaġa, jew il-parti tan-nofs; ukoll kejl ta' volum li jvarja skont il-likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一半；二分之一。
中间；中央。

sense_translations.en_definition: half (one of two parts, especially when equal)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一半，指两个部分中的一个，尤其指两个相等部分之一。

sense_translations.en_definition: middle (area where two equal halves meet)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 中间，即两个相等部分相接的区域。
一种容量单位，具体数值取决于所计量的液体。

sense_translations.en_definition: for spirits, equivalent to 2 terz, that is officially one imperial pint (568.3 mL).
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于烈酒时，等于两个 terz，正式容量为一英制品脱，即568.3毫升。

sense_translations.en_definition: for milk and oil, equivalent to 2 terz, that is officially 22+¹⁄₂ imperial fluid ounces (639.3 mL).
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于牛奶和油时，等于两个 terz，正式容量为22又二分之一英制液体盎司，即639.3毫升。

formal.mt: Nofs il-baġit ġie allokat għat-tiswija tal-bini.
formal.en: Half of the budget was allocated to repairing the building.
formal.zh: 预算的一半被分配用于修缮建筑。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tista' taqsam il-ħobża? Toni: Iva, nofs għalik u nofs għalija.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you divide the loaf? Toni: Yes, half for you and half for me.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你能把这条面包分一下吗？Toni：可以，一半给你，一半给我。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你能把这条面包分一下吗？
messages.en: Can you divide the loaf?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nofs għalik u nofs għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nofs għalik u nofs għalija.
messages.zh: 可以，一半给你，一半给我。
messages.en: Yes, half for you and half for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个圆并从中央平分：涂色的一边提示“一半”，分界位置提示“中间”；容量义另按液体种类记数值。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Twelve o'clock at night, the point when one calendar day ends and the next begins.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 夜间十二点，即一个日历日结束、下一个日历日开始的时刻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tnax ta' billejl, il-ħin meta tintemm ġurnata u tibda oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 午夜；半夜十二点。

formal.mt: Il-perjodu tar-reġistrazzjoni jintemm f'nofsillejl.
formal.en: The registration period ends at midnight.
formal.zh: 报名期限于午夜结束。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ħin tasal id-dar? Mark: Naħseb li nasal għall-ħabta ta' nofsillejl.
colloquial.en: Maja: What time will you get home? Mark: I think I'll get home around midnight.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你几点到家？Mark：我想大约午夜到家。

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你几点到家？
messages.en: What time will you get home?

messages.speaker: Mark (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li nasal għall-ħabta ta' nofsillejl.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li nasal għall-ħabta ta' nofsillejl.
messages.zh: 我想大约午夜到家。
messages.en: I think I'll get home around midnight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与电子钟的00:00绑定：日期刚翻到下一天，就是午夜；再配对记住“直到午夜”和“午夜之后”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The direction south, or the time around twelve o'clock in the middle of the day.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指南方这一方向，也指一天中十二点左右的正午或中午时段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-direzzjoni opposta għat-tramuntana, jew il-ħin ta' madwar it-tnax ta' ġurnata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 南；南方。
正午；中午十二点。
中午；一天中接近正午的时段。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa tibda f'nofsinhar f'uffiċċju fin-nofsinhar ta' Malta.
formal.en: The meeting starts at noon in an office in the south of Malta.
formal.zh: 会议于正午在马耳他南部的一间办公室开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta niltaqgħu għall-ikel? Mark: F'nofsinhar, ħdejn il-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Maja: When shall we meet for lunch? Mark: At noon, near the square.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们什么时候碰面吃午饭？马克：中午十二点，在广场附近。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们什么时候碰面吃午饭？
messages.en: When shall we meet for lunch?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 中午十二点，在广场附近。
messages.en: At noon, near the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上两幅学习图：指南针上的“南”和时钟上的“十二点”。看到方向语境想南方，看到见面时间想正午。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small curved or spiral shape, especially a lock of hair that curls.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 弯曲或呈螺旋状的小卷儿，尤其指一绺卷曲的头发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma żgħira mdawra, speċjalment troffa xagħar li titgħawweġ f'ċirku jew spirali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卷儿；弯曲或呈螺旋状的部分。
一绺卷发；卷曲的一小束头发。

collocations.zh: 一个小卷儿；一绺小卷发

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt, it-tifla għandha nokkla żgħira fuq il-ġbin.
formal.en: In the photograph, the girl has a small curl on her forehead.
formal.zh: 照片中的女孩额头上有一绺小卷发。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din in-nokkla dejjem tiġi quddiem għajnejja! Maja: Trid pinzetta biex iżżommha f'postha?
colloquial.en: Sara: This curl keeps falling in front of my eyes! Maja: Would you like a hair clip to hold it in place?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这绺卷发老是垂到我眼前！玛雅：要不要一个发夹把它固定住？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din in-nokkla dejjem tiġi quddiem għajnejja!
messages.mt_standard: Din in-nokkla dejjem tiġi quddiem għajnejja!
messages.zh: 这绺卷发老是垂到我眼前！
messages.en: This curl keeps falling in front of my eyes!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 要不要一个发夹把它固定住？
messages.en: Would you like a hair clip to hold it in place?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象额头前一绺打着小圈的头发，把 nokkla 和这幅“卷发小圈”图绑定；重点记住它可以指单独的一绺卷发。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A word that names a person, animal, place, thing, or idea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示人、动物、地点、事物或概念名称的一类词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li ssemmi persuna, annimal, post, ħaġa jew idea.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 名词，词类之一，用来表示人、事物、地点或概念等。
名词；表示名称的一类词。

formal.mt: Fis-sentenza 'It-tifel jaqra', il-kelma 'tifel' hija nom.
formal.en: In the sentence 'The boy reads', the word 'boy' is a noun.
formal.zh: 在“It-tifel jaqra”（男孩读书）这个句子中，“tifel”（男孩）是名词。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kelma 'mejda' hija nom? Pawlu: Iva, għax issemmi ħaġa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the word 'mejda' a noun? Pawlu: Yes, because it names a thing.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：“mejda”（桌子）这个词是名词吗？保罗：是的，因为它表示一种事物的名称。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: “mejda”（桌子）这个词是名词吗？
messages.en: Is the word 'mejda' a noun?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.zh: 是的，因为它表示一种事物的名称。
messages.en: Yes, because it names a thing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nom 写在“人、地点、东西、想法”四个格子的上方，当作它们共同的词类标签：这些名称通常属于名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The formal proposal of someone as a candidate for an award, position, or role.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式提出某人作为奖项、职位或职务候选人的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proposta formali ta' persuna bħala kandidata għal premju, kariga jew rwol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提名；正式提出某人为奖项或职位的候选人。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ħabbar in-nominazzjoni tal-għalliem għall-premju.
formal.en: The committee announced the teacher's nomination for the award.
formal.zh: 委员会宣布了该教师获得这一奖项提名的消息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt bin-nominazzjoni ta' Sara għall-premju? Mark: Iva! Ninsab ferħan ħafna għaliha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you heard about Sara's nomination for the award? Mark: Yes! I'm very happy for her.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听说萨拉获得那个奖项的提名了吗？马克：听说了！我真替她高兴。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听说萨拉获得那个奖项的提名了吗？
messages.en: Have you heard about Sara's nomination for the award?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 听说了！我真替她高兴。
messages.en: Yes! I'm very happy for her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象候选名单上刚添上一个名字，旁边写着 nominazzjoni。记住“进入候选名单”这个画面，提名之后才可能获奖或当选。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Usual, expected, or within the ordinary range for a particular situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某种情况下属于通常、预期或正常范围的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun bħas-soltu, mistenni jew fil-limiti tas-soltu f'sitwazzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正常的；符合通常状态或预期的。
正常的；通常的；平常的。

formal.mt: Wara t-tiswija, il-magna reġgħet bdiet taħdem b'mod normali.
formal.en: After the repair, the machine began operating normally again.
formal.zh: 维修后，机器重新开始正常运转。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Huwa normali li din il-magna tagħmel ftit ħoss? Rita: Iva, dan il-ħoss huwa normali meta tkun qed taħdem.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is it normal for this machine to make a little noise? Rita: Yes, this sound is normal when it is running.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这台机器发出一点声音正常吗？丽塔：正常，它运转时会有这种声音。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa normali li din il-magna tagħmel ftit ħoss?
messages.mt_standard: Huwa normali li din il-magna tagħmel ftit ħoss?
messages.zh: 这台机器发出一点声音正常吗？
messages.en: Is it normal for this machine to make a little noise?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan il-ħoss huwa normali meta tkun qed taħdem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan il-ħoss huwa normali meta tkun qed taħdem.
messages.zh: 正常，它运转时会有这种声音。
messages.en: Yes, this sound is normal when it is running.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“这是正常的吗？”这句常用问话记住 normali：它给人、事物或情况贴上“正常、平常”的性质标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Usually, or in the ordinary course of events.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常如此；在一般情况或日常惯例下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bħas-soltu jew fil-biċċa l-kbira tal-każijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通常；一般情况下。
通常；平常；一般而言。

collocations.en: there is usually; there are usually

formal.mt: Il-librerija normalment tiftaħ fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The library usually opens at nine in the morning.
formal.zh: 图书馆通常在上午九点开门。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif tmur għax-xogħol? Mark: Normalment immur bil-karozza tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Sara: How do you get to work? Mark: I usually go by bus.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你怎么去上班？马克：我通常坐公交车去。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你怎么去上班？
messages.en: How do you get to work?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 我通常坐公交车去。
messages.en: I usually go by bus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一周日程表中多数天都画着公交车：normalment 表示“通常如此”。把它放进“我通常……”的句框中反复练习。

gloss_zh: 挪威的；来自挪威的；挪威语

teaching_sense.en_definition: From Norway, or relating to Norway, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自挪威的，或与挪威、挪威人民及其文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej min-Norveġja jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-pajjiż, man-nies jew mal-kultura tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挪威的；挪威人的；与挪威有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or pertaining to Norway
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自挪威的；属于挪威或与挪威有关的。
挪威语。

formal.mt: L-awtur Norveġiż ippreżenta l-ktieb tiegħu waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The Norwegian author presented his book during the meeting.
formal.zh: 这位挪威作家在会上介绍了自己的书。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-film huwa Norveġiż? Mark: Iva, u d-djalogu huwa bin-Norveġiż.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this film Norwegian? Mark: Yes, and the dialogue is in Norwegian.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是一部挪威电影吗？马克：是的，对白也是挪威语。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是一部挪威电影吗？
messages.en: Is this film Norwegian?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，对白也是挪威语。
messages.en: Yes, and the dialogue is in Norwegian.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一部贴着挪威国旗的电影：电影来源可用形容词 Norveġiż，影片使用的语言可叫 in-Norveġiż。用“来自哪里”和“说什么语言”区分两种词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: November, the eleventh month of the year.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 十一月，一年中的第十一个月。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħdax-il xahar tas-sena, bejn Ottubru u Diċembru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 十一月，月份专名。
十一月；一年中的第十一个月。

formal.mt: Il-kors il-ġdid jibda fit-3 ta' Novembru.
formal.en: The new course begins on 3 November.
formal.zh: 新课程于十一月三日开始。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Meta se tiġi żżurna? Maja: F'Novembru, fil-bidu tax-xahar.
colloquial.en: Lara: When are you coming to visit us? Maja: In November, at the beginning of the month.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你什么时候来看我们？玛雅：十一月，月初的时候。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你什么时候来看我们？
messages.en: When are you coming to visit us?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 十一月，月初的时候。
messages.en: In November, at the beginning of the month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历第十一页写上 Novembru，并把“在十一月”整块记作 f'Novembru；再配合月初、月底两个搭配练习约时间。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be read by someone, or to be clear enough for someone to read.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指文字、文章等被人阅读，也可指字迹清楚、能够辨认。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta test jinqara minn xi ħadd, jew meta l-kitba tkun ċara biżżejjed biex wieħed jaqraha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被阅读；被读出。
字迹可辨认；文字能够看清并读懂。
qara 的中间被动形式，表示被读或能够被读。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport nqara b'leħen għoli waqt il-laqgħa tal-kumitat.
formal.en: The report was read aloud during the committee meeting.
formal.zh: 这份报告在委员会会议上被大声宣读。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-messaġġ ta' Mark nqara fil-klassi? Lara: Iva, l-għalliema qrat il-messaġġ kollu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was Mark's message read in class? Lara: Yes, the teacher read the whole message.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 的留言在课堂上读过了吗？Lara：读过了，老师把整段留言都读了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: Mark 的留言在课堂上读过了吗？
messages.en: Was Mark's message read in class?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 读过了，老师把整段留言都读了。
messages.en: Yes, the teacher read the whole message.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象报告被老师拿起来朗读：关注的是文字被读。再想象模糊字迹终于能辨认，把两个义项连在一起记。

gloss_zh: 被掐；被刺痛；感到受伤或不满

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be pinched physically, or to feel hurt or resentful because of someone's words or actions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指身体被掐，也可指因别人的言语或行为而受到伤害、心生不满。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta xi ħadd joqros lil persuna, jew meta persuna tħossha mweġġgħa jew offiża minħabba kliem jew għemil ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被掐；被捏痛。
被人说了伤人的话；受到言语刺伤。
qaras 的中间被动形式，表示被掐或受到刺痛。
感到受伤；因受到冒犯而心生不满或怨意。

formal.mt: It-tifel nqaras f'dirgħajh waqt il-logħob u mar jgħid lill-għalliema.
formal.en: The boy was pinched on his arm during play and went to tell the teacher.
formal.zh: 男孩玩耍时胳膊被掐了，便去告诉老师。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark ma jridx ikellimni? Pawlu: Nqaras b'dak li għedtlu lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why doesn't Mark want to talk to me? Pawlu: He was hurt by what you told him yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark 为什么不愿意跟我说话？Pawlu：你昨天对他说的话伤到他了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 为什么不愿意跟我说话？
messages.en: Why doesn't Mark want to talk to me?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 你昨天对他说的话伤到他了。
messages.en: He was hurt by what you told him yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把身体被掐的一阵痛，与听到伤人话时心里的一阵刺痛并排想象，帮助记住身体和情绪两个用法。

gloss_zh: 被杀死；被工作等压得筋疲力尽

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be killed, or figuratively to become exhausted or overwhelmed by work or another burden.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被杀死，也可作比喻，表示被工作或其他负担压得筋疲力尽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta xi ħadd jitlef ħajtu għax jinqatel, jew, b'mod figurattiv, meta xogħol jew piż ieħor jgħejjih ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被杀死；遭杀害。
被某种负担压倒，例如工作过多而精疲力竭。
qatel 的中间被动形式，表示被杀死，也可用于被负担压垮的比喻。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddikjara li raġel nqatel fl-attakk.
formal.en: The report states that a man was killed in the attack.
formal.zh: 报告指出，一名男子在袭击中被杀害。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu ġej magħna llejla? Lara: Le, illum nqatel bix-xogħol u jrid jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Pawlu coming with us tonight? Lara: No, he was worn out by work today and wants to rest.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 今晚跟我们一起去吗？Lara：不去了，他今天工作累垮了，想休息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 今晚跟我们一起去吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu coming with us tonight?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, illum nqatel bix-xogħol u jrid jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Le, illum nqatel bix-xogħol u jrid jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 不去了，他今天工作累垮了，想休息。
messages.en: No, he was worn out by work today and wants to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景区分：新闻里的被杀死，以及朋友抱怨工作累死了。看到工作搭配时，联想到夸张表达疲惫。

gloss_zh: 被煎炸；陷入窘境；被骗；热得难受

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be fried in hot fat or oil; figuratively, to be placed in an awkward situation, cheated, or made to feel extremely hot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指食物被油煎或油炸；也可比喻陷入窘境、遭到欺骗，或感到酷热难耐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta ikel jissajjar fiż-żejt jew fix-xaħam jaħraq; b'mod figurattiv, meta xi ħadd jitqiegħed f'sitwazzjoni skomda, jiġi mqarraq, jew iħoss ħafna sħana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被油煎；被油炸。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be put in an awkward situation
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被置于尴尬或难以应付的处境。
遭到诈骗；被人骗取钱财。
感到非常热；热得难受。
qela 的中间被动形式，基本表示被煎炸，也有相关比喻用法。
受到欺骗；被人耍弄或占便宜。

collocations.en: felt extremely hot in the sun

formal.mt: Il-ħut nqela fiż-żejt jaħraq u ġie servut mal-ħaxix.
formal.en: The fish was fried in hot oil and served with vegetables.
formal.zh: 鱼用热油煎好后，配蔬菜上桌。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark daħal ġewwa? Pawlu: Nqela fix-xemx; mar jixrob ftit ilma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark go inside? Pawlu: He got terribly hot in the sun; he went to drink some water.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark 为什么进屋了？Pawlu：他在太阳下热坏了，去喝点水。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 为什么进屋了？
messages.en: Why did Mark go inside?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nqela fix-xemx; mar jixrob ftit ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Nqela fix-xemx; mar jixrob ftit ilma.
messages.zh: 他在太阳下热坏了，去喝点水。
messages.en: He got terribly hot in the sun; he went to drink some water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 以油锅煎炸为记忆画面，再分别贴上酷热、窘境、被骗三张标签。这是串联义项的学习联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 被毁灭；败落；疲惫不堪；自毁

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be destroyed or fall into ruin; also to become thoroughly worn out or bring ruin upon oneself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被毁坏、走向败落，也可表示被某事折腾得疲惫不堪，或使自己走向毁灭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta xi ħaġa tinqered jew tispiċċa f'rovina; ukoll meta persuna tgħejja ħafna minħabba xi ħaġa jew twassal lilha nnifisha għall-qerda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被摧毁；被毁灭。

sense_translations.en_definition: to feel worn out by sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因某事感到精疲力竭；被某事折腾得疲惫不堪。
qered 的中间被动形式，表示遭到毁坏或进入毁坏的状态。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be destroyed, to go to ruin
sense_translations.zh_definition: 遭到毁灭；逐渐败落或沦为废墟。
毁掉自己；使自身陷入毁灭或败落。

collocations.en: was completely worn out by work
collocations.zh: 被工作折腾得筋疲力尽

formal.mt: Il-maħżen nqered bin-nar, iżda ħadd ma weġġa'.
formal.en: The warehouse was destroyed by fire, but nobody was injured.
formal.zh: 仓库被大火烧毁，但无人受伤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark għadu se joħroġ magħna? Lara: Le, nqered bix-xogħol illum u mar jorqod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Mark still going out with us? Lara: No, he was completely worn out by work today and went to bed.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 还打算跟我们出去吗？Lara：不了，他今天工作累得筋疲力尽，已经去睡了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 还打算跟我们出去吗？
messages.en: Is Mark still going out with us?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nqered bix-xogħol illum u mar jorqod.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nqered bix-xogħol illum u mar jorqod.
messages.zh: 不了，他今天工作累得筋疲力尽，已经去睡了。
messages.en: No, he was completely worn out by work today and went to bed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排记三幅图：建筑被毁、一个人累瘫、一个人因自身行为走向败落。用具体语境分清毁坏、疲惫和自毁。

gloss_zh: 被找到；发现自己处于某种状态

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be found, or to find oneself in a particular situation or state of mind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指人或物被找到，也可指发现自己处于某种境况或心理状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta persuna jew oġġett jinstab, jew meta persuna ssib ruħha f'ċerta sitwazzjoni jew fi stat ta' ħsieb jew ta' emozzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被找到；被发现。

sense_translations.en_definition: to find oneself (to be in a particular state of mind)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发现自己处于某种心理状态；身处某种心境。

collocations.en: found himself in a state of confusion

formal.mt: Id-dokument nieqes nsab fil-kexxun tal-iskrivanija.
formal.en: The missing document was found in the desk drawer.
formal.zh: 遗失的文件在书桌抽屉里被找到了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-passaport ta' Mark għadu nieqes? Lara: Le, nsab fil-borża tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Mark's passport still missing? Lara: No, it was found in his bag.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 的护照还没找到吗？Lara：已经找到了，就在他的包里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 的护照还没找到吗？
messages.en: Is Mark's passport still missing?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 已经找到了，就在他的包里。
messages.en: No, it was found in his bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想护照被找到，再想发现自己心里很困惑：一个定位物品，一个定位自己的心理状态，借此区分两个义项。

gloss_zh: 被迷住；受到魔法影响；中了魔咒

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be enchanted or captivated, either figuratively by something appealing or literally through magic or a spell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被美好或吸引人的事物迷住，也可指在故事等语境中受到魔法影响、中了魔咒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta persuna tkun affaxxinata ħafna b'xi ħaġa sabiħa jew attraenti, jew meta tkun taħt l-effett ta' maġija jew ta' seħer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被迷住；受到吸引而陶醉。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be under the influence of magic
sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到魔法的影响或支配。
中了魔咒；处于咒术作用之下。

collocations.en: was put under a spell by a witch

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-prinċep nseħer minn saħħara u ma setax jitlaq mill-kastell.
formal.en: In the story, the prince was put under a spell by a witch and could not leave the castle.
formal.zh: 故事中，王子被女巫施了魔咒，无法离开城堡。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark ħa gost fil-kunċert? Pawlu: Iva, nseħer bil-mużika u baqa' sal-aħħar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Mark enjoy the concert? Pawlu: Yes, he was enchanted by the music and stayed until the end.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark 喜欢这场音乐会吗？Pawlu：喜欢，他被音乐迷住了，一直待到结束。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 喜欢这场音乐会吗？
messages.en: Did Mark enjoy the concert?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nseħer bil-mużika u baqa' sal-aħħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nseħer bil-mużika u baqa' sal-aħħar.
messages.zh: 喜欢，他被音乐迷住了，一直待到结束。
messages.en: Yes, he was enchanted by the music and stayed until the end.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把听音乐听得入迷，想象成仿佛中了魔咒；现实中的陶醉与故事里的魔法分别对应比喻义和字面义。

gloss_zh: 被诅咒；惊呆；被强烈感受压倒

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be cursed, or to become dumbfounded or overwhelmed by a powerful experience or emotion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指受到诅咒，也可指因强烈的经历或情绪而惊呆、说不出话，或一时难以承受。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta persuna tiġi misħuta, jew meta tibqa' bla kliem jew tħossha maħkuma minn esperjenza jew emozzjoni qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被诅咒；受到咒骂或诅咒。
惊呆；因震惊而一时说不出话。
被强烈的情绪或经历压倒；一时难以承受或应对。

formal.mt: Fil-ħrafa, ir-re nseħet minn saħħara wara li kiser il-wegħda tiegħu.
formal.en: In the fairy tale, the king was cursed by a witch after breaking his promise.
formal.zh: 童话中，国王违背承诺后遭到了女巫的诅咒。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qal Mark meta sema' li rebaħ? Lara: Nseħet bl-aħbar; għall-ewwel ma qal xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Mark say when he heard he had won? Lara: He was dumbfounded by the news; at first he said nothing.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 听说自己赢了以后说了什么？Lara：他听到消息都惊呆了，起初什么也没说。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qal Mark meta sema' li rebaħ?
messages.mt_standard: X'qal Mark meta sema' li rebaħ?
messages.zh: Mark 听说自己赢了以后说了什么？
messages.en: What did Mark say when he heard he had won?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nseħet bl-aħbar; għall-ewwel ma qal xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Nseħet bl-aħbar; għall-ewwel ma qal xejn.
messages.zh: 他听到消息都惊呆了，起初什么也没说。
messages.en: He was dumbfounded by the news; at first he said nothing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住童话中被诅咒的人，再联想到现实中听到重大消息后愣住的人；用场景区分诅咒、惊呆与情绪压倒。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become very thin and gaunt, or to be emaciated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得十分消瘦、面容憔悴，或处于骨瘦如柴的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir irqiq ħafna u jidher magħlub, jew ikun f'din il-qagħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得消瘦而憔悴。
极度消瘦；骨瘦如柴。

collocations.zh: 因饥饿而瘦得不成样子

formal.mt: Matul il-marda twila, ir-raġel nsikem u tilef ħafna mill-qawwa tiegħu.
formal.en: During the long illness, the man became gaunt and lost much of his strength.
formal.zh: 在长期患病期间，那名男子变得消瘦憔悴，体力也大不如前。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu Pawlu wara l-marda? Rita: Għadu dgħajjef; nsikem ħafna, imma issa qed jiekol aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is Pawlu after his illness? Rita: He is still weak; he became very gaunt, but now he is eating better.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗病后怎么样了？丽塔：他还很虚弱，瘦了很多，不过现在吃得好些了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗病后怎么样了？
messages.en: How is Pawlu after his illness?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu dgħajjef; nsikem ħafna, imma issa qed jiekol aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu dgħajjef; nsikem ħafna, imma issa qed jiekol aħjar.
messages.zh: 他还很虚弱，瘦了很多，不过现在吃得好些了。
messages.en: He is still weak; he became very gaunt, but now he is eating better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与病后衣服变宽、脸颊凹陷的画面联系起来，记住它表示明显消瘦或憔悴。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be extracted or drawn out of something, or to be made thin by drawing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从某物中被提取、抽出或拉出，也可指经拉伸而变细。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinħareġ jew jinġibed minn xi ħaġa, jew isir irqiq billi jinġibed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被提取；被取出。
被抽出；被拉出来。
silet 的中间被动态，表示某物被抽取、拉出或拉细。
被弄细；被拉细。
被拉出或拉伸。

collocations.en: was pulled out of the ground

formal.mt: Dan il-pass nsilet minn ktieb dwar l-istorja tal-belt.
formal.en: This passage was extracted from a book about the history of the city.
formal.zh: 这段文字摘自一本介绍该城市历史的书。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Minn fejn ġie dan it-test? Lara: Nsilet minn ktieb li għandna fil-librerija.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where did this text come from? Lara: It was extracted from a book we have in the library.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这段文字是从哪里来的？拉拉：是从我们图书馆里的一本书中摘录的。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 这段文字是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where did this text come from?

messages.speaker: Lara (图书管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Nsilet minn ktieb li għandna fil-librerija.
messages.mt_standard: Nsilet minn ktieb li għandna fil-librerija.
messages.zh: 是从我们图书馆里的一本书中摘录的。
messages.en: It was extracted from a book we have in the library.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象从书里抽出一段文字，再联想到把材料拉长拉细；用这两个画面记住抽取与拉伸义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become deaf; in another sense, to become excited or upset.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得耳聋；在另一义项中，指变得激动、烦乱或恼怒。
