teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir trux; f'tifsira oħra, jitqanqal ħafna jew jitħawwad emozzjonalment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变聋；失去听觉。
感到激动、心烦或情绪不安。

formal.mt: Wara snin ta' xogħol fi storbju qawwi, il-ħaddiem ntarax.
formal.en: After years of working in loud noise, the worker became deaf.
formal.zh: 在强噪声环境中工作多年后，那名工人失去了听觉。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex kien qed jgħajjat Pawlu? Ben: Ntarax bir-rabja meta sema' x'ġara.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why was Pawlu shouting? Ben: He became extremely upset with anger when he heard what had happened.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗刚才为什么大喊？本：他听说发生的事后，气得情绪激动。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗刚才为什么大喊？
messages.en: Why was Pawlu shouting?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 他听说发生的事后，气得情绪激动。
messages.en: He became extremely upset with anger when he heard what had happened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张情境卡记忆：一张是耳朵听不见，另一张是情绪很激动；读句子时靠上下文分辨。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sit down or remain seated somewhere, or to stay in a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某处坐下、坐着，或留在某个地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joqgħod bilqiegħda f'xi post jew jibqa' hemm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某个地方坐下。
待在某处；停留在某地。
坐着；坐下。

formal.mt: Il-viżitatur ntasab fuq bank fil-bitħa u stenna sakemm wasal il-ħin tal-laqgħa.
formal.en: The visitor sat down on a bench in the courtyard and waited until it was time for the meeting.
formal.zh: 来访者在院子里的长椅上坐下，等候会议开始。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hu n-nannu? Mark: Ntasab ħdejn it-tieqa u qed jaqra l-gazzetta.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is Grandpa? Mark: He sat down by the window and is reading the newspaper.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：爷爷在哪里？马克：他在窗边坐下了，正在看报纸。

messages.speaker: Nina (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Grandpa?

messages.speaker: Mark (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Ntasab ħdejn it-tieqa u qed jaqra l-gazzetta.
messages.mt_standard: Ntasab ħdejn it-tieqa u qed jaqra l-gazzetta.
messages.zh: 他在窗边坐下了，正在看报纸。
messages.en: He sat down by the window and is reading the newspaper.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象走累后找张长椅坐下，并继续待在那里；把坐下与停留连成同一幅生活画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To go out or be turned off, especially of a fire, light, or device; also to be eclipsed or lose colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指火焰或灯光熄灭、设备关闭；也可表示被遮蔽或失去颜色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieqaf jaqbad, jixgħel jew jaħdem; jista' wkoll jiġi mgħotti jew jitlef il-kulur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被熄灭；被扑灭。
关闭；停止亮起或运作。
被遮蔽；光芒被掩盖。
失去颜色；褪色。
tefa 的中间被动态，表示熄灭、被关闭等状态变化。

sense_translations.en_definition: to go out, to be extinguished (fire)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 指火熄灭或被扑灭。

sense_translations.en_definition: to go out, to be turned off (device)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 指设备停止运作或被关闭。

formal.mt: Il-kompjuter ntefa waqt il-laqgħa, u l-preżentazzjoni waqfet għal ftit minuti.
formal.en: The computer turned off during the meeting, and the presentation stopped for a few minutes.
formal.zh: 会议期间电脑关闭了，演示因此中断了几分钟。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex waqaft taqra? Mark: Id-dawl ntefa u ma stajtx nara l-paġna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you stop reading? Mark: The light went out and I couldn't see the page.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么不读了？马克：灯灭了，我看不清书页。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不读了？
messages.en: Why did you stop reading?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-dawl ntefa u ma stajtx nara l-paġna.
messages.mt_standard: Id-dawl ntefa u ma stajtx nara l-paġna.
messages.zh: 灯灭了，我看不清书页。
messages.en: The light went out and I couldn't see the page.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记灯灭、火灭、机器停下这三个画面，再把光芒被遮住和颜色变淡作为另外两个义项记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong or unpleasant smell; a stink.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 令人不快的气味，尤其指明显的臭味或恶臭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Riħa ħażina jew qawwija li ddejjaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 难闻的气味；臭味。
臭气；恶臭；难闻的气味。

formal.mt: Fil-kamra kien hemm ntiena qawwija ta' żibel, għalhekk infetħu t-twieqi.
formal.en: There was a strong stink of rubbish in the room, so the windows were opened.
formal.zh: 房间里有一股浓烈的垃圾臭味，因此窗户被打开了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhi din in-ntiena? Ben: Il-borża taż-żibel għadha hawn; noħroġha issa.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is that stink? Ben: The rubbish bag is still here; I'll take it out now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这是什么臭味？本：垃圾袋还在这里，我现在把它拿出去。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 这是什么臭味？
messages.en: What is that stink?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-borża taż-żibel għadha hawn; noħroġha issa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-borża taż-żibel għadha hawn; noħroġha issa.
messages.zh: 垃圾袋还在这里，我现在把它拿出去。
messages.en: The rubbish bag is still here; I'll take it out now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象闻到垃圾袋的气味后立刻捂住鼻子；这个词是名词，表示那股令人难受的臭味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become lost or go missing; also to lose self-control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指人迷路或物品丢失，也可指失去自我控制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma jibqax jaf fejn qiegħed jew ma jkunx jista' jinstab; jista' wkoll jitlef il-kontroll fuqu nnifsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 丢失；失踪；迷路。
tilef 的中间被动态，表示某人或某物处于丢失、迷失等状态。
失去自制力；情绪失控。

formal.mt: It-turist ntilef fit-toroq tal-belt u talab l-għajnuna biex jasal lura fil-lukanda.
formal.en: The tourist got lost in the city streets and asked for help getting back to the hotel.
formal.zh: 那名游客在城市街道中迷了路，请人帮助他返回酒店。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-mowbajl tiegħek? Pawlu: Ntilef; fittixt fil-borża u taħt is-sufan, imma ma sibtux.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is your mobile phone? Pawlu: It's gone missing; I looked in the bag and under the sofa, but I couldn't find it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的手机在哪里？保罗：丢了，我找了包里和沙发下面，可是没找到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的手机在哪里？
messages.en: Where is your mobile phone?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ntilef; fittixt fil-borża u taħt is-sufan, imma ma sibtux.
messages.mt_standard: Ntilef; fittixt fil-borża u taħt is-sufan, imma ma sibtux.
messages.zh: 丢了，我找了包里和沙发下面，可是没找到。
messages.en: It's gone missing; I looked in the bag and under the sofa, but I couldn't find it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把人找不到路、物品找不到位置、情绪失去控制分成三幅图，分别记住这个词的具体用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce a lot of nasal mucus or to have a very snotty nose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 流出大量鼻涕，或处于鼻涕很多的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu ħafna mukus ħiereġ minn imnieħru.

sense_translations.en_definition: to produce copious amounts of snot
sense_translations.zh_definition: 流出大量鼻涕。
鼻涕很多；鼻子挂着鼻涕。

collocations.en: had a snotty nose all day

formal.mt: It-tifel ntmaħat il-ġurnata kollha, u l-għalliema tatu pakkett imkatar tal-karti.
formal.en: The boy had a snotty nose all day, and the teacher gave him a packet of tissues.
formal.zh: 那个男孩一整天都在流鼻涕，老师给了他一包纸巾。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex għandek daqshekk imkatar tal-karti? Mark: It-tifel ntmaħat ħafna llum u kellu bżonnhom il-ħin kollu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why do you have so many tissues? Mark: The boy had a very snotty nose today and needed them all the time.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你怎么带着这么多纸巾？马克：孩子今天流了很多鼻涕，一直都要用。

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 你怎么带着这么多纸巾？
messages.en: Why do you have so many tissues?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tifel ntmaħat ħafna llum u kellu bżonnhom il-ħin kollu.
messages.mt_standard: It-tifel ntmaħat ħafna llum u kellu bżonnhom il-ħin kollu.
messages.zh: 孩子今天流了很多鼻涕，一直都要用。
messages.en: The boy had a very snotty nose today and needed them all the time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象孩子不停拿纸巾擦鼻子的场景；这里记的是鼻涕很多的身体状态，不是傲慢的性格。

gloss_zh: 放松；瘫软；任由自己倒下；听任摆布

teaching_sense.en_definition: To let oneself relax or go limp, lose bodily strength or tension, or surrender oneself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让自己放松或瘫软，身体失去力气或紧绷状态；也可指放弃抵抗、听任摆布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħalla lilu nnifsu jinħall jew jirtab, tilef is-saħħa jew it-tensjoni f'ġismu, jew ċeda lilu nnifsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放开自己；不再绷紧或控制自己。
放松下来；不再紧绷。
身体变得瘫软无力。
变得松弛；失去原有的紧绷状态。
感到虚弱；觉得身体没有力气。
放弃抵抗；把自己交由他人或某种力量支配。

formal.mt: Wara l-isforz, ir-raġel ntreħa fuq is-siġġu biex jistrieħ.
formal.en: After the exertion, the man slumped into the chair to rest.
formal.zh: 费力干完活后，那名男子瘫坐在椅子上休息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu ntreħa hekk fuq is-sufan? Lara: Għadu kif wasal minn mixja twila u hu għajjien ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu flop onto the sofa like that? Lara: He has just come back from a long walk and is very tired.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu怎么一下子瘫倒在沙发上了？Lara：他刚走了很长一段路回来，累坏了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu ntreħa hekk fuq is-sufan?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu ntreħa hekk fuq is-sufan?
messages.zh: Pawlu怎么一下子瘫倒在沙发上了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu flop onto the sofa like that?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu kif wasal minn mixja twila u hu għajjien ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu kif wasal minn mixja twila u hu għajjien ħafna.
messages.zh: 他刚走了很长一段路回来，累坏了。
messages.en: He has just come back from a long walk and is very tired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象走累后整个人瘫进椅子：从绷紧到松软，再联想到放弃抵抗，把这些义项串起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A human-shaped figure placed in a field or garden to frighten birds away from crops.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放在田地或菜园里、用来吓走鸟类以保护作物的人形假人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Figura f'għamla ta' bniedem li titqiegħed f'għalqa jew ġnien biex tbeżża' l-għasafar u żżommhom 'il bogħod mill-uċuħ tar-raba'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 稻草人；置于田间用来吓走鸟类的人形装置。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi poġġa nuffara f'nofs l-għalqa biex iżomm l-għasafar 'il bogħod miż-żrieragħ.
formal.en: The farmer placed a scarecrow in the middle of the field to keep birds away from the seeds.
formal.zh: 农民在田地中央放了一个稻草人，防止鸟来啄食种子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak wieqaf fl-għalqa? Nannu: Dik nuffara, magħmula minn ħwejjeġ qodma u tiben.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is that standing in the field? Grandfather: That is a scarecrow, made from old clothes and straw.
colloquial.zh: Lara：站在田里的那个人是谁？爷爷：那是个稻草人，用旧衣服和稻草做的。

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 站在田里的那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that standing in the field?

messages.speaker: Nannu (爷爷)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik nuffara, magħmula minn ħwejjeġ qodma u tiben.
messages.mt_standard: Dik nuffara, magħmula minn ħwejjeġ qodma u tiben.
messages.zh: 那是个稻草人，用旧衣服和稻草做的。
messages.en: That is a scarecrow, made from old clothes and straw.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给nuffara配一幅旧衣服套着稻草、站在田里赶鸟的画面，记住它是假人而非真正的农民。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small raised bubble on the skin containing fluid, often caused by rubbing or a burn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 皮肤上隆起、内部含有液体的小疱，常因摩擦或烫伤形成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bużżieqa żgħira mimlija b'likwidu li titla' fuq il-ġilda, spiss minħabba ħakk jew ħruq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水疱；皮肤上鼓起的含液小疱。
皮肤上的水疱，即表皮隆起形成的含液泡状结构。

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja twila, l-istudenta ndunat b'nuffata fuq għarqubha.
formal.en: After the long walk, the student noticed a blister on her heel.
formal.zh: 走了很长一段路后，这名女学生发现脚后跟起了一个水疱。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex qed timxi bil-mod? Lara: Għandi nuffata fuq sieqi; dawn iż-żraben ħakkuli l-ġilda.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why are you walking slowly? Lara: I have a blister on my foot; these shoes rubbed against my skin.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你怎么走得这么慢？Lara：我脚上起了个水疱，这双鞋把皮肤磨了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么走得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you walking slowly?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi nuffata fuq sieqi; dawn iż-żraben ħakkuli l-ġilda.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi nuffata fuq sieqi; dawn iż-żraben ħakkuli l-ġilda.
messages.zh: 我脚上起了个水疱，这双鞋把皮肤磨了。
messages.en: I have a blister on my foot; these shoes rubbed against my skin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用新鞋磨脚后鼓起透明小泡的画面记nuffata；再与田里的nuffara对照，注意词尾不同、意思不同。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The nuclear field, especially energy and technology involving atomic nuclei.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 核能或核技术领域，涉及原子核及其能量的利用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qasam tal-enerġija u t-teknoloġija li jinvolvi n-nuklei tal-atomi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 核；核能或核技术领域，按名词义项理解。
核的；与原子核、核能或核技术有关的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-użu tal-enerġija nukleari fil-produzzjoni tal-elettriku.
formal.en: The report describes the use of nuclear energy in electricity generation.
formal.zh: 这份报告介绍了核能在发电中的应用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq xiex kien id-dokumentarju? Pawlu: Fuq l-enerġija nukleari u kif jaħdem reattur nukleari.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was the documentary about? Pawlu: Nuclear energy and how a nuclear reactor works.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那部纪录片讲什么？Pawlu：讲核能，还有核反应堆如何运作。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 那部纪录片讲什么？
messages.en: What was the documentary about?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq l-enerġija nukleari u kif jaħdem reattur nukleari.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq l-enerġija nukleari u kif jaħdem reattur nukleari.
messages.zh: 讲核能，还有核反应堆如何运作。
messages.en: Nuclear energy and how a nuclear reactor works.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把nukleari与英语nuclear作词形对照，成组记“enerġija nukleari＝核能”，并留意名词与形容词标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An absence or insufficient amount of something, a felt need for what is missing, or a fault or wrongful act.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物的缺失或数量不足，也可指因缺失而感到的需要，或行为上的过失、冒犯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-assenza jew kwantità mhux biżżejjed ta' xi ħaġa, il-ħtieġa li tinħass għal dak li jonqos, jew żball jew għemil ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缺乏；某物不存在或不足。
因缺少某物或某人而感到的需要、缺失感。
冒犯或怠慢他人的行为；有罪的行为或过失。
缺乏；短缺；现有数量不足以满足需要。

collocations.zh: 我想念你；我感到你不在身边的空缺

formal.mt: Minħabba nuqqas ta' fondi, il-proġett ġie pospost sax-xahar id-dieħel.
formal.en: Because of a lack of funds, the project was postponed until next month.
formal.zh: 由于资金不足，该项目被推迟到下个月。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejjer minn meta tlaqt? Mark: Tajjeb, imma nħoss in-nuqqas tiegħek meta niekol waħdi.
colloquial.en: Maja: How have you been since I left? Mark: Fine, but I miss you when I eat alone.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我走以后，你过得怎么样？Mark：挺好的，不过一个人吃饭时我会想你。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我走以后，你过得怎么样？
messages.en: How have you been since I left?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, imma nħoss in-nuqqas tiegħek meta niekol waħdi.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, imma nħoss in-nuqqas tiegħek meta niekol waħdi.
messages.zh: 挺好的，不过一个人吃饭时我会想你。
messages.en: Fine, but I miss you when I eat alone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 围绕“少了该有的东西”记忆：少水是短缺，少尊重是失礼，少了你在身边就是想念。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A professional who prepares and authenticates legal documents and records formal agreements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责拟定、认证法律文件并记录正式协议的专业人员，即公证人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Professjonist li jħejji u jawtentika dokumenti legali u jirreġistra ftehimiet uffiċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公证人；负责拟定或认证法律文书的专业人员。

formal.mt: Il-partijiet iffirmaw il-kuntratt quddiem nutar.
formal.en: The parties signed the contract before a notary.
formal.zh: 各方在公证人面前签署了合同。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Meta għandna l-appuntament man-nutar? Pawlu: Għada fid-disgħa. Ġib il-karta tal-identità miegħek.
colloquial.en: Marija: When is our appointment with the notary? Pawlu: Tomorrow at nine. Bring your identity card.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我们和公证人约在什么时候？Pawlu：明天九点。带上你的身份证。

messages.speaker: Marija (购房者)
messages.zh: 我们和公证人约在什么时候？
messages.en: When is our appointment with the notary?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (配偶)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada fid-disgħa. Ġib il-karta tal-identità miegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Għada fid-disgħa. Ġib il-karta tal-identità miegħek.
messages.zh: 明天九点。带上你的身份证。
messages.en: Tomorrow at nine. Bring your identity card.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nutar 放进“合同、签字、身份核验”的画面中，记住它指负责公证的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A smooth-skinned fruit similar to a peach, or the tree that bears this fruit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外皮光滑、与桃相似的水果，即油桃；也指结这种果实的油桃树。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta b'qoxra lixxa li tixbah lill-ħawħa, jew is-siġra li tagħti din il-frotta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 油桃。
油桃树；结油桃的果树。
油桃果实；表皮光滑的桃类水果。

formal.mt: Fil-ġnien tal-iskola hemm siġra tan-nuċiprisk li tagħti l-frott fis-sajf.
formal.en: In the school garden there is a nectarine tree that bears fruit in summer.
formal.zh: 学校花园里有一棵油桃树，在夏季结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid nuċiprisk wara l-ikel? Pawlu: Iva, grazzi. Agħtini wieħed misjur.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like a nectarine after the meal? Pawlu: Yes, thank you. Give me a ripe one.
colloquial.zh: Maja：饭后想吃个油桃吗？Pawlu：想，谢谢。给我一个熟的吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 饭后想吃个油桃吗？
messages.en: Would you like a nectarine after the meal?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，谢谢。给我一个熟的吧。
messages.en: Yes, thank you. Give me a ripe one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手中光滑的油桃，再把镜头拉远到结油桃的树，用“果实—果树”两幅画面记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pair of lenses held in a frame and worn in front of the eyes, especially to help someone see clearly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戴在眼前、由镜框固定两片镜片的眼镜，尤其用于帮助看清事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Par lentijiet f'qafas li jintlibes quddiem l-għajnejn, speċjalment biex jgħin lil persuna tara ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 眼镜。
眼镜，较正式的英语称呼。
眼镜；佩戴在眼前的镜具。

formal.mt: L-istudenta tilbes in-nuċċali biex taqra l-kitba fuq il-bord.
formal.en: The student wears glasses to read the writing on the board.
formal.zh: 这名女学生戴着眼镜，以便看清黑板上的字。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Rajt in-nuċċali tiegħi? Maja: Iva, qegħdin fuq il-mejda ħdejn il-ktieb.
colloquial.en: Mark: Have you seen my glasses? Maja: Yes, they are on the table next to the book.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你看见我的眼镜了吗？Maja：看见了，在桌上，书的旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 你看见我的眼镜了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen my glasses?

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qegħdin fuq il-mejda ħdejn il-ktieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qegħdin fuq il-mejda ħdejn il-ktieb.
messages.zh: 看见了，在桌上，书的旁边。
messages.en: Yes, they are on the table next to the book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把nuċċali和桌上找眼镜的画面绑定，再整句记住“nilbes in-nuċċali”，表示“我戴眼镜”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Glasses with dark or tinted lenses worn to reduce bright sunlight reaching the eyes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 配有深色或有色镜片、用来减弱进入眼睛的强烈阳光的眼镜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuċċali b'lentijiet skuri jew ikkuluriti li jintlibsu biex inaqqsu d-dawl qawwi tax-xemx li jasal fl-għajnejn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 太阳镜；用来遮挡强烈阳光的眼镜。

formal.mt: Waqt il-ħarġa, l-għalliema libset in-nuċċali tax-xemx minħabba d-dawl qawwi.
formal.en: During the outing, the teacher put on sunglasses because of the bright light.
formal.zh: 外出活动时，老师因为光线强烈而戴上了太阳镜。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħadt in-nuċċali tax-xemx miegħek? Mark: Iva, qegħdin fil-basket; se nilbishom fuq il-bajja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you bring your sunglasses? Mark: Yes, they are in the bag; I will wear them on the beach.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你带太阳镜了吗？Mark：带了，在包里；到了海滩我就戴。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你带太阳镜了吗？
messages.en: Did you bring your sunglasses?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qegħdin fil-basket; se nilbishom fuq il-bajja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qegħdin fil-basket; se nilbishom fuq il-bajja.
messages.zh: 带了，在包里；到了海滩我就戴。
messages.en: Yes, they are in the bag; I will wear them on the beach.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记nuċċali是眼镜，再把tax-xemx与太阳联系起来，想象海滩上戴墨镜，整组词一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a surface flat, smooth, or even by bringing its parts to the same level.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把表面弄平、弄光滑，使各部分处于同一水平。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tagħmel wiċċ ċatt, lixx jew indaqs billi ġġib il-partijiet tiegħu fl-istess livell.

sense_translations.en_definition: witta, daqqas, llixxa, ddritta, qiegħed f'livell wieħed
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使平坦、使齐平、磨平或弄直；把各部分调整到同一水平。
整平；使表面或各部分齐平。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem nvella l-art qabel beda jqiegħed il-madum.
formal.en: The worker levelled the floor before he began laying the tiles.
formal.zh: 工人在开始铺瓷砖之前整平了地面。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex l-ilma m'għadux jinġabar f'dik ir-rokna? Toni: Il-ħaddiem nvella l-art ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why doesn't water collect in that corner anymore? Toni: The worker levelled the ground yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Rita：为什么那个角落不再积水了？Toni：工人昨天把地面整平了。

messages.speaker: Rita (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex l-ilma m'għadux jinġabar f'dik ir-rokna?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex l-ilma m'għadux jinġabar f'dik ir-rokna?
messages.zh: 为什么那个角落不再积水了？
messages.en: Why doesn't water collect in that corner anymore?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.zh: 工人昨天把地面整平了。
messages.en: The worker levelled the ground yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象施工人员用工具把高处削低、低处填平；nvella 的动作目标就是“齐平”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition or degree of being dry, with little moisture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 水分少、缺乏湿润的状态或程度，即干燥。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda jew il-grad ta' xi ħaġa li tkun niexfa u jkollha ftit umdità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 干燥；缺少水分或湿润的状态。
瘦削；身体纤瘦或消瘦的状态。

sense_translations.en_definition: dryness (quality or degree of being dry)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 干燥性或干燥程度；某物有多干。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi n-nxufija tal-ħamrija wara ġimgħat mingħajr xita.
formal.en: The report describes the dryness of the soil after weeks without rain.
formal.zh: 报告描述了连续数周无雨后土壤的干燥状况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: In-nxufija tal-ġilda qed iddejjaqni, speċjalment f'idejja. Marija: Għandi krema tal-idejn fil-basket. Trid ftit?
colloquial.en: Lara: The dryness of my skin is bothering me, especially on my hands. Marija: I have hand cream in my bag. Would you like some?
colloquial.zh: Lara：皮肤干燥让我很不舒服，尤其是双手。Marija：我包里有护手霜。你要用一点吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nxufija tal-ġilda qed iddejjaqni, speċjalment f'idejja.
messages.mt_standard: In-nxufija tal-ġilda qed iddejjaqni, speċjalment f'idejja.
messages.zh: 皮肤干燥让我很不舒服，尤其是双手。
messages.en: The dryness of my skin is bothering me, especially on my hands.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi krema tal-idejn fil-basket. Trid ftit?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi krema tal-idejn fil-basket. Trid ftit?
messages.zh: 我包里有护手霜。你要用一点吗？
messages.en: I have hand cream in my bag. Would you like some?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“干皮肤、干土壤”记住 nxufija 的干燥义；遇到描述身材的语境，再联想到瘦削义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be loved by someone, or to share a relationship in which people love one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到他人的爱，或表示双方彼此相爱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun maħbub minn xi ħadd, jew ikun hemm imħabba bejn żewġ persuni lejn xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被爱；受到喜爱
讨好；巴结；设法博取好感
ħabb的中间态或被动态形式，表示被爱或彼此相爱等意义
彼此相爱；互相爱慕

formal.mt: L-għalliem nħabb mill-istudenti għax kien jisma' l-mistoqsijiet tagħhom bil-paċenzja u jittrattahom b'rispett.
formal.en: The teacher was loved by the students because he listened patiently to their questions and treated them with respect.
formal.zh: 这位老师受到学生们的喜爱，因为他耐心倾听他们的问题，并尊重他们。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex kulħadd għadu jitkellem dwar dak l-għalliem? Mark: Għax nħabb minn kulħadd; dejjem kien lest jgħin.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does everyone still talk about that teacher? Mark: Because he was loved by everyone; he was always ready to help.
colloquial.zh: Lara：为什么大家至今还在谈起那位老师？Mark：因为大家都很喜爱他；他总是乐于助人。

messages.speaker: Lara (往届学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kulħadd għadu jitkellem dwar dak l-għalliem?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kulħadd għadu jitkellem dwar dak l-għalliem?
messages.zh: 为什么大家至今还在谈起那位老师？
messages.en: Why does everyone still talk about that teacher?

messages.speaker: Mark (往届学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax nħabb minn kulħadd; dejjem kien lest jgħin.
messages.mt_standard: Għax nħabb minn kulħadd; dejjem kien lest jgħin.
messages.zh: 因为大家都很喜爱他；他总是乐于助人。
messages.en: Because he was loved by everyone; he was always ready to help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象大家把爱心送给一位老师，记住nħabb的被爱义；两人互送爱心表示相爱，刻意献殷勤则对应讨好义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have milk taken from an animal; figuratively, to become very tired or completely exhausted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指动物被挤奶；也可比喻累得很厉害、精疲力尽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittieħed il-ħalib minn annimal; b'mod figurattiv, wieħed jegħja ħafna jew jispiċċa bla saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被挤奶
累坏；累得筋疲力尽
ħaleb的中间态或被动态形式，表示被挤奶，也可用于累得精疲力尽等意义
精疲力尽；耗尽体力

formal.mt: Il-baqra nħalbet kmieni filgħodu, u l-ħalib inġabar f'kontenitur nadif.
formal.en: The cow was milked early in the morning, and the milk was collected in a clean container.
formal.zh: 这头奶牛一大早就被挤了奶，牛奶收集在干净的容器中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Paul mar jorqod daqshekk kmieni? Lara: Illum nħaleb bix-xogħol; kellu ġurnata twila ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Paul go to bed so early? Lara: He was exhausted by work today; he had a very long day.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Paul为什么这么早就去睡了？Lara：他今天工作累坏了，忙了很长时间。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Paul mar jorqod daqshekk kmieni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Paul mar jorqod daqshekk kmieni?
messages.zh: Paul为什么这么早就去睡了？
messages.en: Why did Paul go to bed so early?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum nħaleb bix-xogħol; kellu ġurnata twila ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Illum nħaleb bix-xogħol; kellu ġurnata twila ħafna.
messages.zh: 他今天工作累坏了，忙了很长时间。
messages.en: He was exhausted by work today; he had a very long day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个并排的画面记忆nħaleb：奶牛被挤奶，以及忙完工作后瘫坐的人；这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel proud of an achievement, a person, or something that matters to oneself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某项成就、某个人或自己重视的事物而感到自豪、得意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħossu kburi minħabba xi kisba, xi persuna jew xi ħaġa li għandu għal qalbu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到自豪；感到骄傲或得意

collocations.zh: 为自己的成功感到自豪
为自己的儿子感到自豪

formal.mt: Il-missier nħamar b'ibnu meta dan temm l-istudji tiegħu wara snin ta' ħidma u sagrifiċċju.
formal.en: The father felt proud of his son when he completed his studies after years of work and sacrifice.
formal.zh: 儿子经过多年的努力和付出完成学业时，父亲为他感到自豪。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif ħassu missierek meta rbaħt? Mark: Nħamar bija u feraħli mill-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did your father feel when you won? Mark: He felt proud of me and congratulated me straight away.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你赢了的时候，你爸爸是什么感受？Mark：他为我感到自豪，马上就向我道贺了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你赢了的时候，你爸爸是什么感受？
messages.en: How did your father feel when you won?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为我感到自豪，马上就向我道贺了。
messages.en: He felt proud of me and congratulated me straight away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象父亲看见孩子完成学业时露出自豪的笑容，把nħamar与为某人感到骄傲联系起来，并留意它与ngħamar的拼写区别。

gloss_zh: 所在一带；地区；周边；街区

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area or the places around a location, including a neighbourhood or parts of a wider region.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个地方所在的一带或周边区域，也可指街区或较大地区中的若干地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Postijiet f'żona jew madwar post partikolari, bħall-viċinat jew partijiet minn reġjun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所在之处；所在一带；大致位置

sense_translations.en_definition: areas; surroundings (of a city); parts (of a region)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 地区；城市周边；某一区域内的各处
街区；邻近地区；附近一带

collocations.en: in the area around the city

formal.mt: L-istħarriġ jinkludi l-inħawi tal-belt u l-irħula fil-qrib sabiex jinġabru fehmiet minn komunitajiet differenti.
formal.en: The survey includes the area around the city and the nearby villages to gather views from different communities.
formal.zh: 这项调查涵盖城市周边及附近村庄，以收集不同社区的意见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm ħanut tal-ikel f'dawn l-inħawi? Mark: Iva, hemm wieħed wara l-kantuniera, ħdejn il-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there a grocery shop in this area? Mark: Yes, there is one around the corner, next to the square.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这一带有食品店吗？Mark：有，拐过街角就有一家，在广场旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 这一带有食品店吗？
messages.en: Is there a grocery shop in this area?

messages.speaker: Mark (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm wieħed wara l-kantuniera, ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm wieħed wara l-kantuniera, ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.zh: 有，拐过街角就有一家，在广场旁边。
messages.en: Yes, there is one around the corner, next to the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在地图上围着一个地点画圈，圈中的街道、邻里和周边村庄都属于这一带；用这幅地图记住nħawi。

gloss_zh: 恢复精神；感到神清气爽

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel fresh and full of energy again after being tired.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 疲倦之后重新感到精神充沛、身体舒畅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jerġa' jħossu frisk u mimli enerġija wara l-għeja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重新振作起来；感觉恢复了精神。
感到神清气爽；重新恢复精神和活力。

collocations.en: felt refreshed after a little rest
collocations.zh: 稍作休息后恢复了精神

collocations.en: felt revived after a good sleep
collocations.zh: 好好睡了一觉后恢复了活力

formal.mt: Wara ftit mistrieħ, il-pazjent nħeja u seta' jkompli l-eżerċizzji ħfief.
formal.en: After a little rest, the patient felt revived and was able to continue the gentle exercises.
formal.zh: 稍作休息后，病人恢复了精神，能够继续做轻度运动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu Pawlu wara l-vjaġġ twil? Rita: Raqqad ftit u nħeja. Issa jrid joħroġ magħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is Pawlu after the long journey? Rita: He had a short sleep and felt refreshed. Now he wants to go out with us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗长途旅行后怎么样了？丽塔：他睡了一小会儿，恢复精神了。现在他想跟我们一起出去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhu Pawlu wara l-vjaġġ twil?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhu Pawlu wara l-vjaġġ twil?
messages.zh: 保罗长途旅行后怎么样了？
messages.en: How is Pawlu after the long journey?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Raqqad ftit u nħeja. Issa jrid joħroġ magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Raqqad ftit u nħeja. Issa jrid joħroġ magħna.
messages.zh: 他睡了一小会儿，恢复精神了。现在他想跟我们一起出去。
messages.en: He had a short sleep and felt refreshed. Now he wants to go out with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象疲倦的人小睡后重新精神饱满，把 nħeja 与“休息后恢复活力”的画面一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 被浪费；徒耗精力；耗尽；变甜

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be used up without producing a useful result, especially time, money, or effort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 时间、金钱或精力被白白消耗，没有产生有用的结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintilef jew jintuża għalxejn, speċjalment ħin, flus jew sforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被浪费；被白白耗费。

sense_translations.en_definition: to waste one's energies on a worthless thing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把自己的精力白白耗在没有价值的事情上。
精力耗尽；变得疲惫不堪。
变甜；味道变得甘甜。

collocations.en: effort that was wasted for nothing

formal.mt: Ħafna ħin nħela minħabba nuqqas ta' koordinazzjoni bejn id-dipartimenti.
formal.en: A great deal of time was wasted because of a lack of coordination between the departments.
formal.zh: 由于各部门之间缺乏协调，大量时间被浪费了。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex domtu daqshekk biex bdejtu? Sara: Ħafna ħin nħela nistennew iċ-ċavetta.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did it take you so long to get started? Sara: A lot of time was wasted waiting for the key.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你们怎么花了这么久才开始？萨拉：等钥匙浪费了很多时间。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 你们怎么花了这么久才开始？
messages.en: Why did it take you so long to get started?

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 等钥匙浪费了很多时间。
messages.en: A lot of time was wasted waiting for the key.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“时间漏光、精力耗光”记住浪费和耗尽义；另做一张“味道变甜”的卡片，分开记忆这个独立义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sloping or moving downwards, or tending towards a lower level.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 朝下倾斜、向下移动或趋向较低位置的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinżel, ikun imżerżaq 'l isfel jew ikollu tendenza lejn livell aktar baxx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 趋向下降的；有向下走势或倾向的。
向下倾斜的；呈下坡状的。
下降的；正在向下移动的。

formal.mt: Il-passaġġ nżuli jwassal mill-entratura sal-ġnien ta' taħt.
formal.en: The downward-sloping passage leads from the entrance to the lower garden.
formal.zh: 这条向下倾斜的通道从入口通往下方的花园。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-passaġġ jitla' jew jinżel? Mark: Huwa nżuli. Jekk nimxu minn hawn, naslu ħdejn il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this passage go up or down? Mark: It slopes down. If we walk this way, we'll reach the sea.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这条通道是上坡还是下坡？Mark：是下坡。沿这里走，我们就会到海边。

messages.speaker: Sara (游客)
messages.zh: 这条通道是上坡还是下坡？
messages.en: Does this passage go up or down?

messages.speaker: Mark (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa nżuli. Jekk nimxu minn hawn, naslu ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa nżuli. Jekk nimxu minn hawn, naslu ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.zh: 是下坡。沿这里走，我们就会到海边。
messages.en: It slopes down. If we walk this way, we'll reach the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 nżuli 配一个向下箭头：修饰通道时想“下坡”，修饰运动时想“下降”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To require or compel someone to do something through a duty, rule, or pressure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过义务、规定或压力，要求或迫使某人做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jagħmel xi ħaġa minħabba dmir, regola jew pressjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使承担义务；要求某人做某事。
胁迫；以压力强迫某人行动。
约束；限制某人的选择或行动，使其不得不服从。
使有义务；迫使或强制某人做某事。

formal.mt: Il-ftehim obbliga lill-kumpanija tħallas l-ispejjeż kollha.
formal.en: The agreement required the company to pay all the expenses.
formal.zh: 协议要求公司支付全部费用。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex bqajtu l-uffiċċju sa tard? Karl: Il-maniġer obbliga lil kulħadd jibqa' sakemm spiċċa x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you stay at the office so late? Karl: The manager made everyone stay until the work was finished.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你们为什么在办公室待到那么晚？Karl：经理要求所有人留下，直到工作完成。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们为什么在办公室待到那么晚？
messages.en: Why did you stay at the office so late?

messages.speaker: Karl (职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-maniġer obbliga lil kulħadd jibqa' sakemm spiċċa x-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Il-maniġer obbliga lil kulħadd jibqa' sakemm spiċċa x-xogħol.
messages.zh: 经理要求所有人留下，直到工作完成。
messages.en: The manager made everyone stay until the work was finished.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 obbliga 记成“让某人必须做”：协议可以要求付款，强势的人也可以迫使别人留下。

gloss_zh: 义务；责任；对某人的亏欠

teaching_sense.en_definition: A duty or responsibility that requires someone to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 要求某人采取某种行动的义务或责任。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dmir jew responsabbiltà li teħtieġ li persuna tagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 义务；必须履行的责任。
对某人的亏欠；所欠的人情或应向其履行的责任。
职责；应当或必须承担的义务。

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt jistabbilixxi l-obbligu tal-kumpanija li tħallas fil-ħin.
formal.en: The contract establishes the company's obligation to pay on time.
formal.zh: 合同规定了公司按时付款的义务。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Trid tiġi tgħinna nhar is-Sibt? Luqa: Niġi bil-qalb. Anna: Grazzi, imma m'għandek l-ebda obbligu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Would you like to come and help us on Saturday? Luqa: I'd be happy to. Anna: Thanks, but you're under no obligation.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你星期六愿意来帮我们吗？Luqa：我很乐意来。Anna：谢谢，不过你没有这个义务。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你星期六愿意来帮我们吗？
messages.en: Would you like to come and help us on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 我很乐意来。
messages.en: I'd be happy to.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 谢谢，不过你没有这个义务。
messages.en: Thanks, but you're under no obligation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 obbligu 当作肩上写着“应尽责任”的小牌子；法律义务、道德责任和人情亏欠都靠语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To do what a person, rule, or instruction requires.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照某人的要求、规定或指示行事；服从或听从。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tagħmel dak li titlob persuna, regola jew istruzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 服从；听从命令、指示或要求。

formal.mt: Is-sewwieq obda l-ordni tal-pulizija u waqqaf il-karozza.
formal.en: The driver obeyed the police order and stopped the car.
formal.zh: 司机服从了警方的命令，停下了汽车。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Ben obda lill-għalliem? David: Iva, poġġa l-mowbajl fil-basket kif qallu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did Ben obey the teacher? David: Yes, he put his phone in his bag as the teacher told him.
colloquial.zh: Marta：Ben 听老师的话了吗？David：听了，他照老师说的把手机放进了包里。

messages.speaker: Marta (母亲)
messages.zh: Ben 听老师的话了吗？
messages.en: Did Ben obey the teacher?

messages.speaker: David (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, poġġa l-mowbajl fil-basket kif qallu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, poġġa l-mowbajl fil-basket kif qallu.
messages.zh: 听了，他照老师说的把手机放进了包里。
messages.en: Yes, he put his phone in his bag as the teacher told him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象先听到指令，再照着行动：obda 强调“听从并照做”，把命令和实际动作连起来记。

gloss_zh: 提供；主动提出给予或帮助

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something available to someone or to propose giving help or doing something for them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人提供东西，或主动提出给予帮助、为对方做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jipproponi li jagħti xi ħaġa lil xi ħadd jew li jgħinu, jew jagħmel xi ħaġa disponibbli għalih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提供；主动提出给予、帮助或做某事。

formal.mt: Iċ-ċentru offra kors b'xejn lil dawk li kienu qed ifittxu xogħol.
formal.en: The centre offered a free course to people who were looking for work.
formal.zh: 该中心向正在求职的人提供了一门免费课程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min offra li jwassalna d-dar? Mark: Pawlu offra li jwassalna bil-karozza tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who offered to take us home? Mark: Pawlu offered to drive us in his car.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁提出送我们回家？马克：保罗提出开他的车送我们。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁提出送我们回家？
messages.en: Who offered to take us home?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu offra li jwassalna bil-karozza tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu offra li jwassalna bil-karozza tiegħu.
messages.zh: 保罗提出开他的车送我们。
messages.en: Pawlu offered to drive us in his car.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友主动递来一杯水，记住“主动提供”的画面。offra 可表示“他提供了”，后接 li 和动作时可理解为“他提出要做……”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particular event or time, especially one that is special or provides an opportunity to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某次事件或某个时刻，尤其指特别的场合，或适合做某事的时机。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġrajja jew ħin partikolari, speċjalment wieħed speċjali jew li jagħti ċans biex issir xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 场合；某次特别的活动或时刻；做某事的时机。

collocations.zh: 在这次场合；在这个时刻

formal.mt: F'din l-okkażjoni, id-direttur irringrazzja lill-ħaddiema kollha għax-xogħol tagħhom.
formal.en: On this occasion, the director thanked all the employees for their work.
formal.zh: 在这个场合，主管感谢了全体员工的辛勤工作。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex xtrajt kejk? Toni: Għax illum hija okkażjoni speċjali: għeluq snin ommi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you buy a cake? Toni: Because today is a special occasion: my mother's birthday.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么买了蛋糕？托尼：因为今天是个特别的日子：我妈妈的生日。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么买了蛋糕？
messages.en: Why did you buy a cake?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax illum hija okkażjoni speċjali: għeluq snin ommi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax illum hija okkażjoni speċjali: għeluq snin ommi.
messages.zh: 因为今天是个特别的日子：我妈妈的生日。
messages.en: Because today is a special occasion: my mother's birthday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把生日蛋糕旁的一张卡片想成写着 okkażjoni speċjali：它提醒你这是“特别的场合”；再把“适合做某事的时刻”联想到“时机”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take up or use a place or space, or to live in a particular building or area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 占据或使用某个地方、空间，也可表示居住在某栋建筑或某个地区。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu jew juża post jew spazju, jew jgħix f'bini jew f'żona partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 占用；占据某个地方或空间。
居住于；栖居于某处。

collocations.en: occupied a house; lived in a house
collocations.zh: 占用了一栋房屋；居住在一栋房屋中

formal.mt: Id-dipartiment okkupa t-tieni sular tal-bini għal sitt xhur.
formal.en: The department occupied the second floor of the building for six months.
formal.zh: 该部门使用了这栋建筑的第二层，为期六个月。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min okkupa l-kamra l-kbira lbieraħ? Ben: It-tim tagħna. Kellna laqgħa twila.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who occupied the large room yesterday? Ben: Our team. We had a long meeting.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：昨天谁用了那间大房间？本：我们团队。我们开了个很长的会。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 昨天谁用了那间大房间？
messages.en: Who occupied the large room yesterday?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.zh: 我们团队。我们开了个很长的会。
messages.en: Our team. We had a long meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象房门上挂着“有人使用”的牌子来记 okkupa：会议团队占用房间，住户居住房屋，两种情景都围绕“人在某处占有空间”。

gloss_zh: 荷兰的；荷兰地区的；荷兰人；荷兰语

teaching_sense.en_definition: From or related to Holland or the Netherlands, including its people, language, or culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自荷兰地区或荷兰这个国家的，或与其人民、语言、文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Olanda jew li għandu x'jaqsam magħha, man-nies tagħha, mal-lingwa jew mal-kultura tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 荷兰的；荷兰人的；荷兰语的。

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or pertaining to Holland or the Netherlands
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自荷兰地区或荷兰这个国家的；与之有关的。
荷兰地区的；与荷兰地区的语言或文化有关的。
荷兰地区的人；荷兰人。
荷兰男子；男性荷兰人。
荷兰语。

formal.mt: Student Olandiż ippreżenta r-riċerka tiegħu waqt il-konferenza internazzjonali.
formal.en: A Dutch student presented his research at the international conference.
formal.zh: 一名荷兰男学生在国际会议上介绍了自己的研究。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħabib il-ġdid tiegħek Olandiż? Mark: Iva, hu mill-Olanda u jitkellem bl-Olandiż u bl-Ingliż.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is your new friend Dutch? Mark: Yes, he is from the Netherlands and speaks Dutch and English.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的新朋友是荷兰人吗？马克：是的，他来自荷兰，会说荷兰语和英语。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的新朋友是荷兰人吗？
messages.en: Is your new friend Dutch?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu mill-Olanda u jitkellem bl-Olandiż u bl-Ingliż.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu mill-Olanda u jitkellem bl-Olandiż u bl-Ingliż.
messages.zh: 是的，他来自荷兰，会说荷兰语和英语。
messages.en: Yes, he is from the Netherlands and speaks Dutch and English.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“人、物、语言”三格卡片记忆：student Olandiż 是荷兰学生，mużew Olandiż 是荷兰博物馆，bl-Olandiż 则表示用荷兰语；根据句中位置区分形容词与名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The killing of one person by another; in some contexts, murder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一人杀死另一人的行为；在某些语境中指谋杀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qtil ta' persuna minn persuna oħra; f'ċerti kuntesti jirreferi għal qtil intenzjonat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杀人行为；一人导致另一人死亡。
谋杀；故意杀人。

collocations.zh: 对一起杀人事件的调查

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-investigazzjoni dwar l-omiċidju.
formal.en: The report describes the investigation into the homicide.
formal.zh: 这份报告描述了对该起杀人事件的调查。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qrajt l-aħbar dwar dak l-omiċidju? Mark: Iva, imma għadna ma nafux id-dettalji kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you read the news about that homicide? Mark: Yes, but we still don't know all the details.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看了那起杀人事件的新闻吗？马克：看了，但我们还不知道全部细节。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看了那起杀人事件的新闻吗？
messages.en: Did you read the news about that homicide?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għadna ma nafux id-dettalji kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għadna ma nafux id-dettalji kollha.
messages.zh: 看了，但我们还不知道全部细节。
messages.en: Yes, but we still don't know all the details.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“杀人案件调查”的新闻画面中记忆；先记广义“杀人”，再根据语境判断是否具体指“谋杀”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having unlimited power and being able to do anything, especially as a description of God.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拥有无限力量、能够做到任何事情的，尤用于描述上帝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu setgħa bla limitu u jista' jagħmel kollox, speċjalment meta jingħad għal Alla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 全能的；具有无限力量的，常用于描述上帝。
无所不能的；拥有无限权能的。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi lil Alla bħala omnipotenti.
formal.en: The author describes God as omnipotent.
formal.zh: 作者将上帝描述为全能的。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'omnipotenti' f'dan it-test? Pawlu: Ifisser li jista' jagħmel kollox.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'omnipotent' mean in this text? Pawlu: It means being able to do anything.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这篇文章里的“omnipotenti”是什么意思？保罗：意思是无所不能。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的“omnipotenti”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'omnipotent' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.zh: 意思是无所不能。
messages.en: It means being able to do anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“任何事情都能做到”的画面记住全能；它表达的程度比普通的“强大”更高，可和 Alla 一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who feels romantic or sexual attraction toward people of the same sex.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对与自己同性别的人产生浪漫或性吸引的人，即同性恋者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħoss attrazzjoni romantika jew sesswali lejn persuni tal-istess sess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 同性恋者；对同性产生浪漫或性吸引的人。
同性恋者，常指男同性恋者。
同性恋的；与对同性的浪漫或性吸引有关的。

formal.mt: Dan il-ktieb jinkludi stejjer ta' omosesswali dwar ħajjithom u l-familji tagħhom.
formal.en: This book includes accounts by gay people about their lives and families.
formal.zh: 这本书收录了同性恋者讲述自身生活与家庭的故事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħija qalli li hu omosesswali. Sara: Jien kuntenta li ħassu komdu jitkellem miegħek.
colloquial.en: Maja: My brother told me he's gay. Sara: I'm glad he felt comfortable talking to you.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我哥哥告诉我，他是同性恋。萨拉：我很高兴他能安心地和你谈这件事。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我哥哥告诉我，他是同性恋。
messages.en: My brother told me he's gay.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien kuntenta li ħassu komdu jitkellem miegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Jien kuntenta li ħassu komdu jitkellem miegħek.
messages.zh: 我很高兴他能安心地和你谈这件事。
messages.en: I'm glad he felt comfortable talking to you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张词性卡记忆：指人时是“同性恋者”，修饰 raġel 或 mara 时是“同性恋的”；同一词形要结合句子判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sexual orientation involving romantic or sexual attraction toward people of the same sex.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对与自己同性别的人产生浪漫或性吸引的性取向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Orjentazzjoni sesswali li tinvolvi attrazzjoni romantika jew sesswali lejn persuni tal-istess sess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 同性恋；以对同性产生浪漫或性吸引为特征的性取向。

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni tispjega l-omosesswalità bħala orjentazzjoni sesswali.
formal.en: The lesson explains homosexuality as a sexual orientation.
formal.zh: 这节课讲解同性恋是一种性取向。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-ktieb jitkellem dwar l-omosesswalità? Mark: Iva, u jinkludi wkoll stejjer personali.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this book discuss homosexuality? Mark: Yes, and it also includes personal stories.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这本书谈到同性恋吗？马克：是的，里面还有个人故事。

messages.speaker: Lara (读者)
messages.zh: 这本书谈到同性恋吗？
messages.en: Does this book discuss homosexuality?

messages.speaker: Mark (图书管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u jinkludi wkoll stejjer personali.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u jinkludi wkoll stejjer personali.
messages.zh: 是的，里面还有个人故事。
messages.en: Yes, and it also includes personal stories.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 omosesswali 与 omosesswalità 并排记忆：前者可以指人，后者指“同性恋这种性取向”，不要把概念名词当成人称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dramatic work in which the story is presented mainly through singing with musical accompaniment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主要通过演唱并配以音乐来表现故事的戏剧作品，即歌剧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xogħol teatrali li fih l-istorja titwassal l-aktar permezz tal-kant b'akkumpanjament mużikali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 歌剧；主要以演唱和音乐呈现情节的戏剧作品。
施行手术；给病人动手术。

formal.mt: It-teatru se jippreżenta opera ġdida b'orkestra u kor.
formal.en: The theatre will present a new opera with an orchestra and choir.
formal.zh: 剧院将上演一部由管弦乐队和合唱团参与演出的新歌剧。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi tara opera miegħi nhar is-Sibt? Mark: Iva! Qatt ma rajt opera fit-teatru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like to come and see an opera with me on Saturday? Mark: Yes! I've never seen an opera at the theatre.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：星期六你想和我一起去看歌剧吗？马克：想！我还从没在剧院看过歌剧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi tara opera miegħi nhar is-Sibt?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi tara opera miegħi nhar is-Sibt?
messages.zh: 星期六你想和我一起去看歌剧吗？
messages.en: Would you like to come and see an opera with me on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Qatt ma rajt opera fit-teatru.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Qatt ma rajt opera fit-teatru.
messages.zh: 想！我还从没在剧院看过歌剧。
messages.en: Yes! I've never seen an opera at the theatre.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为同形词画两幅图：舞台上的歌剧和医生施行手术。看到剧院语境先想名词，看到病人语境再判断动词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized activity carried out for a particular purpose, or a surgical procedure performed on the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为特定目的组织开展的行动或作业，也指对身体进行的外科手术。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħidma organizzata għal għan partikolari, jew intervent kirurġiku fuq il-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行动；作业；为特定目的开展的一项活动，也可指手术。
外科手术；以外科方式对身体进行的治疗。

formal.mt: L-operazzjoni ta' salvataġġ bdiet kmieni filgħodu u ntemmet wara nofsinhar.
formal.en: The rescue operation began early in the morning and ended in the afternoon.
formal.zh: 救援行动于清晨开始，下午结束。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Meta se ssir l-operazzjoni ta' ommok? Maja: Nhar it-Tnejn. Se mmur l-isptar magħha.
colloquial.en: Sara: When is your mother's operation? Maja: On Monday. I'll go to the hospital with her.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你妈妈什么时候做手术？玛雅：星期一。我会陪她去医院。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta se ssir l-operazzjoni ta' ommok?
messages.mt_standard: Meta se ssir l-operazzjoni ta' ommok?
messages.zh: 你妈妈什么时候做手术？
messages.en: When is your mother's operation?

messages.speaker: Maja (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Nhar it-Tnejn. Se mmur l-isptar magħha.
messages.mt_standard: Nhar it-Tnejn. Se mmur l-isptar magħha.
messages.zh: 星期一。我会陪她去医院。
messages.en: On Monday. I'll go to the hospital with her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“有组织地完成一项任务”串联记忆：救援队开展行动，医生进行手术；通过救援或医院语境选择对应中文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person's view, belief, or judgment about someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人对某人或某事持有的看法、意见或判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsieb, fehma jew ġudizzju li persuna għandha dwar xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 意见；看法；个人对人或事的判断。

formal.mt: Fl-opinjoni tal-awtur, il-proposta tista' ttejjeb is-servizz.
formal.en: In the author's opinion, the proposal could improve the service.
formal.zh: 作者认为，这项提议可以改善服务。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhi l-opinjoni tiegħek dwar il-film? Lara: Għoġobni, imma kien twil wisq.
colloquial.en: Mark: What's your opinion of the film? Lara: I liked it, but it was too long.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你觉得这部电影怎么样？拉拉：我挺喜欢的，不过太长了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你觉得这部电影怎么样？
messages.en: What's your opinion of the film?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我挺喜欢的，不过太长了。
messages.en: I liked it, but it was too long.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fl-opinjoni tiegħi 当作“依我看来”的整块表达记住；想象影评讨论，每个人都有自己的 opinjoni。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be against something, present arguments against it, or resist its force or effects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反对某事、提出反对它的论据，或抵御某种力量及其影响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun kontra xi ħaġa, jagħti argumenti kontriha jew jirreżisti l-forza jew l-effetti tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反对；对某人或某事持反对立场。
提出反对的论据；反驳。
抵挡；抵御；承受住某种力量或影响。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat oppona l-proposta għax qies li l-ispejjeż kienu għoljin wisq.
formal.en: The committee opposed the proposal because it considered the costs too high.
formal.zh: 委员会反对这项提议，因为它认为费用过高。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark oppona l-pjan? Sara: Għax ried aktar ħin biex niddiskutuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark oppose the plan? Sara: Because he wanted more time for us to discuss it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么反对这个计划？萨拉：因为他希望我们有更多时间讨论它。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 马克为什么反对这个计划？
messages.en: Why did Mark oppose the plan?

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ried aktar ħin biex niddiskutuh.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ried aktar ħin biex niddiskutuh.
messages.zh: 因为他希望我们有更多时间讨论它。
messages.en: Because he wanted more time for us to discuss it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“面对某事顶住不接受”的画面串联三个义项：立场上反对、言语上反驳、力量上抵御；配合具体宾语区分意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A chance or favourable situation that allows someone to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人能够做某件事的机会或有利时机。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċans jew sitwazzjoni favorevoli li tippermetti lil xi ħadd jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 机会；做某事的可能时机。
机会；适合采取行动或有所发展的有利时机。

formal.mt: Dan il-kors joffri opportunità biex l-istudenti jtejbu l-Malti tagħhom.
formal.en: This course offers an opportunity for students to improve their Maltese.
formal.zh: 这门课程为学生提供了提高马耳他语水平的机会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi miegħi għall-kors? Luka: Iva, hija opportunità tajba biex nitgħallem xi ħaġa ġdida.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like to come to the course with me? Luka: Yes, it is a good opportunity to learn something new.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你想和我一起去上这门课吗？Luka：想，这是学习新东西的好机会。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想和我一起去上这门课吗？
messages.en: Would you like to come to the course with me?

messages.speaker: Luka (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hija opportunità tajba biex nitgħallem xi ħaġa ġdida.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hija opportunità tajba biex nitgħallem xi ħaġa ġdida.
messages.zh: 想，这是学习新东西的好机会。
messages.en: Yes, it is a good opportunity to learn something new.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“机会”想成一扇打开的门，搭配 opportunità tajba 记住“好机会”，再用 biex 接上想做的事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the colour between red and yellow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈红色与黄色之间的橙色的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-kulur bejn l-aħmar u l-isfar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 橙色的；用于描述事物的颜色。
橙色；介于红色与黄色之间的一种颜色。
橙色的。

formal.mt: Fuq il-mappa, il-linja oranġjo turi r-rotta lejn il-mużew.
formal.en: On the map, the orange line shows the route to the museum.
formal.zh: 在地图上，橙色线条表示通往博物馆的路线。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema flokk se tilbes illum? Ben: Il-flokk oranġjo, għax jogħġobni ħafna dak il-kulur.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which shirt are you going to wear today? Ben: The orange shirt, because I really like that colour.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你今天要穿哪件上衣？Ben：橙色那件，因为我很喜欢那个颜色。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天要穿哪件上衣？
messages.en: Which shirt are you going to wear today?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-flokk oranġjo, għax jogħġobni ħafna dak il-kulur.
messages.mt_standard: Il-flokk oranġjo, għax jogħġobni ħafna dak il-kulur.
messages.zh: 橙色那件，因为我很喜欢那个颜色。
messages.en: The orange shirt, because I really like that colour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象衣柜里一件醒目的橙色上衣，用 flokk oranġjo 把物品和颜色一起记住；本组词义都围绕颜色。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To request goods or food, or to tell someone with authority to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 要求提供商品或食物；也指以权威身份命令某人做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titlob oġġetti jew ikel, jew tagħti kmand lil xi ħadd biex jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 订购、点餐；也可指下令。
命令；指示某人必须做某事。

formal.mt: Il-maniġer ordna tagħmir ġdid għall-uffiċċju.
formal.en: The manager ordered new equipment for the office.
formal.zh: 经理为办公室订购了新设备。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Diġà ordnajt l-ikel? Mark: Iva, ordnajt soppa u insalata.
colloquial.en: Nina: Have you ordered the food yet? Mark: Yes, I ordered soup and a salad.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你已经点餐了吗？Mark：点了，我点了汤和沙拉。

messages.speaker: Nina (用餐同伴)
messages.zh: 你已经点餐了吗？
messages.en: Have you ordered the food yet?

messages.speaker: Mark (用餐同伴)
messages.zh: 点了，我点了汤和沙拉。
messages.en: Yes, I ordered soup and a salad.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景记忆：餐厅里“点餐”，工作现场“下令”。看到 ordna，先看后面接的是物品还是接受命令的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To plan and arrange an activity or put things in a useful order.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为活动作计划和安排，或把事物有条理地整理好。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tippjana u tirranġa attività, jew tqiegħed l-affarijiet f'ordni utli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 组织；安排；使事物有条理。
组织、筹办活动；安排或整理事物。
组织、筹办活动；安排或整理事物。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat organizza laqgħa biex jiddiskuti l-proġett mal-istudenti.
formal.en: The committee organized a meeting to discuss the project with the students.
formal.zh: 委员会组织了一次会议，与学生讨论该项目。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min organizza l-festa tal-bieraħ? Luka: Sara organizzat kollox, u aħna għenna bl-ikel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who organized yesterday's party? Luka: Sara organized everything, and we helped with the food.
colloquial.zh: Maja：昨天的聚会是谁组织的？Luka：Sara 安排了所有事情，我们帮忙准备了食物。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天的聚会是谁组织的？
messages.en: Who organized yesterday's party?

messages.speaker: Luka (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sara organizzat kollox, u aħna għenna bl-ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Sara organizzat kollox, u aħna għenna bl-ikel.
messages.zh: Sara 安排了所有事情，我们帮忙准备了食物。
messages.en: Sara organized everything, and we helped with the food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象筹办聚会时依次安排时间、地点和食物，用 organizza festa 记住“把事情安排妥当”这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group working together for a purpose, or the planning and arrangement of activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为共同目标开展工作的团体或机构；也指对活动进行组织和安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp li jaħdem flimkien għal għan, jew l-ippjanar u t-tqassim ta' attivitajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 组织、机构；也指组织安排的过程或方式。
组织、机构；也指组织安排的过程或方式。

formal.mt: L-organizzazzjoni tipprovdi appoġġ lill-familji fil-komunità.
formal.en: The organization provides support to families in the community.
formal.zh: 该组织为社区内的家庭提供支持。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Kif sejra l-organizzazzjoni tal-festa? Sara: Kollox lest; jonqos biss nixtru x-xorb.
colloquial.en: Ben: How are the party arrangements going? Sara: Everything is ready; we just need to buy the drinks.
colloquial.zh: Ben：聚会的筹备工作进展如何？Sara：都准备好了，只差买饮料了。

messages.speaker: Ben (聚会筹备者)
messages.zh: 聚会的筹备工作进展如何？
messages.en: How are the party arrangements going?

messages.speaker: Sara (聚会筹备者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kollox lest; jonqos biss nixtru x-xorb.
messages.mt_standard: Kollox lest; jonqos biss nixtru x-xorb.
messages.zh: 都准备好了，只差买饮料了。
messages.en: Everything is ready; we just need to buy the drinks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记忆：一群人为共同目标工作是“组织”，一张活动筹备清单体现“组织安排”，两者都可用 organizzazzjoni。

gloss_zh: 管弦乐团；为管弦乐队编配；统筹安排

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large group of musicians who play different instruments together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由演奏不同乐器的乐手组成、共同演奏音乐的大型乐团。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp kbir ta' mużiċisti li jdoqqu strumenti differenti flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 管弦乐团；由多种乐器的演奏者组成的乐团。
为管弦乐队编配乐曲；也可比喻统筹安排一项复杂活动。

formal.mt: L-orkestra daqqet tliet biċċiet mużikali waqt il-kunċert.
formal.en: The orchestra played three musical pieces during the concert.
formal.zh: 管弦乐团在音乐会上演奏了三首乐曲。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għoġbitek l-orkestra lbieraħ? Mark: Iva, speċjalment meta daqqew il-vjolini.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you like the orchestra yesterday? Mark: Yes, especially when the violins played.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你喜欢昨天的管弦乐团演出吗？Mark：喜欢，尤其是小提琴演奏的时候。

messages.speaker: Nina (音乐会观众)
messages.zh: 你喜欢昨天的管弦乐团演出吗？
messages.en: Did you like the orchestra yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (音乐会观众)
messages.zh: 喜欢，尤其是小提琴演奏的时候。
messages.en: Yes, especially when the violins played.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象舞台上多种乐器一起演奏，先记名词 orkestra“管弦乐团”；遇到动词用法，再联想到为这些乐器编配或统筹安排。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who watches an event or situation carefully, often to report on it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 仔细观察事件或情况的人，常以记录或报告所见为目的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ssegwi avveniment jew sitwazzjoni bir-reqqa, spiss biex tirrapporta dwarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 观察者；观察员；关注并观察某一事件或情况的人。

formal.mt: L-osservatur indipendenti ħejja rapport dwar il-proċess tal-votazzjoni.
formal.en: The independent observer prepared a report on the voting process.
formal.zh: 独立观察员编写了一份关于投票过程的报告。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se tieħu sehem fid-diskussjoni? Ben: Le, illum qiegħed hawn bħala osservatur.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you going to take part in the discussion? Ben: No, today I am here as an observer.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你会参与讨论吗？Ben：不会，我今天是以观察员的身份来的。

messages.speaker: Sara (会议参与者)
messages.zh: 你会参与讨论吗？
messages.en: Are you going to take part in the discussion?

messages.speaker: Ben (观察员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, illum qiegħed hawn bħala osservatur.
messages.mt_standard: Le, illum qiegħed hawn bħala osservatur.
messages.zh: 不会，我今天是以观察员的身份来的。
messages.en: No, today I am here as an observer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 osservatur 配上一位拿着笔记本、仔细观看现场的人；这个词指“观察的人”，可用 bħala osservatur 记住“作为观察员”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of watching something carefully, or a comment about something noticed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 仔细观看和留意事物的行为；也指根据所注意到的情况提出的看法或评述。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tħares lejn xi ħaġa bir-reqqa, jew kumment dwar xi ħaġa li tkun innutajt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 观察；观察所得的发现，或由此提出的看法、评述。

formal.mt: L-osservazzjoni bir-reqqa tal-pjanti għenet lill-istudenti jifhmu kif jikbru.
formal.en: Careful observation of the plants helped the students understand how they grow.
formal.zh: 对植物的仔细观察帮助学生理解了植物如何生长。

colloquial.mt: Luka: Għamilt osservazzjoni interessanti dwar il-klassi tagħna. Maja: X'innutajt? Luka: Naħdmu aħjar meta nkunu fi gruppi żgħar.
colloquial.en: Luka: I made an interesting observation about our class. Maja: What did you notice? Luka: We work better when we are in small groups.
colloquial.zh: Luka：我对咱们班有个有趣的观察。Maja：你注意到了什么？Luka：我们分成小组时，学习效果更好。

messages.speaker: Luka (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamilt osservazzjoni interessanti dwar il-klassi tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Għamilt osservazzjoni interessanti dwar il-klassi tagħna.
messages.zh: 我对咱们班有个有趣的观察。
messages.en: I made an interesting observation about our class.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你注意到了什么？
messages.en: What did you notice?

messages.speaker: Luka (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħdmu aħjar meta nkunu fi gruppi żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Naħdmu aħjar meta nkunu fi gruppi żgħar.
messages.zh: 我们分成小组时，学习效果更好。
messages.en: We work better when we are in small groups.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“先仔细看，再说出发现”串起两个用法：观看过程是 osservazzjoni，观察后提出的一条看法也可以是 osservazzjoni。

teaching_sense.en_definition: October, the tenth month of the year.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 十月，一年中的第十个月。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għaxar xahar tas-sena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 十月，作为月份名称使用。
十月，指一年中的第十个月。

formal.mt: Il-kors il-ġdid jibda f'Ottubru u jintemm f'Diċembru.
formal.en: The new course begins in October and ends in December.
formal.zh: 新课程十月开始，十二月结束。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta tibda l-kors? Mark: F'Ottubru. Maja: Mela għad għandek ftit żmien biex tipprepara.
colloquial.en: Maja: When do you start the course? Mark: In October. Maja: Then you still have some time to prepare.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你什么时候开始上课？马克：十月。玛雅：那你还有一点时间准备。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你什么时候开始上课？
messages.en: When do you start the course?

messages.speaker: Mark (学员)
messages.zh: 十月。
messages.en: In October.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela għad għandek ftit żmien biex tipprepara.
messages.mt_standard: Mela għad għandek ftit żmien biex tipprepara.
messages.zh: 那你还有一点时间准备。
messages.en: Then you still have some time to prepare.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ottubru 写进年历第十格，再整块记住 f'Ottubru 表示“在十月”。

gloss_zh: 淫秽的；猥亵的；有伤风化的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Offensive or indecent, especially because of sexual language, images, or behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因涉及性的言语、图像或行为而显得淫秽、猥亵或有伤风化的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li joffendi d-diċenza, speċjalment bi kliem, stampi jew imġiba ta' natura sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淫秽的；有伤风化的。
猥亵的；带有色情意味的。
淫秽的；猥亵失当的。

formal.mt: Ir-regolamenti jipprojbixxu l-użu ta' kliem oxxen waqt l-attivitajiet tal-iskola.
formal.en: The regulations prohibit the use of obscene language during school activities.
formal.zh: 规章禁止在学校活动期间使用淫秽言语。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħassart dak il-kumment? Mark: Kien fih kliem oxxen. Maja: Mela aħjar li neħħejtu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you delete that comment? Mark: It contained obscene language. Maja: Then it was better to remove it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么删掉那条评论？马克：里面有淫秽言语。玛雅：那删掉更好。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么删掉那条评论？
messages.en: Why did you delete that comment?

messages.speaker: Mark (评论区管理员)
messages.zh: 里面有淫秽言语。
messages.en: It contained obscene language.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那删掉更好。
messages.en: Then it was better to remove it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 oxxen 放在“言语”和“手势”旁联想，记成评价内容猥亵的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being obscene or lewd, or an expression or act with that quality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 淫秽或猥亵的性质，也可指具有这种性质的言语或行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' dak li hu oxxen, jew kelma jew għemil li joffendi d-diċenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淫秽；淫秽的言语、内容或行为。
猥亵；言行中带有色情意味的性质。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddiskuti l-oxxenità fil-lingwaġġ u l-effett tagħha fuq il-qarrejja.
formal.en: The report discusses obscenity in language and its effect on readers.
formal.zh: 报告讨论言语中的淫秽内容及其对读者的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tridx taqra dik ir-rivista? Mark: Hemm wisq oxxenità fiha. Maja: Nifhem. Nagħżlu xi ħaġa oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you want to read that magazine? Mark: There is too much obscenity in it. Maja: I understand. Let's choose something else.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么不想读那本杂志？马克：里面淫秽内容太多。玛雅：明白了。我们选别的吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tridx taqra dik ir-rivista?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx taqra dik ir-rivista?
messages.zh: 你为什么不想读那本杂志？
messages.en: Why don't you want to read that magazine?

messages.speaker: Mark (读者)
messages.zh: 里面淫秽内容太多。
messages.en: There is too much obscenity in it.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 明白了。我们选别的吧。
messages.en: I understand. Let's choose something else.

cognitive_memory_aid: 成对练习：oxxen 描述“猥亵的”，oxxenità 则给“猥亵这种性质或内容”命名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One of the Earth's vast connected bodies of salt water, such as the Atlantic or Pacific.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地球上面积广阔、彼此相连的咸水水域之一，如大西洋或太平洋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda mill-meded vasti u konnessi ta' ilma mielaħ fid-dinja, bħall-Atlantiku jew il-Paċifiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 洋；大洋；地球上广阔的咸水水域。

formal.mt: Il-vapur qasam l-Oċean Atlantiku biex iwassal il-merkanzija lejn l-Amerika.
formal.en: The ship crossed the Atlantic Ocean to deliver the cargo to America.
formal.zh: 这艘船横渡大西洋，把货物运往美洲。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Liema oċean hemm bejn l-Ewropa u l-Amerika ta' Fuq? Leo: L-Oċean Atlantiku. Ara kemm hu kbir fuq il-mappa!
colloquial.en: Emma: Which ocean lies between Europe and North America? Leo: The Atlantic Ocean. Look how big it is on the map!
colloquial.zh: Emma：欧洲和北美洲之间是哪个大洋？Leo：大西洋。看，它在地图上多大啊！

messages.speaker: Emma (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema oċean hemm bejn l-Ewropa u l-Amerika ta' Fuq?
messages.mt_standard: Liema oċean hemm bejn l-Ewropa u l-Amerika ta' Fuq?
messages.zh: 欧洲和北美洲之间是哪个大洋？
messages.en: Which ocean lies between Europe and North America?

messages.speaker: Leo (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-Oċean Atlantiku. Ara kemm hu kbir fuq il-mappa!
messages.mt_standard: L-Oċean Atlantiku. Ara kemm hu kbir fuq il-mappa!
messages.zh: 大西洋。看，它在地图上多大啊！
messages.en: The Atlantic Ocean. Look how big it is on the map!

cognitive_memory_aid: 看世界地图时，把 oċean 写在大陆之间大片蓝色区域上，再用“大西洋、太平洋”巩固“大洋”的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Related to an ocean or to its waters, currents, climate, or other features.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与大洋及其海水、洋流、气候等特征有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-oċean, mal-ilmijiet tiegħu, mal-kurrenti jew mal-klima tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海洋的；大洋的。
与大洋有关的；属于大洋的。

formal.mt: L-istudju jispjega kif kurrent oċeaniku jista' jinfluwenza t-temperatura tal-kosta.
formal.en: The study explains how an ocean current can influence the temperature along the coast.
formal.zh: 这项研究解释了洋流如何影响沿海地区的温度。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser kurrent oċeaniku? Pawlu: Huwa ilma li jiċċaqlaq fl-oċean f'direzzjoni partikolari.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does an ocean current mean? Pawlu: It is water moving through the ocean in a particular direction.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：洋流是什么意思？保罗：就是海洋中沿某个方向流动的海水。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 洋流是什么意思？
messages.en: What does an ocean current mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa ilma li jiċċaqlaq fl-oċean f'direzzjoni partikolari.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa ilma li jiċċaqlaq fl-oċean f'direzzjoni partikolari.
messages.zh: 就是海洋中沿某个方向流动的海水。
messages.en: It is water moving through the ocean in a particular direction.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进一幅洋流地图里记：看到海水流动，就联想 kurrent oċeaniku；说到海洋性气候，则搭配 klima oċeanika。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An individual physical thing that can be seen or touched.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可以看见或触摸到的一个具体物体或物件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaġa fiżika waħda li tista' tidher jew tintmess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 物体；物件；具体的一件东西。

formal.mt: Kull oġġett fil-wirja għandu tikketta li tispjega minn fejn ġie.
formal.en: Every object in the exhibition has a label explaining where it came from.
formal.zh: 展览中的每件物品都有标签，说明它来自哪里。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu dak l-oġġett fuq il-mejda? Toni: Huwa arloġġ antik ta' nannti.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is that object on the table? Toni: It is an old clock belonging to my grandmother.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：桌上那个物件是什么？托尼：那是我奶奶的一座旧钟。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 桌上那个物件是什么？
messages.en: What is that object on the table?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是我奶奶的一座旧钟。
messages.en: It is an old clock belonging to my grandmother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在桌上摆一本书、一支笔和一只杯子，逐一指着说 oġġett；用“能指给别人看的具体物件”这一画面帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression of disagreement with a proposal, decision, action, or bid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 针对提议、决定、行动或投标提出的不同意见、反对或质疑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni ta' nuqqas ta' qbil ma' proposta, deċiżjoni, azzjoni jew offerta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 针对投标提出的质疑或异议。
针对投标提出的抗议或申诉。
对某事的质疑；提出异议。
抗议；反对的表示。
异议；反对意见或反对理由。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat irreġistra l-oġġezzjoni tar-residenti għall-proġett u talab aktar informazzjoni.
formal.en: The committee recorded the residents' objection to the project and requested further information.
formal.zh: 委员会记录了居民对该项目的反对意见，并要求提供更多信息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek xi oġġezzjoni jekk niftħu t-tieqa? Ben: Le, m'għandi l-ebda oġġezzjoni. Hawn ħafna sħana.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have any objection if we open the window? Ben: No, I have no objection. It is very hot in here.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们把窗户打开，你有意见吗？本：没有，我没意见。这里很热。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek xi oġġezzjoni jekk niftħu t-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek xi oġġezzjoni jekk niftħu t-tieqa?
messages.zh: 我们把窗户打开，你有意见吗？
messages.en: Do you have any objection if we open the window?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, m'għandi l-ebda oġġezzjoni. Hawn ħafna sħana.
messages.mt_standard: Le, m'għandi l-ebda oġġezzjoni. Hawn ħafna sħana.
messages.zh: 没有，我没意见。这里很热。
messages.en: No, I have no objection. It is very hot in here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 oġġezzjoni 和开会时举手说“我有异议”的场景绑定；再配对记忆“提出异议”和“没有异议”，就能同时掌握正式与日常用法。

gloss_zh: 厚的；胖的；肿胀的；声音低沉粗哑的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Thick in physical size; also fat when describing a person or animal, swollen in context, or deep and rough when describing a voice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示物体厚或粗；形容人或动物时可表示胖，特定语境中可表示肿胀，形容声音时可表示低沉或粗哑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħxuna kbira; għal persuna jew annimal jista' jfisser li għandu ħafna xaħam, għal parti tal-ġisem li hi minfuħa, u għal leħen li hu baxx jew aħrax.

sense_translations.en_definition: fat (used of a person or animal)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 胖的；用于形容人或动物体形肥胖。
厚的；例如形容一本书很厚。
肿胀的；因肿起而变粗大的。

sense_translations.en_definition: deep or gravelly (used of a voice)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 声音低沉或粗哑的。
肥胖的；体重过重的。
厚的；粗的；厚度或粗细较大的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport inġabar fi ktieb oħxon li jinkludi t-tabelli u d-dokumenti kollha.
formal.en: The report was compiled into a thick book containing all the tables and documents.
formal.zh: 这份报告被汇编成一本厚书，包含全部表格和文件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-ktieb oħxon wisq biex inġorru fil-basket. Mark: Ħu dak iż-żgħir illum, u ħalli dan id-dar.
colloquial.en: Lara: This book is too thick for me to carry in my bag. Mark: Take the small one today, and leave this one at home.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这本书太厚了，我没法放在包里带着走。马克：今天带那本小的吧，把这本留在家里。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ktieb oħxon wisq biex inġorru fil-basket.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ktieb oħxon wisq biex inġorru fil-basket.
messages.zh: 这本书太厚了，我没法放在包里带着走。
messages.en: This book is too thick for me to carry in my bag.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu dak iż-żgħir illum, u ħalli dan id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu dak iż-żgħir illum, u ħalli dan id-dar.
messages.zh: 今天带那本小的吧，把这本留在家里。
messages.en: Take the small one today, and leave this one at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅画记语境：厚书对应“厚”，胖猫对应“胖”，低沉嗓音对应声音“粗”；若描述受伤后变粗的部位，再按语境理解为“肿胀”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male peafowl, known for its long, colourful tail feathers that it can spread out in a display.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 雄孔雀，以能够展开作展示的修长、色彩鲜艳的尾羽闻名。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur maskili magħruf għar-rix twil u mlewwen ta' denbu, li jiftħu biex juri ruħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雄孔雀，具有能够展开作展示的华丽尾羽。

collocations.zh: 一只色彩鲜艳的雄孔雀

formal.mt: Il-pagun fetaħ denbu u wera r-rix ikkulurit tiegħu lill-viżitaturi tal-ġnien.
formal.en: The peacock spread its tail and showed its colourful feathers to the garden's visitors.
formal.zh: 雄孔雀展开尾巴，向花园里的游客展示色彩鲜艳的羽毛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak il-pagun ħdejn is-siġra! Mark: Kemm għandu rix sabiħ! Maja: Ejja nieqfu hawn u narawh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that peacock near the tree! Mark: What beautiful feathers it has! Maja: Let's stop here and watch it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看树旁边那只雄孔雀！马克：它的羽毛真漂亮！玛雅：我们停在这里看看吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 看树旁边那只雄孔雀！
messages.en: Look at that peacock near the tree!

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 它的羽毛真漂亮！
messages.en: What beautiful feathers it has!

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 我们停在这里看看吧。
messages.en: Let's stop here and watch it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pagun 写在雄孔雀开屏的图旁，再搭配 rix tal-pagun 记住它和华丽羽毛的联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool with a broad blade and a handle, used for digging or moving soil and other loose material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 铲或锹：带有宽铲面和手柄，用于挖土或搬移泥土等松散物料的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'xafra wiesgħa u manku, li tintuża biex tħaffer jew iċċaqlaq il-ħamrija u materjal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 球拍。
铲；用于铲起或搬移泥土等物料的工具。
锹；用于挖土或翻土的工具。
铲；锹。

sense_translations.en_definition: palm of the hand; or the inner part of the hand (including the fingers)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 手掌；也可指包括手指在内的手的内侧。

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar uża pala biex iħaffer toqba għas-siġra l-ġdida.
formal.en: The gardener used a spade to dig a hole for the new tree.
formal.zh: 园丁用锹为新树挖了一个坑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' ġġibli l-pala mill-garaxx? Mark: Iva, trid tħaffer hawn? Maja: Iva, biex inħawwel din il-pjanta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you bring me the spade from the garage? Mark: Yes. Do you want to dig here? Maja: Yes, to plant this plant.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你能把车库里的锹拿给我吗？Mark：可以。你要在这里挖土吗？Maja：对，我要种这株植物。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你能把车库里的锹拿给我吗？
messages.en: Can you bring me the spade from the garage?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 可以。你要在这里挖土吗？
messages.en: Yes. Do you want to dig here?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，我要种这株植物。
messages.en: Yes, to plant this plant.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把宽宽的铲面和摊开的手掌并排想象，记住 pala 可指铲锹，也可指手掌；遇到运动语境再联想到球拍。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A handheld tool with a flat head, used to strike and kill flies.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 苍蝇拍：带有扁平拍面、用手握持来拍打苍蝇的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'manku u ras ċatta, li tintuża biex tolqot u toqtol id-dubbien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苍蝇拍；用来拍打苍蝇的工具。
白琵鹭（Platalea leucorodia），一种喙端宽扁、形似汤匙的鸟。

formal.mt: Il-paletta tad-dubbien għandha tinżamm 'il bogħod mill-ikel.
formal.en: The fly swatter should be kept away from food.
formal.zh: 苍蝇拍应放在远离食物的地方。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hemm dubbiena fil-kċina. Fejn hi l-paletta? Pawlu: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: There is a fly in the kitchen. Where is the fly swatter? Pawlu: In the drawer next to the door.
colloquial.zh: Lara：厨房里有只苍蝇。苍蝇拍在哪里？Pawlu：在门旁边的抽屉里。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm dubbiena fil-kċina. Fejn hi l-paletta?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm dubbiena fil-kċina. Fejn hi l-paletta?
messages.zh: 厨房里有只苍蝇。苍蝇拍在哪里？
messages.en: There is a fly in the kitchen. Where is the fly swatter?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 在门旁边的抽屉里。
messages.en: In the drawer next to the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 paletta 记成厨房里扁平的苍蝇拍，再用白琵鹭扁宽的喙作第二张记忆图；这是形象联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 舞台；戏剧活动；台架；包厢

teaching_sense.en_definition: A raised area where actors, musicians, or other performers appear before an audience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 舞台：供演员、音乐家等在观众面前演出的高起区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post merfugħ fejn atturi, mużiċisti jew artisti oħra jagħtu wirja quddiem udjenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 舞台；供表演者演出的区域。

sense_translations.en_definition: generic term for the theatre and related activities
sense_translations.zh_definition: 戏剧及其相关表演活动的统称。
台架；高台；平台。
剧院等演出场所内的包厢。

formal.mt: L-atturi kollha telgħu fuq il-palk biex jirringrazzjaw lill-udjenza.
formal.en: All the actors went on stage to thank the audience.
formal.zh: 全体演员登上舞台，向观众致谢。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Se titla' fuq il-palk illejla? David: Iva, se nkanta mal-grupp. Nina: Se nkun hemm biex narak!
colloquial.en: Nina: Are you going on stage tonight? David: Yes, I am going to sing with the group. Nina: I will be there to see you!
colloquial.zh: Nina：你今晚要上台吗？David：对，我要和乐队一起唱歌。Nina：我会去看你演出！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今晚要上台吗？
messages.en: Are you going on stage tonight?

messages.speaker: David (表演者)
messages.zh: 对，我要和乐队一起唱歌。
messages.en: Yes, I am going to sing with the group.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我会去看你演出！
messages.en: I will be there to see you!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象演员走上高台，观众坐在包厢里看戏，把整个剧场画面与 palk 连起来；先熟记 fuq il-palk，表示在舞台上。

gloss_zh: 礼仪覆布；披肩；宗教披带

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ceremonial covering cloth, such as a cloth used to cover a chalice in a religious service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 礼仪覆布，例如宗教仪式中用于覆盖圣爵的布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp li tintuża bħala għata f'ċerimonja reliġjuża, pereżempju biex tgħatti l-kalċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 礼仪覆布；可指棺罩、柩衣，或覆盖圣爵的礼仪用布。
披肩式外衣；在宗教语境中指礼仪披带。

formal.mt: Qabel iċ-ċelebrazzjoni, is-sagristan poġġa l-palla ħdejn il-kalċi.
formal.en: Before the service, the sacristan placed the pall beside the chalice.
formal.zh: 礼仪开始前，教堂司事把覆布放在圣爵旁边。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn inpoġġi l-palla? Ġużeppi: Ħdejn il-kalċi, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where shall I put the pall? Ġużeppi: Beside the chalice, please.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我把这块礼仪覆布放在哪里？Ġużeppi：请放在圣爵旁边。

messages.speaker: Marija (教堂志愿者)
messages.zh: 我把这块礼仪覆布放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall I put the pall?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (教堂司事)
messages.zh: 请放在圣爵旁边。
messages.en: Beside the chalice, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 palla 放进宗教礼仪的画面中记忆：一幅图是覆盖器物的布，另一幅图是披在肩上的礼仪披带，靠上下文区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cloth or a piece of cloth used for purposes such as wiping, covering, or making things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 布或一块布，可用于擦拭、覆盖或制作物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Drapp jew biċċa drapp li tintuża biex timsaħ, tgħatti jew tagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毡；由纤维压合而成的布状材料。
布；布料；一块布。

formal.mt: Naddaf il-wiċċ tal-mejda b'pannu niedi u mbagħad nixxfu.
formal.en: Clean the surface of the table with a damp cloth and then dry it.
formal.zh: 用湿布清洁桌面，然后将桌面擦干。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xerridt ftit ilma fuq il-mejda. Toni: Ħu dan il-pannu u imsaħha.
colloquial.en: Sara: I spilled some water on the table. Toni: Take this cloth and wipe it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我把一点水洒在桌上了。Toni：拿这块布把桌子擦一下。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 我把一点水洒在桌上了。
messages.en: I spilled some water on the table.

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 拿这块布把桌子擦一下。
messages.en: Take this cloth and wipe it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手边一块 pannu，弄湿后擦桌子；再把厚实的毡布放在旁边，记住这个词既能表示布，也有毡的义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A light, comfortable shoe worn indoors, usually as one of a pair of slippers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拖鞋：通常在室内穿着的轻便舒适鞋；papoċċ 指其中一只。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żarbun ħafif u komdu li jintlibes ġewwa d-dar, ġeneralment bħala wieħed minn par papoċċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拖鞋；词形 papoċċ 为单数，指一只拖鞋。

formal.mt: Kull mistieden isib par papoċċi ħdejn is-sodda.
formal.en: Each guest will find a pair of slippers beside the bed.
formal.zh: 每位客人都能在床边找到一双拖鞋。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Fejn hu l-papoċċ l-ieħor tiegħi? Adam: Taħt is-sodda. Lina: Sibtha, grazzi!
colloquial.en: Lina: Where is my other slipper? Adam: Under the bed. Lina: I found it, thanks!
colloquial.zh: Lina：我另一只拖鞋在哪里？Adam：在床底下。Lina：找到了，谢谢！

messages.speaker: Lina (姐姐)
messages.zh: 我另一只拖鞋在哪里？
