messages.en: Where is my other slipper?

messages.speaker: Adam (弟弟)
messages.zh: 在床底下。
messages.en: Under the bed.

messages.speaker: Lina (姐姐)
messages.zh: 找到了，谢谢！
messages.en: I found it, thanks!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用找拖鞋的画面记忆：一只叫 papoċċ，一双说 par papoċċi；把单只和成双的表达一起练习，更容易开口。

gloss_zh: 鹦鹉；只会重复别人话的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bird with a curved beak, often kept as a pet; some parrots can imitate human speech.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鹦鹉：一种喙弯曲、常被作为宠物饲养的鸟，其中一些能模仿人说话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur b'munqar mgħawweġ, li spiss jinżamm bħala annimal domestiku; xi pappagalli jistgħu jimitaw il-kliem tal-bniedem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鹦鹉。
鹦鹉，指鸟类。

sense_translations.en_definition: parrot (person who repeats what was said)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鹦鹉学舌的人；只会重复别人说过的话的人。

collocations.zh: 像鹦鹉一样重复；鹦鹉学舌

formal.mt: L-istudent għandu jispjega l-idea fi kliemu, mhux jirrepeti s-sentenza bħal pappagall.
formal.en: The student should explain the idea in their own words, rather than repeat the sentence like a parrot.
formal.zh: 学生应当用自己的话解释这个想法，而不是像鹦鹉一样重复句子。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Il-pappagall tiegħek jitkellem? Luqa: Iva, jgħid bonġu kull filgħodu. Emma: Mela għada nsellimlu!
colloquial.en: Emma: Does your parrot talk? Luqa: Yes, it says good morning every morning. Emma: Then I will say hello to it tomorrow!
colloquial.zh: Emma：你的鹦鹉会说话吗？Luqa：会，它每天早上都说早安。Emma：那我明天跟它打个招呼！

messages.speaker: Emma (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的鹦鹉会说话吗？
messages.en: Does your parrot talk?

messages.speaker: Luqa (鹦鹉主人)
messages.zh: 会，它每天早上都说早安。
messages.en: Yes, it says good morning every morning.

messages.speaker: Emma (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我明天跟它打个招呼！
messages.en: Then I will say hello to it tomorrow!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只 pappagall 反复说早安，再把画面移到只会重复别人话的人身上；鸟义和比喻义便能一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A water bird with a broad, flat bill and webbed feet, often seen swimming on ponds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸭子：一种喙宽扁、脚有蹼的水鸟，常见于池塘中游泳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ilma b'munqar wiesa' u ċatt u saqajn bis-swaba' magħqudin b'rita, li spiss jidher jgħum fl-għadajjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸭；鸭子。

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara edukattiva, it-tfal osservaw papra tgħum fl-għadira.
formal.en: During the educational visit, the children observed a duck swimming in the pond.
formal.zh: 在教学参观期间，孩子们观察了一只在池塘里游泳的鸭子。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Ara dik il-papra ħdejn l-ilma! Rita: Qed taraha tidħol fl-għadira? Ben: Iva, issa qed tgħum.
colloquial.en: Ben: Look at that duck beside the water! Rita: Can you see it going into the pond? Ben: Yes, now it is swimming.
colloquial.zh: Ben：看水边那只鸭子！Rita：你看到它下到池塘里了吗？Ben：看到了，它现在正在游泳。

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.zh: 看水边那只鸭子！
messages.en: Look at that duck beside the water!

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 你看到它下到池塘里了吗？
messages.en: Can you see it going into the pond?

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.zh: 看到了，它现在正在游泳。
messages.en: Yes, now it is swimming.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 papra 和池塘里的鸭子绑定记忆：宽扁的嘴、划水的蹼脚，再念 papra fl-għadira，连同场景一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sound a car horn, especially to warn someone or attract attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按响汽车喇叭，尤指为了提醒他人或引起注意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti ħoss bil-ħorn ta' karozza, speċjalment biex twissi lil xi ħadd jew tiġbed l-attenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按响汽车喇叭。

sense_translations.en_definition: to hoot, to sound the horn
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸣喇叭；使喇叭发出响声。

formal.mt: Is-sewwieq paqpaq bil-ħorn biex iwissi lil min kien qed jaqsam it-triq.
formal.en: The driver honked the horn to warn the people crossing the road.
formal.zh: 司机按响喇叭，提醒正在过马路的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex paqpaq dak is-sewwieq? Toni: Paqpaq biex jiġbed l-attenzjoni tagħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did that driver honk? Toni: He honked to get our attention.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个司机为什么按喇叭？托尼：他按喇叭是为了引起我们的注意。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个司机为什么按喇叭？
messages.en: Why did that driver honk?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 他按喇叭是为了引起我们的注意。
messages.en: He honked to get our attention.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 paqpaq 的重复字形想成两下短促的喇叭声，再配上司机按喇叭的画面；这只是记忆联想。

gloss_zh: 一对；一双；两个配成的一组

teaching_sense.en_definition: Two people or things considered together, especially two matching items used as a set.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 合在一起看待的两个人或两件东西，尤指配套使用的一对或一双物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żewġ persuni jew affarijiet meqjusa flimkien, speċjalment żewġ oġġetti li jaqblu u jintużaw flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 两个合在一起的人或事物；一对。
成对的两个；一对或一双。
两个组成的一组；一对、一双。

formal.mt: Għax-xogħol fil-ġnien, kull parteċipant għandu jġib par ingwanti.
formal.en: For the gardening work, each participant should bring a pair of gloves.
formal.zh: 参加园艺劳动时，每位参与者应带一副手套。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qed infittex par żraben għax-xogħol. Rita: Dan il-par huwa ħafif u komdu.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm looking for a pair of shoes for work. Rita: This pair is light and comfortable.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我想找一双上班穿的鞋。丽塔：这双又轻又舒服。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 我想找一双上班穿的鞋。
messages.en: I'm looking for a pair of shoes for work.

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-par huwa ħafif u komdu.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-par huwa ħafif u komdu.
messages.zh: 这双又轻又舒服。
messages.en: This pair is light and comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 par 放在两只鞋中间，记成“两件配成一组”；遇到鞋和手套时，中文分别用“双”和“副”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An opinion or recommendation offered to help someone decide what to do.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了帮助他人决定如何行动而提出的意见、建议或忠告。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Opinjoni jew suġġeriment mogħti biex jgħin lil xi ħadd jiddeċiedi x'għandu jagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 帮助他人作出决定或采取行动的建议。
经过考虑而给予的忠告或指点。
建议、忠告；供他人参考的意见。

formal.mt: Qabel ma għażlet il-kors, Sara talbet parir mingħand l-għalliema tagħha.
formal.en: Before choosing the course, Sara asked her teacher for advice.
formal.zh: 萨拉在选择课程之前，向她的老师征求了建议。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandi bżonn parir dwar dan il-kors. Mark: Tkellem mal-għalliem; jista' jgħinek tagħżel.
colloquial.en: Sara: I need some advice about this course. Mark: Talk to the teacher; he can help you choose.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：关于这门课程，我需要一点建议。马克：跟老师谈谈吧，他可以帮你作选择。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi bżonn parir dwar dan il-kors.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi bżonn parir dwar dan il-kors.
messages.zh: 关于这门课程，我需要一点建议。
messages.en: I need some advice about this course.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 跟老师谈谈吧，他可以帮你作选择。
messages.en: Talk to the teacher; he can help you choose.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己选课犹豫时向老师要 parir，把这个词与“请给我一点建议”的完整场景一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country's legislative body, whose members debate public matters and consider and pass laws.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 国家的立法机构，其成员讨论公共事务、审议并通过法律。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istituzzjoni leġiżlattiva ta' pajjiż, li fiha l-membri jiddiskutu affarijiet pubbliċi u jeżaminaw u jgħaddu liġijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 议会；负责讨论国家公共事务、审议和通过法律的立法机构。

formal.mt: Il-parlament iddiskuta l-proposta għal liġi ġdida dwar l-edukazzjoni.
formal.en: Parliament debated the proposal for a new law on education.
formal.zh: 议会讨论了一项有关教育的新法律提案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed jiddiskuti l-parlament illum? Toni: Qed jiddiskuti liġi ġdida dwar l-edukazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is parliament discussing today? Toni: It's discussing a new law on education.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：议会今天在讨论什么？托尼：在讨论一部有关教育的新法律。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 议会今天在讨论什么？
messages.en: What is parliament discussing today?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jiddiskuti liġi ġdida dwar l-edukazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jiddiskuti liġi ġdida dwar l-edukazzjoni.
messages.zh: 在讨论一部有关教育的新法律。
messages.en: It's discussing a new law on education.

cognitive_memory_aid: 借英语 parliament 的相似拼写记住 parlament，再想象议员围坐讨论法律的议会场景；相似拼写仅作学习提示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to parliament, its members, or the way its business is conducted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与议会、议员或议会事务的进行方式有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-parlament, mal-membri tiegħu jew mal-mod kif isir ix-xogħol tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 议会的；与议会有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: having to do with the affairs of parliament
sense_translations.zh_definition: 涉及议会事务的；与议会工作有关的。
议会的；与议员或议会活动有关的。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat parlamentari eżamina l-proposta u talab aktar informazzjoni.
formal.en: The parliamentary committee examined the proposal and requested more information.
formal.zh: 议会委员会审查了这项提案，并要求提供更多资料。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dibattitu parlamentari? Pawlu: Huwa dibattitu li jsir fil-parlament dwar kwistjoni jew proposta.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is a parliamentary debate? Pawlu: It's a debate held in parliament about an issue or proposal.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：什么是议会辩论？保罗：就是在议会中就某个问题或提案进行的辩论。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是议会辩论？
messages.en: What is a parliamentary debate?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa dibattitu li jsir fil-parlament dwar kwistjoni jew proposta.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa dibattitu li jsir fil-parlament dwar kwistjoni jew proposta.
messages.zh: 就是在议会中就某个问题或提案进行的辩论。
messages.en: It's a debate held in parliament about an issue or proposal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 parlament“议会”和 parlamentari“议会的”并排记，再用“议会辩论”练习形容词修饰名词。

gloss_zh: 溜走；逃离；另指鸽子咕咕叫

teaching_sense.en_definition: To leave quickly, flee, or make oneself scarce; in a separate sense, to coo like a pigeon or dove.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 迅速离开、逃走或躲开；另有独立义项，指像鸽子那样咕咕叫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titlaq malajr, taħrab jew twarrab biex ma tidhirx; f'tifsira oħra, tagħmel il-ħoss artab tal-ħamiem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 匆匆离去；溜走。
逃走；逃离某处或某种处境。
躲开；悄悄离开，以免被人找到或注意到。

sense_translations.en_definition: to go away, to make off
sense_translations.zh_definition: 离开；迅速走掉或溜走。
咕咕叫，指鸽子等发出轻柔的叫声。

formal.mt: Malli sema' l-allarm, ir-raġel parpar minn fuq il-post.
formal.en: As soon as he heard the alarm, the man fled the scene.
formal.zh: 那名男子一听到警报声，就逃离了现场。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar Mark? Toni: Parpar malli ra lill-għalliem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did Mark go? Toni: He made himself scarce as soon as he saw the teacher.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克去哪儿了？托尼：他一看到老师就溜了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 马克去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Mark go?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.zh: 他一看到老师就溜了。
messages.en: He made himself scarce as soon as he saw the teacher.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 parpar 画两张独立记忆卡：一张是人迅速溜走，一张是鸽子咕咕叫；用主语和情境区分义项。

gloss_zh: 教父；洗礼中的男性教亲

teaching_sense.en_definition: A man who serves as a godparent at a child's baptism and supports the child's religious upbringing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在孩子受洗时担任教亲，并协助其宗教成长的男性，即教父。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġel li jieħu r-rwol ta' parrinu fil-magħmudija ta' tifel jew tifla u jgħin fit-trobbija reliġjuża tiegħu jew tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 教父；在洗礼中为孩子担任教亲的男性。
教父；承担孩子洗礼教亲职责并协助其宗教成长的男性。

formal.mt: Fil-jum tal-magħmudija, il-parrinu qagħad ħdejn il-ġenituri tat-tarbija.
formal.en: On the day of the baptism, the godfather stood beside the baby's parents.
formal.zh: 洗礼当天，教父站在婴儿父母的身旁。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min se jkun il-parrinu ta' bintek? Anna: Ħija se jkun il-parrinu tagħha.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who will be your daughter's godfather? Anna: My brother will be her godfather.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：谁来当你女儿的教父？安娜：我兄弟会当她的教父。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jkun il-parrinu ta' bintek?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jkun il-parrinu ta' bintek?
messages.zh: 谁来当你女儿的教父？
messages.en: Who will be your daughter's godfather?

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 我兄弟会当她的教父。
messages.en: My brother will be her godfather.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象婴儿受洗时，父母身旁站着一位男性教亲，把 parrinu 与“洗礼中的教父”这一身份连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To leave or depart from a place; also to start, begin, or start running.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从某处离开或启程；也可指开始，或机器等启动运转。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titlaq minn post jew tibda vjaġġ; ukoll tibda xi ħaġa jew tibda taħdem, bħal magna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 离开某处；动身。
启程；出发；离去。
离开；走开；启程前往别处。
开始；启动，亦可指机器开始运转。

collocations.en: the ship departed from the harbour
the engine started on the first attempt

formal.mt: Il-vapur parta mill-port fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu u kompla l-vjaġġ tiegħu.
formal.en: The ship departed from the harbour at nine in the morning and continued its journey.
formal.zh: 船于上午九点从港口启航，继续航程。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-mutur parta dalgħodu? Toni: Iva, parta mal-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did the engine start this morning? Toni: Yes, it started on the first attempt.
colloquial.zh: 马克：今天早上发动机启动了吗？托尼：启动了，一下就着了。

messages.speaker: Mark (车主)
messages.zh: 今天早上发动机启动了吗？
messages.en: Did the engine start this morning?

messages.speaker: Toni (修车师傅)
messages.zh: 启动了，一下就着了。
messages.en: Yes, it started on the first attempt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 parta 配上两个画面：船离港启程、发动机启动运转；记住它既能表示“离开”，也能表示“开始”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To exchange one thing for another or trade goods without money; also, to become engaged to marry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用一件东西交换另一件东西，或不用金钱而以物易物；也可表示订婚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti ħaġa u jieħu oħra minflokha, jew ibiddel oġġetti mingħajr ħlas ta' flus; jista' jfisser ukoll li jitgħarras.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 交换某物。
以物易物；用物品交换物品。
订婚；与某人订立婚约。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi partat parti mill-ħaxix tiegħu mal-frott ta' bidwi ieħor, mingħajr ma ntużaw flus.
formal.en: The farmer bartered some of his vegetables for another farmer's fruit, without using money.
formal.zh: 这位农民用自己的一部分蔬菜换了另一位农民的水果，没有使用金钱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ktieb minn fejn ġie? Mark: Ħija partat ktieb tiegħu ma' dan. Maja: Mela ħa ktieb ieħor mingħajr ma ħallas!
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did this book come from? Mark: My brother exchanged one of his books for it. Maja: So he got another book without paying!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书是哪儿来的？马克：我哥哥用自己的一本书换来的。玛雅：那他没花钱就得到另一本书了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这本书是哪儿来的？
messages.en: Where did this book come from?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija partat ktieb tiegħu ma' dan.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija partat ktieb tiegħu ma' dan.
messages.zh: 我哥哥用自己的一本书换来的。
messages.en: My brother exchanged one of his books for it.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ħa ktieb ieħor mingħajr ma ħallas!
messages.mt_standard: Mela ħa ktieb ieħor mingħajr ma ħallas!
messages.zh: 那他没花钱就得到另一本书了！
messages.en: So he got another book without paying!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“两人互换书本”的画面记住交换义，再把订婚义单独配上婚约场景，依上下文区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of leaving or setting off, the beginning of a journey or movement, or the time when departure occurs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 离开或启程这一行为，也指旅程或行进的开始，以及出发的时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tluq jew il-bidu ta' vjaġġ jew moviment; ukoll il-ħin meta jsir it-tluq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出发；启程；离开。
出发时间；启程时刻。
出发；开始；起步。

formal.mt: Il-partenza tal-karozza tal-linja hija skedata għat-tmienja ta' filgħodu; il-passiġġieri għandhom jaslu għaxar minuti qabel.
formal.en: The bus departure is scheduled for eight in the morning; passengers should arrive ten minutes beforehand.
formal.zh: 巴士定于上午八点出发；乘客应提前十分钟到达。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ħin hi l-partenza? Ben: Fid-disgħa, imma rridu nkunu hemm qabel. Lara: Tajjeb, nitlaq mid-dar fit-tmienja.
colloquial.en: Lara: What time is departure? Ben: At nine, but we need to be there earlier. Lara: Okay, I'll leave home at eight.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：几点出发？本：九点，不过我们得早点到。拉拉：好，那我八点从家里出门。

messages.speaker: Lara (旅伴)
messages.zh: 几点出发？
messages.en: What time is departure?

messages.speaker: Ben (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Fid-disgħa, imma rridu nkunu hemm qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Fid-disgħa, imma rridu nkunu hemm qabel.
messages.zh: 九点，不过我们得早点到。
messages.en: At nine, but we need to be there earlier.

messages.speaker: Lara (旅伴)
messages.zh: 好，那我八点从家里出门。
messages.en: Okay, I'll leave home at eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象车站出发牌：partenza 既可指车辆出发，也可指牌上写的出发时刻，还可联想到起点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who takes part in an event, activity, or discussion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参加某项活动、事件或讨论的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tieħu sehem f'avveniment, attività jew diskussjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 参与者；参加活动的人。
参与的；参加某项活动的。

formal.mt: Kull parteċipant fil-kors għandu jimla l-formola ta' reġistrazzjoni qabel l-ewwel lezzjoni.
formal.en: Every participant in the course must complete the registration form before the first lesson.
formal.zh: 每位课程参加者都必须在第一节课之前填写报名表。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Int ukoll parteċipant fil-kors tat-tisjir? David: Iva, din l-ewwel darba tiegħi. Sara: Tajjeb, nistgħu naħdmu flimkien!
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you taking part in the cooking course too? David: Yes, this is my first time. Sara: Great, we can work together!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你也参加这个烹饪课程吗？戴维：是的，这是我第一次参加。萨拉：好呀，我们可以一起做！

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你也参加这个烹饪课程吗？
messages.en: Are you taking part in the cooking course too?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: 是的，这是我第一次参加。
messages.en: Yes, this is my first time.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 好呀，我们可以一起做！
messages.en: Great, we can work together!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象活动签到表上的一个人：名词指参与者；放在国家等名词后面时，可表示参与的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of taking part in an activity, event, or discussion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参加活动、事件或讨论这一行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li wieħed jieħu sehem f'attività, avveniment jew diskussjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 参与；参加某项活动的行为。

formal.mt: Il-proġett jinkoraġġixxi l-parteċipazzjoni attiva tar-residenti fid-deċiżjonijiet dwar il-lokalità.
formal.en: The project encourages residents' active participation in decisions about the locality.
formal.zh: 该项目鼓励居民积极参与有关本地区的决策。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandi nitkellem waqt il-laqgħa? Pawlu: Iva, il-parteċipazzjoni tiegħek importanti. Nina: Mela ngħid l-idea tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Should I speak during the meeting? Pawlu: Yes, your participation matters. Nina: Then I'll share my idea.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我应该在会上发言吗？保罗：应该，你的参与很重要。妮娜：那我就说说我的想法。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 我应该在会上发言吗？
messages.en: Should I speak during the meeting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 应该，你的参与很重要。
messages.en: Yes, your participation matters.

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 那我就说说我的想法。
messages.en: Then I'll share my idea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它和参与者一起记：parteċipant 是参加的人，parteċipazzjoni 是参与这件事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A private individual, especially someone who employs another person; also, an individual detail or particular.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 私人或个人，尤其指雇用他人的私人雇主；也指某个具体细节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna privata, speċjalment waħda li timpjega lil xi ħadd; ukoll dettall wieħed ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 私人雇主；以私人身份雇用他人的人。
细节；具体事项。
私人；以个人身份而非机构身份行事的人。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport għandu jinkludi kull partikular rilevanti tal-każ, inklużi d-data u l-post tal-laqgħa.
formal.en: The report should include every relevant detail of the case, including the date and location of the meeting.
formal.zh: 报告应包含该案件的每个相关细节，包括会面的日期和地点。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Issa fejn qed taħdem? Toni: Qed naħdem ma' partikular, nieħu ħsieb il-ġnien tiegħu. Rita: U qed jogħġbok ix-xogħol?
colloquial.en: Rita: Where are you working now? Toni: I'm working for a private employer, looking after his garden. Rita: And are you enjoying the work?
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你现在在哪儿工作？托尼：我在给一位私人雇主工作，照料他的花园。丽塔：那你喜欢这份工作吗？

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你现在在哪儿工作？
messages.en: Where are you working now?

messages.speaker: Toni (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naħdem ma' partikular, nieħu ħsieb il-ġnien tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Qed naħdem ma' partikular, nieħu ħsieb il-ġnien tiegħu.
messages.zh: 我在给一位私人雇主工作，照料他的花园。
messages.en: I'm working for a private employer, looking after his garden.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 那你喜欢这份工作吗？
messages.en: And are you enjoying the work?

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两幅图记忆：花园主人代表私人雇主，报告里的一个小项目代表细节；本词条两者都是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Referring to a specific person or thing, or describing something special or distinctive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某个特定的人或事物，也可形容事物特别或具有独特之处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jirreferi għal persuna jew ħaġa speċifika, jew li għandu xi ħaġa speċjali li tiddistingwih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 特定的；特别的；有独特之处的。

formal.mt: L-istudju jagħti attenzjoni partikulari lill-ħtiġijiet tal-istudenti li għadhom kif bdew jitgħallmu l-Malti.
formal.en: The study gives special attention to the needs of students who have just started learning Maltese.
formal.zh: 该研究特别关注刚开始学习马耳他语的学生的需求。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għażilt dan il-ġobon? Leo: Għandu togħma partikulari li togħġobni ħafna. Maja: Ħa nduqu jien ukoll!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you choose this cheese? Leo: It has a distinctive taste that I really like. Maja: Let me try it too!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么选这种奶酪？莱奥：它有一种我很喜欢的独特味道。玛雅：我也来尝尝！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么选这种奶酪？
messages.en: Why did you choose this cheese?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu togħma partikulari li togħġobni ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu togħma partikulari li togħġobni ħafna.
messages.zh: 它有一种我很喜欢的独特味道。
messages.en: It has a distinctive taste that I really like.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我也来尝尝！
messages.en: Let me try it too!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用笔圈出某一个案例，再给独特味道画星号：两个动作分别帮助记住特定和特别。

gloss_zh: 政党；党派；订婚时交换戒指

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized political group; also, the exchange of rings when a couple becomes engaged.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有组织的政治团体，即政党或党派；也指情侣订婚时交换戒指这一行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaqda politika organizzata; ukoll il-bdil taċ-ċrieket meta koppja titgħarras.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 政党；有组织的政治团体。

sense_translations.en_definition: exchange of rings during a wedding engagement
sense_translations.zh_definition: 订婚时交换戒指。
党派；政党。

formal.mt: Kull partit politiku għandu jippreżenta l-proposti tiegħu b'mod ċar sabiex il-votanti jkunu jistgħu jqabbluhom.
formal.en: Every political party should present its proposals clearly so that voters can compare them.
formal.zh: 每个政党都应清楚地提出自己的主张，让选民能够进行比较。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Qrajt il-programm ta' dan il-partit? Mark: Għadni le. X'jgħid dwar it-trasport? Anna: Għandu diversi proposti dwar il-karozzi tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Anna: Have you read this party's programme? Mark: Not yet. What does it say about transport? Anna: It has several proposals about buses.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你读过这个政党的纲领吗？马克：还没有。里面对交通怎么说？安娜：里面有几项关于巴士的建议。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你读过这个政党的纲领吗？
messages.en: Have you read this party's programme?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 还没有。里面对交通怎么说？
messages.en: Not yet. What does it say about transport?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu diversi proposti dwar il-karozzi tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu diversi proposti dwar il-karozzi tal-linja.
messages.zh: 里面有几项关于巴士的建议。
messages.en: It has several proposals about buses.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用政党纲领记常见政治义，再单独配一幅订婚交换戒指的图；看到戒指语境时切换词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sporting match or game, especially a football game; also, a large quantity of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一场体育比赛，尤其指足球赛；也可表示某物数量很大。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Logħba sportiva, speċjalment tal-futbol; ukoll kwantità kbira ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体育比赛；一场竞赛。
足球比赛；一场足球赛。
大量；一大批。
比赛；一场对局或赛事。

formal.mt: Il-partita futbol bejn iż-żewġ skejjel se ssir is-Sibt filgħodu fil-grawnd tal-lokalità.
formal.en: The football match between the two schools will take place on Saturday morning at the local ground.
formal.zh: 两所学校之间的足球比赛将于星期六上午在当地球场举行。

colloquial.mt: David: Se tara l-partita llejla? Sara: Iva, niġi għandek fit-tmienja. David: Tajjeb, il-logħba tibda fit-tmienja u nofs.
colloquial.en: David: Are you going to watch the match tonight? Sara: Yes, I'll come to your place at eight. David: Great, the game starts at half past eight.
colloquial.zh: 戴维：你今晚看比赛吗？萨拉：看，我八点去你家。戴维：好，比赛八点半开始。

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今晚看比赛吗？
messages.en: Are you going to watch the match tonight?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，我八点去你家。
messages.en: Yes, I'll come to your place at eight.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, il-logħba tibda fit-tmienja u nofs.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, il-logħba tibda fit-tmienja u nofs.
messages.zh: 好，比赛八点半开始。
messages.en: Great, the game starts at half past eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用一场足球赛记 partita，再用一大堆书记数量义；与 partit 对照，留意末尾的 a。

gloss_zh: 政党支持者；党员；党派拥护者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who supports a political party or its aims.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支持某个政党或其主张的人；在具体语境中也可指党员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tappoġġja partit politiku jew l-għanijiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某个政党的支持者。
政党成员；党员。
坚定拥护某一党派或阵营的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-kelliem ġie deskritt bħala partitarju tal-partit.
formal.en: In the report, the speaker was described as a supporter of the party.
formal.zh: 报告将这位发言者描述为该党的支持者。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark huwa partitarju ta' dak il-partit? Lara: Iva, imma mhux membru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Mark a supporter of that party? Lara: Yes, but he isn't a member.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克是那个党的支持者吗？拉拉：是的，但他不是党员。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark huwa partitarju ta' dak il-partit?
messages.mt_standard: Mark huwa partitarju ta' dak il-partit?
messages.zh: 马克是那个党的支持者吗？
messages.en: Is Mark a supporter of that party?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，但他不是党员。
messages.en: Yes, but he isn't a member.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象集会上举旗支持政党的人，用这个画面记住 partitarju；是否具有党员身份要看上下文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To some extent or in part, rather than completely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某种情况只涉及一部分，或只达到一定程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sa ċertu punt jew f'parti biss, mhux kompletament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 部分地；不完全地；在一定程度上。

formal.mt: L-aċċess għall-bini se jkun limitat parzjalment matul ix-xogħlijiet.
formal.en: Access to the building will be partially restricted during the works.
formal.zh: 施工期间，大楼的出入将受到部分限制。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who receives medical care, examination, or treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接受医疗照护、检查或治疗的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tirċievi kura, eżami jew trattament mediku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 病人；接受医疗照护的患者

formal.mt: Il-pazjent wasal fil-klinika fil-ħin tal-appuntament u ta d-dettalji tiegħu lir-receptionist.
formal.en: The patient arrived at the clinic at the appointment time and gave his details to the receptionist.
formal.zh: 患者按预约时间到达诊所，并向接待员提供了个人信息。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Jien pazjent ġdid. Fejn għandi nistenna? Anna: Tista' toqgħod bilqiegħda hawn; it-tabib isejjaħlek.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm a new patient. Where should I wait? Anna: You can sit here; the doctor will call you.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我是新患者，该在哪里等？安娜：您可以坐在这里，医生会叫您。

messages.speaker: Mark (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien pazjent ġdid. Fejn għandi nistenna?
messages.mt_standard: Jien pazjent ġdid. Fejn għandi nistenna?
messages.zh: 我是新患者，该在哪里等？
messages.en: I'm a new patient. Where should I wait?

messages.speaker: Anna (诊所接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' toqgħod bilqiegħda hawn; it-tabib isejjaħlek.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' toqgħod bilqiegħda hawn; it-tabib isejjaħlek.
messages.zh: 您可以坐在这里，医生会叫您。
messages.en: You can sit here; the doctor will call you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象诊所候诊椅上的人，给他贴上 pazjent 标签；本条按名词学习，直接对应接受诊疗的患者。

gloss_zh: 耐心；忍耐；单人纸牌游戏

teaching_sense.en_definition: The ability to wait or deal with difficulties calmly; also a card game played by one person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 平静等待或应对困难的耐心与忍耐力；也指一个人玩的单人纸牌游戏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħila li tistenna jew tiffaċċja diffikultajiet bil-kalma; ukoll logħba tal-karti għal persuna waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 耐心；平静等待或坚持处理事情的能力。

sense_translations.en_definition: solitaire (game of cards played by an individual player)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 单人纸牌游戏，由一个玩家独自进行。
耐心；对困难、冒犯或不便的克制与容忍。

formal.mt: It-tagħlim ta' lingwa ġdida jitlob paċenzja u prattika regolari.
formal.en: Learning a new language requires patience and regular practice.
formal.zh: 学习一门新语言需要耐心和经常练习。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-kelma għadha diffiċli għalija. Mark: Ħu paċenzja. Nerġgħu naqrawha flimkien. Maja: Sewwa, nipprova darba oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: This word is still difficult for me. Mark: Be patient. Let's read it together again. Maja: All right, I'll try once more.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个词对我来说还是很难。马克：耐心一点。我们再一起读一遍。玛雅：好，我再试一次。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个词对我来说还是很难。
messages.en: This word is still difficult for me.

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.zh: 耐心一点。我们再一起读一遍。
messages.en: Be patient. Let's read it together again.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 好，我再试一次。
messages.en: All right, I'll try once more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己耐心等待时独自摆纸牌，用同一幅画面记住“耐心”和“单人纸牌”两个义项。

gloss_zh: 说话；喋喋不休；闲聊；说闲话

teaching_sense.en_definition: To talk informally or at length, sometimes about other people's private affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随意聊天或不停地说话，有时指谈论别人的私事、说闲话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitkellem b'mod informali jew fit-tul, xi drabi dwar il-ħajja privata ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话；交谈。
闲聊；叽叽喳喳地说个不停。
说闲话；议论别人的私事。
说话；喋喋不休地闲聊；絮絮叨叨。

formal.mt: Min ipaċpaċ waqt il-preżentazzjoni jista' jfixkel lill-parteċipanti l-oħra.
formal.en: Anyone who chatters during the presentation may disturb the other participants.
formal.zh: 在报告期间闲聊的人可能会打扰其他参与者。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu Mark? Pawlu: Qiegħed ipaċpaċ mal-ġar barra. Maja: Għidlu jidħol, għax l-ikel lest.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Mark? Pawlu: He's chatting with the neighbour outside. Maja: Tell him to come in, because the food is ready.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克在哪里？保罗：他正在外面和邻居聊天。玛雅：叫他进来，饭好了。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 马克在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Mark?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 他正在外面和邻居聊天。
messages.en: He's chatting with the neighbour outside.

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 叫他进来，饭好了。
messages.en: Tell him to come in, because the food is ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 paċ-paċ 的重复节奏当作课堂记忆口令，联想到话一句接一句；这只是助记，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 非常健谈的；喋喋不休的；夸夸其谈的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very talkative, often speaking at length or more than is welcome.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 非常爱说话的，常指说得很久或多得让人厌烦的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitkellem ħafna, spiss aktar milli jkun meħtieġ jew mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常健谈的；特别爱说话的。
非常多话的；絮絮叨叨、说个不停的。
夸夸其谈的；废话连篇的，用来形容话多而内容空泛的人。

collocations.zh: 一个特别爱说话的男孩

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ġar paċpaċi jirrakkonta l-istess storja lil kull min jiltaqa' miegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the very talkative neighbour tells the same story to everyone he meets.
formal.zh: 故事中，那位多话的邻居逢人便讲同一个故事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu l-ġar il-ġdid? Mark: Dħuli, imma paċpaċi ħafna. Maja: Mela dejjem issib lil min tkellem!
colloquial.en: Maja: What's the new neighbour like? Mark: Friendly, but very talkative. Maja: Then you'll always have someone to talk to!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新邻居怎么样？马克：很友好，不过特别爱说话。玛雅：那你总能找到人聊天了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 新邻居怎么样？
messages.en: What's the new neighbour like?

messages.speaker: Mark (住户)
messages.zh: 很友好，不过特别爱说话。
messages.en: Friendly, but very talkative.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela dejjem issib lil min tkellem!
messages.mt_standard: Mela dejjem issib lil min tkellem!
messages.zh: 那你总能找到人聊天了！
messages.en: Then you'll always have someone to talk to!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用人物标签记忆：给“总有话说的邻居”贴上 paċpaċi，记住它描述人的多话特点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One side of a sheet in a book or document, or a page of information on a website.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 书籍或文件中一张纸的一面，也指网站上展示信息的页面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Naħa waħda ta' folja fi ktieb jew dokument, jew parti minn sit elettroniku li turi informazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 页；页面，可指纸面上的一页或网页。
书页；书中的一页。

formal.mt: Ikteb ismek fin-naħa ta' fuq tal-ewwel paġna tad-dokument.
formal.en: Write your name at the top of the first page of the document.
formal.zh: 请在文件第一页的上方写上姓名。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq liema paġna qegħdin? Mark: Fuq paġna għaxra. Maja: Grazzi, issa sibt l-eżerċizzju.
colloquial.en: Maja: What page are we on? Mark: On page ten. Maja: Thanks, I've found the exercise now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们现在看到第几页？马克：第十页。玛雅：谢谢，我现在找到练习了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 我们现在看到第几页？
messages.en: What page are we on?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 第十页。
messages.en: On page ten.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 谢谢，我现在找到练习了。
messages.en: Thanks, I've found the exercise now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 每翻一页就默念一次 paġna，再用 paġna għaxra 把“页”和具体页码连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sock or stocking worn on the foot and sometimes part of the leg.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿在脚上、也可能覆盖部分腿部的袜子或长袜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa lbies li tintlibes fuq is-sieq u tista' tgħatti wkoll parti mir-riġel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 袜子
袜子；长袜

formal.mt: Fl-inventarju tal-ħwejjeġ instabet peduna waħda mingħajr is-sieħba tagħha.
formal.en: During the clothing inventory, one sock was found without its matching partner.
formal.zh: 清点衣物时，发现了一只找不到配对的袜子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Sibt peduna waħda biss. Fejn hi l-oħra? Maja: Ħares taħt is-sodda; hemm waħda blu.
colloquial.en: Lara: I found only one sock. Where is the other one? Maja: Look under the bed; there's a blue one there.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我只找到一只袜子，另一只在哪儿？玛雅：看看床底下，那里有一只蓝色的。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt peduna waħda biss. Fejn hi l-oħra?
messages.mt_standard: Sibt peduna waħda biss. Fejn hi l-oħra?
messages.zh: 我只找到一只袜子，另一只在哪儿？
messages.en: I found only one sock. Where is the other one?

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħares taħt is-sodda; hemm waħda blu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħares taħt is-sodda; hemm waħda blu.
messages.zh: 看看床底下，那里有一只蓝色的。
messages.en: Look under the bed; there's a blue one there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 peduna 和洗衣后落单的一只袜子绑定记忆；配上 peduna waħda，顺便记住这里说的是一只袜子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To smoke tobacco or similar substances; in another sense, to tease someone by pulling their leg.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吸食烟草等物产生的烟；另一个义项是戏弄某人或拿某人开玩笑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġibed id-duħħan tat-tabakk jew ta' xi ħaġa simili; f'sens ieħor, daħak b'xi ħadd jew qarraq bih biċ-ċajt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吸烟，指抽香烟等
戏弄某人；拿某人开玩笑
吸烟，指吸入燃烧的烟草等产生的烟

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel ħareġ fil-bitħa u pejjep sigarett qabel irritorna ġewwa.
formal.en: In the story, the man went out into the courtyard and smoked a cigarette before returning inside.
formal.zh: 故事中，那名男子走到院子里，抽了一支香烟，然后回到室内。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu pejjep hawn ġewwa? Mark: Le, ħareġ fil-bitħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu smoke in here? Mark: No, he went out into the courtyard.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗刚才在这里面抽烟了吗？马克：没有，他到院子里去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 保罗刚才在这里面抽烟了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu smoke in here?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 没有，他到院子里去了。
messages.en: No, he went out into the courtyard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用 pejjep sigarett 的吸烟画面记住本义，再给戏弄义单独画一个开玩笑的对话框；两个义项分开记，遇到时按语境选择。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make short, high-pitched sounds, as a bird does.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 像鸟一样发出短促而清脆的鸣叫声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħsejjes qosra u rqaq bħalma jagħmel għasfur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 啁啾；发出短促清脆的鸟鸣声。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, għasfur żgħir pejjez minn fuq fergħa.
formal.en: During the observation, a small bird chirped from a branch.
formal.zh: 观察过程中，一只小鸟在树枝上啁啾鸣叫。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dak il-ħoss? Mark: Iva, għasfur pejjez ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that sound? Mark: Yes, a bird chirped near the window.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听到那个声音了吗？马克：听到了，一只鸟刚才在窗边啁啾地叫。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听到那个声音了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that sound?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 听到了，一只鸟刚才在窗边啁啾地叫。
messages.en: Yes, a bird chirped near the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pejjez 和清晨窗边的小鸟联系起来：听见短促清脆的啾啾声，就回想这个表示鸟鸣的动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who smokes tobacco.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吸食烟草的人；吸烟者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tpejjep it-tabakk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吸烟的人；吸烟者。
吸食烟草的人。

formal.mt: Fil-kwestjonarju, il-parteċipant indika li kien pejjiep okkażjonali.
formal.en: In the questionnaire, the participant indicated that he was an occasional smoker.
formal.zh: 该参与者在问卷中表示，他偶尔吸烟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int pejjiep? Mark: Iva, imma npejjep biss kultant.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you a smoker? Mark: Yes, but I only smoke occasionally.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你吸烟吗？马克：吸，不过只是偶尔抽。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你吸烟吗？
messages.en: Are you a smoker?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 吸，不过只是偶尔抽。
messages.en: Yes, but I only smoke occasionally.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 pejjiep 指的是人：想象问卷上询问是否吸烟的一栏，把这个词与填写该栏的吸烟者联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large water bird with a long bill and a pouch beneath it; in a species-specific sense, the great white pelican.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种喙长、喙下有喉囊的大型水鸟，称为鹈鹕；在具体物种义中指白鹈鹕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur kbir tal-ilma b'munqar twil u borża taħtu; fis-sens ta' speċi partikolari, Pelecanus onocrotalus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鹈鹕，一类具有长喙和喉囊的大型水鸟。
白鹈鹕，学名为 Pelecanus onocrotalus 的鹈鹕物种。

formal.mt: Il-pellikan juża l-borża taħt il-munqar biex jaqbad il-ħut.
formal.en: The pelican uses the pouch beneath its bill to catch fish.
formal.zh: 鹈鹕利用喙下的喉囊捕鱼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak l-għasfur bil-munqar twil! Mark: Dak pellikan. Ħares lejn il-borża taħt il-munqar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that bird with the long bill! Mark: That's a pelican. Look at the pouch beneath its bill.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看那只长着长喙的鸟！马克：那是鹈鹕。看看它喙下面的喉囊。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 看那只长着长喙的鸟！
messages.en: Look at that bird with the long bill!

messages.speaker: Mark (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak pellikan. Ħares lejn il-borża taħt il-munqar.
messages.mt_standard: Dak pellikan. Ħares lejn il-borża taħt il-munqar.
messages.zh: 那是鹈鹕。看看它喙下面的喉囊。
messages.en: That's a pelican. Look at the pouch beneath its bill.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pellikan 与英语 pelican 对照记忆，再画一只长喙下面挂着大喉囊的水鸟；具体物种义另记为白鹈鹕。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act undertaken to express repentance for wrongdoing, especially in religion; also penitence or punishment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为表示对过错的悔意而做的补赎行为，尤用于宗教语境；也可表示悔罪或惩罚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att magħmul biex wieħed juri ndiema għal xi ħażen, speċjalment fir-reliġjon; ukoll indiema jew kastig.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 补赎；为表示悔罪而承担的行为或宗教功课。
悔罪、悔过之意；惩罚。

formal.mt: Wara l-qrar, il-qassis tah talba bħala penitenza.
formal.en: After confession, the priest assigned him a prayer as penance.
formal.zh: 告解后，神父安排他念一篇祷文作为补赎。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'penitenza tak il-qassis? Mark: Tani talba qasira biex ngħidha wara l-qrar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What penance did the priest give you? Mark: He gave me a short prayer to say after confession.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：神父给你安排了什么补赎？马克：他让我在告解后念一篇简短的祷文。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 神父给你安排了什么补赎？
messages.en: What penance did the priest give you?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tani talba qasira biex ngħidha wara l-qrar.
messages.mt_standard: Tani talba qasira biex ngħidha wara l-qrar.
messages.zh: 他让我在告解后念一篇简短的祷文。
messages.en: He gave me a short prayer to say after confession.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“犯错、悔过、做补赎”三个画面记住 penitenza；遇到宗教语境先想到补赎，其他语境再辨别悔罪或惩罚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area of land almost surrounded by water but connected to a larger landmass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大部分边缘被水包围，但仍有一部分与较大陆地相连的陆地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa art imdawra kważi kollha bl-ilma iżda li tibqa' magħquda ma' art ikbar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 半岛，大部分被水环绕而仍与较大陆地相连的陆地。

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi peniżola dejqa li tibqa' magħquda mal-art prinċipali.
formal.en: The map shows a narrow peninsula that remains connected to the mainland.
formal.zh: 地图显示了一处狭长的半岛，它仍与大陆相连。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din gżira jew peniżola? Mark: Peniżola, għax għadha magħquda mal-art.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this an island or a peninsula? Mark: A peninsula, because it is still connected to the land.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是岛还是半岛？马克：是半岛，因为它仍与陆地相连。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这是岛还是半岛？
messages.en: Is this an island or a peninsula?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 是半岛，因为它仍与陆地相连。
messages.en: A peninsula, because it is still connected to the land.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一块伸进海里的陆地，特意保留一条与大陆相连的通道；看到这个“没有完全断开”的图形就想起 peniżola。

gloss_zh: 用刷子涂刷；用画笔绘画

teaching_sense.en_definition: To apply paint with a brush, either to cover a surface or to make a picture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用刷子或画笔施加颜料，可以指涂刷表面，也可以指绘画。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Japplika ż-żebgħa b'pinzell biex jgħatti wiċċ jew joħloq stampa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用刷子涂刷；用画笔绘画。

collocations.en: painted the door with a brush
painted the wall with a brush

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem penzel il-bieb b'attenzjoni u ħallieh jinxef.
formal.en: The worker carefully painted the door with a brush and left it to dry.
formal.zh: 工人仔细地用刷子给门刷漆，然后让它晾干。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min penzel il-bieb? Mark: Missieri. Għadu kemm lestieh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who painted the door with a brush? Mark: My father. He has just finished it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：是谁用刷子给门刷了漆？马克：我爸爸。他刚刷完。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 是谁用刷子给门刷了漆？
messages.en: Who painted the door with a brush?

messages.speaker: Mark (住户)
messages.zh: 我爸爸。他刚刷完。
messages.en: My father. He has just finished it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 penzel 记成一个动作画面：手握刷子，蘸上颜料，一笔一笔涂到门上；记忆重点是“用刷子来涂画”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A word used in the expression peress li to introduce a reason or a fact taken as the basis for what follows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于 peress li 结构，引出原因或作为后文依据的事实，相当于“因为、由于、既然”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża fl-espressjoni peress li biex tintroduċi raġuni jew fatt li fuqu tinbena l-bqija tas-sentenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因为；引出原因。
既然；由于，表示原因或已知前提。
所给释义为无法解释的标记“xrt67”，无法据此确定中文义项。
由于；因为，表示原因。

formal.mt: Peress li l-bini se jkun magħluq, il-laqgħa se ssir onlajn.
formal.en: Since the building will be closed, the meeting will take place online.
formal.zh: 由于大楼届时将关闭，会议将在线上举行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex se nibqgħu d-dar? Mark: Peress li qed tagħmel ix-xita, aħjar naraw film hawn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are we staying home? Mark: Since it is raining, we might as well watch a film here.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们为什么待在家里？马克：既然正在下雨，我们还是在这里看部电影吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们为什么待在家里？
messages.en: Why are we staying home?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Peress li qed tagħmel ix-xita, aħjar naraw film hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Peress li qed tagħmel ix-xita, aħjar naraw film hawn.
messages.zh: 既然正在下雨，我们还是在这里看部电影吧。
messages.en: Since it is raining, we might as well watch a film here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 peress li 整体记成“既然这个原因成立”，后面接原因，再接由此作出的决定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Complete and without faults, or exactly right for a particular purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 完整而没有缺点的；也可指完全符合某种用途或需要的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bla difetti jew eżatt kif għandu jkun għal skop partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 完美的；无缺点的。
完美的；完全合适的。
完成时；表示动作作为已完成整体的一种动词形式。

formal.mt: L-istudent kiseb riżultat perfett fl-eżami tal-grammatika.
formal.en: The student achieved a perfect result in the grammar examination.
formal.zh: 这名学生在语法考试中取得了满分。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-ħin tajjeb għalik? David: Iva, perfett! Niltaqgħu fit-tlieta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this time work for you? David: Yes, perfect! Let's meet at three.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个时间你方便吗？戴维：方便，正合适！我们三点见。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个时间你方便吗？
messages.en: Does this time work for you?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 方便，正合适！我们三点见。
messages.en: Yes, perfect! Let's meet at three.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用英语 perfect 的相似拼写帮助记忆 perfett；描述结果是“完美的”，语法课中的 il-perfett 则是“完成时”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A situation or possibility in which someone or something may suffer harm, injury, or damage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可能导致伤害、损失或破坏的情况或可能性；危险或险境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni jew possibbiltà li fiha xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa jistgħu jġarrbu ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 危险；可能受到伤害的情况。
危险；险境，尤其指面临严重伤害的处境。

formal.mt: Il-wajers mikxufa joħolqu periklu serju għall-ħaddiema.
formal.en: The exposed wires pose a serious danger to the workers.
formal.zh: 裸露的电线对工人构成严重危险。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' ninżel minn hawn? Toni: Le, hemm periklu li taqa'. Uża t-taraġ.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I climb down here? Toni: No, there is a danger of falling. Use the stairs.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我能从这里爬下去吗？托尼：不行，有摔下去的危险。走楼梯吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (游客)
messages.zh: 我能从这里爬下去吗？
messages.en: Can I climb down here?

messages.speaker: Toni (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hemm periklu li taqa'. Uża t-taraġ.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hemm periklu li taqa'. Uża t-taraġ.
messages.zh: 不行，有摔下去的危险。走楼梯吧。
messages.en: No, there is a danger of falling. Use the stairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象警示牌上写着 periklu，提醒前方有危险；再把 fil-periklu 连起来记成“身处险境”。

gloss_zh: 烫发；永久的；长期固定的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hair treatment that produces curls or waves intended to last for a long time, or the hairstyle it creates.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过处理让头发较长时间保持卷曲或波浪形的烫发，也指由此形成的发型。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Trattament tax-xagħar li jagħtih nokkli jew mewġ li jdumu, jew l-istil li jinħoloq bih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烫发；经过处理而较持久保持的卷发发型。
永久的；长期持续或固定的。

formal.mt: Il-klijenta għamlet appuntament fis-salon biex tagħmel permanenti.
formal.en: The client made an appointment at the salon to get a perm.
formal.zh: 这位顾客预约了美发店，准备烫卷发。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nixtieq nagħmel permanenti. Rita: Trid nokkli żgħar jew kbar?
colloquial.en: Anna: I'd like to get a perm. Rita: Would you like small or large curls?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我想烫卷发。丽塔：你想要小卷还是大卷？

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 我想烫卷发。
messages.en: I'd like to get a perm.

messages.speaker: Rita (理发师)
messages.zh: 你想要小卷还是大卷？
messages.en: Would you like small or large curls?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“保持得久”串联两个词义：美发店里指保持卷曲的烫发，修饰工作等名词时表示长期固定的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pin or shaft that supports a part or provides a point around which it turns.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于支承、连接部件或让部件围绕其转动的销或轴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa bħal pin jew fus li ssostni parti jew li parti ddur madwarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 枢轴；部件围绕其转动的支点或轴。
铰链或铰接轴；转动轴。
销；用于连接、定位或固定部件的杆状零件。
耳轴；从部件侧面伸出、用于支承并允许其转动的短轴。

formal.mt: It-tekniku ssostitwixxa l-pern taċ-ċappetta biex il-bieb jerġa' jinfetaħ bla diffikultà.
formal.en: The technician replaced the hinge pin so that the door would open smoothly again.
formal.zh: 技术员更换了铰链销，使门重新能够顺畅开启。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex il-bieb mhux qed jagħlaq sew? Lara: Il-pern taċ-ċappetta tgħawweġ. Irridu nbiddluh.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why isn't the door closing properly? Lara: The hinge pin is bent. We need to replace it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这扇门为什么关不好？拉拉：铰链销弯了。我们得换掉它。

messages.speaker: Mark (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-bieb mhux qed jagħlaq sew?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-bieb mhux qed jagħlaq sew?
messages.zh: 这扇门为什么关不好？
messages.en: Why isn't the door closing properly?

messages.speaker: Lara (维修员)
messages.zh: 铰链销弯了。我们得换掉它。
messages.en: The hinge pin is bent. We need to replace it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门铰链中间那根小轴，门绕着它转；用这个画面把 pern 的销、枢轴和耳轴几个义项联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hang clothes or other items out to dry or air, and by extension to put something on display or expose it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把衣物等挂出来晾干或透气；也可指把某物展示出来或使其暴露。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dendel ħwejjeġ jew oġġetti biex jinxfu jew jieħdu l-arja; ukoll, qiegħed xi ħaġa fejn tidher jew tkun esposta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把衣物等挂出去晾干。

sense_translations.en_definition: to let air into a space
sense_translations.zh_definition: 让空气进入某个空间；使其通风。
展示；展出。
把衣服挂起来晾干。
使暴露；把某物展示出来。
使透气；把物品拿出来通风。

collocations.en: hang out the clothes to dry
put the bedding out to air

formal.mt: Wara l-ħasil, il-ħaddiem perreċ il-lożor fil-bitħa biex jinxfu.
formal.en: After washing them, the worker hung the sheets out in the courtyard to dry.
formal.zh: 洗好之后，工作人员把床单晾在院子里，让它们晾干。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-ħwejjeġ għadhom imxarrbin. Pawlu: Perreċ il-ħwejjeġ barra, għax illum hemm ix-xemx.
colloquial.en: Rita: The clothes are still wet. Pawlu: Hang the clothes outside, because it is sunny today.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：衣服还湿着。保罗：把衣服晾到外面吧，今天有太阳。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 衣服还湿着。
messages.en: The clothes are still wet.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Perreċ il-ħwejjeġ barra, għax illum hemm ix-xemx.
messages.mt_standard: Perreċ il-ħwejjeġ barra, għax illum hemm ix-xemx.
messages.zh: 把衣服晾到外面吧，今天有太阳。
messages.en: Hang the clothes outside, because it is sunny today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把湿衣服挂到外面，既接触空气又显露出来；用这个学习画面串联 perreċ 的晾晒、透气和展示义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Persia, its people, language, or culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与波斯、波斯人、波斯语或波斯文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Persja, man-nies tagħha, mal-lingwa jew mal-kultura tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 波斯的；与波斯人、语言或文化有关的。
波斯语。

formal.mt: Il-mużew qed jesebixxi tapit persjan b'disinji dettaljati.
formal.en: The museum is exhibiting a Persian carpet with detailed designs.
formal.zh: 博物馆正在展出一张图案精细的波斯地毯。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan qattus persjan? Mark: Iva, u għandu pil artab ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this a Persian cat? Mark: Yes, and it has very soft fur.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是波斯猫吗？马克：是的，而且它的毛非常柔软。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是波斯猫吗？
messages.en: Is this a Persian cat?

messages.speaker: Mark (猫主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għandu pil artab ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għandu pil artab ħafna.
messages.zh: 是的，而且它的毛非常柔软。
messages.en: Yes, and it has very soft fur.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把波斯地毯和波斯猫放进同一幅记忆画面：persjan 修饰它们时表示“波斯的”；作为语言名称时则表示“波斯语”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An individual human being.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人，指单独的一名人类个体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bniedem wieħed meqjus bħala individwu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人；个人，指一名个体。

formal.mt: Kull persuna għandha timla formola separata qabel tidħol.
formal.en: Each person must complete a separate form before entering.
formal.zh: 每个人进入前都必须单独填写一份表格。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nixtieq kamra għal persuna waħda. Mark: Għal kemm iljieli?
colloquial.en: Maja: I'd like a room for one person. Mark: For how many nights?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我想订一间供一个人住的房间。马克：住几个晚上？

messages.speaker: Maja (旅客)
messages.zh: 我想订一间供一个人住的房间。
messages.en: I'd like a room for one person.

messages.speaker: Mark (前台接待员)
messages.zh: 住几个晚上？
messages.en: For how many nights?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 persuna waħda 和“一人入住”的房间联系起来记；persuna 表示“人”，这个词在语法上是阴性，并不限定所指人的性别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A conjunction introducing a contrast, limitation, or qualification to what has just been said.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引出与前文形成转折、限制或补充修正的内容，相当于“但是、不过、然而”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tgħaqqad żewġ ideat u turi kuntrast jew limitazzjoni għal dak li jkun għadu kemm intqal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 但是；不过；然而，表示转折。
但是；可是，连接意思有转折的内容。

formal.mt: Il-proposta hija interessanti, però teħtieġ aktar diskussjoni.
formal.en: The proposal is interesting, but it requires further discussion.
formal.zh: 这项提案很有意思，不过还需要进一步讨论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għoġbok l-appartament? Ben: Iva, huwa żgħir però komdu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you like the apartment? Ben: Yes, it is small but comfortable.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢那套公寓吗？本：喜欢，它虽小，不过很舒适。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢那套公寓吗？
messages.en: Did you like the apartment?

messages.speaker: Ben (看房者)
messages.zh: 喜欢，它虽小，不过很舒适。
messages.en: Yes, it is small but comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在两句话之间画一个转弯箭头：前面说“小”，però 后面转到“舒适”，这样记住它表示“不过”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Peru, a country in South America.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 秘鲁，位于南美洲的国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Amerka t'Isfel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 秘鲁。

sense_translations.en_definition: Peru (a country in South America; official name: Repubblika tal-Perù)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 秘鲁，南美洲国家；正式名称为秘鲁共和国。

formal.mt: L-istudenti ħejjew preżentazzjoni dwar il-ġeografija tal-Perù.
formal.en: The students prepared a presentation about the geography of Peru.
formal.zh: 学生们准备了一场介绍秘鲁地理的报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganza? Mark: Se mmur il-Perù ma' ħabib tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going on holiday? Mark: I'm going to Peru with a friend of mine.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要去哪里度假？马克：我要和一位朋友去秘鲁。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (旅行者)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur il-Perù ma' ħabib tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur il-Perù ma' ħabib tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我要和一位朋友去秘鲁。
messages.en: I'm going to Peru with a friend of mine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在南美洲地图上标出“秘鲁—Perù”，把词尾带重音符号的 ù 一起看作国家名称的拼写，反复搭配 il-Perù 朗读。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A line used for hanging washing to dry, or a support on which a bird rests.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于悬挂衣物晾干的绳子；也指供鸟停歇的横杆或栖木。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħabel li fuqu jiddendlu l-ħwejjeġ biex jinxfu, jew appoġġ li fuqu joqgħod għasfur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 晾衣绳，用来悬挂洗过的衣物使其晾干。
晒衣绳；晾衣绳。
鸟的栖木或供鸟停歇的横杆。
栖木；供鸟停歇的支撑物。

collocations.en: to hang clothes on the clothesline

formal.mt: Fil-gaġġa tqiegħdet perċa tal-injam biex l-għasfur ikun jista' joqgħod fuqha.
formal.en: A wooden perch was placed in the cage so that the bird could rest on it.
formal.zh: 笼子里放置了一根木制栖杆，供鸟停歇。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se ndendel dawn il-qomos? Mark: Mal-perċa fil-bitħa; hemm post għalihom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall I hang these shirts? Mark: On the clothesline in the yard; there's room for them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些衬衫挂在哪里？马克：挂在院子里的晾衣绳上吧，还有地方。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这些衬衫挂在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall I hang these shirts?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 挂在院子里的晾衣绳上吧，还有地方。
messages.en: On the clothesline in the yard; there's room for them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 perċa 画两张独立记忆卡：一张是挂着衬衫的晾衣绳，另一张是鸟踩着的栖木；根据衣物或鸟的语境选择词义。

gloss_zh: 变得倦怠；失去精力；变弱

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become sluggish or weak, losing energy and showing little inclination to act.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得迟缓、倦怠或虚弱，失去精力而不太想活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir mitluq jew dgħajjef, jitlef l-enerġija u ma jkollux ħeġġa biex jaġixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐变得无精打采、迟缓或倦怠。
表现出疲乏、倦怠或精神不振。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be weakened, to lose one's energy
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得虚弱；失去精力或力气。
变弱；衰弱；减弱。

formal.mt: Wara sigħat ta' xogħol fix-xemx, il-ħaddiem perċaħ u kellu bżonn jistrieħ.
formal.en: After hours of work in the sun, the worker grew weak and needed to rest.
formal.zh: 在太阳下工作数小时后，这名工人变得有气无力，需要休息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu qiegħed bilqiegħda? Mark: Perċaħ bis-sħana u ddeċieda li jistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Pawlu sitting down? Mark: He grew lethargic from the heat and decided to rest for a while.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗怎么坐下了？马克：他热得没了精神，决定休息一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗怎么坐下了？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu sitting down?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Perċaħ bis-sħana u ddeċieda li jistrieħ ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Perċaħ bis-sħana u ddeċieda li jistrieħ ftit.
messages.zh: 他热得没了精神，决定休息一会儿。
messages.en: He grew lethargic from the heat and decided to rest for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人忙完后像电量下降一样，动作慢下来、肩膀垂下来；用这个失去精力的画面记住 perċaħ 的倦怠和变弱义。

gloss_zh: 主要推动者；主事者；头目；捍卫者

teaching_sense.en_definition: The main person who initiates, carries out, or bears ultimate responsibility for an undertaking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发起、执行或最终负责某项事情的主要人物；可按语境指推动者、主事者或头目。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-persuna ewlenija li tibda xi ħaġa, twettaqha jew tkun responsabbli għaliha.

sense_translations.en_definition: the prime instigator or doer of sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 某事的主要发起者或主要执行者。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who is ultimately responsible for sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某事负最终责任的人；主事者。
带头人物；尤指组织不当行为的头目。
某项事业、主张或群体的积极支持者、捍卫者。

collocations.en: the prime mover behind the project

formal.mt: Ir-rapport identifika lil Pawlu bħala l-perċimes tal-inizjattiva.
formal.en: The report identified Pawlu as the prime mover behind the initiative.
formal.zh: 报告认定保罗是这项倡议的主要推动者。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min kien il-perċimes ta' dan kollu? Pawlu: Jien bdejt kollox, imma l-oħrajn għenuni.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who was the main person behind all this? Pawlu: I started everything, but the others helped me.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这一切是谁带头做的？保罗：是我发起的，不过其他人也帮了我。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min kien il-perċimes ta' dan kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Min kien il-perċimes ta' dan kollu?
messages.zh: 这一切是谁带头做的？
messages.en: Who was the main person behind all this?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (活动发起人)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien bdejt kollox, imma l-oħrajn għenuni.
messages.mt_standard: Jien bdejt kollox, imma l-oħrajn għenuni.
messages.zh: 是我发起的，不过其他人也帮了我。
messages.en: I started everything, but the others helped me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一群人中最先带头、最后负责的那个人圈出来，记作 perċimes；遇到惹事语境可理解为头目。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ham: meat from a pig's leg, prepared for eating by curing, cooking, or smoking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 火腿，用猪腿肉经过腌制、熟制或烟熏等处理制成的食品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Laħam minn sieq ta' ħanżir, ippreparat għall-ikel bit-tmelliħ, bit-tisjir jew bl-affumikar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 火腿。

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, aqta' l-perżut f'biċċiet żgħar u żidu mal-għaġin.
formal.en: For this recipe, cut the ham into small pieces and add it to the pasta.
formal.zh: 制作这道菜时，把火腿切成小块，再加入意大利面中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tixtieq fil-ħobż? Mark: Perżut u ġobon, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: What would you like in your bread? Mark: Ham and cheese, please.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：面包里你想夹什么？马克：请夹火腿和奶酪。

messages.speaker: Maja (店员)
messages.zh: 面包里你想夹什么？
messages.en: What would you like in your bread?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 请夹火腿和奶酪。
messages.en: Ham and cheese, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象点餐时指着面包里的火腿说 perżut，再连读 perżut u ġobon“火腿和奶酪”，用熟悉的食物组合帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tendency to expect bad outcomes or focus on the negative aspects of a situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于预期不好的结果，或着重看待事情消极一面的态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tendenza li wieħed jistenna riżultati ħżiena jew jiffoka fuq l-aspetti negattivi ta' sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悲观；倾向于认为事情会有不好结果的态度或观点。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri pessimiżmu dwar il-futur tal-proġett minħabba n-nuqqas ta' fondi.
formal.en: The report expresses pessimism about the project's future because of the lack of funding.
formal.zh: 由于资金不足，这份报告对项目的未来表示悲观。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma naħsibx li se jirnexxilna. Mark: Għaliex dan il-pessimiżmu kollu? Għad għandna ħin biex nippruvaw.
colloquial.en: Maja: I don't think we'll succeed. Mark: Why all this pessimism? We still have time to try.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我觉得我们不会成功。马克：怎么这么悲观？我们还有时间试一试。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 我觉得我们不会成功。
messages.en: I don't think we'll succeed.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-pessimiżmu kollu? Għad għandna ħin biex nippruvaw.
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-pessimiżmu kollu? Għad għandna ħin biex nippruvaw.
messages.zh: 怎么这么悲观？我们还有时间试一试。
messages.en: Why all this pessimism? We still have time to try.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“还没尝试就觉得会失败”的内心台词贴上 pessimiżmu 标签；再用“对未来悲观”这一固定情境巩固抽象词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The fleshy back part of the lower leg, below the knee.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 膝盖下方、小腿后侧肌肉较丰满的部位，即小腿肚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti mlaħħma fuq wara tar-riġel, taħt l-irkoppa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小腿肚，指人的小腿后侧部位。

sense_translations.en_definition: calf (back of the leg below the knee)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小腿肚，位于膝盖下方、腿的后侧。

formal.mt: Wara t-taħriġ, l-atleta ħass uġigħ fil-pexxun tal-lemin.
formal.en: After training, the athlete felt pain in his right calf.
formal.zh: 训练后，这名运动员感到右侧小腿肚疼痛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn qed juġgħek? Mark: Fil-pexxun tax-xellug, speċjalment meta nimxi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where does it hurt? Mark: In my left calf, especially when I walk.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你哪里疼？马克：左侧小腿肚，尤其是走路的时候。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哪里疼？
messages.en: Where does it hurt?

messages.speaker: Mark (跑步者)
messages.zh: 左侧小腿肚，尤其是走路的时候。
messages.en: In my left calf, especially when I walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 pexxun 时用手指向膝盖下方、腿后侧鼓起的肌肉；把这个身体位置与“小腿肚”直接配对，避免和整条小腿混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A writing instrument that uses ink to make marks on paper.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用墨水在纸上书写或留下痕迹的工具；在特定语境中也指钢笔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tuża l-linka biex tikteb jew tagħmel marki fuq il-karta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 笔；用墨水书写的工具。
钢笔，带有储墨装置并通过笔尖供墨的书写工具。
笔，指使用墨水的书写工具。

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok, imla l-formola b'pinna blu u ffirma fil-qiegħ.
formal.en: Please complete the form with a blue pen and sign at the bottom.
formal.zh: 请用蓝色的笔填写表格，并在底部签名。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek pinna x'issellefni? Mark: Iva, ħu din. Tista' żżommha sa tmiem il-lezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a pen you can lend me? Mark: Yes, take this one. You can keep it until the end of the lesson.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有笔可以借我吗？马克：有，拿这支吧。你可以用到下课。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你有笔可以借我吗？
messages.en: Do you have a pen you can lend me?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu din. Tista' żżommha sa tmiem il-lezzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu din. Tista' żżommha sa tmiem il-lezzjoni.
messages.zh: 有，拿这支吧。你可以用到下课。
messages.en: Yes, take this one. You can keep it until the end of the lesson.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pinna 写在一支常用笔旁边，每次拿笔就默念 tikteb bil-pinna“用笔写字”；再用钢笔的画面记住它也可表示“钢笔”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A brush used to apply paint or make painted marks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来涂抹颜料、绘画或刷漆的刷子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'manku u xagħar li tintuża biex tpinġi jew tapplika ż-żebgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刷子；在绘画或涂漆语境中指画笔、漆刷。
画笔；用于蘸取和涂抹颜料或油漆的刷子。

formal.mt: Uża pinzell fin biex tpinġi d-dettalji żgħar tal-fjura.
formal.en: Use a fine paintbrush to paint the small details of the flower.
formal.zh: 用细画笔描绘花朵的细小部分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-pinzell iż-żgħir? Mark: Ħdejn iż-żebgħa blu. Maja: Tajjeb, se nużah għall-fjuri.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the small paintbrush? Mark: Next to the blue paint. Maja: Good, I'll use it for the flowers.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：小画笔在哪里？马克：在蓝色颜料旁边。玛雅：好，我要用它画花。

messages.speaker: Maja (绘画课同学)
messages.zh: 小画笔在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the small paintbrush?

messages.speaker: Mark (绘画课同学)
messages.zh: 在蓝色颜料旁边。
messages.en: Next to the blue paint.

messages.speaker: Maja (绘画课同学)
messages.zh: 好，我要用它画花。
messages.en: Good, I'll use it for the flowers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pinzell 和一支蘸着蓝色颜料的细画笔联系起来，想象用它逐瓣画花，记住它是手里的工具。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To create a picture by drawing or painting, or to represent something visually.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过绘画制作图像，或用图像描绘某人、某物或某个场景。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħloq stampa bit-tpinġija jew bil-kuluri, jew jirrappreżenta xi ħaġa f'immaġni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绘画；用颜料画出图像。
画；用线条勾画图像。
给……文身；在皮肤上刺绘图案。
描绘；表现人物、事物或场景。
绘画、画出或描绘。

formal.mt: L-artist pinġa xena mill-ħajja ta' kuljum biex juri x-xogħol tas-sajjieda.
formal.en: The artist painted a scene from everyday life to show the work of the fishermen.
formal.zh: 这位艺术家画了一幅日常生活场景，以展现渔民的工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min pinġa din l-istampa? Mark: Ħija pinġieha lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who drew this picture? Mark: My brother drew it yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这幅画是谁画的？马克：我兄弟昨天画的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这幅画是谁画的？
messages.en: Who drew this picture?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我兄弟昨天画的。
messages.en: My brother drew it yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人刚画完一张图，说“他画了”：pinġa 是第三人称阳性单数过去式。先把它与“画出图像”联系，再扩展到描绘和文身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An implement with a bowl and a stem used for smoking tobacco.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有斗钵和烟嘴、用于吸食烟草的器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'reċipjent żgħir għat-tabakk u b'tubu li tintuża biex wieħed ipejjep.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烟斗；用于吸烟的器具。
烟斗；装入烟草后供人吸食的器具。

formal.mt: Il-mużew għandu pipa antika għall-wiri, flimkien ma' oġġetti oħra tal-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The museum has an old pipe on display alongside other everyday objects.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出了一只旧烟斗，以及其他日常生活用品。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-pipa kienet tan-nannu? Pawlu: Iva, kien iżommha f'din il-kaxxa. Lara: Ħa nħalliha hemm, mela.
colloquial.en: Lara: Was this pipe Grandpa's? Pawlu: Yes, he used to keep it in this box. Lara: I'll leave it there, then.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这只烟斗以前是爷爷的吗？保罗：是的，他以前把它放在这个盒子里。拉拉：那我就把它留在这里。

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 这只烟斗以前是爷爷的吗？
messages.en: Was this pipe Grandpa's?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 是的，他以前把它放在这个盒子里。
messages.en: Yes, he used to keep it in this box.

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 那我就把它留在这里。
messages.en: I'll leave it there, then.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 pipa 时想象盒子里的一只弯柄烟斗，把斗钵和烟嘴一起画出来，帮助固定“烟斗”这个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The day two days after today.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从今天算起的第二天，也就是明天之后的那一天。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-jum li jiġi jumejn wara llum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 后天；明天之后的那一天。
后天；作为一个具体日期所指的那一天。
后天；从今天往后数第二天。
在后天；说明某个动作发生在明天之后的那一天。

collocations.en: the day after tomorrow in the morning
the day after tomorrow in the evening

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir pitgħada fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The meeting will take place the day after tomorrow at nine in the morning.
formal.zh: 会议将于后天上午九点举行。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Se niltaqgħu għada? Samwel: Le, pitgħada. Għada għandi x-xogħol. Nina: Sewwa, pitgħada filgħaxija mela.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are we meeting tomorrow? Samwel: No, the day after tomorrow. I have work tomorrow. Nina: All right, the day after tomorrow in the evening, then.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们明天见面吗？萨姆韦尔：不，后天。我明天要上班。妮娜：好，那就后天晚上。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们明天见面吗？
messages.en: Are we meeting tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.zh: 不，后天。我明天要上班。
messages.en: No, the day after tomorrow. I have work tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，那就后天晚上。
messages.en: All right, the day after tomorrow in the evening, then.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历上依次标出今天、明天、后天，把 pitgħada 写在第三格；从今天向右走两格就能记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small bird with an orange-red face and breast, the European robin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种脸部和胸部呈橙红色的小鸟，指欧亚鸲，通常也称知更鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur żgħir b'wiċċ u sider ta' lewn aħmar fl-oranġjo.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 知更鸟；此处指欧亚鸲。
欧亚鸲，学名 Erithacus rubecula；一种胸部呈橙红色的小鸟。

formal.mt: Matul l-osservazzjoni tal-għasafar, l-istudenti raw pitirross fuq fergħa baxxa.
formal.en: During the birdwatching activity, the students saw a robin on a low branch.
formal.zh: 在观鸟活动中，学生们看到一只知更鸟停在低矮的树枝上。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Ara dak l-għasfur bis-sider aħmar! Toni: Dak pitirross. Marta: Ħa narah minn hawn biex ma nbeżżgħux.
colloquial.en: Marta: Look at that bird with the red breast! Toni: That's a robin. Marta: I'll watch it from here so I don't scare it.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：看那只红胸脯的小鸟！托尼：那是知更鸟。玛尔塔：我就在这里看，免得吓到它。

messages.speaker: Marta (观鸟同伴)
messages.zh: 看那只红胸脯的小鸟！
messages.en: Look at that bird with the red breast!

messages.speaker: Toni (观鸟同伴)
messages.zh: 那是知更鸟。
messages.en: That's a robin.

messages.speaker: Marta (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħa narah minn hawn biex ma nbeżżgħux.
messages.mt_standard: Ħa narah minn hawn biex ma nbeżżgħux.
messages.zh: 我就在这里看，免得吓到它。
messages.en: I'll watch it from here so I don't scare it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 pitirross 配一幅小鸟站在树枝上的图，特别涂出橙红色胸脯，用这个醒目的特征记住知更鸟。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The round edible root of a beet plant, usually dark red, eaten as a vegetable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 甜菜可食用的圆形根部，通常呈深红色，可作为蔬菜食用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għerq tond li jittiekel bħala ħaxixa u li ġeneralment ikollu lewn aħmar skur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 红菜头；通常呈深红色、可食用的甜菜根。
甜菜；甜菜根，作为蔬菜时通常指红菜头。

formal.mt: Għall-insalata, qatta' l-pitrava mgħollija f'biċċiet żgħar u żid ftit żejt taż-żebbuġa.
formal.en: For the salad, cut the boiled beetroot into small pieces and add a little olive oil.
formal.zh: 制作沙拉时，把煮熟的红菜头切成小块，再加少许橄榄油。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid ftit pitrava mal-insalata? Luqa: Iva, imma aqtagħha f'biċċiet żgħar. Sara: Sewwa, inżid ftit żejt ukoll.
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like some beetroot with the salad? Luqa: Yes, but cut it into small pieces. Sara: All right, I'll add a little oil too.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：沙拉里要加些红菜头吗？卢卡：要，不过切成小块。萨拉：好，我也加一点油。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 沙拉里要加些红菜头吗？
messages.en: Would you like some beetroot with the salad?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.zh: 要，不过切成小块。
messages.en: Yes, but cut it into small pieces.

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 好，我也加一点油。
messages.en: All right, I'll add a little oil too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象切开 pitrava 后，砧板和沙拉都染上深红色；用“红色根菜切成块”的画面记住红菜头。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Kerosene, a liquid fuel used in lamps and some heaters; the word can also refer to petroleum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 煤油，一种可用于灯具和部分取暖器的液体燃料；该词也可指石油。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fjuwil likwidu li jintuża fil-lampi u f'xi ħiters; il-kelma tista' tirreferi wkoll għaż-żejt mhux raffinat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 煤油；可用作灯油等的液体燃料。
煤油；石油；paraffin 在这里指液体煤油。

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tal-oġġett tgħid li din il-lampa kienet taħdem bil-pitrolju.
formal.en: The object's description states that this lamp used to run on kerosene.
formal.zh: 展品说明写道，这盏灯以前使用煤油。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Din il-lampa taħdem bil-pitrolju? Ġużeppi: Iva, imma issa nużawha biss bħala dekorazzjoni. Anna: Taqbel ħafna ma' din il-kamra.
colloquial.en: Anna: Does this lamp run on kerosene? Ġużeppi: Yes, but now we only use it as a decoration. Anna: It goes very well with this room.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这盏灯用煤油吗？朱塞佩：是的，不过我们现在只把它当装饰品。安娜：它和这个房间很搭。

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.zh: 这盏灯用煤油吗？
messages.en: Does this lamp run on kerosene?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma issa nużawha biss bħala dekorazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma issa nużawha biss bħala dekorazzjoni.
messages.zh: 是的，不过我们现在只把它当装饰品。
messages.en: Yes, but now we only use it as a decoration.

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.zh: 它和这个房间很搭。
messages.en: It goes very well with this room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pitrolju 放进“煤油灯里的液体燃料”这一画面记忆；遇到能源话题时，再结合上下文判断是否指石油。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To paint or depict something in a picture; also, to use make-up.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用颜料绘画或以图画描绘事物；也可表示使用化妆品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tpinġi stampa jew turi xi ħaġa fi stampa; ukoll, tagħmel il-make-up.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绘画；用颜料作画。
化妆；使用化妆品修饰面容。
绘画；画出；以图画描绘或表现。

formal.mt: L-artist pitter veduta tal-port u ta attenzjoni speċjali lid-dawl fuq l-ilma.
formal.en: The artist painted a view of the harbour and paid special attention to the light on the water.
formal.zh: 这位艺术家画了一幅港口景色，并特别留意水面上的光线。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Min pitter din l-istampa? David: Ħija pitter din l-istampa waqt il-vaganzi. Elena: Jogħġbuni ħafna l-kuluri.
colloquial.en: Elena: Who painted this picture? David: My brother painted this picture during the holidays. Elena: I really like the colours.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这幅画是谁画的？戴维：我哥哥在假期里画了这幅画。埃莱娜：我很喜欢这些颜色。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 这幅画是谁画的？
messages.en: Who painted this picture?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija pitter din l-istampa waqt il-vaganzi.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija pitter din l-istampa waqt il-vaganzi.
messages.zh: 我哥哥在假期里画了这幅画。
messages.en: My brother painted this picture during the holidays.

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 我很喜欢这些颜色。
messages.en: I really like the colours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pitter 记成画面中的动作：有人把颜色画到纸上；另设一张化妆卡片，提醒自己这个动词也能表示化妆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An artist who creates pictures using paint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用颜料创作图画的艺术家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Artist li joħloq stampi biż-żebgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 画家；从事绘画创作的人。
画家；以绘画进行艺术创作的艺术家。

formal.mt: Il-pittur se jippreżenta r-ritratti l-ġodda tiegħu f'wirja fil-gallerija.
formal.en: The painter will present his new portraits at an exhibition in the gallery.
formal.zh: 这位画家将在画廊的展览中展出他新创作的肖像画。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dak ir-raġel hu l-pittur ta' dawn l-istampi? Ben: Iva, u tista' tkellmu dwar ix-xogħol tiegħu. Marija: Nixtieq nistaqsih dwar il-kuluri li juża.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is that man the painter who made these pictures? Ben: Yes, and you can talk to him about his work. Marija: I'd like to ask him about the colours he uses.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：那个男人就是画这些画的画家吗？本：是的，你可以和他聊聊他的作品。玛丽亚：我想问问他使用的颜色。

messages.speaker: Marija (展览观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-raġel hu l-pittur ta' dawn l-istampi?
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-raġel hu l-pittur ta' dawn l-istampi?
messages.zh: 那个男人就是画这些画的画家吗？
messages.en: Is that man the painter who made these pictures?

messages.speaker: Ben (展览工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u tista' tkellmu dwar ix-xogħol tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u tista' tkellmu dwar ix-xogħol tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是的，你可以和他聊聊他的作品。
messages.en: Yes, and you can talk to him about his work.

messages.speaker: Marija (展览观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq nistaqsih dwar il-kuluri li juża.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq nistaqsih dwar il-kuluri li juża.
messages.zh: 我想问问他使用的颜色。
messages.en: I'd like to ask him about the colours he uses.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pittur 写在画架旁那个人的名牌上：pinzell 是手里的画笔，pitter 表示绘画动作，pittur 就是作画的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of creating pictures with paint, or a picture made in this way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用颜料创作图画的活动，也指这样创作出来的画作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li toħloq stampi biż-żebgħa, jew stampa maħluqa b'dan il-mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绘画；用颜料创作图画的活动。
图画；画作；绘图作品。

formal.mt: Il-mużew xtara pittura taż-żejt li turi l-port.
formal.en: The museum purchased an oil painting depicting the harbour.
formal.zh: 博物馆购入了一幅描绘港口的油画。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-pittura għamiltha int? Lara: Iva, għamiltha waqt il-lezzjoni tal-pittura.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you paint this picture? Lara: Yes, I painted it during the painting lesson.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这幅画是你画的吗？拉拉：是的，我在绘画课上画的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这幅画是你画的吗？
messages.en: Did you paint this picture?

messages.speaker: Lara (绘画学生)
messages.zh: 是的，我在绘画课上画的。
messages.en: Yes, I painted it during the painting lesson.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pittura 和画室里的两个画面连起来：正在拿笔作画是“绘画”，墙上完成的作品是“画作”。

gloss_zh: 小鸟；鸟（多用于对儿童说话）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bird, especially when speaking to a young child.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟、小鸟，尤其用于大人对幼儿说话的语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur, speċjalment meta wieħed jitkellem ma' tifel żgħir jew tifla żgħira.

sense_translations.en_definition: a bird (a word occurring mainly in child-directed speech)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸟、小鸟；主要用于对儿童说话的词。

sense_translations.en_definition: a bird (word occurring in child-directed speech)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸟、小鸟；用于对儿童说话的词。
鸟。

formal.mt: Fil-ktieb għat-tfal, pizu żgħir jibni bejta f'siġra.
formal.en: In the children's book, a little bird builds a nest in a tree.
formal.zh: 在这本儿童读物中，一只小鸟在树上筑巢。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ara l-pizu fuq il-fergħa! Nina: Qed ikanta! Marija: Iva, ejja nisimgħuh.
colloquial.en: Marija: Look at the bird on the branch! Nina: It's singing! Marija: Yes, let's listen to it.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：看树枝上的小鸟！妮娜：它在唱歌！玛丽娅：是呀，我们听听吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 看树枝上的小鸟！
messages.en: Look at the bird on the branch!

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 它在唱歌！
messages.en: It's singing!

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 是呀，我们听听吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's listen to it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pizu 放进亲子看鸟的场景：大人指着树枝说“小鸟”，孩子抬头听鸟叫，顺便记住它常见于儿童话语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dish consisting of a flat bread base baked with toppings such as tomato and cheese.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在扁平面饼上放番茄、奶酪等配料后烘烤而成的食品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikel magħmul minn bażi ċatta tal-għaġina, b'ingredjenti bħat-tadam u l-ġobon fuqha, li tinħema fil-forn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 比萨饼。
比萨饼；一种在面饼上加配料烘烤而成的食品。

formal.mt: Il-menu jinkludi pizza bil-faqqiegħ u pizza bil-ħaxix.
formal.en: The menu includes a mushroom pizza and a vegetable pizza.
formal.zh: 菜单上有蘑菇比萨饼和蔬菜比萨饼。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nieħdu pizza kbira u naqsmuha? Lara: Iva, imma mingħajr żebbuġ, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mark: Shall we get a large pizza and share it? Lara: Yes, but without olives, please.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们点一个大比萨一起吃，好吗？拉拉：好，不过请不要放橄榄。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们点一个大比萨一起吃，好吗？
messages.en: Shall we get a large pizza and share it?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma mingħajr żebbuġ, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma mingħajr żebbuġ, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 好，不过请不要放橄榄。
messages.en: Yes, but without olives, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用整张圆饼记 pizza，再想象切下一块就是 porzjon pizza；把单词与点餐、分享的动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: How heavy something is, or an object used to provide or measure weight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体有多重，也可指用来增加重量或称量的重物、砝码。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kemm tkun tqila xi ħaġa, jew oġġett li jintuża biex iżid jew ikejjel it-toqol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重量。

sense_translations.en_definition: weight (quality of being more or less heavy)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻重；物体较重或较轻的性质。
一个重物；用于称量的砝码或用于负重的物件。

formal.mt: Il-piż tal-bagalja ma għandux jaqbeż għoxrin kilo.
formal.en: The weight of the suitcase must not exceed twenty kilograms.
formal.zh: 行李箱的重量不得超过二十公斤。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhu l-piż ta' din il-bagalja? Rita: Għaxar kilos. Trid inpoġġiha fuq il-miżien?
colloquial.en: Mark: How much does this suitcase weigh? Rita: Ten kilograms. Shall I put it on the scales?
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个行李箱有多重？丽塔：十公斤。要我把它放到秤上吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (旅客)
messages.zh: 这个行李箱有多重？
messages.en: How much does this suitcase weigh?

messages.speaker: Rita (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaxar kilos. Trid inpoġġiha fuq il-miżien?
messages.mt_standard: Għaxar kilos. Trid inpoġġiha fuq il-miżien?
messages.zh: 十公斤。要我把它放到秤上吗？
messages.en: Ten kilograms. Shall I put it on the scales?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把行李放上秤：读数表示 piż“重量”；再放上一块砝码，那块物件也可以叫 piż。

gloss_zh: 计划；计策；平地；平台；楼层；水平的

teaching_sense.en_definition: An arrangement of actions or steps intended to achieve a particular result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为达到某个目标而安排的行动或步骤，即计划。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sett ta' passi jew azzjonijiet maħsuba biex jintlaħaq għan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 计划；预先安排的行动方案。
计策；为达到目的而设计的巧妙办法。
平地；平坦的地面。
平台；建筑物的楼层。
计划；方案；策划。
水平的；呈水平方向的。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat approva pjan ta' azzjoni biex itejjeb is-servizz.
formal.en: The committee approved an action plan to improve the service.
formal.zh: 委员会批准了一项改善服务的行动计划。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek pjan għal għada? Mark: Iva, immorru l-baħar filgħodu u nieklu barra wara.
