colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a plan for tomorrow? Mark: Yes, we'll go to the seaside in the morning and eat out afterwards.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你明天有什么计划吗？马克：有，我们上午去海边，之后在外面吃饭。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天有什么计划吗？
messages.en: Do you have a plan for tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, immorru l-baħar filgħodu u nieklu barra wara.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, immorru l-baħar filgħodu u nieklu barra wara.
messages.zh: 有，我们上午去海边，之后在外面吃饭。
messages.en: Yes, we'll go to the seaside in the morning and eat out afterwards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用日程表记 pjan“计划”，再用楼层图记“楼层、平台”。这些是分开的词义卡片；作形容词时另记“水平的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large, roughly spherical body that travels around a star.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围绕恒星运行、形状大致呈球形的大型天体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġisem ċelesti kbir, bejn wieħed u ieħor tond, li jdur madwar kewkba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行星；围绕恒星运行的一类天体。

collocations.en: a planet in the solar system

formal.mt: Id-Dinja hija pjaneta li ddur madwar ix-Xemx.
formal.en: Earth is a planet that orbits the Sun.
formal.zh: 地球是一颗围绕太阳运行的行星。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Liema pjaneta hi dik fl-istampa? Pawlu: Dik hi Saturnu. Ara ċ-ċrieki ta' madwarha!
colloquial.en: Nina: Which planet is that in the picture? Pawlu: That's Saturn. Look at the rings around it!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：图片里那是哪颗行星？保罗：那是土星。看它周围的光环！

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 图片里那是哪颗行星？
messages.en: Which planet is that in the picture?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik hi Saturnu. Ara ċ-ċrieki ta' madwarha!
messages.mt_standard: Dik hi Saturnu. Ara ċ-ċrieki ta' madwarha!
messages.zh: 那是土星。看它周围的光环！
messages.en: That's Saturn. Look at the rings around it!

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画出太阳和绕着它运行的地球，把地球旁的标签写成 pjaneta，用绕行的画面记住“行星”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A musical instrument with black and white keys that make hammers strike strings when pressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种带有黑白琴键的乐器，按下琴键时由琴槌敲击琴弦发声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument mużikali b'tasti bojod u suwed li, meta tagħfashom, iħaddmu mrietel żgħar li jolqtu l-kordi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钢琴。

formal.mt: L-istudenta se ddoqq il-pjanu fil-kunċert tal-iskola.
formal.en: The student will play the piano at the school concert.
formal.zh: 这名学生将在学校音乐会上弹奏钢琴。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tista' ddoqq xi ħaġa fuq il-pjanu? Mark: Żgur! Trid tisma' l-biċċa li qed nitgħallem?
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you play something on the piano? Mark: Sure! Would you like to hear the piece I'm learning?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你能用钢琴弹点什么吗？马克：当然！你想听我正在学的那首曲子吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' ddoqq xi ħaġa fuq il-pjanu?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' ddoqq xi ħaġa fuq il-pjanu?
messages.zh: 你能用钢琴弹点什么吗？
messages.en: Can you play something on the piano?

messages.speaker: Mark (钢琴学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur! Trid tisma' l-biċċa li qed nitgħallem?
messages.mt_standard: Żgur! Trid tisma' l-biċċa li qed nitgħallem?
messages.zh: 当然！你想听我正在学的那首曲子吗？
messages.en: Sure! Would you like to hear the piece I'm learning?

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 pjanu 就想象双手落在黑白琴键上，并连读 idoqq il-pjanu“弹钢琴”；注意末尾的 u，帮助区别 pjan“计划”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A helpful act done for someone, or a feeling of pleasure and enjoyment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为别人做的一件帮忙的事，也指愉悦、享受或乐趣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għajnuna li tagħti lil xi ħadd, jew sensazzjoni ta' ferħ u tgawdija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 帮忙；为别人做的有益之事。
愉悦；快乐。
愉悦；享受；乐趣。
帮忙；为别人做的有益之事。
愿望；想要某事物的欲望。

formal.mt: Il-librerija tħeġġeġ lit-tfal jaqraw għall-pjaċir.
formal.en: The library encourages children to read for pleasure.
formal.zh: 图书馆鼓励儿童为了乐趣而阅读。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tista' tagħmilli pjaċir u ġġibli tazza ilma? Pawlu: Bi pjaċir! Tridu kiesaħ?
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you do me a favour and bring me a glass of water? Pawlu: Gladly! Would you like it cold?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你能帮我拿杯水吗？保罗：很乐意！你想要凉水吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tagħmilli pjaċir u ġġibli tazza ilma?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tagħmilli pjaċir u ġġibli tazza ilma?
messages.zh: 你能帮我拿杯水吗？
messages.en: Can you do me a favour and bring me a glass of water?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 很乐意！你想要凉水吗？
messages.en: Gladly! Would you like it cold?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一问一答记住两个常用义：请求 pjaċir 是“帮个忙”，回答 bi pjaċir 是“很乐意”；再把愉快阅读联想到“乐趣”。

gloss_zh: 相当；有点；宁可；倒不如说

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adverb expressing a moderate degree, a preference for one alternative, or a correction to a previous statement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 副词，表示程度上的“相当、有点”，选择上的“宁可”，或纠正前述说法时的“倒不如说”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avverbju li juri grad moderat, preferenza għal għażla minflok oħra, jew korrezzjoni ta' dak li jkun intqal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相当；或表示选择，意为“宁可、宁愿”。
有点；稍微；在一定程度上。
倒不如说；恰恰相反，用于纠正前面的说法。

formal.mt: Il-proposta hija pjuttost interessanti, iżda teħtieġ aktar dettalji.
formal.en: The proposal is rather interesting, but it needs more detail.
formal.zh: 这项提议相当有意思，但需要更多细节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu l-kafè? Mark: Pjuttost qawwi. Se nżid ftit ħalib.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's the coffee like? Mark: Rather strong. I'll add a little milk.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：咖啡怎么样？马克：有点浓。我加一点牛奶。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 咖啡怎么样？
messages.en: What's the coffee like?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pjuttost qawwi. Se nżid ftit ħalib.
messages.mt_standard: Pjuttost qawwi. Se nżid ftit ħalib.
messages.zh: 有点浓。我加一点牛奶。
messages.en: Rather strong. I'll add a little milk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进两个句框记忆：形容词前表示“相当、有点”，接 milli 比较两种选择时表示“而不是”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flat plaque or plate bearing writing or decoration; the word can also refer to an electrical plug.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有文字或装饰的扁平牌匾、铭牌；这个词也可指电插头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa ċatta b'kitba jew dekorazzjoni; il-kelma tista' tirreferi wkoll għal plagg elettriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牌匾；通常带有题字、纪念文字或装饰的牌。
电插头；连接电器与电源插座的部件。
板牌；铭牌；带有标识、文字或装饰的扁平牌片。

formal.mt: Plakka kommemorattiva ħdejn id-daħla tfakkar il-ftuħ tal-mużew.
formal.en: A commemorative plaque beside the entrance marks the opening of the museum.
formal.zh: 入口旁的一块纪念牌匾纪念这座博物馆的开馆。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'hemm miktub fuq dik il-plakka? Mark: Hemm l-isem tal-perit u s-sena meta nfetaħ il-bini.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's written on that plaque? Mark: It gives the architect's name and the year the building opened.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那块牌匾上写着什么？马克：写着建筑师的名字和这栋楼启用的年份。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 那块牌匾上写着什么？
messages.en: What's written on that plaque?

messages.speaker: Mark (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm l-isem tal-perit u s-sena meta nfetaħ il-bini.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm l-isem tal-perit u s-sena meta nfetaħ il-bini.
messages.zh: 写着建筑师的名字和这栋楼启用的年份。
messages.en: It gives the architect's name and the year the building opened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象入口处一块写着名字的牌匾来记主要义；另做一张“电插头”词卡，靠场景区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plate used to serve food, or a dish of prepared food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 盛放食物的盘子，也可指一盘做好的食物或一道菜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent ċatt li fuqu jitqiegħed l-ikel, jew ikel ippreparat u servut bħala parti minn ikla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一道菜；也可指盛放食物的盘碟，具体依语境判断。
盘子；用来盛放或食用食物的器皿。
盘子、盘碟；也可指盘中盛好的一份菜肴。

formal.mt: Il-platt prinċipali jiġi servut ma' ħaxix frisk.
formal.en: The main course is served with fresh vegetables.
formal.zh: 主菜配新鲜蔬菜一起上桌。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tgħaddili platt nadif? Mark: Iva, hawn wieħed ħdejn it-tazzi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you pass me a clean plate? Mark: Yes, there's one here beside the glasses.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：能递给我一个干净盘子吗？马克：可以，杯子旁边这里有一个。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 能递给我一个干净盘子吗？
messages.en: Can you pass me a clean plate?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 可以，杯子旁边这里有一个。
messages.en: Yes, there's one here beside the glasses.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用同一幅餐桌图记两个意思：空着时是“盘子”，装上做好的食物后又能表示“一盘菜、一道菜”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small plate, especially a saucer beneath a cup; also a paten used to hold the wafer during Catholic Mass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小盘子，尤其指放在杯子下面的茶碟；也指天主教弥撒中放置圣饼的圣盘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Platt żgħir, speċjalment wieħed li jitqiegħed taħt tazza; ukoll platt li fuqu titqiegħed l-ostja waqt il-quddiesa Kattolika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 茶碟；放在茶杯或咖啡杯下面的小碟子。

sense_translations.en_definition: paten (saucer-like disc on which the wafer is placed during Catholic mass)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣盘；天主教弥撒中放置圣饼的碟状圆盘。
小碟子；小盘子。

formal.mt: It-tazza għandha titqiegħed fuq il-plattin biex il-mejda tibqa' nadifa.
formal.en: The cup should be placed on the saucer to keep the table clean.
formal.zh: 杯子应放在茶碟上，以保持桌面清洁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid plattin taħt it-tazza? Mark: Iva, grazzi. Poġġi l-kuċċarina fuqu wkoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like a saucer under the cup? Mark: Yes, thanks. Put the teaspoon on it too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：杯子下面要放个茶碟吗？马克：要，谢谢。也把茶匙放在碟子上吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (主人)
messages.zh: 杯子下面要放个茶碟吗？
messages.en: Would you like a saucer under the cup?

messages.speaker: Mark (客人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi. Poġġi l-kuċċarina fuqu wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi. Poġġi l-kuċċarina fuqu wkoll.
messages.zh: 要，谢谢。也把茶匙放在碟子上吧。
messages.en: Yes, thanks. Put the teaspoon on it too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象杯子下面托着的小碟子，先记“茶碟、小盘”；换到弥撒场景，托着圣饼的小圆盘就是“圣盘”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A grammatical number or word form used to refer to more than one person or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 语法中的复数，或表示不止一个人或事物的词形。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadd grammatikali jew forma ta' kelma li tindika aktar minn persuna waħda jew ħaġa waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 复数，语法中表示数量多于一的范畴或词形。
复数；某个词表示多个对象时所用的形式。

formal.mt: Il-plural tal-kelma 'ktieb' huwa 'kotba'.
formal.en: The plural of the word 'ktieb' is 'kotba'.
formal.zh: ktieb（书）的复数形式是 kotba。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu l-plural ta' 'tifel'? Mark: Il-plural huwa 'tfal'.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's the plural of 'tifel'? Mark: The plural is 'tfal'.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：tifel（男孩）的复数是什么？马克：复数是 tfal。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: tifel（男孩）的复数是什么？
messages.en: What's the plural of 'tifel'?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 复数是 tfal。
messages.en: The plural is 'tfal'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一本书和几本书，把 ktieb 与 kotba 并排写；再把 plural 标在“几本书”一侧，记住它指复数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plover, specifically the Eurasian golden plover, Pluvialis apricaria.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种鸻鸟，具体指欧亚金鸻，学名为 Pluvialis apricaria。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tat-tip tal-pluvieri, b'mod speċifiku l-ispeċi Pluvialis apricaria.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种鸟，即鸻鸟。
欧亚金鸻，学名 Pluvialis apricaria。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi ritratt ta' pluviera u deskrizzjoni tal-għasfur.
formal.en: The report includes a photograph of a plover and a description of the bird.
formal.zh: 报告包含一张鸻鸟的照片和对这种鸟的描述。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak l-għasfur fir-ritratt huwa pluviera? Mark: Iva, u hawn miktub l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that bird in the photograph a plover? Mark: Yes, and its scientific name is written here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里的那只鸟是鸻吗？马克：是的，这里还写着它的学名。

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 照片里的那只鸟是鸻吗？
messages.en: Is that bird in the photograph a plover?

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u hawn miktub l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u hawn miktub l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是的，这里还写着它的学名。
messages.en: Yes, and its scientific name is written here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作鸟类图片词卡：正面写 pluviera，背面写“鸻；欧亚金鸻”，再附学名帮助对应具体物种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who writes poetry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 创作诗歌的人，即诗人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tikteb il-poeżija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诗人；从事诗歌创作的人。

formal.mt: Il-poeta se jaqra għażla ta' poeżiji waqt il-laqgħa letterarja.
formal.en: The poet will read a selection of poems at the literary gathering.
formal.zh: 这位诗人将在文学聚会上朗读几首精选诗作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min kiteb din il-poeżija? Mark: Poeta Malti. Għandi ktieb tiegħu jekk trid taqrah.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who wrote this poem? Mark: A Maltese poet. I have a book by him if you'd like to read it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这首诗是谁写的？马克：一位马耳他诗人。我有一本他的书，你想读的话可以看看。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这首诗是谁写的？
messages.en: Who wrote this poem?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Poeta Malti. Għandi ktieb tiegħu jekk trid taqrah.
messages.mt_standard: Poeta Malti. Għandi ktieb tiegħu jekk trid taqrah.
messages.zh: 一位马耳他诗人。我有一本他的书，你想读的话可以看看。
messages.en: A Maltese poet. I have a book by him if you'd like to read it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 poeta 写在“正在写诗的人”旁边，记牢它指创作者本人；与表示作品的 poeżija 配对练习。

gloss_zh: 诗的；诗歌的；富有诗意的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Related to poetry, or having the expressive and imaginative qualities of poetry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与诗歌有关的，或具有诗歌般的表现力和想象力、富有诗意的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-poeżija, jew li għandu l-espressività u l-immaġinazzjoni tal-poeżija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诗歌的；具有诗歌特征的；富有诗意的。

formal.mt: L-awtur juża lingwaġġ poetiku biex jesprimi s-solitudni.
formal.en: The author uses poetic language to express loneliness.
formal.zh: 作者用富有诗意的语言表达孤独。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-messaġġ għandu stil poetiku ħafna. Mark: Iva, speċjalment il-kliem dwar il-baħar u l-qamar.
colloquial.en: Maja: This message has a very poetic style. Mark: Yes, especially the words about the sea and the moon.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这段留言的风格很有诗意。马克：是啊，尤其是描写大海和月亮的那些话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-messaġġ għandu stil poetiku ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-messaġġ għandu stil poetiku ħafna.
messages.zh: 这段留言的风格很有诗意。
messages.en: This message has a very poetic style.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment il-kliem dwar il-baħar u l-qamar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment il-kliem dwar il-baħar u l-qamar.
messages.zh: 是啊，尤其是描写大海和月亮的那些话。
messages.en: Yes, especially the words about the sea and the moon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 poeta“诗人”和 poetiku“有诗意的”放在同一张学习卡上：前者给人命名，后者描述语言或风格。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A poem, or poetry as a form of literary expression.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一首诗，也指以诗的形式表达情感、思想或意象的文学创作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kitba letterarja li tesprimi ħsibijiet, sentimenti jew xbihat, spiss bil-versi; ukoll il-poeżiji bħala forma ta' letteratura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一首诗；一篇诗作。
诗歌；作为文学形式或作品总称的诗。

formal.mt: Għal dan l-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom jaqraw poeżija u jispjegaw it-tema prinċipali tagħha.
formal.en: For this exercise, students should read a poem and explain its main theme.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，学生应阅读一首诗，并解释它的主要主题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed tikteb? Lara: Qed nikteb poeżija għal ommi. Maja: Taqrahieli meta tkun lesta?
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you writing? Lara: I'm writing a poem for my mother. Maja: Will you read it to me when it's ready?
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在写什么？Lara：我在给妈妈写一首诗。Maja：写好以后读给我听，好吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在写什么？
messages.en: What are you writing?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在给妈妈写一首诗。
messages.en: I'm writing a poem for my mother.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 写好以后读给我听，好吗？
messages.en: Will you read it to me when it's ready?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 poeżija 联想到诗集：翻开一页是一首诗，合起整本则想到诗歌这一文学形式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Politics, or a policy that guides the decisions and actions of a government or organization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 政治活动与公共事务，也指政府或机构用来指导决策和行动的政策。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività marbuta mat-tmexxija ta' pajjiż u mal-affarijiet pubbliċi; ukoll prinċipju jew sett ta' regoli li jiggwida d-deċiżjonijiet ta' gvern jew organizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 政治；与国家治理、公共事务和政治活动有关的领域。
政策；政府或机构指导决策与行动的方针。

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija adottat politika ambjentali ġdida biex tnaqqas l-iskart.
formal.en: The company adopted a new environmental policy to reduce waste.
formal.zh: 公司通过了一项新的环境政策，以减少废弃物。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tħobb titkellem dwar il-politika? Sara: Iva, imma llum irrid nitkellem dwar il-politika l-ġdida tal-uffiċċju. Mark: Dik dwar ix-xogħol mid-dar?
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you like talking about politics? Sara: Yes, but today I want to talk about the office's new policy. Mark: The one about working from home?
colloquial.zh: Mark：你喜欢聊政治吗？Sara：喜欢，不过今天我想聊办公室的新政策。Mark：关于居家办公的那项吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 你喜欢聊政治吗？
messages.en: Do you like talking about politics?

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma llum irrid nitkellem dwar il-politika l-ġdida tal-uffiċċju.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma llum irrid nitkellem dwar il-politika l-ġdida tal-uffiċċju.
messages.zh: 喜欢，不过今天我想聊办公室的新政策。
messages.en: Yes, but today I want to talk about the office's new policy.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 关于居家办公的那项吗？
messages.en: The one about working from home?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 politika 放进两个话题框：谈公共事务时是“政治”，谈机构采取什么方针时是“政策”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Related to politics, government, or the management of public affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与政治、政府或公共事务治理有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-politika, mal-gvern jew mat-tmexxija tal-affarijiet pubbliċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 政治的；与政治活动、政府或公共事务有关的。
政治人物；从事政治活动的人。

formal.mt: Id-dibattitu politiku ffoka fuq is-servizzi pubbliċi u l-ħtiġijiet tal-komunità.
formal.en: The political debate focused on public services and the needs of the community.
formal.zh: 这场政治辩论聚焦于公共服务和社区需求。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed tara fuq it-televixin? Mark: Dibattitu politiku. Lara: Dwar xiex qed jitkellmu?
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you watching on television? Mark: A political debate. Lara: What are they talking about?
colloquial.zh: Lara：你在电视上看什么？Mark：一场政治辩论。Lara：他们在讨论什么？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在电视上看什么？
messages.en: What are you watching on television?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 一场政治辩论。
messages.en: A political debate.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们在讨论什么？
messages.en: What are they talking about?

cognitive_memory_aid: 先整块记住 dibattitu politiku“政治辩论”，看到 politiku 修饰话题或活动，就联想到“政治的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: From Poland or related to Poland, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自波兰的，或与波兰、波兰人及其文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Polonja jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Polonja, man-nies tagħha jew mal-kultura tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 波兰的；波兰人的；波兰语的。

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or pertaining to Poland
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自波兰的；与波兰有关的。
波兰人。
波兰语。

formal.mt: Il-kors jintroduċi lill-istudenti għall-Pollakk permezz ta' djalogi qosra u eżerċizzji tal-qari.
formal.en: The course introduces students to Polish through short dialogues and reading exercises.
formal.zh: 这门课程通过简短对话和阅读练习，引导学生学习波兰语。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema lingwa qed titgħallem? Mark: Il-Pollakk. Għandi ħabib Pollakk u rrid nitkellem miegħu bil-lingwa tiegħu. Sara: Tista' tgħallimni kelma?
colloquial.en: Sara: Which language are you learning? Mark: Polish. I have a Polish friend and I want to speak with him in his language. Sara: Can you teach me a word?
colloquial.zh: Sara：你在学哪种语言？Mark：波兰语。我有个波兰朋友，想用他的语言和他交谈。Sara：你能教我一个词吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在学哪种语言？
messages.en: Which language are you learning?

messages.speaker: Mark (语言学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-Pollakk. Għandi ħabib Pollakk u rrid nitkellem miegħu bil-lingwa tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-Pollakk. Għandi ħabib Pollakk u rrid nitkellem miegħu bil-lingwa tiegħu.
messages.zh: 波兰语。我有个波兰朋友，想用他的语言和他交谈。
messages.en: Polish. I have a Polish friend and I want to speak with him in his language.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你能教我一个词吗？
messages.en: Can you teach me a word?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“波兰朋友学波兰语”的画面串联：修饰朋友时表示“波兰的”，指人时是“波兰人”，指语言时是“波兰语”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The pulse, or the wrist where the hand joins the arm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脉搏，即随心跳产生的血管搏动；也指手与手臂相接的手腕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-taħbit tad-demm li jinħass fl-arterji; ukoll il-parti fejn l-id tingħaqad mad-driegħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脉搏；随心跳而产生、可以触摸感知的血管搏动。
手腕；手掌与前臂相接的部位。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-klassi, l-istudenti jkejlu l-polz waqt il-mistrieħ u jirreġistraw in-numru ta' taħbit f'minuta.
formal.en: In the classroom exercise, students measure their resting pulse and record the number of beats in one minute.
formal.zh: 在课堂练习中，学生测量静息时的脉搏，并记录一分钟内的搏动次数。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek arloġġ tal-polz ġdid? Lara: Iva, xtrajtu lbieraħ. Maja: Jogħġobni l-kulur tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a new wristwatch? Lara: Yes, I bought it yesterday. Maja: I like its colour.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你有一块新手表？Lara：是啊，我昨天买的。Maja：我喜欢它的颜色。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有一块新手表？
messages.en: Do you have a new wristwatch?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我昨天买的。
messages.en: Yes, I bought it yesterday.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我喜欢它的颜色。
messages.en: I like its colour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用手指在手腕上感受脉搏：同一个画面同时记住 polz 的“手腕”和“脉搏”两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small horse of a type that remains small when fully grown.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 矮种马；成年后体型仍然较小的一类马。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żiemel ta' tip li jibqa' żgħir fid-daqs anki meta jkun kiber.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 矮种马；体型较小的马。
矮种马，指一种小型马。

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara fir-razzett, it-tfal osservaw poni u tgħallmu kif jieħdu ħsiebu.
formal.en: During the farm visit, the children observed a pony and learned how to care for it.
formal.zh: 参观农场时，孩子们观察了一匹矮种马，并学习如何照料它。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nirkeb il-poni? Pawlu: Iva, l-ewwel ilbes l-elmu u jien nimxi ħdejk. Lara: Tajjeb, lest!
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I ride the pony? Pawlu: Yes, put on your helmet first, and I'll walk beside you. Lara: Okay, ready!
colloquial.zh: Lara：我可以骑这匹矮种马吗？Pawlu：可以，先戴上头盔，我会走在你旁边。Lara：好，准备好了！

messages.speaker: Lara (骑马体验者)
messages.zh: 我可以骑这匹矮种马吗？
messages.en: Can I ride the pony?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (骑术教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-ewwel ilbes l-elmu u jien nimxi ħdejk.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-ewwel ilbes l-elmu u jien nimxi ħdejk.
messages.zh: 可以，先戴上头盔，我会走在你旁边。
messages.en: Yes, put on your helmet first, and I'll walk beside you.

messages.speaker: Lara (骑马体验者)
messages.zh: 好，准备好了！
messages.en: Okay, ready!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 poni 与英语 pony 对照记忆，想象一匹成年后仍然矮小的马，牢牢记住“矮种马”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hand closed tightly with the fingers bent inward; also the amount of something held in one closed hand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 手指向内弯曲握成的拳头；也指一只手抓起的一把东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id magħluqa bis-swaba' mgħawġa 'l ġewwa; ukoll kwantità ta' xi ħaġa li tista' żżomm f'id waħda magħluqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拳头，即手指弯曲握紧时形成的手形。
一把，即一只手能够抓住的量。

formal.mt: Matul l-eżerċizzju, il-parteċipant għalaq idu f'ponn u mbagħad fetaħha bil-mod.
formal.en: During the exercise, the participant closed his hand into a fist and then slowly opened it.
formal.zh: 练习时，参与者先将手握成拳头，然后慢慢张开。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm ross inżid? Toni: Żid ponn ross għalissa; wara naraw jekk hemmx bżonn aktar.
colloquial.en: Lara: How much rice should I add? Toni: Add a handful for now; then we'll see whether we need more.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我要加多少米？托尼：先加一把，之后再看看需不需要更多。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要加多少米？
messages.en: How much rice should I add?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żid ponn ross għalissa; wara naraw jekk hemmx bżonn aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Żid ponn ross għalissa; wara naraw jekk hemmx bżonn aktar.
messages.zh: 先加一把，之后再看看需不需要更多。
messages.en: Add a handful for now; then we'll see whether we need more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把手握成拳头记住 ponn，再想象用同一只手抓一把米，串起“拳头”和“一把”两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A structure built across a river, road, or other gap so that people or vehicles can cross.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 架设在河流、道路或其他间隔之上，供行人或车辆通过的桥梁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Struttura mibnija fuq xmara, triq jew spazju ieħor biex in-nies jew il-vetturi jkunu jistgħu jgħaddu minn naħa għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 桥；连接两侧、供人或车辆跨越障碍的建筑结构。

formal.mt: Il-pont il-ġdid jgħaqqad iż-żewġ naħat tal-wied u jiffaċilita l-moviment tar-residenti.
formal.en: The new bridge connects the two sides of the valley and makes it easier for residents to travel.
formal.zh: 新桥连接山谷两侧，方便居民通行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Naqsmu l-pont biex naslu fil-pjazza? Mark: Iva, il-pjazza tinsab eżatt fuq in-naħa l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we cross the bridge to get to the square? Mark: Yes, the square is just on the other side.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：去广场要过桥吗？马克：对，广场就在另一边。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 去广场要过桥吗？
messages.en: Do we cross the bridge to get to the square?

messages.speaker: Mark (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-pjazza tinsab eżatt fuq in-naħa l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-pjazza tinsab eżatt fuq in-naħa l-oħra.
messages.zh: 对，广场就在另一边。
messages.en: Yes, the square is just on the other side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象走过一座连接两岸的桥，边走边说 pont；把“连接两边、跨过去”的画面固定下来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The narrow or pointed end of an object; in another sense, a small raised spot on the skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体细小或尖锐的末端；另一个义项指皮肤上凸起的小痘痘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tarf irqiq jew bil-ponta ta' oġġett; f'tifsira oħra, nefħa żgħira fuq il-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尖端；物体最末端的小部分。
痘痘；皮肤上凸起的小疙瘩。
尖端；尖头；物体逐渐收窄形成的尖锐末端。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tat-tpinġija, l-istudenti għandhom jużaw il-ponta tal-lapes biex jagħmlu linji rqaq.
formal.en: In the drawing exercise, students should use the tip of the pencil to make thin lines.
formal.zh: 在绘画练习中，学生应使用铅笔尖画出细线。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandi ponta fuq imnieħri, taraha? Nina: Iva, imma hi żgħira ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: I've got a pimple on my nose. Can you see it? Nina: Yes, but it's very small.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我鼻子上长了颗痘痘，你看得到吗？妮娜：看得到，不过很小。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我鼻子上长了颗痘痘，你看得到吗？
messages.en: I've got a pimple on my nose. Can you see it?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 看得到，不过很小。
messages.en: Yes, but it's very small.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个小画面分别记 ponta：纸上的铅笔尖、脸上的小痘痘；这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The people of a particular nation considered together as a collective group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为一个整体来理解的某一国家或民族的人民。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-nies ta' nazzjon partikolari meqjusa flimkien bħala grupp wieħed.

sense_translations.en_definition: people (collective of people comprising a nation)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 人民；构成一个国家或民族的人们的集体。

sense_translations.en_definition: people (a group of persons forming or belonging to a particular nation)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 民族；组成或属于某一特定国家或民族的人群。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi d-drawwiet u t-tradizzjonijiet tal-poplu Malti.
formal.en: The report describes the customs and traditions of the Maltese people.
formal.zh: 该报告介绍了马耳他人民的习俗与传统。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dwar xiex inhu dan il-ktieb? Pawlu: Dwar il-poplu Malti u t-tradizzjonijiet tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this book about? Pawlu: About the Maltese people and their traditions.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这本书讲什么？保罗：讲马耳他人民及其传统。

messages.speaker: Lara (读者)
messages.zh: 这本书讲什么？
messages.en: What is this book about?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (图书管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar il-poplu Malti u t-tradizzjonijiet tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar il-poplu Malti u t-tradizzjonijiet tiegħu.
messages.zh: 讲马耳他人民及其传统。
messages.en: About the Maltese people and their traditions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把许多人围在同一面旗帜下的画面配给 poplu，记住它强调一个民族或国家的人民整体。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Liked, enjoyed, or chosen by many people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到许多人喜爱、欣赏或选择的；受欢迎的或流行的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jogħġob lil ħafna nies, jew li ħafna nies jagħżlu jew jużaw.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受欢迎的；流行的；受到许多人喜爱或选择的。

formal.mt: L-istħarriġ juri li din l-attività hija popolari fost l-istudenti.
formal.en: The survey shows that this activity is popular among students.
formal.zh: 调查显示，这项活动很受学生欢迎。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex hemm daqshekk nies f'dan il-ħanut? Maja: Għax hu popolari ħafna; il-ħobż tiegħu tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why are there so many people in this shop? Maja: Because it's very popular; its bread is good.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这家店怎么这么多人？玛雅：因为它很受欢迎，店里的面包很好吃。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm daqshekk nies f'dan il-ħanut?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm daqshekk nies f'dan il-ħanut?
messages.zh: 这家店怎么这么多人？
messages.en: Why are there so many people in this shop?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu popolari ħafna; il-ħobż tiegħu tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu popolari ħafna; il-ħobż tiegħu tajjeb.
messages.zh: 因为它很受欢迎，店里的面包很好吃。
messages.en: Because it's very popular; its bread is good.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一家门口排着长队的店，用 popolari 描述它“很受欢迎”，把这个词贴在被喜爱的事物旁。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state or degree of being liked, enjoyed, or supported by many people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到许多人喜爱或支持的状态及程度；人气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt jew il-grad li persuna jew ħaġa togħġob lil ħafna nies jew ikollha l-appoġġ tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受欢迎程度；人气；受到公众喜爱或支持的程度。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri żieda fil-popolarità tal-programm fost il-familji.
formal.en: The report shows an increase in the programme's popularity among families.
formal.zh: 报告显示，这个节目在家庭观众中的受欢迎程度有所上升。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif inbiegħu l-biljetti kollha daqshekk malajr? Sara: Il-popolarità ta' din il-kantanta żdiedet ħafna dan l-aħħar.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did all the tickets sell out so quickly? Sara: This singer's popularity has grown a lot recently.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：票怎么这么快就卖完了？萨拉：这位女歌手最近人气涨了很多。

messages.speaker: Nina (歌迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inbiegħu l-biljetti kollha daqshekk malajr?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inbiegħu l-biljetti kollha daqshekk malajr?
messages.zh: 票怎么这么快就卖完了？
messages.en: How did all the tickets sell out so quickly?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-popolarità ta' din il-kantanta żdiedet ħafna dan l-aħħar.
messages.mt_standard: Il-popolarità ta' din il-kantanta żdiedet ħafna dan l-aħħar.
messages.zh: 这位女歌手最近人气涨了很多。
messages.en: This singer's popularity has grown a lot recently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 popolarità 想成人气温度计：刻度越高，越受欢迎；与表示“受欢迎的”的 popolari 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: All the people living in a particular place, or the total number of those people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 居住在某一地区的全部人口，或这些居民的总人数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-nies kollha li jgħixu f'post partikolari, jew in-numru totali tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人口；某一地区的全体居民或居民总数。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, il-popolazzjoni tal-belt żdiedet matul is-sena.
formal.en: According to the report, the city's population increased during the year.
formal.zh: 根据报告，这座城市的人口在该年度有所增加。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Kibret il-popolazzjoni tar-raħal? Lara: Iva, issa jgħixu hawn aktar nies minn qabel.
colloquial.en: Toni: Has the village's population grown? Lara: Yes, more people live here now than before.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：村里的人口增加了吗？拉拉：对，现在住在这里的人比以前多了。

messages.speaker: Toni (返乡居民)
messages.zh: 村里的人口增加了吗？
messages.en: Has the village's population grown?

messages.speaker: Lara (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa jgħixu hawn aktar nies minn qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa jgħixu hawn aktar nies minn qabel.
messages.zh: 对，现在住在这里的人比以前多了。
messages.en: Yes, more people live here now than before.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 popolazzjoni 就想象统计员数一座城里有多少居民：关注居住人口及数量，可与强调人民整体的 poplu 对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The rear part of a boat or ship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 船只后端的部分，即船尾或艉部。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' wara ta' dgħajsa jew vapur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 此义仅列出词形“Poppa”，未注明可进一步确定的中文含义。
船尾；船只后端的部分。
船尾；艉部，也可指船尾的上部区域。

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi l-poppa tad-dgħajsa u l-pożizzjoni tas-sedili ta' wara.
formal.en: The diagram shows the stern of the boat and the position of the rear seats.
formal.zh: 示意图展示了小船的船尾以及后排座位的位置。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn inpoġġi din il-borża? Pawlu: Poġġiha fil-poppa, ħdejn is-sedil.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where should I put this bag? Pawlu: Put it at the stern, beside the seat.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个包放在哪里？保罗：放在船尾，座位旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (乘客)
messages.zh: 这个包放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this bag?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (船员)
messages.zh: 放在船尾，座位旁边。
messages.en: Put it at the stern, beside the seat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一艘朝前行驶的小船，把 poppa 标在最后端，再用 fil-poppa 记住“在船尾”这一位置表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sheltered place by the sea where ships arrive, depart, and load or unload.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供船舶停泊、进出以及装卸货物的海边港口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post imħares ħdejn il-baħar fejn il-vapuri jidħlu, joħorġu, jgħabbu u jħottu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海港；供船舶停泊的避风港。
港口；供船舶进出、停泊及装卸货物的地方。

formal.mt: Il-vapur daħal fil-port kmieni filgħodu biex iħott il-merkanzija.
formal.en: The ship entered the harbour early in the morning to unload its cargo.
formal.zh: 船舶清晨驶入港口卸货。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn qiegħed il-vapur? Mark: Għadu fil-port. Maja: Mela nistgħu narawh minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the ship? Mark: It's still in the harbour. Maja: Then we can see it from here.
colloquial.zh: Maja：船在哪里？Mark：还在港口。Maja：那我们从这里就能看见它。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 船在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the ship?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 还在港口。
messages.en: It's still in the harbour.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们从这里就能看见它。
messages.en: Then we can see it from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把港口想成船舶的停车场：船进港说 jidħol fil-port，船出港说 joħroġ mill-port，配合进出画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A purse, wallet, or handbag used to carry money and small personal belongings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于随身装钱或小件私人物品的钱包、钱袋或手提包；具体所指由语境确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett bħal kartiera jew basket żgħir li fih jinżammu l-flus u affarijiet personali żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钱袋；小钱包，常用于装硬币或现金。
钱包；用于随身放纸币、卡片等的夹式钱包。
手提包；随身携带钱物及其他个人用品的包。

collocations.en: look for one's purse or wallet

formal.mt: Min isib portmoni fil-bini għandu jagħtih lill-persuna responsabbli mir-riċeviment.
formal.en: Anyone who finds a purse or wallet in the building should hand it to the person in charge of reception.
formal.zh: 在楼内捡到钱包的人应将其交给前台负责人。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ma nistax insib il-portmoni tiegħi. Pawlu: Ħarist fil-basket? Sara: Iva, hawn hu! Grazzi.
colloquial.en: Sara: I can't find my wallet. Pawlu: Did you look in the bag? Sara: Yes, here it is! Thanks.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我找不到钱包了。Pawlu：你看过包里了吗？Sara：看了，就在这里！谢谢。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我找不到钱包了。
messages.en: I can't find my wallet.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看过包里了吗？
messages.en: Did you look in the bag?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看了，就在这里！谢谢。
messages.en: Yes, here it is! Thanks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门前检查装钱的小包，把 portmoni 和“钱包在哪里”这一场景绑定；遇到手提包义时，再用上下文确定大小和用途。

gloss_zh: 葡萄牙人；葡萄牙语；葡萄牙的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A Portuguese person, or the Portuguese language, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作名词指葡萄牙人或葡萄牙语，具体含义由谈论人物还是语言的语境确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna mill-Portugall, jew il-lingwa Portugiża, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 葡萄牙人。
葡萄牙语。
葡萄牙的；葡萄牙人的；葡萄牙语的。

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or pertaining to Portugal
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自葡萄牙的；与葡萄牙有关的。
葡萄牙的；葡萄牙人的；葡萄牙语的。
葡萄牙人，指人。
葡萄牙语，指语言。

formal.mt: L-istudent għażel li jistudja l-Portugiż biex ikun jista' jaqra testi bil-lingwa oriġinali.
formal.en: The student chose to study Portuguese so that he could read texts in the original language.
formal.zh: 这名学生选择学习葡萄牙语，以便阅读原文。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-ħabib il-ġdid tiegħek Portugiż? David: Iva, u jgħinni nitgħallem il-Portugiż. Lara: Mela tistgħu tipprattikaw flimkien!
colloquial.en: Lara: Is your new friend Portuguese? David: Yes, and he helps me learn Portuguese. Lara: Then you can practise together!
colloquial.zh: Lara：你的新朋友是葡萄牙人吗？David：是的，他还帮我学葡萄牙语。Lara：那你们可以一起练习！

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你的新朋友是葡萄牙人吗？
messages.en: Is your new friend Portuguese?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: 是的，他还帮我学葡萄牙语。
messages.en: Yes, and he helps me learn Portuguese.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 那你们可以一起练习！
messages.en: Then you can practise together!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 Portugiż 配三张卡片：人物卡记“葡萄牙人”，对话气泡卡记“葡萄牙语”，作家卡记形容词“葡萄牙的”，用搭配区分词义和词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to happen, be true, or be done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有可能发生、属实或实现的；在条件允许下可以做到的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jiġri, ikun veru jew isir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可能的；能够发生、成立或做到的。

formal.mt: Huwa possibbli li l-laqgħa ssir online jekk il-parteċipanti kollha jaqblu.
formal.en: It is possible to hold the meeting online if all participants agree.
formal.zh: 如果所有参与者都同意，会议可以在线举行。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Huwa possibbli li niltaqgħu għada? Mark: Iva, wara x-xogħol. Nina: Tajjeb, fis-sitta mela.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is it possible for us to meet tomorrow? Mark: Yes, after work. Nina: Great, at six then.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们明天能见面吗？Mark：可以，下班以后。Nina：好，那就六点。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们明天能见面吗？
messages.en: Is it possible for us to meet tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 可以，下班以后。
messages.en: Yes, after work.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，那就六点。
messages.en: Great, at six then.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 possibbli 贴在尚未关闭的门上，表示事情“有可能、做得到”；整句记住 Huwa possibbli li...，帮助理解后面接可能发生的事情。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A chance that something may happen or be true, or an option that could be considered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事发生或属实的可能性，也可指可以考虑的一种选择。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċ-ċans li xi ħaġa tiġri jew tkun vera, jew għażla li tista' titqies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可能性；某事可能发生的情况，或可供考虑的选择。

collocations.zh: 另一种可能性；另一个可行选择

formal.mt: Il-kumitat se jeżamina l-possibilità li jiftaħ ċentru ġdid għall-istudenti.
formal.en: The committee will examine the possibility of opening a new centre for students.
formal.zh: 委员会将研究开设新学生中心的可能性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm possibilità li tiġi magħna nhar is-Sibt? Sara: Iva, jekk nispiċċa x-xogħol fil-ħin. Maja: Tajjeb, għidli meta tkun taf.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there a possibility that you'll come with us on Saturday? Sara: Yes, if I finish work on time. Maja: Great, tell me when you know.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你星期六有可能和我们一起去吗？Sara：有，如果我能按时做完工作。Maja：好，确定了就告诉我。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm possibilità li tiġi magħna nhar is-Sibt?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm possibilità li tiġi magħna nhar is-Sibt?
messages.zh: 你星期六有可能和我们一起去吗？
messages.en: Is there a possibility that you'll come with us on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，如果我能按时做完工作。
messages.en: Yes, if I finish work on time.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，确定了就告诉我。
messages.en: Great, tell me when you know.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上放着几张待选方案卡，每张都是 possibilità；用“有一种可能性”记名词用法，再与 possibbli“可能的”作句子对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to say that something may happen or be true, without expressing certainty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某事也许会发生或也许属实，但说话者并不确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża biex juri li xi ħaġa tista' tiġri jew tkun vera, mingħajr ċertezza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可能；也许；表示对事情是否发生或属实尚不确定。

formal.mt: Il-ferrovija se tasal tard, possibilment minħabba problema teknika.
formal.en: The train will arrive late, possibly because of a technical problem.
formal.zh: 火车将晚点到达，可能是由于技术故障。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Meta se tasal Anna? Lara: Possibilment fis-sebgħa, imma għadha ma kkonfermatx. Pawlu: Mela nistennew il-messaġġ tagħha.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: When will Anna arrive? Lara: Possibly at seven, but she hasn't confirmed yet. Pawlu: Then let's wait for her message.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：Anna什么时候到？Lara：可能七点，但她还没确认。Pawlu：那我们等她的消息吧。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: Anna什么时候到？
messages.en: When will Anna arrive?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Possibilment fis-sebgħa, imma għadha ma kkonfermatx.
messages.mt_standard: Possibilment fis-sebgħa, imma għadha ma kkonfermatx.
messages.zh: 可能七点，但她还没确认。
messages.en: Possibly at seven, but she hasn't confirmed yet.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们等她的消息吧。
messages.en: Then let's wait for her message.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 possibilment 想成说话前轻轻加上的“也许”：possibilment għada 就是“也许明天”。用不确定的语气朗读，记住它表示判断而非承诺。

gloss_zh: 穷人；可怜的人；贫穷的；可怜的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person with little money, or someone whose situation makes others feel pity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经济贫困的人，或因遭遇不幸而令人同情、怜悯的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha ftit flus, jew persuna li tqanqal ħasra minħabba s-sitwazzjoni tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穷人；缺少钱财或生活资源的人。
可怜的人；处境令人同情或怜悯的人。
贫穷的；经济拮据的。
可怜的；令人同情或怜悯的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-povru ma kellux flus għall-ikel, iżda l-ġirien offrewlu l-għajnuna.
formal.en: In the story, the poor man had no money for food, but the neighbours offered him help.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个穷人没有钱买食物，但邻居们向他伸出了援手。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu tilef il-karozza tal-linja u kellu jimxi fix-xita. Mark: Povru! Wasal id-dar? Sara: Iva, issa qiegħed id-dar u qed jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Pawlu missed the bus and had to walk in the rain. Mark: Poor guy! Did he get home? Sara: Yes, he's home now and resting.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Pawlu没赶上公交车，只好冒雨走路。Mark：真可怜！他到家了吗？Sara：到了，现在在家休息。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu tilef il-karozza tal-linja u kellu jimxi fix-xita.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu tilef il-karozza tal-linja u kellu jimxi fix-xita.
messages.zh: Pawlu没赶上公交车，只好冒雨走路。
messages.en: Pawlu missed the bus and had to walk in the rain.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 真可怜！他到家了吗？
messages.en: Poor guy! Did he get home?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa qiegħed id-dar u qed jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa qiegħed id-dar u qed jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 到了，现在在家休息。
messages.en: Yes, he's home now and resting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 povru 配两幅图：空钱包对应“贫穷”，淋雨错过车对应“可怜”。先看上下文是在谈钱还是表达同情，再判断名词或形容词用法。

gloss_zh: 混蛋；卑劣的人（粗俗辱称）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vulgar insult for a person regarded as nasty, creepy, or of low character.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来辱骂被认为讨厌、令人反感或品行卑劣之人的粗俗名词，语气具有侮辱性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma vulgari u offensiva għal persuna meqjusa ħażina, diżgustanti jew ta' karattru baxx.

sense_translations.en_definition: term of abuse for sb. considered nasty or a creep (vulgar)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于辱骂讨厌或令人反感之人的粗俗称呼，近似“混蛋”“恶心的家伙”。
品行卑劣的人；带有强烈贬斥和侮辱意味的称呼。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-kelma 'poxt' tintuża bħala insult vulgari biex turi r-rabja tal-karattru.
formal.en: In the story, the word 'poxt' is used as a vulgar insult to show the character's anger.
formal.zh: 故事中，poxt 一词被用作粗俗辱称，以表现人物的愤怒。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex sejjaħlu poxt? Sara: Għax kien irrabjat ħafna. Mark: Xorta seta' jgħid x'ġara mingħajr ma jinsultah.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did he call him a bastard? Sara: Because he was very angry. Mark: He could still have said what happened without insulting him.
colloquial.zh: Mark：他为什么骂那个人是混蛋？Sara：因为他当时很生气。Mark：他还是可以把事情说清楚，不用骂人。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么骂那个人是混蛋？
messages.en: Why did he call him a bastard?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为他当时很生气。
messages.en: Because he was very angry.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xorta seta' jgħid x'ġara mingħajr ma jinsultah.
messages.mt_standard: Xorta seta' jgħid x'ġara mingħajr ma jinsultah.
messages.zh: 他还是可以把事情说清楚，不用骂人。
messages.en: He could still have said what happened without insulting him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 poxt 写在带有“粗俗辱称”提示的词卡上，联想争吵中骂人的“混蛋”；同时记住它表达对人的侮辱，不是中性的性格描述。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sit down or put something in a particular place; poġġa is the past-tense form used with a masculine singular subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 坐下，或把某物放到某处；poġġa 是用于阳性单数主语的过去时形式，可表示“他坐下了”或“他放了”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joqgħod bilqiegħda jew iqiegħed xi ħaġa f'post; poġġa hija forma tal-passat li tintuża ma' suġġett maskil singular.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坐；坐下。
把某物放下或放到某处。
将某物放置在特定位置。
坐下；歇息。

sense_translations.en_definition: to put; to place; to lay
sense_translations.zh_definition: 放；放置；平放。
有妾；纳妾。
存放；存入；寄存。

collocations.en: he sat down on a chair
collocations.zh: 他在一把椅子上坐下了

collocations.en: he put the book on the table

formal.mt: Qabel beda jaqra, l-istudent poġġa l-ktieb fuq il-mejda u poġġa fuq siġġu ħdejn it-tieqa.
formal.en: Before he began reading, the student put the book on the table and sat down on a chair beside the window.
formal.zh: 开始阅读之前，那名学生把书放在桌上，然后在窗边的一把椅子上坐下。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn poġġa l-borża Mark? Maja: Poġġieha ħdejn il-bieb. Lara: Tajjeb, sibtha!
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did Mark put the bag? Maja: He put it next to the door. Lara: Great, I found it!
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark 把包放在哪里了？Maja：他把包放在门边了。Lara：好，找到了！

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: Mark 把包放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did Mark put the bag?

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 他把包放在门边了。
messages.en: He put it next to the door.

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 好，找到了！
messages.en: Great, I found it!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个动作记 poġġa：他先把书放到桌上，再把自己安顿到椅子上；分别对应“放了”和“坐下了”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rail beside stairs or a walkway that people hold for support.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设在楼梯或通道旁、供人抓握以保持平衡的扶手或扶栏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti maġenb taraġ jew passaġġ li wieħed jista' jaqbad magħha biex ikollu appoġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供手抓握、用于支撑身体的扶手。
楼梯扶栏；楼梯旁的扶手栏杆。

collocations.en: to hold on to the handrail

formal.mt: Għas-sigurtà tagħhom, il-viżitaturi għandhom jaqbdu mal-poġġaman waqt li jinżlu t-taraġ.
formal.en: For their safety, visitors should hold on to the handrail while going down the stairs.
formal.zh: 为保障自身安全，参观者下楼梯时应抓住扶手。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan it-taraġ għoli! Pawlu: Aqbad mal-poġġaman u inżel bil-mod. Anna: Hekk aħjar, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Anna: These stairs are steep! Pawlu: Hold on to the handrail and go down slowly. Anna: That's better, thanks.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这楼梯好陡！Pawlu：抓住扶手，慢慢下。Anna：这样好多了，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Anna (游客)
messages.zh: 这楼梯好陡！
messages.en: These stairs are steep!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 抓住扶手，慢慢下。
messages.en: Hold on to the handrail and go down slowly.

messages.speaker: Anna (游客)
messages.zh: 这样好多了，谢谢。
messages.en: That's better, thanks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象下楼时手掌沿着扶手滑动，把 poġġaman 与“伸手抓住楼梯扶手”的画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An eating utensil, such as a knife, fork or spoon; also cutlery considered collectively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于进餐的刀、叉、匙等餐具；既可指一件餐具，也可统指这类餐具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda għall-ikel, bħal sikkina, furketta jew kuċċarina; tintuża wkoll biex tirreferi għal dawn l-għodod flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刀、叉、匙等进餐用餐具的统称。
一件进餐用餐具，如一把叉子或一把匙。

formal.mt: Qabel ma jiġu l-mistednin, għandha titqiegħed pożata nadifa fuq kull mejda.
formal.en: Before the guests arrive, clean cutlery should be placed on every table.
formal.zh: 客人到达前，应在每张桌上摆放干净的餐具。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandna biżżejjed pożati għal kulħadd? Mark: Iva, hemm sett ieħor fil-kexxun.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do we have enough cutlery for everyone? Mark: Yes, there's another set in the drawer.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们的餐具够所有人用吗？马克：够，抽屉里还有一套。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 我们的餐具够所有人用吗？
messages.en: Do we have enough cutlery for everyone?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 够，抽屉里还有一套。
messages.en: Yes, there's another set in the drawer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象餐桌上摆着刀叉匙，把 pożata 与这幅餐具画面相连；再用“一件”和“一套”分别练习单件义与集合义。

gloss_zh: 位置；姿势；立场；等级；职业

teaching_sense.en_definition: The place or arrangement of someone or something, a bodily posture, a viewpoint, or a person's rank or occupation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或事物所处的位置、身体姿势，也可指对某事的立场，以及个人的等级或职业。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-post fejn jinsab xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, il-qagħda tal-ġisem, fehma dwar kwistjoni, jew il-grad jew ix-xogħol ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 位置或所处状态，具体含义由上下文决定。
身体的姿势或姿态。
对某件事持有的意见或立场。
人或物所在的具体地点、位置。
在某个体系中的等级、级别或名次。
个人从事的职业或担任的工作职位。

collocations.en: a clear position on the issue

formal.mt: Il-kumitat spjega l-pożizzjoni tiegħu dwar il-proposta f'rapport miktub.
formal.en: The committee explained its position on the proposal in a written report.
formal.zh: 委员会在书面报告中阐明了其对该提案的立场。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-pożizzjoni mhix komda għal dahri. Lara: Poġġi kuxxin warajk u ara jekk tħossokx aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: This position isn't comfortable for my back. Lara: Put a cushion behind you and see if you feel better.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个姿势让我背部不舒服。拉拉：在身后放个靠垫，看看会不会舒服些。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-pożizzjoni mhix komda għal dahri.
messages.mt_standard: Din il-pożizzjoni mhix komda għal dahri.
messages.zh: 这个姿势让我背部不舒服。
messages.en: This position isn't comfortable for my back.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġi kuxxin warajk u ara jekk tħossokx aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġi kuxxin warajk u ara jekk tħossokx aħjar.
messages.zh: 在身后放个靠垫，看看会不会舒服些。
messages.en: Put a cushion behind you and see if you feel better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“站在哪里”串联记忆：物体有位置，身体有姿势，讨论有立场，工作有职位；这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To forbid an action or ban the use of something through a rule, order or decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过规定、命令或决定，禁止某种行为或不准使用某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma ħalliex li ssir azzjoni jew li tintuża xi ħaġa, permezz ta' regola, ordni jew deċiżjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 禁止；不允许某人做某事。

sense_translations.en_definition: to forbid; to ban; to prohibit
sense_translations.zh_definition: 禁止；通过命令、规定或禁令，不准某种行为或某物的使用。

collocations.en: prohibited the use of mobile phones

formal.mt: Id-direttur ipprojbixxa l-użu tal-mowbajls waqt l-eżami biex jiżgura kundizzjonijiet ġusti għal kulħadd.
formal.en: The director prohibited the use of mobile phones during the examination to ensure fair conditions for everyone.
formal.zh: 负责人禁止在考试期间使用手机，以确保所有人都能在公平的条件下应试。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nista' npejjep hawn ġew? Lara: Le, is-sid ipprojbixxa t-tipjip ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can I smoke in here? Lara: No, the owner has banned smoking indoors.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我能在这里面抽烟吗？拉拉：不能，店主禁止在室内吸烟。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 我能在这里面抽烟吗？
messages.en: Can I smoke in here?

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.zh: 不能，店主禁止在室内吸烟。
messages.en: No, the owner has banned smoking indoors.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门上贴着禁烟标志，再说出 pprojbixxa t-tipjip；把这个动词和“明令不准做”的情境一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To attempt an action, test something, put someone through a trial, or demonstrate that something is true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尝试做某事、试用或测试某物；也可指使人经受考验，或证明某事属实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel tentattiv biex jagħmel xi ħaġa, ittestja xi ħaġa, għadda lil xi ħadd minn prova diffiċli, jew wera li xi ħaġa kienet vera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尝试；努力做某事。
尝试、试用或测试，以了解效果、性能或是否合适。

sense_translations.en_definition: to try; to put through trial, temptation, tribulation
sense_translations.zh_definition: 考验；使人经历试炼、诱惑或磨难。
证明；用证据或论证说明某事是真实或成立的。

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur ipprova l-metodu l-ġdid fuq kampjun żgħir qabel ma użah fl-istudju ewlieni.
formal.en: The researcher tested the new method on a small sample before using it in the main study.
formal.zh: 研究人员先在小样本上测试了新方法，然后才将其用于主要研究。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu pprova jiftaħ il-vażett? Mark: Iva, imma l-għatu għadu mwaħħal.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu try to open the jar? Mark: Yes, but the lid is still stuck.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗试过打开这个罐子吗？马克：试过了，但盖子还是卡着。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 保罗试过打开这个罐子吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu try to open the jar?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 试过了，但盖子还是卡着。
messages.en: Yes, but the lid is still stuck.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按宾语记四个场景：试着开门、试用设备、经受考验、证明事实；不要把每次出现的 pprova 都机械译成“尝试”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To provide or supply something that is needed; in another sense, to obtain something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提供或供应所需的物品、资源或帮助；另一个义项表示获得某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta jew għamel disponibbli dak li kien meħtieġ; f'tifsira oħra, kiseb xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提供；使所需的东西可供使用。
提供、供应；向人或机构供给物品、资源或服务。
获得；取得所需的东西。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill ipprovda ilma tax-xorb u ikel lill-familji milquta mill-għargħar.
formal.en: The council provided drinking water and food to the families affected by the flooding.
formal.zh: 地方议会向受洪灾影响的家庭提供了饮用水和食物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min ipprovda l-ikel għall-festa? Mark: Pawlu pprovda l-ikel, u jien ġibt ix-xorb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who provided the food for the party? Mark: Pawlu provided the food, and I brought the drinks.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：聚会的食物是谁提供的？马克：保罗提供了食物，我带来了饮料。

messages.speaker: Lara (聚会组织者)
messages.zh: 聚会的食物是谁提供的？
messages.en: Who provided the food for the party?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu pprovda l-ikel, u jien ġibt ix-xorb.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu pprovda l-ikel, u jien ġibt ix-xorb.
messages.zh: 保罗提供了食物，我带来了饮料。
messages.en: Pawlu provided the food, and I brought the drinks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象聚会分工表上的“提供食物”和“提供饮料”，用 pprovda 配具体物品记忆；遇到“获得”义时，再单独确认取得东西的是谁。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A main meal, often lunch, or a dinner, supper or banquet depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一天中的正餐，常指午餐；根据语境，也可指晚餐或宴席。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikla prinċipali, spiss dik ta' nofsinhar; skont il-kuntest, tista' tkun ukoll ikla ta' filgħaxija jew ikla kbira għal okkażjoni speċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正餐；常指晚餐，具体用餐时间需结合语境判断。
晚餐；晚间吃的一餐。
午餐；中午吃的一餐。
宴席；为庆祝或正式场合举办的丰盛聚餐。

formal.mt: Il-pranzu għall-parteċipanti se jiġi servut fis-siegħa ta' wara nofsinhar fis-sala prinċipali.
formal.en: Lunch for the participants will be served at one in the afternoon in the main hall.
formal.zh: 参加者的午餐将于下午一点在主厅供应。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'hemm għall-pranzu llum? Omm: Għaġin u insalata; ikun lest f'nofs siegħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's for lunch today? Mum: Pasta and salad; it'll be ready in half an hour.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天午餐吃什么？妈妈：意大利面和沙拉，半小时后就好。

messages.speaker: Maja (女儿)
messages.zh: 今天午餐吃什么？
messages.en: What's for lunch today?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaġin u insalata; ikun lest f'nofs siegħa.
messages.mt_standard: Għaġin u insalata; ikun lest f'nofs siegħa.
messages.zh: 意大利面和沙拉，半小时后就好。
messages.en: Pasta and salad; it'll be ready in half an hour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 pranzu 放进“中午坐下吃正餐”的画面，再看时间和场合判断译成午餐、晚餐还是宴席，避免只背一种中文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A liking for one option more than another, or special treatment given to one person over others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某个选项更喜欢或优先选择；也指对某个人给予特殊照顾的偏袒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għażla jew ħaġa li tħobb aktar minn oħra, jew trattament aħjar li jingħata lil persuna aktar milli lil oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偏好；相比其他事物更喜欢或更愿意选择某事物。
偏袒；不公平地给予某人优待或优先机会。

collocations.zh: 优先考虑某人；偏向某人

formal.mt: Il-kumitat għandu jevalwa kull applikazzjoni bl-istess kriterji, mingħajr ma jagħti preferenza inġusta lil ħadd.
formal.en: The committee should assess every application using the same criteria, without showing unfair favouritism to anyone.
formal.zh: 委员会应使用相同标准评估每份申请，不得不公平地偏袒任何人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek xi preferenza għat-te jew għall-kafè? Pawlu: Nippreferi t-te, imma kafè tajjeb ukoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have a preference for tea or coffee? Pawlu: I prefer tea, but coffee is fine too.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：茶和咖啡，你更喜欢哪一种？保罗：我更喜欢茶，不过咖啡也可以。

messages.speaker: Lara (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek xi preferenza għat-te jew għall-kafè?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek xi preferenza għat-te jew għall-kafè?
messages.zh: 茶和咖啡，你更喜欢哪一种？
messages.en: Do you have a preference for tea or coffee?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (客人)
messages.mt_spoken: Nippreferi t-te, imma kafè tajjeb ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Nippreferi t-te, imma kafè tajjeb ukoll.
messages.zh: 我更喜欢茶，不过咖啡也可以。
messages.en: I prefer tea, but coffee is fine too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“选择时心里的天平偏向一边”：选饮料是个人偏好，分机会时不公平地偏向某人则是偏袒。

gloss_zh: 圣诞马槽布景；耶稣诞生场景模型

teaching_sense.en_definition: A Christmas display representing the birth of Jesus, usually with figures arranged around a manger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 圣诞节展示的耶稣诞生场景布景，通常用人物模型围绕马槽摆设。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xena tal-Milied li turi t-twelid ta' Ġesù, ġeneralment b'figurini madwar il-maxtura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣诞马槽布景；表现耶稣诞生场景的摆设。
耶稣诞生场景模型；圣诞节设置的马槽及相关人物布景。

collocations.zh: 制作耶稣诞生场景模型

formal.mt: Il-presepju fil-wirja juri lil Marija, lil Ġużeppi u lil Ġesù tarbija ħdejn l-annimali.
formal.en: The nativity scene in the exhibition depicts Mary, Joseph, and the infant Jesus beside the animals.
formal.zh: 展览中的圣诞马槽布景展现了玛利亚、约瑟和婴儿耶稣在动物旁的场景。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn se npoġġu l-presepju din is-sena? Rita: Fuq il-mejda ħdejn it-tieqa, biex kulħadd ikun jista' jarah.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where shall we put the nativity scene this year? Rita: On the table by the window, so everyone can see it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：今年我们把圣诞马槽布景放在哪里？丽塔：放在窗边的桌子上，这样大家都能看到。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se npoġġu l-presepju din is-sena?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se npoġġu l-presepju din is-sena?
messages.zh: 今年我们把圣诞马槽布景放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we put the nativity scene this year?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-mejda ħdejn it-tieqa, biex kulħadd ikun jista' jarah.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-mejda ħdejn it-tieqa, biex kulħadd ikun jista' jarah.
messages.zh: 放在窗边的桌子上，这样大家都能看到。
messages.en: On the table by the window, so everyone can see it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 presepju 记成桌上的一整幕圣诞故事：马槽、婴儿和人物模型共同构成“耶稣诞生布景”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The amount of money asked or paid for a product, service, or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 购买商品、接受服务或参加活动时要求支付或实际支付的金额。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ammont ta' flus mitlub jew imħallas għal prodott, servizz jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 价格；商品或服务标示或商定的金额。
收费；提供某项服务所收取的款项。
花费；获得某物或完成某事所需支付的金额。
费用；为某项服务、参与资格或使用权支付的款项。

formal.mt: Il-prezz tal-kors jinkludi l-materjal tat-tagħlim u l-użu tal-laboratorju.
formal.en: The course fee includes the learning materials and use of the laboratory.
formal.zh: 课程费用包含学习材料和实验室使用费。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhu l-prezz ta' din il-borża? Sara: Għoxrin ewro, u għandna waħda iżgħar bi ħmistax-il ewro.
colloquial.en: Mark: What is the price of this bag? Sara: Twenty euros, and we have a smaller one for fifteen euros.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个包多少钱？萨拉：二十欧元，我们还有一个小一点的，十五欧元。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个包多少钱？
messages.en: What is the price of this bag?

messages.speaker: Sara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għoxrin ewro, u għandna waħda iżgħar bi ħmistax-il ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Għoxrin ewro, u għandna waħda iżgħar bi ħmistax-il ewro.
messages.zh: 二十欧元，我们还有一个小一点的，十五欧元。
messages.en: Twenty euros, and we have a smaller one for fifteen euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到商品价签就想到 prezz；再把场景换成课程或服务，同一个词也可以表示要付的费用。

gloss_zh: 珍贵的；贵重的；有价值的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having great value because of its worth, usefulness, rarity, or personal importance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因经济价值、用途、稀少程度或个人意义而十分贵重或值得珍惜的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu valur kbir minħabba l-prezz, l-utilità, ir-rarità jew l-importanza tiegħu għal xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 珍贵的；因稀有或具有特殊意义而值得珍惜的。
有价值的；经济价值高或很有用的。
珍贵的；贵重的；具有重要价值的。

formal.mt: Dan il-manuskritt prezzjuż għandu jinżamm f'kundizzjonijiet xierqa biex ma ssirlu ebda ħsara.
formal.en: This valuable manuscript should be kept in suitable conditions to prevent any damage.
formal.zh: 这份珍贵的手稿应保存在适宜的环境中，以防受到任何损坏。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex iżżomm dan l-arloġġ il-qadim? David: Għalija hu prezzjuż ħafna għax kien ta' missieri.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why do you keep this old watch? David: It is very precious to me because it belonged to my father.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你为什么留着这块旧手表？戴维：它对我来说很珍贵，因为它曾是我父亲的。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么留着这块旧手表？
messages.en: Why do you keep this old watch?

messages.speaker: David (手表主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalija hu prezzjuż ħafna għax kien ta' missieri.
messages.mt_standard: Għalija hu prezzjuż ħafna għax kien ta' missieri.
messages.zh: 它对我来说很珍贵，因为它曾是我父亲的。
messages.en: It is very precious to me because it belonged to my father.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“值得珍惜”串起含义：手稿贵重、时间宝贵、父亲的旧表有纪念意义，都可以用 prezzjuż 描述。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Exact, accurate and clearly specified, with little or no uncertainty or error.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 描述、数值或信息等精确、准确而明确的，几乎没有模糊或误差。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Eżatt u ċar fid-dettalji, b'ftit jew xejn żball jew inċertezza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精确的；细节明确、没有含糊之处的。
确切的；与实际数值、时间或要求完全相符的。
精确的、确切的、准确的；细节清楚且符合事实或标准的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport għandu jinkludi kejl preċiż sabiex ir-riżultati jkunu jistgħu jitqabblu b'mod affidabbli.
formal.en: The report should include precise measurements so that the results can be compared reliably.
formal.zh: 报告应包含精确的测量数据，以便可靠地比较结果。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Taf il-ħin preċiż tal-ferrovija? Mark: Iva, titlaq fit-tmienja u għaxra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you know the exact time of the train? Mark: Yes, it leaves at ten past eight.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你知道火车的确切时间吗？马克：知道，八点十分发车。

messages.speaker: Lara (旅客)
messages.zh: 你知道火车的确切时间吗？
messages.en: Do you know the exact time of the train?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 知道，八点十分发车。
messages.en: Yes, it leaves at ten past eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“八点左右”和“八点十分”作比较，后者给出確切时间，适合联想 preċiż；再搭配尺上的刻度记“精确的测量”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In an exact or accurate way; also used to emphasize an exact time, amount or meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以精确或准确的方式；也用于强调时间、数量或意思恰好如此。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod eżatt jew preċiż; tintuża wkoll biex tenfasizza ħin, ammont jew tifsira eżatta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精确地、准确地；强调时间、数量或意思时，可译为“恰好”“正是”。

formal.mt: L-esperiment beda preċiżament fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu, kif kien indikat fil-pjan.
formal.en: The experiment began at precisely nine in the morning, as indicated in the plan.
formal.zh: 实验按照计划所注明的时间，于上午九点整开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tgħid li niltaqgħu quddiem il-bieb il-kbir? Mark: Preċiżament, hemm niltaqgħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you mean we should meet in front of the main door? Mark: Precisely, that's where we'll meet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的意思是我们在大门前见面？马克：正是，我们就在那儿见。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tgħid li niltaqgħu quddiem il-bieb il-kbir?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tgħid li niltaqgħu quddiem il-bieb il-kbir?
messages.zh: 你的意思是我们在大门前见面？
messages.en: Do you mean we should meet in front of the main door?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 正是，我们就在那儿见。
messages.en: Precisely, that's where we'll meet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 preċiż 记成描述事物“精确的”，把 preċiżament 放进“精确地说明、恰好八点、正是如此”的句子，练习形容词与副词的不同用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being accurate, exact, and careful about details.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 信息、测量或操作准确无误、细节严谨的性质或程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità li tagħti informazzjoni jew tagħmel xi ħaġa b'eżattezza u b'attenzjoni għad-dettalji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 准确性；结果或描述与实际情况相符的程度。
精确性；测量、表达或操作细致而严密的程度。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport għandu jiddeskrivi r-riżultati bi preċiżjoni u jinkludi l-kejl kollu.
formal.en: The report should describe the results accurately and include all the measurements.
formal.zh: 报告应准确描述结果，并包含所有测量数据。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tkejjel il-mejda mill-ġdid? Mark: Irrid naqta' l-injam bi preċiżjoni biex joqgħod sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you measuring the table again? Mark: I want to cut the wood precisely so that it fits properly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么又量一遍桌子？马克：我想把木板切得精确些，这样才能装得合适。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么又量一遍桌子？
messages.en: Why are you measuring the table again?

messages.speaker: Mark (木工爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid naqta' l-injam bi preċiżjoni biex joqgħod sew.
messages.mt_standard: Irrid naqta' l-injam bi preċiżjoni biex joqgħod sew.
messages.zh: 我想把木板切得精确些，这样才能装得合适。
messages.en: I want to cut the wood precisely so that it fits properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用尺子反复核对刻度：preċiżjoni 强调量得准、做得细；把 bi preċiżjoni 整块记成“精确地”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A religious talk giving moral teaching, or a speech that scolds someone about their behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 传达宗教或道德教诲的讲道；也指针对某人行为进行的训话或责骂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diskors reliġjuż li jagħti tagħlim morali, jew ċanfira lil xi ħadd dwar l-imġiba tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 讲道；通常由神职人员发表的宗教或道德教诲。
训斥；因某人的行为而对其进行的责骂或训话。

collocations.en: to give someone a sermon or a scolding

formal.mt: Fil-prietka tal-Ħadd, il-qassis tkellem dwar il-ħtieġa li ngħinu lil min jinsab fil-bżonn.
formal.en: In Sunday's sermon, the priest spoke about the need to help those in need.
formal.zh: 在星期日的讲道中，神父谈到了帮助有需要之人的必要性。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Għaliex int daqshekk kwiet? Lara: Ommi għadha kif tatni prietka għax erġajt wasalt tard.
colloquial.en: Ben: Why are you so quiet? Lara: My mother has just given me a scolding because I got home late again.
colloquial.zh: 本：你为什么这么安静？拉拉：我又晚回家了，妈妈刚刚训了我一顿。

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么这么安静？
messages.en: Why are you so quiet?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ommi għadha kif tatni prietka għax erġajt wasalt tard.
messages.mt_standard: Ommi għadha kif tatni prietka għax erġajt wasalt tard.
messages.zh: 我又晚回家了，妈妈刚刚训了我一顿。
messages.en: My mother has just given me a scolding because I got home late again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个说话场景记忆：教堂里听 prietka 是听讲道；因迟到被家长说教，prietka 就是训话。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male member of a royal family, especially a king's or queen's son, or a man holding the title of prince.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 王室男性成员，尤指国王或女王的儿子；也指拥有亲王头衔的男性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Membru maskili ta' familja rjali, speċjalment iben re jew reġina, jew raġel li għandu t-titlu ta' prinċep.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 王子；亲王；王室中的男性成员或持有相应贵族头衔的男性。

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, il-prinċep iżur l-irħula biex jisma' l-problemi tan-nies qabel jirritorna fil-palazz.
formal.en: In the story, the prince visits the villages to hear people's problems before returning to the palace.
formal.zh: 故事中，王子先到各个村庄听取人们面临的问题，然后返回王宫。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min hu dak bil-kuruna fl-istampa? Rita: Dak il-prinċep; ħdejh hemm ir-re, missieru.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is the one wearing a crown in the picture? Rita: That is the prince; beside him is the king, his father.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：图片里那个戴王冠的人是谁？丽塔：那是王子；他旁边是国王，也就是他的父亲。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 图片里那个戴王冠的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the one wearing a crown in the picture?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-prinċep; ħdejh hemm ir-re, missieru.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-prinċep; ħdejh hemm ir-re, missieru.
messages.zh: 那是王子；他旁边是国王，也就是他的父亲。
messages.en: That is the prince; beside him is the king, his father.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用故事人物卡记忆：在年轻王室男子旁写 prinċep，再与 re“国王”配对，记住王子这一身份及亲王头衔义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person held in prison or otherwise kept captive and unable to leave freely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被关押在监狱中或受到其他形式拘禁、不能自由离开的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna miżmuma fil-ħabs jew fil-magħluq li ma tistax titlaq liberament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 囚犯；被关押或剥夺行动自由的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: one who has been sent to prison or jail
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被送入监狱或拘留所关押的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: one who has been otherwise imprisoned, e.g. a prisoner of war
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以其他方式受到囚禁的人，例如战俘。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-kundizzjonijiet li fihom inżamm il-priġunier u l-kura medika li ngħata.
formal.en: The report describes the conditions in which the prisoner was held and the medical care he received.
formal.zh: 报告描述了该囚犯的关押条件及其接受的医疗照护。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ir-raġel fl-istorja? Pawlu: Hu priġunier tal-gwerra li qed jistenna li jerġa' jara lill-familja tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that man in the story? Pawlu: He is a prisoner of war who is waiting to see his family again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事里的那个男人是谁？保罗：他是一名战俘，正盼着再次见到家人。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书伙伴)
messages.zh: 故事里的那个男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that man in the story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (读书伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu priġunier tal-gwerra li qed jistenna li jerġa' jara lill-familja tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Hu priġunier tal-gwerra li qed jistenna li jerġa' jara lill-familja tiegħu.
messages.zh: 他是一名战俘，正盼着再次见到家人。
messages.en: He is a prisoner of war who is waiting to see his family again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“人被关住，不能自由离开”作为核心画面；看到 priġunier tal-gwerra，再用“战争”提示记住“战俘”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A difficulty or situation that needs attention or a solution.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 需要关注、处理或寻找解决办法的困难或情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diffikultà jew sitwazzjoni li teħtieġ attenzjoni jew soluzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 问题；需要处理或解决的困难。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika problema serja fis-sistema u jipproponi soluzzjoni.
formal.en: The report identifies a serious problem in the system and proposes a solution.
formal.zh: 报告指出了系统中的一个严重问题，并提出了解决办法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi problema bil-kompjuter. Mark: X'ġara? Maja: Ma jixgħelx.
colloquial.en: Maja: I have a problem with the computer. Mark: What happened? Maja: It won't turn on.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我的电脑出了问题。马克：怎么了？玛雅：开不了机。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 我的电脑出了问题。
messages.en: I have a problem with the computer.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 怎么了？
messages.en: What happened?

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 开不了机。
messages.en: It won't turn on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 problema 和英语 problem 对照记忆，再想象电脑打不开的场景：需要解决的困难就是“问题”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing difficulties or being difficult to deal with.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 会造成困难，或本身不容易处理的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li joħloq diffikultajiet jew ikun diffiċli biex wieħed jittratta miegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有问题的；会引起困难或难以妥善处理的。

formal.mt: Dan l-aspett problematiku tal-ftehim jeħtieġ aktar diskussjoni qabel l-approvazzjoni.
formal.en: This problematic aspect of the agreement requires further discussion before approval.
formal.zh: 协议中这个存在问题的方面需要在批准前进一步讨论。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-parkeġġ hawn problematiku? Pawlu: Iva, speċjalment filgħodu. Lara: Mela niġi bil-karozza tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is parking problematic here? Pawlu: Yes, especially in the morning. Lara: Then I'll come by bus.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里停车很麻烦吗？保罗：是的，尤其是早上。拉拉：那我坐公交车来。

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.zh: 这里停车很麻烦吗？
messages.en: Is parking problematic here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (当地居民)
messages.zh: 是的，尤其是早上。
messages.en: Yes, especially in the morning.

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.zh: 那我坐公交车来。
messages.en: Then I'll come by bus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 problema“问题”和 problematiku“有问题的”成对记：前者说一件难事，后者描述某事很难处理。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something made or produced, or the output or yield of a process.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制造或生产出来的东西，也可指某个过程的产出或收成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa magħmula jew miksuba minn proċess ta' produzzjoni, jew dak li tagħti l-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产品；经过制造或加工而得到的物品。
产出；生产或其他过程所产生的成果。
产量；收成，尤指土地或作物产生的收获。

formal.mt: Kull prodott għandu jkollu tikketta li tindika l-ingredjenti u l-pajjiż tal-oriġini.
formal.en: Each product should have a label indicating the ingredients and the country of origin.
formal.zh: 每种产品都应有标签，标明成分和原产国。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-prodott hu magħmul Malta? Rita: Iva, huwa prodott lokali. Mark: Tajjeb, nieħu wieħed.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this product made in Malta? Rita: Yes, it's a local product. Mark: Good, I'll take one.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个产品是在马耳他制造的吗？丽塔：是的，这是本地产品。马克：好，我买一个。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个产品是在马耳他制造的吗？
messages.en: Is this product made in Malta?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 是的，这是本地产品。
messages.en: Yes, it's a local product.

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 好，我买一个。
messages.en: Good, I'll take one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“生产出来的结果”串起三个义项：商店里是产品，工厂里是产出，田地里是收成；都可联系 prodott。

gloss_zh: 富有成效的；生产效率高的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Producing a useful amount of work, goods, or results.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够完成较多工作、生产较多物品或取得有用成果的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jipproduċi ħafna xogħol, oġġetti jew riżultati utli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 富有成效的；生产效率高的；能取得较多有用成果的。

formal.mt: L-għan tat-taħriġ huwa li jagħmel ix-xogħol tat-tim aktar produttiv.
formal.en: The aim of the training is to make the team's work more productive.
formal.zh: 培训的目的是让团队的工作更有成效。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kellek jum produttiv? David: Iva, spiċċajt ir-rapport u weġibt l-emails kollha. Sara: Mela issa tista' tistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you have a productive day? David: Yes, I finished the report and answered all the emails. Sara: Then you can rest a little now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你今天工作有成效吗？戴维：有，我完成了报告，还回复了所有邮件。萨拉：那你现在可以休息一会儿了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天工作有成效吗？
messages.en: Did you have a productive day?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, spiċċajt ir-rapport u weġibt l-emails kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, spiċċajt ir-rapport u weġibt l-emails kollha.
messages.zh: 有，我完成了报告，还回复了所有邮件。
messages.en: Yes, I finished the report and answered all the emails.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那你现在可以休息一会儿了。
messages.en: Then you can rest a little now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 produttiv 与英语 productive 对照，再想象待办事项逐项完成：有实际成果的一天就是 jum produttiv。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money remaining after costs are paid, or an advantage gained from something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 收入扣除成本后剩下的钱，也可指从某事中得到的好处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Flus li jibqgħu wara li jitħallsu l-ispejjeż, jew ġid li wieħed jikseb minn xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 利润；收入扣除成本和费用后的余额。
好处；益处；从某种活动或情况中获得的有利结果。

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija rreġistrat profitt nett ogħla wara li naqqset l-ispejjeż operattivi.
formal.en: The company recorded a higher net profit after reducing operating costs.
formal.zh: 公司降低运营成本后，录得了更高的净利润。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għamilt profitt mill-bejgħ tal-kejkijiet? Toni: Iva, wara l-ispejjeż baqgħuli tletin ewro. Nina: Tajjeb ħafna għall-ewwel darba!
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you make a profit from selling the cakes? Toni: Yes, after expenses I had thirty euros left. Nina: That's very good for a first attempt!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：卖蛋糕赚到钱了吗？托尼：赚到了，扣除费用后还剩三十欧元。妮娜：第一次做就很不错了！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 卖蛋糕赚到钱了吗？
messages.en: Did you make a profit from selling the cakes?

messages.speaker: Toni (蛋糕制作者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, wara l-ispejjeż baqgħuli tletin ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, wara l-ispejjeż baqgħuli tletin ewro.
messages.zh: 赚到了，扣除费用后还剩三十欧元。
messages.en: Yes, after expenses I had thirty euros left.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 第一次做就很不错了！
messages.en: That's very good for a first attempt!

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用英语 profit 帮记 profitt，再记“付完成本才算利润”；若收获的是经验或知识，就理解为“益处”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extending far below a surface, or having great depth in thought, feeling, or effect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在空间上很深的，也可形容思想深刻、感情深切或影响深远。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħafna fond, jew li juri ħsieb serju, sentiment qawwi jew effett kbir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 深刻的；深切的；形容感受、意义或影响的程度很深。
深的；从表面或开口到底部的距离较大的。
思想深刻的；有深度的；包含深入思考或见解的。

formal.mt: L-istudju joffri ħsieb profond dwar ir-relazzjoni bejn il-lingwa u l-identità.
formal.en: The study offers profound reflection on the relationship between language and identity.
formal.zh: 这项研究对语言与身份认同之间的关系提出了深刻思考。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Dan il-film ħalla effett profond fuqi. Mark: Għaliex? Elena: Ġegħelni naħseb ħafna dwar il-familja tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Elena: This film had a profound effect on me. Mark: Why? Elena: It made me think a lot about my family.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这部电影对我的影响很深。马克：为什么？埃莱娜：它让我对自己的家庭想了很多。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-film ħalla effett profond fuqi.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-film ħalla effett profond fuqi.
messages.zh: 这部电影对我的影响很深。
messages.en: This film had a profound effect on me.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 为什么？
messages.en: Why?

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġegħelni naħseb ħafna dwar il-familja tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Ġegħelni naħseb ħafna dwar il-familja tiegħi.
messages.zh: 它让我对自己的家庭想了很多。
messages.en: It made me think a lot about my family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一口深井作画面：井有空间上的“深”，思想和影响也有抽象的“深”；这三种深都能帮助记住 profond。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Advancement to a higher position at work, or activity that promotes a product, service, or cause.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 工作职位的提升，也可指宣传产品、服务或某项事业的推广活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avvanz għal kariga ogħla fuq ix-xogħol, jew attività biex prodott, servizz jew kawża jsiru aktar magħrufa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 晋升；职位提升；也可指推广、宣传或促销活动。

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija nediet kampanja ta' promozzjoni biex tintroduċi l-prodott il-ġdid fis-suq.
formal.en: The company launched a promotional campaign to introduce the new product to the market.
formal.zh: 公司开展了推广活动，将新产品推向市场。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Smajt li ksibt promozzjoni. Prosit! David: Grazzi! Issa se mmexxi tim żgħir. Anna: Nispera li tmur tajjeb fir-rwol il-ġdid.
colloquial.en: Anna: I heard you got a promotion. Congratulations! David: Thanks! Now I'll be leading a small team. Anna: I hope things go well in your new role.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：听说你升职了，恭喜！戴维：谢谢！我接下来要带一个小团队。安娜：希望你在新岗位上一切顺利。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 听说你升职了，恭喜！
messages.en: I heard you got a promotion. Congratulations!

messages.speaker: David (获晋升的同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi! Issa se mmexxi tim żgħir.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi! Issa se mmexxi tim żgħir.
messages.zh: 谢谢！我接下来要带一个小团队。
messages.en: Thanks! Now I'll be leading a small team.

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Nispera li tmur tajjeb fir-rwol il-ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Nispera li tmur tajjeb fir-rwol il-ġdid.
messages.zh: 希望你在新岗位上一切顺利。
messages.en: I hope things go well in your new role.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 promozzjoni 与英语 promotion 对照，用两个场景记忆：员工职位向上是“晋升”，产品受到宣传是“推广”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The way a word or a language is spoken, especially how its sounds are produced.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 词语或语言的发音方式，尤其指语音如何发出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mod kif tingħad kelma jew lingwa, speċjalment kif jiġu prodotti l-ħsejjes tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发音；词语的读音。

formal.mt: L-istudenti jipprattikaw il-pronunzja billi jaqraw testi qosra b'leħen għoli.
formal.en: The students practise pronunciation by reading short texts aloud.
formal.zh: 学生通过朗读短文练习发音。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nista' ntejjeb il-pronunzja tiegħi? Pawlu: Isma' din il-kelma u erġa' għidha bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: How can I improve my pronunciation? Pawlu: Listen to this word and say it again slowly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我怎样才能改善发音？Pawlu：听听这个词，再慢慢说一遍。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 我怎样才能改善发音？
messages.en: How can I improve my pronunciation?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Isma' din il-kelma u erġa' għidha bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Isma' din il-kelma u erġa' għidha bil-mod.
messages.zh: 听听这个词，再慢慢说一遍。
messages.en: Listen to this word and say it again slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pronunzja 配上“听一遍、读一遍”的练习画面，记住它表示发音方式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something owned by a person or organisation, especially land or a building.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人或机构拥有的财产，尤其指土地或房屋。
