teaching_sense.en_definition: Holiness: the quality or state of being holy or sacred.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 圣洁或神圣性：人、事物或场所具有的神圣性质或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew l-istat ta' persuna, ħaġa jew post li hu qaddis jew sagru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣洁；神圣的性质或状态

formal.mt: L-awtur jenfasizza l-qodos tal-post u jitlob lill-viżitaturi jġibu ruħhom b'rispett.
formal.en: The author emphasizes the holiness of the place and asks visitors to behave respectfully.
formal.zh: 作者强调这个场所的神圣性，并要求访客举止恭敬。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'tfisser 'qodos' f'din is-sentenza? Toni: Tfisser kemm il-post hu qaddis; għalhekk il-kittieb jitlob ir-rispett.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'qodos' mean in this sentence? Toni: It means how holy the place is; that's why the writer asks for respect.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这句话里的 qodos 是什么意思？托尼：指这个地方的神圣性，所以作者要求大家保持恭敬。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 qodos 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'qodos' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser kemm il-post hu qaddis; għalhekk il-kittieb jitlob ir-rispett.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser kemm il-post hu qaddis; għalhekk il-kittieb jitlob ir-rispett.
messages.zh: 指这个地方的神圣性，所以作者要求大家保持恭敬。
messages.en: It means how holy the place is; that's why the writer asks for respect.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象进入神圣场所时放轻脚步，把那份“神圣的性质”与名词 qodos 联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A basket used for holding or carrying things, especially a hand basket or a wicker basket.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来盛放或携带物品的篮子，尤其指手提篮或柳编篮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kontenitur biex jitqiegħdu jew jinġarru fih l-affarijiet, speċjalment wieħed bil-manku jew magħmul mill-qasab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手提篮
柳编篮；枝条编成的篮子
篮子

formal.mt: Il-bidwi poġġa l-frott f'qoffa tal-qasab u ġarrha lejn is-suq.
formal.en: The farmer placed the fruit in a wicker basket and carried it to the market.
formal.zh: 农夫把水果放进编织篮，提着它前往市场。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn inpoġġi t-tuffieħ? Omm: Fil-qoffa ħdejn il-mejda, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where shall I put the apples? Mum: In the basket beside the table, please.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：苹果放在哪里？妈妈：请放到桌子旁边的篮子里。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 苹果放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall I put the apples?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 请放到桌子旁边的篮子里。
messages.en: In the basket beside the table, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一篮水果”的画面记 qoffa；把手、编织纹理和篮中水果一起想象，帮助记住具体物件。

gloss_zh: 门闩；锁；核心；要点；拱顶石；亮点

teaching_sense.en_definition: The central or most important point of something; also a latch, bolt, lock, or the keystone of an arch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事的核心、要点或最重要的部分；也可指门闩、锁，或拱的拱顶石。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-punt ewlieni jew l-aktar parti importanti ta' xi ħaġa; ukoll mekkaniżmu li jżomm bieb magħluq, jew il-ġebla ċentrali ta' ħnejja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 门闩；用于扣住或闩住门的装置
事情的核心；问题的关键所在
核心要点
拱顶石；位于拱顶中央的关键石块
锁；锁闭装置

sense_translations.en_definition: the central point, core, heart, highlight of anything
sense_translations.zh_definition: 任何事物的中心、核心、关键部分或亮点

collocations.en: the latch or lock of the door

formal.mt: Il-qofol tal-argument huwa li kull student għandu jkollu aċċess għall-istess riżorsi.
formal.en: The core of the argument is that every student should have access to the same resources.
formal.zh: 这一论证的核心是，每名学生都应能获得同等的资源。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tkellimna ħafna, imma x'inhu l-qofol? Mark: Li rridu niddeċiedu llum, għax għada jkun tard wisq.
colloquial.en: Maja: We've talked a lot, but what's the main point? Mark: That we need to decide today, because tomorrow will be too late.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们说了这么多，可关键是什么？马克：关键是今天就得决定，因为明天就太晚了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 我们说了这么多，可关键是什么？
messages.en: We've talked a lot, but what's the main point?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Li rridu niddeċiedu llum, għax għada jkun tard wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Li rridu niddeċiedu llum, għax għada jkun tard wisq.
messages.zh: 关键是今天就得决定，因为明天就太晚了。
messages.en: That we need to decide today, because tomorrow will be too late.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做三张情境卡来记 qofol：门上的闩锁、拱顶中央的石块、讨论中的核心；这是记忆分组，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 陶罐；罐式蜂箱；大量（尤指雨水）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A jar or jug, usually made of earthenware, used to hold liquids or other contents.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 盛放液体或其他物品的罐或壶，通常由陶土制成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent, ġeneralment tal-fuħħar, li jintuża biex jinżammu fih likwidi jew affarijiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种罐子。

sense_translations.en_definition: a jar or jug, usually earthen
sense_translations.zh_definition: 罐或壶，通常指陶制容器。

sense_translations.en_definition: such a jar used as a beehive, or, by extension, any beehive
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用这种罐子做成的蜂箱；引申为任何蜂箱。

sense_translations.en_definition: a large quantity, chiefly of rain
sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量，主要用于形容雨水很多。

formal.mt: Il-qolla tal-fuħħar tqiegħdet fuq l-ixkaffa ħdejn it-tieqa.
formal.en: The earthenware jar was placed on the shelf beside the window.
formal.zh: 陶罐被放在窗旁的架子上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn inpoġġi din il-qolla? Rita: Poġġiha fuq il-mejda; fiha l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where should I put this jar? Rita: Put it on the table; it has water in it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个罐子放在哪里？丽塔：放在桌上吧，里面装着水。

messages.speaker: Maja (女儿)
messages.zh: 这个罐子放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this jar?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 放在桌上吧，里面装着水。
messages.en: Put it on the table; it has water in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qolla 联想成架子上的陶罐，先记容器义，再把罐式蜂箱和大量雨水作为另外两个义项分别记忆。

gloss_zh: 科尔米的；来自科尔米的；科尔米人

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coming from Qormi or connected with that place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自科尔米或与科尔米这个地方有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej minn Ħal Qormi jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' dan il-post.

sense_translations.en_definition: related to or hailing from the village of Qormi
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与科尔米村有关的，或来自该村的。
来自科尔米的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: of, from or relating to Qormi
sense_translations.zh_definition: 科尔米的、来自科尔米的或与科尔米有关的。
科尔米本地人或居民。

collocations.zh: 一名来自科尔米的男子
一名来自科尔米的面包师

formal.mt: Il-furnar Qormi ppreżenta l-ħobż tiegħu fil-wirja lokali.
formal.en: The baker from Qormi presented his bread at the local exhibition.
formal.zh: 这位来自科尔米的面包师在当地展览会上展示了他的面包。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int Qormi? Mark: Iva, noqgħod Ħal Qormi mal-familja tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you from Qormi? Mark: Yes, I live in Qormi with my family.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你是科尔米人吗？马克：是的，我和家人住在科尔米。

messages.speaker: Maja (新同学)
messages.zh: 你是科尔米人吗？
messages.en: Are you from Qormi?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, noqgħod Ħal Qormi mal-familja tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, noqgħod Ħal Qormi mal-familja tiegħi.
messages.zh: 是的，我和家人住在科尔米。
messages.en: Yes, I live in Qormi with my family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张写着 Qormi 的家乡名牌：修饰人物时记作“来自科尔米的”，作名词时记作“科尔米人”。

gloss_zh: 靠近；接近；接近的动作；邻近

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move nearer to a person, place or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某个人、地点或事物移动，使距离缩短。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiċċaqlaq lejn persuna, post jew ħaġa sabiex id-distanza tonqos.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 靠近；来到更近的位置。
接近；向某人或某物靠拢。
靠近或接近的动作。
接近；距离很近的状态。
走近；来到附近。

formal.mt: Il-viżitatur qorob lejn l-iskrivanija u talab l-informazzjoni.
formal.en: The visitor approached the desk and asked for information.
formal.zh: 来访者走近办公桌，询问信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qorob it-tifel lejn it-tieqa? Mark: Biex jara l-qattus fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the boy go closer to the window? Mark: To see the cat in the garden.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个男孩为什么走近窗户？马克：为了看看花园里的猫。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个男孩为什么走近窗户？
messages.en: Why did the boy go closer to the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 为了看看花园里的猫。
messages.en: To see the cat in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个人之间逐渐缩短的距离记 qorob；例句中的动作是“他靠近了”，名词义则分别记接近动作和邻近状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An open type of footwear held on the foot by straps.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鞋面较开放、用带子固定在脚上的一种鞋，即凉鞋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żarbun miftuħ li jinżamm mas-sieq permezz ta' ċineg.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凉鞋。
凉鞋，一种鞋面开放的鞋类。

formal.mt: Il-qorq tal-ġilda għandu ċineg li jżommuh sew mas-sieq.
formal.en: The leather sandal has straps that hold it securely on the foot.
formal.zh: 这只皮凉鞋带有鞋带，能把鞋稳稳地固定在脚上。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek qorq tal-ġilda? Rita: Iva, ipprova dan u ara jekk joqgħodlokx.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have a leather sandal? Rita: Yes, try this one and see whether it fits.
colloquial.zh: 马克：有皮凉鞋吗？丽塔：有，试试这一只，看看合不合脚。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 有皮凉鞋吗？
messages.en: Do you have a leather sandal?

messages.speaker: Rita (售货员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ipprova dan u ara jekk joqgħodlokx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ipprova dan u ara jekk joqgħodlokx.
messages.zh: 有，试试这一只，看看合不合脚。
messages.en: Yes, try this one and see whether it fits.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 qorq 就想象脚上露出脚趾、靠带子固定的凉鞋，再用“皮凉鞋”和“舒适的凉鞋”两个搭配巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bony structure of the head that protects the brain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 构成头部并保护脑部的骨性结构，即头骨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istruttura tal-għadam tar-ras li tipproteġi l-moħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 头骨；颅骨。
秃头；头部缺少或失去头发的状态。

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi l-qorriegħa u l-moħħ li tipproteġi.
formal.en: The diagram shows the skull and the brain it protects.
formal.zh: 图中展示了头骨及其所保护的脑部。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi l-qorriegħa f'dan il-mudell? Mark: Hawn fuq; din il-parti tipproteġi l-moħħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the skull in this model? Mark: Up here; this part protects the brain.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个模型的头骨在哪里？马克：在这上面，这个部分保护脑部。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个模型的头骨在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the skull in this model?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn fuq; din il-parti tipproteġi l-moħħ.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn fuq; din il-parti tipproteġi l-moħħ.
messages.zh: 在这上面，这个部分保护脑部。
messages.en: Up here; this part protects the brain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qorriegħa 配两张学习图卡：一张画保护脑部的头骨，一张画光秃的头，分别记住头骨义与秃头义。

gloss_zh: 法院；法院大楼；王室宫廷

teaching_sense.en_definition: A court where legal cases are heard and decided.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 审理案件并作出裁决的司法机构或场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Istituzzjoni jew post fejn jinstemgħu l-kawżi u jingħataw deċiżjonijiet legali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法院；法庭。
法院大楼；进行司法审理的建筑。
法院；依法审理案件的司法机构。
国王等君主的宫廷。

formal.mt: Il-qorti semgħet ix-xhieda qabel ma tat id-deċiżjoni tagħha.
formal.en: The court heard the evidence before giving its decision.
formal.zh: 法院在作出裁决前听取了证词。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi l-qorti? Mark: Qiegħda ħdejn il-pjazza; nimxi miegħek sa hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the courthouse? Mark: It is beside the square; I will walk there with you.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：法院大楼在哪里？马克：就在广场旁边，我陪你走过去。

messages.speaker: Maja (问路者)
messages.zh: 法院大楼在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the courthouse?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħda ħdejn il-pjazza; nimxi miegħek sa hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħda ħdejn il-pjazza; nimxi miegħek sa hemm.
messages.zh: 就在广场旁边，我陪你走过去。
messages.en: It is beside the square; I will walk there with you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qorti 放进两个场景记忆：法官审案时是法院，国王与侍从出现时是宫廷；具体指建筑时译作法院大楼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being brief or short in length or duration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 篇幅、长度或持续时间较短的性质；简短或短暂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa li tkun qasira fit-tul, fil-kliem jew fiż-żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 简短；言语或文字篇幅短的性质。
短小或短暂；长度或持续时间较短的性质。

formal.mt: Minkejja l-qosor tiegħu, ir-rapport jispjega l-punti ewlenin b'mod ċar.
formal.en: Despite its brevity, the report explains the main points clearly.
formal.zh: 报告虽然篇幅简短，却清楚地说明了主要要点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tgħidli fil-qosor x'ġara? Mark: Iva, tlifna l-karozza tal-linja u ġejna bil-mixi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you tell me briefly what happened? Mark: Yes, we missed the bus and came on foot.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能简要说说发生了什么吗？马克：可以，我们没赶上公交车，就走过来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你能简要说说发生了什么吗？
messages.en: Can you tell me briefly what happened?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tlifna l-karozza tal-linja u ġejna bil-mixi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tlifna l-karozza tal-linja u ġejna bil-mixi.
messages.zh: 可以，我们没赶上公交车，就走过来了。
messages.en: Yes, we missed the bus and came on foot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一大段文字缩成一句话，用这个画面记 qosor 的“简短”；再把 fil-qosor 整体记成“简要地”。

gloss_zh: 棉花状的；与棉花有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Resembling cotton in appearance or texture, or connected with cotton.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外观或质地像棉花的，或与棉花有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jixbah lill-qoton fid-dehra jew fil-mess, jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-qoton.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 像棉花的；具有棉花般外观或质地的。
与棉花有关的。

formal.mt: Il-kampjun għandu saff qotni abjad fuq il-wiċċ.
formal.en: The sample has a white, cotton-like layer on its surface.
formal.zh: 样品表面有一层白色的棉花状物质。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan is-saff jidher qotni, hux? Mark: Iva, jidher artab bħal qoton.
colloquial.en: Maja: This layer looks cotton-like, doesn't it? Mark: Yes, it looks soft like cotton.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这一层看起来像棉花，对吧？马克：对，看起来像棉花一样柔软。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这一层看起来像棉花，对吧？
messages.en: This layer looks cotton-like, doesn't it?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 对，看起来像棉花一样柔软。
messages.en: Yes, it looks soft like cotton.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象材料表面蓬松的白色棉花状层，用它记 qotni 的形容词义；像棉花并不保证实际成分就是棉花。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A soft natural fibre used to make cloth and other absorbent materials.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种柔软的天然纤维，常用于制作布料和吸水用品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fibra naturali ratba li tintuża biex isiru drappijiet u materjali li jassorbu l-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 棉花；棉纤维

formal.mt: It-tikketta tindika li din il-qmis hija magħmula mill-qoton.
formal.en: The label indicates that this shirt is made of cotton.
formal.zh: 标签注明这件衬衫由棉制成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-qmis tal-qoton? Rita: Iva, missha; kemm hi ratba!
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this shirt made of cotton? Rita: Yes, feel it; it's so soft!
colloquial.zh: Maja：这件衬衫是棉的吗？Rita：是啊，你摸摸，多柔软！

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这件衬衫是棉的吗？
messages.en: Is this shirt made of cotton?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 是啊，你摸摸，多柔软！
messages.en: Yes, feel it; it's so soft!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qoton 和柔软棉衬衫的触感绑定记忆；看到 tal-qoton，就想到“棉制的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An outer layer or covering, such as the crust of bread, the skin of fruit, or the cover of a book.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体的外层或覆盖部分，例如面包的外皮、水果的皮或书的封面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-saff ta' barra jew il-kisja ta' xi ħaġa, bħall-ħobż, il-frott jew ktieb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面包等食物的硬外皮
壳；硬壳
皮，例如水果的表皮
植物种子或果实的外壳；颖壳
航海船只

sense_translations.en_definition: outer cover of a periodical or book
sense_translations.zh_definition: 期刊或书籍的封面
坚硬或干燥的外层
树皮
较厚的果皮；外壳
船；艇
书的封面；书皮
硬币；零钱

formal.mt: Fuq il-qoxra tal-ktieb hemm it-titlu u isem l-awtur.
formal.en: The title and the author's name appear on the cover of the book.
formal.zh: 书的封面上印有书名和作者姓名。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Trid il-ħobż bil-qoxra? Lara: Iva, inħobb il-qoxra meta tkun tqarmeċ.
colloquial.en: Mark: Would you like the bread with the crust? Lara: Yes, I like the crust when it's crunchy.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你要带外皮的面包吗？Lara：要，我喜欢脆脆的面包皮。

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.zh: 你要带外皮的面包吗？
messages.en: Would you like the bread with the crust?

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, inħobb il-qoxra meta tkun tqarmeċ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, inħobb il-qoxra meta tkun tqarmeċ.
messages.zh: 要，我喜欢脆脆的面包皮。
messages.en: Yes, I like the crust when it's crunchy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“包在外面的一层”串起面包皮、果皮、树皮和书封面；船只、硬币义另做词卡记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To prostitute oneself, to engage in sexual intercourse described as fornication, or to prostitute another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指自己卖淫、发生被称为私通或淫乱的性行为，或使他人卖淫；具体含义取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jipprattika l-prostituzzjoni, ikollu x'jaqsam sesswalment barra ż-żwieġ, jew idaħħal persuna oħra fil-prostituzzjoni, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卖淫；以自己的性服务换取报酬
私通；发生被称为淫乱或婚外性行为的关系
使人卖淫；让某人从事卖淫

collocations.en: he committed fornication with another person

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tat-test, it-tifsira tal-verb 'qoħob' għandha tiġi ċċarata: il-kuntest juri jekk jirreferix għall-prostituzzjoni jew għal relazzjoni sesswali barra ż-żwieġ.
formal.en: In the analysis of the text, the meaning of the verb 'qoħob' should be clarified: the context shows whether it refers to prostitution or to a sexual relationship outside marriage.
formal.zh: 分析文本时，应明确动词 qoħob 的含义：上下文会表明它指卖淫，还是婚姻之外的性关系。

colloquial.mt: Lara: 'Qoħob' dejjem tfisser li xi ħadd għamel dan għall-flus? Toni: Le, tista' tirreferi wkoll għal relazzjoni sesswali barra ż-żwieġ; trid tara l-kuntest.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does 'qoħob' always mean that someone did it for money? Toni: No, it can also refer to a sexual relationship outside marriage; you need to look at the context.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：qoħob 总是指有人为了钱而这样做吗？托尼：不，也可以指婚姻之外的性关系，要看上下文。

messages.speaker: Lara (成年学生)
messages.mt_spoken: 'Qoħob' dejjem tfisser li xi ħadd għamel dan għall-flus?
messages.mt_standard: 'Qoħob' dejjem tfisser li xi ħadd għamel dan għall-flus?
messages.zh: qoħob 总是指有人为了钱而这样做吗？
messages.en: Does 'qoħob' always mean that someone did it for money?

messages.speaker: Toni (语言教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tista' tirreferi wkoll għal relazzjoni sesswali barra ż-żwieġ; trid tara l-kuntest.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tista' tirreferi wkoll għal relazzjoni sesswali barra ż-żwieġ; trid tara l-kuntest.
messages.zh: 不，也可以指婚姻之外的性关系，要看上下文。
messages.en: No, it can also refer to a sexual relationship outside marriage; you need to look at the context.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“自己卖淫、发生私通、使人卖淫”三张语境卡记 qoħob，每次先判断行为和对象，再选择中文义项。

gloss_zh: 赤贫；贫困；严重匮乏；短缺

teaching_sense.en_definition: Destitution or serious poverty; also a severe lack or scarcity of necessities or other resources.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 赤贫或严重贫困；也指生活必需品或其他资源的严重匮乏、短缺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Faqar kbir jew nuqqas serju ta' affarijiet meħtieġa għall-ħajja jew ta' riżorsi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赤贫；连基本生活所需也难以获得的状态
贫困；缺少基本生活资源的处境
严重匮乏；极度缺少必需品
短缺；供应不足

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-qoħta li kienet tgħix fiha l-familja, mingħajr biżżejjed ikel jew ħwejjeġ.
formal.en: The report describes the destitution in which the family was living, without enough food or clothing.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这家人当时的赤贫处境：食物和衣服都不够。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed niġbru l-ikel għal din il-familja? Omm: Għax qed jgħixu fil-qoħta u m'għandhomx biżżejjed biex jieklu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are we collecting food for this family? Mum: Because they're living in destitution and don't have enough to eat.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们为什么给这家人募集食物？妈妈：因为他们生活非常贫困，连吃的都不够。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed niġbru l-ikel għal din il-familja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed niġbru l-ikel għal din il-familja?
messages.zh: 我们为什么给这家人募集食物？
messages.en: Why are we collecting food for this family?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax qed jgħixu fil-qoħta u m'għandhomx biżżejjed biex jieklu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax qed jgħixu fil-qoħta u m'għandhomx biżżejjed biex jieklu.
messages.zh: 因为他们生活非常贫困，连吃的都不够。
messages.en: Because they're living in destitution and don't have enough to eat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qoħta 放在空米缸和空储物架的画面中，记住它是“贫困或匮乏的状态”这个名词。

gloss_zh: 贫困的；生活贫穷的；吝啬的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Indigent or living in poverty; in another sense, miserly or unwilling to spend or give money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人贫困、生活贫穷；另一个义项表示吝啬，不愿花钱或给钱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu fqir jew jgħix fil-faqar; f'tifsira oħra, li ma jridx jonfoq flus jew jagħtihom lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贫困的；缺少基本生活所需的
生活在贫困之中的
吝啬的；过分不愿花钱或给钱的

collocations.en: too miserly to make a donation

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, ir-raġel qoħti ma kellux biżżejjed flus għall-ikel; hawnhekk l-aġġettiv jiddeskrivi l-faqar tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the indigent man did not have enough money for food; here the adjective describes his poverty.
formal.zh: 故事中，这个贫困的男人没有足够的钱买食物；这里的形容词描述的是他的贫穷处境。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta tgħid li hu qoħti, tfisser li m'għandux flus? Mark: Hawnhekk le. Għandu ħafna flus, imma ma jrid jonfoq xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: When you say he's 'qoħti', do you mean he has no money? Mark: Not here. He has plenty of money, but he doesn't want to spend any.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你说他 qoħti，是说他没钱吗？马克：这里不是。他有很多钱，但一点也不想花。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid li hu qoħti, tfisser li m'għandux flus?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid li hu qoħti, tfisser li m'għandux flus?
messages.zh: 你说他 qoħti，是说他没钱吗？
messages.en: When you say he's 'qoħti', do you mean he has no money?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk le. Għandu ħafna flus, imma ma jrid jonfoq xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk le. Għandu ħafna flus, imma ma jrid jonfoq xejn.
messages.zh: 这里不是。他有很多钱，但一点也不想花。
messages.en: Not here. He has plenty of money, but he doesn't want to spend any.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qoħti 画两个钱包：一个空钱包表示贫困，一个装满却紧闭的钱包表示吝啬；靠语境区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The nearby area or a place at a short physical distance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 附近的区域，或与某处实际距离较近的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-postijiet ta' madwar jew post li jinsab f'distanza qasira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 附近；邻近区域
实际距离较近的地方
近的；邻近的
在……附近；靠近……

formal.mt: Fil-qrib hemm librerija pubblika u waqfa tal-karozzi tal-linja.
formal.en: There is a public library and a bus stop in the vicinity.
formal.zh: 附近有一座公共图书馆和一个公交车站。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Hemm kafetterija fil-qrib? Pawlu: Iva, hemm waħda qrib il-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is there a café nearby? Pawlu: Yes, there's one near the square.
colloquial.zh: Nina：附近有咖啡馆吗？Pawlu：有，广场附近有一家。

messages.speaker: Nina (游客)
messages.zh: 附近有咖啡馆吗？
messages.en: Is there a café nearby?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (当地居民)
messages.zh: 有，广场附近有一家。
messages.en: Yes, there's one near the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上两个相邻的点：fil-qrib 表示“在附近”，qrib 后接地点可表示“靠近某处”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To gradually lose the hair on one's head and become bald.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 头发逐渐脱落，直至出现秃顶或变秃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef xagħar rasu ftit ftit u jsir qargħi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐秃顶；头发逐渐脱落而变秃
变秃；成为秃头

formal.mt: Fil-bijografija tiegħu, l-awtur isemmi li qriegħ ftit ftit matul is-snin.
formal.en: In his biography, the author mentions that he gradually went bald over the years.
formal.zh: 作者在传记中提到，自己的头发在这些年间逐渐脱落，最终秃顶了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: F'dan ir-ritratt missierek għandu ħafna xagħar! Mark: Iva, wara qriegħ ftit ftit.
colloquial.en: Lara: Your father has so much hair in this photo! Mark: Yes, he gradually went bald later.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这张照片里，你爸爸的头发好多啊！Mark：是啊，后来他就逐渐秃顶了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan ir-ritratt missierek għandu ħafna xagħar!
messages.mt_standard: F'dan ir-ritratt missierek għandu ħafna xagħar!
messages.zh: 这张照片里，你爸爸的头发好多啊！
messages.en: Your father has so much hair in this photo!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，后来他就逐渐秃顶了。
messages.en: Yes, he gradually went bald later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用连续几张头发越来越少的照片记住 qriegħ；搭配 ftit ftit，把“逐渐变秃”的过程记清楚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of pinching, or a sharp sensation like small pricks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 掐、夹捏的动作，或类似细针刺扎的尖锐感觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li toqros lil xi ħadd, jew sensazzjoni bħal tingiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 掐；夹捏；被掐的感觉
刺扎；针刺般的感觉

collocations.en: pinching or pricking in the arm

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel jiddeskrivi l-qris li ħass f'dirgħajh.
formal.en: In the story, the boy describes the pinching he felt in his arms.
formal.zh: 故事中，男孩描述了双臂被掐时的感觉。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tweġġagħni bil-qris! Mark: Skużani, se nieqaf.
colloquial.en: Lara: You're hurting me with all that pinching! Mark: Sorry, I'll stop.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你这样掐，弄疼我了！Mark：对不起，我不掐了。

messages.speaker: Lara (妹妹)
messages.zh: 你这样掐，弄疼我了！
messages.en: You're hurting me with all that pinching!

messages.speaker: Mark (哥哥)
messages.zh: 对不起，我不掐了。
messages.en: Sorry, I'll stop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“被手指掐一下”和“被细针刺一下”两个画面记忆 qris，分别对应夹捏与刺扎感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coral: small marine animals and the hard skeletal material they produce.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 珊瑚，指一类小型海洋动物及其形成的坚硬骨骼物质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimali żgħar tal-baħar u l-materjal iebes tal-iskeletri tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 珊瑚

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw ritratti tal-qroll waqt il-lezzjoni dwar il-ħajja fil-baħar.
formal.en: The students examined photographs of coral during the lesson on marine life.
formal.zh: 学生们在海洋生物课上观察了珊瑚的照片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak l-aħmar fir-ritratt? Pawlu: Dak qroll; ħadt ir-ritratt waqt li kont qed nogħdos.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that red thing in the photo? Pawlu: That's coral; I took the photo while diving.
colloquial.zh: Maja：照片里那个红色的东西是什么？Pawlu：那是珊瑚，我潜水时拍的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 照片里那个红色的东西是什么？
messages.en: What's that red thing in the photo?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (潜水爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak qroll; ħadt ir-ritratt waqt li kont qed nogħdos.
messages.mt_standard: Dak qroll; ħadt ir-ritratt waqt li kont qed nogħdos.
messages.zh: 那是珊瑚，我潜水时拍的。
messages.en: That's coral; I took the photo while diving.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qroll 配一张海底珊瑚图，再用 qroll aħmar“红珊瑚”把词语和颜色一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A carnation flower, or cloves used as a spice; the intended meaning depends on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指康乃馨花，也可指作为香料使用的丁香，具体含义取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fjura tal-qronfol, jew ħwawar magħmula mill-blanzuni mnixxfa tas-siġra tal-qronfol, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 康乃馨；香石竹
丁香；作为香料使用的丁香树干燥花蕾（Syzygium aromaticum）
康乃馨；香石竹（Dianthus caryophyllus）

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob niskata qronfol mitħun biex tagħti togħma lill-kejk.
formal.en: The recipe calls for a pinch of ground cloves to flavour the cake.
formal.zh: 食谱要求加入一小撮丁香粉，为蛋糕增添风味。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nixtieq bukkett qronfol għal ommi. Rita: Liema kulur tippreferi, aħmar jew abjad?
colloquial.en: Nina: I'd like a bouquet of carnations for my mother. Rita: Which colour would you prefer, red or white?
colloquial.zh: Nina：我想买一束康乃馨送给妈妈。Rita：你喜欢哪种颜色，红色还是白色？

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 我想买一束康乃馨送给妈妈。
messages.en: I'd like a bouquet of carnations for my mother.

messages.speaker: Rita (花店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema kulur tippreferi, aħmar jew abjad?
messages.mt_standard: Liema kulur tippreferi, aħmar jew abjad?
messages.zh: 你喜欢哪种颜色，红色还是白色？
messages.en: Which colour would you prefer, red or white?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景分开记：花店的 qronfol 是康乃馨，厨房里磨成粉的 qronfol 是丁香香料。

gloss_zh: 母鸡；下蛋或抱窝的母鸡

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hen, especially one that lays eggs or sits on eggs to hatch them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 母鸡，尤其指下蛋或坐在蛋上孵化的母鸡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiġieġa, speċjalment waħda li tbid jew toqgħod fuq il-bajd biex tfaqqsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 母鸡
下蛋的母鸡；抱窝孵蛋的母鸡

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw il-qroqqa fil-bejta waqt li kienet fuq il-bajd.
formal.en: The students observed the hen in the nest while she was sitting on the eggs.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了窝里正在孵蛋的母鸡。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hi l-qroqqa? Pawlu: Fil-bejta, fuq il-bajd. Ejja narawha bil-kwiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where's the hen? Pawlu: In the nest, sitting on the eggs. Let's go and look at her quietly.
colloquial.zh: Lara：母鸡在哪里？Pawlu：在窝里孵蛋呢。我们轻轻地过去看看。

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 母鸡在哪里？
messages.en: Where's the hen?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (祖父)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-bejta, fuq il-bajd. Ejja narawha bil-kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-bejta, fuq il-bajd. Ejja narawha bil-kwiet.
messages.zh: 在窝里孵蛋呢。我们轻轻地过去看看。
messages.en: In the nest, sitting on the eggs. Let's go and look at her quietly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qroqqa 画成窝里护着鸡蛋的母鸡；连读 qroqqa fuq il-bajd，记住“母鸡在蛋上孵化”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family connection or relationship linking people or families.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人与人或家庭之间的亲属联系或亲缘关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rabta ta' familja bejn persuni jew bejn familji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 亲属关系；亲缘关系。
相互关联或具有亲缘联系的关系。
关系；亲属关系；亲子血缘关系；姻亲或亲近关系。

collocations.zh: 两个家庭之间的亲缘关系

formal.mt: Id-dokument jispjega r-rabta ta' qrubija bejn iż-żewġ familji.
formal.en: The document explains the kinship tie between the two families.
formal.zh: 这份文件说明了两个家庭之间的亲缘关系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qrubija hemm bejnek u Pawlu? Lara: Pawlu huwa kuġin tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: How are you and Pawlu related? Lara: Pawlu is my cousin.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你和保罗是什么亲戚？拉拉：保罗是我的表亲。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你和保罗是什么亲戚？
messages.en: How are you and Pawlu related?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗是我的表亲。
messages.en: Pawlu is my cousin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qrubija 写在家谱连线上，看到人物之间的连线，就回想“亲属关系”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being sour, acidic, or sharply irritating to the senses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 酸的味道、酸性，或使感官受到强烈刺激的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa li tkun qarsa, aċiduża jew li tirrita s-sensi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 酸味；味觉上的酸。
刺鼻、呛人或辛辣刺激的性质。
酸性；酸度。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta tuża ftit zokkor biex tibbilanċja l-qrusa tal-lumi.
formal.en: The recipe uses a little sugar to balance the sourness of the lemons.
formal.zh: 这份食谱用少量糖来平衡柠檬的酸味。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din ix-xarba għandha qrusa qawwija. Rita: Żid ftit ilma jekk hi qarsa wisq għalik.
colloquial.en: Mark: This drink has a strong sour taste. Rita: Add a little water if it is too sour for you.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这饮料的酸味很重。丽塔：如果你觉得太酸，就加一点水。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这饮料的酸味很重。
messages.en: This drink has a strong sour taste.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żid ftit ilma jekk hi qarsa wisq għalik.
messages.mt_standard: Żid ftit ilma jekk hi qarsa wisq għalik.
messages.zh: 如果你觉得太酸，就加一点水。
messages.en: Add a little water if it is too sour for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象咬下柠檬后皱起脸，把这种“酸味”的感觉贴上 qrusa 标签；遇到气味语境再联想“刺鼻”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become shorter in length or duration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在长度或持续时间上变短。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir iqsar fit-tul jew fil-ħin li jdum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得更短；长度或持续时间缩短。
变短；变得短。

formal.mt: Wara l-ħasil, id-drapp qsar u ma baqax adattat għall-proġett.
formal.en: After washing, the fabric became shorter and was no longer suitable for the project.
formal.zh: 洗涤后，布料变短了，不再适合用于该项目。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex id-drapp m'għadux twil daqs qabel? Maja: Qsar wara l-ħasil; issa rridu nkejluh mill-ġdid.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the fabric no longer as long as before? Maja: It became shorter after washing; now we need to measure it again.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这块布怎么没有原来那么长了？玛雅：洗后变短了，现在我们得重新量一下。

messages.speaker: Lara (缝纫学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex id-drapp m'għadux twil daqs qabel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex id-drapp m'għadux twil daqs qabel?
messages.zh: 这块布怎么没有原来那么长了？
messages.en: Why is the fabric no longer as long as before?

messages.speaker: Maja (缝纫教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Qsar wara l-ħasil; issa rridu nkejluh mill-ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Qsar wara l-ħasil; issa rridu nkejluh mill-ġdid.
messages.zh: 洗后变短了，现在我们得重新量一下。
messages.en: It became shorter after washing; now we need to measure it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一块布洗前长、洗后短的对比图，在变化箭头上写 qsar，记住这是“变短”的动作。

gloss_zh: 司铎的；与司铎职务有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to priests or the priesthood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与司铎、神父或其宗教职务有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-qassisin jew mal-qsusija.

sense_translations.en_definition: having to do with the priesthood
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与司铎职务或司铎身份有关的。
司铎的；神父的；具有司铎特征的。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu tal-mużew jinkludi deskrizzjoni tal-ilbies qsusi muri fis-sala.
formal.en: The museum catalogue includes a description of the priestly attire displayed in the hall.
formal.zh: 博物馆目录收录了展厅中所展示司铎服饰的说明。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan l-ilbies qsusi kien jintuża fiċ-ċerimonji? Anna: Iva, u ħdejn il-vetrina hemm spjegazzjoni dwaru.
colloquial.en: Mark: Was this priestly attire used in ceremonies? Anna: Yes, and there is an explanation about it beside the display case.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这套司铎服饰以前是仪式上穿的吗？安娜：是的，展柜旁边有相关说明。

messages.speaker: Mark (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-ilbies qsusi kien jintuża fiċ-ċerimonji?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-ilbies qsusi kien jintuża fiċ-ċerimonji?
messages.zh: 这套司铎服饰以前是仪式上穿的吗？
messages.en: Was this priestly attire used in ceremonies?

messages.speaker: Anna (博物馆讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u ħdejn il-vetrina hemm spjegazzjoni dwaru.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u ħdejn il-vetrina hemm spjegazzjoni dwaru.
messages.zh: 是的，展柜旁边有相关说明。
messages.en: Yes, and there is an explanation about it beside the display case.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qsusi 当作贴在服饰或职责旁的形容标签，表示“司铎的”；用 ilbies qsusi 整组记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The religious office or status of being a priest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 担任司铎的宗教职务或具有司铎身份的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat jew il-kariga reliġjuża ta' min ikun qassis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 司铎职务或身份；司铎群体。

collocations.zh: 担任司铎的准备与培育

formal.mt: Il-programm ta' tħejjija għall-qsusija jinkludi studju u servizz fil-komunità.
formal.en: The programme of preparation for the priesthood includes study and service in the community.
formal.zh: 司铎培育课程包括学习和社区服务。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħuk għadu qed jitħejja għall-qsusija? Pawlu: Iva, qed jistudja u jagħmel servizz fil-parroċċa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is your brother still preparing for the priesthood? Pawlu: Yes, he is studying and serving in the parish.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你兄弟还在接受司铎培育吗？保罗：是的，他正在学习，也在堂区服务。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟还在接受司铎培育吗？
messages.en: Is your brother still preparing for the priesthood?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed jistudja u jagħmel servizz fil-parroċċa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed jistudja u jagħmel servizz fil-parroċċa.
messages.zh: 是的，他正在学习，也在堂区服务。
messages.en: Yes, he is studying and serving in the parish.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“准备成为神父”的场景记 qsusija：它是名词，指司铎职务或身份；搭配“司铎培育”反复联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of causing the death of a person or animal, including murder in relevant contexts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 导致人或动物死亡的行为；在相应语境中指谋杀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li bih persuna jew annimal jinqatel; f'ċerti kuntesti jfisser omiċidju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谋杀；故意杀人。
杀害；致死行为。

sense_translations.en_definition: killing, murder, slaughter (the act of causing the death of a person or animal)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 杀害、谋杀、屠杀或宰杀，即导致人或动物死亡的行为。

collocations.zh: 对该起杀害事件的调查

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-effetti tal-qtil fuq il-familji tal-vittmi.
formal.en: The study examines the effects of killings on the victims' families.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察杀害事件对受害者家庭的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ir-rumanz huwa dwar każ ta' qtil? Mark: Iva, u d-ditektiv isib ħjiel ġdid f'kull kapitlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this novel about a murder case? Mark: Yes, and the detective finds a new clue in every chapter.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本小说讲的是一起谋杀案吗？马克：是的，而且侦探在每一章都会发现新线索。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ir-rumanz huwa dwar każ ta' qtil?
messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-rumanz huwa dwar każ ta' qtil?
messages.zh: 这本小说讲的是一起谋杀案吗？
messages.en: Is this novel about a murder case?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u d-ditektiv isib ħjiel ġdid f'kull kapitlu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u d-ditektiv isib ħjiel ġdid f'kull kapitlu.
messages.zh: 是的，而且侦探在每一章都会发现新线索。
messages.en: Yes, and the detective finds a new clue in every chapter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qtil 放进侦探小说封面的“谋杀案”标签中记忆；再记住它也能泛指杀害人或动物的行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sweet confection made with sugar or honey and nuts, such as almonds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用糖或蜂蜜及杏仁等坚果制成的糖果，即牛轧糖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħelu magħmul biz-zokkor jew bl-għasel u bil-lewż jew bil-ġewż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牛轧糖，一种通常含糖或蜂蜜及坚果的糖果。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta tal-qubbajt tinkludi għasel u lewż.
formal.en: The nougat recipe includes honey and almonds.
formal.zh: 这份牛轧糖食谱的配料包括蜂蜜和杏仁。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Nixtieq biċċa qubbajt tal-lewż, jekk jogħġbok. Mark: Tippreferi l-qubbajt artab jew iebes? Rita: Artab, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Rita: I would like a piece of almond nougat, please. Mark: Do you prefer soft or hard nougat? Rita: Soft, please.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：请给我一块杏仁牛轧糖。马克：你喜欢软的还是硬的牛轧糖？丽塔：请给我软的。

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq biċċa qubbajt tal-lewż, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq biċċa qubbajt tal-lewż, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请给我一块杏仁牛轧糖。
messages.en: I would like a piece of almond nougat, please.

messages.speaker: Mark (糖果店店员)
messages.zh: 你喜欢软的还是硬的牛轧糖？
messages.en: Do you prefer soft or hard nougat?

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我软的。
messages.en: Soft, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象糖果柜里一块嵌着杏仁的牛轧糖，把 qubbajt 写在价签上，再用“软的还是硬的”购物问答巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In front of a person or thing, or in someone's presence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示位于某人或某物前面，也可表示当着某人的面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'pożizzjoni fuq in-naħa ta' quddiem ta' persuna jew ħaġa, jew fil-preżenza ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在……前面；位于……前方。
目前；眼下。

sense_translations.en_definition: before (in front of; position in front of)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在……之前、前面，指空间上处于前方的位置。

sense_translations.en_definition: in the presence (of), in s.o/s.th's presence
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某人或某物面前；当着某人的面。

collocations.en: in front of the children; in the children's presence
collocations.zh: 在孩子们面前；当着孩子们的面

formal.mt: L-istudenti nġabru quddiem il-librerija qabel bdiet iż-żjara.
formal.en: The students gathered in front of the library before the visit began.
formal.zh: 参观开始前，学生们在图书馆前集合。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn qed tistennieni? Mark: Quddiem il-ħanut, ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you waiting for me? Mark: In front of the shop, beside the door.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在哪里等我？Mark：在商店前面，门旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在哪里等我？
messages.en: Where are you waiting for me?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在商店前面，门旁边。
messages.en: In front of the shop, beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 quddiem，就想象自己站在门前：空间上是“在前面”，有人在场时也可理解为“当着他的面”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Christian religious service of Holy Mass, or one individual celebration of that service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基督教的弥撒礼仪，也指一次具体举行的弥撒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċelebrazzjoni reliġjuża Nisranija tal-Ewkaristija, jew ċelebrazzjoni waħda ta' dan ir-rit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弥撒，指宗教礼仪。

sense_translations.en_definition: a mass; a single celebration of the rite of Holy Mass
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一场弥撒；一次具体举行的弥撒礼仪。

formal.mt: Il-quddiesa se tibda fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu fil-knisja tar-raħal.
formal.en: Mass will begin at nine in the morning in the village church.
formal.zh: 弥撒将于上午九点在村里的教堂开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ħin tibda l-quddiesa? Mark: Fid-disgħa. Niltaqgħu quddiem il-knisja?
colloquial.en: Maja: What time does Mass start? Mark: At nine. Shall we meet in front of the church?
colloquial.zh: Maja：弥撒几点开始？Mark：九点。我们在教堂前碰面好吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 弥撒几点开始？
messages.en: What time does Mass start?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 九点。我们在教堂前碰面好吗？
messages.en: At nine. Shall we meet in front of the church?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 quddiesa 和“教堂里的一场弥撒”整幅画面绑定记忆；英语对应 Mass，这里的 mass 指宗教礼仪。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The highest point or top of something, especially a mountain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物最高的部位或顶端，尤指山峰的最高处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ogħla punt jew parti ta' xi ħaġa, speċjalment ta' muntanja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 山顶；山峰的最高处。
顶部；顶端；最高处。
山顶；峰顶；顶峰。
顶点；尖顶；最高点。

formal.mt: Il-grupp laħaq il-quċċata tal-muntanja qabel nofsinhar.
formal.en: The group reached the summit of the mountain before noon.
formal.zh: 这支队伍在中午之前到达了山顶。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nistgħu naraw il-quċċata minn hawn? Pawlu: Iva, ħares lejn l-ogħla punt tal-muntanja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can we see the summit from here? Pawlu: Yes, look at the highest point of the mountain.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：从这里能看到山顶吗？保罗：能，看看山的最高处。

messages.speaker: Lara (登山者)
messages.zh: 从这里能看到山顶吗？
messages.en: Can we see the summit from here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (登山向导)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħares lejn l-ogħla punt tal-muntanja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħares lejn l-ogħla punt tal-muntanja.
messages.zh: 能，看看山的最高处。
messages.en: Yes, look at the highest point of the mountain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一座山，把 quċċata 标在最高点；再把同一标签移到物体顶部，串联“山顶、顶部、顶点”三个意思。

gloss_zh: 周岁抓周仪式；周岁抓周家宴

teaching_sense.en_definition: A celebration of a child's first birthday in which the child chooses an object traditionally believed to suggest a future occupation or interest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 庆祝孩子一周岁的家庭仪式，孩子从若干物品中选择一样，人们按习俗把这个选择理解为未来职业或兴趣的象征。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċelebrazzjoni tal-ewwel għeluq snin ta' tarbija, li fiha tagħżel oġġett minn fost diversi oġġetti; skont it-tradizzjoni, l-għażla tindika x-xogħol jew l-interessi tagħha fil-futur.

sense_translations.en_definition: family gathering on the occasion of a baby's first birthday, during which the child is shown multiple objects and needs to select one, which is said to reflect the child's future occupation.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为庆祝婴儿一周岁举行的家庭聚会，家人展示多种物品，让孩子选择一样，据说所选物品能反映孩子未来的职业。

sense_translations.en_definition: A ceremony held to celebrate a child's first birthday, during which a basket filled with grain, toys, and other assorted items is presented to the child. The item the child selects is believed to predict their future interests or destiny.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 庆祝孩子一周岁的仪式，家人把装有谷物、玩具及其他各类物品的篮子放在孩子面前，按习俗认为孩子选中的物品能预示其未来的兴趣或命运。

collocations.en: the objects used in the first-birthday ceremony

formal.mt: Waqt il-quċċija, il-familja poġġiet diversi oġġetti quddiem it-tarbija u ħallietha tagħżel wieħed.
formal.en: During the first-birthday ceremony, the family placed several objects in front of the baby and let the baby choose one.
formal.zh: 抓周仪式上，家人把几样物品放在宝宝面前，让宝宝选择一样。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta se tagħmlu l-quċċija? Lara: Nhar il-Ħadd, meta t-tarbija tagħlaq sena.
colloquial.en: Maja: When are you holding the first-birthday ceremony? Lara: On Sunday, when the baby turns one.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你们什么时候举行抓周仪式？Lara：星期日，宝宝满一周岁那天。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们什么时候举行抓周仪式？
messages.en: When are you holding the first-birthday ceremony?

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Nhar il-Ħadd, meta t-tarbija tagħlaq sena.
messages.mt_standard: Nhar il-Ħadd, meta t-tarbija tagħlaq sena.
messages.zh: 星期日，宝宝满一周岁那天。
messages.en: On Sunday, when the baby turns one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 quċċija 记成一幅抓周画面：宝宝满一岁，面前摆物品，伸手选一样；所选物品只是习俗中的未来象征。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short traditional saying that expresses a general lesson, observation, or piece of advice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 流传于民间的简短说法，用来表达经验、道理或劝告。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qawl qasir u tradizzjonali li jesprimi tagħlima, osservazzjoni jew parir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谚语；以简短、流传的说法表达生活经验或道理的俗谚。

formal.mt: L-għalliema kitbet qwiela fuq il-bord u talbet lill-istudenti jispjegaw it-tagħlima tagħha.
formal.en: The teacher wrote a proverb on the board and asked the students to explain its lesson.
formal.zh: 老师在黑板上写了一句谚语，请学生解释其中的道理。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser din il-qwiela? Pawlu: Tagħtina parir biex naħsbu qabel naġixxu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does this proverb mean? Pawlu: It advises us to think before we act.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这句谚语是什么意思？Pawlu：它劝我们先想清楚再行动。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这句谚语是什么意思？
messages.en: What does this proverb mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tagħtina parir biex naħsbu qabel naġixxu.
messages.mt_standard: Tagħtina parir biex naħsbu qabel naġixxu.
messages.zh: 它劝我们先想清楚再行动。
messages.en: It advises us to think before we act.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qwiela 想成黑板上的一句谚语：字句很短，道理很长；先记“谚语”这个名词，再用例句巩固。

gloss_zh: 谚语的；谚语式的；冗长啰嗦的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to proverbs or having the character of a proverb; also excessively wordy or long-winded.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与谚语有关的，或具有谚语特点的；也可形容表达冗长、啰嗦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut mal-qwiel jew li għandu l-karattru ta' qawl; jista' jfisser ukoll li juża wisq kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与谚语有关的；涉及谚语的。
冗长的；啰嗦的；表达时用词过多的。
谚语的；谚语式的；具有谚语特点的。

formal.mt: L-awtur juża stil qwieli biex jesprimi tagħlimiet ġenerali dwar il-ħajja.
formal.en: The author uses a proverbial style to express general lessons about life.
formal.zh: 作者用谚语式的文风表达普遍的人生道理。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hawnhekk, 'qwieli' jfisser li d-diskors hu twil wisq? Pawlu: Iva, f'din is-sentenza jfisser li juża wisq kliem.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does 'qwieli' mean that the speech is too long here? Pawlu: Yes, in this sentence it means that it uses too many words.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这里的 qwieli 是说讲话太冗长吗？Pawlu：对，在这个句子里，它表示用词过多。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk, 'qwieli' jfisser li d-diskors hu twil wisq?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk, 'qwieli' jfisser li d-diskors hu twil wisq?
messages.zh: 这里的 qwieli 是说讲话太冗长吗？
messages.en: Does 'qwieli' mean that the speech is too long here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, f'din is-sentenza jfisser li juża wisq kliem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, f'din is-sentenza jfisser li juża wisq kliem.
messages.zh: 对，在这个句子里，它表示用词过多。
messages.en: Yes, in this sentence it means that it uses too many words.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qwieli 做两张语境卡：一张写“谚语式文风”，一张写“讲话太啰嗦”；它是形容词，要结合所修饰的对象判断。

gloss_zh: 卖淫；被贬称为放荡的行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: Prostitution; also a derogatory description of behaviour judged to be sexually promiscuous.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指卖淫；也可用作贬义称呼，指说话者认为性行为放荡的举止，后一用法带有侮辱和评判色彩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prostituzzjoni; ukoll kelma dispreġġjattiva għal imġiba li titqies sesswalment promiskwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卖淫；以金钱或报酬为交换提供性服务。
被贬称为“淫荡、放荡”的行为；属于带侮辱性和性道德评判的说法。

collocations.zh: 指责某人性行为放荡的说法

formal.mt: F'dan it-test, il-kelma 'qħubija' tirreferi għall-prostituzzjoni; f'kuntesti oħra jista' jkollha sens dispreġġjattiv.
formal.en: In this text, the word 'qħubija' refers to prostitution; in other contexts it can have a derogatory meaning.
formal.zh: 在这篇文本中，qħubija 指卖淫；在其他语境中，它可能带有贬义。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser 'qħubija' f'dan il-ktieb? Sara: Hawn tfisser prostituzzjoni, imma tista' tintuża wkoll bħala kelma offensiva.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does 'qħubija' mean in this book? Sara: Here it means prostitution, but it can also be used as an offensive word.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这本书里的 qħubija 是什么意思？萨拉：这里指卖淫，不过这个词也可以用来侮辱人。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 这本书里的 qħubija 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'qħubija' mean in this book?

messages.speaker: Sara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser prostituzzjoni, imma tista' tintuża wkoll bħala kelma offensiva.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser prostituzzjoni, imma tista' tintuża wkoll bħala kelma offensiva.
messages.zh: 这里指卖淫，不过这个词也可以用来侮辱人。
messages.en: Here it means prostitution, but it can also be used as an offensive word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给这个词做一张双义卡：一面写“卖淫”，另一面写“带侮辱性的放荡指责”；阅读时同时辨认含义与语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Occupying position number four in an ordered sequence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示顺序中排在第三之后、第五之前的第四位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġi wara t-tielet u qabel il-ħames f'ordni jew sekwenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 第四，表示次序的序数词。
田地；田野。
乡野；乡间地区。
绿色草木；绿意；绿色植被。
第四；次序中的第四位。
农业用地；耕地；田地。

formal.mt: Ir-raba' kapitlu tar-rapport jiddeskrivi kif jintuża r-raba' f'dan ir-reġjun.
formal.en: The fourth chapter of the report describes how agricultural land is used in this region.
formal.zh: 报告的第四章介绍这个地区的农业用地如何使用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema kapitlu qed taqra? Mark: Ir-raba'. Fih hemm ritratti tar-raba' ħdejn ir-raħal tagħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which chapter are you reading? Mark: The fourth. It has photographs of the fields near our village.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在读第几章？Mark：第四章。里面有我们村附近田地的照片。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在读第几章？
messages.en: Which chapter are you reading?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-raba'. Fih hemm ritratti tar-raba' ħdejn ir-raħal tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-raba'. Fih hemm ritratti tar-raba' ħdejn ir-raħal tagħna.
messages.zh: 第四章。里面有我们村附近田地的照片。
messages.en: The fourth. It has photographs of the fields near our village.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“第四章里有一块田”同时记住 raba' 的两个词性：序数词是“第四”，名词可指田地与乡野；书写时保留末尾撇号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fasten something with a tie or binding, or to connect people or things through a relationship or commitment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用绳带等把东西系住、绑牢；也可指通过关系或承诺使人或事物相连。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħħal jew żamm xi ħaġa b'ħabel jew b'rabta; ukoll għaqqad persuni jew affarijiet permezz ta' relazzjoni jew impenn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 系；扎；用绳带等拴住。
捆绑；束缚；使受到约束。
使结为夫妻；使通过婚姻结合。
使承担承诺或义务；使受到某项约定的约束。
系住；绑住；捆扎。
连接；联结；使相互联系。
郊区；城镇外围的居民区。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem rabat il-kaxxa b'ħabel biex ma tinfetaħx waqt it-trasport.
formal.en: The worker tied the box with rope so that it would not open during transport.
formal.zh: 工人用绳子把箱子绑好，以免运输时打开。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min rabat il-pakkett? Mark: Pawlu rabtu. Issa lest biex nibagħtuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who tied up the parcel? Mark: Pawlu did. Now it is ready for us to send.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁把包裹捆好了？Mark：Pawlu 捆的。现在可以寄出了。

messages.speaker: Maja (店员)
messages.zh: 谁把包裹捆好了？
messages.en: Who tied up the parcel?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu rabtu. Issa lest biex nibagħtuh.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu rabtu. Issa lest biex nibagħtuh.
messages.zh: Pawlu 捆的。现在可以寄出了。
messages.en: Pawlu did. Now it is ready for us to send.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“他把包裹绑好了”记住动词 rabat，再把“绑在一起”联想到连接与承诺；名词“郊区”另做一张词义卡。

gloss_zh: 养育；饲养；培育；培养习惯或品质

teaching_sense.en_definition: To raise and care for a child or animal, or to develop a quality or habit through repeated guidance or practice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 照料并养育孩子或动物；也指通过长期引导或练习培养某种品质、习惯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħa ħsieb tifel jew annimal u għenu jikber; ukoll żviluppa kwalità jew drawwa permezz ta' gwida jew prattika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 养育；抚养长大。
饲养；繁育动物。

sense_translations.en_definition: to inculcate a quality or habit
sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过反复教导或长期实践培养某种品质或习惯。

sense_translations.en_definition: to bring up, rear, raise, educate (a child)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 抚养、养育孩子；使孩子成长并接受教育。

formal.mt: Matul is-snin, Pawlu rabba f'uliedu sens ta' responsabbiltà billi tahom xogħol adattat għall-età tagħhom.
formal.en: Over the years, Pawlu developed a sense of responsibility in his children by giving them tasks suited to their age.
formal.zh: 多年来，Pawlu 通过给孩子们安排适合其年龄的任务，培养了他们的责任感。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Missierek qatt rabba annimali? Mark: Iva, rabba t-tiġieġ għal ħafna snin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did your father ever raise animals? Mark: Yes, he raised chickens for many years.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你爸爸以前养过动物吗？Mark：养过，他养了很多年的鸡。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爸爸以前养过动物吗？
messages.en: Did your father ever raise animals?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, rabba t-tiġieġ għal ħafna snin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, rabba t-tiġieġ għal ħafna snin.
messages.zh: 养过，他养了很多年的鸡。
messages.en: Yes, he raised chickens for many years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rabba 放进“长期照料、慢慢成长”的画面：孩子需要养育，动物需要饲养，好习惯也需要培养；三种对象串联记忆。

gloss_zh: 求平方；使成为二次形式；使增至四倍

teaching_sense.en_definition: To square a number, make an expression quadratic, or increase a quantity to four times its original value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将一个数平方，使表达式成为二次形式，或将数量增加到原来的四倍；具体含义由数学或数量语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimmultiplika numru bih innifsu, jagħmel espressjoni kwadratika, jew iżid kwantità għal erba' darbiet il-valur oriġinali tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 求某数的平方，即将该数乘以自身。
使表达式或关系成为二次形式。
使数量增至原来的四倍。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-matematika, l-istudent rabba' n-numru tlieta u kiseb disgħa.
formal.en: In the mathematics exercise, the student squared the number three and obtained nine.
formal.zh: 在数学练习中，学生将三平方，得到了九。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rabba' n-numru ħamsa. Mark: Jiġifieri ħamsa għal ħamsa? Maja: Iva, it-tweġiba hi ħamsa u għoxrin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Square the number five. Mark: You mean five times five? Maja: Yes, the answer is twenty-five.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：把五平方。马克：就是五乘五吗？玛雅：对，答案是二十五。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 把五平方。
messages.en: Square the number five.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 就是五乘五吗？
messages.en: You mean five times five?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, it-tweġiba hi ħamsa u għoxrin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, it-tweġiba hi ħamsa u għoxrin.
messages.zh: 对，答案是二十五。
messages.en: Yes, the answer is twenty-five.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张算式卡区分词义：三平方是九，三增至四倍是十二；看到 rabba' 先看题目要求。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bond, tie, or connection between people or things, including a commitment to someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人与人或事物之间的纽带、系结或联系，也可指对某人或某事承担的承诺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaqda jew konnessjoni bejn persuni jew affarijiet, jew impenn lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人或事物相互联结的纽带。
系结；把人或事物联系起来的关系。
两个或多个对象之间的联系。
对某事或某人承担的承诺或责任。
纽带；使彼此维系在一起的联系。
联系；事物或人之间的关系。

formal.mt: L-istudju juri rabta bejn l-attività fiżika u s-saħħa mentali.
formal.en: The study shows a connection between physical activity and mental health.
formal.zh: 这项研究显示，身体活动与心理健康之间存在联系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad għandek rabta ma' sħabek tal-iskola? Mark: Iva, niltaqgħu kull xahar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you still have a connection with your school friends? Mark: Yes, we meet every month.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你和以前的同学还有联系吗？马克：有，我们每个月都见面。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad għandek rabta ma' sħabek tal-iskola?
messages.mt_standard: Għad għandek rabta ma' sħabek tal-iskola?
messages.zh: 你和以前的同学还有联系吗？
messages.en: Do you still have a connection with your school friends?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，我们每个月都见面。
messages.en: Yes, we meet every month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一条线把家人、朋友和承诺连在一起：rabta 就是这条可见或无形的联系纽带。

gloss_zh: 掩埋；填埋；藏匿；盖过；废料；大量

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bury or conceal something, or fill a hole with earth, stones, or building material; figuratively, to overshadow something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西掩埋或隐藏起来，或用泥土、石块及建筑材料填满坑洞；比喻用法可指盖过其他事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħatti jew jaħbi xi ħaġa, jew jimla ħofra bil-ħamrija, bil-ġebel jew b'materjal tal-bini; b'mod figurattiv, jagħmel xi ħaġa oħra tidher inqas importanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物掩埋在泥土或其他材料之下。

sense_translations.en_definition: to fill up (epecially with stones or masonry)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 填满，尤其指用石块或砖石材料填塞。
隐藏；使某物不被看见。
大量；一大堆。

sense_translations.en_definition: material (often building material) which is dumped or piled up
sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾倒或堆积起来的材料，通常指建筑材料或建筑废料。
掩埋；通过覆盖或遮蔽将某物隐藏起来。

sense_translations.en_definition: to backfill (to refill a hole with the material dug out of it)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 回填；用挖出的材料重新填满坑洞。
藏匿；把东西放到隐蔽处存放。

sense_translations.en_definition: to overshadow (to dominate something and make it seem insignificant or small)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 盖过；使其他事物显得不重要或微不足道。
碎屑；残骸；建筑废料。
废料倾倒场；垃圾堆放场；填埋场。
很大的数目或数量。

formal.mt: Wara li tlesta x-xogħol fuq il-pajp, il-ħaddiem radam il-ħofra bil-materjal li kien ħareġ minnha.
formal.en: After the work on the pipe was completed, the worker backfilled the hole with the material that had been dug out of it.
formal.zh: 管道作业完成后，工人用先前挖出的材料回填了坑洞。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min radam il-ħofra fil-ġnien? Mark: Jien, bil-ħamrija li ħriġna minnha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who filled in the hole in the garden? Mark: I did, with the soil we dug out of it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把花园里的坑填上了？马克：我填的，用的就是我们从坑里挖出的土。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把花园里的坑填上了？
messages.en: Who filled in the hole in the garden?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我填的，用的就是我们从坑里挖出的土。
messages.en: I did, with the soil we dug out of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一堆碎石倒进坑里：做这个动作是动词“填埋”，那堆材料可用名词 radam 表示；先分词性再选义。

gloss_zh: 归还；给予；获利；备妥；翻译；归还之物；犁沟；船迹

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give something back or render it to someone; in other contexts, to yield a profit, make ready, or translate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物归还或给予他人；在其他语境中，也可表示产生利润、准备妥当或翻译。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti xi ħaġa lura jew jagħtiha lil xi ħadd; f'kuntesti oħra, iħalli qligħ, iħejji jew jittraduċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给予；提供；作出相应的回报。
归还；把东西交还给原持有人。
产生利润；带来收益。
给予这一行为。
归还或返还这一行为。
所给予或归还的东西。
交还；给予；作出回报。
准备；使某物处于就绪状态。
翻译；用另一种语言表达。

sense_translations.en_definition: furrow (a trench cut in the soil)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 犁沟；在土壤中开出的长沟。

sense_translations.en_definition: wake (the path left behind a ship on the surface of the water)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 船迹；船驶过后留在水面上的航迹。

formal.mt: Il-bejjiegħ radd il-flus lix-xerrej wara li dan irritorna l-prodott difettuż.
formal.en: The seller returned the money to the buyer after the buyer returned the defective product.
formal.zh: 买家退回有缺陷的商品后，卖家向其退还了货款。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark radd il-ktieb li selliftu? Lara: Iva, ġabu lura dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark return the book you lent him? Lara: Yes, he brought it back this morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克把你借给他的书还了吗？拉拉：还了，他今天早上拿回来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克把你借给他的书还了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark return the book you lent him?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 还了，他今天早上拿回来了。
messages.en: Yes, he brought it back this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“借书后归还”记住动词 radd；再把名词义画成田里的沟、水面的船迹，分开记忆避免混淆。

gloss_zh: 纺车；风车；旋转烟花；原地转轮；爱抱怨的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wheel that rotates without moving forward, such as a spinning wheel, a windwheel, or a Catherine wheel firework; also a person who grumbles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在原地转动而不向前行进的轮状装置，例如纺车、风车或轮式旋转烟花；也可指爱抱怨的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rota li ddur mingħajr ma timxi 'l quddiem, bħal rota tal-għażil, tar-riħ jew tan-nar; tista' tfisser ukoll persuna li tgerger.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纺车；用于纺线的轮式装置。
风车；由风力驱动旋转的装置。
轮式旋转烟花；点燃后围绕固定中心转动的烟花。

sense_translations.en_definition: any wheel that does not move forward, especially
sense_translations.zh_definition: 泛指在原地旋转而不向前行进的轮子。
一架纺车；纺线用的转轮装置。
风轮；风车。
爱抱怨的人；经常发牢骚的人。

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesebixxi raddiena tal-għażil u jispjega kif kienet tintuża biex isir il-ħajt.
formal.en: The museum displays a spinning wheel and explains how it was used to make yarn.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出了一架纺车，并说明它如何用于纺线。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik ir-rota tal-injam? Mark: Dik raddiena tal-għażil; tintuża biex isir il-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that wooden wheel? Mark: That is a spinning wheel; it is used to make yarn.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个木轮子是什么？马克：那是纺车，用来纺线。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 那个木轮子是什么？
messages.en: What is that wooden wheel?

messages.speaker: Mark (博物馆讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik raddiena tal-għażil; tintuża biex isir il-ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Dik raddiena tal-għażil; tintuża biex isir il-ħajt.
messages.zh: 那是纺车，用来纺线。
messages.en: That is a spinning wheel; it is used to make yarn.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把纺车、风车和旋转烟花画成三个原地转圈的轮子；另加一个不停抱怨的人，作为人物义的记忆图。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Radio as a means of broadcasting or a device for receiving broadcasts; in chemistry, the element radium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指无线电广播这种传播方式，或接收广播的收音机；在化学语境中也指元素镭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mezz ta' xandir jew apparat li jirċievi x-xandiriet; fil-kimika, l-element radju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收音机；无线电广播。
镭，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: L-avviż se jixxandar fuq ir-radju għada filgħodu.
formal.en: The announcement will be broadcast on the radio tomorrow morning.
formal.zh: 这则通知将于明天早上通过广播播出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tixgħel ir-radju? Mark: Iva. Trid tisma' l-aħbarijiet? Maja: Iva, wasal il-ħin tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you turn on the radio? Mark: Yes. Do you want to hear the news? Maja: Yes, it is time for it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能打开收音机吗？马克：可以。你想听新闻吗？玛雅：对，到新闻时间了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你能打开收音机吗？
messages.en: Can you turn on the radio?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 可以。你想听新闻吗？
messages.en: Yes. Do you want to hear the news?

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 对，到新闻时间了。
messages.en: Yes, it is time for it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 radju 放进两幅画：客厅里听广播的是收音机，化学课上的元素卡写的是镭；用场景区分同形词。

gloss_zh: 放牧；照管、引领；起泡；起泡现象

teaching_sense.en_definition: To tend animals while they graze; in other contexts, to guide people or to produce foam.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 照看正在吃草的牲畜，放牧；在其他语境中也可表示照管、引领他人，或液体等起泡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħa ħsieb annimali waqt li jirgħu; f'kuntesti oħra, mexxa nies jew għamel ir-ragħwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放牧，使牲畜吃草。

sense_translations.en_definition: to foam (used, e.g., of soap in water)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 起泡，例如肥皂在水中产生泡沫。
起沫，产生细密的泡沫。
起泡，泡沫形成的过程或现象。
起沫，细密泡沫产生的过程或现象。
放牧、牧养或赶领牲畜。

sense_translations.en_definition: to tend, to lead (e.g. a congregation)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 照管、引领，例如牧养或带领教会会众。
起泡，产生泡沫。

collocations.en: tended the sheep as they grazed

formal.mt: Ir-ragħaj ragħa n-nagħaġ fl-għalqa u tahom l-ilma qabel daħal il-lejl.
formal.en: The shepherd tended the sheep in the field and gave them water before nightfall.
formal.zh: 牧羊人在田里放牧羊群，并在夜幕降临前给它们饮水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ragħa n-nagħaġ illum? Pawlu: Ħija ragħahom filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who tended the sheep today? Pawlu: My brother tended them this morning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今天是谁放的羊？Pawlu：我兄弟今天早上放的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天是谁放的羊？
messages.en: Who tended the sheep today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我兄弟今天早上放的。
messages.en: My brother tended them this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ragħa 放进两幅学习画面：羊群吃草对应“放牧”，肥皂冒泡对应“起泡”；先看主语和宾语，再选词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The loud rumbling or crashing sound heard during a thunderstorm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 雷暴时听到的轰隆声或突然的巨响，即雷声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħoss qawwi li jinstema' waqt maltempata bir-ragħad u s-sajjetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雷，雷声；雷暴时听到的轰隆声。

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl, instema' ragħad qawwi u niżlet ħafna xita.
formal.en: During the night, loud thunder was heard and heavy rain fell.
formal.zh: 夜间响起了轰隆的雷声，并下起了大雨。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Smajt ir-ragħad? Mark: Iva, ejja nidħlu ġewwa qabel tibda x-xita.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you hear the thunder? Mark: Yes, let's go inside before it starts raining.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你听见雷声了吗？Mark：听见了，趁还没下雨，我们进去吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见雷声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear the thunder?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nidħlu ġewwa qabel tibda x-xita.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nidħlu ġewwa qabel tibda x-xita.
messages.zh: 听见了，趁还没下雨，我们进去吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's go inside before it starts raining.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习时把 ragħad 配上“轰隆隆”的声音卡片，再与表示闪电的 sajjetti 成对记忆：耳朵听雷声，眼睛看闪电。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who looks after sheep or other grazing livestock.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 照看、放牧羊群或其他食草牲畜的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tieħu ħsieb in-nagħaġ jew bhejjem oħra waqt li jirgħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牧羊人，照看和放牧羊群的人。
牧人；放牧牲畜的人，尤指牧羊人。

formal.mt: Ir-ragħaj mexxa n-nagħaġ lejn il-mergħa u baqa' magħhom sa filgħaxija.
formal.en: The shepherd led the sheep to the pasture and stayed with them until evening.
formal.zh: 牧羊人把羊群带到牧场，并一直照看它们到傍晚。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak ħdejn in-nagħaġ? Toni: Dak ir-ragħaj; qed jieħu ħsiebhom.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is that beside the sheep? Toni: That's the shepherd; he's looking after them.
colloquial.zh: Lara：羊群旁边那个人是谁？Toni：那是牧羊人，他正在照看羊群。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.zh: 羊群旁边那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that beside the sheep?

messages.speaker: Toni (导游)
messages.zh: 那是牧羊人，他正在照看羊群。
messages.en: That's the shepherd; he's looking after them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ragħaj 写在牧羊人的人物卡上，把 nagħaġ 写在羊群卡上；用“谁在照看羊群？”这个问题提醒自己 ragħaj 指人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mass or layer of small bubbles, such as those made by soap or found on a liquid's surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 许多小气泡聚集形成的泡沫，可指肥皂泡沫、液面浮沫等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Massa jew saff ta' bżieżaq żgħar, bħal dawk tas-sapun jew dawk fuq wiċċ likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 泡沫，许多小气泡聚集形成的物质。
细密泡沫，尤指液体表面的泡沫。
浮沫，液体表面聚集的泡沫或杂质层。
泡沫；液体表面或内部形成的成团小气泡。
皂沫，肥皂或清洁用品遇水搓洗时产生的泡沫。

formal.mt: Wara l-ħasil, laħlaħ idejk sew bl-ilma biex tneħħi r-ragħwa tas-sapun.
formal.en: After washing, rinse your hands thoroughly with water to remove the soap lather.
formal.zh: 洗手后，用水充分冲洗双手，去除肥皂泡沫。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għad hemm ir-ragħwa fuq idejk. Ben: Sewwa, se nlaħlaħhom mill-ġdid.
colloquial.en: Nina: There's still lather on your hands. Ben: All right, I'll rinse them again.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你手上还有皂沫。Ben：好，我再冲一下。

messages.speaker: Nina (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你手上还有皂沫。
messages.en: There's still lather on your hands.

messages.speaker: Ben (弟弟)
messages.zh: 好，我再冲一下。
messages.en: All right, I'll rinse them again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象洗手时掌心堆起一团白泡，把这团可见的“泡沫”标为 ragħwa；再换成海浪泡沫，练习同一个名词的不同场景。

gloss_zh: 典当；抵押物、保证金；赎金

teaching_sense.en_definition: To leave a valuable item as security in exchange for a loan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把贵重物品交作借款担保，以换取贷款，即典当。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħalla oġġett ta' valur bħala garanzija biex jieħu self.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 典当，把有价值的物品交作借款担保。

sense_translations.en_definition: pledge, pawn, bail (money or item of value deposited as a security)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 抵押物、质押物或保证金、保释金；作为担保交存的钱款或贵重物品。

sense_translations.en_definition: ransom (money paid in exchange for the release of a hostage)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 赎金，为换取人质获释而支付的钱款。

formal.mt: Biex jikseb self għal żmien qasir, ir-raġel rahan l-arloġġ tiegħu.
formal.en: To obtain a short-term loan, the man pawned his watch.
formal.zh: 为了获得短期贷款，这名男子典当了自己的手表。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-arloġġ ta' ħuk? Pawlu: Rahan l-arloġġ biex iħallas kont, imma biħsiebu jieħdu lura.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is your brother's watch? Pawlu: He pawned the watch to pay a bill, but he intends to get it back.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你兄弟的手表在哪儿？Pawlu：他把手表当了，用来付账，不过他打算赎回来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟的手表在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is your brother's watch?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rahan l-arloġġ biex iħallas kont, imma biħsiebu jieħdu lura.
messages.mt_standard: Rahan l-arloġġ biex iħallas kont, imma biħsiebu jieħdu lura.
messages.zh: 他把手表当了，用来付账，不过他打算赎回来。
messages.en: He pawned the watch to pay a bill, but he intends to get it back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张学习卡区分词性：动作卡写“典当手表”，物品卡写“作为担保的手表”；赎金义另配“付钱换人质获释”的场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A man who belongs to a religious order, often living in a monastery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 加入宗教修会、通常在修道院中过修道生活的男性成员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġel li jagħmel parti minn ordni reliġjuż u spiss jgħix f'kunvent jew monasteru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修士，通常在修道院中过宗教生活的男性。

sense_translations.en_definition: a member of a religious order
sense_translations.zh_definition: 修会成员，隶属于某个宗教修会的人。

formal.mt: Ir-raheb laqa' lill-viżitaturi u spjegalhom kif kienet tintuża l-librerija tal-kunvent.
formal.en: The monk welcomed the visitors and explained how the friary's library was used.
formal.zh: 修士接待了来访者，并向他们介绍了修院图书馆的使用方式。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min se jurina l-kunvent? Mark: Ir-raheb li hemm ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who will show us around the friary? Mark: The monk over there beside the door.
colloquial.zh: Anna：谁会带我们参观修院？Mark：就是那边门旁的那位修士。

messages.speaker: Anna (游客)
messages.zh: 谁会带我们参观修院？
messages.en: Who will show us around the friary?

messages.speaker: Mark (导游)
messages.zh: 就是那边门旁的那位修士。
messages.en: The monk over there beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 raheb 放进“修院里的一位修士”这幅画面，再用“他属于一个修会”补充人物身份，帮助同时记住两个相近义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person in charge of a group or vessel, such as a leader, commander, or captain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责领导一个团体或指挥船只的人，如首领、指挥官或船长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tmexxi grupp jew bastiment, bħal mexxej, kmandant jew kaptan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 首领；居于领导地位的人。
负责人；某团体的领导者。
领导者；带领他人的人。
指挥官；领袖；船长。

formal.mt: Ir-rajjes tal-bastiment ordna lill-ekwipaġġ biex jipprepara għat-tluq.
formal.en: The captain of the vessel ordered the crew to prepare for departure.
formal.zh: 船长命令船员做好启航准备。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min hu r-rajjes ta' din id-dgħajsa? Toni: Dak ir-raġel bil-kappell; staqsih meta nitilqu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is the captain of this boat? Toni: That man with the hat; ask him when we are leaving.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这条船的船长是谁？托尼：那个戴帽子的男人；问问他我们什么时候出发。

messages.speaker: Nina (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu r-rajjes ta' din id-dgħajsa?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu r-rajjes ta' din id-dgħajsa?
messages.zh: 这条船的船长是谁？
messages.en: Who is the captain of this boat?

messages.speaker: Toni (船员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-raġel bil-kappell; staqsih meta nitilqu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-raġel bil-kappell; staqsih meta nitilqu.
messages.zh: 那个戴帽子的男人；问问他我们什么时候出发。
messages.en: That man with the hat; ask him when we are leaving.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rajjes 想成站在船头发号施令的人，由“船长”联想到“首领、负责人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A story or narrative that describes a sequence of real or imagined events.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 讲述一系列真实或虚构事件的故事或叙述。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Storja jew narrattiva li tiddeskrivi ġrajjiet veri jew immaġinati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 故事；对事件的叙述。
故事；讲述真实或虚构事件的叙事。

formal.mt: L-istudent kiteb rakkont qasir dwar vjaġġ li għamel mal-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: The student wrote a short story about a trip he took with his family.
formal.zh: 这名学生写了一篇短篇故事，讲述他与家人一起旅行的经历。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qrajt ir-rakkont li bgħattlek? David: Iva, u l-aħħar parti għoġbitni ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you read the story I sent you? David: Yes, and I really liked the last part.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你读了我发给你的故事吗？戴维：读了，我特别喜欢最后那部分。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你读了我发给你的故事吗？
messages.en: Did you read the story I sent you?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u l-aħħar parti għoġbitni ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u l-aħħar parti għoġbitni ħafna.
messages.zh: 读了，我特别喜欢最后那部分。
messages.en: Yes, and I really liked the last part.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中翻开一本故事书，把开头、经过、结尾连成一个 rakkont，整体记成“故事”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become fond of a person or develop an attachment to a thing or place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 逐渐喜欢上某个人，或对某件事物、某个地方产生依恋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Beda jħobb lil xi ħadd jew żviluppa rabta ma' xi ħaġa jew ma' post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐喜欢上某人；对某人产生感情。

sense_translations.en_definition: to form an attachment to sth. or to a place
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某物或某个地方产生依恋。
黄铜。
铜。

collocations.zh: 对这个地方产生了依恋

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara twila tiegħu, it-tifel ram mal-familja li laqgħetu.
formal.en: During his long visit, the boy became attached to the family that welcomed him.
formal.zh: 在长时间做客期间，男孩对接待他的那家人产生了感情。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex Ġanni ma jridx jitlaq mir-raħal? Luqa: Ram mal-post u għamel ħafna ħbieb hemm.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why doesn't Ġanni want to leave the village? Luqa: He has become attached to the place and has made many friends there.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：詹尼为什么不想离开村庄？卢卡：他已经对那里产生了依恋，还在那里交了很多朋友。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Ġanni ma jridx jitlaq mir-raħal?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Ġanni ma jridx jitlaq mir-raħal?
messages.zh: 詹尼为什么不想离开村庄？
messages.en: Why doesn't Ġanni want to leave the village?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ram mal-post u għamel ħafna ħbieb hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Ram mal-post u għamel ħafna ħbieb hemm.
messages.zh: 他已经对那里产生了依恋，还在那里交了很多朋友。
messages.en: He has become attached to the place and has made many friends there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把动词 ram 画成心留在熟悉的地方；名词另开金属卡片，分别记“铜、黄铜”，避免混义。

gloss_zh: 装备；搭设；开始；套上挽具；容纳

teaching_sense.en_definition: To equip or furnish something, or put something such as a tent in place for use; in other senses, to begin, harness, arm, or contain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为某物配备所需用品，或将帐篷等搭设好以供使用；其他义项包括开始、套上挽具、武装和容纳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għammar xi ħaġa b'dak li teħtieġ jew waqqaf xi ħaġa, bħal tinda, biex tintuża; f'tifsiriet oħra, beda, xedd, arma jew żamm ġewwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 装备；为某人或某物配备所需用品。
搭设；架设；将某物布置好以供使用。
开始；着手进行。
给牲畜等套上挽具。
给自己配备武器；武装自己。

sense_translations.en_definition: to arm (to supply with armour or weapons)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某人配备盔甲或武器；武装。

sense_translations.en_definition: to arm oneself; to become armed
sense_translations.zh_definition: 武装自己；变得有武器装备。
开始；开始做某事。
容纳；将某物盛放或保存在内部。
布置；配置家具、设备或其他所需物品。

sense_translations.en_definition: to harness (to place a harness on something)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 套上挽具；把挽具装到牲畜等身上。

formal.mt: It-tim rama tinda ħdejn l-iskola biex jilqa' lill-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The team set up a tent beside the school to welcome the participants.
formal.zh: 团队在学校旁搭起了一顶帐篷，用于接待参加者。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min rama t-tinda fil-ġnien? Ben: Ħija, biex norqdu fiha llejla.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who set up the tent in the garden? Ben: My brother, so we can sleep in it tonight.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁在花园里搭了帐篷？本：我哥哥搭的，这样我们今晚就能睡在里面。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁在花园里搭了帐篷？
messages.en: Who set up the tent in the garden?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 我哥哥搭的，这样我们今晚就能睡在里面。
messages.en: My brother, so we can sleep in it tonight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“搭帐篷”记住 rama，再分卡学习“开始、装备、容纳”等义项；这些只是记忆分组，并非词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Loose material made up of many very small grains of rock or minerals, commonly found on beaches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由许多细小岩石或矿物颗粒组成的松散物质，常见于海滩等处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal maħlul magħmul minn ħafna frak żgħir ta' blat jew minerali, li spiss jinstab fuq il-bajjiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沙；由细小颗粒组成的沙子。

formal.mt: L-istudenti qabblu kampjun ta' ramel fin ma' kampjun ta' żrar.
formal.en: The students compared a sample of fine sand with a sample of gravel.
formal.zh: 学生们把一份细沙样本与一份碎石样本进行了比较。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Għaliex hemm ir-ramel fiż-żraben tiegħek? Sam: Għax imxejt fuq il-bajja u ma nżajtx iż-żraben.
colloquial.en: Ella: Why is there sand in your shoes? Sam: Because I walked on the beach without taking my shoes off.
colloquial.zh: 埃拉：你的鞋里怎么有沙子？萨姆：因为我没脱鞋就在沙滩上走了。

messages.speaker: Ella (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的鞋里怎么有沙子？
messages.en: Why is there sand in your shoes?

messages.speaker: Sam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax imxejt fuq il-bajja u ma nżajtx iż-żraben.
messages.mt_standard: Għax imxejt fuq il-bajja u ma nżajtx iż-żraben.
messages.zh: 因为我没脱鞋就在沙滩上走了。
messages.en: Because I walked on the beach without taking my shoes off.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脱鞋时倒出一小堆沙子，把 ramel 记成成堆的沙；再与表示沙滩或沙粒的 ramla 对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sandy beach; in another sense, a single grain of sand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地表覆盖沙子的海滩；另一个义项指单独的一粒沙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bajja miksija bir-ramel; f'tifsira oħra, ħabba waħda tar-ramel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沙滩；覆盖着沙子的海滩。
一粒沙；单独的一颗沙粒。
沙质海滩；沙滩。

formal.mt: Il-passaġġ iwassal għal ramla żgħira mdawra bil-blat.
formal.en: The path leads to a small sandy beach surrounded by rocks.
formal.zh: 这条小路通向一片被岩石环绕的小沙滩。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn se mmorru ngħumu? Ġużi: Hemm ramla sabiħa wara dik l-għolja; nistgħu mmorru hemm.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where are we going swimming? Ġużi: There is a lovely sandy beach behind that hill; we can go there.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：我们要去哪里游泳？朱齐：那座山丘后面有一片漂亮的沙滩；我们可以去那里。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们要去哪里游泳？
messages.en: Where are we going swimming?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ramla sabiħa wara dik l-għolja; nistgħu mmorru hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ramla sabiħa wara dik l-għolja; nistgħu mmorru hemm.
messages.zh: 那座山丘后面有一片漂亮的沙滩；我们可以去那里。
messages.en: There is a lovely sandy beach behind that hill; we can go there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ramla 配两幅图：远看是一片沙滩，放大是一粒沙；依靠句子场景判断具体义项。

gloss_zh: 撒沙覆盖；感到轻微刺麻

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover a surface or an object with sand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把沙撒在某个表面或物体上，使其被沙覆盖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħatti wiċċ jew oġġett bir-ramel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用沙覆盖；在……上撒沙。

sense_translations.en_definition: to tingle (to have a prickling or mildly stinging sensation)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到刺麻；出现轻微针刺般或微微刺痛的感觉。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem rammel il-mogħdija biex in-nies ma jiżolqux.
formal.en: The worker covered the path with sand so that people would not slip.
formal.zh: 工人在小路上撒了沙，以免行人滑倒。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex hemm ir-ramel fuq il-mogħdija? Lara: Il-ħaddiem rammel il-mogħdija għax kienet tiżloq.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why is there sand on the path? Lara: The worker covered the path with sand because it was slippery.
colloquial.zh: 马克：小路上为什么有沙？拉拉：因为路滑，工人在路上撒了沙。

messages.speaker: Mark (行人)
messages.zh: 小路上为什么有沙？
messages.en: Why is there sand on the path?

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħaddiem rammel il-mogħdija għax kienet tiżloq.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħaddiem rammel il-mogħdija għax kienet tiżloq.
messages.zh: 因为路滑，工人在路上撒了沙。
messages.en: The worker covered the path with sand because it was slippery.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词配上“工人给小路撒沙”的画面记忆；另把“身体刺麻”单独做一张义项卡，避免把两种意思混用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Christian period of forty days before Easter associated with penitence and fasting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基督教复活节前的四十天节期，与忏悔和禁食有关，称为四旬期或大斋期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-perjodu ta' erbgħin jum qabel l-Għid, marbut mal-penitenza u s-sawm.

sense_translations.en_definition: lent (period of forty days prior to Easter)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 四旬期；复活节前的四十天节期。

sense_translations.en_definition: Lent (Christian period of penitence and fasting before Easter)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 大斋期；基督教复活节前进行忏悔和禁食的节期。

formal.mt: Matul ir-Randan, il-parroċċa torganizza laqgħat ta' talb u attivitajiet ta' għajnuna għall-familji fil-bżonn.
formal.en: During Lent, the parish organizes prayer meetings and activities to help families in need.
formal.zh: 四旬期期间，堂区组织祈祷聚会及援助困难家庭的活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se tagħmel matul ir-Randan? Pawlu: Se nqatta' aktar ħin fit-talb u ngħin fil-parroċċa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What will you do during Lent? Pawlu: I'll spend more time praying and help at the parish.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：四旬期期间你打算做些什么？保罗：我会多花些时间祈祷，并在堂区帮忙。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 四旬期期间你打算做些什么？
messages.en: What will you do during Lent?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nqatta' aktar ħin fit-talb u ngħin fil-parroċċa.
messages.mt_standard: Se nqatta' aktar ħin fit-talb u ngħin fil-parroċċa.
messages.zh: 我会多花些时间祈祷，并在堂区帮忙。
messages.en: I'll spend more time praying and help at the parish.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在学习日历上，把复活节前的一段时间标成“Rand an 四旬期”，再配上祈祷、禁食两幅小图；记忆时把词形连写为 randan。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A written or spoken account that presents information about an event, situation, or piece of work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以书面或口头形式说明事件、情况或工作内容的报告。
