teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħrif bil-miktub jew bil-fomm dwar ġrajja, sitwazzjoni jew xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 报告；汇报情况或结果的材料。
关系；人与人或事物之间的联系。
报告、陈述或记述；对某件事情作出的说明。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta r-riżultati tal-istħarriġ u jagħti rakkomandazzjonijiet għat-titjib tas-servizz.
formal.en: The report presents the survey results and gives recommendations for improving the service.
formal.zh: 该报告介绍了调查结果，并提出改善服务的建议。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif sejjer mal-kollegi l-ġodda? Mark: Tajjeb ħafna, għandi rapport tajjeb magħhom.
colloquial.en: Lara: How are you getting on with your new colleagues? Mark: Very well; I have a good relationship with them.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你和新同事相处得怎么样？马克：很好，我跟他们关系不错。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你和新同事相处得怎么样？
messages.en: How are you getting on with your new colleagues?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna, għandi rapport tajjeb magħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna, għandi rapport tajjeb magħhom.
messages.zh: 很好，我跟他们关系不错。
messages.en: Very well; I have a good relationship with them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个固定场景区分词义：桌上一份 rapport 是“报告”，与同事有 rapport tajjeb 是“关系好”；看到搭配再选中文意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or result of representing a person, group, thing, or idea, including showing it in words or images.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 代表某人或群体，或以文字、图像等方式呈现事物、观念的行为或结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew ir-riżultat li tirrappreżenta persuna, grupp, ħaġa jew idea, ukoll permezz ta' kliem jew stampi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 代表；表述或呈现；使某人、群体或事物得到体现。
描绘；以图像、文字等方式表现某个对象。

formal.mt: Il-pittura toffri rappreżentazzjoni realistika tal-ħajja ta' kuljum fir-raħal.
formal.en: The painting offers a realistic depiction of everyday life in the village.
formal.zh: 这幅画写实地描绘了村庄的日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din l-istampa turi kif kien jidher ir-raħal? Pawlu: Iva, hija rappreżentazzjoni tar-raħal mitt sena ilu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this picture show what the village used to look like? Pawlu: Yes, it is a depiction of the village a hundred years ago.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张图画的是村庄以前的样子吗？保罗：是的，它描绘的是一百年前的村庄。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Din l-istampa turi kif kien jidher ir-raħal?
messages.mt_standard: Din l-istampa turi kif kien jidher ir-raħal?
messages.zh: 这张图画的是村庄以前的样子吗？
messages.en: Does this picture show what the village used to look like?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hija rappreżentazzjoni tar-raħal mitt sena ilu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hija rappreżentazzjoni tar-raħal mitt sena ilu.
messages.zh: 是的，它描绘的是一百年前的村庄。
messages.en: Yes, it is a depiction of the village a hundred years ago.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长词放进一幅“用图画呈现村庄”的画面中，整块记忆 rappreżentazzjoni viżiva；再用会议中的群体代表场景记住“代表”义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sleep, resting with the eyes closed and without normal awareness of the surroundings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 睡觉；闭眼休息，处于通常不清醒感知周围环境的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun fl-irqad, b'għajnejh magħluqa u normalment bla għarfien ta' dak li jkun madwaru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 睡觉；处于睡眠状态。

sense_translations.en_definition: to calm down (used e.g. of a rough sea)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 平静下来；例如指原本波涛汹涌的海面恢复平静。

formal.mt: Wara l-maltemp, il-baħar raqad u d-dgħajjes reġgħu ħarġu mill-port.
formal.en: After the storm, the sea became calm and the boats left the harbour again.
formal.zh: 暴风雨过后，海面平静下来，船只再次驶出港口。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-tifel għadu rieqed? Mark: Iva, raqad tard ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the boy still asleep? Mark: Yes, he went to sleep late yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：孩子还在睡吗？马克：是啊，他昨天很晚才睡。

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.zh: 孩子还在睡吗？
messages.en: Is the boy still asleep?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.zh: 是啊，他昨天很晚才睡。
messages.en: Yes, he went to sleep late yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想一个安睡的孩子，再想一片安静的海面：人 raqad 是“睡了”，海 raqad 是“平静了”，用两个安静画面连接义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To repair something damaged or torn, especially by adding a patch or sewing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 修补破损或撕裂的东西，尤其指通过打补丁或缝合来补好。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isewwi xi ħaġa mħassra jew imqattgħa, speċjalment billi jżid roqgħa jew iħitha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修补；用补片等把破损处补起来。
修补；把损坏或撕裂的东西补好。
打补丁；缝补或修补破损处。

collocations.en: mended a hole in the shirt
collocations.zh: 补好了衬衫上的一个洞

formal.mt: Il-ħajjat raqqa' t-toqba fil-ġakketta b'biċċa drapp tal-istess kulur.
formal.en: The tailor patched the hole in the jacket with a piece of fabric of the same colour.
formal.zh: 裁缝用一块同色布料补好了夹克上的洞。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min raqqa' l-qalziet tiegħek? Pawlu: Ommi, u issa kważi ma tidhirx ir-roqgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who patched your trousers? Pawlu: My mother, and now you can hardly see the patch.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁给你的裤子打了补丁？保罗：我妈妈，现在几乎看不出补丁了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁给你的裤子打了补丁？
messages.en: Who patched your trousers?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ommi, u issa kważi ma tidhirx ir-roqgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Ommi, u issa kważi ma tidhirx ir-roqgħa.
messages.zh: 我妈妈，现在几乎看不出补丁了。
messages.en: My mother, and now you can hardly see the patch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 raqqa' 写在“破裤子补好”的前后对照图旁边；词尾的撇号也一起记入词形，不要在抄写时漏掉。

gloss_zh: 使变薄；使变瘦；精确细致

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something thinner or slimmer, or to cause someone to lose weight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物体变薄、变细，或使人变瘦、减轻体重。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa aktar rqiqa jew iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitlef il-piż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物变得更细或更纤薄。
使体重减轻；使变瘦。
使变薄；使变细。
做到精确；在表达或处理细节时细致准确。

collocations.en: made the piece of wood thinner

formal.mt: Il-furnar raqqaq l-għaġina b'mod uniformi qabel qatagħha f'biċċiet żgħar.
formal.en: The baker made the dough uniformly thin before cutting it into small pieces.
formal.zh: 面包师先把面团擀得厚薄均匀，再把它切成小块。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min raqqaq l-għaġina? Mark: Jien, u issa lesta biex naqtgħuha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who made the dough thinner? Mark: I did, and now it's ready for us to cut.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁把面团擀薄了？马克：我擀的，现在可以切了。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 谁把面团擀薄了？
messages.en: Who made the dough thinner?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, u issa lesta biex naqtgħuha.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, u issa lesta biex naqtgħuha.
messages.zh: 我擀的，现在可以切了。
messages.en: I did, and now it's ready for us to cut.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用擀面杖把厚面团擀薄的画面记住 raqqaq；再分别配上体重下降和细节精确两张卡片，区分“变瘦”与“精确”的义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not common or not often found or encountered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不常见、难得遇到或数量稀少的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx komuni jew li ma tiltaqax miegħu ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 罕见的；稀有的。
不常见的；并不普遍的。
很少；不常；表示某种行为发生的频率低。

formal.mt: Il-librerija żżomm kotba rari f'kamra apposta biex tipproteġihom mill-ħsara.
formal.en: The library keeps rare books in a dedicated room to protect them from damage.
formal.zh: 图书馆把珍稀书籍存放在专用房间内，以保护它们免受损坏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tmur spiss f'dak il-ħanut? Pawlu: Le, rari mmur, imma kultant insib kotba rari hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you often go to that shop? Pawlu: No, I rarely go, but sometimes I find rare books there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你常去那家店吗？保罗：不，我很少去，不过有时能在那里找到珍稀书籍。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你常去那家店吗？
messages.en: Do you often go to that shop?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, rari mmur, imma kultant insib kotba rari hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Le, rari mmur, imma kultant insib kotba rari hemm.
messages.zh: 不，我很少去，不过有时能在那里找到珍稀书籍。
messages.en: No, I rarely go, but sometimes I find rare books there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一句话同时记两种词性：rari mmur 是“我很少去”，kotba rari 是“珍稀书籍”；修饰动作记频率，修饰名词记罕见。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To apply pressure to something, squeeze it, or push oneself through a crowd.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对物体施加压力、把它挤紧或挤出其中的东西，也可指在人群中推挤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tagħfas jew tagħsar xi ħaġa, jew timbotta biex tgħaddi minn qalb in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按压；向某物施加压力。
挤压；把某物压紧或挤出其中的液体。
向某物施加压力这一行为。

sense_translations.en_definition: act of squeezing sth. or sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 挤压某物或挤紧某人的动作。
紧紧拥抱；紧抱的动作。

sense_translations.en_definition: to press (oneself), to push, shove (as of people in a throng)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 挤着向前移动；推挤，如拥挤人群中的动作。

collocations.zh: 把几个包裹挤紧在一起

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem rass l-isponża biex joħroġ minnha l-ilma żejjed.
formal.en: The worker squeezed the sponge to remove the excess water.
formal.zh: 工人挤压海绵，把多余的水挤了出来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan il-pakkett hu daqshekk ċatt? Pawlu: Ħija rass il-pakketti kollha flimkien biex jidħlu fil-kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is this package so flat? Pawlu: My brother pressed all the packages together so they would fit in the box.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个包裹怎么这么扁？保罗：我哥哥把所有包裹挤在一起，好装进箱子里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-pakkett hu daqshekk ċatt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-pakkett hu daqshekk ċatt?
messages.zh: 这个包裹怎么这么扁？
messages.en: Why is this package so flat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija rass il-pakketti kollha flimkien biex jidħlu fil-kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija rass il-pakketti kollha flimkien biex jidħlu fil-kaxxa.
messages.zh: 我哥哥把所有包裹挤在一起，好装进箱子里。
messages.en: My brother pressed all the packages together so they would fit in the box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手把海绵挤紧：物体受压、人群推挤、紧紧拥抱，都可围绕“挤紧”来记；名词义表示这个动作本身。

gloss_zh: 拥挤的人群；人潮；人群奔涌

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tightly packed crowd of people, sometimes moving forward in a rush.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 密集拥挤的人群；在特定语境中也指人群突然奔涌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Folla ta' nies magħfusin flimkien, xi drabi mexjin jew jiġru f'daqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人群，尤其指聚集得较为拥挤的人群。
密集的人群；拥挤的人潮。
人群；拥挤聚集的大群人。
人群惊慌或突然集体奔冲；可能造成踩踏的奔涌。

collocations.en: a tightly packed crowd of people
a crowd packed around the doorway

formal.mt: Wara l-kunċert kien hemm rassa ta' nies ħdejn il-ħruġ tas-sala.
formal.en: After the concert, a tightly packed crowd gathered near the hall's exit.
formal.zh: 音乐会结束后，大厅出口附近聚集了拥挤的人群。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hemm rassa kbira mal-bieb. Mark: Ejja nistennew ftit hawn sakemm jgħaddu n-nies.
colloquial.en: Lara: There's a big crowd packed around the door. Mark: Let's wait here a little until people have passed through.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：门口挤了好多人。马克：我们在这里等一会儿，等大家过去吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 门口挤了好多人。
messages.en: There's a big crowd packed around the door.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nistennew ftit hawn sakemm jgħaddu n-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nistennew ftit hawn sakemm jgħaddu n-nies.
messages.zh: 我们在这里等一会儿，等大家过去吧。
messages.en: Let's wait here a little until people have passed through.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rassa 配成“出口处挤满人”的画面，先记拥挤的人群，再由语境判断是否已经发展成人群奔涌。

gloss_zh: 传统重量单位，约八百克

teaching_sense.en_definition: A traditional unit of weight officially equal to 0.794 kg, often rounded informally to 800 grams.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种传统重量单位，正式数值为零点七九四千克，日常常按八百克计算。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità tradizzjonali ta' piż ta' 0.794 kilogramma, li fl-użu ta' kuljum spiss titqies bħala 800 gramma.

sense_translations.en_definition: a rotolo (old unit of mass of roughly 800g)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个罗托洛：一种约合八百克的旧质量单位。

sense_translations.en_definition: a traditional unit of weight, still used e.g. in household contexts, officially 1.75 imperial pounds (0.794 kg), now widely metrified informally to mean 800 grammes
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种至今仍见于家庭等场景的传统重量单位，正式为一点七五英制磅，即零点七九四千克；如今在非正式使用中普遍按八百克理解。

collocations.en: a ratal of flour, approximately 800 grams
collocations.zh: 一 ratal 面粉，约八百克

collocations.en: half a ratal of sugar, approximately 400 grams
collocations.zh: 半 ratal 糖，约四百克

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob ratal dqiq, jiġifieri madwar 800 gramma fl-użu ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The recipe calls for a ratal of flour, meaning approximately 800 grams in everyday usage.
formal.zh: 这份食谱需要一 ratal 面粉，按日常用法约为八百克。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Ir-riċetta tan-nanna tgħid ratal dqiq. Kemm niżen? Ben: Għal din ir-riċetta, iżen madwar 800 gramma.
colloquial.en: Anna: Grandma's recipe says a ratal of flour. How much should I weigh out? Ben: For this recipe, weigh out about 800 grams.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：奶奶的食谱写着一 ratal 面粉，我该称多少？本：做这份食谱，就称大约八百克吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (家庭烘焙者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-riċetta tan-nanna tgħid ratal dqiq. Kemm niżen?
messages.mt_standard: Ir-riċetta tan-nanna tgħid ratal dqiq. Kemm niżen?
messages.zh: 奶奶的食谱写着一 ratal 面粉，我该称多少？
messages.en: Grandma's recipe says a ratal of flour. How much should I weigh out?

messages.speaker: Ben (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal din ir-riċetta, iżen madwar 800 gramma.
messages.mt_standard: Għal din ir-riċetta, iżen madwar 800 gramma.
messages.zh: 做这份食谱，就称大约八百克吧。
messages.en: For this recipe, weigh out about 800 grams.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象旧食谱旁放着厨房秤：一 ratal 日常约八百克；需要精确数值时，记住七百九十四克。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something softer or more tender; also to pamper someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变软或使食物变得软嫩；也可指过分宠爱、娇惯某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tagħmel xi ħaġa aktar ratba jew il-laħam aktar faċli biex tomogħdu; ukoll li tfissed lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变软；降低某物的硬度。
使软嫩，尤其指让肉等食物更容易咀嚼。
娇惯；过分宠爱或处处迁就某人。

formal.mt: Il-kok rattab il-butir qabel ma ħalltu mad-dqiq.
formal.en: The cook softened the butter before mixing it with the flour.
formal.zh: 厨师先让黄油软化，再把它与面粉混合。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-butir għadu iebes? Toni: Le, missieri rattab il-butir ftit, u issa nistgħu nħalltuh.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this butter still hard? Toni: No, my father softened the butter a little, and now we can mix it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这块黄油还硬吗？托尼：不硬了，我爸爸让黄油软化了一点，现在可以搅拌了。

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.zh: 这块黄油还硬吗？
messages.en: Is this butter still hard?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, missieri rattab il-butir ftit, u issa nistgħu nħalltuh.
messages.mt_standard: Le, missieri rattab il-butir ftit, u issa nistgħu nħalltuh.
messages.zh: 不硬了，我爸爸让黄油软化了一点，现在可以搅拌了。
messages.en: No, my father softened the butter a little, and now we can mix it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“黄油变软、肉变嫩”记具体义，再另配“孩子被处处宠着”的画面记娇惯义；这些只是学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ravioli: small parcels of pasta enclosing a filling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 意式馅饺，即用面皮包住馅料的小块面食。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaġin magħmul minn biċċiet żgħar ta' għaġina magħluqa b'mili ġewwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 意式馅饺；内部包有馅料的面食。
意式馅饺。

formal.mt: Għall-ikla ta' nofsinhar, ir-ristorant joffri ravjul bl-irkotta u biz-zalza tat-tadam.
formal.en: For lunch, the restaurant offers ricotta ravioli with tomato sauce.
formal.zh: 午餐时，这家餐馆供应配番茄酱的乳清奶酪馅意式饺。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'hemm għall-ikel illum? Rita: Ravjul bl-irkotta. Tridu biz-zalza tat-tadam?
colloquial.en: Mark: What's for dinner today? Rita: Ricotta ravioli. Would you like it with tomato sauce?
colloquial.zh: 马克：今天晚饭吃什么？丽塔：乳清奶酪馅意式饺。你想配番茄酱吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 今天晚饭吃什么？
messages.en: What's for dinner today?

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 乳清奶酪馅意式饺。你想配番茄酱吗？
messages.en: Ricotta ravioli. Would you like it with tomato sauce?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ravjul 记成盘中一个个包着馅的小面袋，再搭配乳清奶酪和番茄酱的画面，记住它是夹馅面食。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A circular road junction where traffic moves around a central island.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 车辆围绕中央岛通行、连接多条道路的环形交叉路口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Salib it-toroq b'gżira fin-nofs li l-vetturi jduru magħha biex jaslu għall-ħruġ li jridu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 环形交叉路口；车辆绕中央岛行驶的交通环岛。

collocations.en: the first exit from the roundabout

formal.mt: Biex tasal sal-librerija, ħu t-tieni ħruġ tar-rawndebawt u kompli dritt.
formal.en: To reach the library, take the second exit from the roundabout and continue straight ahead.
formal.zh: 前往图书馆，请从环岛的第二个出口驶出，然后继续直行。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-ħanut qiegħed qabel ir-rawndebawt jew warajh? Luqa: Warajh, fuq ix-xellug.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is the shop before the roundabout or after it? Luqa: After it, on the left.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：商店在环岛前面还是过了环岛之后？卢卡：过了环岛之后，在左边。

messages.speaker: Nina (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħanut qiegħed qabel ir-rawndebawt jew warajh?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħanut qiegħed qabel ir-rawndebawt jew warajh?
messages.zh: 商店在环岛前面还是过了环岛之后？
messages.en: Is the shop before the roundabout or after it?

messages.speaker: Luqa (当地朋友)
messages.zh: 过了环岛之后，在左边。
messages.en: After it, on the left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一个中央小岛，车辆绕着它走，再数第一、第二个出口；把 rawndebawt 和这个路线图一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bring someone up or develop their habits, attitudes, and abilities through guidance and practice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过照料、引导和练习养育某人，或培养其习惯、观念与能力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li trabbi lil xi ħadd jew tgħinu jiżviluppa drawwiet, fehmiet u ħiliet permezz ta' gwida u taħriġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 养育；抚养，使其成长。

sense_translations.en_definition: to inculcate with habits or views
sense_translations.zh_definition: 向某人灌输观念，或培养其形成某些习惯。
养育；抚育，使其长大。
培养或训练某人，使其为某事做好准备。
使具备所需的条件或资源；配备；供给。
获得某物；取得或逐渐形成某种素养、习惯等。

collocations.en: cultivated a sense of responsibility in the children
collocations.zh: 培养了孩子们的责任感

formal.mt: Il-programm rawwem fit-tfal sens ta' responsabbiltà permezz ta' ħidma fi gruppi.
formal.en: The programme cultivated a sense of responsibility in the children through group work.
formal.zh: 这个项目通过小组活动培养了孩子们的责任感。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif rawwem lil uliedu biex jaqraw kuljum? Pawlu: Kien jaqra magħhom kull filgħaxija u jħallihom jagħżlu l-kotba.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did he bring up his children to read every day? Pawlu: He used to read with them every evening and let them choose the books.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他是怎样培养孩子们每天阅读的习惯的？保罗：他以前每天晚上都和他们一起读书，还让他们自己选书。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif rawwem lil uliedu biex jaqraw kuljum?
messages.mt_standard: Kif rawwem lil uliedu biex jaqraw kuljum?
messages.zh: 他是怎样培养孩子们每天阅读的习惯的？
messages.en: How did he bring up his children to read every day?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien jaqra magħhom kull filgħaxija u jħallihom jagħżlu l-kotba.
messages.mt_standard: Kien jaqra magħhom kull filgħaxija u jħallihom jagħżlu l-kotba.
messages.zh: 他以前每天晚上都和他们一起读书，还让他们自己选书。
messages.en: He used to read with them every evening and let them choose the books.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象家长每天陪孩子读书：既在养育孩子，也在培养习惯；其他义项另记“做好准备、使具备、获得”，不要只套一个中文词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To scrape a surface with a tool to remove material or make it cleaner or smoother.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用工具刮擦表面，以去除附着物或使表面更干净、平整。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li togħrok wiċċ b'għodda biex tneħħi materjal minn fuqu jew tagħmlu aktar nadif jew lixx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刮；用工具刮擦表面。
刮石工具；用于刮削石材的刮刀。
一次刮擦或刮削；刮除表面物质的动作。

collocations.en: scraped the surface of the stone

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem raxka l-wiċċ tal-ġebla biex ineħħi s-saff ta' ħmieġ.
formal.en: The worker scraped the surface of the stone to remove the layer of dirt.
formal.zh: 工人刮擦石头表面，以去除那层污垢。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-ħaddiem raxka din il-ġebla? Mark: Kien hemm saff ta' ħmieġ fuqha, u ried ineħħih.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the worker scrape this stone? Mark: There was a layer of dirt on it, and he wanted to remove it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：工人为什么刮这块石头？马克：上面有一层污垢，他想把它清掉。

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.zh: 工人为什么刮这块石头？
messages.en: Why did the worker scrape this stone?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm saff ta' ħmieġ fuqha, u ried ineħħih.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm saff ta' ħmieġ fuqha, u ried ineħħih.
messages.zh: 上面有一层污垢，他想把它清掉。
messages.en: There was a layer of dirt on it, and he wanted to remove it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿刮刀清理石面：动词是“刮”，工具名词是“刮刀”，动作名词是“一次刮削”；依靠句中位置区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of scraping a surface, or removing tissue with a curette during surgery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刮削表面的动作；也指手术中使用刮匙去除组织的操作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tobrox wiċċ, jew li tneħħi tessut waqt operazzjoni permezz ta' kuretta.

sense_translations.en_definition: to remove tissue during surgery with a curette
sense_translations.zh_definition: 手术中使用刮匙去除组织的操作；刮除术。
刮削；刮除的动作或过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi r-raxkament tat-tessut b'kuretta waqt l-operazzjoni.
formal.en: The report describes the scraping of tissue with a curette during the operation.
formal.zh: 报告描述了手术中用刮匙刮除组织的操作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tagħmel dan ir-raxkament? | Pawlu: Biex inneħħi ż-żebgħa l-qadima minn fuq l-injam.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you doing this scraping? | Pawlu: To remove the old paint from the wood.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：你为什么要这样刮削？ | 保罗：为了把木头上的旧漆刮掉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么要这样刮削？
messages.en: Why are you doing this scraping?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex inneħħi ż-żebgħa l-qadima minn fuq l-injam.
messages.mt_standard: Biex inneħħi ż-żebgħa l-qadima minn fuq l-injam.
messages.zh: 为了把木头上的旧漆刮掉。
messages.en: To remove the old paint from the wood.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“刮掉一层”的画面中记忆：木头上刮旧漆是刮削，手术中用刮匙去除组织也是刮除。

gloss_zh: 刮削工具；刮削或修整石材的人；刮刀

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool used for scraping, or a person who scrapes or dresses stone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于刮削的工具；也可指刮削或修整石材的工人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda użata biex tobrox, jew persuna li tobrox jew tirfina l-ġebel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于刮削或刮除的工具。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who scrapes or dresses stone
sense_translations.zh_definition: 刮削或修整石材的人；石材修整工。
刮刀；刮削器。

collocations.en: a worker who scrapes or dresses stone

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem uża raxkatur tal-metall biex ineħħi ż-żebgħa l-qadima mill-bieb.
formal.en: The worker used a metal scraper to remove the old paint from the door.
formal.zh: 工人用金属刮刀去除门上的旧漆。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu r-raxkatur? | Mark: Fil-kaxxa tal-għodda, ħdejn il-martell.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the scraper? | Mark: In the toolbox, next to the hammer.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：刮刀在哪里？ | 马克：在工具箱里，锤子旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 刮刀在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the scraper?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 在工具箱里，锤子旁边。
messages.en: In the toolbox, next to the hammer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两个并排的画面：手里拿着的是刮削工具，正在修整石头的是工人；具体指工具还是人，要看上下文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A scrape on a surface, or an instance of scraping it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面上的一道刮痕，或对表面进行的一次刮削。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marka fuq wiċċ magħmula bil-brix, jew azzjoni waħda ta' brix.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一道刮痕；一处刮擦痕迹。
一次刮削；一次刮除。

formal.mt: L-ispezzjoni sabet raxkatura żgħira fuq il-wiċċ tal-mejda.
formal.en: The inspection found a small scrape on the surface of the table.
formal.zh: 检查发现桌面上有一道小刮痕。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara, hemm raxkatura fuq il-mejda! | Toni: Iva, rajtha. Naħseb li saret meta ċaqlaqna s-siġġu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look, there is a scrape on the table! | Toni: Yes, I saw it. I think it happened when we moved the chair.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看，桌子上有一道刮痕！ | 托尼：是的，我看到了。我想是我们搬椅子时弄的。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 看，桌子上有一道刮痕！
messages.en: Look, there is a scrape on the table!

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, rajtha. Naħseb li saret meta ċaqlaqna s-siġġu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, rajtha. Naħseb li saret meta ċaqlaqna s-siġġu.
messages.zh: 是的，我看到了。我想是我们搬椅子时弄的。
messages.en: Yes, I saw it. I think it happened when we moved the chair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象椅子擦过桌边：动作是一次刮削，留下的是一道刮痕；用“刮一下、留一道”把两个义项连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A scraping implement, especially one used to dress stone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于刮削的工具，尤指修整石材表面的刮具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda għall-brix, speċjalment biex tirfina wiċċ il-ġebel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于修整石材表面的工具。
刮刀；刮削工具。

collocations.en: to finish the stone with a scraper

formal.mt: L-artiġjan uża r-raxketta biex jirfina l-wiċċ tal-ġebla.
formal.en: The craftsperson used the scraper to finish the surface of the stone.
formal.zh: 工匠用刮具修整石材表面。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tgħaddili r-raxketta, jekk jogħġbok? | Rita: Hawn hi. Għadek qed tirfina dik il-ġebla?
colloquial.en: Mark: Could you pass me the scraper, please? | Rita: Here it is. Are you still finishing that stone?
colloquial.zh: 马克：请把刮具递给我好吗？ | 丽塔：给你。你还在修整那块石头吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (工匠)
messages.zh: 请把刮具递给我好吗？
messages.en: Could you pass me the scraper, please?

messages.speaker: Rita (助手)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn hi. Għadek qed tirfina dik il-ġebla?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn hi. Għadek qed tirfina dik il-ġebla?
messages.zh: 给你。你还在修整那块石头吗？
messages.en: Here it is. Are you still finishing that stone?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与工匠手中的石材刮具绑定：看到粗糙石面被一点点刮平，就回想 raxketta 的工具义。

gloss_zh: 洒；喷；撒；喷雾；浪花飞沫；皮疹

teaching_sense.en_definition: To scatter small drops of liquid or small particles over something by sprinkling or spraying.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把液体以小滴喷洒在某物上，或把盐等细小颗粒撒在某物上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ixerred qtar żgħir ta' likwidu jew frak fin, bħal melħ, fuq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 洒；撒，把少量液体或细小颗粒分散在某物上。
喷；喷洒，使液体以细小水滴散出。
使雨点般洒落；向某物上密集地洒下。
喷雾；喷散在空气中的细小液滴。
海浪激起的飞沫；海水飞溅形成的水雾。
皮疹；皮肤上出现的成片小疹点。
撒；撒布，例如撒盐。
洒落；喷洒；少量洒下的东西。
飞溅的水花或液体；一次溅洒。

collocations.en: he sprayed water on the leaves

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar raxx l-ilma fuq il-weraq tal-pjanti.
formal.en: The gardener sprayed water on the plants' leaves.
formal.zh: 园丁往植物的叶子上喷了水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel Toni mal-insalata? | Lara: Raxx ftit melħ fuqha u ħallatha sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Toni do to the salad? | Lara: He sprinkled a little salt on it and mixed it well.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：托尼对沙拉做了什么？ | 劳拉：他往上撒了少许盐，然后拌匀了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 托尼对沙拉做了什么？
messages.en: What did Toni do to the salad?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Raxx ftit melħ fuqha u ħallatha sew.
messages.mt_standard: Raxx ftit melħ fuqha u ħallatha sew.
messages.zh: 他往上撒了少许盐，然后拌匀了。
messages.en: He sprinkled a little salt on it and mixed it well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“小点散开”记喷洒、撒盐和海水飞沫；皮疹义另配“皮肤上一片小点”的画面。这只是记忆联想，不表示词源关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sprinkle or spray liquid, or, of the weather, to rain lightly in fine drops.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把液体喷洒或洒落；用于天气时，表示下细小而轻微的雨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ixerred likwidu fi qtar żgħir; meta jingħad għat-temp, jagħmel xita ħafifa ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 洒；把液体以小滴分散洒下。
使雨点般洒下；淋洒。
下毛毛雨；飘细雨。
喷洒、洒布液体。
下细密的小雨；轻微地下雨。

collocations.en: he sprayed water on the plants
it drizzled a little this morning
collocations.zh: 今天早上下了一点毛毛雨

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl raxxax għal ftit ħin, iżda filgħodu t-temp kien niexef.
formal.en: It drizzled briefly during the night, but the weather was dry in the morning.
formal.zh: 夜间下了一小会儿毛毛雨，但早晨天气干燥。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għamlet ħafna xita dalgħodu? | Pawlu: Le, raxxax ftit biss. Issa waqaf.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did it rain a lot this morning? | Pawlu: No, it only drizzled a little. It has stopped now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：今天早上雨下得大吗？ | 保罗：不，只下了一点毛毛雨。现在已经停了。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 今天早上雨下得大吗？
messages.en: Did it rain a lot this morning?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, raxxax ftit biss. Issa waqaf.
messages.mt_standard: Le, raxxax ftit biss. Issa waqaf.
messages.zh: 不，只下了一点毛毛雨。现在已经停了。
messages.en: No, it only drizzled a little. It has stopped now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅小水滴画面记忆：手里的喷壶洒出细滴，天空也飘下细滴；前者帮助记喷洒，后者帮助记毛毛雨。

gloss_zh: 族群；种族；品种；血统；后代

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group distinguished by shared ancestry or origin; for animals, a breed with shared characteristics.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按共同祖先或出身划分的群体；用于动物时，指具有共同特征的品种。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp li għandu antenati jew oriġini komuni; għall-annimali, grupp b'karatteristiċi komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 族群身份；民族归属。
动物的品种。
血统；世系。
后代；子孙。
种族。
种族；动物品种；族群身份，具体含义取决于语境。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi razza ta' klieb magħrufa għall-intelliġenza tagħha.
formal.en: The report describes a breed of dog known for its intelligence.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一种以聪明著称的犬种。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ta' liema razza hu l-kelb tiegħek? Mark: Hu ta' razza mħallta, u jħobb jilgħab ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What breed is your dog? Mark: He's a mixed breed, and he loves playing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的狗是什么品种的？马克：它是混合品种，而且特别爱玩。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ta' liema razza hu l-kelb tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Ta' liema razza hu l-kelb tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你的狗是什么品种的？
messages.en: What breed is your dog?

messages.speaker: Mark (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu ta' razza mħallta, u jħobb jilgħab ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Hu ta' razza mħallta, u jħobb jilgħab ħafna.
messages.zh: 它是混合品种，而且特别爱玩。
messages.en: He's a mixed breed, and he loves playing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 razza 放进两张分类卡：谈人时联想族群或血统，谈狗时联想品种；先看对象，再选中文义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where crops are grown or animals are kept, or the farmhouse associated with such a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 种植作物或饲养动物的农场，也可指与农场相关的农舍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn jitkabbru l-uċuħ tar-raba' jew jitrabbew l-annimali, jew id-dar marbuta ma' dan il-post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 农场；从事种植或养殖的场所。
农舍；农场里的住宅。

formal.mt: Il-familja għandha razzett fejn tkabbar il-ħaxix u trabbi t-tiġieġ.
formal.en: The family has a farm where it grows vegetables and raises chickens.
formal.zh: 这家人有一个农场，在那里种蔬菜、养鸡。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se tqattgħu tmiem il-ġimgħa? Pawlu: F'razzett antik fil-kampanja.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are you spending the weekend? Pawlu: In an old farmhouse in the countryside.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你们周末准备在哪里过？保罗：在乡间的一座老农舍里。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们周末准备在哪里过？
messages.en: Where are you spending the weekend?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 在乡间的一座老农舍里。
messages.en: In an old farmhouse in the countryside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一幅乡村图：外面是种菜养鸡的农场，里面是住人的农舍；razzett 可以指这两个相连的场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reason or cause that explains an event or justifies an action; also the ability to think logically.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来解释某事发生或说明某项行动为何合理的原因、理由；也可指进行逻辑思考的理性能力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kawża li tispjega għaliex ġrat xi ħaġa, jew ġustifikazzjoni għal azzjoni; ukoll il-ħila li wieħed jaħseb b'mod loġiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 理由；原因；也可指理性或推理能力。
一个理由；导致某事发生的原因。

formal.mt: Ir-raġuni għall-bidla fl-iskeda hija n-nuqqas ta' trasport.
formal.en: The reason for the change in the schedule is the lack of transport.
formal.zh: 更改日程的原因是缺乏交通安排。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm xi raġuni għaliex trid titlaq kmieni? Mark: Iva, irrid nilħaq l-aħħar karozza tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there a reason why you want to leave early? Mark: Yes, I need to catch the last bus.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想早点走，是有什么原因吗？马克：有，我得赶上末班公交车。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm xi raġuni għaliex trid titlaq kmieni?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm xi raġuni għaliex trid titlaq kmieni?
messages.zh: 你想早点走，是有什么原因吗？
messages.en: Is there a reason why you want to leave early?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irrid nilħaq l-aħħar karozza tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irrid nilħaq l-aħħar karozza tal-linja.
messages.zh: 有，我得赶上末班公交车。
messages.en: Yes, I need to catch the last bus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 每次问“为什么”就找一条 raġuni：迟到有原因，决定有理由；讨论如何思考时，再联想到“理性”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ray or beam of light, an X-ray, or the radius of a circle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指一条光线或一道光束，也可指X射线，或圆心到圆周的半径。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Linja jew faxx ta' dawl, raġġ X, jew linja miċ-ċentru ta' ċirku saċ-ċirkonferenza tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一缕光；一道光线。
X射线。
X射线，指这类射线的复数或集合表达。
光线；光束。
半径；圆心到圆周的线段或其长度。

formal.mt: Ir-raġġ taċ-ċirku huwa ħames ċentimetri, għalhekk id-dijametru tiegħu huwa għaxar ċentimetri.
formal.en: The radius of the circle is five centimetres, so its diameter is ten centimetres.
formal.zh: 这个圆的半径为五厘米，因此直径为十厘米。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm daqshekk dawl fuq il-mejda? Mark: Hemm raġġ ta' xemx dieħel mit-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is there so much light on the table? Mark: A ray of sunlight is coming through the window.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：桌上怎么这么亮？马克：有一束阳光从窗户照进来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm daqshekk dawl fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm daqshekk dawl fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 桌上怎么这么亮？
messages.en: Why is there so much light on the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm raġġ ta' xemx dieħel mit-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm raġġ ta' xemx dieħel mit-tieqa.
messages.zh: 有一束阳光从窗户照进来了。
messages.en: A ray of sunlight is coming through the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张直线图记 raġġ：窗边的一道光、标着X的射线、圆心连到圆周的半径；这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 村民；乡村的；乡巴佬（贬义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who lives in or comes from a village; in a derogatory use, a person described as an uncultured bumpkin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 居住在村庄或来自村庄的人；带贬义使用时，指被说成缺乏教养的乡巴佬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħix f'raħal jew ġejja minn raħal; b'mod dispreġġjattiv, persuna meqjusa nieqsa mill-edukazzjoni jew mill-manjieri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与村庄有关者；此义项表达与村庄的关联。
村民；居住在村庄的人。
乡巴佬；对被认为土气或缺乏教养者的贬称。
乡村的；村民的；农民的。
不讲礼貌的；粗鲁无礼的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, raħli jiddeskrivi l-ħajja ta' kuljum fir-raħal tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, a villager describes everyday life in his village.
formal.zh: 故事中，一位村民描述了自己村庄的日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'raħli' f'dan ir-rakkont? Mark: Hawn ifisser persuna li tgħix f'raħal.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'raħli' mean in this story? Mark: Here it means a person who lives in a village.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个故事里的 raħli 是什么意思？马克：这里指住在村庄里的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的 raħli 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'raħli' mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser persuna li tgħix f'raħal.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser persuna li tgħix f'raħal.
messages.zh: 这里指住在村庄里的人。
messages.en: Here it means a person who lives in a village.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 raħli 放进村庄人物画面，记住中性的“村民”；遇到嘲讽语气，再辨认贬义“乡巴佬”。

gloss_zh: 照管放牧牲畜；建村；畜牧者、牧人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To look after grazing livestock; in another sense, to build a village.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 照管正在放牧的牲畜；另一个义项是建造村庄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħa ħsieb il-bhejjem waqt li jirgħu; f'tifsira oħra, bena raħal.

sense_translations.en_definition: to take care of grazing animals
sense_translations.zh_definition: 照管吃草或放牧中的牲畜。
建造村庄，建立村落。
畜牧者、牲畜饲养者；牧人。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi raħħal il-bhejjem fl-għalqa u żgura li kellhom biżżejjed ilma.
formal.en: The farmer looked after the grazing livestock in the field and ensured that they had enough water.
formal.zh: 农民照管田里放牧的牲畜，并确保它们有足够的饮水。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min raħħal il-bhejjem illum? Toni: Missieri; dam magħhom sal-ħamsa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who looked after the grazing livestock today? Toni: My father; he stayed with them until five.
colloquial.zh: Lara：今天是谁照管放牧的牲畜？Toni：我父亲，他一直陪着它们到五点。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 今天是谁照管放牧的牲畜？
messages.en: Who looked after the grazing livestock today?

messages.speaker: Toni (农户之子)
messages.zh: 我父亲，他一直陪着它们到五点。
messages.en: My father; he stayed with them until five.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 raħħal 做三格记忆卡：“照管牲畜”的动作、“建村”的动作、“畜牧者”的人物；先辨词性，再辨语境，并留意双写 ħ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover a surface with marble; in another sense, to plead earnestly with someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用大理石覆盖或铺饰表面；另一个义项是向人恳求、哀求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kesa wiċċ bl-irħam; f'tifsira oħra, talab lil xi ħadd bil-ħerqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恳求，诚恳地请求某人。
哀求，急切或强烈地恳请某人。
用大理石覆盖或铺饰。

sense_translations.en_definition: to marble, to cover with marble
sense_translations.zh_definition: 铺覆大理石，用大理石饰面。

formal.mt: Matul ir-restawr, il-ħaddiem raħħam l-art tas-sala skont il-pjan approvat.
formal.en: During the restoration, the worker covered the hall floor with marble according to the approved plan.
formal.zh: 修复期间，工人按照获批方案，给大厅地面铺上了大理石。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min raħħam it-taraġ? Mark: Ħaddiem li rrakkomandali ħabib; għamel xogħol sabiħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who clad the stairs in marble? Mark: A worker a friend recommended to me; he did a lovely job.
colloquial.zh: Sara：是谁给楼梯铺的大理石？Mark：是朋友推荐给我的一位工人，他做得很漂亮。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 是谁给楼梯铺的大理石？
messages.en: Who clad the stairs in marble?

messages.speaker: Mark (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħaddiem li rrakkomandali ħabib; għamel xogħol sabiħ.
messages.mt_standard: Ħaddiem li rrakkomandali ħabib; għamel xogħol sabiħ.
messages.zh: 是朋友推荐给我的一位工人，他做得很漂亮。
messages.en: A worker a friend recommended to me; he did a lovely job.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 raħħam 分设两幅学习画面：一幅是工人铺大理石，一幅是某人诚恳请求；遇到地面、楼梯等词时，优先联想铺饰义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lower the price of something so that it becomes cheaper to buy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 降低某物的售价，使购买它所需的钱减少。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Naqqas il-prezz ta' xi ħaġa biex tkun irħas biex tixtriha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物变得更便宜。
降低某物的价格。

sense_translations.en_definition: to cheapen, to reduce the price
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使价格降低；给某物降价。

formal.mt: Il-ħanut raħħas il-prezz tal-ħalib biex jgħin lill-familji jiffrankaw.
formal.en: The shop lowered the price of milk to help families save money.
formal.zh: 这家商店降低了牛奶的价格，帮助家庭节省开支。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-ħanut raħħas il-kafè? Pawlu: Iva, issa jiswa euro inqas.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has the shop made the coffee cheaper? Pawlu: Yes, it now costs one euro less.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：商店给咖啡降价了吗？保罗：是的，现在便宜了一欧元。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 商店给咖啡降价了吗？
messages.en: Has the shop made the coffee cheaper?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.zh: 是的，现在便宜了一欧元。
messages.en: Yes, it now costs one euro less.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象店员把价签上的数字往下改：raħħas 表示主动给商品降价。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave with restraint by keeping one's reactions and conduct under control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 约束自己的反应和举止，表现得克制而有分寸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu bil-qies u jżomm ir-reazzjonijiet u l-imġiba tiegħu taħt kontroll.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 举止克制；行事有分寸。
克制；对行为或反应的约束。
自制力；控制自己情绪和行为的能力。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti wrew rażan waqt id-dibattitu u semgħu lil xulxin mingħajr ma għollew leħinhom.
formal.en: The participants showed restraint during the debate and listened to one another without raising their voices.
formal.zh: 参与者在辩论中表现克制，彼此倾听，没有提高嗓门。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kont irrabjat, imma bqajt kalm. | Mark: Urejt ħafna rażan. Ma kienx faċli.
colloquial.en: Maja: I was angry, but I stayed calm. | Mark: You showed a lot of self-control. It was not easy.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：我当时很生气，但还是保持了冷静。 | 马克：你很有自制力。这可不容易。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我当时很生气，但还是保持了冷静。
messages.en: I was angry, but I stayed calm.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Urejt ħafna rażan. Ma kienx faċli.
messages.mt_standard: Urejt ħafna rażan. Ma kienx faċli.
messages.zh: 你很有自制力。这可不容易。
messages.en: You showed a lot of self-control. It was not easy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象生气时先停一拍再开口：行为上是“表现克制”，这种表现叫“克制”，支撑它的能力叫“自制力”；按词性分别记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To restrain or control a person, an action, an emotion, or an impulse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对人、行为、情绪或冲动施加约束，使其受到控制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżomm persuna, azzjoni, emozzjoni jew xewqa taħt kontroll.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 约束；抑制；阻止某人或某种冲动任意发展。
控制；使行为、情绪或情况保持在掌握之中。
约束并控制；使某人或某事受到限制。

collocations.zh: 他控制住了自己的怒气

formal.mt: Minkejja l-kritika qawwija, id-direttur rażżan ir-rabja tiegħu u wieġeb bil-kalma.
formal.en: Despite the strong criticism, the director controlled his anger and replied calmly.
formal.zh: 尽管受到严厉批评，主管仍控制住怒气，平静地作了回应。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma weġibtx mill-ewwel? | Toni: Rażżant lili nnifsi għax kont irrabjat. Ridt nikkalma l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you not answer straight away? | Toni: I held myself back because I was angry. I wanted to calm down first.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你为什么没有马上回答？ | 托尼：我当时很生气，所以克制住了自己。我想先冷静下来。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么没有马上回答？
messages.en: Why did you not answer straight away?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rażżant lili nnifsi għax kont irrabjat. Ridt nikkalma l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Rażżant lili nnifsi għax kont irrabjat. Ridt nikkalma l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 我当时很生气，所以克制住了自己。我想先冷静下来。
messages.en: I held myself back because I was angry. I wanted to calm down first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习时给这个动词配一个明确对象：控制怒气、约束自己、收敛热情。把“控制住什么”一起记，比只背中文释义更牢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A steep rock face or a place where the ground drops sharply.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 陡峭的岩壁或地面骤然下落的地方，常指悬崖、峭壁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wiċċ wieqaf ħafna tal-blat jew post fejn l-art tinżel f'daqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悬崖；峭壁。
陡崖；险峻的悬崖。
深谷；两侧陡峭的狭谷。
悬崖；垂直或接近垂直的岩壁。

formal.mt: Il-mogħdija tgħaddi qrib irdum għoli li jħares fuq il-baħar.
formal.en: The path passes near a high cliff overlooking the sea.
formal.zh: 这条小径经过一处俯瞰大海的高崖附近。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nistgħu nieħdu ritratt hawn? Mark: Iva, imma ejja nibqgħu 'l bogħod minn tarf l-irdum.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can we take a photo here? Mark: Yes, but let's stay away from the edge of the cliff.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们可以在这里拍张照吗？马克：可以，不过我们离悬崖边远一点吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 我们可以在这里拍张照吗？
messages.en: Can we take a photo here?

messages.speaker: Mark (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ejja nibqgħu 'l bogħod minn tarf l-irdum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ejja nibqgħu 'l bogħod minn tarf l-irdum.
messages.zh: 可以，不过我们离悬崖边远一点吧。
messages.en: Yes, but let's stay away from the edge of the cliff.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rdum 配上一幅地面突然向下折落的图：看岩壁记悬崖，看陡壁之间的低处记深谷。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male monarch who rules a kingdom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 统治一个王国的男性君主，即国王。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Monarka raġel li jsaltan fuq renju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 国王；男性君主。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-re stieden lir-rappreżentanti tal-irħula fil-palazz tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the king invited the village representatives to his palace.
formal.zh: 故事中，国王邀请各村代表到他的宫殿。

colloquial.mt: Mia: Min hu dak bil-kuruna fl-istampa? Omm: Dak hu r-re tal-istorja.
colloquial.en: Mia: Who's that wearing a crown in the picture? Mum: That's the king in the story.
colloquial.zh: 米娅：图里那个戴王冠的人是谁？妈妈：那是故事里的国王。

messages.speaker: Mia (女儿)
messages.zh: 图里那个戴王冠的人是谁？
messages.en: Who's that wearing a crown in the picture?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 那是故事里的国王。
messages.en: That's the king in the story.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给短词 re 配一个鲜明形象：戴王冠、住宫殿的国王；再连读 ir-re，记住句中常见的带冠词形式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A response to something that happens, or a chemical change involving substances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对发生的事情作出的回应或表现，也可指物质之间发生的化学反应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tweġiba jew bidla fl-imġiba wara xi ħaġa li tiġri, jew bidla kimika bejn sustanzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反应；对事件或刺激的回应，也可指化学反应。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi r-reazzjoni tal-istudenti għall-metodu l-ġdid tat-tagħlim.
formal.en: The report describes the students' reaction to the new teaching method.
formal.zh: 报告描述了学生对新教学方法的反应。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'kienet ir-reazzjoni ta' ommok meta rat ir-rigal? Maja: Tbissmet u għannqitni!
colloquial.en: Sara: What was your mum's reaction when she saw the present? Maja: She smiled and hugged me!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你妈妈看到礼物时是什么反应？玛雅：她笑了，还抱了我！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'kienet ir-reazzjoni ta' ommok meta rat ir-rigal?
messages.mt_standard: X'kienet ir-reazzjoni ta' ommok meta rat ir-rigal?
messages.zh: 你妈妈看到礼物时是什么反应？
messages.en: What was your mum's reaction when she saw the present?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 她笑了，还抱了我！
messages.en: She smiled and hugged me!

cognitive_memory_aid: 按先后顺序记忆：先发生一件事，再出现 reazzjoni；收到礼物后的笑容和实验中的变化都可叫反应。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To win a contest or gain something through success, or to defeat or overcome an opponent or difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在比赛中获胜或通过成功取得某物，也可指击败对手、克服困难。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Toħroġ rebbieħ f'kompetizzjoni jew tikseb xi ħaġa bis-suċċess, jew tegħleb avversarju jew diffikultà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 获胜；赢得比赛、奖项等。
征服；攻克。
在比赛或较量中击败。
打败；战胜。
克服困难或障碍；战胜。
制服；使对方屈服。
在比赛或较量中大败对手。
彻底击败；征服。
彻底战胜；征服。
击败；战胜对手。
把某事转化为对自己有利的条件；加以利用而获益。
争取到某人的支持；说服或打动某人。

formal.mt: It-tim rebaħ il-finali wara xhur ta' taħriġ intensiv.
formal.en: The team won the final after months of intensive training.
formal.zh: 经过数月的高强度训练，这支队伍赢得了决赛。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min rebaħ il-logħba tal-bieraħ? Pawlu: It-tim tagħna! Skurjajna fl-aħħar minuta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who won yesterday's game? Pawlu: Our team! We scored in the last minute.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：昨天的比赛谁赢了？保罗：我们队！我们在最后一分钟进球了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天的比赛谁赢了？
messages.en: Who won yesterday's game?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (队员)
messages.zh: 我们队！我们在最后一分钟进球了。
messages.en: Our team! We scored in the last minute.

cognitive_memory_aid: 围绕一个赢字建立记忆网：赢比赛、战胜对手、克服困难、赢得支持；再用宾语判断 rebaħ 的具体意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause or enable someone or a team to win.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人或某支队伍获胜；促成胜利。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel li xi ħadd jew tim joħroġ rebbieħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使获胜；促使某人或某队赢得胜利。

collocations.en: won the game for the team

formal.mt: Il-gowl fl-aħħar minuta rebbaħ il-logħba lit-tim.
formal.en: The goal in the last minute won the game for the team.
formal.zh: 最后一分钟的进球帮助这支队伍赢得了比赛。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min rebbaħ il-logħba lit-tim? Mark: Pawlu, bil-gowl tiegħu fl-aħħar minuta!
colloquial.en: Sara: Who won the game for the team? Mark: Pawlu, with his goal in the last minute!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：是谁帮助球队赢了比赛？马克：保罗，他在最后一分钟进了球！

messages.speaker: Sara (球迷)
messages.zh: 是谁帮助球队赢了比赛？
messages.en: Who won the game for the team?

messages.speaker: Mark (球迷)
messages.zh: 保罗，他在最后一分钟进了球！
messages.en: Pawlu, with his goal in the last minute!

cognitive_memory_aid: 成对记句子：rebaħ 是队伍赢了，rebbaħ 是某个进球使队伍赢了；把双写的 b 当作提醒自己补上使字的记忆标记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The season between winter and summer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 冬季之后、夏季之前的季节，即春天。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istaġun bejn ix-xitwa u s-sajf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 春天；春季。
春季，指冬季与夏季之间的季节。

formal.mt: Fir-rebbiegħa, l-istudenti josservaw il-pjanti fil-ġnien tal-iskola.
formal.en: In spring, the students observe the plants in the school garden.
formal.zh: 春天，学生们观察学校花园里的植物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema staġun jogħġbok l-aktar? Lara: Ir-rebbiegħa, għax inħobb il-fjuri.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which season do you like best? Lara: Spring, because I love flowers.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你最喜欢哪个季节？拉拉：春天，因为我喜欢花。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你最喜欢哪个季节？
messages.en: Which season do you like best?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 春天，因为我喜欢花。
messages.en: Spring, because I love flowers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rebbiegħa 与春天花开的画面绑定，再连读 fir-rebbiegħa，记住“在春天”的完整表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who wins a competition or achieves success.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在比赛中获胜或取得成功的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tirbaħ kompetizzjoni jew tikseb suċċess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 获胜者；赢家。
成功者；取得成功的人。
征服者；战胜他人或敌对势力的人。

formal.mt: Ir-rebbieħ tal-kompetizzjoni se jirċievi l-premju waqt iċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: The winner of the competition will receive the prize during the ceremony.
formal.zh: 比赛的获胜者将在典礼上领奖。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu r-rebbieħ tal-kompetizzjoni? Mark: Pawlu! Kien kuntent ħafna meta sema' ismu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is the winner of the competition? Mark: Pawlu! He was very happy when he heard his name.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：比赛的获胜者是谁？马克：保罗！他听到自己的名字时特别高兴。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 比赛的获胜者是谁？
messages.en: Who is the winner of the competition?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu! Kien kuntent ħafna meta sema' ismu.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu! Kien kuntent ħafna meta sema' ismu.
messages.zh: 保罗！他听到自己的名字时特别高兴。
messages.en: Pawlu! He was very happy when he heard his name.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象领奖台上的那个人，把 rebbieħ 记成“赢家本人”；与表示“胜利”的 rebħa 配对区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Success in winning a game, competition, or struggle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在比赛、竞争或斗争中战胜对手所取得的胜利。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Suċċess miksub meta wieħed jirbaħ logħba, kompetizzjoni jew taqbida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大获全胜；凯旋；重大成功。
胜利；获胜。

formal.mt: It-tim kiseb rebħa importanti fl-aħħar logħba tal-istaġun.
formal.en: The team achieved an important victory in the final game of the season.
formal.zh: 球队在本赛季的最后一场比赛中取得了一场重要的胜利。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif marret il-logħba? Lara: Ksibna rebħa! Illejla se niċċelebraw.
colloquial.en: Mark: How did the game go? Lara: We won! Tonight we are going to celebrate.
colloquial.zh: 马克：比赛怎么样？拉拉：我们赢了！今晚要庆祝一下。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 比赛怎么样？
messages.en: How did the game go?

messages.speaker: Lara (队员)
messages.zh: 我们赢了！今晚要庆祝一下。
messages.en: We won! Tonight we are going to celebrate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rebħa 放在比赛结束的庆祝画面里：它指“胜利这个结果”，rebbieħ 则指“获胜的那个人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spin cotton or other fibres into thread; also, to talk excessively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将棉花等纤维纺成线；也可表示说话过多、喋喋不休。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħajt mill-qoton jew minn fibri oħra; ukoll, jitkellem iżżejjed.

sense_translations.en_definition: to spin (used of cotton and other thread)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 纺线；用于棉线及其他线的纺制。
说话过多；喋喋不休。

sense_translations.en_definition: to spin cotton on a spindle
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用纺锤纺棉线。

formal.mt: Waqt id-dimostrazzjoni, l-artiġjan redden il-qoton biex juri kif isir il-ħajt.
formal.en: During the demonstration, the artisan spun cotton to show how thread is made.
formal.zh: 在演示过程中，工匠纺棉线，展示线是如何制成的。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu għadu jitkellem? Mark: Iva, ilu jredden għal siegħa!
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Pawlu still talking? Mark: Yes, he has been going on for an hour!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗还在说吗？马克：是啊，他已经絮叨一个小时了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗还在说吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu still talking?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，他已经絮叨一个小时了！
messages.en: Yes, he has been going on for an hour!

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习时并排想象两个画面：手里不停纺线，嘴里不停说话；用这组画面记住 redden 的两个用法，不把联想当作词源。

gloss_zh: 举起；提高；收存；另有依语境而定的义项

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lift or raise something, or to put it away for later use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某物举起或提高，也可指把东西收起来留待以后使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għolla xi ħaġa jew poġġieha f'post biex tintuża aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 举起；提起。
抬高；提高。
收起；妥善放好。
储存以备将来使用。
举起；抬起；升高。
用力举起；费力抬起。
储存；存放。
尊崇；颂扬；抬高地位。
绝经；进入停经阶段。
试图打某人；作势要打某人。
停止做某事。
救助某人；使某人脱险。
试图发生性行为。

collocations.en: he put the books away in the cupboard

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem refa' l-kaxxa b'attenzjoni u poġġieha fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: The worker lifted the box carefully and placed it on the table.
formal.zh: 工人小心地举起箱子，把它放在桌上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min refa' l-kaxxa fuq l-ixkaffa? Mark: Pawlu refa' l-kaxxa dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who lifted the box onto the shelf? Mark: Pawlu lifted the box this morning.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁把箱子搬到架子上了？马克：保罗今天早上搬上去的。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 谁把箱子搬到架子上了？
messages.en: Who lifted the box onto the shelf?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗今天早上搬上去的。
messages.en: Pawlu lifted the box this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“举起箱子”和“把书收进柜子”记牢 refa' 的常用义；其余义项逐个配语境学习，不凭“举起”硬猜。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vote in which the electorate decides directly on a specific public question or proposal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由选民直接就某一公共议题或提案作出决定的投票。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vot li fih l-elettorat jiddeċiedi direttament dwar kwistjoni jew proposta partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公民投票；由选民直接表决某项议题的全民公决。

formal.mt: Ir-riżultat tar-referendum tħabbar wara li ngħaddu l-voti kollha.
formal.en: The result of the referendum was announced after all the votes had been counted.
formal.zh: 所有选票清点完毕后，公民投票的结果得以公布。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tivvota fir-referendum? Mark: Iva, imma l-ewwel irrid naqra aktar dwar il-proposta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to vote in the referendum? Mark: Yes, but first I want to read more about the proposal.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你会参加这次公民投票吗？马克：会，但我想先多了解一下这项提案。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你会参加这次公民投票吗？
messages.en: Are you going to vote in the referendum?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-ewwel irrid naqra aktar dwar il-proposta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-ewwel irrid naqra aktar dwar il-proposta.
messages.zh: 会，但我想先多了解一下这项提案。
messages.en: Yes, but first I want to read more about the proposal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 referendum 就想象选民围绕同一项提案投票，再用“议题、选票、结果”三个画面串起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who applies the rules during a sporting contest; also, a person who writes a reference for someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在体育比赛中执行规则的裁判；也可指为他人撰写推荐信的推荐人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tapplika r-regoli waqt logħba sportiva; ukoll, persuna li tikteb ittra ta' referenza għal xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体育比赛的裁判。
裁判；如网球、板球等运动中的裁判。

sense_translations.en_definition: referee (person who writes a letter of reference)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 推荐人；为他人撰写推荐信的人。

formal.mt: L-applikant għandu jagħti l-isem ta' referì li jista' jikteb ittra ta' referenza.
formal.en: The applicant should provide the name of a referee who can write a letter of reference.
formal.zh: 申请人应提供一位能够撰写推荐信的推荐人的姓名。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex waqfet il-logħba? Lara: Ir-referì ra plejer imweġġa' u waqqaf il-logħba.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why has the game stopped? Lara: The referee saw an injured player and stopped the game.
colloquial.zh: 马克：比赛怎么停了？拉拉：裁判看到有球员受伤，就暂停了比赛。

messages.speaker: Mark (球迷)
messages.zh: 比赛怎么停了？
messages.en: Why has the game stopped?

messages.speaker: Lara (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-referì ra plejer imweġġa' u waqqaf il-logħba.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-referì ra plejer imweġġa' u waqqaf il-logħba.
messages.zh: 裁判看到有球员受伤，就暂停了比赛。
messages.en: The referee saw an injured player and stopped the game.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 referì 配两张人物卡：球场上执裁的人、申请中写推荐信的人；靠“比赛”或“推荐信”的语境选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instruction or principle that states what is allowed, required, or normally done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说明什么可以做、必须做或通常应怎样做的规则、规定或原则。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Istruzzjoni jew prinċipju li jgħid x'inhu permess, x'għandu jsir jew kif normalment wieħed għandu jaġixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 规则；规定某种活动应如何进行的要求
规定；管理某种行为或活动的具体要求
规则、规范、行为准则、原则或指令

formal.mt: Skont ir-regola tal-librerija, kull qarrej għandu jirritorna l-kotba sad-data indikata.
formal.en: Under the library's rule, every reader must return books by the indicated date.
formal.zh: 根据图书馆的规定，每位读者都必须在指定日期之前归还图书。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi r-regola ta' din il-logħba? Mark: Kull wieħed jiġbed karta u jistenna sakemm imissu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's the rule for this game? Mark: Each person draws a card and waits for their turn.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个游戏的规则是什么？Mark：每人抽一张牌，然后等轮到自己。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个游戏的规则是什么？
messages.en: What's the rule for this game?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kull wieħed jiġbed karta u jistenna sakemm imissu.
messages.mt_standard: Kull wieħed jiġbed karta u jistenna sakemm imissu.
messages.zh: 每人抽一张牌，然后等轮到自己。
messages.en: Each person draws a card and waits for their turn.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象游戏盒里写着一条 regola：轮到你才行动。把这个词和具体的行为要求联系起来，也可延伸记作一般准则。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official rule or set of rules governing an activity, organization, or place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于管理某项活动、机构或场所的正式规定，或一套规章。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Regola uffiċjali jew ġabra ta' regoli li jirregolaw attività, organizzazzjoni jew post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 规章；条例；正式制定的管理规定
规章；规则；约束某项活动或行为的规定

formal.mt: Ir-regolament tal-kompetizzjoni jispeċifika min jista' jipparteċipa u meta għandhom jintbagħtu l-applikazzjonijiet.
formal.en: The competition regulations specify who may participate and when applications must be submitted.
formal.zh: 竞赛规章明确规定了参赛资格和申请提交时间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' ndaħħal ir-rota fil-bitħa tal-iskola? Ben: Ejja niċċekkjaw ir-regolament tal-iskola biex inkunu ċerti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I bring my bicycle into the schoolyard? Ben: Let's check the school regulations to make sure.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我能把自行车带进学校院子吗？Ben：我们查一下学校规章，确认一下吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 我能把自行车带进学校院子吗？
messages.en: Can I bring my bicycle into the schoolyard?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja niċċekkjaw ir-regolament tal-iskola biex inkunu ċerti.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja niċċekkjaw ir-regolament tal-iskola biex inkunu ċerti.
messages.zh: 我们查一下学校规章，确认一下吧。
messages.en: Let's check the school regulations to make sure.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 regolament 想成学校或比赛发出的正式规章文件；和 regola 一起记忆时，前者常让人联想到成套的管理规定。

gloss_zh: 有规律的；定期的；定期地

teaching_sense.en_definition: Happening at consistent intervals or following a consistent pattern.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按较稳定的时间间隔发生，或遵循稳定规律的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jseħħ f'intervalli ta' żmien konsistenti jew isegwi ritmu stabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有规律的；定期的；按稳定节奏发生的
有规律地；定期地；经常地

formal.mt: Il-kumitat jorganizza laqgħat regolari biex jevalwa l-progress tal-proġett.
formal.en: The committee organizes regular meetings to assess the project's progress.
formal.zh: 委员会定期组织会议，以评估项目进展。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Hemm servizz regolari tal-karozzi tal-linja minn hawn? David: Iva, tgħaddi karozza tal-linja kull għoxrin minuta.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is there a regular bus service from here? David: Yes, a bus comes every twenty minutes.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这里有定时运行的公交车吗？David：有，每二十分钟来一班。

messages.speaker: Nina (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm servizz regolari tal-karozzi tal-linja minn hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm servizz regolari tal-karozzi tal-linja minn hawn?
messages.zh: 这里有定时运行的公交车吗？
messages.en: Is there a regular bus service from here?

messages.speaker: David (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tgħaddi karozza tal-linja kull għoxrin minuta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tgħaddi karozza tal-linja kull għoxrin minuta.
messages.zh: 有，每二十分钟来一班。
messages.en: Yes, a bus comes every twenty minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一排间隔相等的小点来记 regolari；修饰服务或会议时理解为有规律的，作副词时则理解为有规律地。

gloss_zh: 定期地；有规律地；经常地

teaching_sense.en_definition: At regular intervals or repeatedly as part of a usual routine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按固定或较稳定的间隔，或作为日常习惯反复进行地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'intervalli ta' żmien regolari jew ripetutament bħala parti minn rutina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 定期地；有规律地；作为习惯经常地

formal.mt: Il-persunal jiċċekkja regolarment it-tagħmir biex jiżgura li jaħdem sew.
formal.en: The staff regularly check the equipment to ensure that it works properly.
formal.zh: 工作人员定期检查设备，以确保其正常运作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek tmur il-librerija regolarment? Mark: Iva, immur kull nhar ta' Sibt u nissellef ktieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you still go to the library regularly? Mark: Yes, I go every Saturday and borrow a book.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你还经常去图书馆吗？Mark：是啊，我每周六都去借一本书。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还经常去图书馆吗？
messages.en: Do you still go to the library regularly?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, immur kull nhar ta' Sibt u nissellef ktieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, immur kull nhar ta' Sibt u nissellef ktieb.
messages.zh: 是啊，我每周六都去借一本书。
messages.en: Yes, I go every Saturday and borrow a book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历的每个星期六画一本书，用 regolarment 描述反复发生的阅读行动；记住它说明动作发生的规律或频率。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device or mechanism that controls a quantity such as pressure, flow, or temperature.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 控制压力、流量或温度等数值的设备或机械装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat jew mekkaniżmu li jikkontrolla kwantità bħall-pressjoni, il-fluss jew it-temperatura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 调节器；用于控制或维持某种状态、数值的装置

sense_translations.en_definition: regulating mechanism (e.g. for the flow of gas from a cylinder)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 调节机构，例如控制气瓶输出气体流量的装置

formal.mt: Ir-regolatur tal-pressjoni jikkontrolla l-pressjoni tal-gass li joħroġ miċ-ċilindru.
formal.en: The pressure regulator controls the pressure of the gas leaving the cylinder.
formal.zh: 压力调节器控制从气瓶输出的气体压力。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan ir-regolatur jikkontrolla t-temperatura? Ben: Iva, bih tista' tagħżel it-temperatura li trid.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this regulator control the temperature? Ben: Yes, you can use it to select the temperature you want.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个调节器是控制温度的吗？Ben：对，你可以用它选择所需的温度。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个调节器是控制温度的吗？
messages.en: Does this regulator control the temperature?

messages.speaker: Ben (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bih tista' tagħżel it-temperatura li trid.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bih tista' tagħżel it-temperatura li trid.
messages.zh: 对，你可以用它选择所需的温度。
messages.en: Yes, you can use it to select the temperature you want.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个标着 regolatur 的控制旋钮，旁边连着压力表或温度显示；用它调节数值的画面来记住调节器。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An excessive desire to possess more, or an unwillingness to share or spend what one has.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 过度想要占有更多东西的贪欲，也可指不愿分享或花费已有财物的吝啬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa żejda li wieħed ikollu aktar, jew nuqqas ta' rieda li jaqsam ma' ħaddieħor jew jonfoq minn dak li għandu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对钱财的贪欲；贪财。
吝啬；不愿花钱或与别人分享财物。
贪婪、贪财或吝啬，侧重想要占有财物的欲望。

formal.mt: Ir-regħba għall-flus tista' twassal biex persuna tittratta lil ħaddieħor b'mod inġust.
formal.en: Greed for money can lead a person to treat others unfairly.
formal.zh: 对金钱的贪欲可能使人不公平地对待别人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħa l-gallettini kollha għalih? Lara: Minħabba r-regħba; ma ħalla xejn għalina.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did he take all the biscuits for himself? Lara: Because of greed; he left nothing for us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他为什么把饼干全拿走了？拉拉：因为贪心；他一点也没给我们留。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么把饼干全拿走了？
messages.en: Why did he take all the biscuits for himself?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba r-regħba; ma ħalla xejn għalina.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba r-regħba; ma ħalla xejn għalina.
messages.zh: 因为贪心；他一点也没给我们留。
messages.en: Because of greed; he left nothing for us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 regħba 联想到一只只进不出的存钱罐：拼命想多占一点是贪婪，舍不得拿出来分享是吝啬。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To desire more possessions excessively, or to be or become greedy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 过度贪求更多财物，或处于、变成贪婪的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jixtieq ikollu aktar milli jeħtieġ, jew ikun jew isir rgħib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 觊觎；强烈贪求某物。
贪婪；贪得无厌。
处于贪婪的状态，或变得贪婪。

formal.mt: Pawlu regħeb għal aktar flus, għalkemm diġà kellu biżżejjed biex jgħix komdu.
formal.en: Pawlu coveted more money, although he already had enough to live comfortably.
formal.zh: 保罗虽然已经有足够的钱过舒适生活，却仍贪求更多钱财。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Pawlu ħa l-aħħar biċċa wkoll? Maja: Regħeb għal aktar u ma ħalla xejn għalina.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Pawlu take the last piece as well? Maja: He greedily wanted more and left nothing for us.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗为什么连最后一块也拿走了？玛雅：他贪心地想要更多，一点也没给我们留。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu ħa l-aħħar biċċa wkoll?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu ħa l-aħħar biċċa wkoll?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么连最后一块也拿走了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu take the last piece as well?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Regħeb għal aktar u ma ħalla xejn għalina.
messages.mt_standard: Regħeb għal aktar u ma ħalla xejn għalina.
messages.zh: 他贪心地想要更多，一点也没给我们留。
messages.en: He greedily wanted more and left nothing for us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 regħeb 记成“手里已经有了，眼睛还盯着更多”的动作或状态；与表示贪欲的名词 regħba 对照记忆。

gloss_zh: 脸红；害羞；感到羞愧或尴尬

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become red in the face, or to feel ashamed or embarrassed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脸部变红，或感到羞愧、害羞或尴尬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aħmar f'wiċċu, jew iħoss mistħija jew imbarazzament.

sense_translations.en_definition: to go red in the face
sense_translations.zh_definition: 脸部变红；涨红了脸。

sense_translations.en_definition: to blush (become red in the face)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 脸红，指脸部泛红。
感到羞愧或尴尬。

formal.mt: L-istudent regħex bil-mistħija meta l-għalliem faħħru quddiem il-klassi kollha.
formal.en: The student blushed with embarrassment when the teacher praised him in front of the whole class.
formal.zh: 老师当着全班的面表扬那名学生时，他害羞得脸红了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt lil Mark meta faħħruh? Maja: Iva, regħex mill-ewwel; ma kienx qed jistenna dak il-kliem.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see Mark when they praised him? Maja: Yes, he blushed straight away; he wasn't expecting those words.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他们表扬马克时，你看到他的样子了吗？玛雅：看到了，他一下就脸红了；他没想到会听到那些话。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 他们表扬马克时，你看到他的样子了吗？
messages.en: Did you see Mark when they praised him?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, regħex mill-ewwel; ma kienx qed jistenna dak il-kliem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, regħex mill-ewwel; ma kienx qed jistenna dak il-kliem.
messages.zh: 看到了，他一下就脸红了；他没想到会听到那些话。
messages.en: Yes, he blushed straight away; he wasn't expecting those words.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 regħex 时想象突然被全班注视，脸颊一下变红：既记住外在的脸红，也记住内心的害羞或尴尬。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A blush, blushing, or a feeling of shame; the word can also mean a shock.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脸红这一表现或过程，也可表示羞愧或震惊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħmura fil-wiċċ jew sens ta' mistħija; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll xokk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 震惊；受到惊动时的强烈感受。
动词 regħex 的动名词，表示脸红或感到羞愧、尴尬这一过程或状态。
脸上的红晕；脸红这一表现或过程。
羞愧；羞耻感。

collocations.zh: 因害羞或尴尬而泛起的红晕

formal.mt: Ir-regħxa f'wiċċ l-istudent kienet tidher ċara meta ssemma ismu waqt iċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: The blush on the student's face was clearly visible when his name was mentioned during the ceremony.
formal.zh: 典礼上提到那名学生的名字时，他脸上的红晕十分明显。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tgħatti wiċċek? Mark: Għandi regħxa ta' mistħija; kulħadd sema' l-iżball li għamilt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you covering your face? Mark: I'm blushing with embarrassment; everyone heard the mistake I made.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么捂着脸？马克：我尴尬得脸都红了；大家都听到了我犯的错。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么捂着脸？
messages.en: Why are you covering your face?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi regħxa ta' mistħija; kulħadd sema' l-iżball li għamilt.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi regħxa ta' mistħija; kulħadd sema' l-iżball li għamilt.
messages.zh: 我尴尬得脸都红了；大家都听到了我犯的错。
messages.en: I'm blushing with embarrassment; everyone heard the mistake I made.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 regħex 的“脸红了”定格成一张照片，照片里的红晕就是名词 regħxa；另用“突然受到震惊”的画面单独记住其震惊义。

gloss_zh: 用唾液润湿；给人吃东西，尤指空腹时

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wet something with saliva, or to give someone food, especially when their stomach is empty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用唾液润湿某物；也可指给人吃东西，尤其是在对方空腹时。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ixarrab xi ħaġa bir-rieq, jew jagħti lil xi ħadd x'jiekol, speċjalment fuq stonku vojt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用自己的唾液润湿某物。
给某人吃东西；喂某人。

sense_translations.en_definition: to feed someone (especially on an empty stomach)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给某人吃东西，尤其指让空腹的人进食。
用唾液润湿。

collocations.en: gave the boy something to eat
moistened the end of the thread with saliva

formal.mt: Qabel il-vjaġġ, il-missier rejjaq lit-tifel biex ma jitlaqx fuq stonku vojt.
formal.en: Before the journey, the father gave the boy something to eat so that he would not leave on an empty stomach.
formal.zh: 出发前，父亲给男孩吃了点东西，免得他空着肚子上路。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min rejjaq lit-tifel dalgħodu? Pawlu: In-nanna; tatu ftit ħobż u ħalib qabel l-iskola.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who gave the boy something to eat this morning? Pawlu: His grandmother; she gave him some bread and milk before school.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：今天早上谁给孩子吃东西了？保罗：他奶奶；上学前她给了他一些面包和牛奶。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 今天早上谁给孩子吃东西了？
messages.en: Who gave the boy something to eat this morning?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nanna; tatu ftit ħobż u ħalib qabel l-iskola.
messages.mt_standard: In-nanna; tatu ftit ħobż u ħalib qabel l-iskola.
messages.zh: 他奶奶；上学前她给了他一些面包和牛奶。
messages.en: His grandmother; she gave him some bread and milk before school.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 rejjaq 建两张记忆卡：一张画用唾液润湿线头，另一张画给空腹的孩子吃面包；分别练习，记清两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give off an unpleasant smell or to be smelly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 散发难闻的气味，或处于发臭、有臭味的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ riħa ħażina jew ikollu riħa ħażina.

sense_translations.en_definition: to give off a bad smell
sense_translations.zh_definition: 散发难闻的气味；发出臭味。
有臭味；处于发臭的状态。

collocations.en: the fish gave off a bad smell
gave off a very bad smell

formal.mt: Il-ħut rejjaħ wara li tħalla barra mill-friġġ għal żmien twil.
formal.en: The fish gave off a bad smell after being left out of the refrigerator for a long time.
formal.zh: 鱼在冰箱外放了很久后，散发出了臭味。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn ġejja din ir-riħa ħażina? Mark: L-iskart rejjaħ; se noħorġu issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is this bad smell coming from? Mark: The rubbish has started to smell; I'll take it out now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这股臭味是从哪儿来的？马克：垃圾发臭了；我现在就把它拿出去。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġejja din ir-riħa ħażina?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġejja din ir-riħa ħażina?
messages.zh: 这股臭味是从哪儿来的？
messages.en: Where is this bad smell coming from?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 垃圾发臭了；我现在就把它拿出去。
messages.en: The rubbish has started to smell; I'll take it out now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rejjaħ 配上“闻到垃圾臭味便捏住鼻子”的画面，直接记住它描述散发臭味或有臭味的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A written account of information, or the best result recorded in a particular activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 保存信息的记录，也指某项活动中有记载的最佳成绩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħrif miżmum bil-miktub, jew l-aħjar riżultat irreġistrat f'attività partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 记录；记载。
纪录；有记录以来的最佳数值或成绩。

formal.mt: L-atleta kiser ir-rekord nazzjonali fit-tellieqa tal-mitt metru.
formal.en: The athlete broke the national record in the hundred-metre race.
formal.zh: 这名运动员打破了百米赛跑的全国纪录。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandek rekord tal-ispejjeż ta' dan ix-xahar? Mark: Iva, ktibt kollox f'dan in-notebook.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do you have a record of this month's expenses? Mark: Yes, I wrote everything in this notebook.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你有这个月的开支记录吗？马克：有，我把所有开支都记在这个笔记本里了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek rekord tal-ispejjeż ta' dan ix-xahar?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek rekord tal-ispejjeż ta' dan ix-xahar?
messages.zh: 你有这个月的开支记录吗？
messages.en: Do you have a record of this month's expenses?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，我把所有开支都记在这个笔记本里了。
messages.en: Yes, I wrote everything in this notebook.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 rekord 配两个学习画面：账本里保存“记录”，跑道上打破“纪录”；根据语境选择中文写法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A connection between people or things, including the way people relate to one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人与人或事物之间的关系，包括人们彼此相处和联系的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rabta bejn persuni jew affarijiet, inkluż il-mod kif il-persuni jġibu ruħhom ma' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 关系；联系。
关系；彼此联系或相处的状态。
人与人之间的关系；人际关系。
事物之间的关联或联系。

collocations.en: a good relationship with the neighbours
the relationship between cause and effect
collocations.zh: 原因与结果之间的关系

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina r-relazzjoni bejn l-irqad u l-memorja.
formal.en: The study examines the relationship between sleep and memory.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察睡眠与记忆之间的关系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek relazzjoni tajba mal-ġirien? Pawlu: Iva, nitkellmu kuljum u ngħinu lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a good relationship with the neighbours? Pawlu: Yes, we talk every day and help one another.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你和邻居关系好吗？保罗：好，我们每天聊天，也互相帮助。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你和邻居关系好吗？
messages.en: Do you have a good relationship with the neighbours?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nitkellmu kuljum u ngħinu lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nitkellmu kuljum u ngħinu lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 好，我们每天聊天，也互相帮助。
messages.en: Yes, we talk every day and help one another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 relazzjoni 想成连接两端的一条线：连接两个人是人际关系，连接两件事是事物关联。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A system of beliefs and practices concerning God, gods, or what is considered sacred.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围绕神、诸神或被视为神圣的事物形成的一套信仰与实践体系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema ta' twemmin u prattiki marbuta ma' Alla, ma' allat jew ma' dak li jitqies sagru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宗教；包含信仰、仪式及相关实践的体系。

formal.mt: Il-kors jintroduċi lill-istudenti għall-istudju tar-reliġjon u tar-rwol tagħha fis-soċjetà.
formal.en: The course introduces students to the study of religion and its role in society.
formal.zh: 这门课程引导学生研究宗教及其在社会中的作用。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fuq xiex qed taqra? Daniel: Fuq ir-reliġjon; irrid nifhem aħjar it-twemmin ta' nies differenti.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you reading about? Daniel: Religion; I want to understand different people's beliefs better.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你在读哪方面的内容？丹尼尔：宗教；我想更好地了解不同人的信仰。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你在读哪方面的内容？
messages.en: What are you reading about?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq ir-reliġjon; irrid nifhem aħjar it-twemmin ta' nies differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq ir-reliġjon; irrid nifhem aħjar it-twemmin ta' nies differenti.
messages.zh: 宗教；我想更好地了解不同人的信仰。
messages.en: Religion; I want to understand different people's beliefs better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 reliġjon 时，在脑中并列放置信仰、仪式和神圣事物三个标签，合起来理解“宗教”。

gloss_zh: 宗教的；虔诚的；修会成员

teaching_sense.en_definition: Connected with religion, or showing strong religious belief and devotion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与宗教有关的，或具有坚定宗教信仰、表现虔诚的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut mar-reliġjon, jew li juri twemmin u devozzjoni qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宗教的；与宗教有关的；笃信宗教的，虔诚的。
修会成员；作为名词时指修士等加入修会的人。

formal.mt: Il-mużew jinkludi kollezzjoni ta' arti reliġjuża.
formal.en: The museum includes a collection of religious art.
formal.zh: 这座博物馆收藏了一批宗教艺术作品。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-ktieb għandu suġġett reliġjuż? Mark: Iva, jitkellem dwar it-twemmin u t-talb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this book have a religious subject? Mark: Yes, it discusses belief and prayer.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这本书的主题与宗教有关吗？马克：是的，它谈论信仰和祈祷。

messages.speaker: Lara (读者)
messages.zh: 这本书的主题与宗教有关吗？
messages.en: Does this book have a religious subject?

messages.speaker: Mark (图书管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jitkellem dwar it-twemmin u t-talb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jitkellem dwar it-twemmin u t-talb.
messages.zh: 是的，它谈论信仰和祈祷。
messages.en: Yes, it discusses belief and prayer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用搭配区分词性：reliġjuż 描述人或事物时是“宗教的、虔诚的”，单独指人时可表示“修会成员”。

gloss_zh: 扔掉；丢弃；忽视；流产；发出；鄙视；容纳大量人群；发芽

teaching_sense.en_definition: To get rid of something by throwing it away or discarding it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物扔掉或舍弃，不再保留。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Teħles minn xi ħaġa billi tarmiha jew ma tibqax iżżommha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扔掉；把不需要的东西丢弃。
舍弃；弃置，不再保留或使用。
忽视；疏于照顾或处理。
扔掉；丢弃；舍弃。
流产；妊娠未能继续至胎儿正常出生。
发出；散发；向外排放。
蔑视；鄙视；轻看。

sense_translations.en_definition: to contain a lot of people in an area
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某一区域内容纳大量人群。
发芽；萌发。

formal.mt: L-impjegat rema l-karti li ma kinux għadhom meħtieġa fil-kontenitur tar-riċiklaġġ.
formal.en: The employee threw the papers that were no longer needed into the recycling container.
formal.zh: 这名员工把不再需要的纸张扔进了回收容器。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn hi l-kaxxa l-qadima? Pawlu: Rmejtha għax kienet imqatta'.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is the old box? Pawlu: I threw it away because it was torn.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：那个旧盒子在哪里？保罗：我把它扔了，因为它破了。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 那个旧盒子在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the old box?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 我把它扔了，因为它破了。
messages.en: I threw it away because it was torn.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“他把旧物扔掉了”的画面记住 rema 的常用义；其他义分别配上具体语境，不要都硬译成“扔”。

gloss_zh: 旧建筑中的大房间；马车房

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large room in an old building, or a building used to house carriages.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 旧建筑中的宽大房间，也指存放马车的房屋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra kbira f'bini antik, jew bini fejn jinżammu l-karozzini.

sense_translations.en_definition: a big room in an old buiding
sense_translations.zh_definition: 旧建筑中的一间大房间。
马车房；用来停放马车的建筑。

collocations.en: the door of the coach house

formal.mt: Il-pjan ta' restawr jinkludi r-remissa u l-bieb il-kbir tagħha.
formal.en: The restoration plan includes the coach house and its large door.
formal.zh: 修复计划包括马车房及其大门。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn se nqiegħdu s-siġġijiet? Ġanni: Fir-remissa; hemm biżżejjed spazju.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where shall we put the chairs? Ġanni: In the large room in the old building; there is enough space.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：我们把椅子放在哪里？詹尼：放在旧楼的那间大房间里；那里空间够大。

messages.speaker: Marija (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 我们把椅子放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we put the chairs?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (活动助手)
messages.zh: 放在旧楼的那间大房间里；那里空间够大。
messages.en: In the large room in the old building; there is enough space.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象推开旧楼的一扇大门，里面空间宽敞，甚至能停马车；用这个场景记住 remissa 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country ruled by a king or queen, or the period during which a monarch rules.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由国王或女王统治的国家，也指某位君主的统治时期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż immexxi minn re jew reġina, jew il-perjodu li fih isaltan monarka.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 君主的统治时期；在位期间。
王国；由国王或女王统治的国家。
铼；一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi l-ħajja fil-belt matul ir-renju ta' dik ir-reġina.
formal.en: The document describes life in the city during that queen's reign.
formal.zh: 这份文献描述了那位女王统治期间的城市生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed taqra? Daniel: Ktieb dwar renju antik u n-nies li kienu jgħixu fih.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you reading? Daniel: A book about an ancient kingdom and the people who lived in it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在读什么？丹尼尔：一本讲述古代王国和当地居民的书。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你在读什么？
messages.en: What are you reading?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ktieb dwar renju antik u n-nies li kienu jgħixu fih.
messages.mt_standard: Ktieb dwar renju antik u n-nies li kienu jgħixu fih.
messages.zh: 一本讲述古代王国和当地居民的书。
messages.en: A book about an ancient kingdom and the people who lived in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 renju 画两张卡：地图表示“王国”，时间轴表示“统治时期”；化学语境中的“铼”另作一张卡记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state with no monarch, in which a president commonly serves as head of state.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不设君主的国家，通常由总统担任国家元首。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat mingħajr monarka, fejn normalment president ikun il-kap tal-istat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 共和国；实行共和政体的国家。

formal.mt: Il-kostituzzjoni tiddefinixxi l-pajjiż bħala repubblika.
formal.en: The constitution defines the country as a republic.
formal.zh: 宪法将这个国家界定为共和国。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser repubblika? Mark: Hija forma ta' stat mingħajr re jew reġina bħala kap tal-istat.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does republic mean? Mark: It is a form of state without a king or queen as head of state.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：共和国是什么意思？马克：这是一种不由国王或女王担任国家元首的国家形式。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 共和国是什么意思？
messages.en: What does republic mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija forma ta' stat mingħajr re jew reġina bħala kap tal-istat.
messages.mt_standard: Hija forma ta' stat mingħajr re jew reġina bħala kap tal-istat.
messages.zh: 这是一种不由国王或女王担任国家元首的国家形式。
messages.en: It is a form of state without a king or queen as head of state.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 repubblika 与“共和国总统”这个搭配一起记：想到国家元首的职位，便能联想到“共和国”的含义。
