teaching_sense.en_definition: A loss of body weight or a change towards being thinner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体重下降或身体逐渐变瘦的变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Telf ta' piż jew bidla li biha persuna ssir aktar rqiqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体重减轻；消瘦。

sense_translations.en_definition: to lose weight, to become thin
sense_translations.zh_definition: 体重下降；变瘦。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jsemmi reqq gradwali matul l-aħħar xahrejn.
formal.en: The medical report mentions gradual weight loss over the last two months.
formal.zh: 医疗报告提到，过去两个月里体重逐渐下降。

colloquial.mt: Marija: It-tabib semma r-reqq ta' missieri. Pawlu: Qed jgħid li tilef il-piż? Marija: Iva, hekk spjegah.
colloquial.en: Marija: The doctor mentioned my father's weight loss. Pawlu: Does he mean that he has lost weight? Marija: Yes, that is how he explained it.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：医生提到了我父亲的消瘦。保罗：他的意思是体重下降了吗？玛丽娅：对，他就是这样解释的。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 医生提到了我父亲的消瘦。
messages.en: The doctor mentioned my father's weight loss.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他的意思是体重下降了吗？
messages.en: Does he mean that he has lost weight?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，他就是这样解释的。
messages.en: Yes, that is how he explained it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 reqq 配上体重秤读数下降的画面：名词记“消瘦”，动词记“变瘦”，用词性区分状态变化的表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Careful attention to details and possible mistakes, sometimes involving caution or hesitation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对细节和可能的错误保持细致注意与谨慎，有时也指顾虑或迟疑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attenzjoni għad-dettalji u għall-iżbalji possibbli, xi drabi b'kawtela jew eżitazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谨慎；小心。
良心上的顾虑；因原则而产生的不安或迟疑。
犹豫；迟疑。
仔细审查；谨慎；精确细致。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat eżamina bir-reqqa kull proposta qabel ħa d-deċiżjoni finali.
formal.en: The committee carefully examined every proposal before making the final decision.
formal.zh: 委员会在作出最终决定前，仔细审查了每一项提案。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qrajt il-messaġġ tiegħi? Mark: Iva, qrajtu bir-reqqa. Il-ħin tal-laqgħa huwa ċar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you read my message? Mark: Yes, I read it carefully. The meeting time is clear.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你读了我的消息吗？马克：读了，我仔细看过。开会时间写得很清楚。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你读了我的消息吗？
messages.en: Did you read my message?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qrajtu bir-reqqa. Il-ħin tal-laqgħa huwa ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qrajtu bir-reqqa. Il-ħin tal-laqgħa huwa ċar.
messages.zh: 读了，我仔细看过。开会时间写得很清楚。
messages.en: Yes, I read it carefully. The meeting time is clear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿放大镜逐字核对文件，把 reqqa 记成“细心与谨慎”；整块记住 bir-reqqa，就是“仔细地”。

gloss_zh: 走近；靠近；参加考试；向某人自我介绍

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move closer to a person or place; in particular contexts, to sit an examination or introduce oneself to someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人或某处靠近；在特定语境中，也可表示参加考试或向某人自我介绍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jersaq eqreb lejn persuna jew post; f'kuntesti partikolari, jagħmel eżami jew jippreżenta ruħu lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 接近；走向。
靠近；来到较近的位置。
走近；接近。
走近某人；上前接触某人。
参加某项考试；应试。
向某人自我介绍。

formal.mt: L-istudent resaq lejn il-mejda u ta d-dokumenti lill-għalliem.
formal.en: The student approached the table and handed the documents to the teacher.
formal.zh: 学生走到桌子旁，把文件交给了老师。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex resaq Mark lejn it-tieqa? Pawlu: Ried jara min kien barra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark move towards the window? Pawlu: He wanted to see who was outside.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克为什么走到窗边去了？保罗：他想看看谁在外面。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么走到窗边去了？
messages.en: Why did Mark move towards the window?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他想看看谁在外面。
messages.en: He wanted to see who was outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 resaq 记成一个人向前走近的画面，再把 resaq għall-eżami 单独配上考生入场的画面，帮助区分常用义与考试义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who lives in a particular place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某个特定地方居住的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħix f'post partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 居民；在某地居住的人。

formal.mt: Kull resident tal-lokalità jista' jattendi l-laqgħa pubblika.
formal.en: Every resident of the locality may attend the public meeting.
formal.zh: 当地每位居民都可以参加这次公开会议。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Int resident hawn? Mark: Iva, noqgħod fit-triq ta' wara.
colloquial.en: Anna: Are you a resident here? Mark: Yes, I live on the next street.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你是这里的居民吗？马克：是的，我住在后面那条街。

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.zh: 你是这里的居民吗？
messages.en: Are you a resident here?

messages.speaker: Mark (居民)
messages.zh: 是的，我住在后面那条街。
messages.en: Yes, I live on the next street.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 resident 画一个站在自家门口的人，记住它回答“谁住在这里”，中心是居住的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of living in a place, or the home or address where someone lives.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某地居住的状态或居留身份，也指一个人的住所或居住地址。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li persuna tgħix f'post, jew id-dar jew l-indirizz fejn tgħix.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 居住；在某地居留的状态或身份。
住所；居所；定居地址。

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok ikteb l-indirizz ta' residenza tiegħek fil-formola.
formal.en: Please enter your residential address on the form.
formal.zh: 请在表格中填写你的居住地址。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'indirizz nikteb hawn? David: L-indirizz ta' residenza tiegħek, fejn toqgħod bħalissa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Which address should I write here? David: Your residential address, where you live now.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这里该填哪个地址？戴维：填你的居住地址，就是你现在住的地方。

messages.speaker: Marija (申请人)
messages.zh: 这里该填哪个地址？
messages.en: Which address should I write here?

messages.speaker: David (办事员)
messages.mt_spoken: L-indirizz ta' residenza tiegħek, fejn toqgħod bħalissa.
messages.mt_standard: L-indirizz ta' residenza tiegħek, fejn toqgħod bħalissa.
messages.zh: 填你的居住地址，就是你现在住的地方。
messages.en: Your residential address, where you live now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 residenza 放在地址表格旁边，记成“居住这件事或居住的地方”；与表示居住者的 resident 配对练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Reviewing material to learn it better, or examining and changing a text or other work to improve it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重新学习材料以巩固知识，或重新检查并修改文本等内容以加以改进。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Studju mill-ġdid biex wieħed isaħħaħ dak li tgħallem, jew eżami u tibdil ta' test jew xogħol biex jitjieb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 复习；修订；对已有内容的重新检查与修改。

formal.mt: Wara reviżjoni tat-test, l-awtur ikkoreġa l-iżbalji u ċċara l-ispjegazzjonijiet.
formal.en: After revising the text, the author corrected the errors and clarified the explanations.
formal.zh: 作者在修订文本后，改正了错误，并使解释更加清楚。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid tagħmel ftit reviżjoni miegħi? Mark: Iva, nibdew bil-kliem tal-lezzjoni tal-bieraħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like to do some revision with me? Mark: Yes, let's start with the words from yesterday's lesson.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你想和我一起复习一会儿吗？马克：好，我们先复习昨天课上的词。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你想和我一起复习一会儿吗？
messages.en: Would you like to do some revision with me?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 好，我们先复习昨天课上的词。
messages.en: Yes, let's start with the words from yesterday's lesson.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象再次打开笔记本：为了记牢知识是“复习”，为了改好文章是“修订”，两幅画面共同帮助记住 reviżjoni。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To do something again or to return to a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 再次做某件事，或返回某个地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel xi ħaġa għal darba oħra jew mar lura f'post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重复；再做一次。
重申；再次陈述。
再次进行；再次表演或执行。
返回；回去。
再做；重新做。
返回；回来。

formal.mt: L-għalliem reġa' spjega l-eżerċizzju biex l-istudenti jifhmu aħjar.
formal.en: The teacher explained the exercise again so that the students would understand better.
formal.zh: 老师再次讲解了这道练习，以便学生更好地理解。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu reġa' lura? Mark: Iva, u reġa' ħareġ għax nesa l-ħobż.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu come back? Mark: Yes, and he went out again because he forgot the bread.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗回来了吗？马克：回来了，不过他忘了买面包，又出去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 保罗回来了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu come back?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u reġa' ħareġ għax nesa l-ħobż.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u reġa' ħareġ għax nesa l-ħobż.
messages.zh: 回来了，不过他忘了买面包，又出去了。
messages.en: Yes, and he went out again because he forgot the bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两格小漫画记 reġa'：第一格“人回来了”，第二格“同一个动作又做一次”；分别搭配 lura 和后续动作练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woman who rules a kingdom, or the wife of a king.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 统治王国的女性君主，或国王的妻子；分别称为女王和王后。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara li tmexxi saltna, jew il-mara ta' re.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 女王，即女性君主；王后，即国王的妻子

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-reġina laqgħet id-delegazzjoni fil-palazz u semgħet it-talbiet tagħha.
formal.en: In the story, the queen welcomed the delegation to the palace and listened to its requests.
formal.zh: 故事中，女王在宫殿接待了代表团，并听取了其诉求。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hi dik bil-kuruna fl-istampa? Pawlu: Dik hi r-reġina. Trid taqra l-istorja tagħha?
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is that woman wearing a crown in the picture? Pawlu: That's the queen. Do you want to read her story?
colloquial.zh: Lara：图片里那个戴王冠的女人是谁？Pawlu：那是女王。你想读她的故事吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 图片里那个戴王冠的女人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that woman wearing a crown in the picture?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik hi r-reġina. Trid taqra l-istorja tagħha?
messages.mt_standard: Dik hi r-reġina. Trid taqra l-istorja tagħha?
messages.zh: 那是女王。你想读她的故事吗？
messages.en: That's the queen. Do you want to read her story?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 reġina 配上一幅女性戴王冠的画面；阅读时再看她是统治国家的女王，还是国王的妻子王后。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area of a country or of the world considered as a unit because of its location or shared features.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因地理位置或共同特点而被视为一个整体的地区或区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żona ta' pajjiż jew tad-dinja meqjusa bħala unità minħabba l-post jew il-karatteristiċi komuni tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地区；区域，通常指具有共同地理或其他特点的一片地方

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina kif it-trasport pubbliku jgħaqqad l-irħula ta' dan ir-reġjun.
formal.en: The study examines how public transport connects the villages in this region.
formal.zh: 该研究考察公共交通如何连接这一地区的各个村庄。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Taf xi post sabiħ f'dan ir-reġjun? David: Iva, hemm raħal ħdejn il-baħar li jogħġobni ħafna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you know any nice places in this region? David: Yes, there's a village by the sea that I really like.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你知道这个地区有什么好地方吗？David：知道，海边有个村子，我特别喜欢。

messages.speaker: Nina (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf xi post sabiħ f'dan ir-reġjun?
messages.mt_standard: Taf xi post sabiħ f'dan ir-reġjun?
messages.zh: 你知道这个地区有什么好地方吗？
messages.en: Do you know any nice places in this region?

messages.speaker: David (当地朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm raħal ħdejn il-baħar li jogħġobni ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm raħal ħdejn il-baħar li jogħġobni ħafna.
messages.zh: 知道，海边有个村子，我特别喜欢。
messages.en: Yes, there's a village by the sea that I really like.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在地图上圈出相邻的一片地方，并写上 reġjun；想象圈内有多个村庄，共同组成一个地区。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To send, bring, or give someone or something back.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人或物送回、带回原处，或把物品归还给原主。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibgħat jew iġib lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa lura, jew jagħti xi ħaġa lura lil sidha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 送回；遣返；把物品退回
击退；使进攻者或攻势退却
带回；把人或物带回原处
归还；把物品交还给原主

formal.mt: Il-ħanut reġġa' l-flus lill-klijent wara li dan irritorna l-prodott difettuż.
formal.en: The shop refunded the customer after he returned the defective product.
formal.zh: 顾客退回有缺陷的商品后，商店把钱退还给了他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min reġġa' l-ktieb fuq l-ixkaffa? Mark: Jien. Sibtu fuq il-mejda u poġġejtu hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who put the book back on the shelf? Mark: I did. I found it on the table and put it there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁把书放回书架上了？Mark：我。我在桌上看到它，就把它放到那里了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把书放回书架上了？
messages.en: Who put the book back on the shelf?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Sibtu fuq il-mejda u poġġejtu hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Sibtu fuq il-mejda u poġġejtu hemm.
messages.zh: 我。我在桌上看到它，就把它放到那里了。
messages.en: I did. I found it on the table and put it there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一支指向原处的回头箭头串联记忆：包裹送回、物品带回、钱款归还；敌人的进攻被推回去，就是击退。

gloss_zh: 松开；放松；放走；让步；发出

teaching_sense.en_definition: To loosen or relax something, let it go, give in, or emit something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变松或放松，将其放开、释放，也可指让步或发出某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inaqqas it-tensjoni ta' xi ħaġa, iħalliha tmur, iċedi, jew joħroġ xi ħaġa bħal ħoss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 松开；使原本紧固的东西变松。
使松弛；减小绷紧或拉紧的程度。
放手；松开所抓住或控制的东西。
放松；使紧张或紧绷的状态缓和。
让步；屈服；不再坚持抵抗。
松开、使松弛或放松。
释放；放走；解除束缚后让其离开。
发出；释放出声音等。

formal.mt: Wara li fetaħ il-gaġġa, ir-raġel reħa l-għasfur fil-ġnien.
formal.en: After opening the cage, the man released the bird in the garden.
formal.zh: 打开鸟笼后，那名男子在花园里放走了鸟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ħabel m'għadux issikkat? Mark: Pawlu reħa l-ħabel biex inkunu nistgħu nċaqilqu l-kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the rope no longer tight? Mark: Pawlu let go of the rope so that we could move the box.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：绳子怎么不再绷紧了？马克：保罗松开了绳子，好让我们搬动箱子。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 绳子怎么不再绷紧了？
messages.en: Why is the rope no longer tight?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu reħa l-ħabel biex inkunu nistgħu nċaqilqu l-kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu reħa l-ħabel biex inkunu nistgħu nċaqilqu l-kaxxa.
messages.zh: 保罗松开了绳子，好让我们搬动箱子。
messages.en: Pawlu let go of the rope so that we could move the box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习时用“松开握紧的手”串联 reħa 的松开、放松和放走；再分别给让步、发出各配一个例句，避免混淆语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slackness, laziness, or tiredness, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 松弛或懈怠的状态，也可指懒散或疲倦，具体含义取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' tensjoni jew ħeġġa; tista' tfisser ukoll għażż jew għeja, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 松弛；不够紧绷或不够认真投入的状态。
懒惰；懒散；不愿付出努力。
疲倦；疲乏；缺乏精力的感觉。

formal.mt: Ir-reħja fix-xogħol wasslet għal dewmien fit-tlestija tal-proġett.
formal.en: Slackness at work led to a delay in completing the project.
formal.zh: 工作上的懈怠导致项目延迟完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid toħroġ għal mixja? Lara: Illum għandi reħja kbira; nippreferi nistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to go out for a walk? Lara: I'm very tired today; I'd rather rest for a while.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：想出去散步吗？拉拉：我今天很疲倦，还是想先休息一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 想出去散步吗？
messages.en: Do you want to go out for a walk?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum għandi reħja kbira; nippreferi nistrieħ ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Illum għandi reħja kbira; nippreferi nistrieħ ftit.
messages.zh: 我今天很疲倦，还是想先休息一会儿。
messages.en: I'm very tired today; I'd rather rest for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面记 reħja：绳子松弛、做事懒散、身体疲倦；读句子时先看语境，别把疲倦一律理解成懒惰。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel extremely cold or become chilled to the bone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到非常寒冷，或冷得浑身发僵、寒气彻骨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss kesħa kbira ħafna jew jiksaħ sal-għadam.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be chilled to the bone
sense_translations.zh_definition: 冷得彻骨；冻得浑身发僵。
冻僵；冻得厉害。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be or feel very cold; to be freezing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常冷；感到极冷；冻得受不了。

collocations.en: he became chilled in the rain

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem reżaħ waqt li kien qed jistenna barra mingħajr kowt.
formal.en: The worker became extremely cold while waiting outside without a coat.
formal.zh: 那名工人没有穿外套，在外面等候时冻得厉害。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex daħal Pawlu daqshekk malajr? Mark: Reżaħ barra. Mar jagħmel ftit te.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Pawlu come inside so quickly? Mark: He got very cold outside. He went to make some tea.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗怎么这么快就进屋了？马克：他在外面冻坏了，去泡茶了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 保罗怎么这么快就进屋了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu come inside so quickly?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Reżaħ barra. Mar jagħmel ftit te.
messages.mt_standard: Reżaħ barra. Mar jagħmel ftit te.
messages.zh: 他在外面冻坏了，去泡茶了。
messages.en: He got very cold outside. He went to make some tea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 reżaħ 配上人在雨里抱紧双臂、冻得发抖的画面，重点记“人感到极冷”这个动作或经历。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A chill in the air, especially in cold weather, or a breeze that brings a feeling of cold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 空气中的寒意，尤指寒冷天气带来的冷感，也可指带来凉意的风。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kesħa fl-arja, speċjalment fi temp kiesaħ, jew żiffa li ġġib sens ta' kesħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 寒意；寒冷，尤用于描述寒冷天气。
凉风；寒意。

formal.mt: Minkejja x-xemx, kien hemm reżħa ħafifa fl-arja matul il-mixja ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: Despite the sunshine, there was a slight chill in the air during the morning walk.
formal.zh: 尽管阳光明媚，清晨散步时空气中仍带着一丝寒意。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Hawn reżħa dieħla mit-tieqa. Pawlu: Nagħlaqha? Anna: Iva, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Anna: There's a chilly breeze coming in through the window. Pawlu: Shall I close it? Anna: Yes, please.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：有股凉风从窗户吹进来。保罗：要我把窗户关上吗？安娜：好的，麻烦你。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 有股凉风从窗户吹进来。
messages.en: There's a chilly breeze coming in through the window.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 要我把窗户关上吗？
messages.en: Shall I close it?

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 好的，麻烦你。
messages.en: Yes, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象清晨打开窗户，一股凉风吹进来：这股“寒意或凉风”就是名词 reżħa；用窗边的冷空气画面帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone or something very cold, or to cause something to freeze.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或物变得很冷，或使某物冻结。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa kiesħa ħafna, jew iġiegħel xi ħaġa tiffriża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变冷；使感到寒冷。
使冻结；使冻住。

formal.mt: Ir-riħ kiesaħ reżżaħ il-kamra matul il-lejl.
formal.en: The cold wind chilled the room during the night.
formal.zh: 冷风在夜间使房间变得十分寒冷。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tagħlaq it-tieqa? Mark: Ir-riħ reżżaħ il-kamra. Maja: Sewwa, ħa nġib kutra wkoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you closing the window? Mark: The wind has made the room very cold. Maja: All right, I'll get a blanket too.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么关窗？Mark：风把房间吹得很冷。Maja：好，那我也去拿条毯子。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么关窗？
messages.en: Why are you closing the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 风把房间吹得很冷。
messages.en: The wind has made the room very cold.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 好，那我也去拿条毯子。
messages.en: All right, I'll get a blanket too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象冷风灌进房间，把人和水都冷透；用这个画面记住“使变冷”，再延伸到“使冻结”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very eager to possess or obtain something, especially money, and sometimes unwilling to share or spend it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强烈想要占有或获得某物的，尤其指贪求钱财，也可指不愿分享或花钱的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jixtieq ħafna jikseb jew ikollu xi ħaġa, speċjalment il-flus, u xi drabi ma jridx jaqsamha jew jonfoq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 热切渴求的；对某事有强烈欲望的。
小气的；不愿花钱或与人分享的。
贪婪的；总想得到更多的。
吝啬的；过分舍不得花钱的。
贪财的；对财富有强烈占有欲的。
贪婪、贪财或吝啬的，强调一心想占有东西。

collocations.zh: 一个贪婪或吝啬的男人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, in-negozjant rgħib ried iżomm il-profitt kollu għalih.
formal.en: In the story, the greedy merchant wanted to keep all the profit for himself.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个贪婪的商人想把全部利润据为己有。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħallejt xi kejk għalina? Mark: Iva, ħadt biċċa waħda biss. Maja: Tajjeb, ħsibt li kont rgħib u ħadtu kollu!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you leave any cake for us? Mark: Yes, I only took one piece. Maja: Good, I thought you had been greedy and taken it all!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你给我们留蛋糕了吗？Mark：留了，我只拿了一块。Maja：那就好，我还以为你贪心地全拿走了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你给我们留蛋糕了吗？
messages.en: Did you leave any cake for us?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 留了，我只拿了一块。
messages.en: Yes, I only took one piece.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, ħsibt li kont rgħib u ħadtu kollu!
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, ħsibt li kont rgħib u ħadtu kollu!
messages.zh: 那就好，我还以为你贪心地全拿走了！
messages.en: Good, I thought you had been greedy and taken it all!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“伸手想多拿”和“攥紧不肯分”两个画面连起来，分别记住贪婪与吝啬这两组意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The ability or determination to choose and pursue something, or the wish for something to happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作出选择并努力实现目标的意志，也指希望某事发生的意愿或愿望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħila jew id-determinazzjoni li tagħżel u taħdem għal xi ħaġa, jew ix-xewqa li jiġri xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 意志；意愿。
对某事物的渴望；想要某物或实现某事的愿望。

sense_translations.en_definition: will (one’s faculty of wanting or willing something)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 意志，即人产生意愿、作出选择并决意行动的能力。
意愿；一个人所希望实现的事情或结果。

formal.mt: B'rieda soda u xogħol regolari, l-istudenta tejbet il-ħiliet tagħha fil-qari.
formal.en: Through strong determination and regular work, the student improved her reading skills.
formal.zh: 凭借坚定的意志和持续的练习，这名学生提高了阅读能力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Irrid nitgħallem il-Malti, imma kultant naqta' qalbi. Mark: Għandek ir-rieda, u jien nista' ngħinek tipprattika. Maja: Grazzi, ejja nibdew b'għaxar minuti kuljum.
colloquial.en: Maja: I want to learn Maltese, but sometimes I get discouraged. Mark: You have the determination, and I can help you practise. Maja: Thanks, let's start with ten minutes a day.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我想学马耳他语，可有时会灰心。Mark：你有这份决心，我也可以帮你练习。Maja：谢谢，我们先从每天十分钟开始吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid nitgħallem il-Malti, imma kultant naqta' qalbi.
messages.mt_standard: Irrid nitgħallem il-Malti, imma kultant naqta' qalbi.
messages.zh: 我想学马耳他语，可有时会灰心。
messages.en: I want to learn Maltese, but sometimes I get discouraged.

messages.speaker: Mark (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek ir-rieda, u jien nista' ngħinek tipprattika.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek ir-rieda, u jien nista' ngħinek tipprattika.
messages.zh: 你有这份决心，我也可以帮你练习。
messages.en: You have the determination, and I can help you practise.

messages.speaker: Maja (学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi, ejja nibdew b'għaxar minuti kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi, ejja nibdew b'għaxar minuti kuljum.
messages.zh: 谢谢，我们先从每天十分钟开始吧。
messages.en: Thanks, let's start with ten minutes a day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“我想做到”写成愿望，再把“每天坚持”画成行动，连起来记住 rieda 的意愿与意志两面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strap attached to a horse's bridle and held by a rider or driver to guide the horse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缰绳，连接马笼头、供骑手或驾车者握住以引导马匹的带子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċinga mwaħħla mal-ilġiem ta' żiemel, li r-rikkieb jew is-sewwieq iżomm biex imexxi ż-żiemel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缰绳；用于控制或引导马匹的带子。
动词 ried 加宾语后缀 -na，意为“他想要我们”；后接动作时可表示“他想让我们……”。

collocations.en: he wanted us to go with him
collocations.zh: 他想让我们跟他一起去

formal.mt: Ir-rikkieb żamm ir-riedna b'id waħda waqt li ż-żiemel mexa bil-mod.
formal.en: The rider held the rein in one hand while the horse walked slowly.
formal.zh: 马匹缓步行走时，骑手用一只手握着缰绳。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-għalliem riedna nżommu r-riedna hekk? Mark: Iva, imma qalilna biex ma niġbdux bis-saħħa. Maja: Sewwa, issa fhimt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the instructor want us to hold the rein like this? Mark: Yes, but he told us not to pull hard. Maja: All right, now I understand.
colloquial.zh: Maja：教练是想让我们这样握缰绳吗？Mark：是的，但他叫我们别用力拉。Maja：好，我现在明白了。

messages.speaker: Maja (骑术学员)
messages.zh: 教练是想让我们这样握缰绳吗？
messages.en: Did the instructor want us to hold the rein like this?

messages.speaker: Mark (同班学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma qalilna biex ma niġbdux bis-saħħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma qalilna biex ma niġbdux bis-saħħa.
messages.zh: 是的，但他叫我们别用力拉。
messages.en: Yes, but he told us not to pull hard.

messages.speaker: Maja (骑术学员)
messages.zh: 好，我现在明白了。
messages.en: All right, now I understand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一句“他想让我们握缰绳”同时记两个词义：动词 riedna 是“他想要我们”，名词 ir-riedna 是“缰绳”，靠句法分清。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very strong wind or violent windstorm; in some contexts, a hurricane or whirlwind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 猛烈的风或风暴；根据语境，也可指飓风或旋风。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Riħ qawwi ħafna jew maltempata bir-riħ; skont il-kuntest, jista' jfisser ukoll uragan jew riħ li jdur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大风；狂风。
飓风。
旋风。
狂风、风暴或旋风，具体含义依语境而定。

formal.mt: Ir-riefnu qawwi kkawża ħsara lis-siġar u waqqaf it-traffiku għal diversi sigħat.
formal.en: The powerful gale damaged trees and brought traffic to a halt for several hours.
formal.zh: 猛烈的狂风损坏了树木，导致交通中断数小时。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt ir-riefnu lbieraħ filgħaxija? Mark: Iva, għalaqt it-twieqi kollha għax ir-riħ kien qawwi ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear the gale last night? Mark: Yes, I closed all the windows because the wind was very strong.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你昨晚听到狂风的声音了吗？马克：听到了，风特别大，我把所有窗户都关上了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你昨晚听到狂风的声音了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear the gale last night?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għalaqt it-twieqi kollha għax ir-riħ kien qawwi ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għalaqt it-twieqi kollha għax ir-riħ kien qawwi ħafna.
messages.zh: 听到了，风特别大，我把所有窗户都关上了。
messages.en: Yes, I closed all the windows because the wind was very strong.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 riefnu 和狂风吹得窗户作响的画面一起记；看到海上或树木受损的语境，就联想猛烈风暴。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone greedy or excessively eager to acquire and keep wealth or possessions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人变得贪婪，尤其指使其过度追求或占有财富与财物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel lil xi ħadd rgħib, b'xewqa żejda għall-flus jew għall-ġid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变得贪财；使产生过度占有财富的欲望。
使某人变得贪婪。

collocations.zh: 财富使那个男人变得贪婪
成功使那个商人变得贪婪

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-ġid riegħeb lin-negozjant, li beda jaħseb biss fil-profitt tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, wealth made the businessman greedy, and he began to think only of his own profit.
formal.zh: 在这个故事中，财富使商人变得贪婪，他开始只考虑自己的利润。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-karattru jrid aktar flus meta diġà għandu biżżejjed? Mark: Il-ġid riegħeb lil dak ir-raġel; qatt ma jkun kuntent b'dak li għandu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does the character want more money when he already has enough? Mark: Wealth made that man greedy; he is never satisfied with what he has.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个人物明明已经有足够的钱了，为什么还想要更多？马克：财富使那个人变得贪婪；他对自己拥有的东西总不满足。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-karattru jrid aktar flus meta diġà għandu biżżejjed?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-karattru jrid aktar flus meta diġà għandu biżżejjed?
messages.zh: 这个人物明明已经有足够的钱了，为什么还想要更多？
messages.en: Why does the character want more money when he already has enough?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġid riegħeb lil dak ir-raġel; qatt ma jkun kuntent b'dak li għandu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġid riegħeb lil dak ir-raġel; qatt ma jkun kuntent b'dak li għandu.
messages.zh: 财富使那个人变得贪婪；他对自己拥有的东西总不满足。
messages.en: Wealth made that man greedy; he is never satisfied with what he has.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 riegħeb 时想象金币越堆越高，一个人却越想要更多；重点记住它表示使别人变贪婪这一变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To thunder or rumble, to quake or vibrate, or to cause someone or something to tremble.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 打雷或发出雷鸣般的轰响；震颤、振动，或使人、物颤抖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel ħoss ta' ragħad, titriegħed jew tivvibra, jew iġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa titriegħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打雷；发出雷鸣。
隆隆作响；指雷声滚动般持续轰鸣。
震颤；颤抖。
振动；震动。
使颤抖；使震颤或微微抖动。

collocations.en: the noise made the windows shake

formal.mt: Matul il-maltemp riegħed diversi drabi, u l-ħoss qawwi riegħed it-twieqi tal-bini.
formal.en: During the storm, it thundered several times, and the loud noise made the building's windows shake.
formal.zh: 暴风雨期间，雷声数次响起，巨响震得建筑物的窗户发抖。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt kemm riegħed billejl? Mark: Iva, il-ħoss qajjimni u mbagħad bdiet nieżla x-xita.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear how much it thundered during the night? Mark: Yes, the noise woke me up, and then it started raining.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听到夜里雷打得多厉害了吗？马克：听到了，雷声把我吵醒了，接着就开始下雨。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你听到夜里雷打得多厉害了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear how much it thundered during the night?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ħoss qajjimni u mbagħad bdiet nieżla x-xita.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ħoss qajjimni u mbagħad bdiet nieżla x-xita.
messages.zh: 听到了，雷声把我吵醒了，接着就开始下雨。
messages.en: Yes, the noise woke me up, and then it started raining.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 riegħed 记成雷声带动震动的连续画面：天空轰隆响，窗户跟着抖，人也感到震颤。

gloss_zh: 脸红；使脸红；使羞愧或难堪

teaching_sense.en_definition: To blush or become red, or to make someone blush, feel ashamed, or feel embarrassed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脸红、变红；也可指使某人脸红、羞愧或感到难堪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Issir aħmar, speċjalment fil-wiċċ, jew iġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jistħi, iħossu umiljat jew imbarazzat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脸红，通常因害羞、羞愧或尴尬而起。
变红；面色发红。
使脸红。

sense_translations.en_definition: to humiliate, put to shame, embarrass
sense_translations.zh_definition: 羞辱；使羞愧；使难堪或尴尬。

collocations.en: the compliment made the boy blush
collocations.zh: 那句赞美使男孩脸红了

collocations.en: embarrassed his friend in front of everyone
collocations.zh: 当着所有人的面使朋友难堪

formal.mt: Il-kumment personali riegħex lill-istudent quddiem il-klassi kollha.
formal.en: The personal remark embarrassed the student in front of the whole class.
formal.zh: 那句针对个人的评论让这名学生在全班面前感到难堪。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex it-tifel sar aħmar? Mark: Il-kumpliment riegħex lit-tifel; ma kienx qed jistenna dak it-tifħir.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the boy go red? Mark: The compliment made the boy blush; he was not expecting that praise.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个男孩为什么脸红了？马克：那句赞美让他脸红了；他没想到会受到这样的表扬。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个男孩为什么脸红了？
messages.en: Why did the boy go red?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumpliment riegħex lit-tifel; ma kienx qed jistenna dak it-tifħir.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumpliment riegħex lit-tifel; ma kienx qed jistenna dak it-tifħir.
messages.zh: 那句赞美让他脸红了；他没想到会受到这样的表扬。
messages.en: The compliment made the boy blush; he was not expecting that praise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张发红的脸记 riegħex：赞美可能使人害羞脸红，尖刻评论可能使人羞愧难堪；留意是谁引起变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To support someone or something, or to guide, direct, or govern people and their affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支撑某人或某物；也可指引导、指挥他人，或治理群体及其事务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti appoġġ lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa, jew tmexxi, tiggwida jew tiggverna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 支撑；扶持；给予支持。

sense_translations.en_definition: to support, to guide, to direct, to govern
sense_translations.zh_definition: 支撑、引导、指挥或治理，具体含义依对象和语境而定。

formal.mt: Il-mexxej rieġa l-pajjiż b'għaqal matul perjodu diffiċli.
formal.en: The leader governed the country wisely during a difficult period.
formal.zh: 这位领导人在艰难时期明智地治理了国家。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif niżel it-taraġ in-nannu? Mark: Pawlu rieġa lin-nannu waqt li kien nieżel.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Grandad get down the stairs? Mark: Pawlu supported Grandad as he was going down.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：爷爷是怎么下楼梯的？马克：保罗在爷爷下楼时扶着他。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷是怎么下楼梯的？
messages.en: How did Grandad get down the stairs?

messages.speaker: Mark (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu rieġa lin-nannu waqt li kien nieżel.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu rieġa lin-nannu waqt li kien nieżel.
messages.zh: 保罗在爷爷下楼时扶着他。
messages.en: Pawlu supported Grandad as he was going down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记 rieġa：手扶老人是支撑，领导国家是治理；再把引导和指挥放在两幅画之间联想。

gloss_zh: 发臭；突然转身攻击；改变方向

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give off a bad smell; in a separate sense, to change direction or turn round suddenly to attack.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 散发难闻气味；另有改变方向或突然转身发起攻击的义项，须结合语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Toħroġ riħa ħażina; f'tifsira oħra, tibdel id-direzzjoni jew iddur f'daqqa biex tattakka.

sense_translations.en_definition: to give off a bad smell
sense_translations.zh_definition: 散发难闻的气味；发出臭味。

sense_translations.en_definition: to turn round suddenly to attack
sense_translations.zh_definition: 突然转身发起攻击。
改变方向；转向。
闻起来难闻；发臭。

collocations.en: the fish began to smell bad
the meat began to smell bad

formal.mt: Il-ħut rieħ wara li tħalla barra mill-friġġ għal żmien twil.
formal.en: The fish began to smell bad after being left out of the refrigerator for a long time.
formal.zh: 鱼被放在冰箱外很长时间后开始发臭。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn ġejja din ir-riħa ħażina? Mark: Il-ħut rieħ. Insejnieh barra mill-friġġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is this bad smell coming from? Mark: The fish has started to smell bad. We forgot it outside the refrigerator.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这股臭味是从哪里来的？马克：鱼发臭了。我们忘了把它放进冰箱。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġejja din ir-riħa ħażina?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġejja din ir-riħa ħażina?
messages.zh: 这股臭味是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where is this bad smell coming from?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 鱼发臭了。我们忘了把它放进冰箱。
messages.en: The fish has started to smell bad. We forgot it outside the refrigerator.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 rieħ 分设两张记忆卡：一张是食物发臭，一张是突然转身；依上下文选义，不把两组意思强行串成词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To support or prop up something, or to help someone; a separate sense is to strike forcefully.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支撑、撑住某物，或帮助某人；另有重击、猛打的义项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżżomm xi ħaġa biex ma taqax jew tgħin lil xi ħadd; f'tifsira oħra, tolqot bil-qawwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 支撑；支持；扶持。
重击；猛打。
撑住；支撑；用支撑物加固。
帮助；扶助。

collocations.en: propped up the wall with a beam

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem rifed il-ħajt b'travu biex ma jaqax waqt it-tiswijiet.
formal.en: The worker propped up the wall with a beam to prevent it from falling during the repairs.
formal.zh: 工人用一根梁撑住墙，以防墙在维修期间倒塌。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif żamm il-ħajt sakemm waslu l-ħaddiema? Mark: Pawlu rifed il-ħajt b'travu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the wall stay up until the workers arrived? Mark: Pawlu propped up the wall with a beam.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：工人来之前，那堵墙是怎么撑住的？马克：保罗用一根梁撑住了墙。

messages.speaker: Maja (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif żamm il-ħajt sakemm waslu l-ħaddiema?
messages.mt_standard: Kif żamm il-ħajt sakemm waslu l-ħaddiema?
messages.zh: 工人来之前，那堵墙是怎么撑住的？
messages.en: How did the wall stay up until the workers arrived?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 保罗用一根梁撑住了墙。
messages.en: Pawlu propped up the wall with a beam.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用梁撑住墙的画面记 rifed 的支撑义，再联想扶助朋友；重击义单独记，并注意拼写只有一个 f。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To support or prop up something so that it stays upright or firmly in place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支撑或撑起某物，使其保持直立或稳固，也可指用支撑物加固。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżżomm jew issaħħaħ xi ħaġa b'appoġġ biex tibqa' wieqfa jew f'postha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 支撑；支持。
撑起；用支撑物撑住。
撑住；支撑；加设支撑以加固。

collocations.en: propped up the shelf with a piece of wood
collocations.zh: 用一块木头撑住了搁板

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa riffed l-ixkaffa b'biċċa njam biex tibqa' f'postha.
formal.en: The carpenter propped up the shelf with a piece of wood to keep it in place.
formal.zh: 木匠用一块木头撑住搁板，使其保持在原位。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-ixkaffa għadha tinżel minn naħa? Mark: Le, Pawlu riffed l-ixkaffa b'biċċa njam u issa tinsab dritta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the shelf still sagging on one side? Mark: No, Pawlu propped up the shelf with a piece of wood, and now it is level.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：搁板还是一边往下垂吗？马克：没有了，保罗用一块木头撑住了它，现在已经平了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 搁板还是一边往下垂吗？
messages.en: Is the shelf still sagging on one side?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, Pawlu riffed l-ixkaffa b'biċċa njam u issa tinsab dritta.
messages.mt_standard: Le, Pawlu riffed l-ixkaffa b'biċċa njam u issa tinsab dritta.
messages.zh: 没有了，保罗用一块木头撑住了它，现在已经平了。
messages.en: No, Pawlu propped up the shelf with a piece of wood, and now it is level.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 riffed 中并排的 ff 想成两根支柱，帮助记住撑住和加固的意思；这只是拼写联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To press down on something with the feet, especially by stamping or treading on it repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用脚踩压某物，尤指用力踩踏或反复践踏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħfas fuq xi ħaġa bis-saqajn, speċjalment bil-qawwa jew għal diversi drabi.

sense_translations.en_definition: to stamp or trample on sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用力踩踏或践踏某物。
反复踩在某物上。

formal.mt: Xi ħadd riffes fuq il-fjuri fil-ġnien u għamel ħsara lil diversi pjanti.
formal.en: Someone trampled on the flowers in the garden and damaged several plants.
formal.zh: 有人踩踏了花园里的花，损坏了好几株植物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min riffes fuq il-kaxxa? Mark: Jien, bi żball. Kienet mal-art.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who stepped on the box? Mark: I did, by accident. It was on the floor.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁踩了这个盒子？马克：是我，不小心踩的。它当时在地上。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁踩了这个盒子？
messages.en: Who stepped on the box?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 是我，不小心踩的。它当时在地上。
messages.en: I did, by accident. It was on the floor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 riffes 配上鞋底反复压住花草的画面，记住它强调用脚踩压或践踏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person forced to leave their country because of war, persecution, or serious danger and seek safety in another country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因战争、迫害或严重危险而被迫离开本国，到另一国家寻求安全的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li jkollha titlaq minn pajjiżha minħabba gwerra, persekuzzjoni jew periklu serju u tfittex kenn f'pajjiż ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 难民；因战争、迫害或严重危险而逃离本国、到另一国家寻求庇护的人。

formal.mt: Ir-rifuġjat ingħata appoġġ biex jitgħallem il-lingwa u jsib xogħol.
formal.en: The refugee received support to learn the language and find work.
formal.zh: 这名难民获得了学习语言和寻找工作的支持。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu r-raġel il-ġdid fil-klassi? Lara: Huwa rifuġjat li qed jitgħallem il-Malti magħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is the new man in the class? Lara: He is a refugee who is learning Maltese with us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：班里新来的那位男士是谁？拉拉：他是一名难民，正在和我们一起学马耳他语。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 班里新来的那位男士是谁？
messages.en: Who is the new man in the class?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa rifuġjat li qed jitgħallem il-Malti magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa rifuġjat li qed jitgħallem il-Malti magħna.
messages.zh: 他是一名难民，正在和我们一起学马耳他语。
messages.en: He is a refugee who is learning Maltese with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rifuġjat 放进逃离战乱、寻找安全住所的情景中记忆，核心是被迫离乡求庇护的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something given to another person as a present, often to celebrate an occasion or express affection, thanks, or respect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 送给他人的礼物，常用于庆祝某个日子，或表达关爱、感谢及敬意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tingħata lil persuna oħra biex tiġi ċċelebrata okkażjoni jew jintwerew affezzjoni, ħajr jew rispett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 礼物；为庆祝或表达心意而送出的东西。
赠礼；赠送给他人的物品。
贡礼；为表示敬意而献上的礼物。
礼物；赠送给他人以表达心意的东西。

formal.mt: Fi tmiem iċ-ċerimonja, l-istudenti taw rigal lill-għalliema bħala sinjal ta' ħajr.
formal.en: At the end of the ceremony, the students gave the teacher a gift as a token of thanks.
formal.zh: 仪式结束时，学生们送给老师一份礼物，以表谢意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ir-rigal għalik. Mark: Grazzi! Nista' niftħu issa?
colloquial.en: Maja: This present is for you. Mark: Thank you! Can I open it now?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份礼物是送给你的。马克：谢谢！我现在可以打开吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这份礼物是送给你的。
messages.en: This present is for you.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 谢谢！我现在可以打开吗？
messages.en: Thank you! Can I open it now?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象生日时递出一个包好的盒子，同时说 rigal；把这个词与送礼、收礼的动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The use of threats, such as threatening to reveal private information, to force someone to give money or do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过威胁，例如扬言公开私人信息，迫使他人交钱或做某事的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-użu ta' theddid, bħal theddida li tinkixef informazzjoni privata, biex persuna tiġi mġiegħla tagħti flus jew tagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 敲诈；勒索，尤指以公开秘密或私人信息等相威胁，迫使他人交钱或服从要求。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ ta' rikatt li fih intalbu flus bi theddida li tiġi ppubblikata informazzjoni privata.
formal.en: The report describes a case of blackmail in which money was demanded under threat of publishing private information.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一起勒索事件，其中有人以公开私人信息相威胁，索要钱财。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qalli biex inħallas, inkella jippubblika l-messaġġi privati tiegħi. Lara: Dan hu rikatt. Żomm il-messaġġi bħala prova.
colloquial.en: Mark: He told me to pay, or he would publish my private messages. Lara: That's blackmail. Keep the messages as evidence.
colloquial.zh: 马克：他让我付钱，否则就公开我的私人消息。拉拉：这是勒索。把这些消息留作证据。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qalli biex inħallas, inkella jippubblika l-messaġġi privati tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Qalli biex inħallas, inkella jippubblika l-messaġġi privati tiegħi.
messages.zh: 他让我付钱，否则就公开我的私人消息。
messages.en: He told me to pay, or he would publish my private messages.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu rikatt. Żomm il-messaġġi bħala prova.
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu rikatt. Żomm il-messaġġi bħala prova.
messages.zh: 这是勒索。把这些消息留作证据。
messages.en: That's blackmail. Keep the messages as evidence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“不给钱就公开秘密”的情景记 rikatt，把威胁与强迫索取连在一起，就能抓住勒索的含义。

gloss_zh: 乘骑；一段车程；搭便车；褶裥

teaching_sense.en_definition: A journey or outing on an animal or in a vehicle, including a lift that someone gives you in their car.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 骑乘动物或乘坐车辆的一次行程，也可指别人开车顺路载你的一程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vjaġġ jew dawra fuq annimal jew f'vettura, inkluż meta xi ħadd iwasslek bil-karozza tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: a ride (e.g. on a horse or car)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次乘骑或乘车行程，例如骑马或坐汽车。

sense_translations.en_definition: a lift given to sb. in one's car
sense_translations.zh_definition: 开车顺路载某人一程；让某人搭便车。
一次乘骑、乘车或兜风。
褶；褶裥，指布料等折叠形成的褶层。

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-ġurnata jinkludi rikba fuq żiemel taħt is-superviżjoni ta' għalliem.
formal.en: The day's programme includes a horse ride under an instructor's supervision.
formal.zh: 当天的活动安排包括在教练指导下骑马。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid rikba sad-dar? Mark: Iva, grazzi! Il-karozza tiegħi għand il-mekkanik.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like a lift home? Mark: Yes, thanks! My car is at the mechanic's.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：要我开车送你回家吗？马克：好啊，谢谢！我的车在修理厂。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 要我开车送你回家吗？
messages.en: Would you like a lift home?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi! Il-karozza tiegħi għand il-mekkanik.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi! Il-karozza tiegħi għand il-mekkanik.
messages.zh: 好啊，谢谢！我的车在修理厂。
messages.en: Yes, thanks! My car is at the mechanic's.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rikba 记作名词“一趟乘骑”：骑马一趟、搭车一程都适用；布料的褶裥义另配裙褶画面记忆。

gloss_zh: 骑乘；登上；使臣服；染病；交配；重叠

teaching_sense.en_definition: To ride an animal or travel in or on a vehicle, or to get onto an animal or vehicle in order to ride.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 骑乘动物或乘坐车辆，也可指为骑乘而跨上动物或登上车辆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tivvjaġġa fuq annimal jew f'vettura, jew titla' fuq annimal jew vettura biex tivvjaġġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 骑；乘坐。
跨上；骑上。
登上或爬上某物。
使某人臣服；使某人受支配。

sense_translations.en_definition: to ride a horse, a vehicle
sense_translations.zh_definition: 骑马；乘坐车辆。

sense_translations.en_definition: to mount a horse, a vehicle
sense_translations.zh_definition: 跨上马背；登上车辆。
奴役；征服并使之服从。
染上疾病；患病。
交配；发生性交。
重叠；部分覆盖在另一物之上。

collocations.zh: 乘坐了或登上了公共汽车

formal.mt: It-tifel rikeb iż-żiemel għall-ewwel darba waqt il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: The boy rode the horse for the first time during the lesson.
formal.zh: 这个男孩在课上第一次骑了马。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark rikeb il-karozza tal-linja? Lara: Iva, telaq għaxar minuti ilu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark get on the bus? Lara: Yes, he left ten minutes ago.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克上公共汽车了吗？拉拉：上了，他十分钟前就走了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克上公共汽车了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark get on the bus?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 上了，他十分钟前就走了。
messages.en: Yes, he left ten minutes ago.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rikeb 配上跨上马背或登车的动作，和名词 rikba“一趟乘骑”对照；其余义项按支配、疾病、交配及重叠语境分别记忆。

gloss_zh: 富有的；滋味浓郁的；丰富的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having much wealth, a full flavour, or an abundant variety of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人拥有很多财富，也可形容食物滋味浓郁，或某事物内容丰富。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħafna ġid, togħma qawwija u sħiħa, jew abbundanza u varjetà ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 富有的；丰富的。
滋味浓郁的；味道丰富饱满的。
富裕的；拥有很多财富的。
丰富的；充实的；充足的；多样的。

formal.mt: Il-mużew joffri programm rikk u varjat ta' attivitajiet edukattivi.
formal.en: The museum offers a rich and varied programme of educational activities.
formal.zh: 博物馆提供丰富多样的教育活动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan ir-raġel rikk? Mark: Iva, għandu ħafna flus, imma jgħix ħajja sempliċi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this man wealthy? Mark: Yes, he has a lot of money, but he lives a simple life.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个男人很有钱吗？马克：是的，他有很多钱，不过生活很简朴。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个男人很有钱吗？
messages.en: Is this man wealthy?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandu ħafna flus, imma jgħix ħajja sempliċi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandu ħafna flus, imma jgħix ħajja sempliċi.
messages.zh: 是的，他有很多钱，不过生活很简朴。
messages.en: Yes, he has a lot of money, but he lives a simple life.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rikk 想成“很充足”：钱财充足是富有，滋味充足是浓郁，活动内容充足是丰富；搭配阴性名词时可见 rikka。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who rides a horse, bicycle, motorcycle, or another vehicle that is ridden.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 骑马、骑自行车或骑摩托车等的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tirkeb żiemel, rota, mutur jew vettura oħra li tinstaq billi wieħed jirkibha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 骑手；骑乘者。
一名骑手；一个骑乘的人。

formal.mt: Kull rikkieb tar-rota għandu jilbes elmu waqt it-taħriġ.
formal.en: Every bicycle rider should wear a helmet during training.
formal.zh: 每位自行车骑手在训练期间都应佩戴头盔。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ir-rikkieb fuq iż-żiemel abjad? Pawlu: Dak ħija; qed jitħarreġ għall-kompetizzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that rider on the white horse? Pawlu: That's my brother; he's training for the competition.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：骑在白马上的那个骑手是谁？保罗：那是我哥哥；他正在为比赛训练。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ir-rikkieb fuq iż-żiemel abjad?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ir-rikkieb fuq iż-żiemel abjad?
messages.zh: 骑在白马上的那个骑手是谁？
messages.en: Who is that rider on the white horse?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是我哥哥；他正在为比赛训练。
messages.en: That's my brother; he's training for the competition.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 rikkieb 就在脑中画出“骑在上面的人”：可以骑马、骑自行车，也可以骑摩托车；记住这个词指人。

gloss_zh: 丢弃；废弃物；架设；套挽具；萌发；流产

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of throwing something away, or material that has been discarded.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物丢弃的行为，也可指已经被丢弃的废料或废弃物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jarmi xi ħaġa, jew materjal li jkun ġie mwarrab u mormi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 架设；搭建；安置。
给牲畜套上挽具；套具。
废物；废料。
被丢弃的材料；废弃物。

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of throwing sth. away
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物扔掉或丢弃的行为。
动词 rema 的动名词形式，表示相应的动作或过程。
扔掉；丢弃。
发芽；萌发。
流产；妊娠中止。

formal.mt: Ir-rimi tal-iskart għandu jsir fil-postijiet magħżula għal dan il-għan.
formal.en: Waste disposal should take place at the sites designated for this purpose.
formal.zh: 废弃物应在为此指定的地点处置。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn nista' nieħu din iż-żebgħa qadima? Toni: Ċempel lill-kunsill u staqsi dwar ir-rimi tagħha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where can I take this old paint? Toni: Call the council and ask about its disposal.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这些旧油漆可以送到哪里？托尼：打电话给地方议会，问问该怎么处置。

messages.speaker: Nina (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' nieħu din iż-żebgħa qadima?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' nieħu din iż-żebgħa qadima?
messages.zh: 这些旧油漆可以送到哪里？
messages.en: Where can I take this old paint?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċempel lill-kunsill u staqsi dwar ir-rimi tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Ċempel lill-kunsill u staqsi dwar ir-rimi tagħha.
messages.zh: 打电话给地方议会，问问该怎么处置。
messages.en: Call the council and ask about its disposal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“把废物送去处置”的画面记住 rimi tal-iskart；这个词还有其他独立义项，遇到植物或其他语境时要重新按上下文选义。

gloss_zh: 嫩芽；新梢；后裔；一次投掷；志向或使命感

teaching_sense.en_definition: A new shoot or bud growing from a plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物新长出的嫩芽或新梢。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti ġdida u tenera li toħroġ minn pjanta, bħal għajn jew fergħa żgħira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 芽；尚未展开的幼芽。
嫩芽；萌芽；新梢。
后裔；子孙；家族后代。
一次投掷；一掷。
志向；对某种职业或使命的内在召唤。

formal.mt: Matul l-osservazzjoni, dehret rimja ġdida fil-bażi tal-pjanta.
formal.en: During the observation, a new shoot appeared at the base of the plant.
formal.zh: 观察期间，植物基部长出了一株新芽。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ara, ħarġet rimja ġdida! Ġużeppi: Iva, ħalliha tikber u oqgħod attent meta ssaqqi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Look, a new shoot has come out! Ġużeppi: Yes, let it grow and be careful when you water it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：看，长出新芽了！朱塞佩：是啊，让它长吧，浇水时小心一点。

messages.speaker: Sara (园艺初学者)
messages.zh: 看，长出新芽了！
messages.en: Look, a new shoot has come out!

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħalliha tikber u oqgħod attent meta ssaqqi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħalliha tikber u oqgħod attent meta ssaqqi.
messages.zh: 是啊，让它长吧，浇水时小心一点。
messages.en: Yes, let it grow and be careful when you water it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一根刚冒出的绿色嫩芽记住 rimja，并连着念 rimja ġdida“新芽”；后裔、投掷和志向分别另设语境卡片记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The liquid naturally produced in the mouth; saliva or spit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 口腔自然分泌的液体，即唾液或口水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-likwidu li jiġi prodott b'mod naturali fil-ħalq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 唾液；口腔分泌的液体。
口水；吐出的唾液。
唾液；口水；吐出的唾液。

formal.mt: Il-kampjun tar-riq intbagħat lil-laboratorju għall-analiżi.
formal.en: The saliva sample was sent to the laboratory for analysis.
formal.zh: 唾液样本已送往实验室进行分析。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex qed tibla' r-riq? Ben: Qed inxomm il-ħobż frisk u qabditni l-ġuħ!
colloquial.en: Anna: Why are you swallowing saliva? Ben: I can smell the fresh bread, and it's made me hungry!
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你怎么在咽口水？本：我闻到新鲜面包的香味，肚子都饿了！

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么在咽口水？
messages.en: Why are you swallowing saliva?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inxomm il-ħobż frisk u qabditni l-ġuħ!
messages.mt_standard: Qed inxomm il-ħobż frisk u qabditni l-ġuħ!
messages.zh: 我闻到新鲜面包的香味，肚子都饿了！
messages.en: I can smell the fresh bread, and it's made me hungry!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象闻到刚出炉的面包后咽口水，把 riq 和这个口腔画面绑定；实验室里的“唾液样本”则记作 kampjun tar-riq。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The possibility of harm or loss, or a venture undertaken despite that possibility.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发生伤害或损失的可能性，也可指明知有这种可能仍进行的冒险之举。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-possibbiltà ta' ħsara jew telf, jew azzjoni li ssir minkejja din il-possibbiltà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冒险之举；具有风险的尝试或事业。
风险；危险；可能造成伤害或损失的因素。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika riskju għoli ta' għargħar f'din iż-żona.
formal.en: The report identifies a high risk of flooding in this area.
formal.zh: 报告指出，这一地区存在很高的洪水风险。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Naqsmu minn hawn? It-triq kollha ilma. Lara: Ma rridx nieħu riskju; ejja ngħaddu minn triq oħra.
colloquial.en: Mark: Shall we cross here? The road is covered in water. Lara: I don't want to take a risk; let's go another way.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们从这里过去吗？路上全是水。拉拉：我不想冒险；我们换条路走吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naqsmu minn hawn? It-triq kollha ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Naqsmu minn hawn? It-triq kollha ilma.
messages.zh: 我们从这里过去吗？路上全是水。
messages.en: Shall we cross here? The road is covered in water.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma rridx nieħu riskju; ejja ngħaddu minn triq oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Ma rridx nieħu riskju; ejja ngħaddu minn triq oħra.
messages.zh: 我不想冒险；我们换条路走吧。
messages.en: I don't want to take a risk; let's go another way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 riskju 放进“前面可能有损失”的画面，再配动作记忆：tieħu riskju 是冒险，tnaqqas ir-riskju 是降低风险。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Belonging or relating separately to each person or thing in a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 分别属于或对应于一组中每个人或事物的；各自的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jappartjeni jew jirreferi separatament għal kull persuna jew ħaġa fi grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 各自的；分别相应的。

formal.mt: Kull membru tat-tim għandu jifhem ir-rwol rispettiv tiegħu fil-proġett.
formal.en: Each team member should understand their respective role in the project.
formal.zh: 每位团队成员都应了解自己在项目中的相应职责。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawn id-dokumenti fejn inpoġġihom? Nina: Poġġi kull dokument fil-fajl rispettiv tiegħu; l-ismijiet qegħdin fuq il-qoxra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where should I put these documents? Nina: Put each document in its corresponding file; the names are on the covers.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些文件放在哪里？妮娜：把每份文件放进对应的文件夹；封面上写着名称。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 这些文件放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put these documents?

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġi kull dokument fil-fajl rispettiv tiegħu; l-ismijiet qegħdin fuq il-qoxra.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġi kull dokument fil-fajl rispettiv tiegħu; l-ismijiet qegħdin fuq il-qoxra.
messages.zh: 把每份文件放进对应的文件夹；封面上写着名称。
messages.en: Put each document in its corresponding file; the names are on the covers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象每个人拿回贴着自己名字的文件夹：rispettiv 表示“各自对应的”，用来修饰名词；复数搭配中可见 rispettivi。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In the same order as the people or things previously mentioned, with each item corresponding to its partner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按前面提及的人或事物的顺序逐一对应；分别。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skont l-istess ordni tal-persuni jew tal-affarijiet imsemmija, b'kull element jaqbel ma' dak li jikkorrispondi għalih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分别；按所述顺序一一对应地。

collocations.en: ten and twelve years old, respectively
collocations.zh: 年龄分别为十岁和十二岁
分别为第一名和第二名

collocations.mt: ħames ewro u tmien ewro rispettivament
collocations.en: five euros and eight euros, respectively
collocations.zh: 分别为五欧元和八欧元

formal.mt: Anna u Mark kisbu l-ewwel u t-tieni post rispettivament fil-kompetizzjoni.
formal.en: Anna and Mark took first and second place, respectively, in the competition.
formal.zh: 安娜和马克在比赛中分别获得第一名和第二名。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm jiswew il-ktieb u l-pinna? Pawlu: Ħames ewro u żewġ ewro rispettivament: ħamsa għall-ktieb u tnejn għall-pinna.
colloquial.en: Sara: How much do the book and the pen cost? Pawlu: Five euros and two euros, respectively: five for the book and two for the pen.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这本书和这支笔多少钱？保罗：分别是五欧元和两欧元：书五欧元，笔两欧元。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这本书和这支笔多少钱？
messages.en: How much do the book and the pen cost?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħames ewro u żewġ ewro rispettivament: ħamsa għall-ktieb u tnejn għall-pinna.
messages.mt_standard: Ħames ewro u żewġ ewro rispettivament: ħamsa għall-ktieb u tnejn għall-pinna.
messages.zh: 分别是五欧元和两欧元：书五欧元，笔两欧元。
messages.en: Five euros and two euros, respectively: five for the book and two for the pen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rispettivament 想成两列之间的顺序连线：前列第一项对应后列第一项，第二项对应第二项；读到它就检查对应顺序。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An answer or reply given in response to a question, message, or request.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 针对问题、消息或请求所作的回答、答复或回应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tweġiba mogħtija għal mistoqsija, messaġġ jew talba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某个问题、消息或行动所作的回应。
回答；答复；对问题、来信或请求的回应。

formal.mt: L-uffiċċju bagħat risposta bil-miktub għat-talba tal-istudent.
formal.en: The office sent a written response to the student's request.
formal.zh: 办公室就该学生的请求发出了书面答复。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek qed tistenna risposta mingħand l-għalliema? — Lara: Iva, bgħattilha messaġġ dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you still waiting for a reply from the teacher? — Lara: Yes, I sent her a message this morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还在等老师的答复吗？——拉拉：对，我今天早上给她发了消息。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek qed tistenna risposta mingħand l-għalliema?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek qed tistenna risposta mingħand l-għalliema?
messages.zh: 你还在等老师的答复吗？
messages.en: Are you still waiting for a reply from the teacher?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 对，我今天早上给她发了消息。
messages.en: Yes, I sent her a message this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 risposta 和聊天框里等来的那条答复联系起来；搭配 tagħti risposta 记成“给出回答”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Success or prosperity in a person's life, work, or activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人在生活、工作或其他活动中获得的成功、兴旺或顺遂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Suċċess jew ġid fil-ħajja, fix-xogħol jew fl-attivitajiet ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 成功；事情取得良好结果。
成功；个人生活或事业上的兴旺、顺遂。

collocations.zh: 祝你事事顺遂、取得成功

formal.mt: Nawguraw lill-istudenti kollha risq u suċċess fl-istudji tagħhom.
formal.en: We wish all students prosperity and success in their studies.
formal.zh: 我们祝愿所有学生学业顺遂、取得成功。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għada nibda x-xogħol il-ġdid. — Rita: Nawguralek ħafna risq! — Mark: Grazzi, Rita!
colloquial.en: Mark: I start my new job tomorrow. — Rita: I wish you lots of success! — Mark: Thanks, Rita!
colloquial.zh: 马克：我明天开始新工作。——丽塔：祝你一切顺利、大获成功！——马克：谢谢你，丽塔！

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我明天开始新工作。
messages.en: I start my new job tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 祝你一切顺利、大获成功！
messages.en: I wish you lots of success!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 谢谢你，丽塔！
messages.en: Thanks, Rita!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友开始新工作时，你用 risq 祝他事业顺遂；把它与“成功、兴旺”的祝愿一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A repeated pattern of beats, sounds, or movements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 节拍、声音或动作有规律地重复形成的节奏或韵律。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Andament regolari ta' taħbit, ħsejjes jew movimenti li jirrepetu ruħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 节奏；声音、节拍或动作按一定规律形成的韵律。

formal.mt: L-istudenti ċapċpu biex iżommu r-ritmu tal-kanzunetta.
formal.en: The students clapped to keep the rhythm of the song.
formal.zh: 学生们通过拍手来保持歌曲的节奏。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ir-ritmu ta' din il-kanzunetta mgħaġġel wisq għalija. — Pawlu: Ejja niżfnu bil-mod għall-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Lara: The rhythm of this song is too fast for me. — Pawlu: Let's dance slowly at first.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这首歌的节奏对我来说太快了。——保罗：我们先慢慢跳吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-ritmu ta' din il-kanzunetta mgħaġġel wisq għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-ritmu ta' din il-kanzunetta mgħaġġel wisq għalija.
messages.zh: 这首歌的节奏对我来说太快了。
messages.en: The rhythm of this song is too fast for me.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们先慢慢跳吧。
messages.en: Let's dance slowly at first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 ritmu 时配合手指有规律地敲桌子，把词语和耳朵听见、身体跟随的“节奏”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A photograph or a picture showing the appearance of a person or thing, especially a portrait.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现人物或事物外貌的照片或图像，尤其指肖像。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xbieha ta' persuna jew ħaġa, magħmula bil-kamera jew impinġija, speċjalment xbieha ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 照片；用相机拍摄的影像。
肖像；表现某个人外貌的画像或照片。
照片；图像；人物肖像。
呈现某人或某物外貌的肖像、画像或形象。

formal.mt: L-applikant għandu jehmeż ritratt riċenti mal-formola.
formal.en: The applicant must attach a recent photograph to the form.
formal.zh: 申请人须在表格上附上一张近期照片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tiħodli ritratt ħdejn il-baħar? — Mark: Żgur! Ħares lejn il-kamera.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you take a photo of me by the sea? — Mark: Of course! Look at the camera.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能在海边给我拍张照吗？——马克：当然！看镜头。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你能在海边给我拍张照吗？
messages.en: Can you take a photo of me by the sea?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 当然！看镜头。
messages.en: Of course! Look at the camera.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象相机拍下一张 ritratt，再把照片放进肖像相框；用同一个画面连接“照片”和“肖像”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The feathers covering a bird's body, considered together as its plumage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟身上的羽毛，常作为整体理解为羽衣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kisja ta' għasfur magħmula minn għadd ta' strutturi ħfief li jgħattulu ġismu u jgħinuh iżomm sħun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 羽毛；鸟类体表轻而柔韧的覆盖物。

sense_translations.en_definition: dry fly (a type of fishing hook that stays on the water's surface)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 干式毛钩；漂浮在水面、模仿昆虫供鱼咬食的一种钓钩。
羽毛；鸟类全身羽毛构成的羽衣。

formal.mt: Ir-rix jgħin lill-għasafar iżommu sħan u jipproteġi ġisimhom.
formal.en: Feathers help birds stay warm and protect their bodies.
formal.zh: 羽毛帮助鸟类保暖，并保护它们的身体。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara kemm għandu rix ikkulurit dak l-għasfur! — Rita: Iva, ir-rix ta' denbu sabiħ ħafna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look how colourful that bird's feathers are! — Rita: Yes, its tail feathers are beautiful.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看，那只鸟的羽毛颜色多鲜艳！——丽塔：是呀，它尾巴上的羽毛特别漂亮。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm għandu rix ikkulurit dak l-għasfur!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm għandu rix ikkulurit dak l-għasfur!
messages.zh: 看，那只鸟的羽毛颜色多鲜艳！
messages.en: Look how colourful that bird's feathers are!

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ir-rix ta' denbu sabiħ ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ir-rix ta' denbu sabiħ ħafna.
messages.zh: 是呀，它尾巴上的羽毛特别漂亮。
messages.en: Yes, its tail feathers are beautiful.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rix 记成鸟身上一整层轻软羽毛；遇到钓鱼语境时，再联想漂在水面、模仿昆虫的干式毛钩。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To use a rake to gather loose material or to loosen and level soil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用耙子聚拢散落物，或将土壤耙松、耙平。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uża rixtellu biex jiġbor materjal mifrux jew biex ifarrak u jwitti l-ħamrija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用耙子耙；把落叶等散落物耙到一起，或耙整地面。
耙；耙地；用耙具疏松、打碎或整平土壤。
梳理；用梳子将毛发等梳顺。
梳毛；用梳毛器具将羊毛等纤维梳松、理顺。
挠头；用手指抓挠自己的头部。

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar rixtel il-ħamrija qabel ma żera' ż-żrieragħ.
formal.en: The gardener raked the soil before sowing the seeds.
formal.zh: 园丁在播种前耙整了土壤。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min rixtel il-weraq fil-ġnien? — Pawlu: Jien. Ġbartu kollu f'rokna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who raked the leaves in the garden? — Pawlu: I did. I gathered them all in a corner.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁把花园里的落叶耙起来了？——保罗：是我。我把它们全都拢到一个角落了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把花园里的落叶耙起来了？
messages.en: Who raked the leaves in the garden?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 是我。我把它们全都拢到一个角落了。
messages.en: I did. I gathered them all in a corner.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用动作串联记忆 rixtel：先耙落叶，再梳毛发、梳羊毛，最后挠挠头；这些是记忆画面，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rack used to hold or arrange plates; also a small wooden gate separating two spaces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于放置、排列盘子的碗碟架；也指分隔两个空间的小木门。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Struttura li fiha jitqiegħdu l-platti; ukoll xatba żgħira tal-injam li tifred naħa minn oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 碗碟架；用于竖放或收纳盘子的架子。

sense_translations.en_definition: A kind of small wooden gate which separates on side from another
sense_translations.zh_definition: 分隔两侧空间的一种小木门或木隔门。
盘架；用于摆放盘子或碗碟的架子。

collocations.en: put the plates in the plate rack
a wooden rack or small wooden gate, depending on context
collocations.zh: 木制架子或小木隔门，具体依语境判断

formal.mt: Wara l-ħasil, il-platti jitqiegħdu fir-rixtelliera biex jinxfu.
formal.en: After washing, the plates are placed in the plate rack to dry.
formal.zh: 盘子洗净后放在碗碟架上晾干。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-platti? — Rita: Fir-rixtelliera ħdejn is-sink. — Mark: Tajjeb, hemm post għalihom kollha.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where should I put these plates? — Rita: In the plate rack beside the sink. — Mark: Great, there's room for all of them.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这些盘子放在哪里？——丽塔：放在水槽旁边的碗碟架上。——马克：好，那里放得下全部盘子。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 这些盘子放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put these plates?

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 放在水槽旁边的碗碟架上。
messages.en: In the plate rack beside the sink.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 好，那里放得下全部盘子。
messages.en: Great, there's room for all of them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“盘子一只只竖在架子里”的画面记 rixtelliera，再补记分隔两边的小木门义；靠摆盘和隔开的场景区分。

gloss_zh: 栅门；栏栅；围栅；耙子；亚麻梳

teaching_sense.en_definition: A gate or railing that closes or marks an entrance or boundary; also a garden rake or a comb for flax.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于封闭入口或划分边界的栅门、栏栅；也可指园艺耙子或梳理亚麻纤维的梳具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xatba jew struttura ta' vireg li tagħlaq daħla jew tifred spazju; ukoll għodda bi snien biex tiġbor il-weraq, taħdem il-ħamrija jew tgħaqqad il-kittien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 栅门；设置在出入口、可以开关的门。
栏杆、栏栅；栅门。
围栅；用竖立木桩等构成的围栏或防护栅。
耙子；用于耙拢落叶或整理土壤的园艺工具。
亚麻梳；用于梳理、分开亚麻纤维的带齿工具。

collocations.en: gather the leaves with a rake

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi għandhom jagħlqu r-rixtellu warajhom meta jidħlu fil-ġnien.
formal.en: Visitors must close the gate behind them when entering the garden.
formal.zh: 访客进入花园后须随手关上栅门。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu r-rixtellu biex niġbor il-weraq? — Pawlu: Fil-barrakka, ħdejn il-pala. — Maja: Sib tu! Issa nista' nibda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where's the rake so I can gather the leaves? — Pawlu: In the shed, beside the spade. — Maja: Found it! Now I can start.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：耙子在哪里？我要把落叶拢起来。——保罗：在棚子里，铲子旁边。——玛雅：找到了！现在可以开始了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu r-rixtellu biex niġbor il-weraq?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu r-rixtellu biex niġbor il-weraq?
messages.zh: 耙子在哪里？我要把落叶拢起来。
messages.en: Where's the rake so I can gather the leaves?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 在棚子里，铲子旁边。
messages.en: In the shed, beside the spade.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 找到了！现在可以开始了。
messages.en: Found it! Now I can start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用几幅带横杆或齿列的画面记 rixtellu：入口的栅门、边界的围栅、地上的耙子和梳亚麻的工具；这是形象联想，不是词源说明。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who cards wool or other fibres to prepare them for spinning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将羊毛等纤维梳理整齐，为纺纱作准备的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tixxettel is-suf jew fibri oħra biex tippreparahom għall-għażil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 梳理羊毛等纤维的人。
梳毛工；从事纤维梳理的人。

formal.mt: Ir-rixtiel ipprepara s-suf għall-għażil billi xettlu bir-reqqa.
formal.en: The carder prepared the wool for spinning by carefully carding it.
formal.zh: 梳毛工仔细梳理羊毛，为纺纱作好了准备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jagħmel ir-rixtiel? Pawlu: Ixettel is-suf biex ikun lest għall-għażil.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does a carder do? Pawlu: He cards wool so that it is ready for spinning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：梳毛工做什么？保罗：他梳理羊毛，让羊毛可以用来纺纱。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 梳毛工做什么？
messages.en: What does a carder do?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ixettel is-suf biex ikun lest għall-għażil.
messages.mt_standard: Ixettel is-suf biex ikun lest għall-għażil.
messages.zh: 他梳理羊毛，让羊毛可以用来纺纱。
messages.en: He cards wool so that it is ready for spinning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rixtiel 与“梳毛工先梳顺羊毛，再交给纺纱工”的画面绑定，记住它指人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Instructions for preparing a dish, or a doctor's written instructions for obtaining and using medicine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说明如何制作菜肴的食谱，或医生开具的配药及用药处方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Struzzjonijiet biex tipprepara platt tal-ikel, jew struzzjonijiet miktuba minn tabib biex tikseb u tuża mediċina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 食谱；说明食材、用量和制作步骤的配方。
处方；医生开具的药物及用法说明。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent ippreżenta r-riċetta tat-tabib lill-ispiżjar biex jieħu l-mediċina.
formal.en: The patient presented the doctor's prescription to the pharmacist to obtain the medicine.
formal.zh: 患者向药剂师出示医生的处方，以领取药物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kejk tajjeb ħafna! Għandek ir-riċetta? Mark: Iva, nibgħathielek. Maja: Grazzi, irrid nipprova nagħmlu d-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: This cake is delicious! Do you have the recipe? Mark: Yes, I'll send it to you. Maja: Thanks, I want to try making it at home.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个蛋糕真好吃！你有食谱吗？Mark：有，我发给你。Maja：谢谢，我想在家试着做。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kejk tajjeb ħafna! Għandek ir-riċetta?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kejk tajjeb ħafna! Għandek ir-riċetta?
messages.zh: 这个蛋糕真好吃！你有食谱吗？
messages.en: This cake is delicious! Do you have the recipe?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，我发给你。
messages.en: Yes, I'll send it to you.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谢谢，我想在家试着做。
messages.en: Thanks, I want to try making it at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两张写着用量和步骤的纸：厨房里是食谱，药房里是处方；同一个词靠场景区分。

gloss_zh: 腿；脚；物体底端与支靠面之间的空隙

teaching_sense.en_definition: A leg: a body part used for standing and walking, or a supporting part of an object such as a table.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 腿，即身体用于站立和行走的部位；也可指桌子等物体的支撑腿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti tal-ġisem li tintuża biex wieħed joqgħod wieqaf u jimxi, jew parti li ssostni oġġett bħal mejda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腿；身体用于站立和行走的部位，也可指家具等的支撑腿。

sense_translations.en_definition: space between the bottom end of an object and the surface it is leaning against
sense_translations.zh_definition: 物体底端与其所倚靠的表面之间的空隙。
腿；脚，具体所指依语境而定。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstab li riġel tal-mejda kien miksur.
formal.en: During the inspection, a table leg was found to be broken.
formal.zh: 检查时发现一条桌腿已经断裂。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandi uġigħ fir-riġel wara l-mixja. Maja: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda u nistrieħu ftit.
colloquial.en: Mark: My leg hurts after the walk. Maja: Let's sit down and rest for a bit.
colloquial.zh: 马克：走完这段路，我腿疼。玛雅：我们坐下来休息一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 走完这段路，我腿疼。
messages.en: My leg hurts after the walk.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda u nistrieħu ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda u nistrieħu ftit.
messages.zh: 我们坐下来休息一会儿吧。
messages.en: Let's sit down and rest for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用自己的腿记 riġel，再联想支撑桌子的桌腿；遇到特殊空隙义时，单独结合物体位置记忆。

gloss_zh: 气味；臭味；隐约的感觉或迹象

teaching_sense.en_definition: A smell perceived through the nose, whether pleasant or unpleasant; figuratively, a hint or feeling that something is present or may happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鼻子闻到的气味，可以好闻也可以难闻；比喻某事存在或即将发生的隐约迹象或感觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li jinħass bl-imnieħer, sew jekk ikun pjaċevoli u sew jekk ikun ħażin; b'mod figurattiv, ħjiel jew sensazzjoni dwar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 气味；由嗅觉感知到的味道。
气味；某人或某物散发出的味道。
恶臭；强烈而难闻的气味。
一种气味；一股味道。
臭味；难闻的气味或恶臭。
隐约的迹象、感觉或预感。

formal.mt: Mill-forn kienet ħierġa riħa ta' ħobż frisk li nħasset fit-triq kollha.
formal.en: The smell of fresh bread was coming from the bakery and could be detected along the whole street.
formal.zh: 面包店飘出新鲜面包的香味，整条街都闻得到。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'riħa tajba! Qed taħmi xi ħaġa? Maja: Iva, għandi kejk fil-forn.
colloquial.en: Lara: What a lovely smell! Are you baking something? Maja: Yes, I have a cake in the oven.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：好香啊！你在烤什么东西吗？玛雅：是啊，烤箱里有个蛋糕。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'riħa tajba! Qed taħmi xi ħaġa?
messages.mt_standard: X'riħa tajba! Qed taħmi xi ħaġa?
messages.zh: 好香啊！你在烤什么东西吗？
messages.en: What a lovely smell! Are you baking something?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，烤箱里有个蛋糕。
messages.en: Yes, I have a cake in the oven.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 riħa 时先想鼻子闻味道：配 tajba 可以香，配 ħażina 可以臭；比喻义可联想察觉到某事的苗头。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The joint in the middle of the leg where it bends.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 腿部中间连接大腿和小腿、使腿能够弯曲的关节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ġog bejn il-koxxa u l-parti t'isfel tar-riġel, fejn ir-riġel jitgħawweġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 膝盖；连接大腿与小腿的关节。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent ħass uġigħ fl-irkoppa waqt li kien tiela' t-taraġ.
formal.en: The patient felt pain in his knee while climbing the stairs.
formal.zh: 患者上楼梯时感到膝盖疼痛。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed timxi bil-mod? Mark: Waqajt ilbieraħ u għadha tuġagħni l-irkoppa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you walking slowly? Mark: I fell yesterday, and my knee still hurts.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么走得这么慢？马克：我昨天摔倒了，膝盖现在还疼。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么走得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you walking slowly?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Waqajt ilbieraħ u għadha tuġagħni l-irkoppa.
messages.mt_standard: Waqajt ilbieraħ u għadha tuġagħni l-irkoppa.
messages.zh: 我昨天摔倒了，膝盖现在还疼。
messages.en: I fell yesterday, and my knee still hurts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 rkoppa，就想象上楼时弯曲的膝盖；配合轻触膝盖的动作一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rubbish or unwanted things that are considered useless.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被认为没有用处、需要清理或丢弃的垃圾和杂物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żibel jew affarijiet bla bżonn li jitqiesu bla użu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 垃圾；丢弃的废物。
无用的东西；没有用处的杂物。
垃圾；废物；无用杂物。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema neħħew munzell rmixk mill-maħżen qabel ma bdew it-tiswijiet.
formal.en: The workers removed a heap of rubbish from the storeroom before starting the repairs.
formal.zh: 工人在开始维修前，从储藏室清走了一堆垃圾杂物。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex ma nistgħux nidħlu fil-garaxx? Ben: Għax mimli rmixk; irridu nneħħu l-affarijiet li m'għadniex nużaw.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why can't we get into the garage? Ben: Because it is full of useless stuff; we need to remove the things we no longer use.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我们为什么进不了车库？本：因为里面堆满了无用杂物；我们得把不用的东西清走。

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.zh: 我们为什么进不了车库？
messages.en: Why can't we get into the garage?

messages.speaker: Ben (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax mimli rmixk; irridu nneħħu l-affarijiet li m'għadniex nużaw.
messages.mt_standard: Għax mimli rmixk; irridu nneħħu l-affarijiet li m'għadniex nużaw.
messages.zh: 因为里面堆满了无用杂物；我们得把不用的东西清走。
messages.en: Because it is full of useless stuff; we need to remove the things we no longer use.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rmixk 放进“清理车库”的情景：眼前那堆没用、准备清走的东西就是它。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An anchor, a mooring or berth, or an area of water where vessels can lie at anchor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指船锚、船舶系泊的泊位，或供船舶抛锚停泊的水域；具体所指由上下文决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ankra, post fejn tintrabat jew titwaqqaf dgħajsa, jew żona tal-baħar fejn il-bastimenti jistgħu jibqgħu ankrati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锚；用于固定船舶的锚具。
系泊处；供船舶停靠或系泊的泊位。
锚地；供船舶抛锚停泊、具有一定遮蔽条件的水域。

formal.mt: Il-kaptan talab rmiġġ fil-port għad-dgħajsa tiegħu.
formal.en: The captain requested a berth in the harbour for his boat.
formal.zh: 船长为自己的船申请了一个港内泊位。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Sibt rmiġġ għad-dgħajsa? Rita: Iva, sibt post fil-port, ħdejn id-daħla.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did you find a mooring for the boat? Rita: Yes, I found a place in the harbour, near the entrance.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你找到小船的系泊处了吗？丽塔：找到了，在港内靠近入口的地方。

messages.speaker: Mark (船主)
messages.zh: 你找到小船的系泊处了吗？
messages.en: Did you find a mooring for the boat?

messages.speaker: Rita (同行船员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, sibt post fil-port, ħdejn id-daħla.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, sibt post fil-port, ħdejn id-daħla.
messages.zh: 找到了，在港内靠近入口的地方。
messages.en: Yes, I found a place in the harbour, near the entrance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“船锚—系泊处—锚地”三幅相连的画面记 rmiġġ，再根据句子判断指物件还是地点。

gloss_zh: 拖曳；拖走车辆或重型机械

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pull a vehicle or another heavy object along using another vehicle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用另一辆车牵引车辆或其他重物，使其移动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġibed vettura jew oġġett tqil minn post għal ieħor permezz ta' vettura oħra.

sense_translations.en_definition: to tow (usually used for vehicles or heavy machinery)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拖曳；牵引，通常用于车辆或重型机械。
拖曳；用车辆等牵引另一物体移动。

formal.mt: It-trakk rmonka l-karozza li waqfet fit-triq sal-garaxx.
formal.en: The truck towed the car that had broken down on the road to the garage.
formal.zh: 卡车把在路上抛锚的汽车拖到了修理厂。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif waslet il-karozza għand il-mekkanik? Mark: Ġie trakk u rmonka l-karozza sal-garaxx.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did the car get to the mechanic? Mark: A truck came and towed the car to the garage.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：汽车是怎么送到修车师傅那里的？马克：来了一辆卡车，把汽车拖到了修理厂。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 汽车是怎么送到修车师傅那里的？
messages.en: How did the car get to the mechanic?

messages.speaker: Mark (车主)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġie trakk u rmonka l-karozza sal-garaxx.
messages.mt_standard: Ġie trakk u rmonka l-karozza sal-garaxx.
messages.zh: 来了一辆卡车，把汽车拖到了修理厂。
messages.en: A truck came and towed the car to the garage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象前车用拖绳拉着故障车移动，把 rmonka 与“车辆牵引车辆”的动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To succeed, do well or prosper, or manage to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 取得成功、发展兴旺，或经过努力设法完成某件事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kiseb suċċess, mar tajjeb jew għamel progress, jew irnexxielu jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 成功；达到预期目标。
兴旺；发展顺利；日益成功。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be able to, to manage
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够做到；设法办成某事。

formal.mt: L-istudent rnexxa fl-eżami wara xhur ta' studju regolari.
formal.en: The student succeeded in the exam after months of regular study.
formal.zh: 经过数月有规律的学习，这名学生在考试中取得了成功。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar ħuk fl-eżami? Lara: Rnexxa! Studja ħafna u issa jinsab ferħan.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did your brother do in the exam? Lara: He passed! He studied hard, and now he is happy.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你哥哥考得怎么样？拉拉：考过了！他很用功，现在很开心。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥考得怎么样？
messages.en: How did your brother do in the exam?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rnexxa! Studja ħafna u issa jinsab ferħan.
messages.mt_standard: Rnexxa! Studja ħafna u issa jinsab ferħan.
messages.zh: 考过了！他很用功，现在很开心。
messages.en: He passed! He studied hard, and now he is happy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“努力之后办成了”串起 rnexxa：考试成功、生意兴旺，以及终于设法做到某事。

gloss_zh: 四分之一；四分之一胴体的肉

teaching_sense.en_definition: One of four equal parts of a whole, including a quarter of an animal's carcass used as meat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 整体四等份中的一份，也可指牲畜胴体分成四份后的一份肉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda minn erba' partijiet indaqs ta' ħaġa sħiħa, ukoll waħda mill-erba' partijiet ta' karkassa għall-laħam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 四分之一；整体四等份中的一份。
四分之一胴体的肉；牲畜胴体四分后的一份。

formal.mt: Il-biċċier qasam robbu taċ-ċanga f'biċċiet iżgħar għall-bejgħ.
formal.en: The butcher divided a quarter of beef into smaller cuts for sale.
formal.zh: 肉贩把四分之一牛胴体的肉分切成较小的肉块出售。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan robbu taċ-ċanga? Pawlu: Iva, huwa robbu ta' quddiem; nista' naqtgħu f'biċċiet iżgħar.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this a quarter of beef? Pawlu: Yes, it is a forequarter; I can cut it into smaller pieces.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这是四分之一牛胴体的肉吗？保罗：是的，这是前四分之一胴体；我可以把它切成小块。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这是四分之一牛胴体的肉吗？
messages.en: Is this a quarter of beef?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (肉贩)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa robbu ta' quddiem; nista' naqtgħu f'biċċiet iżgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa robbu ta' quddiem; nista' naqtgħu f'biċċiet iżgħar.
messages.zh: 是的，这是前四分之一胴体；我可以把它切成小块。
messages.en: Yes, it is a forequarter; I can cut it into smaller pieces.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个分成四等份的整体，圈出其中一份记 robbu；在肉铺情景中再联想到四分之一胴体。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A trembling or small shaking movement, especially of the body or part of it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体或身体某个部位出现的颤抖、震颤或轻微抖动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tregħid jew ċaqliq żgħir u ripetut tal-ġisem jew ta' parti minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 震颤；不自主的轻微抖动。
轻颤；短暂而细微的抖动。
一阵颤抖；一阵轻颤。

collocations.zh: 因寒冷而起的一阵颤抖

formal.mt: Qabel id-diskors, il-kelliem ħass rogħda ħafifa f'idejh minħabba t-tensjoni.
formal.en: Before the speech, the speaker felt a slight tremor in his hands because of nervousness.
formal.zh: 演讲前，发言者因紧张而感到双手轻微颤抖。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għandek bard? Mark: Iva, ħassejt rogħda ta' bard; se nilbes il-ġakketta.
colloquial.en: Rita: Are you cold? Mark: Yes, I felt a shiver from the cold; I am going to put on my jacket.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你冷吗？马克：冷，我刚打了个寒战；我要穿上外套。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你冷吗？
messages.en: Are you cold?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħassejt rogħda ta' bard; se nilbes il-ġakketta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħassejt rogħda ta' bard; se nilbes il-ġakketta.
messages.zh: 冷，我刚打了个寒战；我要穿上外套。
messages.en: Yes, I felt a shiver from the cold; I am going to put on my jacket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象寒风吹来时身体轻轻一抖，用这一阵颤抖记 rogħda，也可联想到紧张时手抖。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A corner where two sides meet, or a place near such a meeting point.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两边相接形成的角，或靠近这个交接处的角落。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn jiltaqgħu żewġ naħat, jew spazju qrib dak il-post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 角落；边缘或墙面相接处附近的位置。
角；夹角；两边相交形成的部位。

collocations.en: in a corner of the room

formal.mt: Il-librerija għandha rokna kwieta fejn l-istudenti jistgħu jaqraw.
