formal.en: The library has a quiet corner where students can read.
formal.zh: 图书馆设有一个安静的角落，供学生阅读。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn inpoġġi din il-lampa? Lara: Poġġiha f'dik ir-rokna, ħdejn is-sufan.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where should I put this lamp? Lara: Put it in that corner, next to the sofa.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这盏灯放在哪里？拉拉：放在那个角落里，沙发旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这盏灯放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this lamp?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 放在那个角落里，沙发旁边。
messages.en: Put it in that corner, next to the sofa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两面墙碰在一起，墙边摆着一盏灯：交会处是角，灯所在的位置是角落，把这两个画面都贴上 rokna。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lose one's husband or wife through death and become widowed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因丈夫或妻子去世而丧偶，成为寡妇或鳏夫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef lil martu jew lil żewġu minħabba l-mewt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 丧偶；因配偶去世而失去婚姻伴侣。

sense_translations.en_definition: to become a widow or widower
sense_translations.zh_definition: 成为寡妇或鳏夫；经历配偶去世。

collocations.en: was widowed at a young age
was widowed after many years of marriage

formal.mt: Wara li romol, baqa' jgħix fid-dar tal-familja.
formal.en: After he was widowed, he continued living in the family home.
formal.zh: 丧偶后，他继续住在原来的家中。

colloquial.mt: Lara: In-nannu romol is-sena li għaddiet. Mark: Immorru nżuruh fi tmiem il-ġimgħa?
colloquial.en: Lara: My grandfather was widowed last year. Mark: Shall we go and visit him at the weekend?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我爷爷去年丧偶了。马克：我们周末去看望他，好吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我爷爷去年丧偶了。
messages.en: My grandfather was widowed last year.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们周末去看望他，好吗？
messages.en: Shall we go and visit him at the weekend?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 romol 放进人生经历句来记：“他去年丧偶了。”重点记住这是描述失去配偶这一变化的动词。

gloss_zh: 补丁；一小块土地；一小片地方

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small piece of material used to mend something, or a small area of land or space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于修补东西的一小块材料，也指一小块土地或一小片地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa żgħira ta' drapp użata biex issewwi xi ħaġa, jew biċċa żgħira ta' art jew spazju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一块补丁；一小片或一小块。
一小块土地；一处小地块。
一小片空间；一小块地方。
修补衣服用的补丁；补衣布块。
一小块土地；一处地方。

formal.mt: Wara d-dar hemm roqgħa art fejn il-familja tkabbar il-ħaxix.
formal.en: Behind the house there is a small patch of land where the family grows vegetables.
formal.zh: 房子后面有一小块地，这家人在那里种蔬菜。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi toqba fil-qalziet. Rita: Nista' nsewwih b'roqgħa żgħira.
colloquial.en: Maja: My trousers have a hole in them. Rita: I can mend them with a small patch.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我的裤子破了一个洞。丽塔：我可以用一小块补丁把它补好。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 我的裤子破了一个洞。
messages.en: My trousers have a hole in them.

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝)
messages.zh: 我可以用一小块补丁把它补好。
messages.en: I can mend them with a small patch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把衣服上的一小块补丁和屋后的一小块菜地并排想象：两者都是局部的一小块，用 roqgħa 串起这两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rice grains used as food, either uncooked or cooked.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为食物的米粒，既可指未煮的米，也可指煮熟的米饭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qmuħ li jintużaw bħala ikel, kemm qabel kif ukoll wara t-tisjir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 米；大米；煮熟后的米饭。

formal.mt: Ir-ross għandu jissajjar fl-ilma sakemm jirtab.
formal.en: The rice should be cooked in water until it is tender.
formal.zh: 米应放在水中煮至软熟。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Trid ross jew patata mat-tiġieġ? Maja: Ross, jekk jogħġbok, u ftit ħaxix ukoll.
colloquial.en: Mark: Would you like rice or potatoes with the chicken? Maja: Rice, please, and some vegetables too.
colloquial.zh: 马克：鸡肉配米饭还是土豆？玛雅：请配米饭，再加一点蔬菜。

messages.speaker: Mark (服务员)
messages.zh: 鸡肉配米饭还是土豆？
messages.en: Would you like rice or potatoes with the chicken?

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Ross, jekk jogħġbok, u ftit ħaxix ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Ross, jekk jogħġbok, u ftit ħaxix ukoll.
messages.zh: 请配米饭，再加一点蔬菜。
messages.en: Rice, please, and some vegetables too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象米袋和饭碗上都贴着 ross：马耳他语用这个词连接生米与熟饭，中文则根据做饭前后选择“米”或“米饭”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A circular part that turns to move a vehicle or machine; also a bicycle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 转动时使车辆或机器运动的圆形部件，即轮子；也指自行车。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti tonda li ddur biex tmexxi vettura jew magna; ukoll vettura b'żewġ roti li timxi bil-pedali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轮子；车轮。
自行车；脚踏车。

formal.mt: Qabel il-vjaġġ, iċċekkja li r-rota ta' quddiem iddur sew.
formal.en: Before the journey, check that the front wheel turns properly.
formal.zh: 出发前，请检查前轮能否正常转动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif se tmur l-iskola għada? Mark: Se mmur bir-rota jekk ma tagħmilx xita.
colloquial.en: Lara: How will you get to school tomorrow? Mark: I'll go by bicycle if it doesn't rain.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你明天怎么去学校？马克：如果不下雨，我就骑自行车去。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你明天怎么去学校？
messages.en: How will you get to school tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur bir-rota jekk ma tagħmilx xita.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur bir-rota jekk ma tagħmilx xita.
messages.zh: 如果不下雨，我就骑自行车去。
messages.en: I'll go by bicycle if it doesn't rain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先在脑中画一个轮子，再画一辆自行车，两个图都标 rota；看到“前面的”想到前轮，看到“骑着去”想到自行车。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The path or direction followed when travelling from one place to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从一地前往另一地时所走的路线或遵循的方向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-triq jew id-direzzjoni li wieħed isegwi biex jasal minn post għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行进方向；航向；行进所循的路径。
路线；从出发地到目的地所走的路径。
行进路线；航线；航向。

formal.mt: Minħabba t-temp ħażin, il-kaptan iddeċieda li jibdel ir-rotta tal-vapur.
formal.en: Because of the bad weather, the captain decided to change the ship's course.
formal.zh: 由于天气恶劣，船长决定改变船的航向。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema rotta se nieħdu sal-bajja? Lara: Nieħdu dik li tgħaddi mir-raħal; hija iqsar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which route shall we take to the beach? Lara: Let's take the one through the village; it's shorter.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们走哪条路线去海滩？拉拉：走穿过村子的那条吧，比较近。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们走哪条路线去海滩？
messages.en: Which route shall we take to the beach?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nieħdu dik li tgħaddi mir-raħal; hija iqsar.
messages.mt_standard: Nieħdu dik li tgħaddi mir-raħal; hija iqsar.
messages.zh: 走穿过村子的那条吧，比较近。
messages.en: Let's take the one through the village; it's shorter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在地图上画一条从家到海滩的线，标上 rotta。再对照 rota 的轮子图：双写 t 的 rotta 记路线，单写 t 的 rota 记轮子或自行车。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A decrease in the usual price or amount charged, especially a discount on a purchase.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常价格或收费金额的降低，尤其指购物时给予的折扣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis fil-prezz tas-soltu jew fl-ammont mitlub, speċjalment meta tixtri xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 折扣；从原价中减去的金额。
返利；退还给付款人的部分款项。
降低；价格、费用等的减少。
价格低廉；便宜的程度或性质。

collocations.zh: 百分之十的折扣，即九折

formal.mt: Il-ħanut joffri roħs ta' għaxra fil-mija fuq il-kotba kollha.
formal.en: The shop offers a ten percent discount on all books.
formal.zh: 这家商店所有图书均打九折。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Hemm xi roħs fuq din il-ġakketta? Rita: Iva, illum tiswa għoxrin ewro minflok ħamsa u għoxrin.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is there any discount on this jacket? Rita: Yes, today it costs twenty euros instead of twenty-five.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这件夹克有折扣吗？丽塔：有，今天二十欧元，原价二十五欧元。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm xi roħs fuq din il-ġakketta?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm xi roħs fuq din il-ġakketta?
messages.zh: 这件夹克有折扣吗？
messages.en: Is there any discount on this jacket?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum tiswa għoxrin ewro minflok ħamsa u għoxrin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum tiswa għoxrin ewro minflok ħamsa u għoxrin.
messages.zh: 有，今天二十欧元，原价二十五欧元。
messages.en: Yes, today it costs twenty euros instead of twenty-five.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 roħs 和价签上划掉的原价一起记：价格往下降，就是减价或折扣；强调价格本身很低时，也可理解为低廉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a pale red colour, like red mixed with white.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈浅红色的，即像红色混入白色后形成的粉红色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu kulur aħmar ċar, bħal aħmar imħallat mal-abjad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粉红色的；呈粉色的。
玫瑰；粉红色。

formal.mt: Fuq il-mappa, iż-żona tal-logħob hija mmarkata b'kulur roża ċar.
formal.en: On the map, the play area is marked in light pink.
formal.zh: 地图上，游乐区用浅粉红色标出。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Trid it-tazza roża jew dik blu? Maja: Dik roża, jekk jogħġbok. Taqbel mal-platt tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Rita: Would you like the pink cup or the blue one? Maja: The pink one, please. It matches my plate.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你要粉红色的杯子还是蓝色的？玛雅：请给我粉红色的，和我的盘子很配。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid it-tazza roża jew dik blu?
messages.mt_standard: Trid it-tazza roża jew dik blu?
messages.zh: 你要粉红色的杯子还是蓝色的？
messages.en: Would you like the pink cup or the blue one?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik roża, jekk jogħġbok. Taqbel mal-platt tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Dik roża, jekk jogħġbok. Taqbel mal-platt tiegħi.
messages.zh: 请给我粉红色的，和我的盘子很配。
messages.en: The pink one, please. It matches my plate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一点红颜料调进白颜料，得到粉红色，再给杯子和裙子涂上这个颜色；每涂一件就说 roża，记住它描述颜色的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period of rest or quiet relaxation, especially after effort or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 休息或安静放松的一段时间，尤指活动或劳作后的歇息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żmien ta' mistrieħ jew ta' kwiet, speċjalment wara xogħol jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 休憩；安静休息的状态。
休息；休憩；暂停活动以歇息的一段时间。

formal.mt: Wara diversi sigħat ta' xogħol, il-ħaddiema ngħataw ħin ta' rpoż.
formal.en: After several hours of work, the workers were given a period of rest.
formal.zh: 工作数小时后，工人们获准休息一段时间。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għandi bżonn ftit rpoż wara din il-mixja. Pawlu: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda hawn għal ftit.
colloquial.en: Marta: I need a little rest after this walk. Pawlu: Let's sit here for a while.
colloquial.zh: Marta：走完这一程，我需要歇一歇。Pawlu：我们在这里坐一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi bżonn ftit rpoż wara din il-mixja.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi bżonn ftit rpoż wara din il-mixja.
messages.zh: 走完这一程，我需要歇一歇。
messages.en: I need a little rest after this walk.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda hawn għal ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda hawn għal ftit.
messages.zh: 我们在这里坐一会儿吧。
messages.en: Let's sit here for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rpoż 和走累后坐下歇息的画面联系起来，再用 ftit rpoż 记住“休息一会儿”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become thinner, especially for a person to lose weight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得更瘦或更薄，尤其指人的体重减轻、身形变瘦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir irqaq, speċjalment meta persuna titlef mill-piż tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体重减轻；瘦下来。
变瘦；变薄。

sense_translations.en_definition: to lose weight, to become thin
sense_translations.zh_definition: 体重减轻；变得更瘦或更薄。

formal.mt: Matul is-sena, Pawlu rqaq u l-qalziet li kien jilbes beda jiġih wiesa'.
formal.en: Over the year, Pawlu lost weight, and the trousers he used to wear began to feel loose.
formal.zh: 这一年里，Pawlu 瘦了下来，原先穿的裤子开始显得宽松。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Innutajt li Pawlu rqaq ftit? Lara: Iva, il-ġakketta li kien jilbes issa tiġih wiesgħa.
colloquial.en: Marta: Have you noticed that Pawlu has lost a little weight? Lara: Yes, the jacket he used to wear is loose on him now.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你注意到 Pawlu 瘦了一点吗？Lara：注意到了，他以前穿的那件外套现在宽松了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你注意到 Pawlu 瘦了一点吗？
messages.en: Have you noticed that Pawlu has lost a little weight?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ġakketta li kien jilbes issa tiġih wiesgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ġakketta li kien jilbes issa tiġih wiesgħa.
messages.zh: 注意到了，他以前穿的那件外套现在宽松了。
messages.en: Yes, the jacket he used to wear is loose on him now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“裤子从合身变宽松”的前后画面记 rqaq：它强调变瘦这一变化过程，是动词。

gloss_zh: 薄的；瘦的；纤细的；微妙的；细的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Thin or slender, with little thickness or bulk; also fine in texture or subtle in character.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 厚度小、体形瘦或形状纤细的；也可形容质地细腻或含义微妙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ftit ħxuna jew ġisem irqiq; jista' wkoll jiddeskrivi materjal fin jew differenza sottili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 薄的；厚度小的；瘦的。
清瘦的；身体脂肪较少的。
纤细的；细长的。
微妙的；细微而不易察觉的。
细的；颗粒细小或质地细腻的。

formal.mt: Għal dan il-mudell intuża wajer rqiq li seta' jitgħawweġ faċilment.
formal.en: A thin wire that could be bent easily was used for this model.
formal.zh: 这个模型使用了容易弯曲的细金属丝。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-wajer rqiq biżżejjed għall-mudell? Mark: Iva, u jitgħawweġ faċilment.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this wire thin enough for the model? Mark: Yes, and it bends easily.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这根金属丝做模型够细吗？Mark：够细，而且很容易弯。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这根金属丝做模型够细吗？
messages.en: Is this wire thin enough for the model?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 够细，而且很容易弯。
messages.en: Yes, and it bends easily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rqiq 放在细金属丝和细沙旁边记：它描述“细、薄”的性质，也能延伸到微妙之处。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality or state of being thin, slender, or small in thickness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 薄、纤细或瘦的性质与状态，也可指物体厚度较小这一特征。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew l-istat ta' xi ħaġa li tkun rqiqa jew ta' persuna li tkun rqiqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 薄或纤细的性质；瘦的状态。

formal.mt: Ir-rquqija tal-karta tippermetti li d-dawl jgħaddi minnha.
formal.en: The thinness of the paper allows light to pass through it.
formal.zh: 纸张很薄，因此光线能够透过。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex jidher id-dawl minn din il-karta? Pawlu: Minħabba r-rquqija tagħha; din hija karta fina ħafna.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why can we see light through this paper? Pawlu: Because of its thinness; this is very fine paper.
colloquial.zh: Marta：为什么能透过这张纸看到光？Pawlu：因为它很薄；这是一种非常薄的纸。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex jidher id-dawl minn din il-karta?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex jidher id-dawl minn din il-karta?
messages.zh: 为什么能透过这张纸看到光？
messages.en: Why can we see light through this paper?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba r-rquqija tagħha; din hija karta fina ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba r-rquqija tagħha; din hija karta fina ħafna.
messages.zh: 因为它很薄；这是一种非常薄的纸。
messages.en: Because of its thinness; this is very fine paper.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象光透过一张薄纸：rquqija 指“薄这种性质”，用中文“薄度”提醒自己它是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To come or go back to a place, or to give something back to its owner or original location.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 回到原先的地方；也指把物品交还主人或送回原处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jerġa' jiġi jew imur f'post, jew jagħti xi ħaġa lura lil sidha jew iqegħedha lura fejn kienet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 返回；回到原处。
回来；回到先前所在的地方。
返回；回来。
归还；把某物交还。

formal.mt: L-istudent irritorna l-ktieb lill-bibljoteka qabel id-data stipulata.
formal.en: The student returned the book to the library before the specified date.
formal.zh: 学生在规定日期之前把书归还给了图书馆。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Pawlu diġà rritorna d-dar? Lara: Iva, wasal ftit ilu u qiegħed fil-kċina.
colloquial.en: Marta: Has Pawlu returned home already? Lara: Yes, he arrived a little while ago and is in the kitchen.
colloquial.zh: Marta：Pawlu 已经回家了吗？Lara：是的，他刚回来不久，现在在厨房。

messages.speaker: Marta (姐姐)
messages.zh: Pawlu 已经回家了吗？
messages.en: Has Pawlu returned home already?

messages.speaker: Lara (妹妹)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, wasal ftit ilu u qiegħed fil-kċina.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, wasal ftit ilu u qiegħed fil-kċina.
messages.zh: 是的，他刚回来不久，现在在厨房。
messages.en: Yes, he arrived a little while ago and is in the kitchen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅“回去”的画面记 rritorna：人回家是返回，书回图书馆是归还。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become soft, or figuratively to become less firm in attitude and give way out of sympathy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得柔软；比喻态度软化，因同情或心软而让步。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir artab, jew, b'mod figurattiv, isir inqas iebes fl-imġiba tiegħu u jċedi għax jitħassar lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变软；失去原有的硬度。

sense_translations.en_definition: to give way (to become soft of heart)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 心软而让步；因怜悯或同情而不再坚持。
变得柔软。

collocations.en: he softened in response to the request

formal.mt: Il-butir rtab wara li tħalla għal xi ħin f'temperatura tal-kamra.
formal.en: The butter softened after being left at room temperature for a while.
formal.zh: 黄油在室温下放置一段时间后变软了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Missierek ħalliek tmur għall-kunċert? Mark: Iva, fl-aħħar rtab meta spjegajtlu kemm kien importanti għalija.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did your father let you go to the concert? Mark: Yes, he finally softened when I explained how important it was to me.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你爸爸让你去听音乐会了吗？Mark：让了，我解释了这对我有多重要后，他终于心软了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爸爸让你去听音乐会了吗？
messages.en: Did your father let you go to the concert?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fl-aħħar rtab meta spjegajtlu kemm kien importanti għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fl-aħħar rtab meta spjegajtlu kemm kien importanti għalija.
messages.zh: 让了，我解释了这对我有多重要后，他终于心软了。
messages.en: Yes, he finally softened when I explained how important it was to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把黄油变软与人的态度变软并排想象：rtab 既能说物体变软，也能说心软让步。

gloss_zh: 松弛下来；被放松；被松开

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become slack or loose, especially when something is no longer held tight or under tension.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得松弛或松开，尤指原本拉紧、绷紧的东西不再紧绷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinħall jew isir inqas miġbud, speċjalment meta ma jibqax jinżamm issikkat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被放松；由绷紧变为松弛。
被松开；变得不再紧固。

formal.mt: Wara li tnaqqas il-piż, il-ħabel rteħa u ma baqax miġbud.
formal.en: After the load was reduced, the rope became slack and was no longer taut.
formal.zh: 负重减轻后，绳子松弛下来，不再绷紧。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Ara, il-ħabel rteħa. Pawlu: Iva, se nerġa' nissikkah.
colloquial.en: Marta: Look, the rope has gone slack. Pawlu: Yes, I'll tighten it again.
colloquial.zh: Marta：看，绳子松了。Pawlu：是的，我再把它拉紧。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，绳子松了。
messages.en: Look, the rope has gone slack.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，我再把它拉紧。
messages.en: Yes, I'll tighten it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根绷直的绳子逐渐垂下：rteħa 表示紧张程度降低、松弛下来，抓住“紧变松”的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To withdraw from an activity or withdraw something submitted, or to stop working through retirement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 退出某项活动，撤回已提交的东西；也指结束职业工作而退休。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieqaf jieħu sehem f'attività jew ineħħi xi ħaġa li jkun ippreżenta, jew jieqaf mix-xogħol biex jirtira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 退出；撤回申请、提议等已提交的东西。
退休；结束职业工作。

formal.mt: L-applikant irtira l-applikazzjoni tiegħu qabel ma bdiet l-evalwazzjoni.
formal.en: The applicant withdrew his application before the evaluation began.
formal.zh: 申请人在评估开始前撤回了自己的申请。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Missierek għadu jaħdem l-iskola? Mark: Le, rtira s-sena l-oħra u issa għandu aktar ħin għall-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does your father still work at the school? Mark: No, he retired last year and now has more time for the garden.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你爸爸还在那所学校工作吗？Mark：没有，他去年退休了，现在有更多时间打理花园。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爸爸还在那所学校工作吗？
messages.en: Does your father still work at the school?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, rtira s-sena l-oħra u issa għandu aktar ħin għall-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Le, rtira s-sena l-oħra u issa għandu aktar ħin għall-ġnien.
messages.zh: 没有，他去年退休了，现在有更多时间打理花园。
messages.en: No, he retired last year and now has more time for the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“从参与中退出”串起 rtira：撤回申请是退出申请过程，退休是退出职业工作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being soft; also a lack of firmness in discipline or an overly lenient attitude.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体柔软的性质；也指纪律或管理上的松懈，以及对人过于宽纵的态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa ratba; ukoll nuqqas ta' fermezza fid-dixxiplina jew attitudni li tittollera wisq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 柔软；质地柔软的性质。
松懈；执行、管理或纪律不够严格的状态。
宽纵的态度；对他人的要求或过失过分迁就。

formal.mt: Ir-rtubija tad-drapp tagħmel din il-kutra komda ħafna.
formal.en: The softness of the fabric makes this blanket very comfortable.
formal.zh: 布料的柔软质地使这条毯子十分舒适。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tħoss ir-rtubija ta' din il-kutra? Mark: Iva, ratba ħafna. Nieħduha?
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you feel how soft this blanket is? Mark: Yes, it's very soft. Shall we get it?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你摸到这条毯子有多柔软了吗？马克：嗯，特别软。我们买下它吧？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你摸到这条毯子有多柔软了吗？
messages.en: Can you feel how soft this blanket is?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 嗯，特别软。我们买下它吧？
messages.en: Yes, it's very soft. Shall we get it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象手摸柔软毯子的感觉，再联想到管理时态度太软：rtubija 可表示柔软，也可表示松懈或宽纵。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A holder around which thread, film, or similar material is wound; in another sense, a vertebra.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于缠绕线、胶片等材料的轴或卷筒；另有椎骨的含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li madwaru jitkebbeb ħajt, film jew materjal simili; f'tifsira oħra, għadma tas-sinsla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 线轴；用于绕线的小轴或筒管。
卷轴、绕线轴或筒管；用于卷绕线、胶片等材料的器具。
椎骨；构成脊柱的一块骨头。

formal.mt: Qabel tibda tħit, poġġi rukkell tal-ħajt fuq il-magna tal-ħjata.
formal.en: Before you begin sewing, place a spool of thread on the sewing machine.
formal.zh: 开始缝纫前，请把一轴线放到缝纫机上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu r-rukkell tal-ħajt blu? Mark: Fil-kaxxa, ħdejn l-imqass.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the spool of blue thread? Mark: In the box, next to the scissors.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那轴蓝线在哪里？马克：在盒子里，剪刀旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (缝纫学员)
messages.zh: 那轴蓝线在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the spool of blue thread?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 在盒子里，剪刀旁边。
messages.en: In the box, next to the scissors.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象线绕在线轴上、胶片绕在卷轴上，帮助记住常用义；“椎骨”另配脊柱图片记忆，不必把两个义项强行联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A heron: a bird with long legs and a long neck, often seen standing or feeding near water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鹭鸟，一种腿长、颈长，常在水边站立或觅食的鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur b'saqajn twal u għonq twil, li spiss joqgħod jew ifittex l-ikel ħdejn l-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鹭；一种长腿、长颈，常在水边活动的鸟。

formal.mt: Ir-russett baqa' wieqaf ħdejn l-ilma qabel ma qabad ħuta.
formal.en: The heron stood by the water before catching a fish.
formal.zh: 那只鹭鸟先站在水边，随后捕到了一条鱼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tara dak ir-russett ħdejn ix-xmara? Mark: Iva, għandu għonq twil ħafna!
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you see that heron by the river? Mark: Yes, it has a very long neck!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看见河边那只鹭鸟了吗？马克：看见了，它的脖子真长！

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟伙伴)
messages.zh: 你看见河边那只鹭鸟了吗？
messages.en: Do you see that heron by the river?

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟伙伴)
messages.zh: 看见了，它的脖子真长！
messages.en: Yes, it has a very long neck!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 russett 配上一幅“长腿长颈的鸟站在水边等鱼”的画面，看到这个词就回想鹭鸟的轮廓。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a red or rosy face or cheeks, either naturally or because the face has become flushed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脸或双颊呈红色、红润的，既可描述自然的面色，也可描述暂时脸红的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu wiċċ jew ħaddejn ħomor jew lewn il-ward, b'mod naturali jew għal xi ħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脸红的；面部呈红色的。
双颊红润的；脸颊带有健康红晕的。
满脸通红的；面部因运动、热等原因而泛红的。

collocations.zh: 他跑步后显得满脸通红

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja twila, ir-raġel deher ruxxan u talab tazza ilma.
formal.en: After the long walk, the man looked flushed and asked for a glass of water.
formal.zh: 长时间步行后，那名男子显得满脸通红，并要了一杯水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex int daqshekk ruxxan? Mark: Għadni kif spiċċajt niġri.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you so red in the face? Mark: I've just finished running.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的脸怎么这么红？马克：我刚跑完步。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的脸怎么这么红？
messages.en: Why are you so red in the face?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我刚跑完步。
messages.en: I've just finished running.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ruxxan 放进两张脸的画面：孩子双颊自然红润，跑步的人暂时满脸通红；共同线索都是脸上的红色。

gloss_zh: 灵魂；鬼魂；精神；构成反身代词的词

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person's soul or inner spiritual self; also a ghost or spirit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人的灵魂或内在精神存在；也可指鬼魂、幽灵或其他灵体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti spiritwali ta' persuna; ukoll fantażma jew spirtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灵魂；人的内在精神存在。
鬼魂；被认为是死者显现的幽灵。
精神；灵体；不具有物质形体的精神存在。

sense_translations.en_definition: -self, -selves; used with a pronominal suffix to form reflexive pronouns
sense_translations.zh_definition: 自己；与代词后缀结合构成反身代词，表示动作涉及施事自身，如“我自己”“你自己”。

formal.mt: Fil-poeżija, il-baħar jirrifletti l-paċi tar-ruħ.
formal.en: In the poem, the sea reflects the peace of the soul.
formal.zh: 在这首诗中，大海映照出灵魂的安宁。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għajjien ħafna llum. Maja: Ħu ħsieb ruħek u strieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm very tired today. Maja: Take care of yourself and rest a little.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我今天特别累。玛雅：照顾好自己，休息一会儿。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我今天特别累。
messages.en: I'm very tired today.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu ħsieb ruħek u strieħ ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu ħsieb ruħek u strieħ ftit.
messages.zh: 照顾好自己，休息一会儿。
messages.en: Take care of yourself and rest a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“内在的自己”串联记忆：名词 ruħ 指灵魂或精神；学短语 ħu ħsieb ruħek 时，把 ruħek 整体记成“你自己”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A revolt or uprising against authority; also a noisy disturbance or uproar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反抗权威的反叛或起义；也可指人群造成的骚动、混乱或喧闹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rewwixta kontra l-awtorità; ukoll taqlib, għajjat jew storbju kbir fost in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反叛；对权威或统治的公开反抗。
骚动；人群中的喧嚣、混乱或动荡。
起义；一群人共同起来反抗当权者的行动。
喧闹；许多人激动、愤怒或抗议时发出的嘈杂声。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi r-rvell u t-talbiet tal-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The report describes the uprising and the participants' demands.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这场起义及参与者的诉求。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara fil-pjazza? Mark: Qam rvell, u n-nies bdew jgħajtu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened in the square? Mark: An uproar broke out, and people started shouting.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：广场上发生什么事了？马克：闹起来了，大家开始大声叫喊。

messages.speaker: Maja (路人)
messages.zh: 广场上发生什么事了？
messages.en: What happened in the square?

messages.speaker: Mark (目击者)
messages.mt_spoken: Qam rvell, u n-nies bdew jgħajtu.
messages.mt_standard: Qam rvell, u n-nies bdew jgħajtu.
messages.zh: 闹起来了，大家开始大声叫喊。
messages.en: An uproar broke out, and people started shouting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象广场上人群突然激动起来：若强调反抗权威，理解为反叛或起义；若强调现场声音与混乱，理解为喧闹或骚动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The function or part someone or something has in a situation; also a character played by an actor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某人或某物在一种情境中承担的职责、作用或角色；也指演员扮演的人物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-funzjoni jew il-parti li persuna jew ħaġa għandha f'sitwazzjoni; ukoll il-karattru li jinterpreta attur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 角色；某人承担的职责或某物发挥的作用，也指演员扮演的人物。

formal.mt: L-għalliema għandhom rwol importanti fl-iżvilupp tat-tfal.
formal.en: Teachers have an important role in children's development.
formal.zh: 教师在儿童的发展中发挥重要作用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'rwol għandek fid-dramm? Mark: Għandi r-rwol tat-tabib.
colloquial.en: Maja: What role do you have in the play? Mark: I play the doctor.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在这出戏里演什么角色？马克：我演医生。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你在这出戏里演什么角色？
messages.en: What role do you have in the play?

messages.speaker: Mark (学生演员)
messages.zh: 我演医生。
messages.en: I play the doctor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“你在其中负责哪一部分”记 rwol：舞台上是扮演的角色，生活或工作中是承担的职责和发挥的作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive or get something, or to welcome someone on arrival.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 收到或得到某物，也可指迎接到来的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tieħu jew tasallek xi ħaġa, jew tilqa' lil xi ħadd meta jasal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收到；接收。
得到；收到。
迎接；接待到来的人。

formal.mt: Id-direttur irċieva lid-delegazzjoni fl-uffiċċju tiegħu.
formal.en: The director welcomed the delegation into his office.
formal.zh: 主任在自己的办公室接待了代表团。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark irċieva l-pakkett? Sara: Iva, wasallu dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark receive the parcel? Sara: Yes, it arrived this morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克收到包裹了吗？萨拉：收到了，今天早上送到的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克收到包裹了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark receive the parcel?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 收到了，今天早上送到的。
messages.en: Yes, it arrived this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用开门接东西的画面记忆：门口来包裹就是收到，门口来客人就是迎接；根据宾语区分两种用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hard stone, often with coloured veins, used for floors, work surfaces, buildings, and sculpture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大理石，一种常有彩色纹理的坚硬石材，用于地面、台面、建筑和雕塑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġebla iebsa, spiss b'vini ta' kuluri differenti, li tintuża għall-art, għall-uċuħ tal-kċina, fil-bini u fl-iskultura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大理石；用于建筑、装饰或雕刻的石材。

formal.mt: L-art tas-sala hija magħmula mill-irħam abjad b'vini griżi.
formal.en: The hall floor is made of white marble with grey veins.
formal.zh: 大厅地面由带有灰色纹理的白色大理石铺成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-mejda tal-irħam? Mark: Iva, ara kemm hi tqila! Maja: Mela ejja nċaqilquha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this table made of marble? Mark: Yes, feel how heavy it is! Maja: Then let's move it together.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这张桌子是大理石的吗？Mark：是啊，你看它多重！Maja：那我们一起搬吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这张桌子是大理石的吗？
messages.en: Is this table made of marble?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 是啊，你看它多重！
messages.en: Yes, feel how heavy it is!

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 那我们一起搬吧。
messages.en: Then let's move it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手摸到冰凉、有天然纹理的大理石桌面，把 rħam 与石材的触感和花纹一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become less expensive or fall in price.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 价格降低；变得比以前便宜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jonqos fil-prezz u jsir jiswa inqas minn qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变便宜；价格下降。
折扣；从原价中减去的优惠。

collocations.en: fell in price by two euros

formal.mt: Il-mudell il-qadim rħas b'għoxrin ewro wara li ħareġ il-mudell il-ġdid.
formal.en: The old model fell in price by twenty euros after the new model was released.
formal.zh: 新型号上市后，旧型号降价了二十欧元。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan it-telefon għadu jiswa mitejn ewro? Mark: Le, rħas. Issa jiswa mija u tmenin ewro. Maja: Tajjeb, mela nista' nixtrih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this phone still cost two hundred euros? Mark: No, it has become cheaper. It now costs one hundred and eighty euros. Maja: Good, then I can buy it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这部手机还是卖两百欧元吗？Mark：不是，降价了，现在卖一百八十欧元。Maja：好，那我可以买了。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-telefon għadu jiswa mitejn ewro?
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-telefon għadu jiswa mitejn ewro?
messages.zh: 这部手机还是卖两百欧元吗？
messages.en: Does this phone still cost two hundred euros?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, rħas. Issa jiswa mija u tmenin ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Le, rħas. Issa jiswa mija u tmenin ewro.
messages.zh: 不是，降价了，现在卖一百八十欧元。
messages.en: No, it has become cheaper. It now costs one hundred and eighty euros.

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 好，那我可以买了。
messages.en: Good, then I can buy it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一张从两百降到一百八十的价签，记住动词“变便宜”；名词义“折扣”则对应减掉的优惠。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Costing little money or having a price that is easy to afford.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 花费较少、价格低廉或容易负担得起的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiswa ftit flus jew għandu prezz li wieħed jista' jħallas faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 便宜的；价格低的。
不贵的；花费不多的。
价格可负担的；买得起的。
便宜的；不昂贵的。

formal.mt: Il-ħanut joffri ikel tajjeb bi prezz irħis għall-istudenti.
formal.en: The shop offers good food at a low price for students.
formal.zh: 这家店以低廉的价格为学生提供可口的食物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ktieb jiswa ħames ewro biss. Mark: Kemm hu rħis! Fejn sibtu? Maja: Fil-ħanut ħdejn l-iskola.
colloquial.en: Maja: This book costs only five euros. Mark: That's so cheap! Where did you find it? Maja: In the shop next to the school.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这本书只要五欧元。Mark：真便宜！你在哪里找到的？Maja：在学校旁边的店里。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ktieb jiswa ħames ewro biss.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ktieb jiswa ħames ewro biss.
messages.zh: 这本书只要五欧元。
messages.en: This book costs only five euros.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 真便宜！你在哪里找到的？
messages.en: That's so cheap! Where did you find it?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 在学校旁边的店里。
messages.en: In the shop next to the school.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rħis 写在低价标签上，记住它描述“现在很便宜”；再与 rħas 的“价格变低了”作对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Up to a stated time or as far as a stated place or point.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示时间持续到某一时刻，或空间、范围延伸到某一地点或界限。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tindika ż-żmien li fih tieqaf xi ħaġa, jew il-post jew il-punt li tasal fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 直到；表示某种状态或活动持续到指定时间。
到……为止；表示时间上的终点。
一直到；远至；表示空间或范围所达到的界限。

formal.mt: L-applikazzjonijiet jistgħu jintbagħtu sal-aħħar tax-xahar.
formal.en: Applications may be submitted until the end of the month.
formal.zh: 申请可提交至本月底。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Sa fejn se timxi miegħi? Mark: Sal-istazzjon; imbagħad immur id-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: How far will you walk with me? Mark: As far as the station; then I'll go home.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你会陪我走到哪里？马克：走到车站，然后我就回家。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你会陪我走到哪里？
messages.en: How far will you walk with me?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 走到车站，然后我就回家。
messages.en: As far as the station; then I'll go home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sa 想成一支指向终点的箭头：时间轴上指到午夜，地图上指到车站；sal-istazzjon 中的 sal- 也表达这个终点关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To find a person or thing, or discover information or a fact.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 找到某人或某物，或发现某项信息、事实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Issib persuna jew ħaġa, jew tiskopri informazzjoni jew fatt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 找到；寻获
发现原先不知道的事物或事实
意识到；认识到
觉得某物有用，或认为某人能提供帮助
抓住；捕获
寻找；寻求
查明；得知；意识到
被称为；以某名称为人所知

formal.mt: Wara li eżamina d-dokumenti, ir-riċerkatur sab żball fid-data.
formal.en: After examining the documents, the researcher found an error in the date.
formal.zh: 研究人员检查文件后，发现日期有误。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Sibt iċ-ċwievet? Mark: Iva, sibthom fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you find the keys? Mark: Yes, I found them on the table.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你找到钥匙了吗？Mark：找到了，就在桌上。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你找到钥匙了吗？
messages.en: Did you find the keys?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 找到了，就在桌上。
messages.en: Yes, I found them on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把寻找钥匙的画面连成记忆：sab 表示他找到了，sibt 可用于问你找到了吗；再联系发现事实、意识到问题。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To endure difficulty, sorrow, or delay patiently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以耐心承受困难、悲伤或等待。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tissaporti diffikultà, niket jew dewmien bil-paċenzja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 耐心地承受；隐忍
耐心；能够安静等待的能力

sense_translations.en_definition: patience, endurance (ability to accept sorrow and hardship)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 忍耐；承受悲伤与艰难的能力
容忍；耐心忍受

formal.mt: Matul il-marda twila tiegħu, Pawlu sabar minkejja l-uġigħ.
formal.en: During his long illness, Pawlu endured patiently despite the pain.
formal.zh: 在漫长的患病期间，保罗忍着疼痛，耐心承受。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif baqa' daqshekk kalm Pawlu waqt dik l-istennija kollha? Lara: Sabar, għax kien jaf li t-tabib kien qed jgħin lil pazjent ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Pawlu stay so calm through all that waiting? Lara: He was patient because he knew the doctor was helping another patient.
colloquial.zh: Maja：等了那么久，保罗怎么还能这么平静？Lara：他耐心等着，因为他知道医生正在帮助另一位病人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif baqa' daqshekk kalm Pawlu waqt dik l-istennija kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Kif baqa' daqshekk kalm Pawlu waqt dik l-istennija kollha?
messages.zh: 等了那么久，保罗怎么还能这么平静？
messages.en: How did Pawlu stay so calm through all that waiting?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sabar, għax kien jaf li t-tabib kien qed jgħin lil pazjent ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Sabar, għax kien jaf li t-tabib kien qed jgħin lil pazjent ieħor.
messages.zh: 他耐心等着，因为他知道医生正在帮助另一位病人。
messages.en: He was patient because he knew the doctor was helping another patient.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象排队时平静等待：作动词记为耐心承受，作名词记为耐心或忍耐力，读句子时先辨词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To comfort someone who is sad, worried, or distressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安慰悲伤、忧虑或痛苦的人，使其得到慰藉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti faraġ lil xi ħadd li jkun imdejjaq, inkwetat jew muġugħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安慰；给予慰藉
抚慰；使人感到宽慰
安慰他人的人；抚慰者

sense_translations.en_definition: to console (try to alleviate someone's sadness)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 安慰；设法减轻某人的悲伤

formal.mt: Wara li waslet l-aħbar ħażina, l-għalliem sabbar lill-istudent bi kliem ta' faraġ.
formal.en: After the bad news arrived, the teacher consoled the student with comforting words.
formal.zh: 坏消息传来后，老师用宽慰的话语安慰了学生。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min sabbar lil Lara wara l-eżami? Mark: Ħuha sabbarha u qalilha li tista' terġa' tipprova.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who comforted Lara after the exam? Mark: Her brother comforted her and told her she could try again.
colloquial.zh: Maja：考试后是谁安慰了拉拉？Mark：她哥哥安慰了她，告诉她还可以再试一次。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min sabbar lil Lara wara l-eżami?
messages.mt_standard: Min sabbar lil Lara wara l-eżami?
messages.zh: 考试后是谁安慰了拉拉？
messages.en: Who comforted Lara after the exam?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuha sabbarha u qalilha li tista' terġa' tipprova.
messages.mt_standard: Ħuha sabbarha u qalilha li tista' terġa' tipprova.
messages.zh: 她哥哥安慰了她，告诉她还可以再试一次。
messages.en: Her brother comforted her and told her she could try again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把双写的 bb 想成两个人并肩坐着，其中一人安慰另一人；这是帮助记住拼写与词义的画面联想。

gloss_zh: 砰地撞击；猛关；用力跺；摔东西的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To strike something forcefully or shut it with a loud bang.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用力撞击某物，或将其砰地关上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tolqot xi ħaġa bil-qawwa jew tagħlaqha b'ħoss qawwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 砰地敲打；用力撞击
猛摔；砰地关上
用力跺脚；重重踩踏
扔东西或摔东西的人
猛摔东西或砰地关东西的人
砰地敲击；重击；跺脚

collocations.en: stamped his feet on the floor

formal.mt: Meta daħal buffur qawwi ta' riħ, il-bieb sabbat mal-ħajt.
formal.en: When a strong gust of wind came in, the door banged against the wall.
formal.zh: 一阵强风吹进来时，门砰地撞上了墙。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min sabbat il-bieb? Mark: Jien. Skużani, ma ridtx nagħmel dak il-ħoss kollu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who slammed the door? Mark: I did. Sorry, I didn't mean to make all that noise.
colloquial.zh: Lara：谁把门关得砰的一声？Mark：是我。对不起，我没想弄出那么大的声音。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把门关得砰的一声？
messages.en: Who slammed the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Skużani, ma ridtx nagħmel dak il-ħoss kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Skużani, ma ridtx nagħmel dak il-ħoss kollu.
messages.zh: 是我。对不起，我没想弄出那么大的声音。
messages.en: I did. Sorry, I didn't mean to make all that noise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住门砰地关上、脚重重跺地的声音画面；sabbat 的常见动作重点是用力，往往伴随响声。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Heavy material carried in a vessel to improve its balance and stability.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 船只为保持平衡与稳定而装载的重物或材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal tqil li jitqiegħed f'bastiment biex jgħinu jżomm il-bilanċ u l-istabbiltà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压载物；用于保持船只等稳定的配重材料

formal.mt: Is-saborra fil-qiegħ tal-vapur tgħin biex il-vapur jibqa' stabbli waqt il-vjaġġ.
formal.en: The ballast at the bottom of the ship helps the ship remain stable during the voyage.
formal.zh: 船底的压舱物有助于船只在航行期间保持稳定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm saborra fid-dgħajsa? Pawlu: Biex tgħin lid-dgħajsa żżomm il-bilanċ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is there ballast in the boat? Pawlu: To help the boat keep its balance.
colloquial.zh: Maja：船里为什么放着压舱物？Pawlu：为了帮助船保持平衡。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 船里为什么放着压舱物？
messages.en: Why is there ballast in the boat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (船员)
messages.zh: 为了帮助船保持平衡。
messages.en: To help the boat keep its balance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象船底放着沉重的配重，船身因此更稳；把 saborra 与船底、重量、平衡这三个画面一起记。

gloss_zh: 砰的一下；撞击声；突发事件

teaching_sense.en_definition: A forceful bang or slam, or an occurrence that happens suddenly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次猛烈的撞击或关门声，也可指突然发生的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daqqa jew għeluq b'ħoss qawwi, jew ġrajja li sseħħ għal għarrieda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次猛摔或砰地关上的动作
突然出现或发生的事物
砰的一声；一次重击或撞击
突发事件；突然发生的事情

formal.mt: Il-bieb ingħalaq b'sabta qawwija, u kulħadd fil-kamra waqaf jitkellem.
formal.en: The door closed with a loud slam, and everyone in the room stopped talking.
formal.zh: 门砰地一声关上了，房间里所有人都停止了交谈。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Smajt dik is-sabta? Lara: Iva, it-tieqa ngħalqet bir-riħ.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did you hear that bang? Lara: Yes, the wind blew the window shut.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你听到刚才砰的那一声了吗？Lara：听到了，风把窗户吹关上了。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 你听到刚才砰的那一声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that bang?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 听到了，风把窗户吹关上了。
messages.en: Yes, the wind blew the window shut.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用门突然砰响的瞬间来记 sabta：既抓住一次撞击及其声音，也能帮助联想突然发生的事情。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To block an opening or passage so that something cannot pass through.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 堵住开口或通道，使物体、液体或气体无法通过。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħlaq fetħa jew passaġġ biex xi ħaġa ma tkunx tista' tgħaddi minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 堵住；阻塞
使便秘；使排便不畅
堵塞；阻塞
塞住；堵住开口或使流动停止

formal.mt: L-iskart sadd il-pajp u waqqaf il-fluss tal-ilma.
formal.en: The waste blocked the pipe and stopped the flow of water.
formal.zh: 废弃物堵住了管道，使水流停止。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex l-ilma mhux nieżel? Mark: Naħseb li x-xagħar sadd il-pajp. Ejja nneħħuh.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why isn't the water draining? Mark: I think hair has blocked the pipe. Let's remove it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：水为什么排不下去？Mark：我想是头发堵住了管道。我们把它清掉吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 水为什么排不下去？
messages.en: Why isn't the water draining?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li x-xagħar sadd il-pajp. Ejja nneħħuh.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li x-xagħar sadd il-pajp. Ejja nneħħuh.
messages.zh: 我想是头发堵住了管道。我们把它清掉吧。
messages.en: I think hair has blocked the pipe. Let's remove it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象头发堵住排水管，水无法通过：先记 sadd 的堵住义，再用通行不畅的画面辅助记忆使便秘义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A blockage that prevents something from flowing or passing through.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使液体、空气或其他东西无法顺利通过的堵塞或障碍物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ostaklu li jwaqqaf il-fluss jew il-passaġġ ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 堵塞；通道被堵住的情况。
阻碍；妨碍通行或通过的障碍物。

formal.mt: L-ispezzjoni sabet sadda fil-pajp li kienet qed twaqqaf il-fluss tal-ilma.
formal.en: The inspection found a blockage in the pipe that was stopping the flow of water.
formal.zh: 检查发现管道内有一处堵塞，阻断了水流。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-ilma mhux nieżel. Hemm sadda? Toni: Iva, hemm sadda fil-pajp. Irridu nneħħuha.
colloquial.en: Lara: The water isn't draining. Is there a blockage? Toni: Yes, there's a blockage in the pipe. We need to remove it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：水排不下去，是堵住了吗？托尼：是的，管道里有堵塞，我们得把它清除。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)
messages.zh: 水排不下去，是堵住了吗？
messages.en: The water isn't draining. Is there a blockage?

messages.speaker: Toni (水管工)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm sadda fil-pajp. Irridu nneħħuha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm sadda fil-pajp. Irridu nneħħuha.
messages.zh: 是的，管道里有堵塞，我们得把它清除。
messages.en: Yes, there's a blockage in the pipe. We need to remove it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sadda 联想成管道里卡住的一团杂物：水流到这里就停住，帮助记住“堵塞”。

gloss_zh: 生锈；长期维持恋爱关系；久留一地；发霉

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop rust, especially on an iron or steel object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生锈，尤指铁制或钢制物品的表面出现锈迹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu s-sadid, speċjalment meta jkun oġġett tal-ħadid jew tal-azzar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生锈；表面形成锈迹。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be in a relationship for a long time
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与某人长期维持恋爱关系。

sense_translations.en_definition: to stay in one place for a long time
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在同一个地方待很久；长期留在一处。
发霉；长出霉斑。

formal.mt: Il-kanċell tal-ħadid saddad wara li tħalla għal żmien twil mingħajr manutenzjoni.
formal.en: The iron gate rusted after being left without maintenance for a long time.
formal.zh: 铁门因长期缺乏维护而生锈了。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-katnazz saddad. Ma nistax niftħu. Rita: Ejja nġibu katnazz ġdid.
colloquial.en: Mark: The padlock has rusted. I can't open it. Rita: Let's get a new padlock.
colloquial.zh: 马克：挂锁生锈了，我打不开。丽塔：我们去买把新挂锁吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 挂锁生锈了，我打不开。
messages.en: The padlock has rusted. I can't open it.

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 我们去买把新挂锁吧。
messages.en: Let's get a new padlock.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“挂锁放久了生锈”的画面记 saddad；再用关系、地点和潮湿物品三个场景分别记其他义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The reddish-brown material that forms on iron or steel as it rusts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 铁或钢生锈时表面形成的红褐色物质，即铁锈。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sustanza kannella ħamranija li tifforma fuq il-ħadid jew l-azzar meta jissaddad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锈；金属表面因锈蚀而形成的物质。
铁锈，即铁氧化后形成的物质。
霉或霉斑；使植物受损、枯萎的病害。

formal.mt: Qabel iż-żebgħa, il-ħaddiem neħħa s-sadid minn fuq il-kanċell tal-ħadid.
formal.en: Before painting, the worker removed the rust from the iron gate.
formal.zh: 上漆前，工人清除了铁门表面的锈。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu dan il-kannella fuq ir-rota? Pawlu: Dak sadid. Irridu nneħħuh.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's this brown stuff on the bicycle? Pawlu: That's rust. We need to remove it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：自行车上这些褐色的东西是什么？保罗：那是锈，我们得把它清掉。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 自行车上这些褐色的东西是什么？
messages.en: What's this brown stuff on the bicycle?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是锈，我们得把它清掉。
messages.en: That's rust. We need to remove it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见铁门上的红褐色粉屑就想起 sadid：它是名词“锈”，可与动词 saddad“生锈”配对记忆。

gloss_zh: 净化；清洁；纯净；清澈；落得某种处境

teaching_sense.en_definition: To end up in a particular state or situation, often an unwanted one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 最终处于某种状态或境地，常指不理想的结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spiċċa fi stat jew f'sitwazzjoni partikolari, ħafna drabi mhux mixtieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 净化；使变得纯净。
清洁；使变干净。
纯净；纯洁的性质或状态。
清澈；清晰或明净的状态。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be left; to come to be in some undesired state
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被留下；落得某种不理想的处境。

collocations.en: he ended up without a job

formal.mt: Wara li għalqet il-fabbrika, il-ħaddiem safa bla xogħol.
formal.en: After the factory closed, the worker was left without a job.
formal.zh: 工厂关闭后，这名工人失业了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Luqa safa waħdu fl-istazzjon? Ben: Tilef il-ferrovija, imma sejjer għalih issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why was Luqa left alone at the station? Ben: He missed the train, but I'm going to pick him up now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：卢卡怎么会被独自留在车站？本：他错过了火车，不过我现在就去接他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 卢卡怎么会被独自留在车站？
messages.en: Why was Luqa left alone at the station?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tilef il-ferrovija, imma sejjer għalih issa.
messages.mt_standard: Tilef il-ferrovija, imma sejjer għalih issa.
messages.zh: 他错过了火车，不过我现在就去接他。
messages.en: He missed the train, but I'm going to pick him up now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 safa bla xogħol 整块记成“结果没了工作”；纯净、清澈等义项另设词义卡，并标清名词或动词。

gloss_zh: 旅行；出国；移居国外；出口及出口市场

teaching_sense.en_definition: Travel or the activity of going abroad.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 旅行这一活动，尤其指出国旅行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività ta' min jivvjaġġa, speċjalment lejn pajjiż ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 旅行；出行。
出国；前往国外。
移居国外；从本国迁往其他国家生活。
动词 siefer 的动名词，表示出国或旅行这一活动。
航行；旅行；旅途活动。
出口；出口市场。

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija tħallas l-ispejjeż tas-safar tal-impjegati li jattendu laqgħat barra minn Malta.
formal.en: The company pays the travel expenses of employees who attend meetings outside Malta.
formal.zh: 公司支付员工前往马耳他境外参加会议的差旅费用。

colloquial.en: Sara: Have you got your travel documents ready? David: Yes, the passport and tickets are in the bag.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：旅行证件准备好了吗？戴维：准备好了，护照和票都在包里。

messages.speaker: Sara (旅伴)
messages.zh: 旅行证件准备好了吗？
messages.en: Have you got your travel documents ready?

messages.speaker: David (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-passaport u l-biljetti qegħdin fil-basket.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-passaport u l-biljetti qegħdin fil-basket.
messages.zh: 准备好了，护照和票都在包里。
messages.en: Yes, the passport and tickets are in the bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把护照、机票和行李放进同一幅出国画面来记 safar；再用“人员出行、货物出口”区分相关义项。

gloss_zh: 到哪里；到哪一部分；到什么程度

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to ask or indicate how far something reaches or up to which point it continues.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于询问或说明到达哪里、延续到哪一点，或进展到哪一部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tistaqsi jew tindika sa liema post jew punt tasal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 到哪里为止；直到什么地方。
到哪里；到哪一部分为止。

formal.mt: L-istudent għandu jindika safejn wasal fil-qari tar-rapport.
formal.en: The student should indicate how far they have got in reading the report.
formal.zh: 学生应说明自己已经读到报告的哪一部分。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Safejn wasalt fil-ktieb? Luqa: Sal-kapitlu ħamsa. Għad fadalli ħafna.
colloquial.en: Emma: How far have you got in the book? Luqa: Up to chapter five. I've still got a lot left.
colloquial.zh: 艾玛：这本书你读到哪里了？卢卡：读到第五章，还有很多没读。

messages.speaker: Emma (同学)
messages.zh: 这本书你读到哪里了？
messages.en: How far have you got in the book?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.zh: 读到第五章，还有很多没读。
messages.en: Up to chapter five. I've still got a lot left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指停在书中的某一页，用 safejn 问“读到哪里”；同样可以把这根手指移到地图上的终点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thickness of material covering a surface or lying between other thicknesses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 覆盖在表面上或夹在其他物质之间的一层材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda ta' materjal fuq wiċċ jew bejn meded oħra ta' materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 层；覆盖表面或叠放在其他材料上的一层。
地层；层状结构中的一个层次。
层；层次；地层。
一排；横向或纵向排列成行的一组人或物。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem applika saff irqiq ta' żebgħa fuq il-wiċċ nadif tal-bieb.
formal.en: The worker applied a thin coat of paint to the clean surface of the door.
formal.zh: 工人在门的洁净表面上涂了一层薄漆。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Saff wieħed ta' żebgħa biżżejjed? Mark: Le, nagħmlu saff ieħor meta jinxef l-ewwel wieħed.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is one coat of paint enough? Mark: No, we'll put on another coat when the first one dries.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：刷一层漆够吗？马克：不够，第一层干了以后我们再刷一层。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 刷一层漆够吗？
messages.en: Is one coat of paint enough?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nagħmlu saff ieħor meta jinxef l-ewwel wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nagħmlu saff ieħor meta jinxef l-ewwel wieħed.
messages.zh: 不够，第一层干了以后我们再刷一层。
messages.en: No, we'll put on another coat when the first one dries.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刷子在门上铺出一层薄漆，把这一层叫 saff；再用叠层的岩石和排成行的物品辅助记其他义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove unwanted material from something, for example by filtering or sieving it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 去除某物中的杂质，例如通过过滤或过筛使其更纯净。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa l-impuritajiet minn xi ħaġa, pereżempju billi għaddieha minn filtru jew għarbiel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 净化；去除杂质，使变得纯净。
过滤；使液体等通过过滤材料以除去杂质。
过筛；用筛子分离较细的材料和较大的颗粒。

formal.mt: Il-kok saffa l-brodu b'passatur fin biex ineħħi l-biċċiet żgħar tal-ħaxix.
formal.en: The cook strained the broth through a fine strainer to remove the small pieces of vegetables.
formal.zh: 厨师用细滤网过滤高汤，去除其中的蔬菜碎块。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' nferra' l-brodu issa? Toni: L-ewwel saffa l-brodu b'dan il-passatur.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I pour the broth now? Toni: First strain the broth through this strainer.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：现在可以倒高汤了吗？托尼：先用这个滤网把高汤过滤一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (学厨者)
messages.zh: 现在可以倒高汤了吗？
messages.en: Can I pour the broth now?

messages.speaker: Toni (厨师)
messages.zh: 先用这个滤网把高汤过滤一下。
messages.en: First strain the broth through this strainer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“高汤穿过滤网、碎渣留在网上”的动作记 saffa；换成水是过滤，换成粉末是过筛，核心都是去除杂质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To arrange or place material in successive layers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把材料一层一层地铺放，或使其形成不同层次。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qiegħed materjal f'saffi wieħed fuq l-ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物逐层铺放或叠放。
使材料形成不同层次；使分层。

formal.mt: L-istudent saffaf ramel ta' kuluri differenti f'kontenitur trasparenti biex juri l-konfini bejn is-saffi.
formal.en: The student arranged sand of different colors in layers in a transparent container to show the boundaries between the layers.
formal.zh: 学生把不同颜色的沙子分层装入透明容器，以展示各层之间的界限。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif inqiegħed il-ħaxix fid-dixx? Pawlu: Saffaf il-patata u t-tadam, imbagħad żid ftit żejt.
colloquial.en: Marta: How should I arrange the vegetables in the dish? Pawlu: Layer the potatoes and tomatoes, then add a little oil.
colloquial.zh: Marta：烤盘里的蔬菜该怎么放？Pawlu：把土豆和番茄分层铺好，然后加一点油。

messages.speaker: Marta (学做菜的朋友)
messages.zh: 烤盘里的蔬菜该怎么放？
messages.en: How should I arrange the vegetables in the dish?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (会做菜的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Saffaf il-patata u t-tadam, imbagħad żid ftit żejt.
messages.mt_standard: Saffaf il-patata u t-tadam, imbagħad żid ftit żejt.
messages.zh: 把土豆和番茄分层铺好，然后加一点油。
messages.en: Layer the potatoes and tomatoes, then add a little oil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象透明杯里不同颜色的沙子一层叠一层，把 saffaf 记成“动手分层铺放”的动作。

gloss_zh: 过滤器；炼狱（另有旧义标注）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A filter that removes unwanted particles from a substance passing through it; also a term for purgatory in a religious sense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让物质通过并截留杂质的过滤器；在宗教义中也指炼狱，其中一个所列义项标为旧用法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tneħħi partiċelli mhux mixtieqa minn sustanza li tgħaddi minnha; f'tifsira reliġjuża, il-purgatorju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: （旧用法）炼狱。
过滤器；用于截留杂质的过滤装置。
炼狱；宗教观念中灵魂得到净化的境地。

formal.mt: L-ilma jgħaddi minn saffajja li żżomm il-partiċelli solidi qabel ma jinġabar fil-kontenitur.
formal.en: The water passes through a filter that retains solid particles before it is collected in the container.
formal.zh: 水先经过截留固体颗粒的过滤器，再被收集到容器中。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hi s-saffajja tal-ilma? Mark: Ħdejn il-flixkun. Naddafha qabel tużaha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the water filter? Mark: Next to the bottle. Clean it before you use it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：水过滤器在哪里？Mark：在瓶子旁边。使用之前先把它清洁一下。

messages.speaker: Lara (实验课学生)
messages.zh: 水过滤器在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the water filter?

messages.speaker: Mark (实验课同学)
messages.zh: 在瓶子旁边。使用之前先把它清洁一下。
messages.en: Next to the bottle. Clean it before you use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“过滤器截留杂质”的画面记住 saffajja；读到宗教文本时，再切换到“炼狱”义，不把两个义项混用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pure or free from unwanted mixtures or impurities; in another sense, virginal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 纯净、没有杂质或不必要混合成分的；另可表示贞洁的、保有童贞的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħieles minn impuritajiet jew taħlit mhux mixtieq; f'tifsira oħra, verġni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纯的；纯净的；不含杂质或混合成分的。
贞洁的；保有童贞的。

formal.mt: Id-deheb safi ma jkunx imħallat ma' metalli oħra.
formal.en: Pure gold is not mixed with other metals.
formal.zh: 纯金不掺有其他金属。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan deheb safi? Toni: Le, huwa mħallat ma' metalli oħra.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this pure gold? Toni: No, it is mixed with other metals.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这是纯金吗？Toni：不是，它掺有其他金属。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 这是纯金吗？
messages.en: Is this pure gold?

messages.speaker: Toni (珠宝店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa mħallat ma' metalli oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa mħallat ma' metalli oħra.
messages.zh: 不是，它掺有其他金属。
messages.en: No, it is mixed with other metals.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 safi 和一杯没有杂质的水、一块不掺其他金属的金子连在一起，先记“纯净”，再单独记人物语境中的“贞洁”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Situated low or lower down, as preserved in the place-name Ħal Saflieni.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位置较低或位于低处的；这一形容词保留在地名 Ħal Saflieni 中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab f'pożizzjoni baxxa jew aktar 'l isfel; dan l-aġġettiv baqa' fl-isem tal-post Ħal Saflieni.

sense_translations.en_definition: situated low/lower down. this adjective survives in place-name ħal saflieni, which is sitauated lower down the hill known as tal-ħorr
sense_translations.zh_definition: 位于低处或位置较低的。这个形容词保留在地名 Ħal Saflieni 中，该地位于名为 Tal-Ħorr 的山丘较低处。
较低的；位置在下方的。

collocations.en: Ħal Saflieni, a place-name preserving the adjective
collocations.zh: Ħal Saflieni，保留这个形容词的地名

formal.mt: Fl-isem tal-post Ħal Saflieni, l-aġġettiv 'saflieni' jindika pożizzjoni aktar baxxa.
formal.en: In the place-name Ħal Saflieni, the adjective 'saflieni' indicates a lower position.
formal.zh: 在地名 Ħal Saflieni 中，形容词 saflieni 表示位置较低。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'saflieni' f'Ħal Saflieni? David: Ifisser li l-post jinsab aktar 'l isfel.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'saflieni' mean in Ħal Saflieni? David: It means that the place is situated lower down.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Ħal Saflieni 里的 saflieni 是什么意思？David：意思是这个地方的位置较低。

messages.speaker: Maja (学习马耳他语的游客)
messages.zh: Ħal Saflieni 里的 saflieni 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'saflieni' mean in Ħal Saflieni?

messages.speaker: David (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-post jinsab aktar 'l isfel.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-post jinsab aktar 'l isfel.
messages.zh: 意思是这个地方的位置较低。
messages.en: It means that the place is situated lower down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ħal Saflieni 想成地图上山坡较低处的一个标记，用“地名在下方”的画面记住 saflieni 的位置含义。

gloss_zh: 旅行；出国旅行；国外度假

teaching_sense.en_definition: A trip or journey, especially a journey abroad or a holiday in another country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次旅行或旅程，尤指出国旅行或到国外度假。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vjaġġ, speċjalment lejn pajjiż ieħor, li jista' jkun ukoll għal vaganza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次旅行；一趟旅程。
到国外度假；一次国外假期旅行。

sense_translations.en_definition: a trip, voyage abroad, an instance of such travel
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次旅行或出国旅程；一次这样的出行。

collocations.zh: 离开马耳他的出国旅行

formal.mt: Il-programm tas-safra jinkludi żjara f'mużew u jumejn ta' mistrieħ.
formal.en: The itinerary for the trip includes a museum visit and two days of rest.
formal.zh: 这次旅行的行程包括参观一座博物馆和两天休息时间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qed tippjana xi safra għas-sajf? Luqa: Iva, nixtieq immur l-Italja għal ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you planning a trip for the summer? Luqa: Yes, I'd like to go to Italy for a week.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你在计划夏天去旅行吗？Luqa：是的，我想去意大利待一个星期。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在计划夏天去旅行吗？
messages.en: Are you planning a trip for the summer?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtieq immur l-Italja għal ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq immur l-Italja għal ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 是的，我想去意大利待一个星期。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to go to Italy for a week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 safra 配上一张机票和一只行李箱，记成“一趟出行”；加上国外的目的地，就容易联想到出国旅行或国外度假。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of willingly giving up something valuable for a more important purpose, or an offering made to honor a deity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了更重要的目标而自愿舍弃有价值之物的行为；也指为敬奉神灵而进行的献祭或所献的祭品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti jew iċ-ċaħda volontarja ta' xi ħaġa ta' valur għal għan aktar importanti; ukoll offerta lil divinità jew l-att li ssir din l-offerta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牺牲；献祭。

sense_translations.en_definition: sacrifice, offering (act of giving something up willingly in order to honour a deity; that which is so offered)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 献祭；祭品。指为敬奉神灵而自愿献出某物的行为，也指所献出的物品。

sense_translations.en_definition: sacrifice (act of giving something up for the sake of something more important or pressing)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 牺牲；为了更重要或更紧迫的事情而舍弃某物的行为。

formal.mt: Il-ġenituri għamlu sagrifiċċju finanzjarju biex binthom tkun tista' tkompli l-istudji tagħha.
formal.en: The parents made a financial sacrifice so that their daughter could continue her studies.
formal.zh: 父母在经济上作出了牺牲，让女儿能够继续学业。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex ma ġejtx magħna fi tmiem il-ġimgħa? Daniel: Kelli nistudja. Kien sagrifiċċju, imma l-eżami kien importanti għalija.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why didn't you come with us at the weekend? Daniel: I had to study. It was a sacrifice, but the exam was important to me.
colloquial.zh: Marija：周末你为什么没跟我们一起去？Daniel：我得学习。放弃这次活动确实是一种牺牲，不过这场考试对我很重要。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma ġejtx magħna fi tmiem il-ġimgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma ġejtx magħna fi tmiem il-ġimgħa?
messages.zh: 周末你为什么没跟我们一起去？
messages.en: Why didn't you come with us at the weekend?

messages.speaker: Daniel (备考的同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli nistudja. Kien sagrifiċċju, imma l-eżami kien importanti għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli nistudja. Kien sagrifiċċju, imma l-eżami kien importanti għalija.
messages.zh: 我得学习。放弃这次活动确实是一种牺牲，不过这场考试对我很重要。
messages.en: I had to study. It was a sacrifice, but the exam was important to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“为了更重要的事，主动舍弃珍贵之物”记住 sagrifiċċju；日常语境是牺牲，宗教语境则可能是献祭或祭品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Regarded as holy or connected with religious worship and treated with special reverence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被视为神圣的，或与宗教敬拜有关、受到特别尊崇的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meqjus qaddis jew marbut mal-qima reliġjuża, u ttrattat b'rispett speċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神圣的；因宗教意义而受到尊崇的。
神圣的；圣洁的。
神圣的；圣洁的；与宗教敬拜有关的。

formal.mt: Dan il-post huwa meqjus sagru mill-komunità reliġjuża, u l-viżitaturi huma mitluba jġibu ruħhom b'rispett.
formal.en: This place is regarded as sacred by the religious community, and visitors are asked to behave respectfully.
formal.zh: 这个地方被该宗教团体视为神圣场所，来访者被要求举止恭敬。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex qed titkellem bil-mod? Pietru: Għax dan hu post sagru. Ejja nitkellmu barra.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why are you speaking quietly? Pietru: Because this is a sacred place. Let's talk outside.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你为什么小声说话？Pietru：因为这里是神圣的场所。我们到外面说吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (参观者)
messages.zh: 你为什么小声说话？
messages.en: Why are you speaking quietly?

messages.speaker: Pietru (同行的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dan hu post sagru. Ejja nitkellmu barra.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dan hu post sagru. Ejja nitkellmu barra.
messages.zh: 因为这里是神圣的场所。我们到外面说吧。
messages.en: Because this is a sacred place. Let's talk outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象走进一处受人敬重的宗教场所，脚步和说话声都放轻，用这个画面把 sagru 与“神圣、应当尊敬”联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For lightning to flash in the sky.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指天空中出现闪电，强调闪电闪现这一动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta tidher berqa fis-sema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打闪；闪电闪现

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl sagħaq diversi drabi, u mbagħad bdiet nieżla xita qawwija.
formal.en: Lightning flashed several times during the night, and then heavy rain began to fall.
formal.zh: 夜间闪了几次电，随后下起了大雨。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Rajt? Għadu kemm sagħaq! Pawlu: Iva, ejja nidħlu ġewwa qabel tibda x-xita.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did you see that? Lightning just flashed! Pawlu: Yes, let's go inside before the rain starts.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：看见了吗？刚刚打闪了！保罗：看见了，趁还没下雨，我们进去吧。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 看见了吗？刚刚打闪了！
messages.en: Did you see that? Lightning just flashed!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nidħlu ġewwa qabel tibda x-xita.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nidħlu ġewwa qabel tibda x-xita.
messages.zh: 看见了，趁还没下雨，我们进去吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's go inside before the rain starts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把天空突然亮起的一瞬间想成一个动作：sagħaq 是“打闪了”；与名词 sagħqa“一道闪电”对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sudden flash of lightning in the sky.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天空中突然出现的一道闪电，指一次可见的闪光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Berqa li tidher għal waqt qasir fis-sema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一道闪电；一次闪电的闪光

collocations.en: a flash of lightning in the sky

formal.mt: Sagħqa qawwija dawlet is-sema għal ftit sekondi waqt il-maltemp.
formal.en: A powerful flash of lightning lit up the sky for a few seconds during the storm.
formal.zh: 暴风雨期间，一道强烈的闪电照亮了天空，持续了几秒。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'kien dak id-dawl? Mark: Kienet sagħqa. Dalwaqt nisimgħu r-ragħad.
colloquial.en: Lara: What was that light? Mark: It was a flash of lightning. We'll hear the thunder soon.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：刚才那道亮光是什么？马克：是一道闪电。很快就会听到雷声了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 刚才那道亮光是什么？
messages.en: What was that light?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是一道闪电。很快就会听到雷声了。
messages.en: It was a flash of lightning. We'll hear the thunder soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给夜空拍下一张照片，照片里定格的“一道闪电”就是 sagħqa；用静止画面记住它是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Thyme, an aromatic herb used to add flavour to food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 百里香，一种有香气、可用于食物调味的香草。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxixa aromatika li tintuża biex tagħti t-togħma lill-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 百里香

formal.mt: Żid ftit sagħtar frisk mal-patata qabel iddaħħalha fil-forn.
formal.en: Add a little fresh thyme to the potatoes before putting them in the oven.
formal.zh: 把土豆放进烤箱前，加入少许新鲜百里香。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għandna nżidu mal-patata? Toni: Ftit sagħtar u żejt taż-żebbuġa.
colloquial.en: Nina: What should we add to the potatoes? Toni: A little thyme and olive oil.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：土豆里加点什么好？托尼：加点百里香和橄榄油。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 土豆里加点什么好？
messages.en: What should we add to the potatoes?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 加点百里香和橄榄油。
messages.en: A little thyme and olive oil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sagħtar 写在厨房香料罐的想象标签上，再配上“新鲜”和“晒干”两幅画面，牢牢记住百里香。

gloss_zh: 含百里香的；有百里香味的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Containing thyme or having the flavour of thyme.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容食物等含有百里香，或带有百里香的味道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih is-sagħtar jew li għandu t-togħma tas-sagħtar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 含有百里香的
尝起来有百里香味的
带有百里香特有风味的

collocations.en: bread containing or flavoured with thyme
collocations.zh: 含百里香或带百里香味的面包

formal.mt: Għal dan il-platt, uża żejt sagħtri biex tagħti lill-ħaxix togħma tas-sagħtar.
formal.en: For this dish, use thyme-flavoured oil to give the vegetables a thyme flavour.
formal.zh: 做这道菜时，使用百里香风味油，让蔬菜带上百里香的味道。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-ħobż sagħtri? Ben: Iva, fih ftit sagħtar. Trid biċċa?
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this thyme bread? Ben: Yes, it contains a little thyme. Would you like a piece?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这是百里香面包吗？本：是的，里面加了点百里香。要来一块吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是百里香面包吗？
messages.en: Is this thyme bread?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fih ftit sagħtar. Trid biċċa?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fih ftit sagħtar. Trid biċċa?
messages.zh: 是的，里面加了点百里香。要来一块吗？
messages.en: Yes, it contains a little thyme. Would you like a piece?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张学习卡对照：sagħtar 是香草“百里香”，sagħtri 则贴在面包或油旁边，表示“含它或有它的味道”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stay awake for part or all of the night, usually to work or engage in religious devotion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在夜间一段时间或整夜保持清醒，通常为了工作或宗教祈祷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Baqa' mqajjem għal parti mil-lejl jew għal-lejl kollu, ġeneralment biex jaħdem jew jitlob.

sense_translations.en_definition: to wake (part of) the night (usually for work or religious devotions)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在夜间部分时间或整夜保持清醒，通常为了工作或宗教祈祷；熬夜；守夜

formal.mt: L-istudent sahar jistudja sabiex ilesti għat-test tal-għada.
formal.en: The student stayed up at night studying to prepare for the next day's test.
formal.zh: 那名学生熬夜学习，为第二天的测验做准备。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex Mark jidher daqshekk għajjien? Luqa: Għax ilbieraħ sahar jaħdem fuq ir-rapport.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why does Mark look so tired? Luqa: Because he stayed up last night working on the report.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克为什么看起来这么累？卢卡：因为他昨晚熬夜写报告了。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 马克为什么看起来这么累？
messages.en: Why does Mark look so tired?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ilbieraħ sahar jaħdem fuq ir-rapport.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ilbieraħ sahar jaħdem fuq ir-rapport.
messages.zh: 因为他昨晚熬夜写报告了。
messages.en: Because he stayed up last night working on the report.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象深夜台灯仍亮着，人还在工作或祈祷；用这幅“夜里没有睡”的画面记住 sahar。

gloss_zh: 守夜；夜间祈祷；加班；夜更

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period of staying awake at night, especially for devotion, or a period of working late or overtime.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 夜间保持清醒的一段时间或一次活动，尤指守夜祈祷；也指工作到很晚或加班。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żmien jew okkażjoni li wieħed iqatta' mqajjem billejl, speċjalment fit-talb, jew jaħdem wara l-ħin normali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 守夜；夜间保持清醒的活动
加班；正常工时以外的工作时间

sense_translations.en_definition: vigil (private or communal act of devotion at nighttime)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 夜间的个人或集体宗教敬礼活动；守夜祈祷

sense_translations.en_definition: instance of working late or overtime
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次工作到很晚或加班的经历

sense_translations.en_definition: watch; watch of the night (one of four divisions of the night in Antiquity)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 夜更；古代将一夜分为四段时，其中的一段

formal.mt: Il-komunità organizzat sahra ta' talb fil-knisja nhar is-Sibt filgħaxija.
formal.en: The community organised a prayer vigil in the church on Saturday evening.
formal.zh: 该团体于星期六晚上在教堂组织了一场守夜祈祷活动。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Se terġa' taħdem bis-sahra llum? David: Iva, għandi sagħtejn oħra, imbagħad immur id-dar.
colloquial.en: Marija: Are you working overtime again today? David: Yes, I have another two hours, then I'll go home.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你今天又要加班吗？戴维：是的，还要工作两个小时，然后就回家。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 你今天又要加班吗？
messages.en: Are you working overtime again today?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi sagħtejn oħra, imbagħad immur id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi sagħtejn oħra, imbagħad immur id-dar.
messages.zh: 是的，还要工作两个小时，然后就回家。
messages.en: Yes, I have another two hours, then I'll go home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sahra 配三幅提示图：教堂守夜、办公室加班、古代夜更。先看语境，再选择“守夜、加班或一更”的译法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of catching fish; in another sense, the activity of hunting animals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 捕捉鱼类的活动或渔民的工作；另一个义项指狩猎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività tal-qbid tal-ħut jew ix-xogħol tas-sajjied; f'tifsira oħra, il-kaċċa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 捕鱼；钓鱼。

sense_translations.en_definition: fishing (the act of catching fish; a fisherman's work)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 捕鱼活动；渔民从事的捕捞工作。
狩猎；捕猎动物的活动。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-importanza tas-sajd għall-familji li jgħixu qrib il-baħar.
formal.en: The report describes the importance of fishing for families who live near the sea.
formal.zh: 报告阐述了捕鱼对沿海家庭的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Trid tiġi għas-sajd għada filgħodu? Lara: Iva, imma għandi bżonn nissellef qasba.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you want to come fishing tomorrow morning? Lara: Yes, but I need to borrow a fishing rod.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你明天早上想一起去钓鱼吗？拉拉：想，不过我得借一根钓竿。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天早上想一起去钓鱼吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come fishing tomorrow morning?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għandi bżonn nissellef qasba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għandi bżonn nissellef qasba.
messages.zh: 想，不过我得借一根钓竿。
messages.en: Yes, but I need to borrow a fishing rod.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sajd 配上钓竿和渔网的画面，先记活动“捕鱼”，再用语境区分另一个义项“狩猎”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The season between spring and autumn, usually associated with hot weather.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 春季与秋季之间的季节，通常天气炎热。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istaġun bejn ir-rebbiegħa u l-ħarifa, li normalment ikun sħun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 夏天；夏季。
夏季，指一年中春季之后、秋季之前的季节。

formal.mt: Fis-sajf, il-librerija tiftaħ aktar kmieni biex il-qarrejja jkunu jistgħu jżuruha qabel is-sħana ta' nofsinhar.
formal.en: In summer, the library opens earlier so that readers can visit before the midday heat.
formal.zh: 夏季，图书馆提早开放，方便读者在正午炎热来临前到访。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'se tagħmel dan is-sajf? Pawlu: Se nqatta' ġimgħa ħdejn il-baħar mal-familja.
colloquial.en: Nina: What are you going to do this summer? Paul: I'm going to spend a week by the sea with my family.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你今年夏天打算做什么？保罗：我打算和家人在海边待一周。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今年夏天打算做什么？
messages.en: What are you going to do this summer?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nqatta' ġimgħa ħdejn il-baħar mal-familja.
messages.mt_standard: Se nqatta' ġimgħa ħdejn il-baħar mal-familja.
messages.zh: 我打算和家人在海边待一周。
messages.en: I'm going to spend a week by the sea with my family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 sajf 就想象夏日海边和暑假日历；连同 fis-sajf“在夏天”一起记，更容易放进句子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Related to summer or having the warmth, appearance, or atmosphere of summer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与夏季有关的，或具有夏日温暖、外观或气氛的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mas-sajf jew li jfakkar fis-sħana, fid-dehra jew fl-atmosfera tas-sajf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有夏日气息的；像夏天一样温暖或明快的。
夏季的；具有夏季特点的。

formal.mt: Minħabba t-temp sajfi, l-attivitajiet tal-iskola se jsiru filgħodu.
formal.en: Because of the summery weather, the school activities will take place in the morning.
formal.zh: 由于天气如夏日般炎热，学校活动将安排在上午举行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Illum għandna temp sajfi! Daniel: Veru, ejja mmorru mixja ħdejn il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Sara: We've got summery weather today! Daniel: We really have; let's go for a walk by the sea.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：今天的天气真有夏天的感觉！丹尼尔：确实，咱们去海边散步吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天的天气真有夏天的感觉！
messages.en: We've got summery weather today!

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, ejja mmorru mixja ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, ejja mmorru mixja ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.zh: 确实，咱们去海边散步吧。
messages.en: We really have; let's go for a walk by the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sajf“夏天”和 sajfi“夏季的”并排做词卡：前者给季节命名，后者给天气或衣服添加夏日特征。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sudden bright electrical flash in the sky during a storm, sometimes striking the ground or an object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 暴风雨中天空突然出现的明亮放电现象，有时会击中地面或物体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daqqa qawwija ta' elettriku li tidher bħala dawl fis-sema waqt maltempata u li tista' tolqot l-art jew xi oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一道闪电；天空中突然出现的电光。
霹雳；一道猛烈、可击中地面或物体的闪电。

collocations.en: a bolt of lightning struck a tree
collocations.zh: 一道闪电击中了一棵树

formal.mt: Waqt il-maltempata, sajjetta laqtet siġra qrib l-iskola.
formal.en: During the storm, a bolt of lightning struck a tree near the school.
formal.zh: 暴风雨期间，一道闪电击中了学校附近的一棵树。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt dik is-sajjetta? Luqa: Iva, dawwlet is-sema kollu!
colloquial.en: Maya: Did you see that flash of lightning? Luke: Yes, it lit up the whole sky!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到刚才那道闪电了吗？卢克：看到了，整个天空都亮了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到刚才那道闪电了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that flash of lightning?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，整个天空都亮了！
messages.en: Yes, it lit up the whole sky!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sajjetta 配一张闪电划破天空的图，记住它指那道亮光或雷击，例句里可让它“击中一棵树”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who catches fish, especially as a job.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从事捕鱼的人，尤指以捕鱼为职业的渔民。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taqbad il-ħut, speċjalment bħala xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 渔民；捕鱼的人。

formal.mt: Is-sajjied iċċekkja x-xbieki qabel ma ħareġ bid-dgħajsa.
formal.en: The fisherman checked the nets before setting out in the boat.
formal.zh: 渔民乘船出发前检查了渔网。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min hu dak ħdejn id-dgħajsa? Ġużeppi: Dak zijuwi, sajjied li joħroġ jistad kull filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who is that beside the boat? Joseph: That's my uncle, a fisherman who goes fishing every morning.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：船旁边那个人是谁？约瑟夫：那是我叔叔，他是渔民，每天早上都出去捕鱼。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 船旁边那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that beside the boat?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak zijuwi, sajjied li joħroġ jistad kull filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak zijuwi, sajjied li joħroġ jistad kull filgħodu.
messages.zh: 那是我叔叔，他是渔民，每天早上都出去捕鱼。
messages.en: That's my uncle, a fisherman who goes fishing every morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张图对照记忆：sajd 是“捕鱼”这件事，sajjied 是站在渔船上做这件事的“渔民”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instance of cooking, generally used as a cognate object with the verb meaning to cook.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次或一番烹煮，通常与表示“烹饪”的同源动词搭配，作其宾语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Darba ta' tisjir, ġeneralment użata bħala oġġett mal-verb sajjar.

sense_translations.en_definition: a cooking (generally used as the cognate object of the verb)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次烹煮；通常用作同源动词的宾语，表达烹饪一番。
一次烹饪；一番烹煮。

collocations.en: did a good job of cooking

formal.mt: Il-kok sajjar sajra tajba għall-mistednin, b'attenzjoni għall-kwalità tal-ingredjenti.
formal.en: The chef did a good job of cooking for the guests, paying attention to the quality of the ingredients.
formal.zh: 厨师为宾客好好烹饪了一番，并注重食材的品质。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Illum sajjart sajra tajba! Toni: Grazzi! Ħadt il-ħin tiegħi biex kollox jiġi sew.
colloquial.en: Maria: You did a good job of cooking today! Tony: Thanks! I took my time to get everything right.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你今天这番烹饪真不错！托尼：谢谢！我花了些时间，把每样东西都做好。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天这番烹饪真不错！
messages.en: You did a good job of cooking today!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi! Ħadt il-ħin tiegħi biex kollox jiġi sew.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi! Ħadt il-ħin tiegħi biex kollox jiġi sew.
messages.zh: 谢谢！我花了些时间，把每样东西都做好。
messages.en: Thanks! I took my time to get everything right.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sajra 记成中文的“烹饪一番”：重点是一次烹煮，连着 sajjar sajra 一起读，记住常见搭配方式。

gloss_zh: 烹煮；煮熟所需时间；成熟过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of cooking or the time needed for food to cook properly; also the process of ripening.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 烹煮的过程，或把食物适当煮熟所需的时间；也指果实等逐渐成熟的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess tat-tisjir jew il-ħin meħtieġ biex l-ikel isir sew; ukoll il-proċess li bih il-frott isir misjur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烹煮；使食物变熟的过程。

sense_translations.en_definition: the time required for sth. to be properly cooked
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某种食物适当煮熟所需的时间；烹煮时长。
成熟过程，指果实等逐渐变熟。

formal.mt: Il-ħin tas-sajran jiddependi mid-daqs tal-biċċiet tal-laħam.
formal.en: The cooking time depends on the size of the pieces of meat.
formal.zh: 烹煮所需时间取决于肉块的大小。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm hu twil il-ħin tas-sajran għal dan il-laħam? Mark: Madwar siegħa, imma rridu naraw jekk ikunx sar sew.
colloquial.en: Lara: How long is the cooking time for this meat? Mark: About an hour, but we need to check whether it's properly cooked.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这肉需要煮多久？马克：大约一小时，不过我们得检查一下是否已经熟透。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu twil il-ħin tas-sajran għal dan il-laħam?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu twil il-ħin tas-sajran għal dan il-laħam?
messages.zh: 这肉需要煮多久？
messages.en: How long is the cooking time for this meat?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Madwar siegħa, imma rridu naraw jekk ikunx sar sew.
messages.mt_standard: Madwar siegħa, imma rridu naraw jekk ikunx sar sew.
messages.zh: 大约一小时，不过我们得检查一下是否已经熟透。
messages.en: About an hour, but we need to check whether it's properly cooked.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“逐渐变熟”的画面串联 sajran：锅里的食物在烹煮，计时器显示所需时间，树上的果实则在成熟。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Up to the time when something happens; in a conditional use, unless.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某事发生之前一直持续，即“直到”；在条件用法中也可表示“除非”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sa meta tiġri xi ħaġa; f'użu ta' kundizzjoni, jista' jfisser ħlief jekk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 直到；一直到某个时间或某事发生时。
直到……为止，表示状态或动作持续到某个界限。
除非；若不满足所述条件则不发生，常见于 sakemm ma... 的结构中。
直到……为止；表示时间上的终点或界限。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom jibqgħu fis-sala sakemm tintemm il-laqgħa.
formal.en: Participants should remain in the hall until the meeting ends.
formal.zh: 与会者应留在大厅，直到会议结束。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tista' tistenna hawn sakemm nasal? Pawlu: Iva, nistenniek hawn sakemm ma tagħmilx xita; jekk tibda x-xita, nidħol fil-kafetterija.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you wait here until I arrive? Paul: Yes, I'll wait for you here unless it rains; if it starts raining, I'll go into the café.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你能在这里等到我来吗？保罗：可以，除非下雨，我会在这里等你；如果开始下雨，我就进咖啡馆。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你能在这里等到我来吗？
messages.en: Can you wait here until I arrive?
